recipes.description: Papadam (also papadum, poppadom, papar, and appalam) is an Indian and Sri Lankan flatbread made from black gram bean flour with salt and cumin.

ingredients.text: ¼ cup water (or more if needed)
ingredients.name: woda

steps.text: Mix together the flour, pepper, cumin, and salt.
Add water and knead the dough until it is smooth. You may have to add some water, depending on the flour.
Split the dough into 10–15 balls.
Roll out one ball at a time to a very thin round layer on a slightly oiled surface.
Dry the papadams in the oven for an hour (at about 100°C or 200°F).
Keep them in an airtight container.
Fry the papadams in oil until they are crispy but not too brown.

recipes.title: Banana Pudding
recipes.description: Deser z kremem waniliowym, bananami, wafelkami lub biszkoptami savoiardi i bezą.

ingredients.text: 1 cup + 2 Tablespoons (200 g + 25 g) granulated sugar
ingredients.name: cukier

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon vanilla extract or vanilla sugar
ingredients.name: ekstrakt waniliowy

steps.text: In a saucepan, stir together the milk, 1 cup (200 g) of sugar, butter, salt, and vanilla extract and cook over medium heat until the butter melts.
Whisk the egg yolks in a separate container (a coffee mug will do), then whisk two tablespoons of the hot milk mixture into the egg yolks to temper them so they don’t curdle.
When the egg mixture is smooth, whisk it into the milk mixture.
Add 2 tablespoons of cold water to the cornstarch and stir until smooth; then whisk it into the milk mixture and cook until thickened, stirring constantly so it doesn’t burn.
Remove the custard from heat.
Whip the egg whites and 2 Tablespoons (25 g) sugar in a bowl until stiff peaks form.
Cut the bananas into thin slices (about ¼ inch or 5 mm thick).
In a large bowl with a flat bottom, place a layer of vanilla wafers or ladyfingers on the bottom.
Pour half of the lemon juice and spread half of the custard over these, then layer half of the banana slices on top of the custard.
Add another layer of cookies, the rest of the lemon juice, the rest of the custard, and the rest of the banana slices.
Top with the meringue and sprinkle the coconut on top.
Refrigerate for several hours before serving.

recipes.title: Cheesy Chicken Pasta
recipes.description: A quick pasta with cream cheese, mozzarella, cheddar, chopped chicken and hoisin sauce.

ingredients.text: ¾ cup (85 g/3 oz) dried pasta (whatever shape you like)
ingredients.name: makaron pszenny

ingredients.text: ¾ cup (75 g) grated mozzarella cheese
ingredients.name: mozzarella

ingredients.text: ¾ cup (75 g) grated cheddar cheese
ingredients.name: ser cheddar

ingredients.text: ½ cup (125 ml) heavy whipping cream
ingredients.name: śmietanka 36%

steps.text: Bring a pot of water to the boil. Add the pasta and cook for about 10 minutes (or until the pasta is soft).
Drain the pasta so that no water remains in the pan. Return drained pasta to the pot.
Add the cream, cheeses, chicken, and hoisin sauce to the pasta.
Cook for a few minutes to warm everything through.
Serve.

recipes.title: Pattaya Fried Rice
recipes.description: Malaysian dish of chicken fried rice wrapped in an omelette pouch, similar to Japanese omurice.

ingredients.text: 3 tbsp olive oil (2 tbsp for frying and 1 tbsp for making an omelette)
ingredients.name: oliwa z oliwek
ingredients.note: 2 tbsp for frying and 1 tbsp for making an omelette

ingredients.text: 2 red chillies, cut in 1 cm dice
ingredients.name: papryczka chili

ingredients.text: 2 chicken fillets, cut in 1.5 cm pieces
ingredients.name: pierś z kurczaka

steps.text: Heat the oil in a non-stick pan. When the oil is hot, fry the garlic and shallots, stirring until brown and fragrant.
Add the chicken pieces, carrot, green peas, and red chilli. Stir for 2 minutes.
Add the rice, nam pla, tomato sauce, salt, and pepper. Stir until all mixed.
To make the omelette, heat the oil in a separate pan. Beat the eggs, and pour into the pan. Cook until the egg is browned on the bottom.
Flip the egg over to cook on the other side.
Place a ball of the fried rice mixture in the center of the omelette. Fold up the 4 edges of the omelette to enclose the rice. Flip it onto a serving plate.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Radish Tart
recipes.description: Radish tart is a tasty and colorful pie, best served hot from the oven. Fresh red radishes and yellow cheese give this pretty pie an interesting look and taste.

ingredients.text: 1 cup (4 oz) shredded Edam, Gouda, or Gruyere cheese, divided (Cheddar is also acceptable)
ingredients.name: ser gouda
ingredients.note: 4 oz, shredded, divided; Edam, Gouda, or Gruyere (Cheddar is also acceptable)

ingredients.text: ½–1 small bunch of red radishes
ingredients.name: rzodkiewka

steps.text: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).
Sift and measure flour into a bowl.
Cut in the butter until the particles are coarse.
Stir in half of the cheese.
Pour in ¼ cup of the cream; toss the mixture with a fork until all parts are moistened.
Turn the dough into a 9-inch round pie pan. With floured fingers, press the mixture into the bottom and sides of the pan, then prick the shell with a floured fork.
Bake the pie shell for 10–12 minutes. The sides will slip down a little during baking.
Cool on a wire rack.
Lower the oven temperature to 375°F (190°C).
Sprinkle the remaining cheese evenly over the bottom of the cooled pie shell.
Beat together the egg yolks, the ¾ cup cream, and the salt. Pour the egg mixture over the cheese.
Place the radish slices evenly over the top of the pie.
Bake for 20–25 minutes, or until set.
Remove the pie from the oven, cut it into wedges, and serve it hot.

recipes.title: Black-Eyed Peas and Kale
recipes.description: Black-eyed peas and kale is a tasty side dish suitable for vegans.

steps.text: Sauté the onion and garlic in the oil over medium heat for several minutes.
Add tomatoes and their juice, peas, cayenne and bay leaf. Simmer, covered, for 15 minutes.
Add kale and simmer uncovered until kale is tender but still green (5–10 minutes). Season to taste with salt and freshly-ground black pepper.

recipes.title: Potato-Chickpea Curry
recipes.description: Vegan curry of potatoes and chickpeas cooked in coconut milk with curry powder.

ingredients.text: 3 potatoes, chopped (Yukon gold are good, but use whatever you like)
ingredients.name: ziemniak
ingredients.note: chopped (Yukon gold are good, but use whatever you like)

steps.text: Chop the onion and mince the garlic. Sauté them in olive oil in a saucepan for approximately 5 minutes.
Add the curry powder and fry for a couple minutes more.
Add the coconut milk and the potatoes. Simmer, covered, for about 20 minutes.
Drain the chickpeas, add them to the pot, and simmer for about 20 minutes more, or until the potatoes are cooked.
Serve with basmati rice or whatever you prefer.

recipes.title: Chimichurri
recipes.description: A South American sauce for meats, made mainly of oil, vinegar, parsley, red chilli and herbs. It can be used as a marinade, a sauce for grilled or roasted meats, or a dipping sauce for empanadas.

ingredients.text: ½ green bell pepper, seeded and finely chopped
ingredients.name: papryka zielona

steps.text: Combine all the ingredients except the oil, vinegar and water in a large bowl and mix together well, ensuring all the herbs and spices (especially the salt) are distributed evenly.
Allow to rest for 30 minutes.
Bring the vinegar and water to the boil, add to the other ingredients and mix well. This helps to soften the taste of the onion and garlic.
Allow to rest for 30 minutes.
Add the oil and mix well. If the liquid part doesn't cover the ingredients add oil water and vinegar in a 2:1:1 ratio to cover them.
Transfer to an air-tight container and refrigerate overnight at least, or better, for a few days.
When needed, remove from refrigerator about 30 minutes ahead of time to allow the oil to thin out again. Stir well and serve.

recipes.title: Curried Rice
recipes.description: Ryż z curry, masłem, cebulą i rodzynkami, gotowany w bulionie.

ingredients.text: 1 cup (125 g/4.4 oz) uncooked brown rice or white rice
ingredients.name: ryż
ingredients.note: uncooked brown rice or white rice

steps.text: Find a large saucepan or frying pan which has a lid, and place over medium heat.
Add butter then chopped onion to pan. Cook the onion for a couple of minutes until it starts to brown slightly.
Add curry powder, and stir for a minute.
Mix in vegetarian bouillon cubes, raisins, rice, and water.
Put on pan lid and simmer until water is absorbed (about 15 minutes).

recipes.title: Cannoli
recipes.description: Cannoli are sweet Italian pastries. They consist of a fried pastry shell in the shape of a tube, filled with a sweet cream and cheese mixture.

steps.text: Prepare the cannoli shells if you are making them yourself.
Combine the ricotta and sugar.
Fold in the whipped cream and chocolate chips.
Fill shells with the ricotta mixture. A piping bag works well here.
Cool cannoli in the fridge before serving.

recipes.title: Jam Roly-Poly
recipes.description: Traditional British flat-rolled suet pudding spread with jam and rolled up.

ingredients.text: 250 g (1 cup or 8 oz) self-rising flour
ingredients.name: mąka samorosnąca

ingredients.text: 125 g (½ cup or 4 oz) shredded suet
ingredients.name: łój wołowy

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C (400°F or Gas Mark 6).
Sift the flour into a bowl with the salt. Add the suet and sufficient water to create a soft but not sticky dough.
Turn on to a floured board and roll out to a rectangle about 20×30 cm (8×12 inches).
Brush the pastry with the warmed jam, leaving a 1 cm (½ inch) border all around.
Fold in this border and brush with milk. With the short side towards you, roll up the pastry loosely and seal the ends well.
Place on a greased baking sheet, with the sealed edge underneath. Brush with the beaten egg and sprinkle with caster sugar.
Bake in the oven for 35–40 minutes until golden brown.
Remove from the oven, sprinkle on a little more sugar and serve hot with home-made English custard.

recipes.title: Crispy Calamari
recipes.description: Chrupiące smażone kalmary w cieście z mąki kukurydzianej i pszennej, podane z solą i pieprzem.

steps.text: Rinse the squid thoroughly and pat dry.
Cut the tentacles in half lengthwise and the tubes into ½-inch rings.
Set aside.
Combine parsley, garlic, salt, pepper, eggs, flour, and lemon juice.
Transfer to large bowl.
Dredge squid pieces in cornmeal, then wet mixture, then again in cornmeal.
Set aside.
Heat oil in a deep-fryer or cast-iron Dutch oven to 400°F.
Add squid, 4 at a time, and deep fry for 45 seconds to a minute.
Drain on a wire rack and repeat with remaining squid.
Sprinkle calamari with some more kosher salt and freshly-ground black pepper, and serve.

recipes.title: Cachapa (Venezuelan Corn Pancakes)
recipes.description: Cachapas are traditionally made with fresh corn and are a summer favorite, but this easy recipe uses canned cream corn, pancake mix, and whatever cheese you have on hand.

ingredients.text: 1 can (14 fl oz / 398 g) creamed corn
ingredients.name: kukurydza konserwowa kremowa

steps.text: Blend all the ingredients together in a blender. The mix should become thick and heavy. If not, add more corn.
Shape the mix into small pancakes approximately ½ inch (1.5 cm) thick and about 5 inches (13 cm) in diameter.
Let them cook on medium heat for about 1 minute on each side, or until small bubbles form on the top.
Serve hot and accompany with cheese (feta, Mexican white cheese Cotija, Venezuelan or Colombian Queso Blanco, Queso de Mano or Queso Guayanes where available).

recipes.title: Date bars
recipes.description: Date bars have crumbly upper and lower surfaces with a date filling in the middle.

steps.text: Mix the dates, sugar, and water in a saucepan.
Cook over low heat, stirring constantly for about 10 minutes or until thickened. Cool.
Cream together the butter, shortening, and brown sugar in a separate container.
Mix the flour, salt, baking soda, and oats into the crumble crust mix.
Grease a 13x9-inch pan.
Evenly press half of the crumble mixture into the bottom of the pan.
Spread the date filling on top.
Evenly place remaining crumble mixture into the pan, pressing lightly.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 400°F, or until light brown.
Cut into bars while still warm.

recipes.title: Kheer (Rice Pudding)
recipes.description: Kheer or payasam is a thick rice pudding.

ingredients.text: 250 ml (1 cup) long grain white rice
ingredients.name: ryż biały

steps.text: Bring the milk to a boil. Stir regularly to prevent scorching.
Add rice and simmer slowly until thick (about 20 minutes).
Stir in the sugar, sultanas, and the ground cardamom seeds. Cook for 5 minutes.
Remove from the heat, stir in the almonds and rosewater, and cover until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Double Chocolate Brownies
recipes.description: Brownies z podwójną porcją czekolady, z dodatkiem masła, cukru i orzechów.

ingredients.text: 1 package (12 ounces) dark or bittersweet chocolate chips, divided in half
ingredients.name: czekolada gorzka
ingredients.note: dark or bittersweet, divided in half

steps.text: Let the eggs and butter sit out for 30 minutes to bring to room temperature.
Preheat oven to 165°C (325°F).
In a small bowl, sift together the flour, baking soda, and salt. Set aside.
In a small saucepan combine butter, sugar, and water. Bring just to a boil then remove from heat.
Add half of the chocolate chips (6 oz) and vanilla. Stir until smooth and shiny.
Transfer the chocolate mixture into a large bowl.
Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Gradually blend in flour mixture.
Stir in remaining chocolate chips and nuts if desired.
Spread in a greased 9-inch square pan.
Bake at 165°C (325°F) for 30–35 minutes.
Cool completely before cutting into 2¼-inch squares.

recipes.title: Potato Curry (Aloo Masala)
recipes.description: Potato masala (Tamil: uralai kizhangu masala) is a potato dish often served alongside roti or folded inside a dosa.

steps.text: Heat oil.
Sauté the mustard seed first, then add chana dhal, curry leaves, onion and chillies.
Fry until the onions begin to change color.
Add potatoes.
Sprinkle the turmeric evenly and stir well to mix all the ingredients.
Cover and cook on a medium flame for about 5 minutes, stirring well, until the potatoes become very soft and somewhat mashed.
Season with salt to taste.

recipes.title: Leben (Middle Eastern Sour Milk)
recipes.description: Traditional Middle Eastern or North African drink made from milk fermented with yogurt.

steps.text: Add the milk to a large pot. Boil until it starts to foam.
Turn off the heat and wait for the milk to cool to room temperature.
Stir in the yogurt and half and half.

To make your leben more sour, boil the mixture and add the citric acid along with it until it starts to foam. To make your leben more sweet, boil the mixture and add the sugar along with it until it starts to foam. It is not recommended to add the sugar and citric acid together in your leben. This will worsen its taste.
Stir well, cover with a towel, and let rest overnight at room temperature.
Uncover and stir, then enjoy.
To preserve your leben, cool it as a regular dairy product.

recipes.title: Rice with Milk (Arroz con Leche)
recipes.description: Arroz con leche is a sweet dish of creamed rice.

ingredients.text: 2 cups white granulated sugar or fruit syrup
ingredients.name: cukier biały

ingredients.text: Outer peel of 1 lemon (remove white pith)
ingredients.name: skórka cytrynowa

steps.text: Put the rice in a strainer and rinse it until the water runs clear.
Put the rice in a pot with the water, and boil it for 7 minutes until the rice softens and the water is almost completely absorbed.
Add the milk, the sticks of cinnamon, and the lemon peel.
Boil over moderate heat for 10 minutes.
Take the cinnamon sticks and the lemon peel out, and cook for another 5–6 minutes until the rice is softer, stirring often with a wood spoon.
Add the sugar, and cook for another 30 minutes.
Add the salt, and cook for 1–2 more minutes, stirring often.
Take the rice mixture off the heat and place it in a deep glass dish, sprinkle with cinnamon powder, and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Sweet and Sour Fish Casserole
recipes.description: A sweet and sour fish casserole baked in the oven. It goes well with rice and a green salad.

ingredients.text: 2–3 medium onions, sliced to make 1 cup
ingredients.name: cebula

ingredients.text: 500–700 g white fish fillet (e.g., cod, haddock, hake, pollock)
ingredients.name: filet z białej ryby
ingredients.note: 500–700 g; e.g., cod, haddock, hake, pollock

ingredients.text: 2 Tbsp finely-chopped parsley or cilantro sprig (optional)
ingredients.name: natka pietruszki
ingredients.note: optional, finely chopped parsley or cilantro sprig

steps.text: Combine lemon juice, tomato paste, sugar and turmeric in a small bowl and mix until smooth. Set this sauce aside.
Preheat oven to 350°F.
Heat the oil in a large pot. Add the onions and sauté until golden-brown and they begin to loosen their moisture. Remove using a slotted spoon and layer in an oven-proof dish.
In the same oil, sauté the bell and chili peppers for 2 minutes or until softened. Transfer using a slotted spoon to the oven-proof dish, layering over the onions.
Layer half of the raw tomatoes over the peppers.
Spread the garlic over the tomatoes and season with half of the salt and pepper.
In the same oil, sauté the fish for 1 minute, then transfer to the dish and place on top of the tomatoes. Season with the remaining salt and pepper.
Top the fish with the remaining tomato slices. Spread the lemon-tomato-paste sauce over the top layer.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the aluminum foil and continue baking 10 more minutes, or until the fish flakes easily when tested.
Sprinkle with parsley or cilantro garnish, if desired.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Mincemeat
recipes.description: A mixture of spiced chopped apples, raisins and beef that is aged in the refrigerator for several weeks before use.

ingredients.text: 2 cups (160 g/5.6 oz) seedless black raisins
ingredients.name: rodzynki

ingredients.text: 1 ½ cups (375 ml/12.7 oz) meat stock
ingredients.name: bulion wołowy

ingredients.text: 1 ½ cups (500 g/1.1 lb) sorghum molasses or regular molasses
ingredients.name: melasa

steps.text: Core apples; remove the seeds, but don't peel.
Cube meat and cover with water.
Simmer until tender; this may take up to an hour.
Remove meat and cook the stock down to the amount needed, or thicken slightly with cornstarch.
Run meat through a food mill (medium or coarse blade), or grind to an equivalent fineness in a food processor.
Cut lemon in half and remove seeds. Purée the whole lemon in a blender, rind and all, with some of the liquid ingredients, or process as finely as possible in a food processor.
Grind the apples (or process using a coarse blade, but not too fine).
Combine the apple, meat, and raisins in a large, heavy-bottomed pot.
Add the sugar, spices, liquids, and lemon purée to the meat and apples. Use hot meat stock to rinse the last of the molasses into the mixture. Stir thoroughly.
Cook slowly, uncovered, stirring often to prevent burning until the mixture is pasteurized and enough of the liquids have evaporated to produce the texture and thickness you want.
Let cool, then stir in the ground pepper.
Refrigerate, allowing the spices to mellow for several weeks.

recipes.title: Damper (Australian Campfire Bread)
recipes.description: Australian bushman's bread, made while camping and cooked in the coals of a campfire.

ingredients.text: scant ¼ cup water (more and it will be as tough as an old boot)
ingredients.name: woda
ingredients.note: scant; more and it will be as tough as an old boot

steps.text: Add salt to flour.
Add water, then mix and form into a round loaf.
Dig a 1 foot-deep hole near a fire, and fill it with 2 shovels of hot coals and ash.
Add damper mixture to a greased camp oven (traditional cast iron round pot with lid).
Cook in the hole for a maximum of 40 minutes. If undercooked it will be flat and rubbery.

recipes.title: Lechon Paksiw (Pork Roast Leftovers in Sweet and Sour Sauce)
recipes.description: Leftover roast pork cooked in a sweet and sour sauce with vinegar, soy sauce and liver sauce.

ingredients.text: ½ cup corn starch (mixed with ½ cup water)
ingredients.name: skrobia kukurydziana

steps.text: In a large pot, heat 12 cups of water to a brisk boil on high heat.
Reduce heat to low.
Add in roast pork leftovers, and all dry ingredients (garlic, black pepper, brown sugar, banana blossom, bay leaf), allow to sit for 30 minutes.
Once all pieces of the leftover pork is tender (almost falling off the bone), add in vinegar, liver sauce and soy sauce. Let sit for 15 minutes.
Add in diluted cornstarch to thicken sauce.

recipes.title: Killer Queso Dip
recipes.description: Queso (chile con queso) to gęsty dip z serem, kiełbasą i pomidorami z zielonymi chili, popularny w kuchni południowo-zachodniej i Tex-Mex.

ingredients.text: 10 oz (280 g) canned tomatoes stewed with green chiles (e.g. Rotel brand)
ingredients.name: pomidory z puszki z zielonymi chili
ingredients.note: stewed with green chiles (e.g. Rotel brand)

ingredients.text: Tortilla chips or fritos for serving
ingredients.name: chipsy tortilla kukurydziane

steps.text: Brown sausage in saucepan and drain grease.
Add cubed cheese, diced tomatoes, and diced chilies.
Heat over low, stirring until cheese is melted and ingredients are well blended.

recipes.title: Killer Queso Dip (slow cooker)
recipes.description: Wersja queso przygotowana w wolnowarze z kiełbasą, serem i pomidorami z chili.

ingredients.text: 10 oz (280 g) canned tomatoes stewed with green chiles (e.g. Rotel brand)
ingredients.name: pomidory z puszki z zielonymi chili
ingredients.note: stewed with green chiles (e.g. Rotel brand)

ingredients.text: Tortilla chips or fritos for serving
ingredients.name: chipsy tortilla kukurydziane

steps.text: Brown sausage in a skillet and drain grease.
In a slow cooker, melt cheese with tomatoes and chilies, stirring.
Add browned sausage. Stir until well melted and mixed.

recipes.title: Brandy Butter
recipes.description: A hard sauce made from butter, sugar and brandy, served with Christmas pudding and mince pies.

ingredients.text: 75 g sieved icing sugar or caster sugar
ingredients.name: cukier puder
ingredients.note: sieved icing sugar or caster sugar

steps.text: Cream together the butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Gradually beat in the brandy.
Chill before serving.
Serve with Christmas pudding and warm mince pies.

images: Gyudon by jetalone in Higashi-Ginza, Tokyo.jpg

recipes.title: Gyudon (Japanese Beef and Rice Bowl)
recipes.description: Rice topped with beef and onion simmered in a mildly sweet sauce flavored with dashi, soy sauce, and mirin.

steps.text: Cover the eggs in boiling water, and let them sit for 20 minutes so they are soft inside and not hard.
Carefully peel off the shell.
Boil the beef and drain the water.
Combine sake, mirin, soy sauce, and sugar in a frying pan. Stir over at medium heat.
Add beef and cook. Before all the sauce evaporates, remove the beef.
Add water, dashi, grated ginger, and onions to the sauce. Cover and boil.
Mix in the beef.
Put the steamed rice in a bowl, and top with the sauced meat.
Arrange the soft egg and pickled ginger on top. Top with scallions and shichimi seasoning.

recipes.title: Spritzgebäck (German Spritz Butter Cookies)
recipes.description: Spritzgebäck is a type of German cookie.

ingredients.text: 1 tsp almond, vanilla, or lemon extract
ingredients.name: ekstrakt migdałowy, waniliowy lub cytrynowy

steps.text: Beat butter and sugar until light.
Beat in egg, egg yolk and extract.
Sift flour, salt, and baking powder together; gradually add flour mixture to eggs.
Chill dough for ½ hour.
Press ¼ of the dough into a cookie press.
Keep remaining dough chilled.
Shape cookies onto a greased baking sheet.
Bake in oven at  for 7–10 minutes or until done.
Cool on wire racks and store in airtight tins.

recipes.title: Asparagus Frittata
recipes.description: Gruba, sycząca frittata z zieloną szparagą i bazylią, zapiekana pod grillem.

ingredients.text: 1 bunch of fresh asparagus, trimmed and chopped
ingredients.name: szparag

ingredients.text: 3 teaspoons milk (whole fat milk is best, but part skim would be fine)
ingredients.name: mleko
ingredients.note: whole fat milk is best, but part skim would be fine

ingredients.text: 2 teaspoons chopped fresh basil or 1 teaspoon dried basil
ingredients.name: bazylia świeża

steps.text: In a bowl, beat together the eggs, milk, basil, salt and pepper. Set aside.
Preheat broiler/oven to 350°F (175°C). Heat the olive oil in the heat-safe skillet over medium heat.
When the oil is hot, add the garlic and sauté until fragrant, about a minute.
Add the chopped asparagus and sauté for about 5 minutes until it begins to become tender.
Pour the egg mixture into the skillet and cook about 4 minutes or until bubbles begin to form in the center of the eggs.
Sprinkle the Parmesan cheese on top of the eggs, and immediately transfer the pan to the oven.
Cook under the broiler until the top puffs and browns, about 3 minutes.
Remove the pan from the oven (careful, it will be hot) and cut the frittata into wedges.
Serve immediately with crusty bread and fresh fruit for a light spring dinner.

recipes.title: Adult Macaroni and Cheese
recipes.description: Macaroni and cheese for adults, made with Fontina, mascarpone, Gruyere, cream cheese and Swiss cheese instead of cheddar.

ingredients.text: ½ tsp (2.5 ml) kosher salt, plus more for the water
ingredients.name: sól
ingredients.note: kosher salt, plus more for the water

ingredients.text: ½ cup (60 g / 2.1 oz) grated Fontina
ingredients.name: ser fontina

ingredients.text: ½ cup (60 g / 2.1 oz) grated Gruyere
ingredients.name: ser gruyère

ingredients.text: ½ cup (150 g / 5.3 oz) mascarpone cheese
ingredients.name: mascarpone

ingredients.text: ½ cup (150 g / 5.3 oz) cream cheese
ingredients.name: serek śmietankowy

ingredients.text: 1¼ sticks (150 g / 5.3 oz) unsalted butter, divided
ingredients.name: masło

steps.text: In a gallon (~3.8 L) of salted boiling water, cook macaroni to al dente. Strain into a colander and rinse with cold water.
While pasta is cooking, in a heavy saucepan, melt 2 tbsp butter over medium heat.
Once bubbling ceases, whisk in flour and cook, whisking continuously, until blonde.
Add remaining ingredients except butter.
Once cheese is melted and sauce is smooth, add 1 tbsp butter, whisking continuously until melted.
Repeat until all butter has been used.
Gently fold in macaroni and serve warm.

recipes.title: Balangu (Nigerian Spiced Ram Meat)
recipes.description: Balangu is a meat delicacy commonly consumed in the northern part of Nigeria. It is similar to suya, but made from ram meat.

steps.text: Boil the mutton for 2 minutes in a pot with a small amount of water.
Drain.
Cut the cooked meat into pieces of your desired size.
Season the meat all over with pepper, cayenne, nutmeg, garlic, stock cube, and salt.
Brush the seasoned meat with oil, and roast in the oven.
Serve with onions.

recipes.title: Traditional Finnish Lemon Mead (Sima)
recipes.description: Sima is a Finnish, lemon-flavored mead mostly consumed during the celebrations of the 1st of May.

ingredients.text: ¼ tsp yeast (ordinary baker's yeast, either fresh or dry)
ingredients.name: drożdże
ingredients.note: ordinary baker's yeast, either fresh or dry

steps.text: Sterilize all equipment: wash the bucket and bottles well and rinse them with boiling water right before using.
Boil 4 litres of water.
Wash the lemons well and peel the zest, being careful not to include the bitter white pith. Put the zest into the container.
Slice the lemons, remove the white pith from around the slices and add the slices into the container.
Add all the sugar into the container with the lemons.
Pour the boiling water on top and mix well until the sugar is mostly dissolved.
Add 4 litres of cold water so that the mixture is lukewarm, between 35°C and 45°C (check with a thermometer if unsure).
When the temperature is right, add the yeast: dissolve it in a small cup of the mixture, then mix it back into the container.
Let it stand overnight at room temperature.
Bottle it: add one spoonful of sugar and a few raisins to each bottle before pouring the sima in.
After bottling, let the bottles stand at room temperature out of direct sunlight for 2 more days. The raisins will bloat up and float to the surface.
Move the bottles to the refrigerator. The sima is ready and should be served cold. It will keep for at least a week in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: Pizza Dough
recipes.description: A simple pizza dough that works well for thin crusts.

steps.text: Mix water, yeast, flour, and salt in a large mixing bowl. If the batter is thin and runny like pancake batter, knead in a little more flour to get a sticky dough. If you can touch the batter with your finger and not stick to it, that's too dry, so knead in a little water.
Set the mixing bowl so it is sitting in warm water, or place on top of a warm oven. Let rise for 20–30 minutes. Don't worry if it only rises 10% or 20%—it'll still work.

Grease a baking sheet with some oil, then sprinkle cornmeal on the oil. Use you fingers to press the dough out until it is about ¼ inch thick all over, with the edges ½ inch thick. Sprinkle flour on top of the dough so it doesn't stick to your hands.
Top dough with pizza toppings as desired—see pizza article.

Bake at 425°F for about 15–20 minutes. Rotate every 5 minutes and move to upper or lower shelves as necessary. After 10 minutes slide a large knife under the crust. If it is dark brown, move it to a higher shelf so it doesn't burn while the top finishes cooking. If it is white or light tan, move to lower shelf so you get a crispy crust before the cheese starts turning brown on top.

recipes.title: Sangría
recipes.description: Hiszpański napój z czerwonego wina z owocami, brandy i cukrem.

steps.text: Pour the wine in a container large enough to hold all the ingredients.
Add the lemon juice, orange and lemon segments, apple pieces, and banana slices.
Add sugar and brandy; stir to mix well using a wooden spoon.
Add cinnamon.
Keep in the fridge for at least an hour.
Add ice cubes and let it stand 10 minutes before serving.
Serve in tall glasses, including fruit bits.

recipes.title: Bhuna Khichuri (Bengali Rice and Lentils)
recipes.description: Bengali dish of rice and lentils with butter, spices and fried onion, served warm in the monsoon rain.

ingredients.text: 1 cup white fragrant rice (e.g Basmati rice or short-grained pilau rice)
ingredients.name: ryż basmati
ingredients.note: e.g Basmati rice or short-grained pilau rice

ingredients.text: 1 cup green gram or red split lentils
ingredients.name: soczewica czerwona
ingredients.note: green gram or red split lentils

ingredients.text: ½ cup split dried chickpeas (preferably  Bengal variety; optional)
ingredients.name: ciecierzyca

ingredients.text: 2 whole green chiles, slit in the middle and optionally de-seeded
ingredients.name: papryczka chili
ingredients.note: slit in the middle and optionally de-seeded

ingredients.text: 2 cm piece of ginger, finely chopped
ingredients.name: imbir świeży

ingredients.text: 1 medium or 2 small onions, thinly sliced
ingredients.name: cebula

ingredients.text: 1 bunch coarsely chopped fresh coriander leaves
ingredients.name: kolendra świeża (liście)

steps.text: Rinse rice, lentils, and chickpeas separately in cold water.
Dry rice in a colander or on a flat surface.
Leave lentils and chickpeas to soak in water for 30 minutes.
Drain lentils and chickpeas, then roast them briefly until they emit an aroma; set aside to cool.
Heat water in a kettle to use later. Keep warm but not boiling.
Semi-crush cardamom, cinnamon, and cloves.

Heat 2 tbsp butter in a heavy-based pan over medium heat. Add bay leaf and semi-crushed spices in; once they start to sputter, add sliced ginger and cumin. Stir for 1–2 minutes until ginger has a nutty aroma.
Add green chili and garden peas, and stir once or twice.
Add rice to the mixture and stir gently for 2–3 minutes, making sure the oil coats it thoroughly.
Add lentils, chickpeas and salt; stir again for 1–2 more minutes.

Add hot water to the pan. The level of water should be about 1 inch above the mixture. Lower the heat slightly, cover, and simmer until done. Check regularly to make sure rice does not burn at the bottom. Rice and lentils are done when there is no hard part in rice, it is medium firm, each one is easily separable, but not very soft or sticky.
While the rice is simmering, heat the remaining butter in a separate frying pan. Fry the onion on a medium heat until it starts to brown.
When rice mixture is done, top with onion and accompanying oil. Garnish with coriander.
Turn down the heat to the lowest and cover until served which should not take long.

recipes.title: Chocolate Fudge
recipes.description: Chocolate fudge is a traditional, rich candy, especially around the holidays in the United States.

ingredients.text: 2 ½ cups (550 g / 1.2 lb) white granulated sugar
ingredients.name: cukier

ingredients.text: ½ cup (125 g / 4.4 oz) margarine or butter
ingredients.name: margaryna

ingredients.text: ⅔ cup (160 ml / 5.4 oz) evaporated milk
ingredients.name: mleko odparowane

ingredients.text: 2 cups (160 g / 5.6 oz) semi sweet chocolate chips
ingredients.name: czekolada półgorzka

ingredients.text: ¾ cup (75 g / 2.6 oz) chopped walnuts
ingredients.name: orzech włoski

steps.text: Line a 9 in square or 13 by pan with foil so that foil extends over sides of pan; butter foil.
In large saucepan, combine sugar, margarine, and evaporated milk. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly.
After 5 minutes of constant stirring, remove saucepan from heat.
Add marshmallow creme and chocolate chips; blend until smooth. Stir in walnuts and vanilla.
Pour into buttered, foil-lined pan. Cool to room temperature.
Score fudge into 36–48 squares. Refrigerate until firm.
Remove fudge from pan by lifting foil; remove foil from sides of fudge. Using large knife, cut through scored lines. Store in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Benechin Kunkujang (Gambian Seasoned Rice and Lamb)
recipes.description: Benechin Kunkujang or thiebou yap is a Senegalese dish popular in Gambia, known for its special blend of spices from Kunkujang. It is a one-pot rice dish with tender lamb, aromatic vegetables and spices.

ingredients.text: 1 lb lamb meat, cut into cubes
ingredients.name: baranina

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper (adjust according to your spice preference)
ingredients.name: pieprz cayenne
ingredients.note: adjust according to your spice preference

ingredients.text: Fresh parsley or cilantro, chopped (for garnish)
ingredients.name: natka pietruszki

steps.text: Rinse the long-grain rice under cold water until the water runs clear. Set aside.
In a large pot, heat vegetable oil over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and minced garlic, and sauté until translucent.
Add the lamb meat cubes to the pot and cook until browned on all sides.
Stir in the diced red and green bell peppers, and cook for a few minutes until they start to soften.
Add the chopped tomatoes and tomato paste to the pot, stirring well to combine with the other ingredients.
Sprinkle in ground ginger, black pepper, coriander, paprika, cayenne pepper, and salt. Mix everything together to coat the meat and vegetables with the spices.
Pour water or broth into the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
Once boiling, add the rinsed rice to the pot, stirring well, and reduce the heat to low.

Cover the pot with the lid and let the rice simmer for about 20–25 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed. Avoid opening the lid during this time to ensure proper cooking.
Remove the pot from the heat and let it sit, covered, for 5–10 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Fluff the rice with a fork and garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro.
Serve hot.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Rice Pilaf
recipes.description: Rice pilaf can be served as a side-dish or main dish.

ingredients.text: ½ cup uncooked orzo pasta or uncooked vermicelli pasta broken into small pieces
ingredients.name: makaron pszenny
ingredients.note: uncooked orzo pasta or uncooked vermicelli pasta broken into small pieces

steps.text: Melt butter or margarine in heavy deep pan or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add vegetables and let them be lightly cooked without coloring; using the vegetables would mean you omit the orzo pasta.
Add orzo pasta (or small broken pieces of vermicelli pasta) and cook, stirring constantly until pasta is golden brown.
Add rice and stir until rice is well coated with butter. Allow rice to simmer in butter for a minute or two.
Add boiling chicken broth and salt.
Lower heat to a simmer, cover pan and cook 25 minutes over low heat until liquid is absorbed.
Gently fluff with a fork. Let stand for 15–20 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Fattoush
recipes.description: Fattoush is a Lebanese salad, good for hot weather.

ingredients.text: 1 head romaine lettuce, torn into bite-size pieces
ingredients.name: sałata rzymska

ingredients.text: ¼ cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
ingredients.name: natka pietruszki

ingredients.text: 1 green bell pepper, seeded and chopped
ingredients.name: papryka zielona

ingredients.text: 4 pita rounds, toasted and torn into pieces
ingredients.name: pita

steps.text: Mix the water and cornstarch in a small saucepan over medium-high heat until thickened.
Remove from heat, and mix in lemon juice, garlic, sumac, salt, and pepper.
Refrigerate until ready to use.
In a large bowl, toss together the lettuce, cucumber, tomatoes, green onions, parsley, mint, bell pepper, purslane, and arugula.
Toss with the dressing, and serve with pita.

recipes.title: Banana Nutmeg Pancakes
recipes.description: Puszyste naleśniki z bananami i gałką muszkatołową, na maślance i mleku.

steps.text: Heat a large non-stick skillet or griddle over low heat while preparing ingredients.
Mix flour, sugar, salt, baking powder, and baking soda in medium bowl.
Whisk nutmeg into dry ingredients.
Microwave buttermilk and milk in a 2-cup Pyrex measuring cup to room temperature, 20 to 30 seconds.
Whisk in egg, butter, and vanilla.
Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients and whisk until just mixed.
Return batter to measuring cup, stirring in a teaspoon or two of water, if necessary, to make a thick, but pourable batter.
Increase heat to medium and generously brush skillet or griddle with oil.
When oil starts to spider, but before it starts to smoke, pour batter, about ¼ cup at a time. Work in batches, if necessary, to avoid overcrowding.
Drop 5 or 6 slices of banana over the uncooked side of each pancake as it cooks.
When pancake bottoms are golden brown and tops start to bubble, 2 to 3 minutes, flip pancakes.
Cook until pancakes are golden brown on remaining side.
Repeat, brushing skillet or griddle with oil.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Chicken Stock
recipes.description: Homemade chicken stock made by simmering chicken carcasses with vegetables and a bouquet garni.

ingredients.text: 4 oz (125 g) onions, in medium dice
ingredients.name: cebula

ingredients.text: 2 oz (60 g) carrots, in medium dice
ingredients.name: marchew

ingredients.text: 2 oz (60 g) celery with leaves, in medium dice
ingredients.name: seler naciowy

ingredients.text: 2 oz (60 g) parsnips (optional), in medium dice
ingredients.name: pasternak

ingredients.text: 2 oz (60 g) leeks (optional), in medium dice
ingredients.name: por

ingredients.text: 8 sprigs fresh or ¼ tsp dried thyme
ingredients.name: gałązka tymianku
ingredients.note: fresh; or ¼ tsp dried thyme

ingredients.text: 2 whole garlic cloves, unpeeled and crushed
ingredients.name: ząbek czosnku

steps.text: Place the chicken carcasses in a stockpot, and cover with water.
Place over moderate heat. As the water comes to a boil, lower the heat to a simmer.
Scum will begin to rise to the surface. As it does so, skim it off with a perforated spoon.
Add the rest of the ingredients and simmer for 2 hours or more, as your taste determines.
Simmer the stock for 4 to 5 hours or more. One hour before the end of the cooking time, add the rest of the ingredients.
Strain, cool rapidly by placing pot in an ice-filled cooler, and refrigerate or freeze in suitably-sized portions.

recipes.title: Char Siu (Chinese BBQ pork)
recipes.description: Cha shao is a kind of spiced Cantonese honey roast pork, often called Chinese BBQ pork.

steps.text: Slice the meat into strips about 1 inch (2.5 cm) wide by 6 inches (15 cm) long.
Pierce the pork all over thoroughly with a fork.
Mix all other ingredients together to make a marinade.
Place pork strips in a tray and cover with marinade, ensuring strips are covered completely.
Cover tightly with cling film and place in the refrigerator for several hours (8–24 hours is preferable).
Preheat the oven to 230°C or 420°F and place a pan in the bottom to catch drippings, lined with aluminium foil.
Hang the meat on hooks in the oven or lay them on a rack, in two or three batches if needed.
Roast for 20 minutes, until pork is cooked all the way through. Baste at least twice. The pork should turn a golden-red colour.
Allow to cool while still hanging, or lay on wire rack to cool. Avoid laying on top of other meat or on a flat surface until cooled.
Cover and refrigerate until needed.

recipes.title: Banoffee Pie
recipes.description: A pie with a biscuit base, a caramel layer made from condensed milk, sliced bananas and whipped cream on top.

ingredients.text: 9 oz (250 g / 16 ea.) gingernut (or digestive) biscuits
ingredients.name: herbatnik imbirowy

ingredients.text: 1 tin (400 g / 14 oz) sweetened condensed milk
ingredients.name: mleko skondensowane słodzone

ingredients.text: 6 oz (175 g / ¾ cup) caster sugar
ingredients.name: cukier

ingredients.text: ¼ pint (150 ml / ⅔ cup) double cream
ingredients.name: śmietanka

steps.text: Crush the biscuits into crumbs with the end of a rolling pin. This is best done inside a freezer bag to avoid spillage and loss.
Melt two-fifths of the butter (about 4 oz) in a large saucepan. Once melted, take off the heat and mix in the biscuit crumbs.
Press into the bottom of an 8-inch (20 cm) loose-bottomed pie tin, and transfer to the fridge to chill.

Place the remaining butter with the sugar into a medium-sized saucepan (ideally non-stick if you don't like dish washing). Melt over a medium heat, stirring until the butter has melted and the sugar is just starting to melt.
Add the condensed milk and bring to the boil, stirring continuously for 5 minutes to make your caramel.
Slice the bananas, arrange over the crumb base, and pour the caramel over the top.
Chill for at least an hour so the caramel firms up.
Prior to serving, whip the cream, and spoon over the top. Optionally, garnish with some grated chocolate or Cape gooseberries.

recipes.title: Strawberry Dumplings
recipes.description: Strawberry dumplings (erdbeerknödel) are a typically Austrian dish usually served as a main course, rather than as a dessert. Curd cheese dough is wrapped around ripe strawberries and served with toasted breadcrumbs.

ingredients.text: 2 cups (500 g) curd cheese (e.g. quark, pot cheese, or farmer cheese)
ingredients.name: twaróg
ingredients.note: e.g. quark, pot cheese, or farmer cheese; 2 cups

ingredients.text: 12 ripe, medium-sized strawberries, rinsed and trimmed
ingredients.name: truskawka

steps.text: Melt the butter in a frying pan.
Add the breadcrumbs and the sugar and toast them until they gain a brown colour. Stir well, as the sugar makes the crumbs burn faster.
Put the egg and the curd cheese into a large bowl.
Add a pinch of salt.
Stir until the mixture is smooth; the egg and the cheese should be blended well.
Slowly add the flour, stirring until the dough sticks to one side of the bowl.
Let the dough rest for about 5 minutes. If the dough is too moist, which sometimes happens due to the salt, add some more flour.
Cover your hands with flour, so that the dough won't stick to your fingers when forming the dumplings.
Take a large tablespoon of dough and put it onto your palm.
Add some flour and roll the dough slightly between your hands until you receive a small ball.
Press the ball flat and put a strawberry into the middle. Cover the strawberry with dough, and pinch to seal.
Sprinkle the dumpling and your hands with some more flour. Carefully roll the dumpling until you get a smooth, round ball.
Put the dumplings on a floured plate. Leave enough space between them, as they will otherwise stick to one another.
Fill a large pot with about 3 liters of water and bring it to a boil.
Put the dumplings into the boiling water. Let them boil in the open pot for about 10 minutes. The dumplings are done, when they float as if they "danced".
Take the dumplings out of the boiling water and roll them in the breadcrumbs until they are covered evenly. Since the crumbs are supposed to stick, the dumplings should still be moist on the surface.
Serve the dumplings together with a little of the roasted crumbs, and sprinkle them with icing sugar.

recipes.title: Tuna Melt Fishcakes
recipes.description: Fishcakes made with tuna, ricotta, eggs, capers and breadcrumbs, baked in the oven and served hot or cold.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 180ºC before beginning preparation.
In a bowl beat the eggs and mix in well the drained tuna with the ricotta.
Add a little salt and pepper, the lemon zest, basil or parsley, Parmesan and half the bread crumbs.
Distribute a trickle of olive oil in an ovenproof dish.
Work the ingredients well and, with the help of two spoons, form medium-sized balls to be covered in the other half of the breadcrumbs and lay them in the ovenproof dish.
Bake in the oven for 25–30 minutes and serve warm or cold drizzling with lemon juice and accompanied by a green salad.

recipes.title: Hermits
recipes.description: Chewy molasses spice cookies, quite strong in ginger and cloves.

ingredients.text: ⅔ cup (65 g) seedless raisins (a handful more if you like them)
ingredients.name: rodzynki
ingredients.note: seedless, a handful more if you like them

ingredients.text: ⅔ cup (120 g) packed dark brown sugar
ingredients.name: cukier trzcinowy brązowy

steps.text: Preheat oven to 375°F/190°C.
Line a sheet pan with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, stir together flour, raisins, brown sugar, ginger, cinnamon, cloves, baking powder, and salt until well combined; watch the brown sugar to ensure that it doesn't clump.
Stir in molasses, butter, vanilla, and egg until fully integrated. Shape the dough in two strips (approximately 6 x) separated by at least 1.5 in on the sheet pan.
Bake for 12–15 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center of the strips comes out dry.
Allow to cool slightly then remove the hermits (on their parchment) to cooling racks to cool completely; be sure the bottoms have cooled.

Move the hermits (still on their parchment) to a counter for portioning and removal from parchment. Cut hermits into 1.5 in wide strips and carefully scrape them away from the parchment with a good thin spatula.
Enjoy with a glass of milk or a nice cup of tea.

recipes.title: Shashlik (Russian Skewered Meat)
recipes.description: Shashlik is a Russian dish of mostly meat roasted over open fire on skewers, marinated before roasting.

ingredients.text: Pieces of onion, red or green bell pepper, bacon, sausage, cucumber, baby mushrooms
ingredients.name: cebula
ingredients.note: red or green bell pepper, bacon, sausage, cucumber, baby mushrooms

steps.text: Mix the honey, mustard, vodka, salt and pepper in a deep bowl and soak the meat pieces in it.
Leave the bowl in the refrigerator for 3 hours.
Arrange the meat pieces on wooden or metal skewers, putting some pieces of bacon, sausage, pepper, onion, mushrooms, cucumber, according to your preference, between the pieces of meat.
Grill the skewers.
Serve with potato and other salads!

recipes.title: Victoria Sandwich
recipes.description: The Victoria sandwich (also known as the Victoria sponge) is a Victorian cake that is popular in the UK.

ingredients.text: 170 g (⅔ cup or 6 oz) self-raising flour
ingredients.name: mąka pszenna samorosnąca

ingredients.text: 170 g (⅔ cup or 6 oz) unsalted butter or margarine
ingredients.name: masło

ingredients.text: 170 g (⅔ cup or 6 oz) caster sugar
ingredients.name: cukier

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C (400°F or Gas Mark 6).
Cream the butter and sugar into a bowl and mix with a wooden spoon until softened.
Add the 3 eggs, the vanilla essence, and the flour and mix until smooth.
Divide the mixture between the two greased cake pans.
Bake in the oven for 20–30 minutes (10–15 in a fan-assisted oven) until firm to the touch.
Leave to cool completely on a cooling rack.
Turn one cake upside down and spread jam and whipped cream over it. Then, place the second cake on top.
Cut into wedges, and serve.

recipes.title: Dovga (Azerbaijani Yogurt Soup)
recipes.description: Dovga is a national meal of Azerbaijani cuisine, a yogurt milk soup that can be eaten both cold and warm.

steps.text: Stir yogurt to remove lumps, then pour into a pot.
Add rice and egg, and thoroughly mix.
Set pot over low heat. Mix continuously and slowly until it boils (otherwise the yogurt and eggs may curdle).
While the mixture is boiling, chop the greens. Add these into the yogurt mixture, and boil again for about 5 minutes.
Stir in peas, if using.
Serve in plates or glasses, adding salt to taste.

recipes.title: Dutch Apple Fritters (Oliebollen)
recipes.description: Oliebollen (literally: oil dumplings) are a type of Dutch apple fritter, served at Dutch festivals in the United States.

ingredients.text: Canola oil or shortening for frying
ingredients.name: olej roślinny
ingredients.note: canola oil or shortening, for frying

steps.text: Dissolve sugar in warm water. Sprinkle yeast on top. Let stand for about 10 minutes.
In a large mixing bowl, beat eggs until mixed. Add scalded milk, warm water, yeast mixture, and margarine. Beat well.
Add flour, sugar, and salt. Mix well. Add diced apple.
Let dough rise in a warm place until doubled in size. A lobster pot works well for this.
In a separate bowl, mix the sugar with cinnamon to taste. Set aside.
Fill a fryer pot with 4 inches of canola oil or melted shortening. Heat to 375°F (190°C).
Scoop large spoonfuls of dough into the hot oil. Dipping the spoons in the hot oil before scooping the dough keeps the spoons from getting too sticky.
Fry the oliebollen until golden brown, turning them to ensure even cooking.
Remove the oliebollen, and place on paper towels on paper bags.
Roll oliebollen in the cinnamon sugar mixture, and serve warm.

recipes.title: Mussels in Onion and Butter Sauce (Moules Mariniere)
recipes.description: Mussels cooked in a skillet with shallots, garlic, butter, dry sherry and bay leaf, finished with parsley.

steps.text: Sauté the shallots with the garlic clove in ¼ cup butter until golden.
Place wine and bay leaf in a large skillet.
Add the sautéed shallots and mussels, salt, and plenty of pepper.
Agitate pan for 6–8 minutes on moderate-high heat. Allow mussels to cook evenly, removing them from the heat once the shells open.
Discard any mussels that did not open.
Pour mussels into heated bowls.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve.

recipes.title: Nettle Pesto
recipes.description: Nettle pesto is a sauce made from stinging nettles instead of the basil used in traditional pesto.

ingredients.text: ⅓ cup hazelnuts, walnuts, or pine nuts
ingredients.name: orzech laskowy

steps.text: Dry sauté or roast the nuts until slightly browned.
Wearing thick gloves, submerge nettles in boiling water for 1 minute.
Drain and transfer to an ice water bath to stop the cooking process.
Drain.
Combine all ingredients in a blender and process until smooth.
Alternatively, grind with mortar and pestle for a coarser consistency.

recipes.title: Blueberry Pancakes
recipes.description: Fluffy buttermilk pancakes flavored with cinnamon and nutmeg and studded with frozen blueberries.

ingredients.text: 1½ tsp cream of tartar (or baking powder)
ingredients.name: winian potasu (kwas winowy)

steps.text: Sift together flour, sugar, baking powder, cream of tartar, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg. Set aside.
Whisk together buttermilk, butter and egg yolks in a large bowl.
Mix flour mixture into buttermilk mixture.
Mix in blueberries.
Whip egg whites in a small bowl until stiff, but do not let dry peaks form.
Fold egg whites into pancake batter.
Heat a large pan or griddle over medium heat.
Lightly spray or brush with vegetable oil.
Ladle in a ¼ cup of batter for each pancake; cook until set and bubbly on the top.
Turn pancake over, then cook for 1 more minute.
Serve warm with whatever topping you prefer.

recipes.title: Friar's Omelette
recipes.description: A traditional Scottish recipe for eggs and apples; apple can be substituted with rhubarb, plum (stones removed) or blackberry.

ingredients.text: 4 ounces (125 g / 1 stick) butter plus butter for greasing a baking dish
ingredients.name: masło
ingredients.note: plus butter for greasing a baking dish

ingredients.text: 1 ounce (25 g / 1 rounded tablespoon) white sugar for decoration
ingredients.name: cukier

steps.text: Peel and core the apples, slice them, and place in a saucepan with the water.
Cook until soft (similar to applesauce), then remove from heat and add butter, sugar and lemon juice; mix well.
While this is cooling, beat the eggs very well. When the apple mixture is cool, mix in the eggs as well.
Butter a deep baking dish and spread the breadcrumbs around it so that they stick to the bottom and the sides, keeping a good amount for the top.
Pour the apple and egg mixture into the dish and cover with a thick layer of breadcrumbs.
Bake in a moderate oven (350°F / 180°C / Gas Mark 4) for about half an hour.
Turn out onto a flat dish and sprinkle with sugar before serving.

categories: Recipes using beef broth and stock

recipes.title: Wow-Wow Sauce
recipes.description: A sauce apparently created by Dr. William Kitchiner in the early 19th century, made with port, wine vinegar, pickled cucumbers or pickled walnuts, English mustard and mushroom ketchup in a base of beef stock, flour and butter.

ingredients.text: 1 tbsp mushroom ketchup and/or port wine
ingredients.name: sos grzybowy

steps.text: Put a piece of butter as big as an egg into a saucepan.
When it is melted, stir in the flour and beef broth.
Add vinegar, mushroom ketchup, and mustard.
Simmer together until it is as thick as you wish.
Add the parsley and pickles, and warm them through.

recipes.title: Cola II
recipes.description: Cola is a type of soda flavored with citrus and spices. This version is derived from John Pemberton's original 1886 formula, with green tea extract replacing the coca leaf extract.

ingredients.text: 2 oz (60 ml) 150+ proof unflavored spirit OR a mixture of 10 tsp (50 ml) water with 2 tsp (10 ml) gum arabic
ingredients.name: spirytus neutralny 150+ proof
ingredients.note: or a mixture of 10 tsp (50 ml) water with 2 tsp (10 ml) gum arabic

ingredients.text: ⅔ cup (160 ml) water, heated to 122°F (50°C)
ingredients.name: woda

ingredients.text: 4 drops tea extract or a mixture of 2 parts water to 1 part matcha
ingredients.name: ekstrakt z herbaty zielonej
ingredients.note: or a mixture of 2 parts water to 1 part matcha

steps.text: Combine the spirit or gum arabic water and oils together in a small cup, mixing well. Set aside.

Combine the hot water, caffeine, caramel coloring, green tea extract, vanilla extract, lime juice, citric acid, sugar, and ¼ tsp (1.25 ml) of the oil mixture in a heat-safe container. Stir well to dissolve and make a syrup.
To make the finished soda, combine 1 volume of syrup with 5 volumes of carbonated water.

recipes.title: Thai Green Curry with Chicken
recipes.description: Thai green curry with chicken, coconut milk, lemongrass and kaffir lime leaves.

ingredients.text: 2 tbsp Thai green curry paste (according to taste)
ingredients.name: pasta z zielonego curry tajskiego

ingredients.text: 1–2 thick stalks lemongrass, fat ends bashed with a rolling pin (optional)
ingredients.name: trawa cytrynowa
ingredients.note: 1–2 thick stalks, fat ends bashed with a rolling pin (optional)

ingredients.text: 750 g (1½ lb) skinless, boneless chicken, cut into chunks (use breast and/or leg meat)
ingredients.name: kurczak bez skóry i kości
ingredients.note: skinless, boneless, cut into chunks (use breast and/or leg meat)

ingredients.text: 6–8 kaffir lime leaves, torn into pieces (if unavailable, use the grated zest of 1 lime)
ingredients.name: liść limonki kaffir
ingredients.note: 6–8, torn into pieces (if unavailable, use the grated zest of 1 lime)

ingredients.text: 1 good shake of Thai fish sauce or light soy sauce
ingredients.name: sos rybny
ingredients.note: good shake of Thai fish sauce or light soy sauce

ingredients.text: 1 small handful of coriander leaves, roughly chopped
ingredients.name: kolendra świeża (liście)

steps.text: Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan.
Add the green curry paste and sugar and cook over a fairly high heat for about a minute, stirring with the lemongrass, if using.
Reduce the heat slightly and stir in the chicken pieces and lime leaves or zest until coated in the paste.
Add the coconut milk, fish sauce or soy sauce and bring to a simmer, cooking for 25–30 minutes until thickened slightly.
Stir in the coriander and lime juice.
Check for seasoning, adding more fish sauce or soy sauce if needed.
Leave the curry to sit for a few minutes so the sauce becomes creamier. You will also taste the true flavours of the curry paste ingredients when it's slightly cooler.
Serve with lots of fragrant Thai jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Cincinnati-Style Chili
recipes.description: A slow-simmered, spiced ground beef chili in the Cincinnati style, traditionally served over spaghetti.

steps.text: Crumble the raw ground beef into the cold water.
Add remaining ingredients and spices. Stir well, breaking the meat up before cooking.
Cover and simmer over low heat for two hours, stirring occasionally.
Cool, then refrigerate and remove solidified grease.
Reheat and serve as desired.

recipes.title: Rasmalai (Indian Cheese and Milk Dessert)
recipes.description: Rasmalai is a very popular Indian milk-based dessert recipe.

steps.text: Crumble paneer and knead it.
Add the 2 tbsp of maida and knead again with the palm to make a smooth dough.
Divide into sixteen equal portions, roll into balls, and press slightly to flatten them.
Thinly slice almonds and pistachios. Dissolve 2 cups sugar in 2 cups of water, then bring to a boil.
Slowly lower the paneer balls in the boiling syrup and cook on high heat for ten minutes. Sprinkle a little water and ½ tbsp of maida and bring to a boil again. Cook for few minutes.
Meanwhile boil milk in a thick-bottomed pan, lower heat, and continue to boil until it is reduced to a thick consistency (⅓ of its original volume).
Add the rest of the sugar and the cardamom powder, and keep boiling until the sugar is dissolved. Remove from heat, cool, and refrigerate for 1 hour.
Add sliced almonds, pistachios, and orange powder, and mix again.
Squeeze the chenna balls and put them into the chilled sweetened milk. Refrigerate it for another half an hour. Serve chilled.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
recipes.description: Green bean casserole was invented in 1955 by the Campbell Soup Company and has become a popular Thanksgiving side dish in the United States.

ingredients.text: 2 ⅔ cups canned French fried onions, divided into 2 equal portions
ingredients.name: cebula smażona w cienkich plastrach z puszki

ingredients.text: 2 cans (21 ounces) cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.name: zupa krem z pieczarek

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Stir together beans, milk, ½ of onions, pepper, soup, and soy sauce in a 3-quart casserole dish.
Bake until hot, about 25 minutes.
Sprinkle top with rest of onions.
Bake another 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Blueberry Muffin
recipes.description: Blueberry muffins are a pastry common in many parts of the world.

ingredients.text: ⅓ cup (65 g) white granulated sugar
ingredients.name: cukier

ingredients.text: ¾ cup (180 ml) blueberries, fresh or frozen
ingredients.name: borówki amerykańskie

steps.text: Grease muffin cups or line with paper cups; set aside.
Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a medium bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt. Make a well in the center of the mixture and set aside.
In a small bowl, combine beaten egg, milk, and oil. Add this mixture all at once to the flour mixture. Fold in blueberries and stir just until combined. Do not overstir.
Spoon batter into prepared cups, filling each about two-thirds full.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes or until golden. When a wooden toothpick is inserted near the middle, it should come out clean.
Remove from muffin cups and let cool on a wire rack for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Shepherd's Pie II
recipes.description: Pâté Chinois (Chinese Pie), sometimes known as shepherd's pie, is a simple dish made from layered hamburger, creamed corn, and mashed potatoes.

ingredients.text: 1 pound (450 g) lean ground hamburger meat
ingredients.name: mięso mielone wołowe

ingredients.text: 12 oz (341 ml or 1 can) creamed corn
ingredients.name: kukurydza konserwowa

ingredients.text: Salt, pepper, and butter to taste
ingredients.name: sól
ingredients.note: salt, pepper, and butter to taste

ingredients.text: 1–2 cups shredded Cheddar or Mexican blend cheese (optional, amount depends on how much cheese you want)
ingredients.name: ser cheddar
ingredients.note: 1–2, shredded, optional, Cheddar or Mexican blend

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
In a large skillet, brown the hamburger meat until it is no longer pink.
In a medium baking pan, evenly layer the meat on the bottom, then corn. Spread a layer of potatoes.
If using, sprinkle cheese on top.
Bake in the oven for about 30 minutes, or until the cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Red Lentil Soup
recipes.description: A simple vegan soup of red lentils, carrots, onion and garlic, flavored with a bay leaf.

steps.text: Pick over the lentils to remove any debris if needed. Rinse well.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Once oil is hot, add the onion and carrots. Sauté for a few minutes, until the vegetables have started to soften, then add the garlic.
Add the lentils, bay leaf, and water to the pot. Simmer over low-medium heat for 20–30 minutes until lentils are softened.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Garlic Croutons I
recipes.description: Grzanki czosnkowe z suchego chleba, smażone na oliwie i zapiekane do chrupkości. Klasyczny dodatek do sałatki Caesar.

steps.text: Pour the olive oil into a shallow bowl over the garlic and let it soak. Soaking it longer will yield more garlic flavor.
Preheat the oven to 350 °F (~180 °C).
Strain the olive oil into a frying pan and fry the bread cubes in it, tossing to coat with oil.
Spread the bread cubes on a baking sheet and sprinkle with salt. Bake for 10 minutes or until crispy and dry.

recipes.title: Spanish Omelet
recipes.description: The Spanish omelet (tortilla) is one of the best-known Spanish dishes, often served warm or cold as a tapa.

steps.text: Peel and slice potatoes. The slices should be quite thin.
Meanwhile, heat the oil on a low heat in a large sauté pan.

Add the potatoes to the sauté pan, and fry until soft and cooked through, but not browned. This can take quite a while—don't rush it. It is a good idea to keep the pan covered so the steam from the potatoes at the bottom of the pan helps cook the ones at the top.
Slice the onion thinly. Fry it lightly in frying pan, stirring frequently for a few minutes or until sweet. Or you can simply add them to the potatoes for the last five minutes of cooking.
Beat the eggs in a large bowl and add salt.

Add the hot cooked potatoes and onion to the egg in the bowl, gently mix the potatoes and onion into the egg and leave it for five minutes. This starts the egg cooking and helps cover the potato slices in egg so it all sticks together nicely.
Drain oil, reserving oil for another time.
Pour the potatoes, onion and egg mix back into the pan, and cook for about 5 minutes on a low heat. Keep the pan moving so the mix doesn't stick to the pan. A non-stick pan makes this much easier.

When the edge of the tortilla looks cooked place a large, flat plate over the pan (like a lid), put one hand on the plate to hold it in place and turn the whole thing over (the first few times you do this it is best do this over the sink—can be very messy).

You should now have an up-side-down omelette on your plate, cooked on top and raw underneath. Check the pan is clean and scrape any bits that have stuck in the pan off and add a bit of oil if it is looking dry. Now slide the omelette back into the pan to cook the bottom.
Cook for another few minutes.
Repeat the turning trick a couple of times (practice makes perfect) to make sure it is cooked evenly.
Transfer to a large plate, cut into wedges, and serve with more tapas.

recipes.title: Homemade Corn Tortillas
recipes.description: Tortille kukurydziane (masa) to płaski placek popularny w Meksyku i Ameryce Środkowej.

steps.text: In a large bowl, stir together the masa and salt.
Add the water, and mix together well to form a dough.
Turn out onto a lightly floured board and knead for 5 minutes.
Divide the dough into ¼ cup (3 oz / 90 g) portions, and form them into balls.
Roll each ball into a flat round about 6 inches (10 cm) in diameter and ⅛ inches (0.25 cm) thick.
Heat a large heavy skillet over medium high heat.
Place the tortillas one at a time into the dry hot skillet; cook until brown on one side, then turn and brown the other side.
Remove from the skillet and keep warm in cloth towel.

recipes.title: Curry Chicken I
recipes.description: A mildly spiced curry of whole chicken pieces marinated in yoghurt and spices, then simmered in a tomato-onion sauce with optional coconut milk.

ingredients.text: 2 tsp olive oil or sunflower oil
ingredients.name: oliwa z oliwek

steps.text: Cut the chicken into 5–7 cm pieces and slice them at edges with a knife.
Combine garlic, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp red chili powder, 1 tsp garam masala, red pepper powder, yoghurt, coriander leaves, and ground black pepper in a large bowl.
Add the chicken pieces, and marinate for 8 hours in refrigerator.
In a large pot, fry onion rings, green chilies, and tomato in olive or sunflower oil over low heat until onions are light yellow.
Stir in remaining 1 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp red chili powder, and ground cashews.
Add chicken pieces, and fry them for about 5 minutes while gently stirring.
Add the marinade and water until all chicken pieces are submerged. Add coconut milk if desired.
Allow the dish to cook over low to medium heat for 30–45 minutes.
Remove from heat and wait for a few minutes until the chicken pieces are tender and have absorbed the sauce.
Serve with rice (Basmati variety works well).

recipes.title: One-Hour Thanksgiving Dinner
recipes.description: Cały obiad świąteczny Thanksgiving, który przygotowuje się w godzinę, z gotowych i instant składników.

ingredients.text: 1 ea. 5–6 lb fully pre-cooked smoked turkey breast (see notes)
ingredients.name: pierś z indyka

ingredients.text: 1–2 package(s) of instant potatoes or stuffing
ingredients.name: ziemniaki instant

ingredients.text: Nonstick cooking spray or vegetable oil
ingredients.name: olej roślinny
ingredients.note: nonstick cooking spray or vegetable oil

steps.text: Thaw the frozen turkey breast for one day in the refrigerator.
Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Remove turkey from bag and place in aluminum roasting pan. Spray the turkey with cooking spray, or rub the breast with it vegetable oil.
Place turkey breast in the oven on the middle rack, and cook for 15 minutes.
Begin preparing the gravy mix according to package directions.
Place the vegetables on the stove over low heat.
Prepare the instant potatoes or stuffing according to the package directions.
On a small pan lay out your frozen biscuits allowing them to touch one another. At this point the turkey breast should have been cooking for 30 minutes.

Place the frozen biscuits on the lower rack of the oven. The biscuits will cook just fine with the turkey in the oven and will be ready in 25–30 minutes. Check them after 20 minutes to be sure they do not burn.
Finish preparing your instant potatoes or stuffing, instant gravy, and vegetables. Place them in serving dishes if desired.

Place the cranberry sauce in a serving dish. If you are serving pie along with the dinner you will also need to place the pie on a serving dish. If a frozen pie has been purchased, follow the instructions for reheating
After 1 hour of cooking, remove the turkey and check the internal temperature with a thermometer to make sure it has reached 160°F (the minimum temperature necessary to kill any remaining bacteria).
Carve the turkey and serve with all of the prepared side dishes.

recipes.title: Cornstarch Slurry
recipes.description: A mixture of cold water and cornstarch used as a thickening agent, particularly common in Asian sauces.

steps.text: Pour the cornstarch in a cup.
Add water and mix thoroughly with a fork.
Re-mix as needed to keep the cornstarch in suspension.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
recipes.description: A simple cake with chopped apples, cinnamon and nutmeg, served warm with whipped cream.

ingredients.text: 1 cup (237 ml / 225 g) white granulated sugar
ingredients.name: cukier

ingredients.text: Add 2 cups (½ lb / 227 g) chopped apples
ingredients.name: jabłko

steps.text: Cream together butter and sugar until fluffy.
Beat in the eggs.
Sift together the flour, baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg. Mix into the batter until just incorporated.
Fold in the apples.
Transfer the batter to a greased and lined cake pan.
Bake at 350 °F (177 °C, gas mark 4) for 45 minutes.
Serve warm with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Wakeup Sausage Casserole
recipes.description: A baked breakfast casserole with sausage, bread cubes, cheddar and eggs.

ingredients.text: 24 ounces evaporated milk (or substitute 3 cups of milk)
ingredients.name: mleko skondensowane słodzone

ingredients.text: 1 pound hot bulk pork sausage, cooked, drained, and crumbled
ingredients.name: kiełbasa surowa (biała)

ingredients.text: 8 cups (8–10 slices) ½-inch cubed French or Italian bread (ideally a day old or a little stale)
ingredients.name: chleb włoski
ingredients.note: 8–10 slices, ½-inch cubes, ideally a day old

steps.text: Preheat oven.
Grease a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Place bread cubes in the pan evenly.
Combine eggs, garlic powder, green onion tops, evaporated milk, onion powder, and mustard.
Pour into baking dish.
Crumble sausage over the mixture evenly.
Add cheese and peppers, if desired, over the top.
If preparing ahead, cover and refrigerate.
Bake until set, about 45 minutes.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Boliche (Cuban Chorizo-Stuffed Roast)
recipes.description: Boliche to popularne kubańskie danie: pieczeń z oka rundy nadziewana kiełbasami chorizo, duszona w sosie pomidorowym.

ingredients.text: 3 tbsp green Spanish olives with pimentos
ingredients.name: oliwki zielone nadziewane papryką

steps.text: Cut slits into eye round roast, and stuff with quartered chorizos (follow the grain of meat).
Lightly rub meat with adobo seasoning.
Brown the meat on all sides in a sauté pan to seal in the juices. Remove and place in a large covered roasting pan.
In the same pan as the beef was browned, add saffron, garlic, onions, peppers, bay leaves, oregano, olives, capers, and the Sazon seasoning. Sauté until the onions are translucent in color.
Deglaze with red wine, turn heat down, and simmer about 5 minutes. Add the cilantro and the tomato sauce and stir well.

Pour this mixture over the beef, and roast at 325 °F for 1 ½–2 hours, or until meat is tender. Turn the roast over and baste with the sauce once in a while to assure full flavor penetration and even cooking.
Serve.

recipes.title: Kaiserschmarrn (Austrian Shredded Pancake)
recipes.description: A traditional Austrian dish of shredded pancake, served with icing sugar and usually stewed plums.

steps.text: Separate the whites from the yolks.
Put yolks, milk, sugar and salt in a bowl and whip well.
Fold in the flour while stirring thoroughly until the mass is pasty.
Add the raisins to the mixture.
Whisk the whites until they are stiff and then fold them into the mixture.
Melt the butter in a frying pan, and add the dough.
Cook until the pancake gets solid at the bottom.
Divide the mass into quarters with a wooden spoon or spatula and turn them over. After a little while start scrambling the quarters.
Keep turning the Kaiserschmarrn until it is done.
Serve with icing sugar on top.

recipes.title: Sunglow Motel-Cafe Pickle Pie
recipes.description: The Sunglow Motel-Cafe in Bicknell, Utah serves the unique pickle pie, developed by Cula Ekker.

ingredients.text: 12 oz sweet pickles, drained and ground
ingredients.name: ogórek konserwowy słodki

steps.text: Beat eggs and sugar until lemon-colored and thick; beat in cinnamon, nutmeg, lemon extract, cornstarch, cream and margarine.
Stir ground sweet pickles into mixture.
Pour pickle mixture into unbaked pie shells.
Bake at 350°F for 1–1.25 hours, until a knife inserted in center comes out clean.

recipes.title: Banana Caramel Dessert
recipes.description: A dessert loosely based on banoffee pie, combining bananas and caramel sauce with pre-made cinnamon roll dough.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
In a small bowl, toss bananas, vanilla, and melted butter until bananas are well coated.
On a cookie sheet, unroll 2 cinnamon rolls, leaving the two triangles attached to form a square.
Place ¼ of the banana mixture in the center of each pair of rolls.
Bake for 11 to 13 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Heat the caramel topping and drizzle over dessert.
Serve warm, with ice cream if desired.

recipes.title: Tartiflette
recipes.description: Tartiflette is a French dish from the Savoy region, originating in the valley of Aravis, home of Reblochon cheese.

ingredients.text: 1¾ pounds Yukon Gold potatoes (5 or 6 medium-sized ones, all the same size) or waxy boiling potatoes
ingredients.name: ziemniak
ingredients.note: Yukon Gold (5 or 6 medium-sized ones, all the same size) or waxy boiling potatoes

ingredients.text: 5–6 ounces slab bacon or salt pork, cut into lardons about 1 x ¼ x ¼ inch
ingredients.name: boczek
ingredients.note: 5–6 ounces of slab bacon or salt pork, cut into lardons about 1 x ¼ x ¼ inch

ingredients.text: 1 ea. (about 6 ounces) medium onion, finely chopped
ingredients.name: cebula

ingredients.text: ¼ cup dry white wine or dry vermouth
ingredients.name: wino białe wytrawne
ingredients.note: dry white wine or dry vermouth

ingredients.text: 6 tablespoons (¼ cup plus 2 tablespoons) heavy cream
ingredients.name: śmietanka kremówka

ingredients.text: ½ tsp salt, or to taste
ingredients.name: sól

steps.text: Boil potatoes in their skins for exactly 20 minutes, until they're just beginning to get tender. Do not overcook! Rinse with cold water to stop the cooking.
While still warm, peel the potatoes with your fingers, then use a large, very sharp knife to cut them into slices about ⅓-inch thick.
Cut the slices into rough cubes.
While the potatoes are cooking, slice the slab bacon or salt pork into slices about ¼-inch thick, then cut into lardons about ¼-inch across.
Melt the butter in a large sauté pan, then cook the lardons over medium-high heat until crisp and golden brown. Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside, leaving the bacon fat in the pan.
Preheat the oven to 350 °F.

Cook the onions in the bacon fat over medium heat, stirring often, until wilted and slightly golden. Drain in a strainer, pressing with a spoon to remove as much fat as possible, and leave them there.
Pour off the fat in the pan, return the bacon and onions, and add the wine. Cook over high heat until the wine is nearly evaporated.
Add the diced potatoes and cook for a minute or so, stirring constantly until all the ingredients are well mixed together.
Add the cream and salt and pepper to taste. Use a little more salt than you might think is necessary, at least ½ teaspoon. Stir all the ingredients together for a minute.
Lightly butter the inside of a 10–11-inch earthenware baking dish. Add the potato mixture and smooth the surface.

Cut the Reblochon in two down across the top so that you have two pieces in the shape of a half-moon. Put one piece away for another use. Use a sharp knife to lightly score the crust of the remaining half-cheese about every inch, including its side. Then carefully slice horizontally through its center so that you have two half-moon pieces.
Place the two pieces of cheese crust-side-up on top of the potatoes so that they form a circular cheese again.
Cover the dish tightly with aluminum foil and bake in the center of the oven for 1 hour.
Remove the foil and stir the cheese, including the crust, into the potatoes, mixing well.
Place 5–6 inches under the broiler and cook until golden brown on top.

recipes.title: Beef Curry
recipes.description: This is a beef curry that can be made out of ingredients which you might find in your fridge normally, so no need to buy extra ones.

ingredients.text: 1 bell pepper or 1 cup (200 g) frozen mixed bell peppers
ingredients.name: papryka
ingredients.note: or 1 cup (200 g) frozen mixed bell peppers

steps.text: Peel and chop the onion and pepper.
Brown the ground beef in a pan and add the curry powder.
Add the chopped onion and pepper to the pan, and fry this for one minute.
Add the crumbled stock cube, tomato purée, mango chutney and paprika to the pan and stir.
Add water into the pan till it covers the mixture.
Bring to a boil and simmer for 1 hour stirring every 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, bring the rice to a boil in the 2.75 cups of water.
If you would like the rice to be yellow, add a small amount of tumeric.
Immediately cover and reduce heat to a minimum and allow to cook for 10 minutes.
Turn off heat and allow to rest for 10 minutes.
Add lemon juice to the rice.
Fluff with a spoon or fork.
Put the rice on a plate with the curry on top. You may wish to mold the rice for a nicer presentation.

recipes.title: Meatloaf II
recipes.description: Klasyczny amerykański meatloaf z mięsem mielonym, farszem gotowym i sosem sojowym.

ingredients.text: 8 oz (220 g) package of pre-made stuffing (e.g. Stove Top or Paxo)
ingredients.name: gotowy farsz w paczce

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C).
Beat eggs, water, and approximately soy sauce together in a bowl and set aside.
Get a large bowl and mix the ground beef and stuffing together. Make sure to use your hands and combine the mixture well, as this is the most important step.
Slowly work the egg mixture into the meat and stuffing, once again making sure to combine all ingredients well.
Pick up the big ball of meat and pack in hands until you have formed a loaf. Place in ungreased loaf pan.
Bake, uncovered, on the center rack of the oven for 45–55 minutes until center of meatloaf is browned.
Drain excess grease off side of pan and let stand 5–10 minutes before cutting and serving.

recipes.title: Meringue Cookies I
recipes.description: Chrupiące bezy z ubitych białek i cukru, podawane czasem z bitą śmietaną.
