ingredients.text: 1 cup (250 ml) superfine sugar, powdered sugar, or granulated sugar (ideally a mixture of 50% superfine and 50% powdered sugar)
ingredients.name: cukier
ingredients.note: superfine sugar, powdered sugar, or granulated sugar (ideally a mixture of 50% superfine and 50% powdered sugar)

steps.text: Whip whites of eggs until stiff and dry.
Add lemon juice.

Gradually add sugar and continue beating until mixture holds shape and is very shiny. Test to make sure the sugar is wholly dissolved and no grains remain (this can take longer or shorter depending on the sugar used).
Add vanilla.
Drop meringue by spoonfuls on unglazed paper.
Bake in a slow oven 80–90 minutes, depending on size. Use very low heat, as meringues should dry rather than bake and should be dry and only very slightly colored, when finished.
Let cool before serving.

recipes.title: Chicken Marsala I
recipes.description: Chicken cutlets cooked in marsala wine with mushrooms, parsley and rosemary.

recipes.title: Garlic Parmesan Pasta
recipes.description: Fettuccine or angel hair pasta tossed in garlic, basil and lemon butter with broccoli, walnuts and Parmesan.

ingredients.text: 220 g (8 oz) fettuccine or angel hair pasta, cooked and drained
ingredients.name: makaron pszenny
ingredients.note: fettuccine or angel hair, cooked and drained

ingredients.text: 360 ml (1 ½ cups) broccoli florets, cooked tender-crisp
ingredients.name: brokuł gotowany

steps.text: Melt the butter in a large skillet. Add the basil, lemon juice, garlic powder and seasoned salt, blending well.
Add the fettuccine, broccoli, and walnuts. Blend well and toss to coat the fettuccine.
After tossing, add fresh grated Parmesan cheese to top off the dish.

recipes.title: Lemon Meringue Pie (British)
recipes.description: A sticky, indulgent British-style lemon meringue pie with a sweetened condensed milk filling and a biscuit base.

ingredients.text: 2 imperial tbsp (36 ml / 2.4 US tbsp) butter
ingredients.name: masło

ingredients.text: 6 imperial tbsp (108 ml / 7.2 US tbsp) caster sugar
ingredients.name: cukier

steps.text: Pound the digestive biscuits into crumbs with the end of a rolling pin.

Add sufficient melted butter to the crumbs to make the mixture cohesive. Mix well, then press it into the bottom of a 10 inch (25 cm) diameter, 1 inch deep pie dish. Press down firmly with the tip of a spoon to make the base.
Combine the sweetened condensed milk and egg yolk. Stir gently, then mix in the lemon zest and juice to taste, being careful not to add too much or it will spoil the texture. Do not stir too much.
Pour the filling into the pie dish, covering the biscuit layer.
Whip the egg whites until foamy. Gradually beat in the sugar until you get stiff peaks.
Spoon the meringue into the pie dish, sealing around the edges.
Bake in a moderately cool oven (325 °F / 162 °C) for about 45 minutes until the meringue is a light golden brown.
Remove from the oven, allow to cool, and place in the refrigerator for 2 hours to set.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Risotto ai Funghi
recipes.description: Risotto ai funghi to prawdopodobnie najbardziej znane ze wszystkich dań risotto, najlepiej przygotowywane z borowikami; suszone grzyby też się nadają.

ingredients.text: 250 g arborio, vialone nano, or carnaroli risotto rice
ingredients.name: ryż arborio

ingredients.text: 1 small (150 g) white onion, finely chopped
ingredients.name: cebula

ingredients.text: 200 g fresh porcini mushrooms,or about 50 g dried
ingredients.name: borowik

ingredients.text: 100 g freshly grated Parmesan Reggiano cheese
ingredients.name: parmezan

steps.text: If using dried mushrooms, soak them for at least 20 minutes in 200 ml warm water. Ignore shorter times on the packet. Once reconstituted, chop about half into small pieces and roughly chop the rest. No need to soak fresh mushrooms.
Melt half the butter in a medium frying pan or saucepan on medium heat.
Sweat the onion and garlic in the butter until the onion is translucent. They must not burn; if they do, throw them away and start over.
Add the rice and swirl it in the pan until coated in butter. Leave for about 30 seconds.
Splash in the wine and wait for it to evaporate.
Add about half the stock slowly, one ladle at a time.
Stir the rice about every 2 minutes to release the starch and add more stock if there is the slightest chance of the rice drying out.
After about 5 minutes of cooking, add the mushrooms and their juice (liquor). If using dried mushrooms, avoid adding the sediment at the bottom of the container.
Cook until al dente, with a bit of bite left, not squashy. This takes 15–20 minutes; start testing small spoonfuls after about 15 minutes. The rice should be fairly glutinous and not too runny.
When the rice is cooked, take it off the heat and add the chopped parsley, the remaining butter and about 2 tbsp of the Parmesan, and mix together. Adjust the seasoning.
Let it stand for about 2 minutes (the Mantecatura period) and serve.

recipes.title: Vanillekipferl (Almond Crescent Cookies)
recipes.description: Vanillekipferl are small almond biscuits shaped like a crescent moon, popular in Austria and Germany as a Christmas biscuit.

steps.text: Sift the flour into a bowl.
Cut the cold butter into slices and mix it with the flour.
Add icing sugar, salt, vanilla sugar, ground almonds, and egg to the mixture.
Rinse hands in cold water, and knead the dough on a pastry board. Let the dough rest for half an hour.
Grease a baking tray, or alternatively use a sheet of baking paper to prevent the kipferl from sticking.
Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F/Gas 4).
Form the dough to a cylinder with a diameter of approximately 5 cm, and cut off 0.5 cm thick slices. Roll them between your flat palms to form a sausage shape that is slightly tapered.
Lay them in crescent shape on the baking tray, and bake them for 8–10 minutes until they are a light golden brown.
Immediately after baking, dip the Kipferl into a mixture of icing sugar and vanilla sugar. Try some—they are delicious while still warm!
Leave the rest out overnight, and then store them in an airtight tin.

recipes.title: Traditional Lasagne
recipes.description: Traditional lasagne with a beef ragu layered with pasta sheets, béchamel sauce and parmesan.

steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a Dutch oven over medium high heat until shimmering.
Add the ground beef and cook, breaking it up with a wooden spoon, until all liquid has evaporated and the meat begins to sizzle.
Stir in the wine, scraping the pot to loosen the fond. Simmer until the wine has evaporated.
Add the crushed tomatoes, bring to a simmer, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare the béchamel sauce.
Preheat the oven to 375°F/190°C.
Mix the basil, oregano, salt, and pepper into the ragu.

Place a thin layer of ragu in the base of the ovenproof dish and cover with a single layer of pasta sheets. Spread a layer of béchamel sauce over the pasta. Repeat until you run out of meat, making sure you have enough béchamel sauce left to cover the top layer of pasta.
Sprinkle grated parmesan over the pasta.
Place the dish in the oven on the top shelf and cook for about 45 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned and the sauce is bubbling.
Serve.

recipes.title: Moqueca de Peixe (Brazilian Seafood Stew)
recipes.description: The original Bahian moqueca de peixe, a fish stew cooked in layers with azeite de dendê and coconut milk.

ingredients.text: 1 kg fresh white fish, cut into two finger-wide strips/slices
ingredients.name: ryba biała
ingredients.note: fresh white fish, cut into two finger-wide strips/slices

ingredients.text: 2 mid-sized onions, cut into circular slices
ingredients.name: cebula

ingredients.text: 2 bell peppers (one red, one green), cut into circular slices
ingredients.name: papryka czerwona
ingredients.note: one red, one green, cut into circular slices

ingredients.text: 2 bell peppers (one red, one green), cut into circular slices
ingredients.name: papryka zielona
ingredients.note: one red, one green, cut into circular slices

ingredients.text: 4 ripe tomatoes, optionally skinned then chopped
ingredients.name: pomidor

ingredients.text: 4 cilantro stems with leaves, finely chopped
ingredients.name: kolendra świeża

ingredients.text: 12 tablespoons Azeite de dendê (a very tasty, heavy, saffron-colored palm oil, which may not be omitted under any circumstances)
ingredients.name: azeite de dendê
ingredients.note: a very tasty, heavy, saffron-colored palm oil, which may not be omitted under any circumstances

steps.text: Leave the fish in a marinade made out of lemon juice and fine powdered pepper for at least 1 hour.
Put the fish, onions, bell peppers, garlic, tomatoes and the cilantro in numerous layers into a pot.

Pour the azeite de dendê and the coconut milk over all, and boil everything for 20 minutes. From time to time, ladle/scoop the liquid from the pot's bottom to its top. Be careful, in order to not break the fish!
Season to taste with salt.
Serve with white rice.

recipes.title: Dinuguan (Pork Blood Stew)
recipes.description: Dinuguan (pork blood stew), or dinardaraan in Ilocano, is a Filipino dish usually made from the blood, entrails and meat of a pig. It has a thick chocolate-like color and consistency and is most often served over rice or puto.

ingredients.text: 3 cups (700 g) ½-inch cubed boneless pork butt with fat
ingredients.name: łopatka wieprzowa

ingredients.text: ½ cup (120 ml) vinegar mixed with 1 cup (240 ml) water and 1 tablespoon salt
ingredients.name: ocet
ingredients.note: mixed with 1 cup water and 1 tablespoon salt

ingredients.text: 1 medium-sized yellow onion, peeled and sliced
ingredients.name: cebula

ingredients.text: 1½ cups (360 ml) pork blood (Ideally from Vietnamese, Filipino or Western European markets)
ingredients.name: krew wieprzowa
ingredients.note: Ideally from Vietnamese, Filipino or Western European markets

ingredients.text: 2 hot jalapeño peppers, seeded and chopped
ingredients.name: papryczka jalapeño

steps.text: Place the pork in a 4-quart (560 ml) covered stove-top casserole dish and add the vinegar mixture. Bring to a boil and reduce the heat.
Cook, covered, for about an hour, until the pork is tender. Make sure that the liquid doesn't dry out. Add more water if necessary.
Heat a frying pan and add the lard or oil.
When the oil is hot enough, sauté the onion and garlic until the onion appears translucent. Remove from heat.
Add the oil, garlic, and onion to the pork and continue cooking for 5 minutes.
Purée the pork blood in a food processor.
Add the blood to the pork gradually while stirring the mixture. Bring to a boil.
Add the chopped pepper and simmer uncovered to reduce the sauce until desired thickness is achieved. Keep covered and serve hot.

recipes.title: Shortcrust Pastry
recipes.description: Kruche, maślane ciasto bez jajek, często używane jako spód do tart.

ingredients.text: 120 g (1 cup) plain flour, plus extra for dusting
ingredients.name: mąka pszenna

steps.text: Cream together butter, sugar, and lemon rind in a bowl.
Sift together the plain and potato flours into a mound.
Make a well in the center of the mound and add the creamed mixture.
Knead lightly until the dough is consistent.
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and chill for 1 hour before use.

recipes.title: Sweet Cornbread
recipes.description: Sweet cornbread is a variant of Skillet Cornbread made in central and eastern Ontario and Quebec, also known as Johnny Cake.

ingredients.text: ½ cup (160 g / 5.6 oz) maple syrup
ingredients.name: syrop klonowy

ingredients.text: ½ cup (90 g / 3.2 oz) brown sugar
ingredients.name: cukier trzcinowy brązowy

ingredients.text: ½ cup (125 g / 4.4 oz) butter, softened
ingredients.name: masło

steps.text: In a large bowl, beat eggs lightly to break the yolks as one would for scrambled eggs, then mix in the butter. Soften the butter beforehand if you must by heating it a little.
The butter/egg mixture should be loose. Add the sugar and maple syrup, mix well, then add the salt to the liquid mixture.
Mix the cornmeal and baking powder, then blend them into the liquids.

Slowly add the flour as needed to reach a proper cake batter texture. It should be softer than a cookie dough, able to stick to the mixing spoon and come off in blobs. You may not need all of the flour, or may even need a little more based on your eggs and how closely you measured.
Pour into a greased pan, put into an oven heated to 200°C (400°F), and bake for between 15–25 minutes.

recipes.title: Eggnog
recipes.description: Klasyczny gęsty napój jajeczny z brandy i rumem, bitą śmietaną i mlekiem.

ingredients.text: 480 ml (2 cups) cups whipping cream, cold
ingredients.name: śmietanka 36%

steps.text: Whip the eggs for 2 or 3 minutes with an electric mixer at medium speed until very frothy.
Gradually beat in the sugar, vanilla, and nutmeg.
Turn the mixer off and stir in the cold brandy, rum, whipping cream, and milk.
Chill well.
To serve, sprinkle individual servings with more nutmeg.

recipes.title: Mango and Coconut Chutney (Am ki Chatni)
recipes.description: A fresh Indian-style chutney of mango, coconut, ginger and cayenne, brightened with orange and lime juice.

ingredients.text: 1 Tbsp fresh or canned coconut, finely chopped
ingredients.name: kokos świeży

ingredients.text: 1 Tbsp fresh ginger, scraped and finely chopped
ingredients.name: imbir świeży

ingredients.text: 2–3 Tbsp fresh orange juice, or a mixture of orange and lime juice
ingredients.name: sok pomarańczowy
ingredients.note: 2–3, or a mixture of orange and lime juice

steps.text: Place the mango on one side on a work surface and make a slit in the tip across its width with a sharp knife. Hold the mango upright on its stem end and carefully slice the flesh, with the skin attached, off one side of the stone, as close to it as possible. Turn it the other way and cut off the flesh from the other side of the stone.
Place each mango half, skin-side down, on the work surface, and cut lines through the flesh down to the skin in a lattice pattern so that you end up with a checkerboard pattern with ½-inch squares.

Grasp the mango half with both hands, skin down, thumbs on the flesh and four fingers of each hand underneath on the skin. Turn the skin inside out by pushing the skin inwards with your four fingers while pushing the two sides downward with your thumbs. The skin will have cubes of flesh attached, which can be easily cut off with a sharp knife.
Place the mango cubes in a small bowl.
Add the coconut, cilantro, ginger, cayenne, orange/lime juice, and salt and mix gently with a tablespoon.
Leave to marinate in the refrigerator for 1–2 hours before serving.

images: Rice and beans stew in bowl.jpg

recipes.title: Beans and Rice
recipes.description: A vegan adaptation of Cajun rice and beans, similar to gallo pinto. Great for weekend cooking and feeding a crowd on a budget.

ingredients.text: 1 package (16 oz) dry beans (kidney or black beans preferred)
ingredients.name: fasola czerwona (sucha)
ingredients.note: 16 oz, kidney or black beans preferred

ingredients.text: 1–2 whole dried or fresh hot peppers (optional)
ingredients.name: papryczka chili

steps.text: Soak beans overnight, or, bring to a boil and let sit for one hour.
In a Dutch oven or large pot, sauté onions and garlic in olive oil on medium heat until onions are translucent.
Add green pepper and celery, and sauté for a few minutes more.
Add beans and enough water to cover all ingredients.
Add spices, then bring to a boil. Lower heat, cover, and simmer, stirring occasionally, until done (1–2 hours, depending on the age of your beans).
Add rice and twice as much water to a pot (i.e. 1 cup rice + 2 cups water).
Bring to a rolling boil, and cook until the water has boiled down to the level of the rice.
Reduce heat to a light simmer, cover, and cook for 20 minutes.
Serve the beans over the rice and enjoy! It is also very tasty with cornbread.

recipes.title: Puttanesca Sauce (Vegan)
recipes.description: A vegan puttanesca pasta sauce made with tomatoes, olives, capers, garlic and chile flakes.

ingredients.text: ½ cup chopped pitted Kalamata olives
ingredients.name: oliwki Kalamata

ingredients.text: ½ cup chopped pitted salt-cured black olives
ingredients.name: oliwki czarne solone

steps.text: Heat oil in a large skillet.
Add garlic and sauté over medium heat until garlic starts to brown lightly.
Add oregano, pepper, olives, capers, and tomatoes. Simmer for about 15 minutes.
Add parsley and cook for another 2 minutes.
Add salt to taste.
Pour over 1 pound (450 g) of cooked pasta, and serve.

recipes.title: Tres Leches Cake II
recipes.description: A popular Latin American dessert: a cake soaked in a mixture of three kinds of milk and topped with whipped topping.

ingredients.text: 1 box of white cake mix, preferably with pudding in the mix
ingredients.name: mieszanka do ciasta białego
ingredients.note: preferably with pudding in the mix

ingredients.text: 1 cup of heavy whipping cream or half and half
ingredients.name: śmietanka 36%

steps.text: Prepare cake mix as directed on the package. Transfer to a greased baking dish or cake pan, and bake per the directions.
While the cake is baking, combine the sweetened condensed milk, evaporated milk, and heavy whipping cream to make the milk mixture. Mix well.
When the cake is finished baking, remove from the oven and poke holes all over the top of the cake with a fork.
Pour all of the milk mixture on top of the cake.
Cover the cake, and refrigerate it for 8 hours or overnight.
Immediately before serving, spread cake with cool whip or as guests prefer.

recipes.title: Asian-Inspired Chicken Salad
recipes.description: A chicken salad inspired by East and Southeast Asian flavors of soy, ginger, sesame, and mango.

ingredients.text: 1 package (6 oz) grilled chicken breast, cut in strips
ingredients.name: pierś z kurczaka grillowana

ingredients.text: ¾ cups salad dressing (teriyaki ginger, Asian sesame with ginger, or balsamic vinaigrette)
ingredients.name: sos sałatkowy
ingredients.note: teriyaki ginger, Asian sesame with ginger, or balsamic vinaigrette

ingredients.text: 1 mango, peeled, seeded, and thinly sliced (optional)
ingredients.name: mango

steps.text: In large saucepan quickly plunge broccoli and pea pods into boiling water for 30 seconds.
Drain vegetables. Quickly rinse with cold water. Drain well.
In large bowl toss together the blanched broccoli and pea pods, greens, cabbage and carrots.
Add chicken.
Drizzle with salad dressing. Toss to coat.
Arrange on 4 serving plates.
Top with mango, if desired.
Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Reuben Sandwich
recipes.description: Grillowana kanapka z soloną wołowiną, kiszoną kapustą, szwajcarskim serem i sosem Russian dressing.

ingredients.text: ½ lb (225 g) sliced corned beef (or try using pastrami)
ingredients.name: wołowina solona w plastrach

ingredients.text: 2 slices rye bread (or use sourdough bread in case of rye allergy)
ingredients.name: chleb żytni
ingredients.note: or use sourdough bread in case of rye allergy

steps.text: Combine the sauerkraut, onion, and parsley.
Spread the dressing on two slices bread.
Pile layers of corned beef, cheese, and sauerkraut mixture on one slice.
Add second slice of bread.
Butter the outside of the bread.
Grill until lightly browned, roughly 5–10 minutes.

recipes.title: Yeasted Cornbread
recipes.description: Yeasted cornbread made with yellow cornmeal, white flour and whole wheat flour, baked in a greased 9×9-inch pan.

steps.text: Mix water, yeast, and sugar. Let this sit for a few minutes until it bubbles.
Stir in the rest of the ingredients, adding water until it is pourable.
Bake in a greased 9×9-inch pan at 350°F (175°C, gas mark 4) for 25 minutes or until the edges turn golden brown.

recipes.title: Asparagus Soup
recipes.description: A smooth, velvety soup made from asparagus, shallot, butter and cream, seasoned with cayenne pepper.

ingredients.text: ¼–1 cup whipping or light cream
ingredients.name: śmietanka

ingredients.text: Salt, freshly ground black pepper, and cayenne pepper to taste
ingredients.name: sól
ingredients.note: freshly ground black pepper, cayenne pepper

steps.text: Snap the tough ends off the asparagus spears.
Bring the water to a boil in a medium saucepan, salt the water lightly, and add the asparagus spears.
Cook at a lively simmer for 10 minutes.
Lift out with tongs and set aside. Reserve the cooking water.
In a separate saucepan large enough to hold the finished soup, heat the butter, add the chopped shallot, and cook gently until soft but not browned.
Add the cooked asparagus spears and one cup of the cooking water and bring to a boil.
Cook at a lively simmer for 5 minutes.
Remove from the heat and strain the soup through a medium sieve into a bowl, reserving the liquid.
Purée the solids in a food processor with enough of the reserved liquid to allow the mixture to purée smoothly.

Strain the purée through the sieve back into the non-reactive saucepan, rubbing the mixture through with a flexible scraper or wooden spoon and leaving the fibrous parts in the sieve. Discard the contents of the sieve.

Add the cream and enough of the remaining asparagus cooking water to give the soup the consistency you want. Season to taste with salt, freshly ground black pepper, and cayenne pepper. Reheat gently over low heat, making sure not to let the soup boil.
Serve hot or chilled. If you want to serve it chilled, let it cool, then refrigerate it uncovered until thoroughly cold, then cover with plastic wrap. You can keep it refrigerated for up to 2 days.

recipes.title: Burple Nurples
recipes.description: A cookie loosely derived from the animated television show Chowder. It is unclear whether it is intended for consumption.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 320°F.
In a bowl, gently crack egg.
Mix in sugar, then butter, flour, and coriander to make a dough.
Shape dough into small balls.
Place dough balls on a cookie sheet.
Bake for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Miyan Taushe (Hausa Pumpkin Soup)
recipes.description: Miyan taushe is a traditional, popular soup in Hausa homes, especially during festive seasons or when pumpkins are in season.

ingredients.text: 2–3 tablespoons palm oil or groundnut oil
ingredients.name: olej palmowy lub orzechowy

ingredients.text: 1 cup chopped spinach, ugu leaf, or yakuwa leaf (optional)
ingredients.name: szpinak

steps.text: Place the meat in a pot. Add chopped onion, seasoning cubes, salt, and enough water to cover everything.
Simmer until the meat is cooked through and tender to your taste—this can take a while for tough cuts of meat.
Add pumpkin chunks to the pot. Cook until they become soft (about 10–15 minutes), then gently mash some of the pumpkin to thicken the soup.
Add groundnut paste if using, daddawa, palm oil, chile pepper, and fish. Stir well and simmer for another 10 minutes.
Add your leafy vegetables and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add water if needed to get your desired soup thickness.

recipes.title: Lahoh (Spongy Flatbread)
recipes.description: Lahoh, alternately called laḥūḥ, is a griddle-cake made similar to a pancake, but with a slightly different texture and notable for its porous texture on one side.

ingredients.text: 3 cup of wheat flour or sorghum flour
ingredients.name: mąka pszenna

ingredients.text: Dab of margarine or vegetable oil for greasing pan
ingredients.name: margaryna

steps.text: Combine semolina and ½ cup of lukewarm water in a bowl, then bring the mixture to a boil in saucepan.
Remove from heat, place in a bowl, and leave to thicken.
Stir cold water into the semolina mixture.
Stir in rock salt until fully dissolved into the mixture.
Stir in the wheat flour and yeast.
Mix in another 2 cups of lukewarm water until you get a thin batter.
Cover the batter and let it rest until it is risen and bubbly.
Grease a skillet or frying pan with a little margarine, and heat over medium heat.
Ladle some batter into the pan, and let it spread out. A tiny bit of flour sprinkled in the pan helps prevent sticking.
Cook the batter until the top surface is covered with air pockets like a sponge.
Flip to the other side, and cook for about 5 seconds.
Remove and let cool.
Repeat the cooking process with the remaining batter.

recipes.title: Chuu Chee Fish
recipes.description: Whole fish in kaeng chuu chee curry sauce with lime leaves. It is a Thai main course, also good with rice.

ingredients.text: 650 g whole bream or similar fish
ingredients.name: ryba

ingredients.text: 1 metric cup vegetable oil (reserve 1 tablespoon for stir-frying curry paste)
ingredients.name: olej roślinny
ingredients.note: reserve 1 tablespoon for stir-frying curry paste

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon of kaeng chu chee curry paste
ingredients.name: pasta curry kaeng chu chee

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon (warning: perhaps the metric 20 mL one) fish sauce
ingredients.name: sos rybny
ingredients.note: warning: perhaps the metric 20 mL one

steps.text: In a wok or large frypan, over high heat, fry fish using most of the vegetable oil, until golden on one side. It will take about 5 minutes.
Lower heat and, using tongs, gently turn fish over.
Turn up heat again and cook until golden. Using tongs again, lift fish gently onto a serving plate.
In the wok, gently stir-fry the curry-paste and lime leaves in remaining tablespoon of oil.
Add coconut milk and fish sauce. Simmer for about 5 minutes.
Add sugar and simmer for another 5 minutes.
Taste to see if extra coconut milk, fish sauce, or sugar is required.
Pour sauce over fish and garnish with cilantro and chopped chili peppers.

recipes.title: Frito Pie (Baked)
recipes.description: A traditional, basic Frito pie made from corn chips, cheddar cheese and chili con carne, baked until bubbly.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350 °F (175 °C).
Spread 2 cups of Fritos in a baking dish.
Sprinkle half of the cheese over the Fritos.
Spread the chili over the Fritos.
Bake for 15–20 minutes until cheese is bubbly.
Add remaining cheese and Fritos to top of pie.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Original Texas-Style Chili
recipes.description: The original Texas-style chili con carne, made with beef, chile peppers, suet and masa harina, and no other vegetables.

ingredients.text: 4 chile pods, skinned and blistered, or sun-dried chiles
ingredients.name: papryczka chili
ingredients.note: skinned and blistered, or sun-dried chiles

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon Tabasco sauce (optional but frequently included)
ingredients.name: sos Tabasco

ingredients.text: 2 garlic cloves, chopped (or more, to taste)
ingredients.name: ząbek czosnku

steps.text: Sear beef in a little cooking oil (not lard) until lightly browned.

Add the seared beef, suet, and chile pods to a large iron skillet or pot (at least four quarts), and enough water (the reserved "pepper water" if you prepared the pods yourself) to keep the meat from burning.
Bring to a boil, then lower heat, cover, and simmer about 30 minutes.
Take pot off the stove and add spices and garlic.
Put back on the stove, bring to a boil again, lower heat, and simmer another hour, keeping the lid on as much as possible.
Stir when necessary, but remember that too much stirring will tear the meat. Add a little more water if anything seems seriously in danger of burning (but as little water as possible).
Take pot off the stove and skim off all or most of the grease.
Mix in masa harina, which "tightens" or thickens the chili con carne and adds a subtle tamale-like flavor.
Simmer about 30 minutes more, until meat is done.
Do a lot of tasting during this time to adjust the seasoning.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Spicy Miso Udon
recipes.description: A spicy miso udon soup made with dry udon noodles, where the temperature must be kept low so the delicate flavors are not ruined.

ingredients.text: 2 oz katsuobushi (the flavor is mild so you can use more)
ingredients.name: katsuobushi
ingredients.note: the flavor is mild so you can use more

ingredients.text: 1 chopped green bell pepper or jalapeno pepper
ingredients.name: papryka zielona

ingredients.text: ½ tbsp honey or to taste
ingredients.name: miód

steps.text: Bring the chicken broth to a boil. Add the katsuobushi flakes, remove from heat, and let rest for 1 minute.
Strain out and discard the katsuobushi flakes, and set the broth aside.
Cook the udon noodles in salted water until al dente. Drain them, rinse with cold water, and set aside.
In a medium-sized soup pot, stir fry sucuk, green pepper, and onion in olive oil.
Add cabbage, paprika powder, and red pepper paste. Stir to combine.
Add reserved broth, and bring to a simmer over low to medium heat; do not let this get too hot because the flavor of the katsuobushi is very delicate.
Add bean sprouts. Continue to simmer until vegetables reach desired texture.
Add cooked noodles, miso, honey, and tabasco. Do not let the soup reach a boil, as too much heat will destroy the soup's rich flavor.
Add enoki and sardines, and simmer just enough to warm through.
Crack an egg or two into the broth, and serve when the yolk is just firm.
Garnish with scallions.

recipes.title: Tomato Pizza
recipes.description: Tomato pie is a type of pizza, popular in Italy and the north east USA, made with thick pizza dough and a thick tomato sauce, sprinkled with grated Romano cheese after cooking.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 250°C (450°F).
Stretch the pizza dough to cover a greased baking sheet. Dough should be about 3 cm (¾ inch) thick.
Allow the dough to rise while the sauce is prepared.
Heat a saucepan on medium heat, add the olive oil and garlic.
Sauté until garlic is just golden.
Add crushed tomatoes and oregano.
Cook until the sauce is thickened, about 15–20 minutes.
Cool the sauce until it is room temperature.
Top the pizza dough with mozzarella cheese, then any toppings such as sausage or pepperoni, then top with sauce, bake in the oven for about 15–20 minutes.
After removing the tomato-pie from the oven, sprinkle the grated cheese on top and then let the pizza cool to room temperature.
Serve at room temperature or reheat under the broiler or in a toaster-oven.

recipes.title: Tapai Ketan (Indonesian Fermented Sticky Rice)
recipes.description: Tapai, also tape, is a traditional fermented food of Indonesia. This recipe is for tape ketan, made from glutinous rice.

ingredients.text: A couple of drops of pandan paste for color (optional)
ingredients.name: pasta pandanowa

steps.text: Rinse the rice and cook it in the water, unsalted. If adding pandan paste, add it now.
Bring the water to boiling point with the rice in it, then put the lid on the pot, turn the heat down to lowest possible setting and simmer for 15 minutes.
Allow rice to cool down to about 30°C (86°F). To help it cool down faster, sit the pot in a basin of cold water.
Crumble the cake of ragi tapai over the rice and mix in well.
Loosely pack the mixture into a large jar, cover with a cloth, and set aside in a warm place to ferment (about 30–35°C / 86–95°F). The tapai will ferment over the next 2–4 days.

After about two days, it should start to show a little liquid at the bottom of the jar, and will start producing a distinctive smell of tapai. At this point, the tapai can be considered complete, although it will taste better after a couple of days kept in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Fool
recipes.description: Rhubarb fool is a traditional dessert in Swedish cuisine. Its sweet and sour taste makes it a perfect summer dessert, to be served after a heavy meal.

ingredients.text: Milk, or a mixture of milk and cream, for serving
ingredients.name: mleko
ingredients.note: for serving; or a mixture of milk and cream

steps.text: Rinse the rhubarb and cut it into smaller pieces, about 1–3 cm in length.
If the rhubarb is coarse or of low quality, it may be necessary to peel it first.
Bring the water and sugar to a boil.
Add the rhubarb and boil until soft, about 3–5 minutes.
Meanwhile, mix the starch with a bit of water until it dissolves.
When the rhubarb is soft, whisk or stir vigorously to make sure all the rhubarb pieces break up into strings.
There should be no whole pieces left—if necessary boil some more.
Remove the rhubarb from the heat.
Add the dissolved starch to the rhubarb while stirring.
Keep stirring and bring the rhubarb to a boil once again.
Pour the rhubarb fool into serving bowls and sprinkle some sugar on top to prevent a skin from forming.
Leave to cool off and then refrigerate.
Serve at room temperature or chilled, with milk.

recipes.title: Pakistani Chai
recipes.description: Pakistański chai, czyli herbata z mlekiem i kardamonem, przygotowywana w rondelku.

ingredients.text: *2 heaping teaspoons of loose chai tea leaves
ingredients.name: herbata czarna liściasta

ingredients.text: *2 pieces of whole cardamom (optional, but it gives a nice aroma)
ingredients.name: kardamon

steps.text: Bring the water to a simmer in the saucepan over medium-high heat. Tear the cardamom shell (or grind it) and add it to the pan.
Quickly put the milk in the microwave and heat it for 2 minutes, or until very close to boiling over.
When the water nearly reaches a boil, slowly add the loose tea. Don't overwhelm the pan.
Add hot milk to the pan until it reaches a light brown color. It'll get only a shade or two darker when it's done. Raise the heat to the highest setting.
If you think you added too much milk, take a big spoon or spatula and mix it continuously. Remember: This all goes very fast, so be prepared ahead of time with your utensils.
Take the saucepan off the heat when the chai is about to boil over and pour it in the cup through the strainer.
Sweeten with sugar if desired.

recipes.title: Meatloaf I
recipes.description: Klasyczny meatloaf z mielonej wołowiny, zapiekany w formie do chleba i podawany z sosem z zupy grzybowej.

steps.text: Combine the ground beef, eggs, minced garlic, salt, allspice, curry powder, and Worcestershire sauce.
Mix in the chopped onion, celery, and cracker crumbs.
Press the mixture into a standard loaf pan.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for about 10–20 minutes until browned on top.
Tilt the pan, and drain off any accumulated grease. Add the mushroom soup on top.
Bake another 1.5–2 hours until cooked through.

recipes.title: Chocolate Crinkles
recipes.description: Easy chocolate cookies with a strong chocolate taste and a dramatic black and white appearance; the dough must chill for several hours before baking.

ingredients.text: 4 squares (4 oz / 115 g) unsweetened chocolate, melted
ingredients.name: czekolada gorzka do pieczenia

steps.text: Mix oil, chocolate, and granulated sugar.
Blend in one egg at a time until well mixed. Add vanilla.
Stir flour, baking powder, and salt into chocolate mixture.
Chill several hours or overnight.
Heat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Drop teaspoonfuls of dough into confectioners' sugar.
Roll in sugar; shape into balls.
Place about 2 inches (5 cm) apart on greased baking sheet.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Choucroute (Sauerkraut with Meat and Potatoes)
recipes.description: Choucroute garnie is a dish of sauerkraut with sausages, salt pork, and potatoes.

ingredients.text: 1 or so tablespoons of duck fat
ingredients.name: tłuszcz kaczy

ingredients.text: 1 or so tablespoons of coriander seed
ingredients.name: nasiona kolendry

ingredients.text: 2 strips of bacon (or the same amount of salted pork belly), sliced into rough squares
ingredients.name: boczek
ingredients.note: or the same amount of salted pork belly, sliced into rough squares

ingredients.text: 1 cup (240 ml) or so of white wine (dry)
ingredients.name: wino białe wytrawne

steps.text: In a pot large enough to in the end hold everything, melt the duck fat over medium heat.
When hot, add the onions and sauté until translucent (about 5 minutes or so).
Then, add the sauerkraut, white wine, juniper berries, clove, coriander seed, mustard seed, and garlic.
Add the smoked pork and bacon.
Cover, and then simmer for about 2 hours.
In other pot, simmer the peeled potatoes and your sausages—don't boil, or your sausages will split open.
Simmer until potatoes are done (and by then the sausage will be, too).
Serve in a heap—sauerkraut at the bottom, various pig and potato parts on top.

recipes.title: Nigerian Barbecued Chicken Wings
recipes.description: Nigerian barbecued chicken wings are usually eaten as a side dish or served alongside grains like jollof rice and fried rice.

steps.text: Combine the flour, cornmeal, pepper, salt, sugar, ginger, and paprika in a bowl.
Add the chicken pieces, and rub the mixture into them well so they are completely coated.
Set in the fridge, and allow the chicken to rest for 1 hour.
Arrange the chicken pieces on a baking tray or on a grill. Grill or bake until cooked through (about 45 minutes baking at 375°F).

recipes.title: Fabes con Almejas (Spanish Beans with Clams)
recipes.description: A clam and bean stew from Asturias, Spain, served as a lighter variation of fabada.

ingredients.text: 1 pound (450 g) dried white beans (e.g. navy, great northern, cannellini)
ingredients.name: fasola biała

ingredients.text: 1 generous pinch of saffron or yellow food coloring
ingredients.name: szafran

ingredients.text: A large loaf of crusty bread
ingredients.name: chleb

steps.text: Rinse the beans and soak overnight.
Scrub the clams clean and rinse.
Drain the beans and place them in a skillet with the onion, garlic, two pinches of parsley, bay leaves, and olive oil.
Add just enough water to cover the ingredients and cook over a high flame.

Bring to a boil and then reduce to a simmer. Skim off any foam. Cook them, loosely covered, until done. This should take about 90 minutes. Check the skillet occasionally to add water. Never allow the water to drop below the height of the ingredients.

When the beans are almost done, place the clams in a separate skillet and add about an inch of water. Cover the skillet and cook over medium heat, shaking the pan occasionally to help the clams open. Check the clams every minute. Remove them as they open and place them in a separate bowl. This should take no more than 10 minutes. Once you've removed all the clams you'll have clam broth in the skillet. Save the broth, as you'll need it for the next step.
Check the broth for bits of dirt and clam shell. If there's a lot, you'll have to strain it through a cloth to remove the grit.
Add the broth to the simmering beans along with the saffron (or food coloring), the remaining parsley, paprika and salt to taste.
Cover and cook for 5–10 minutes.
Ladle the beans and broth into separate bowls and add six clams to each bowl.
Serve with crusty bread on the side.

recipes.title: Latino Scramble
recipes.description: Latino scramble to śniadaniowa jajecznica z szynką, kukurydzą i serem mozzarella, podawana z arepas, kawą i sokiem pomarańczowym.

steps.text: Melt butter in a medium frying pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions, and fry until they start to brown.
Add ham and sweet corn, and let fry for 5 minutes.
Add tomato, salt, and pepper. Though not traditional, you can also add one drop of Tabasco per egg.
Beat the eggs with ketchup, and add to frying pan. Immediately add mozzarella cheese.
Let cook to your desired egg texture.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
recipes.description: Miękkie ciastka owsiane z rodzynkami i orzechami włoskimi.

ingredients.text: ¾ cup butter, applesauce, equal parts butter and vegetable oil, or shortening
ingredients.name: masło
ingredients.note: or applesauce, equal parts butter and vegetable oil, or shortening

ingredients.text: 1 ¼ cup brown sugar, firmly packed
ingredients.name: cukier trzcinowy brązowy

ingredients.text: 3 cup raw oats (rolled or quick/old fashioned)
ingredients.name: płatki owsiane

steps.text: Heat oven to 350°F.
Lightly grease cookie sheet with oil, shortening, or butter.
Combine your choice of fat (butter, apple sauce, butter/vegetable oil mix, or shortening), brown sugar, egg, milk, and vanilla; beat with mixer on high speed to blend well.
Combine oats, flour, baking soda, salt and cinnamon; add to shortening mixture and combine until just blended.
Stir in raisins and nuts.
Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet, 2 inches apart.
Bake for 10–13 minutes, or until lightly browned.

images: Eba with Ewedu soup & Stew with Croaker Fish and Shaki.jpg

recipes.title: Ewedu Soup (Yoruba Style)
recipes.description: Traditional Yoruba soup made from jute leaves, with a slippery, mucilaginous texture, often served with fufu, pounded yam or amala.

ingredients.text: 2–3 pieces of beef, goat meat, or fish (your choice)
ingredients.name: wołowina
ingredients.note: 2–3 pieces of beef, goat meat, or fish (your choice)

ingredients.text: 1–2 tablespoons ground pepper or fresh pepper (to taste)
ingredients.name: pieprz mielony
ingredients.note: 1–2, ground or fresh pepper, to taste

steps.text: Combine the meat, onion, stock cube, and salt in a pot. Cover with water, and simmer until tender to your taste—for tough meat, this will take longer.
Wash the ewedu leaves thoroughly if fresh. If using dried ewedu, soak it in warm water for 30 minutes until it softens.
In a second pot, add the washed ewedu leaves and a little water. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally. It will begin to produce a slimy texture as it cooks.
Blend the red bell peppers and ground pepper until you get a smooth purée. Add the blended pepper to the pot of cooking ewedu.
Stir in the ground crayfish, palm oil, and any additional seasoning (stock cubes, salt, and pepper) to taste.
Continue cooking for another 5–10 minutes, stirring frequently until the soup thickens and becomes smooth.
Serve the ewedu soup hot, paired with your choice of fufu, pounded yam, or amala.

recipes.title: Queen of Puddings
recipes.description: Favourite English bread pudding served with an apricot glaze and a soft meringue topping.

ingredients.text: 6 oz (about 4 cups / 170 g) freshly-grated bread crumbs
ingredients.name: bułka tarta

ingredients.text: 4 Tbsp raspberry jam, or jam of choice
ingredients.name: dżem malinowy
ingredients.note: raspberry jam, or jam of choice

steps.text: Heat the milk, sugar, lemon zest and butter until just below the boil.
Pour onto the bread crumbs and allow the whole to cool slightly, about 10 minutes.
Beat the egg yolks and stir into the bread crumb and milk mixture.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 35 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes.
Spread the top with the warmed jam, being careful not to break the surface of the pudding.
Whip the egg whites with the vanilla sugar and a few drops of lemon juice until the mixture reaches soft peaks.
Spread the meringue over the top of the pudding. Return to the oven and bake for 15 minutes until the meringue has browned.
Serve as is or with crème anglaise.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Muffins
recipes.description: Banana nut muffins based on a Joy of Cooking recipe, slightly modified.

ingredients.text: ½ cups (120 ml) chopped nuts (such as walnuts)
ingredients.name: orzech

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Grease a muffin tin.
Cream together eggs, honey, milk, vegetable oil, and bananas.
Combine dry ingredients, then mix gently with wet ingredients. Lumpy batter is to be expected.
Bake for 20–25 minutes.
Cool.

recipes.title: Cabbie Claw (Scottish Whitefish with Egg and Potato)
recipes.description: Traditional dish from the North-East of Scotland and Orkney, made with young whitefish such as cod, haddock or whiting, served over mashed potato with an egg sauce.

ingredients.text: 1 kg (about 2 lb) whole spelding (cod or other whitefish like haddock or whiting)
ingredients.name: młody dorsz
ingredients.note: whole spelding (cod or other whitefish like haddock or whiting)

ingredients.text: 2-3 springs fresh Parsley (plus extra for garnish)
ingredients.name: natka pietruszki

ingredients.text: 2 Hard boiled eggs (whites chopped, yolks reserved for garnish)
ingredients.name: jajko ugotowane na twardo
ingredients.note: whites chopped, yolks reserved for garnish

ingredients.text: A pinch of freshly grated Nutmeg
ingredients.name: gałka muszkatołowa

ingredients.text: 500 g (about 1 lb) Mashed potato, for serving
ingredients.name: ziemniaki gotowane

ingredients.text: A pinch of cayenne pepper, for garnish
ingredients.name: pieprz cayenne

steps.text: Clean the spelding, removing the eyes, splitting the fish, and wiping it down.
Rub the fish with coarse salt and leave overnight.
The following day, hang the fish in a shaded, cool, drafty place for 24 hrs.
Cover the fish in a kettle with boiling water. Parsley and fresh horseradish may be added to the broth.
Simmer until the fish is cooked.
Remove the fish from the broth, reserving the broth.
Skin and de-bone the fish, then flake the flesh roughly and keep warm in a slow oven.
Make a roux with the butter and flour, then slowly add the fish stock and milk, constantly stirring to avoid lumpiness.
Chop the whites of the eggs roughly (reserving the yolks). Mix the whites into the sauce, and season to taste.
Layer the flaked fish on top of the mashed potato. Pour the sauce over top, and garnish with chopped egg yolks, parsley, and cayenne.

recipes.title: Gambian Baobab Juice (Bouye)
recipes.description: Bouye juice is a creamy Gambian beverage made from baobab fruit pulp, sweetened and mixed with evaporated milk. It is served chilled over ice in the hot Gambian climate.

ingredients.text: 1 cup evaporated milk or condensed milk
ingredients.name: mleko odparowane

ingredients.text: ¼ cup sugar (adjust according to taste)
ingredients.name: cukier

steps.text: In a blender, combine the baobab fruit pulp and water. Blend on high speed until the mixture is smooth and well-combined.
Place a strainer or cheesecloth over a pitcher or jug, and pour the blended mixture through it to remove any pulp or seeds, resulting in a smoother juice.
Add the evaporated milk or condensed milk to the pitcher, along with the sugar and vitamin C powder (if using). Stir well until the sugar is dissolved and the ingredients are thoroughly mixed.
Refrigerate the bouye juice for at least 1 hour to chill and allow the flavors to meld together.
Once chilled, give the juice a good stir before serving.
Pour the juice into glasses filled with ice cubes.
Garnish each glass with fresh mint leaves for added freshness and aroma.
Serve the bouye juice immediately and enjoy its refreshing and creamy goodness.

recipes.title: Rich Brownies
recipes.description: Rich brownies are cake-like but are denser and not springy or gooey.

ingredients.text: ⅔ cup (160 g / 1.6 dl) solid fat (e.g. margarine, butter, shortening, or lard)
ingredients.name: tłuszcz stały
ingredients.note: e.g. margarine, butter, shortening, or lard

ingredients.text: 1 cup (240 g / 2.4 dl) coarsely chopped nuts (½ inch / 1 cm walnuts work well)
ingredients.name: orzechy
ingredients.note: coarsely chopped (½ inch / 1 cm walnuts work well)

steps.text: Heat oven to 175 °C (350 °F).
Melt chocolate and margarine in a double boiler, or (carefully) in a saucepan on low heat, stirring often.
Remove from heat.
Mix in the sugar, eggs and vanilla.
Excluding the nuts, mix the dry ingredients with each other, and then into the wet mixture.
Mix in the nuts.
Spread into a 30x20 cm (13x9 in) baking pan, or into two 20x20 cm (8x8 in) baking pans.
Bake for 30 minutes, or until brownies pull away from the sides of the pan.

recipes.title: Corn Chowder I
recipes.description: Zupa z kukurydzą, ziemniakami i selerem na mleku i śmietance, przyprawiona tymiankiem.

ingredients.text: 1½ cups diced, pared potatoes, cut in ½-inch cubes
ingredients.name: ziemniak
ingredients.note: diced, pared, cut in ½-inch cubes

steps.text: In a medium saucepan, melt butter; add onion and celery and cook until tender.
Add potatoes, corn, salt, pepper, water, bouillon cubes, and thyme.
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes, or until potatoes and corn are tender.
Add milk and cream.
Heat through.

recipes.title: Buuz (Mongolian Meat Dumplings)
recipes.description: Mongolian steamed dumplings filled with seasoned minced beef.

steps.text: Combine beef, salt, onion, pepper, and water in a bowl. Mix together thoroughly and leave covered during the preparation of the dough.
In a bowl mix together flour and cold water to make a very soft dough. Cover the bowl and leave the dough for 5 minutes to relax.
Knead the dough for a half minute. Cut the dough into 10 pieces, and flatten the dough into discs.
Place a fair amount of meat mixture on each disc, and fold the edges together to enclose the filling.
Boil a fair amount of water in a steamer. Spread some oil on the steamer pan to protect the buuz buns from getting stuck during cooking.
Carefully place the buuz buns on the steamer pan, spacing them 1 cm (0.4 inch) away from one another. Place the pan into the boiling steamer and cover the steamer very well. Cook for 15 minutes.
Take out the steamer board and fan the buuz for 30 seconds using steamer cover or any safe, light object.
Serve with some cabbage salad, or some chopped kosher cucumbers. Enjoy!

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Saffron Rice
recipes.description: Saffron rice is yellow or tan, with a taste reminiscent of spice breads and spice cakes. It goes well with chicken.

ingredients.text: 1 inch piece of cinnamon stick or equivalent ground cinnamon
ingredients.name: cynamon
ingredients.note: 1 inch piece of cinnamon stick or equivalent ground cinnamon

steps.text: Wash the rice in cool water until the water runs absolutely clear.
Place the saffron threads in a teaspoon or tablespoon of boiling water to soak.
Heat the oil, cinnamon, and cloves in a heavy saucepan.
Add the celery to the saucepan.
Add the rice to the saucepan; stir for 5 minutes and/or until the grains are golden.
Add the stock, sugar, molasses, salt, coriander, and cardamom.
Stir to dissolve the sugar.
Bring to a boil, then reduce to a low simmer.
Add the saffron mix, both water and threads, stirring gently.
Cover and cook 25 minutes, or until rice is tender and the liquid absorbed.
Fluff with a fork.

recipes.title: Tabbouleh II
recipes.description: A simple tabbouleh, a sweet, chewy Mediterranean salad with bulgur, parsley, mint, tomato and onion.

ingredients.text: 1 bunch fresh parsley (preferably flat leaf), very finely chopped
ingredients.name: natka pietruszki
ingredients.note: fresh, preferably flat leaf, very finely chopped

ingredients.text: ½ bunch fresh mint leaves, finely chopped
ingredients.name: mięta świeża

ingredients.text: ½ tsp salt, or to taste
ingredients.name: sól

ingredients.text: ½ tsp pepper, or to taste
ingredients.name: pieprz czarny mielony

steps.text: Place the bulgur in the lemon juice and set aside for 15 minutes.
When the bulgur is soft, mix all the ingredients together, adding the olive oil last.
Toss well, and adjust the lemon juice as desired.

categories: Recipes using beef broth and stock

recipes.title: Sizzling Sisig (Filipino Pork Sauté)
recipes.description: Sisig is a Filipino dish made from pork jowl and ears, pork belly, and chicken liver, usually seasoned with calamansi, onions, and chili peppers.

ingredients.text: ½ kilo of pig's heart, grilled and minced
ingredients.name: serce wieprzowe

ingredients.text: ½ kilo of pig's lungs, grilled and minced
ingredients.name: płuca wieprzowe

ingredients.text: ½ kilo of pig's intestines, grilled and minced
ingredients.name: jelita wieprzowe

ingredients.text: 2 tbsp oil from the pork fat
ingredients.name: tłuszcz wieprzowy

ingredients.text: 1 cup vinegar (sukang iloko would be good)
ingredients.name: ocet

steps.text: Grill pork head to remove hair.
Boil pork head until tender.
Take out all the meat and dice.
In a sauté pan, heat oil and sauté garlic, onion, red pepper, pork meat and liver.
Season with liquid seasoning, black pepper, and brown sugar.
Pour in beef stock and cook until meat is tender and starts to oil again.
Add minced chili pepper last.
Serve on a sizzling plate.

recipes.title: Ghormeh Sabzi (Iranian Herb Stew)
recipes.description: Ghormeh sabzi is one of the most popular dishes in the Persian part of Iran, a slow-simmered herb stew flavoured with dried limes.

ingredients.text: 800 g beef or lamb which has some fat (such as the meat for boiled beef)
ingredients.name: wołowina
ingredients.note: beef or lamb which has some fat (such as the meat for boiled beef)

ingredients.text: 1 can (about 400 g) fried ghormeh sabzi herbs
ingredients.name: suszone zioła ghormeh sabzi, smażone

steps.text: Boil the red beans for 1 hour.
Remove unnecessary fat from the meat, and cut the meat into smaller pieces.
Heat a bit of normal olive oil in a big pot with lid. Add the onions, and fry at high temperature for 1–2 minutes.
Stir in the meat, and cook for another 1–2 minutes.
Reduce the heat to the lowest level. The meat will release a significant amount of juice which will contribute to the flavor of the stew.
Stir in the parsley, spinach, coriander leaves, and ghormeh sabzi herbs.
Stir in boiling water (about 0.5 L or until the consistency is right).
Stir in the cooked, drained beans. Simmer for about ½–3 hours over low heat. The longer the better.
Soak the dried limes in hot water for 15 minutes, and puncture each of them with a fork.
Add the dried limes, turmeric, pepper, and salt to the stew. Simmer for another ½–1 hour.
If desired, for the best taste, let the stew cool down and store it in a fridge. The taste is better over the next two days.
Steam the rice.
Grind the saffron and sugar together in a mortar. Add about 1 tablespoon boiling water. Toss some of the cooked rice with the saffron water to color it.
Serve the stew hot in its own bowl. Serve the plain rice in a separate bowl, topped with the saffron rice.

recipes.title: Béchamel Sauce (Basic)
recipes.description: A basic white sauce, one of the five French mother sauces, used as the base of many other sauces.

ingredients.text: 1000 ml (4½ cups) whole milk (>3% milk fat)
ingredients.name: mleko

steps.text: In a saucepan, melt the butter over medium-low heat. Whisk in the flour to make a roux.
Cook the roux over gentle heat for 3–5 minutes, but do not brown. This cooking is necessary to remove the floury taste.
In a separate pot, begin heating the milk. Peel the onion, but do not cut it.
Add the onion and bay leaf into the pot with the milk. Keep stirring until milk is heated to 80°C. Do not let the milk adhere and cook to pot bottom.
Remove onion and bay leaf.
Gradually whisk the heated milk into cooked roux. Add salt and pepper to taste.
Stir and cook for 15 minutes until thickened. No lumps should be present.

recipes.title: Pierogi I
recipes.description: Polish dumplings typically filled with potatoes, cheese, meat, sauerkraut and mushrooms, or wild fruits such as strawberries and blueberries.

ingredients.text: 3½ cups all-purpose flour, plus extra for rolling dough
ingredients.name: mąka pszenna

ingredients.text: 1 recipe sauerkraut filling or cheese filling
ingredients.name: nadzienie

steps.text: Place flour in a large bowl.
In a measuring cup, combine the salt, eggs and the ½ cup cold water, and beat well with a fork. Add these to the flour and mix with your hands until blended.
Slowly mix in the remaining water, adding only as much as needed until the dough feels wet.
Add the butter and knead until there are no lumps and the dough feels very smooth.
Cover and refrigerate the dough for at least 1 hour, but for best results let it sit in the refrigerator for at least 24 hours.
Divide the dough into thirds and roll out each on a lightly floured surface until approximately ⅛ inch thick.
With a cup or glass, cut as many circles as possible out of the dough, but do not lift them off the work surface.

Carefully lift each circle of dough from the table (a spatula helps) and put between 1 tsp and 1 tbsp of filling in its center. The amount varies depending on the size of the glass used to cut the dough.
For each circle, fold the dough over to form a half-moon shape, and pinch the edges closed, making sure there are no air pockets.
Repeat for the remaining dough.
Place no more than ⅓ of the pierogi at a time in boiling salted water for 5–10 minutes.
Drain in a colander and lightly rinse with cold water to prevent them from sticking together.
Serve immediately or fry in butter.

recipes.title: Atkins-Friendly Mock Tiramisu
recipes.description: Loosely inspired by tiramisu, made with sour cream, cream cheese, eggs, cocoa and instant espresso, without refined carbohydrates.

steps.text: Blend everything together until smooth.

categories: Recipes using vegetable broth and stock

recipes.title: Bean Soup (Vegetarian)
recipes.description: A hearty vegetarian soup with mixed vegetables, tomatoes, pasta, kidney and black beans, and Parmesan.

ingredients.text: ⅓ cup broken angel-hair pasta, in 1- to 2-inch lengths
ingredients.name: makaron anielskie włosy

steps.text: Pour broth and water into a 4½-quart Dutch oven or soup pot.
Place pot over high heat.
While liquid is heating, add frozen vegetables, stewed tomatoes with their juices and uncooked pasta.
Cover pot and bring to boil.
Meanwhile, rinse and drain beans.
When soup comes to a boil, uncover it and stir well. Scrape the pot with a wooden spoon to loosen any pasta.
Add beans, Italian seasoning, and garlic powder.
Reduce heat to medium-high or medium, maintaining a moderate boil.
Stir frequently and cook until pasta is tender, about 5 minutes.
Reduce heat to low and add Parmesan.
Stir occasionally and simmer for 5 minutes to develop the flavor.
Serve at once or simmer on low until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Cheese Sauce I
recipes.description: Cheese sauce is a variation of Béchamel Sauce.

ingredients.text: 1 cup heavy whipping cream or ½ cup whole milk, hot
ingredients.name: śmietanka
ingredients.note: or ½ cup whole milk, hot

steps.text: Melt the butter in a saucepan. Add the flour and whisk together over medium heat for 2–3 minutes, to make a white roux. Do not allow to brown.
Remove from heat and allow to cool nearly to room temperature.
Gradually add hot heavy whipping cream to the roux, whisking to combine. This will also work with a hot roux and room temperature heavy cream or milk.
Add the salt, cheese, and mustard, then heat till just simmering and cheese has melted.

If desired, you may bring the sauce to a boil; once the cheese sauce has come to a boil, lower the heat to low and very slowly simmer for about 45 minutes. Stir it every so often to avoid sticking to the bottom (a whisk is appropriate here).
Do not allow the sauce to brown.
The longer the sauce is simmered, the smoother it becomes due to the cooking and swelling of the starch grains.

recipes.title: Svelekake (Norwegian Yogurt Pancakes)
recipes.description: Norwegian yogurt pancakes fried on a hot griddle and served with butter, brunost or a hazelnut spread.

steps.text: Mix all ingredients gently (do not use mixer).
Let batter stand ½ hour.
Fry on hot griddle.
Serve with butter, brunost (brown/goat cheese), or Nugatti Crisp (caramel/hazelnut dessert spread).

recipes.title: Soy Milk I
recipes.description: Domowe mleko sojowe przygotowane z suszonej soi, zblendowane i przecedzone przez ściereczkę.

steps.text: Put the soybeans and 1 L of water into the pot, and let them soak for 8–12 hours.

Strip the soaked beans of their hulls by rubbing or crushing them between your fingers. Remove the hulls and pour away the excess water. While the hulls have about the same density as the beans and bean splinters, you can exploit their high flow resistance for separating the two: Fill some water into the bowl, then pour it away quickly enough to drag the hulls with it, but not so quickly that the beans will follow. This process resembles the winnowing of dry chaff from seeds. It's no problem if a few hulls remain.
Add ½ L of fresh water and blend until you get a creamy substance. Add another ½ liter and blend until totally smooth.

Bring the raw milk to a boil while stirring, then reduce the temperature to minimum, put the lid on top, and simmer for 20 minutes. Attention: May overboil, check frequently. Removing the lid will allow vapor to escape and reduce the foam. Another possibility is to pour a little bit of cold water on top of the lid.
The bitter odor of the raw milk should now be gone. Remove the pot from the stove and add 1 liter of cold water.

Line the inside of the can with the cheesecloth so it is completely covered, and the edges of the cloth hang over the edge of the can. The following process will not work if the body of the can is much wider than the opening, though. In this case, use a large bowl instead.

Carefully pour the cooked, unfiltered milk into the can. Then fold the cheesecloth together at the top and lift it up out of the can so that the filtered milk drips into the can. Rotate the bottom of the cloth against the top and use your hands to exert additional pressure upon the soy mass. Be careful not to burn yourself.

When you're no longer able to extract significant amounts of milk from the soy mass, open the cheesecloth, and put the resulting rubberlike, crumbly okara ball into the prepared container. Store it in a cool place for up to 3 days; you may also freeze it.

recipes.title: Custard Pie
recipes.description: This eggy, sweet pie is easy to make—it forms its own crust as it cooks! Delicious for dessert or a sweet breakfast.

steps.text: Blend all ingredients for 1 minute in a blender.
Pour into a buttered 9-inch pie plate.
Bake for 30 minutes at 400°F (200°C / Gas Mark 6) or until a knife inserted into the center by 1 inch comes out clean.

recipes.title: Sausage-Egg Breakfast Dish
recipes.description: Zapiekanka śniadaniowa z kiełbasą, jajkami, chlebem i serem cheddar.

steps.text: Brown sausage and sprinkle with pepper.
Drain off excess fat, and let sausage cool.
Beat eggs and add milk.
Fold in cubes of stale bread, cheese, and cooled sausage.
Pour into an 8 by 8-inch baking dish coated with cooking spray.
Refrigerate for at least an hour (or freeze for later).
Preheat oven to 325°F. Bake for 1 hour.
Cool and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Shrimp Fritters (Accra)
recipes.description: Trinidadian fried fritters made from flour, chopped shrimp, and aromatics, deep-fried until golden brown.

ingredients.text: ¼ cup (60 ml) green pepper, chopped
ingredients.name: papryka zielona

ingredients.text: 1 Scotch bonnet or other hot pepper, minced
ingredients.name: papryczka chili
ingredients.note: Scotch bonnet or other hot pepper, minced

ingredients.name: woda
ingredients.note: enough to make a soft mixture

steps.text: Combine green pepper, spring onions, onions, and scotch bonnet in a bowl.
Add remaining ingredients except water, and mix thoroughly.
Stir in enough water to make a soft mixture using a spoon. Beat mixture until is smooth.
Using a pan or deep fryer, drop spoonfuls in to hot oil, and fry until all sides are brown.

recipes.title: Black Bean Soup
recipes.description: A blend of beans and vegetables inspired by Tex-Mex cuisine.

steps.text: Pick over the beans.
Place in large bean pot and add water to cover by at least 2 inches (~5 cm).
Soak overnight, then change water.
Bring beans to a boil. Reduce heat, then simmer until beans start to soften, around ½ hour.
Add bay leaves, bell peppers, chili powder, cumin, garlic, jalapeños, onions, and red wine vinegar.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Simmer ½ to 1 hour, until beans are soft.
Take out bay leaves.
Stir in cilantro.
Add some sour cream.
Serve.

recipes.title: Spicy Carrot Aioli
recipes.description: Vegan aioli-style sauce made from carrot, garlic and olive oil emulsion, with serrano chile and orange juice.

ingredients.text: 100–200 ml orange juice (any other citrus works)
ingredients.name: sok pomarańczowy

ingredients.text: French-style or Dijon mustard (i.e. one that does not contain "turmeric" in the list of ingredients; optional)
ingredients.name: musztarda dijon
ingredients.note: French-style or Dijon, without turmeric; optional

steps.text: Cut carrots extremely fine (i.e. 1 mm slivers) so that blender can handle it.
Combine all ingredients. Use a blender to start blending everything together.
Continue blending in additional olive oil until it reaches desired creaminess.
Adjust seasoning to taste.

recipes.title: Marillenknödel (Austrian Apricot Dumplings)
recipes.description: Sweet Austrian dumplings filled with apricots and sugar cubes, rolled in buttered breadcrumbs and powdered sugar.

steps.text: Mix the curd with the egg in a wide bowl. Add the semolina and a pinch of salt.
Wait for about 20 minutes to allow the semolina to soak.
Then, mix in as much flour as is necessary to make a smooth dough. In order to form fine dumplings later on, it is very important that the dough is not sticky.
Again, wait for about 10 minutes.
In the meantime, cut the apricots into two halves. Remove the pits and replace them with a sugar cube. Then, put the halves of the apricots together again.
Pour water and some salt into a big pot, and bring it to a boil.
Divide the dough into 10 equal pieces, and mould them into flat, round disks. Flouring your hands will prevent the dough from sticking onto them.

Wrap each apricot with one disk of dough, then roll the dumpling between your hands. Make sure that there are no holes in the dough and that the dough sticks to the apricots. Try to form evenly round dumplings. Don't worry if this does not work out perfectly the first time you prepare dumplings. The breadcrumbs and the sugar, which the dumplings will be covered with later on, will conceal any irregularities.

Carefully put the dumplings into the boiling water. The water usually ceases to boil for a short while after the dumplings have been placed into the pot. Wait until it boils again, and then reduce heat. Let the dumplings boil slowly until they start rising to the surface of the water.
Cover the pot and wait for about another 4 minutes. The dumplings will gain size during this period.
In the meantime, heat the butter in a pan and add bread crumbs along with sugar and a bit of cinnamon. Fry the breadcrumbs until they turn light brown.
Drain the dumplings, then roll them in the toasted bread crumbs until they are covered all over.
Serve the Marillenknödel together with the remaining bread crumbs, and coat them with much powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Easy Nachos
recipes.description: Nachos z tortilla chips zapiekane z serem cheddar, z opcjonalnymi zielonymi chili i cebulą.

ingredients.text: ⅓ cup (80 ml) chopped canned peeled green chiles (optional)
ingredients.name: papryczki chili zielone z puszki

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Lay the tortilla chips on a cookie sheet.
Toss together the cheese, chilies and onion; sprinkle over the tortilla chips.
Bake for about 2 minutes, or until the cheese has melted.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Pretzels (Soft)
recipes.description: These are soft pretzels.

ingredients.text: 1 package yeast (¼ oz active dry yeast, 2¼ tsp dry yeast, or one 0.6 oz yeast cake)
ingredients.name: drożdże suszone
ingredients.note: ¼ oz active dry yeast, 2¼ tsp dry yeast, or one 0.6 oz yeast cake

steps.text: Dissolve the yeast in the water.
Mix in the salt, sugar, and flour.
Knead the dough until it is smooth.
Roll out (do not cut) a blob of dough until it is a rope about 18 inches long.

If a traditional shape is desired: Make a loop with the middle of the dough, crossing the dough over itself at about the 15% and 85% areas. Give this contact point a 180° twist, then flip it (and the ends) over toward the middle of the dough piece so that the ends overlap the more-central part at about the 45% and 55% areas.
Brush the pretzel with egg.
Sprinkle coarse salt onto the egg.
Bake at 425°F for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Machacado con Huevo (Eggs with Shredded Beef)
recipes.description: Shredded dry beef scrambled with eggs, served with tortillas, refried beans, cheese and salsa.

ingredients.text: 10 ea. 8-inch soft taco-size flour tortillas, warmed
ingredients.name: tortilla pszenna

ingredients.text: 2 cups (8 ounces) shredded cheddar or Monterey Jack Cheese
ingredients.name: ser cheddar

steps.text: Heat butter in large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add eggs; cook, stirring frequently, for 2–3 minutes or until eggs just begin to set.
Stir in shredded beef filling. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 2 to 3 minutes or until eggs are cooked and beef is heated through.
Serve eggs with tortillas, beans, cheese, and salsa.

recipes.title: Latkes
recipes.description: Latkes are potato pancakes, commonly associated with the Jewish cultural tradition in the United States and Europe.

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons matzo meal, cornmeal, or flour
ingredients.name: mąka pszenna

ingredients.text: Applesauce, sour cream, and/or sugar for serving
ingredients.name: mus jabłkowy

steps.text: Grate the potatoes and onions.
Place grated potatoes and onions in cheesecloth or a fine sieve. Squeeze mixture well to drain excess moisture, which will ensure proper frying.
Mix drained potato and onion mixture with egg, matzo meal, and salt.

Heat oil in a 10-inch (25 cm) pan over medium heat until it is quite hot. Drop 1–2 tablespoons of the potato mixture per pancake into the pan. Flip partway through the cooking to allow both sides to fry.
Serve with applesauce, sour cream, and/or sugar as a topping.

categories: Recipes using vegetable broth and stock

recipes.title: Chow Mein
recipes.description: Chow mein z seitanem, kiełkami fasoli mung i warzywami, bez oyster sauce, z grzybami shiitake w marynacie.

ingredients.text: Vegetable oil for frying, as needed
ingredients.name: olej roślinny

ingredients.text: ¼ cup water or low-sodium vegetable broth
ingredients.name: woda lub bulion warzywny

steps.text: 1–2 hours before cooking, rinse the mung bean sprouts so that they have time to drain thoroughly.
Cut the seitan into thin strips. Add the marinade ingredients, adding the cornstarch last. Marinate the seitan for 20 to 25 minutes.

To prepare the sauce, in a small bowl dissolve the 1 tablespoon cornstarch with the 4 tablespoons water. Whisk the water or vegetable broth with the oyster sauce, soy sauce, salt, pepper and cornstarch and water mixture and set aside.
Soften the noodles by placing them in boiling salted water. Plunge into cold water to stop the cooking process and drain thoroughly.

Wash all the vegetables as needed. Cut the celery and the bok choy into ½-inch pieces on the diagonal. If substituting broccoli for bok choy, peel the stalks until no more strings come out, and slice thinly on the diagonal. Wipe the mushrooms clean with a damp cloth and slice. Cut the red bell pepper in half, remove the seeds and cut into chunks. Peel and chop the onion. Dice the green onion.
Heat a wok or frying pan over medium-high to high heat. Add 2 tablespoons oil. When the oil is hot, add the noodles. Fry in batches until golden. Remove the noodles from the pan.

Heat 2 tablespoons oil. Add the onion and the seitan, keeping remaining marinade aside for later use. Let the seitan brown briefly, then stir-fry until the redness is gone and the seitan is nearly cooked through. Remove the cooked seitan and onion from the pan.

Cook the rest of the vegetables separately, except for the green onion, seasoning each with a bit of salt while stir-frying if desired. When cooking the bok choy or broccoli, add ¼ cup of water and cover while cooking. Remove each of the vegetables from the pan when finished stir-frying. Add more oil as needed.

Give the sauce a quick re-stir. Add all the ingredients back into the wok, making a "well" in the middle of the wok for the sauce. Add the sauce and any remaining marinade, stirring quickly to thicken. Mix everything together. Stir in the green onions. Pour the cooked vegetable and sauce mixture on top of the noodles. Garnish the chow mein with the toasted sesame seeds. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Vanilla Ice Cream (Egg-Free)
recipes.description: Egg-free vanilla ice cream made with half-and-half and whipping cream, churned in an ice cream machine and then frozen until solid.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in an ice cream machine.
Run the machine according to the manufacturer's directions.
Transfer ice cream to a container, and freeze for a few hours until solid.

recipes.title: Salsa (Fermented)
recipes.description: This fermented salsa recipe produces a tangy tomato sauce with strong flavour. No cooking is required.

ingredients.text: 1 bunch of fresh cilantro (coriander leaf, Chinese parsley)
ingredients.name: kolendra świeża (liście)

steps.text: Clean and dry a large (1 litre) preserves jar and a large bowl.
Dice the tomatoes.
Quarter and slice the capsicum.
Finely slice the chilis, removing the seeds if you prefer. Wash your hands right after cutting the chilis, and do not touch your eyes or face for some time after handling them.
Peel and chop the onion and garlic finely. Roughly chop the cilantro.
Mix all ingredients together in the bowl with salt and (optional) spices; mix well.
Pack tightly into the jar, leaving 1 cm space at the top.
Cover the jar with a cloth or cling-wrap. Sit the jar in a bowl or on a plate to collect any overflowing juice. Leave to ferment at room temperature.

The salsa will be fermented in 2–3 days, depending on the climate. Wipe any excess liquid from around the jar, put the lid on tightly and move it to the refrigerator; it will keep well but continue to slowly ferment, getting more sour over time.

recipes.title: Hash Browns
recipes.description: Hash browns or hashed browns are a simple potato preparation in which potato pieces are pan-fried after being shredded, julienned, diced, or riced.

ingredients.text: Cooking oil (canola is good—see smoke point information)
ingredients.name: olej roślinny
ingredients.note: canola is good—see smoke point information

steps.text: Grate the raw potatoes with a cheese grater, place them into a bowl and cover completely with water. Let sit for 10 minutes.
Drain the grated potatoes well; if this is not done thoroughly the potatoes will steam instead of fry.
Mix in chopped onions by hand.
Mix the egg OR flour into the hash brown mixture evenly. This will allow the hash browns to stay together when frying.
Place a large frying pan on medium-high heat and add enough oil to provide a thin coating over the entire bottom of the pan.

When the oil has come up to temperature apply a large handful of potatoes to the pan and reshape into a patty that is about ¼–½ inch (6–12 mm) thick. The thinner the patty, the crispier the hash browns will be throughout.
Flip when they are crisp and brown on the cooking side. They should also stick together nicely before they are flipped. This should take about 5–8 minutes.
The hash browns are done when the new side is brown and crispy. This should take another 3–5 minutes.

recipes.title: Pasta and Bean Soup (Pasta e Fagioli)
recipes.description: A stew-like Italian pasta and bean dish dominated by umami flavor, rather than the usual tomato-based soup.

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon or more crushed or ground hot red pepper
ingredients.name: papryka chili w proszku

ingredients.text: ½ pound small diameter macaroni (whole wheat is best)
ingredients.name: makaron pełnoziarnisty
ingredients.note: small diameter, whole wheat is best

steps.text: Put washed beans in salted water (3 parts to 1 part beans).
Soak overnight, or bring to a boil, boil 2 minutes and let stand, covered, for 1 hour.
Do not drain beans, but bring to a boil.
Skim off foam and add oil, garlic and bay leaf.
Simmer for about 2 hours, or until tender.
Cook pasta for 6–7 minutes, but don't let it get too soft.
Drain pasta and save some of the water.
Stir pasta and red pepper into beans and simmer until pasta is al dente, adding some of the saved water if necessary.
Garnish with red pepper to taste and parsley.

recipes.title: Lancashire Hotpot
recipes.description: Lancashire hotpot, originating from England, is a very easy but delicious baked dish consisting of lamb, onions, potatoes, and herbs.

ingredients.text: 2 lb (900 g) neck of lamb or mutton
ingredients.name: baranina

ingredients.text: 1 large or 2 small white onions, diced
ingredients.name: cebula
ingredients.note: large or 2 small white onions, diced

steps.text: Dice the lamb and set aside. Preheat oven to 325°F / 170°C / Gas mark 3.
Add a layer of the potatoes to the bottom of a casserole dish, and cover with a handful of the diced onion.
Layer the diced lamb on top of this, sprinkling with the herbs.
Repeat these layers until the dish is full. Top with a final layer of the potatoes.
Pour boiling water into the dish until filled—if more water is needed, continue to add until topped.
Bake for at least 1 hour, though traditionally the dish was left baking all day. Mutton will require a longer cooking time.

recipes.title: Lamb Shawarma
recipes.description: Grillowana jagnięcina marynowana w przyprawach i occie, podawana w picie z dodatkami.

ingredients.text: 1.5 kg leg of lamb or other tender cut
ingredients.name: jagnięcina udziec

steps.text: Cut the lamb into large 4 cm chunks.
Combine the nutmeg, cinnamon, cardamom, garlic cloves, black pepper, cayenne pepper, lemon, and vinegar in a small mixing bowl and pour over meat.
Marinate for 2 hours or more.
Grill the onions with some garlic for few minutes.
Drain meat, pat dry, and grill until golden brown.
Serve with pita bread, tomato, fresh onion, tabbouleh, tzatziki, lettuce and chili sauce.

recipes.title: Chocolate Balls
recipes.description: A quick, easy snack with chocolate and peanut butter.

ingredients.text: 1 cup (60 g / 2.1 oz) puffed rice cereal
ingredients.name: ryż preparowany

ingredients.text: ½ cup (50 g / 1.8 oz) chopped nuts
ingredients.name: orzechy

ingredients.text: 1 small bag (50 g / 1.8 oz) semi-sweet chocolate chips
ingredients.name: czekolada półgorzka

steps.text: Melt the semi-sweet chocolate chips in a double boiler.
Put all other ingredients into a bowl. Mix.
Form the mixture into small balls, about half the size of a golf ball.
If desired, refrigerate or freeze the peanut butter balls for easier dipping.
Dip the balls in the melted chocolate and place on wax paper.
Allow the chocolate balls to cool in the freezer or fridge before consumption.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cookies I
recipes.description: Oatmeal chocolate chip cookies made specifically for use with oats, rather than as a variation of a flour-based cookie.

steps.text: In a large bowl beat eggs lightly to break the yolks, then mix in the shortening—you should have a loose mixture.
Mix in the brown sugar, milk, vanilla, and salt.
Mix the flour, baking powder, soda, cinnamon, and oatmeal together in another bowl.
Mix the wet and dry mixes together to get a soft dough.
Stir in chocolate chips and walnuts.
Make balls and place onto a greased or parchment-lined baking sheet. Bake in an oven preheated to 180°C (350°F) for 15–20 minutes.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Chicken à la King
recipes.description: Chicken breast cubes and vegetables in a creamy sauce made with butter, flour and chicken broth, served over biscuits, toast or English muffins.

ingredients.text: 3½ ounces (100 g) chopped pimentos or other mild chile peppers
ingredients.name: pimento

ingredients.text: 13½–14½ US fl. oz. (400–430 ml) chicken broth (depending on the size of can or jar available in your area)
ingredients.name: bulion drobiowy
ingredients.note: 400–430 ml, depending on the size of can or jar available in your area

steps.text: Season the chicken breasts with salt, pepper and garlic powder and then cube them into bite-size pieces.
