Sauté the chicken cubes, onion, mushrooms, and pimentos in the olive oil in a skillet.
In a saucepan, melt the butter, stir in the flour and cook over medium heat for about a minute.
Add the chicken broth and stir till thickened.
Add the sauce to the chicken and vegetable mixture; stir together and cook a few more minutes.
Serve over biscuits, toast or toasted English muffins.

recipes.title: Pan-fried Ravioli
recipes.description: Ravioli obtoczone w bułce tartej i smażone na głębokim tłuszczu, podawane z gorącym sosem marinara.

ingredients.text: ¾ cup Italian seasoned bread crumbs
ingredients.name: bułka tarta

ingredients.text: ½ package (25 ounces) frozen ravioli, thawed
ingredients.name: ravioli mrożone

steps.text: Combine milk and egg in a small bowl.
Place breadcrumbs and salt in a shallow bowl.
Dip ravioli in milk mixture, and coat with breadcrumbs.
In a large saucepan, heat marinara sauce over medium heat until bubbling, about 5–10 minutes.
Reduce the heat to simmer.
In a large heavy pan, pour oil to depth of 2 inches. Heat oil over medium heat to 375°F.
Fry ravioli in hot oil, a few at a time, for about 1 minute on each side or until golden.
Drain on paper towels.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and serve immediately with hot marinara sauce.

recipes.title: Jambons
recipes.description: Kwadratowe ciasto francuskie z serem i szynką, popularne w Irlandii i Wielkiej Brytanii.

ingredients.text: 150 g grated cheese (Dubliner Cheese recommended, can be substituted)
ingredients.name: ser
ingredients.note: grated; Dubliner Cheese recommended, can be substituted

steps.text: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F).
Melt butter over medium heat and add flour.
Cook for 5 minutes and begin adding milk gradually until the mixture thickens.
Cut your pre-prepared puff pastry into squares and spoon a generous amount of the mixture onto each square.
Sprinkle some ham and grated cheese on top.
Fold the corners of the puff pastry so that they meet in the centre, forming a panier feuilleté (puff pastry basket) shape.
Beat the egg and brush it over each sealed panier feuilleté.
Bake for 20–25 minutes until puffed and golden brown.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chocolate Chip Muffins
recipes.description: A deliciously sweet muffin recipe that makes an excellent breakfast.

ingredients.text: 1 ¾ cup (250 g / 8.8 oz) all-purpose flour
ingredients.name: mąka pszenna

ingredients.text: ¾ cup (175 g / 6.2 oz) granulated sugar
ingredients.name: cukier

ingredients.text: ⅓ cup (40 g / 1.4 oz) cocoa, sifted if lumpy
ingredients.name: kakao

ingredients.text: ⅓ cup (80 ml / 2.7 fl oz) cooking oil
ingredients.name: olej roślinny

steps.text: Combine all-purpose flour, chocolate chips, sugar, cocoa, salt, and baking powder in a mixing bowl. Create a well in the center.
Beat egg in a small bowl. Add milk, cooking oil, and vanilla. Stir and pour into well. Stir until just moistened.
Grease 12 muffin cups with cooking spray. Fill cups ¾ full.
Bake at 400°F (205°C) for 20 minutes until a skewer inserted into the center tests clean.

recipes.title: Cherry-Berry Jumble Fruit Pie
recipes.description: A mixed berry and cherry pie with a cornstarch-thickened filling, topped with a crust brushed with melted butter.

ingredients.text: 1 cup canned sweet cherries with juice
ingredients.name: wiśnie

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Drain cherries, reserving juice; set cherries aside.
Add water to juice if necessary to make ½ cup liquid.
In a large saucepan, mix together cherry juice, sugar, cornstarch and flour. Stir until smooth, then cook on medium heat until it starts to thicken.
Add fruit, preserves and lemon juice. Mix well.
Place 1 crust in a 9-inch (23 cm) pie pan or plate. Spoon in fruit filling.
Cut several slits in the middle of the second crust and place it over the filling.
Crimp the edges, and brush with melted butter.
Bake until the pie is golden brown, 40 to 45 minutes. Oven temperatures vary, so the time may vary.

recipes.title: Molasses Cookies
recipes.description: Soft, slightly chewy molasses cookies with a mild ginger flavor, which can be made as drop cookies or rolled cookies.

ingredients.text: ½ cup milk (minus ½ tablespoon for the vinegar)
ingredients.name: mleko
ingredients.note: minus ½ tablespoon for the vinegar

steps.text: Grease or parchment-line some cookie sheets.
Combine the vinegar and milk.
Combine the baking soda, cinnamon, ginger, and 2½ cups of flour.
Cream together the sugar and shortening until well-combined, then beat in the molasses and egg until smooth.
Alternately mix in the dry and milk mixtures, starting and ending with the dry mixture.

Bit by bit, mix in more flour as needed. For drop cookies, you might not add any more. For rolled cookies produced without refrigeration, you are likely to need an extra 1½ cup for a total of 4 cups. Refrigeration can reduce this slightly.
Chill the batter in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour.
Form the cookies.
If making drop cookies, scoop some batter onto the prepared cookie sheet. Using a bit of sugar to prevent sticking, squish the cookie with a glass. Press some toppings into the top of the cookie.

Plop a pint-sized blob of batter onto a flour-dusted surface. Dust the top of the dough with flour as you squish it down, then roll it out. A cold marble rolling pin is suggested. Cut out shapes, then place them on the cookie sheet. The unused dough may be put back into the mix; note that this increases the proportion of flour.
Bake cookies for 8–10 minutes at 375°F.

recipes.title: Frijoles Antioqueños (Colombian Bean Stew)
recipes.description: Antioqueño beans are an icon of Colombian food, a hearty bean stew cooked with hogao, plantain and optional meat.

ingredients.text: ½ lb flank steak, pork legs, or pork rinds (optional)
ingredients.name: mięso wołowe lub wieprzowe
ingredients.note: flank steak, pork legs, or pork rinds (optional)

steps.text: Wash beans and let hydrate overnight by covering with twice its volume of water.
The next day, remove any floating beans.
Heat the oil in a pressure cooker.
Add scallions and let fry until they start to brown.
Add tomato, cumin, broth cube, and allspice. This is called "hogao", a basic sauce for many Colombian dishes.
Add 6 cups water, the beans, and plantain. Bring to a boil over medium heat.
Cover the pressure cooker, and let cook for 30 minutes.
Let cool, then open the pressure cooker.
Check water level, add the meat if using, and cover again. Cook for another 30 minutes.
Taste for salt.
If you want a thicker mixture, you can cook uncovered over low heat.

recipes.title: Lasagne with Bean Sauce
recipes.description: Vegetarian lasagne layered with a sauce of navy beans and tomatoes, cottage cheese and mozzarella.

ingredients.text: 1 can (400 g/15 oz) navy beans, drained and chopped
ingredients.name: fasola biała

ingredients.text: 240 ml (1 cup) cottage cheese or ricotta cheese
ingredients.name: twaróg
ingredients.note: 1 cup, cottage cheese or ricotta cheese

steps.text: Boil the lasagna noodles.
Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F).
Sauté garlic and onions.
Add the chopped beans and cook for 5 minutes.
Add tomato sauce, tomato purée, tomato paste, oregano, basil, and pepper, and cook for 5 minutes.
In a 30 x 20 cm (13 x 9 in) baking dish, form a layer using half the noodles, sauce, cottage cheese, and mozzarella. Repeat to form a second layer.
Sprinkle top with Parmesan cheese.
Bake uncovered at 180°C (350°F) for 25 minutes, until noodles are tender and sauce is bubbling.

recipes.title: Alfajores (Latin American Sandwich Cookies)
recipes.description: Alfajores are a Latin-American sandwich cookie filled with dulce de leche.

steps.text: Cream butter; add sugar and beat until fluffy.
Add egg and egg yolks one at a time, beating well.
Beat in vanilla and lemon rind.
Sift together cornstarch, flour, baking powder, and salt. Add to batter and mix well.
Drop batter by small spoonfuls onto well-buttered baking sheet.
Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes. Remove immediately and cool.
Sandwich the cookies together with dulce de leche.

recipes.title: South Texan Pinto Beans
recipes.description: Pinto beans simmered slowly with paprika, chili powder, garlic and onion in the Texan style, served as a side dish with their cooking liquid.

ingredients.text: 1 ½ tbsp paprika OR ½ tsp each of paprika and pepper
ingredients.name: papryka słodka mielona
ingredients.note: OR ½ tsp each of paprika and pepper

ingredients.text: 1 ½ tbsp granulated or brown sugar
ingredients.name: cukier

ingredients.text: 1 tbsp salt OR 2 tsp salt and a ham hock
ingredients.name: sól
ingredients.note: OR 2 tsp salt and a ham hock

ingredients.text: 1 ½ tbsp dehydrated onion OR ½ small onion, finely diced
ingredients.name: cebula suszona
ingredients.note: OR ½ small onion, finely diced

steps.text: Wash beans carefully and soak overnight in 8 cups of water.
Drain and refill with 5 cups of water.
Add all the other ingredients.
Bring to a boil and simmer at least an hour, or until tender.
Remove bay leaves.
Do not drain prior to serving, as the liquid is an important aspect of the dish. It can be served using slotted spoon, to allow draining, or with a ladle into small side-dish bowls.

recipes.title: Breakfast Sludge
recipes.description: Breakfast sludge is a breakfast recipe that originally showed up on Imgur and Reddit in 2011. It combines a number of drinks and foods that are commonly eaten for breakfast.

ingredients.text: 1 teabag or 1 scoop of chai powder
ingredients.name: herbata ziołowa lub owocowa
ingredients.note: teabag or 1 scoop of chai powder

steps.text: Put water on to boil.
Break up the granola bar into a mug. You will want to ensure that it is very well ground up. The pieces of the granola bar should be about the size of pieces of oatmeal.
Add the instant coffee, chai, sugar, and hot chocolate powder to the cup.
Add cinnamon to taste.
Pour in enough boiling water to fill the cup.
Stir vigorously until everything is mixed and the mixture has a dark brown appearance.
Add milk to taste.

recipes.title: Ginger Pancakes
recipes.description: Puszyste placki imbirowe z kawałkami kandyzowanego imbiru, z dodatkiem wanilii i maślanki.

steps.text: Heat a large non-stick skillet or griddle over low heat while preparing ingredients.
Mix flour, sugar, salt, baking powder, and baking soda in medium bowl.
Whisk ground ginger into dry ingredients.
Microwave buttermilk and milk in a 2-cup Pyrex measuring cup for 20–30 seconds until it is room temperature.
Whisk in egg, butter, and vanilla.
Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients and whisk until just mixed.
Return batter to measuring cup, stirring in a teaspoon or two of water, if necessary, to make a thick, but pourable batter.
Increase heat to medium and generously brush skillet or griddle with oil.
When oil starts to spider, but before it starts to smoke, pour in dollops of batter, about ¼ cup at a time. Work in batches, if necessary, to avoid overcrowding.
Sprinkle 1 tablespoon crystallized ginger over the uncooked side of each pancake as it cooks.
When pancake bottoms are golden brown and tops start to bubble, flip pancakes.
Cook until pancakes are golden brown on remaining side.
Repeat cooking with remaining batter, brushing skillet or griddle with oil between batches.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Chicken Cabbage Salad
recipes.description: Bardzo prosta sałatka z kapusty, z dodatkiem kurczaka, makaronu instant i sosu z octu ryżowego; może być dodatkiem lub daniem głównym.

ingredients.text: 2 packages of instant ramen noodles (Oriental/soy sauce flavor)
ingredients.name: makaron instant

ingredients.text: ½ cup of vegetable or canola oil
ingredients.name: olej roślinny

ingredients.text: 1 packet of Oriental flavoring (from one of the ramen packages)
ingredients.name: przyprawa orientalna
ingredients.note: from one of the ramen packages

steps.text: Chop the cabbage, cilantro leaves, and green onion until it is at an even consistency among the three. Mix together.
Add the almonds and sunflower seeds.
Break up the ramen noodles and place in the salad.
Mix oil, rice vinegar, and flavoring. This is now your dressing.
Pour dressing over salad, and add salt and pepper to taste.
Leave salad to sit and absorb flavor for an hour for best taste.

recipes.title: Spoonbread
recipes.description: A Southern U.S. cornmeal soufflé-like side bread, baked until puffed and set, with scallions, pepper flakes and optional cheese.

ingredients.text: 1 cup white or yellow corn meal
ingredients.name: mąka kukurydziana

ingredients.text: ⅛–1 teaspoon red pepper flakes, to taste
ingredients.name: płatki chili

ingredients.text: ⅓ cup grated cheese, mild or sharp to taste (if used, reduce salt)
ingredients.name: ser tarty
ingredients.note: mild or sharp to taste; if used, reduce salt

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (205°C).
Thickly coat 8 x 8 inch (20 x 20 cm) baking pan with cooking spray.
Beat egg whites until stiff, then set aside.
Heat milk in medium saucepan over medium heat until just barely bubbling at the edges.
Reduce heat and whisk while slowly adding cornmeal.
Whisk constantly over low heat for 5 minutes.
Take off heat and stir in black pepper, red pepper flakes, salt, and scallions.
Stir in egg yolks and cheese.
Fold in whipped egg whites.
Pour into pan.
Bake about 30 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into center comes out clean.

recipes.title: Percolator Punch
recipes.description: A warm spiced punch of pineapple and cranberry juice, brewed in a percolator with brown sugar, cloves, allspice and cinnamon.

steps.text: Place the pineapple juice, cranberry juice, water, and salt in the bottom reservoir of the percolator.
Place the brown sugar, cloves, allspice, and cinnamon in the top compartment.
Heat for 10 minutes.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookies I
recipes.description: A tasty oatmeal cookie, just like those you remember.

steps.text: Using a mixer, cream together the shortening, brown sugar, white sugar, egg, water and vanilla until light and fluffy (about 10 minutes on high).
In a mixing bowl, mix together the oats, flour, baking soda, and salt.
Add dry ingredients into wet, mix well using mixer.
Stir in raisins if using.
Scoop the portions out—this recipe makes 20 cookies, so make 20 portions.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 8–10 minutes.

recipes.title: Karkanji (Chadian Spiced Hibiscus Drink)
recipes.description: Karkanji is a hibiscus drink from Chad and the Sahel region, made from dried hibiscus petals spiced with ginger and cloves and sweetened to taste. It is served chilled.

ingredients.text: 1 cup dried hibiscus (also known as roselle or sorrel) petals
ingredients.name: płatki suszonego hibiskusa
ingredients.note: also known as roselle or sorrel

ingredients.text: Sugar, to taste (start with ½ cup)
ingredients.name: cukier
ingredients.note: to taste, start with ½ cup

steps.text: Rinse the dried hibiscus petals under cold water to remove any dust or debris.
In a saucepan, bring the water to a boil.
Add the rinsed hibiscus petals, grated ginger, cloves, and cinnamon stick. Stir well.
Let the mixture boil for about 5–7 minutes, or until the water turns a rich deep red and the spices have released their aroma.
Remove the saucepan from heat and let it steep for another 10 minutes for a stronger flavor.
Strain the liquid using a sieve into a clean jug or bowl to remove the solids.
Stir in sugar while the drink is still warm, adjusting to your preferred sweetness level.
Allow the drink to cool completely. Refrigerate until chilled or serve over ice.

recipes.title: Banana Cream Pie II
recipes.description: A banana cream pie with sliced bananas under a cornstarch custard, topped with optional meringue and baked briefly.

ingredients.text: 3 large bananas or 4 medium bananas, sliced
ingredients.name: banan

ingredients.text: ⅓ cup all purpose flour or 3 Tbsp cornstarch
ingredients.name: mąka pszenna

ingredients.text: Meringue made from the leftover egg whites (optional)
ingredients.name: beza z białek
ingredients.note: optional, made from leftover egg whites

steps.text: Combine sugar, cornstarch, and salt in a saucepan.
Add milk gradually.
Cook, stirring constantly, over medium heat until bubbly.
Cook and stir an additional 2 minutes and remove from burner.
Stir small amount of hot mixture into egg yolks, then immediately add egg yolk mixture to hot mixture and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat.
Add butter and vanilla and stir until smooth.
Slice bananas into the cooled baked pastry shell.
Top with pudding mixture and spread meringue (if desired) on top of the pie.
Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 12–15 minutes.
Cool before serving.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
recipes.description: Sweet, fluffy cake or quick bread with grated zucchini.

steps.text: Grease and flour two 8 x 4-inch loaf pans. Preheat oven to 325°F.
Sift together flour, salt, baking powder, baking soda, and cinnamon in a bowl.
Beat eggs, oil, vanilla, and sugar together in a large bowl.
Add sifted ingredients to the creamed mixture, and beat well.
Stir in zucchini until well combined.
Pour batter into prepared pans.
Bake for 40 minutes to 1 hour, or until tester inserted into the center comes out clean.
Cool in pan for 20 minutes.
Remove from pan and completely cool.

recipes.title: Jachnun (Yemenite Layered Pastry)
recipes.description: Jachnun is a Yemenite pastry made of worked dough (made without the use of yeast) and traditionally eaten hot during the Sabbath morning meal, after being left to bake all throughout the night within a sealed pot in an oven.

ingredients.text: 2–3 tbsp white granulated sugar (or to taste)
ingredients.name: cukier

ingredients.text: 200 g butter, soft margarine, or shortening
ingredients.name: masło

steps.text: Combine the flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt. Make a well in the center.
Add some of the water to the well, and mix with your hands. Gradually knead in the rest of the water, then continue kneading for 15 minutes. The dough should not be too soft or sticky.

Tear off a piece of dough the size of your fist. Flatten and roll it out on your work surface, then shape again into a ball. Repeat this step for the rest of the dough, then brush all the balls with a thin coating of oil.
Allow the dough to rest for about 1–2 hours, until the balls have sunken slightly.
Roll and stretch each ball out on a greased surface until it is very thin. Try to make the dough as thin as possible without it tearing.

Spread some soft butter over the whole surface of the flattened dough. Make a triangular fold lengthwise, like a shirt fold: fold one-third of the dough toward the middle then fold the other side. Make a small fold up and down, and start rolling (with greased hands) from the bottom to the top, like folding a sleeping bag. You should be left with an elongated, slightly fat rolled jachnun. Repeat this shaping step for all the dough balls.
Preheat oven to 212 F. Line a pot with slices of bread or pita so that it does not become overly dry while baking in the oven.

Place the unbaked jachnun into a cookie bag, with each bag holding a single layer of jachnun. This prevents loss of moisture. Stack the jachnun in the pot, with 2–3 rows stacked one on top of the other in a criss-crossed fashion (horizontally and vertically).
Cover the pot with the lid, and bake in the preheated oven for 6–10 hours.
Serve with hard-boiled eggs and tomato salsa, with a little zhug over the paste.

recipes.title: Grilled Vegetable Sandwich
recipes.description: A simple vegan open-faced sandwich of grilled vegetables on wholemeal bread with olive oil and oregano.

ingredients.text: 2 slices of bread (preferably organic wholemeal bread)
ingredients.name: chleb pełnoziarnisty

ingredients.text: Sliced vegetables (e.g. mushrooms, courgettes, tomatoes, peppers, etc.)
ingredients.name: warzywa
ingredients.note: e.g. mushrooms, courgettes, tomatoes, peppers, etc.

steps.text: Place bread slices next to each other on a baking tray.
Arrange the vegetables evenly across both slices.
Drizzle the olive oil over the vegetables, and add liberal sprinklings of oregano.
Broil on medium-high heat for 5–10 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve open-faced, or carefully combine the two parts of the sandwich.

recipes.title: Almond Cake
recipes.description: A simple almond cake that makes a good snack or tea cake, leavened only by beaten air.

ingredients.text: 16 Tbsp (8 oz / 227 g) unsalted butter, room temperature
ingredients.name: masło

ingredients.text: 6 ea. (300 g) standard eggs, room temperature
ingredients.name: jajko

ingredients.text: 2 cups (300 g) almond flour or finely-ground almonds
ingredients.name: mąka migdałowa

steps.text: Cream the butter and sugar on medium-high speed until light and fluffy. Scrape down the bowl to make sure everything is well-incorporated.
Whisk together the eggs and vanilla. Gradually beat the eggs into the butter-sugar mixture. If you add too much of the eggs at once, the batter may curdle.
Mix in the almond meal on low speed.
Fold the flour into the batter until it is well-incorporated. Do not over-mix the batter at this stage, as it may make the cake overly tough.
Line the bottom of an 8 or 9-inch square cake pan with parchment paper. Lightly grease the parchment and the sides of the pan.
Transfer the batter to the pan. Smooth the top.

Bake at 350°F (180°C) until golden brown, and a skewer inserted into the center comes out clean. The time will vary depending on your oven and pan size, but start checking the cake after about 30 minutes.
Cool the cake in the pan. Use a knife to loosen the sides of the cake from the pan, if necessary. Unmold the cake from the pan, and peel off the parchment if it is attached to the cake.
If desired, sprinkle the top of the cake with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Dibi (Senegalese Grilled Meat)
recipes.description: Dibi is a popular Senegalese street food of grilled lamb or goat meat cooked with a flavorful marinade.

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon thyme (or the equivalent amount of dried thyme)
ingredients.name: tymianek suszony
ingredients.note: or the equivalent amount of dried thyme

ingredients.text: ¼ cup white vinegar or lemon juice
ingredients.name: ocet biały

ingredients.text: ¼ cup water (or more if needed)
ingredients.name: woda

ingredients.text: 1½ pounds (about 700 g) lamb or goat meat, cut into large chunks or small pieces for skewering
ingredients.name: mięso jagnięce lub koźlęce
ingredients.note: about 700 g, cut into large chunks or small pieces for skewering

steps.text: In a bowl, combine the vegetable oil, garlic, onion, mustard, paprika, coriander, cumin, turmeric, ginger, thyme, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
Add the vinegar or lemon juice and water to form a slightly thick marinade.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Place the chunks of lamb or goat meat into a large bowl or resealable bag.
Pour the marinade over the meat and toss to ensure all pieces are well-coated.
Let the meat marinate in the fridge for at least 2 hours (or overnight for better flavor).
Preheat a grill or barbecue to medium-high heat.
If using skewers, thread the marinated meat onto the skewers.
Grill the meat, turning occasionally, for about 10–15 minutes, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness. For extra flavor, baste the meat with some of the leftover marinade while grilling.
Remove the meat from the grill and let it rest for a few minutes before serving.
Optionally, serve the dibi with chopped onions, tomatoes, and a hot pepper sauce on the side. You can serve it with French fries or bread to complete the meal.

recipes.title: Rhubarb and Custard Bread Pudding
recipes.description: Rhubarb and custard pudding is a recipe adapted from page 21 of the February 2023 edition of Tesco's magazine.

ingredients.text: ½ cup (125 ml/4.2 fl oz) water
ingredients.name: woda

ingredients.text: ⅔ cup (150 g/5.3 oz) superfine sugar, plus 1 tablespoon
ingredients.name: cukier
ingredients.note: 150 g/5.3 oz superfine sugar, plus 1 tablespoon

ingredients.text: 400 g rhubarb, trimmed and chopped into 3 - pieces
ingredients.name: rabarbar

ingredients.text: ⅓ cup plus 1 tablespoon (100 ml) heavy cream, plus extra to serve (optional)
ingredients.name: śmietana kremówka

ingredients.text: 10 slices thick-sliced white sandwich bread, crusts removed and cut into triangles
ingredients.name: chleb tostowy biały
ingredients.note: thick-sliced, crusts removed and cut into triangles

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 160 C.
Heat the water and ¼ cup (60 g) of sugar in a large frying pan over medium heat until the syrup bubbles.
Add the rhubarb and simmer for 3 minutes, turning occasionally.
Remove the heat and set aside to soak.
Heat the milk, cream and vanilla in a saucepan over a low heat until small bubbles appear.
Meanwhile, combine the remaining sugar, custard powder, and eggs in a heatproof bowl.
Gradually pour the hot milk into the egg mixture, whisking as you go to temper it.
Grease a 30 by, deep baking pan. Butter the bread slices.
Lay the bread slices in the baking pan, overlapping them slightly. Distribute the rhubarb on top, reserving the rhubarb syrup.
Pour in the custard to cover the bread slices. Soak for 20 minutes.
Bake for 30 minutes until the bread puffs up.
Scatter over 1 tablespoon sugar.
Increase temperature to 180 C and bake for 5 more minutes until golden.
Dust with powdered sugar and serve optionally with rhubarb syrup and cream.

recipes.title: Black Bean Chili
recipes.description: A vegetarian black bean chili with chipotle and ancho chiles, slow-simmered with tomatoes and spices.

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons (30 mL) corn oil or other vegetable oil
ingredients.name: olej kukurydziany

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons (30 mL) wine vinegar (red or white)
ingredients.name: ocet winny

steps.text: Place beans in a large pot, add with enough water to cover by 2 inches (2.5 cm), and allow to soak overnight. Drain beans and cover again with fresh water.
Bring beans to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer for 2 hours.
Heat the corn oil in a stockpot or other very large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the onions and sauté until tender, about 3 minutes.
Add garlic, chipotle and ancho chiles, cumin, paprika, oregano, salt, cayenne, and vinegar, and sauté for 5 to 10 minutes.
Add tomatoes, tomato puree, and the water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the beans with their juice and simmer for 1 hour.
Serve with or without sour cream.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Chicken Pot Pie II
recipes.description: Pie with a chicken, corn and pea filling in a creamy broth-and-milk sauce, baked under a pastry crust.

steps.text: Heat oven to 425°F.
Prepare pie crusts as directed on package for a two-crust pie in a 9-inch pie pan.
In a medium saucepan, melt margarine over medium heat.
Add onion; cook 2 minutes or until tender.
Stir in flour, salt, and pepper until well-blended.
Gradually stir in broth and milk; cook, stirring constantly, until bubbly and thickened.
Add chicken, corn, and peas; remove from heat.
Spoon chicken mixture into crust-lined pan.
Top with second crust and flute; cut slits in several places.
Bake for 30 to 40 minutes or until crust is golden-brown.
Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Vinegar-Pickled Eggs and Onions
recipes.description: Jajka i cebula marynowane w occie, przechowywane dłużej niż surowe jajka w lodówce.

ingredients.text: 3 cups malt vinegar (malt vinegar can be substituted with any other type of vinegar to taste)
ingredients.name: ocet słodowy
ingredients.note: malt vinegar can be substituted with any other type of vinegar to taste

steps.text: Combine vinegar, water, salt, sugar, and peppercorns in a pot, and bring to simmer over medium heat. Stir regularly while heating so that the sugar on the bottom of the pot doesn't burn.
Simmer until the sugar and salt are fully dissolved. Remove from the heat, set aside and allow this pickling solution to cool to room temperature.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil.

Place eggs in boiling water, using a ladle to gently lower them in. The temperature of the water will lower with the addition of the eggs. Wait for the water to return to a boil and then boil the eggs for a further 12 minutes.
Drain the hot water from the eggs, and transfer the eggs to ice-cold water to stop the cooking. Crack and peel off shells, making sure to remove the membrane between the egg and the shell.
Cut onions into rings 5 mm thick.
Place a layer of onions into a large, non-reactive container, and then arrange a layer of eggs on top. If necessary, continue layering in this way until you have used up the eggs and onions.
Pour in enough of the pickling solution into the container to fully cover the eggs and onions.
Refrigerate for two weeks before serving.

categories: Recipes using beef broth and stock

recipes.title: Beef Pasties
recipes.description: Kornwalijskie pasties z wołowiną, ziemniakami i cebulą w cieście, zainspirowane Cornwall.

ingredients.text: 2 cups (400 g) cubed cooking roast beef, in ¼-inch (65 mm) pieces
ingredients.name: wołowina pieczeniowa
ingredients.note: cubed cooking roast beef, in ¼-inch (65 mm) pieces

ingredients.text: ½ cup (120 mL) diced cooked onion
ingredients.name: cebula gotowana

ingredients.text: Pastry for double crust pie (9-inch or 22 cm)
ingredients.name: ciasto kruche na podwójną skórkę

steps.text: Preheat oven to 450°F (230°C).
Combine beef, potatoes, broth, onion, parsley, thyme, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
On a lightly floured surface, roll out ¼ of the pastry into an 8-inch (20 cm) circle.
Mound 1 cup (240 mL) of filling on half of circle.
Moisten edge of pastry with water.
Fold dough over filling. Crimp edges with fork to seal.
Place on ungreased baking sheet.
Repeat with remaining pastry and filling.
Cut slits in top of each completed pastry.
Brush tops with cream.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Eggs Connaught
recipes.description: Elegancki, lekki przystawkowy przepis na jajka z sosem i krewetkami, inspirowany Connaught Hotel w Mayfair.

steps.text: Scald the milk with onion, mace and peppercorns, tip into a jug, cover, and leave to infuse. Rinse the pan with cold water, add ½ oz (about 30 g) butter, heat gently, and blend in the flour. Strain in the milk, and add salt to taste. Stirring continuously, bring milk to the boil, then cook for 1 minute.
Turn the sauce onto a plate, cover with buttered paper to prevent a skin forming, and leave until cold.
Cream remaining butter until soft.

Split the hard boiled eggs in two. Scoop out the yolks and rub through a wire strainer; keep the whites in a bowl of water as they will soon get hard if exposed to the air. Work the yolks with the creamed butter, cheese, paprika and cold sauce. Chop half the prawns finely, add to the mixture and season to taste. Drain the dry egg whites and have ready a round serving dish or use a cake platter.

Spoon a drop of filling onto the dish to hold each egg white in position, arrange them in a circle and then fill each with the mixture—you can use a piping bag with a ½-inch (about 1.25 cm) plain nozzle.
Scatter over the remaining prawns (split in half if large) and dust with paprika. Place the watercress in the middle and serve brown bread and butter separately.

categories: Recipes using beef broth and stock

recipes.title: Chili con Bambi
recipes.description: A venison chili made with minced venison, kidney beans, cider or stock and spices. The page notes it has also been made with roe deer, muntjac, and springbok.

ingredients.text: 4 tsp paprika or other milder powdered chile
ingredients.name: papryka słodka mielona

ingredients.text: 30 ml (2 tbsp) olive, corn, or sunflower oil (according to taste)
ingredients.name: olej
ingredients.note: olive, corn, or sunflower oil (according to taste)

ingredients.text: 500 g (1.1 lb) minced (ground) stewing venison (minced lean leftovers from trimming are ideal)
ingredients.name: jelenina mielona
ingredients.note: minced (ground) stewing venison (minced lean leftovers from trimming are ideal)

ingredients.text: 500 ml dry cider or beef stock (how much you will need depends on how fast it boils away)
ingredients.name: cydr wytrawny
ingredients.note: or beef stock (how much you will need depends on how fast it boils away)

ingredients.text: 350 g (¾ lb) dried red kidney beans, soaked and cooked
ingredients.name: fasola czerwona

steps.text: Sauté the onions, chiles, and garlic in the oil until well softened.
Add the powdered spices and cook for about 60 seconds.
Add the venison and stir well until it has all (more or less) changed colour.
Add sufficient dry cider or stock to cover, but not too deeply.
Add the stock cube (only if you are using cider), bay leaves, chopped celery, grated carrot and tomato purée, and stir well.

Simmer very gently for at least 3 hours, stirring occasionally and replenishing the liquid (with more cider/wine/stock or just water) if it gets too dry. The ideal is to have the sauce with little separate liquid when it is served - but not dry enough to scorch. It may be simmered on top of the stove, or in a very low oven, or in a slow cooker.
About 30–40 minutes before serving remove the bay leaves, add the oregano and the beans and stir well.
Adjust the salt as needed, stir well, and cook for another 40 minutes.
Serve with long-grain rice, or however else you like to serve chili.

recipes.title: Lentil, Potato, and Tomato Curry
recipes.description: A healthy, inexpensive and easy stew with depths of flavor, excellent served with chapatis or rice.

ingredients.text: 2 large potatoes, cut into ½ inch cubes
ingredients.name: ziemniak
ingredients.note: large, cut into ½ inch cubes

steps.text: In a large pot, combine and cook water, lentils, salt and bay leaf.
In a large frying pan, combine potatoes, turmeric, cayenne pepper, olive oil and margarine.
Fry for 5–10 minutes.
Add potato mixture to the pot with the lentils along with all remaining ingredients.
Cook until the potatoes are soft and tender.
Remove bay leaf before serving.

recipes.title: Sweet Southern Chicken Salad
recipes.description: Chicken salad is very similar in many respects to tuna salad, although there are many variations on the dish which can set it apart. Chicken salad tends to work well with sweet fruit and vegetable flavors, and is ideal for lunch-time sandwiches.

steps.text: Add the chicken breasts to a small pot. Add enough water to cover.
Slice stalks of celery into large sticks. Add celery, bay leaves, teaspoon salt, and peppercorns to the pot. Bring to a boil.
Once boiling, lower temperature and simmer for at least one hour. Chicken should be tender, and should pull apart easily.
Remove chicken from water. You may wish to reserve the water as a base for a stock or a soup.
Slice chicken into small bite-size cubes. Take care not to shred the chicken, because the salad should be chunky.

Put cut chicken into a medium-sized bowl. Add mayonnaise and chutney, one spoonful at a time until salad reaches correct consistency. The salad should be moist and chunky, not wet and mushy. Add salt and pepper to taste.
Serve by itself in a bowl, or on bread, biscuits, or croissants.

recipes.title: Goong Ten (Raw Shrimp Salad)
recipes.description: Goong ten (Dancing Shrimp Salad) is a popular dish in Northeast Thailand and Laos. It consists of fresh raw shrimp in spicy sauce with fresh herbs.

steps.text: Clean freshwater shrimp well.
Put the shrimp in ice water for 5 minutes or until they stop moving.
Drain, dry, and set aside.
Make the spicy sauce by combining the fish sauce, sugar, chili, and lime juice together. Test and flavor it as desired. Add more chili for a more spicy taste or add more lime for a more sour taste.
Shake the shrimp with the spicy sauce in a bag to mix it well.
Serve with peppermint leaves and coriander.

recipes.title: Dr. Kitchener's Pudding
recipes.description: A delicious pudding dish.

ingredients.text: 2 oz (57 g / ⅓ cup) moist sugar
ingredients.name: cukier trzcinowy brązowy

ingredients.text: 2 oz (57 g / ⅓ cup) grated nutmeg
ingredients.name: gałka muszkatołowa

steps.text: Beat the eggs, strain them through a sieve, then gradually stir them into the milk.
Mix in the sugar and nutmeg.
Add the flour, beating the mixture until it becomes a smooth batter.
Gradually add suet and bread-crumbs. Mix all thoroughly together, at least half an hour before putting the pudding into a pot.
Transfer batter into a buttered mould. Cook for 50 minutes at 350 F.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Chicken and Andouille Sausage Gumbo
recipes.description: Chicken and andouille sausage gumbo is a soup or stew which is prepared using roux.

ingredients.text: 2 bell peppers, chopped into ¼-inch pieces
ingredients.name: papryka

ingredients.text: 1 large onion, chopped into ¼-inch pieces
ingredients.name: cebula

ingredients.text: 4 stalks of celery, chopped into ¼-inch pieces
ingredients.name: seler naciowy

ingredients.text: about ½ lb (¼ kg) Andouille sausage or other spicy sausage
ingredients.name: kiełbasa ostra andouille

steps.text: Brown outside of chicken breasts in small amount of oil then set aside.
Make a roux from the flour in a large saucepan.
Add peppers, onions, and celery to roux. Cook until softened.
Slowly stir in water, and bring to a simmer.
Cut up browned chicken breasts, add to gumbo, and cook until done.
Slice up sausage and add ½ hour after the chicken.
Season to taste with cayenne and salt.
Serve in a bowl with a little rice and green onions on top.

recipes.title: Pork Aachi
recipes.description: A pork recipe loosely based on Kerala cooking.

ingredients.text: ½ of a medium sized onion, finely sliced
ingredients.name: cebula

steps.text: Brown the meat in half the coconut oil. Add half the meat masala powder and fry for a minute.
Add the vinegar and fry for a minute more. Add 1 cup water and cook till the meat is about half done.
Sauté the sliced onions and chopped chillies with the remaining coconut oil in a wok or a suitable vessel over medium heat.
Add the ginger and garlic after about 4 minutes. Keep stir frying for about 3 more minutes.
Mix in the remaining meat masala powder, and cook until the onions are translucent.

Add the beef stock cube and ¼ glass of water, keeping on low heat for around 4 minutes. Keep adding a bit of water as necessary to make sure that the paste mix does not stick to the bottom of the vessel/wok.
Add the half-cooked meat and mix well. Keep on medium heat until the meat is cooked thoroughly.
Add ¼ cup of water and the potato flakes/powder and mixture. You can vary the amount of the water/potato mix to desired thickness of the dish.
Remove from fire and hold for 3–5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Abacha Mmiri (Soaked Cassava Flakes)
recipes.description: Abacha mmiri (literally "water cassava flakes"), also known as bobozee, is a Nigerian snack prepared from cassava.

steps.text: Peel the cassava, then cut into slices 1 cm thick. Rinse well.
Boil the cassava in a large pot of water until cooked through.
Soak the cooked cassava in fresh water overnight.
The next day, drain away any remaining water and rinse the cassava well.
Season the cassava to taste with the salt.
Serve the cassava with the coconut, palm kernel, and roasted groundnut.

recipes.title: Jersey Breakfast Dog
recipes.description: Hot dog owinięty boczkiem, smażony w głębokim tłuszczu, podany na bułce z jajkiem i serem.

steps.text: Preheat deep fryer to 355°F.
Wrap bacon around the hot dog, securing at each end with a toothpick.
When oil reaches 355°F, lower wrapped hot dog into fryer.
Heat frying pan and fry one egg.
Place cooked egg on a small plate.
Open bun and place onto frying pan on low heat or in toaster oven to lightly toast.
When bacon is firm and crispy, remove hot dog from oil.
Place slice of cheese onto egg and microwave for 7-10 seconds.
Place egg and cheese on to bun.
Remove toothpicks from hot dog, and add to bun.
Add condiments and serve.

images: Stir-fried beef, Fire Town, Montparnasse, Paris 002.jpg

recipes.title: Beef Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Beef Stir-Fry is a flavorful dish that combines thin slices of beef with vegetables and spicy aromatics, perfect for serving over rice or noodles.

ingredients.text: 1 (6–8 oz / 170–225 g) ribeye steak, sliced thinly across the grain on a bias
ingredients.name: stek ribeye
ingredients.note: 6–8 oz / 170–225 g, sliced thinly across the grain on a bias

ingredients.text: ½ large carrot, peeled and julienned
ingredients.name: marchew

steps.text: Lightly oil the bottom of a wok or large skillet and preheat over medium-high heat.
Add onion and garlic, and cook, stirring, until the garlic turns golden. Remove from the pan and keep warm.
Sprinkle the beef slices with salt and freshly ground black pepper.
Add 4 slices to the hot wok and stir-fry until well browned and no longer pink. Remove and repeat with the remaining beef.
Add chilis, carrots, soy sauce, honey, vinegar, and scallions to the wok. Stir-fry until the vegetables are lightly browned around the edges.
Return the cooked onion, garlic, and beef to the wok. Toss together until heated through.
Sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds before serving.

recipes.title: Thick-Crust Pizza
recipes.description: Grube, puszyste ciasto pizzy z sosem pomidorowym, serem mozzarella i dodatkami.

ingredients.text: 2 packets (14 g / 4½ teaspoon) active dry yeast
ingredients.name: drożdże suszone

steps.text: Pour can of tomato sauce into a mixing bowl.
Add sugar, salt, pepper, parsley, basil, oregano, and crushed garlic to bowl.
Stir, and set aside.
Mix yeast with warm water. Stir to combine.
Pour yeast/water mixture into bowl containing 5 cups flour. Stir.
Spread out parchment paper, and sprinkle with flour. Transfer dough from mixing bowl onto parchment paper. Knead. Repeatedly add more flour until dough feels fairly dry and consistent.
Sprinkle bowl with flour. Roll dough into a ball, sprinkle outside with flour, and put into bowl.
Cover bowl with a towel. Let stand for 2 hours to rise.
Preheat oven to 350–375°F.
Coat bottom and sides of aluminum pan with vegetable oil (about 2–3 tablespoons).
Lay out parchment paper, and sprinkle a layer of flour on top.
Flatten dough on parchment paper using rolling pin.
Put dough in pan.
Make ridge around outside of dough for the crust.
Spread the prepared sauce over the dough. Scatter the mozzarella and toppings over the sauce.
Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, until cheese is melted and crust is browned and cooked through.
Slice and serve.

recipes.title: Green Chili Beef Stew
recipes.description: A New Mexican dish, considered the beef stew of New Mexico, usually served with tortillas or sopapillas.

ingredients.text: 6 green New Mexican chiles, roasted and peeled
ingredients.name: zielona papryczka chili nowomeksykańska

steps.text: Heat the oil in a skillet.
Add the beef cubes and brown on all sides.
Transfer the browned meat to a stock pot.
Add the onions to the skillet and sauté until they are browned.
Add the garlic to the onions and cook for an additional couple of minutes.
Transfer the garlic and onions to the stock pot with the meat.
Add all the remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 1–2 hours or until the meat is very tender.
Serve.

recipes.title: Piñon (Spanish Stovetop Pot Pie)
recipes.description: A Spanish-style stovetop pot pie layering plantains, potatoes, string beans, and a seasoned chicken mixture between two layers of egg.

ingredients.text: 3 skinless, boneless chicken breasts, cut into chunks
ingredients.name: pierś z kurczaka

ingredients.text: 1 medium green pepper, broken into chunks
ingredients.name: papryka zielona

ingredients.text: 1 lb string beans or 2 regular-sized cans French-Style string beans
ingredients.name: fasolka szparagowa
ingredients.note: or 2 regular-sized cans French-style string beans

steps.text: Grind the chicken, green pepper, cilantro, culantro, garlic, and onion with the grinder attachment of a mixer or a food processor. Add adobo seasoning to taste.
In a large nonstick skillet, cook the meat mixture until it is lightly browned.
Add the tomato paste and tomato sauce and salt and pepper to taste. Cook about 2 minutes longer and shut off the heat.
Let the meat rest while you continue on.
Cook the string beans in boiling water till they are crisp-tender. Drain and set aside. Or you can use canned French-style string beans, drained and set aside.

Peel the plantains and cut them lengthwise into ¼–½ inch thick strips. Cook them in a large frying pan with a little oil over medium heat until lightly browned on both sides. Remove to a dish and set aside.
Peel the potatoes and cut them into french fries. Fry them in a skillet with some oil until golden. Remove from the skillet and set aside.
Beat 3 eggs in a bowl and add a pinch of salt and pepper. Beat the other 3 eggs in a separate bowl, adding salt and pepper to taste as well. Set both bowls aside.

In a large (14-inch) nonstick lidded skillet over medium heat, pour in some oil, enough to coat the bottom. Add the first bowl of eggs and swirl the pan until the bottom is coated. Cook until the eggs start to set, then remove from the heat.

Place a layer of half the plantains in the pan on top of the eggs. On top of that place half the string beans, then half the fries. On top of that put all of the meat mixture. On top of the meat, place the rest of the fries, then the rest of the string beans, and the rest of the plantains.
Pour the other bowl of eggs on top. Cover and cook over medium low heat until the eggs on top have expanded and set.
Using the lid from the 14-inch skillet, invert the pan and place the Piñon upside down back into the pan. Cover and cook until done, another 5–10 minutes.
Serve with rice and beans or a side of your choosing.

recipes.title: Ukrainian Cornmeal Stuffing (Nachynka)
recipes.description: Nachynka is a Ukrainian baked cornmeal side dish, served as a side rather than stuffed inside anything.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Melt butter in a pot on medium heat.
Add cornmeal. Stir mixture to warm up the cornmeal.
Add milk. Stir until mixture has thickened.
Beat eggs. Beat in salt, sugar, and baking powder.
Slowly add some of the thickened cornmeal mixture to the egg mixture while mixing to temper the eggs.
Stir the egg mixture into the rest of the cornmeal.
Pour the mixture into a greased casserole dish.
Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 30–40 minutes or until the top has browned.

recipes.title: Tortilla de Patatas
recipes.description: A Spanish potato omelette, served hot or cold, often as a tapas dish. Traditionally made with only potatoes and eggs.

steps.text: Peel the potatoes and cut them into small cubes or thin round slices. Sprinkle with salt and leave any excess water to drain from them while heating the oil to around 350°F (177°C) in a large frying pan.

Fry the potato slices until they are very slightly golden. The more golden and crisp the potatoes are, the juicier the omelette will be. For a dryer and thicker tortilla, turn the heat down and let the potatoes cook gently until tender and soft.
Remove the potatoes from the oil and drain. Beat the eggs, add salt to taste and mix with the potato chips. Leave them to soak for 10 minutes.

Heat 1 tablespoon of the olive oil in a frying pan and, when it's smoking hot, add the potato and egg mixture. Use a smaller frying pan so you get a thicker and well-rounded omelette. Shake the pan to avoid the omelette sticking or burning.
After a few minutes, turn the omelette over with the help of a flat lid or a large dish, and leave until golden on the other side.
Serve hot or cold accompanied by a salad.

recipes.title: Bean Chili
recipes.description: Vegetarian chili made with kidney and black beans, crushed tomatoes and peppers, seasoned with chili powder and cayenne.

ingredients.text: 2 tbsp olive oil or vegetable oil
ingredients.name: oliwa z oliwek

ingredients.text: 1 tsp thyme, basil, oregano, or other spice
ingredients.name: tymianek
ingredients.note: thyme, basil, oregano, or other spice

steps.text: Heat oil over medium-high heat in a large pot.
Add garlic and onion and cook until the onion is translucent (more clear than white).
Add peppers and sauté for a few minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, and spices.
When mixture is bubbling, reduce heat to simmer and add beans.
Cover and simmer for at least 1 hour, stirring occasionally.
The longer it simmers, the better it tastes.

categories: Recipes using chile paste and sauce

recipes.title: Pudina Hilsa (Bengali Fish with Mint)
recipes.description: Pudina hilsa is a wonderful Bengali preparation of hilsa fish. It is very easy and can be served hot with boiled rice.

ingredients.text: 1 kg hilsa fish (kelee shad), cut into 10 pieces
ingredients.name: ryba hilsa

steps.text: Wash the fish thoroughly in water.
Put the salt, sugar, 25 g of butter and all the other ingredients into a baking dish.
Add the fish pieces and sprinkle the rest of the butter on the top.
Bake at 200°C until the fish turns golden in color or otherwise appears to be done.

recipes.title: Simple Nachos
recipes.description: Nachos z mieloną wołowiną, pomidorami z zielonym chili i kwaśną śmietaną.

ingredients.text: 1 pound (450 g) lean ground beef (92% lean or greater)
ingredients.name: wołowina mielona

ingredients.text: 1 can diced tomatoes with green chiles
ingredients.name: pomidory z puszki

ingredients.text: 2 teaspoons or less taco seasoning mix (mostly cumin)
ingredients.name: przyprawa do tacos

steps.text: In a skillet, brown ground beef with Mexican seasoning and Taco Mix.
When beef is browned add the can of diced tomatoes with green chiles, cover and allow to simmer an additional 5 minutes.
Put tortilla chips on a large plate. Place 2 tablespoons of sour cream on plate. Sprinkle beef and diced tomato mixture over top of the chips.
Serve and enjoy.

recipes.title: Kuddi (Spiced Yogurt Sauce)
recipes.description: Kuddi, also called kadhi, is a sort of gravy based on yogurt and chickpea flour. It can be served with pakora, rice, or roti.

steps.text: Combine the yogurt, chickpea flour, sugar, salt, grated ginger, and chopped green chilli.
Heat and bring to a boil with continuous stirring.
Taste and add more sugar or salt as needed. It should be sour, salty, and sweet.
Fry the jeera seeds in butter, and mix them into the kuddi.
Serve.

recipes.title: Boiled Custard
recipes.description: A classic dessert with a light texture and a mild flavor.

ingredients.text: ¼–½ cup (55–110 g / 1.9–3.9 oz) white granulated sugar
ingredients.name: cukier biały granulowany

steps.text: Heat milk and salt (if using) in a double boiler until bubbles form around the edges.
Beat eggs with sugar until uniform.
Gradually mix approximately ½ cup (125 ml / 4.2 oz) hot milk into the egg mixture to temper it.
Slowly stir egg mixture into remaining hot milk.
Optionally, mix cornstarch and water and stir into custard.
Stir over heat until thickened (should coat the spoon), without bringing to a boil.
Remove from heat, and continue stirring to dry the custard slightly.
Stir in vanilla before the dish has cooled completely.
Serve warm or chilled.

recipes.title: Chleb z dyni
recipes.description: Chleb żytni z dodatkiem ugotowanej dyni, zakwasu i drożdży, według staropolskiej receptury.

steps.text: Zalać okruchy żytniego chleba maślanką lub kwaśnym i pozostawić przykryte czystą gazą lub serwetką na dobę w temperaturze pokojowej.
Ugotowaną dynię przetrzeć przez sito lub zmiksować w wodzie z maślanką lub kwaśnym mlekiem.
Dodać część mąki, zakwas i pozostawić na noc (12 godzin).
Dobrze wymieszane z pozostałą częścią mąki ciasto wyrobić i odstawić na 2-3 godzin do wyrośnięcia.
Uformować bochenki i piec w nagrzanym piecu przez 1,5 godziny.

recipes.title: Corn Dogs
recipes.description: Hot dogs coated in a cornmeal batter and deep fried, served like at a fair.

steps.text: Preheat deep fat fryer.
Combine corn meal, flour, and salt.
Add milk, egg, and oil; mix well.
Insert a wooden skewer into one end of each hot dog.
Coat with flour, then coat with corn meal mixture.
Fry a few at a time in deep hot oil until golden brown.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Pumpkin Cookies
recipes.description: Miękkie ciasteczka z dynią, czekoladowymi kawałkami i orzechami.

ingredients.text: 1 cup (250 ml / 8.5 fl oz) vegetable oil
ingredients.name: olej roślinny

ingredients.text: 2 cups (150 g / 5.3 oz) pecans or almonds, chopped
ingredients.name: orzechy pekan lub migdały

ingredients.text: 1 cup (100 g / 3.5 oz) granola, rolled oats or Grape-Nuts
ingredients.name: granola lub płatki owsiane

steps.text: Preheat oven to 375 F.
In a large bowl, combine and wet ingredients.
Sift flour, cinnamon, nutmeg, soda, and cloves together in a separate bowl.
Blend dry into wet ingredients.
Mix in nuts, granola, and chocolate chips.
Drop spoonfuls of dough onto greased cookie sheet.
Bake for 10–12 minutes, then cool.

recipes.title: Rosehip Soup
recipes.description: Basic Jewish rosehip soup, also popular in Iceland and parts of Scandinavia, where it is often used for colds and sore throats.

ingredients.text: For each litre, 1 liquid quart of rosehip pulp
ingredients.name: miąższ dzikiej róży

steps.text: Rinse the rosehips.
Crush dried hips.
Boil in water till soft.
Press through a colander.
Measure the pulp and dilute with water if necessary.
Bring the pulp to a boil and add sugar.
Add more sugar if it is too tart.
Mix potato flour with some cold water.
Thicken the soup while you stir and bring to a boil.
Add blanched and shredded almond.

recipes.title: Prawn Curry
recipes.description: A South Asian prawn curry with tomatoes, potatoes and warm spices, served with boiled rice or naan.

ingredients.text: 1 kg medium-sized prawns (shrimp), cleaned with tails removed
ingredients.name: krewetki

ingredients.text: ¼ tsp nutmeg and mace powder
ingredients.name: gałka muszkatołowa i macis w proszku

steps.text: Heat a tablespoon of oil in a pan and sauté prawns over medium-high heat for 2 minutes only, just until that their water dries out and they turn pink in color.
Don't try to cook prawns for more than that because they will become rubbery and hard to chew.
In a saucepan, heat the remaining oil and fry onions over high heat for 8–10 minutes, stirring constantly until they become light golden in color.
When onions have been fried, add tomato pieces, ginger garlic paste, red chili powder, turmeric powder, salt, cloves, cardamoms and cinnamon sticks.
Cover the pan and cook them over medium heat until they all mix together and form a curry. It takes at least 10–15 minutes for the curry to be cooked.
When curry becomes red and the onions soften, mix in potato pieces and 1 cup water.
Let them cook for 15 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
Uncover the pan and cook over high heat until the oil starts to separate from the gravy.
Add the cumin powder, black pepper powder, garam masala, nutmeg, and mace powder.
Add fried prawn pieces and a sprinkle of coriander leaves. Mix them together and then cover the pan.
Cook for just a minute over very low heat.
Serve with boiled rice or naan.

recipes.title: Rice with Lemon Coconut and Eggplant (Vangibhat)
recipes.description: Cooked long-grain rice mixed with sautéed eggplant, toasted coconut, ground spices and a lemon-turmeric mixture, served at room temperature.

ingredients.text: 1 medium eggplant, peeled and chopped into ½-inch (1 cm) cubes
ingredients.name: bakłażan
ingredients.note: medium, peeled and chopped into ½-inch (1 cm) cubes

steps.text: Place the eggplant into a large bowl and sprinkle with 1 teaspoon salt. Mix well and allow to sit for half an hour, then rinse lightly and allow to drain.

Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a skillet over a medium flame. Add the coriander seeds, split peas, cumin, and cinnamon. Stir well. When the spices have darkened, remove them and place on a plate lined with a paper towel.
In the same pan, fry the coconut, stirring constantly. When it turns a golden-brown, remove and place on the paper towel.
In another skillet, sauté the eggplant until it is cooked through. It should turn a bruised dark brown. Be careful not to add too much oil in the process. Remove, set aside, and keep warm.
Put the dried spices into a mortar and grind into a fine powder. A well-cleaned coffee grinder works well as a substitute.
In a small pot, combine the lemon juice, ½ teaspoon salt, turmeric, and 2 tablespoons water. Bring to a boil. Lower the heat and allow to simmer for 3 minutes.

In a skillet, add the cooked rice and the eggplant and sauté with very little oil. Mix well. Allow the mixture to cool. Add 2 more tablespoons of vegetable oil; mix well. Add the coconut-spice mixture and the lemon mixture. Mix well and serve at room temperature.

recipes.title: Spicy Fried Wings
recipes.description: Crispy deep-fried chicken wings coated in cornmeal and a spicy seasoning blend.

ingredients.text: 12 whole chicken wings, tips removed and cut in half
ingredients.name: skrzydełka z kurczaka
ingredients.note: tips removed and cut in half

steps.text: Combine all seasonings except lemon zest and then sprinkle over chicken. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Combine egg and lemon zest in a pie plate and place cornmeal in another pie plate.
Heat oil to 350°F.
Dip chicken into egg mixture and then dredge in cornmeal.
Fry in batches for 11–12 minutes. Drain on a rack. Please don't use paper towels unless you want greasy chicken.
Sprinkle with red pepper flake for hotter wings, but this is completely optional. Serve.

recipes.title: Charoset (Maghrebi)
recipes.description: Maghrebi charoset is a variety of charoset served during the Jewish celebration of Passover by Jews from Northwest Africa. Serve as part of the seder.

ingredients.text: ½ cup dried apricots or dried peaches, chopped
ingredients.name: suszona morela

steps.text: Soak dried fruit in juice until plumped.
Mash reconstituted fruit with almond and spices to get a mortar-like texture.
Adjust texture with matsoh meal and if needed, sweeten with honey.

recipes.title: Affogato
recipes.description: Italian dessert of gelato or ice cream topped with espresso.

ingredients.text: 1–2 shots espresso, or one long pull shot
ingredients.name: espresso
ingredients.note: 1–2 shots, or one long pull shot

steps.text: Either pour espresso over gelato and serve, or serve them side by side for diner to mix at the table.

recipes.title: Cream Soda
recipes.description: Cream soda is popular in the United States, but is rare in other parts of the world.

steps.text: Combine the vanilla extract, water, and sugar in a pot.
Boil the mixture until it reduces to about 5 oz (150 ml) syrup.
To make the finished soda, combine 1 volume of syrup with 5 volumes of carbonated water.
Chill in refrigerator and serve with ice.

recipes.title: Bryndzové Halušky (Slovak Dumplings with Cheese)
recipes.description: Slovak dumplings made from grated raw potato and flour, topped with sheep's milk bryndza cheese and crispy bacon.

ingredients.text: 750 g potatoes, peeled and finely grated
ingredients.name: ziemniak

ingredients.text: 250 g bryndze cheese, cut into very small pieces
ingredients.name: ser bryndza

ingredients.text: 100 g bacon (údenej slaniny), cooked and cut into small pieces
ingredients.name: boczek
ingredients.note: cooked and cut into small pieces

steps.text: Combine the grated potatoes with the flour and salt to make a dough.
Shape the dough into small cylindrical pieces less than 3 cm in size.
Transfer the dumplings to a pot of boiling salted water. When the dumplings rise to the top of the boiling water, remove one to make sure they are thoroughly cooked.
Remove the dumplings from the pot with a slotted spoon, and transfer to a warmed plate.
Immediately after dumplings are placed on the plate, scatter the cheese over top, and let the cheese melt over the dumplings. Mix if desired.
Sprinkle the crispy bacon bits on top of the cheese.
Serve piping hot.

categories: Recipes using vegetable broth and stock

recipes.title: Muskrat Soup
recipes.description: A hearty soup made with muskrat meat, brown lentils, potatoes, collard greens and bell peppers.

ingredients.text: 3 tbsp olive oil or any type of cooking oil
ingredients.name: oliwa z oliwek
ingredients.note: or any type of cooking oil

ingredients.text: ½ lb muskrat meat, cut into pieces
ingredients.name: mięso z piżmaka

ingredients.text: 5–8 leaves of collard greens, cut into pieces
ingredients.name: liść jarmużu

ingredients.text: Red and yellow bell peppers, diced
ingredients.name: papryka

ingredients.text: 2 cups water (1 cup for constantly deglazing the pan)
ingredients.name: woda
ingredients.note: 1 cup for constantly deglazing the pan

steps.text: Add the onion to a large pot and sauté until golden-brown. Then add the olive oil and stir constantly.
After a couple of minutes, add the garlic. You can add a little bit of water to prevent the garlic from burning.
Add the muskrat meat and stir until golden brown. Stir in the tomato paste.
After 5 minutes, add the salt and pepper and taste the mixture.
Add the brown lentils and cook for 5–7 minutes.
Add the collard greens and cook for 3–4 minutes.
Deglaze the pot with the red wine and cook until reduced by half.
Add the diced potatoes and stir for 5 more minutes.
Add the vegetable stock and the water that is left. Bring to a boil.
Add the peppers with the jalapeño. Let the soup simmer for at least 10 minutes and add the rosemary.
Turn off the heat. You can serve it right away or wait 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Asian Grilled Salmon
recipes.description: Łosoś grillowany w azjatyckiej marynacie z sosu sojowego, imbiru i curry.

ingredients.text: 4 ea. (24 ounces / 680 g) wild salmon fillets with skin, pin bones removed
ingredients.name: filet z łososia dzikiego

steps.text: Purée all ingredients except salmon and fresh herbs in blender until smooth. Pour into plastic bag and add salmon; toss to coat. Seal, getting as much air out as possible, and refrigerate up to 4 hours.
After 4 hours, preheat 4.5 lbs (2 kg) charcoal in chimney. Disperse evenly around the bottom of the grill and reapply grate.
While charcoal heats, remove salmon from marinade. Discard remaining marinade. Let sit at room temperature until coals have heated.
Once the grate is hot, quickly swab the grate with the towel. Add salmon to the hottest part, skin side up, and cook 3–5 minutes per side for medium, rotating 90 degrees halfway to get grill marks.
Remove to a plate and cover tightly with aluminum foil. Let rest 5 minutes.
Move salmon to warmed individual plates, sprinkle with chopped herbs, and garnish with citrus wedges, if desired. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Brioche Stuffing
recipes.description: Brioche bread is a slightly sweetened yeast bread, often used in stuffing applications.

ingredients.text: ½ cup shelled walnuts, finely chopped
ingredients.name: orzech włoski

ingredients.text: ¼ cup dried apples, coarsely chopped
ingredients.name: suszone jabłko

ingredients.text: ¼ cup unsalted butter, cut into small cubes
ingredients.name: masło

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in a deep roasting pan. Press into a loose, flat layer.
Bake in a 375 °F (190 °C) oven for 25 minutes.
Raise temperature to 425 °F (220 °C), and bake for 10 minutes. Serve immediately.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Creamy Mushroom Pasta
recipes.description: A creamy mushroom pasta with garlic, white wine, heavy cream and Parmesan, ready in about twenty minutes.

ingredients.text: 1 serving uncooked pasta (⅔ cup / 75 g / 2.6 oz) (suggestion: whole wheat linguine)
ingredients.name: makaron pszenny
ingredients.note: (⅔ cup / 75 g / 2.6 oz) (suggestion: whole wheat linguine)

ingredients.text: 8 oz (230 g) white button mushroom, stems removed
ingredients.name: pieczarka

ingredients.text: ¼ cup (60 ml / 2 oz) heavy cream
ingredients.name: śmietanka 36%

ingredients.text: ¼ cup (60 ml / 2 oz) low-sodium chicken bone broth
ingredients.name: bulion drobiowy

ingredients.text: ¼ cup (30 g / 1.1 oz) grated parmesan cheese
ingredients.name: parmezan

steps.text: In a large pot, cook pasta in salted boiling water for 8–9 minutes or according to the package directions until al dente. Drain.
Meanwhile, in a large skillet, melt butter over medium-high heat. Stir in minced garlic and let it cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant.
Place mushrooms in the skillet, cup side up. Cook for 3–5 minutes or until mushrooms start shrinking, moving the mushrooms around with a spatula occasionally.
Add white wine; continue cooking to let the wine and mushroom juice evaporate (about 3 minutes).

Pour heavy cream and chicken bone broth into the skillet, and add a generous pinch of salt. Switch to medium heat and cook until the cooking liquid is slightly thickened, flipping the mushrooms a couple times.
Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over the mushrooms and gently stir until the cheese is melted. Taste and add more salt if desired.
Toss the cooked pasta into the skillet. Combine well with the mushroom mixture, then transfer to a serving plate.
Sprinkle with freshly ground black pepper and garnish with chopped parsley. Add more grated Parmesan cheese if desired. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Ugba Stew
recipes.description: A modern spin on traditional ugba stew, with parsley giving it a fresh taste.

ingredients.text: 2 seasoning cubes (preferably Maggi or Knorr brand)
ingredients.name: kostka przyprawowa

steps.text: Soak the dried stockfish in water for 2–3 hours at a minimum, and preferably overnight.
Combine the soaked fish, 3–4 cups of water, pepper, crayfish, seasoning cube, and salt in a pot.
Cover, and cook over medium heat for about 2 hours, or until the fish is very tender. Add more water if needed.
When the fish is cooked and very tender, take a wooden spoon and separate the fish into tiny little bits. Let it cook for another 15–20 minutes.
Add the ukpaka, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the akanwu, and let it dissolve. This takes about 2–5 minutes.
Add palm oil and ogiri. Reduce heat, and cook for 10 minutes.
Remove from the heat, and serve with chopped vegetables and onions.

recipes.title: Peanut Sauce (Vegan)
recipes.description: A peanut sauce that works well with stir-fried tofu and greens or any steamed vegetables.

ingredients.text: 2 Tbsp vinegar, rice vinegar or cider vinegar
ingredients.name: ocet

steps.text: Mix all ingredients together, adding the water last.

recipes.title: Egg Pie
recipes.description: A good dish for breakfast, brunch, or a late-night snack: a baked egg pie with bacon, soda crackers and cheddar.

ingredients.text: ½ cup cheddar cheese, cut into small pieces.
ingredients.name: ser cheddar

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F (~175°C).
Cut bacon into small pieces and sauté until brown.
Crush crackers.
Beat eggs in bowl.
Add crackers, milk, salt, and pepper, then cheese to the eggs.
Spray casserole dish with cooking spray.
Pour mixture into casserole dish, and add bacon.
Bake in preheated oven until a knife comes out clean when pie is tested.
Cut in wedges and serve with jam.

recipes.title: Mini Three-Cheese English Muffin Pizzas
recipes.description: Mini pizze na połówkach angielskich bułeczek z trzema rodzajami sera, kiełbaskami i sosem pomidorowym.

ingredients.text: 6 large English muffins, split and buttered
ingredients.name: bułka angielska

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Sprinkle buttered muffins with Parmesan cheese.
Toast under broiler until golden brown.
Place 1½ tablespoons of shredded cheddar cheese on each muffin.
Cut frankfurters crosswise in ¼-inch slices; arrange on muffins.
Top each with about 2 tablespoons of pizza sauce, and sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of mozzarella cheese.
Bake 12–15 minutes or until thoroughly heated.

recipes.title: Ukpo Oka (Nigerian Corn Pudding)
recipes.description: A corn pudding from the Ika-Ibo people of Delta State, Nigeria, made from fresh sweet corn, pepper, onion and palm oil.

steps.text: Blend together the corn, pepper, onion, and crayfish with a small amount of water.
Transfer the mixture to a bowl, and stir in salt and palm oil to taste.
Pour the mixture into a mold. Place in boiling water, and steam for 45 minutes.

categories: Recipes using chile paste and sauce

recipes.title: Sambal Tempoyak (Anchovies with Fermented Durian Chili Paste)
recipes.description: Indonesian sambal made with fermented durian (tempoyak), coconut milk and chili paste, served with crisp dried anchovies, petai and rice.

steps.text: Remove heads and entrails from ikan bilis.
Wash and soak for 10 minutes.
Deep-fry until crisp.
Combine 2 tbsp of tempoyak, coconut milk, salt, chilis, chili paste, turmeric root, and petai seeds. Grind to make a paste.
Heat oil in a pan and stir-fry the sambal paste with lemon grass until it becomes fragrant.
Add the rest of tempoyak and boil gently over low heat until gravy is thickened.
Add salt to taste. Serve with crisp ikan bilis, petai and rice.

recipes.title: Tomato Paste and Ham Sandwiches (Pan Tomaca)
recipes.description: Pa amb tomàquet, a sandwich style dish or tapa originating in Catalonia but now enjoyed all over Spain. It is lightly toasted bread rubbed with fresh tomato, sprinkled with olive oil and salt, and served with cured ham or cheese.

ingredients.text: Pa de pagès (Catalan bread) or 1 loaf French bread, sliced
ingredients.name: bagietka pszenna
ingredients.note: Pa de pagès (Catalan bread) or 1 loaf French bread, sliced

steps.text: Toast the slices of pa de pagès. If desired, rub garlic on each slice of bread.
Cut the tomatoes in half, and rub the tomato flesh over the surface of the bread until most of the pulp is gone.
Sprinkle with olive oil and a bit of salt, then place a slice of cured ham on top.
Either top each slice with a second slice of bread to make a sandwich, or leave as an open-faced slice.

recipes.title: Miyan Ridi (Nigerian Sesame Soup)
recipes.description: Miya Ridi is a traditional toasted sesame seed soup popular among the Hausa people of Northern Nigeria. Rich in flavor and often served with tuwo or other local swallows, it is a nutritious dish commonly prepared during special occasions or family meals.

ingredients.text: 500 g beef, cut into bite-sized pieces
ingredients.name: wołowina

ingredients.text: 2 cups toasted sesame seeds (ridi), blended into a paste
ingredients.name: ziarno sezamu prażone
ingredients.note: toasted, ridi, blended into a paste

ingredients.text: 2 medium-sized dried smoked fish, cleaned and deboned
ingredients.name: ryba suszona wędzona

steps.text: In a pot, boil the beef with the chopped onion, seasoning cubes, and a little water until the meat is tender.
Blend the toasted sesame seeds into a smooth paste using a blender or grinding stone.
In a separate pot, heat the palm oil over medium heat. Add the sliced onion and blended red bell pepper, then fry for 5–7 minutes until fragrant.
Add the cooked beef and some of the beef stock. Stir in the smoked fish and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the ground sesame seed paste. Stir continuously to avoid lumps, and cook for about 10 minutes. Add water as needed to reach desired consistency.
Add the chopped spinach, stir, and turn off the heat after 1–2 minutes.
Serve hot with tuwo shinkafa, pounded yam, wheat, or other swallow of choice.

recipes.title: Beef Stock
recipes.description: Francuski wywar wołowy (fond blanc i fond brun) przygotowywany z kości, mięsa i warzyw przez kilka godzin.

ingredients.text: 3 lb beef shin bones, sawn into 2-inch lengths
ingredients.name: kość wołowa golenia

ingredients.text: 3 lb beef marrow bones, sawn into 2-inch lengths
ingredients.name: kość szpikowa wołowa

ingredients.text: 2 lb beef short ribs, sawn into 2-inch lengths
ingredients.name: żeberko wołowe

ingredients.text: 2 lb veal shank, sawn into 2-inch lengths
ingredients.name: goleń cielęca

ingredients.text: ½ lb onions, cut into medium dice
ingredients.name: cebula

ingredients.text: 2 leeks, including green part, trimmed and thoroughly washed to remove all sand
ingredients.name: por
ingredients.note: including green part, trimmed and thoroughly washed to remove all sand

ingredients.text: 2 oz carrots, peeled and cut into medium dice
ingredients.name: marchew
ingredients.note: peeled and cut into medium dice

ingredients.text: 2 fresh thyme sprigs or ½ tsp dried thyme
ingredients.name: tymianek świeży

steps.text: Place all the meat and bones in a stock pot and enough water to cover the solids by 2 inches.
Bring to a simmer over medium heat, skimming off foam and scum as it rises to the surface.
Reduce the heat and simmer uncovered and undisturbed for 30 minutes. Do not let it boil.
Skim if necessary and add the vegetables, bouquet garni, and salt.
Stir, partially cover, and simmer for 6 to 8 hours.
Using tongs or a spider, remove the bones and discard them.
Strain the stock into another container and discard the vegetables.
Now strain the stock back into the rinsed stock pot through a double layer of dampened cheesecloth.
Set the pot in a sink of cold water to cool rapidly then put it into the refrigerator to chill.
Remove from the refrigerator, lift the layer of solidified fat off, and discard the fat.
Divide the stock into suitably-sized portions and freeze.

recipes.title: Hot Chocolate (Orange)
recipes.description: Orange hot chocolate is a twist on the old childhood favorite. It is not sweet by design.

ingredients.text: 4 oz (110 g) bittersweet chocolate, chopped (can substitute semisweet)
ingredients.name: czekolada gorzka

steps.text: Place the milk and cinnamon in a saucepan, and gently heat to just below a simmer, about 180 F.
Add the chocolate, and stir while allowing to melt. Do not allow to come to a boil.
When the chocolate has melted, strain the chocolate milk into another container, add the extracts, and whisk or blend until frothy.
Transfer to mugs or heatproof glasses and serve.

recipes.title: Hot Milk Cake
recipes.description: Tradycyjny dwuwarstwowy tort z Mid-Atlantic States, który można polukrować kremem mokka, innym lukrem lub truskawkami.

ingredients.text: 2 cups (480 ml) cake flour or, 4 T (60 ml) cornstarch and enough all-purpose flour to equal 2 cups
ingredients.name: mąka pszenna tortowa
ingredients.note: or 4 T (60 ml) cornstarch and enough all-purpose flour to equal 2 cups

steps.text: An hour before baking, take eggs and butter out of the refrigerator to reach room temperature.
Heat together milk and butter until butter melts. Cool to just warm, then add vanilla.
If you sift the flour, do so after measuring. Combine dry ingredients.
In a large bowl whip the eggs until light and lemon-colored—this could take 5–10 minutes.
Add sugar slowly, beating well.
Add the dry ingredients.
Add milk mixture very slowly, folding it in by hand toward the end.
Divide the batter into 2 greased and floured 9-inch (230 mm) round cake pans.
Bake about 30 minutes at 350 °F (175 °C).
Cool on racks for 10 minutes (you may need to run a knife around the edge first), then turn out to cool completely.
Frost with mocha icing, other icing, or with strawberries.

recipes.title: Chicken and Black-eyed Pea Stew
recipes.description: This dish is a spicy chicken black-eyed pea stew or curry. It is a meal on its own.

ingredients.text: 1 cup of dry black-eyed peas (or about 2 cups canned)
ingredients.name: fasola czarnooka sucha

ingredients.text: 2–3 tbsp vegetable oil or chicken fat
ingredients.name: olej roślinny

ingredients.text: 2 medium (~2 cups) chopped white or red onions
ingredients.name: cebula

ingredients.text: 1 stalk (~½–1 cup) chopped celery including the leaves
ingredients.name: seler naciowy

ingredients.text: 1 tsp black pepper, preferably freshly-crushed peppercorns
ingredients.name: pieprz czarny

ingredients.text: 1 cup uncooked long-grained rice, preferably brown rice
ingredients.name: ryż

ingredients.text: 2 cups chicken stock, canned tomato liquid, water, or vegetable stock
ingredients.name: bulion drobiowy
ingredients.note: or canned tomato liquid, water, or vegetable stock

ingredients.text: 2 cups canned tomatoes (crushed or diced), or 1 pound diced fresh tomatoes.
ingredients.name: pomidor
ingredients.note: canned, crushed or diced; or 1 pound diced fresh

ingredients.text: 1 pound bone-in chicken meat (e.g. two chicken legs)
ingredients.name: udko z kurczaka

ingredients.text: 2 tsp curry powder stirred into the juice of ½ lemon
ingredients.name: curry
ingredients.note: stirred into the juice of ½ lemon

steps.text: If using dry black-eyed peas, wash them, then cook for 20 minutes or until al dente. When done, drain.
Meanwhile, sauté onions, carrots, and celery in oil for 5 minutes.
Add garlic, ginger, salt, and pepper, and sauté for 2 more minutes.
Stir rice into vegetable mix.
Add stock and tomatoes, then bring to a boil.
Add the cooked black-eyed peas.
Add meat, cook a further 5 minutes, turn heat to low, and let simmer for 30–40 minutes. The stew is ready when the rice is soft.
Add chili peppers and curry-lemon paste, then cook for 10 more minutes. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Spicy Chicken Casserole
recipes.description: Zapiekanka z kurczakiem, chili, sosem śmietanowym i tortillami kukurydzianymi, zapiekana z serem cheddar.

ingredients.text: 1 can (10 oz) condensed cream of chicken soup
ingredients.name: zagęszczona zupa krem z kurczaka

ingredients.text: 1 can (10 oz) condensed cream of celery soup
ingredients.name: zagęszczona zupa krem z selera

steps.text: Mix all ingredients except tortillas and cheese.
Layer the tortillas, chicken mixture, and cheese in baking dish. Make two layers, finishing with cheese.
Bake at 375°F for 30–40 minutes.

recipes.title: Bicol Express
recipes.description: Filipino pork dish cooked with coconut milk and chili peppers, named after a train from the Bicol Region.

steps.text: Heat a frying pan over medium heat, then add the cooking oil.
When the oil is hot, add the onion and garlic. Sauté until fragrant and aromatic.
Add the shrimp paste, siling labuyo and the pork belly. Stir fry the mixture until the pork is browned on all sides.
Add the sugar, pepper, and monosodium glutamate if using.
Stir in the coconut milk, and simmer until the meat is cooked through.
Serve with cooked rice.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Stracciatella I
recipes.description: Straciatella is an Italian egg-drop soup. It uses a chicken broth base, and adds flavour with fresh parsley, Parmesan cheese, and pepper.

ingredients.text: Red chile flakes, or chile powder (optional)
ingredients.name: płatki chili
ingredients.note: optional; red chile flakes or chile powder

steps.text: Put the broth in a large pot, and bring to a boil.
Separately, combine eggs, cheese, and parsley, and beat until the cheese and parsley are moistened.
Once the broth is at a rolling boil, use a whisk to set the fluid whirling.
Slowly add the egg mixture, keeping the broth at a boil so the egg cooks quickly.
Remove from heat, and add pepper.
Serve immediately, or reheat and serve very hot.

recipes.title: Hummus with Sprouted Chickpea
recipes.description: Classic hummus made from entirely raw, sprouted chickpeas for a healthy, delicious taste.

steps.text: Soak chickpeas for 12–24 hours then let sprout for 1–2 days. Make sure to rinse three times a day while sprouting.
Combine all ingredients except olive oil, paprika, and fresh parsley in a blender or food processor, and purée until smooth. Refrigerate for best taste.
Sprinkle hummus with olive oil, paprika, and parsley when serving.

recipes.title: Chunky Cran Apple Bran Muffins
