recipes.description: A tasty muffin recipe with apple chunks and dried cranberries.

ingredients.text: ¾ cup (180 g) natural wheat bran
ingredients.name: otręby pszenne

ingredients.text: 1 ½ cup (360 g) chopped, peeled apples
ingredients.name: jabłko

steps.text: Combine bran and milk into a mixing bowl. Let rest for 5 minutes.
Combine flour, baking powder, cinnamon, salt, baking soda and nutmeg in another mixing bowl.
Stir brown sugar, cooking oil, and egg into the bran mixture. Stir in dried ingredients, apples and cranberries.
Spoon batter into greased muffin cups.
Fill muffin cups ¾ full. Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 15 to 20 minutes, or until tester comes out clean.

recipes.title: Beurre Blanc
recipes.description: A classic French butter sauce from the Loire Valley, made by reducing white wine, lemon juice and shallot and emulsifying cold butter into it.

ingredients.text: 1 cup of good white wine (dry aromatic white, preferably French, such as Pouilly-Fumé)
ingredients.name: wino białe wytrawne
ingredients.note: dry aromatic white, preferably French, such as Pouilly-Fumé

ingredients.text: 10–12 Tbsp unsalted butter, very cold and in cubes or lumps
ingredients.name: masło
ingredients.note: 10–12, very cold and in cubes or lumps, unsalted

steps.text: Place the white wine in a non-reactive saucepan with the lemon juice and chopped shallots.
Cook this mixture until reduced to about 2 tablespoons, boiling freely if needed, until the shallot is still fairly moist; a dry pan means the sauce likely won't hold.
Reduce heat to low. Add the heavy cream at this point if you want more holding power (optional, non-traditional).
Begin adding cubes of cold butter while whisking vigorously, keeping the sauce under 200°F (95°C), whisking partly off the flame; add 1 or 2 cubes at a time until all the butter is incorporated.
Season with salt and white pepper, and serve immediately. The sauce can be held in a vacuum container such as a Thermos, but not recommended for long periods.

recipes.title: Thai Red Curry Paste
recipes.description: A spicy paste commonly used to make Thai curry dishes.

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons freshly chopped cilantro, leaves and stems
ingredients.name: kolendra świeża

steps.text: Grind the red chiles, garlic, lemongrass, and onion in a mortar.
Add the remaining ingredients except for the oil, and keep grinding to make a fluid paste.
Mix in the oil. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 1 month.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Eggs
recipes.description: Scrambled eggs made with cottage cheese and seasoned with Mexican seasoning or chili powder.

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon Mexican seasoning or chili powder
ingredients.name: chili w proszku

steps.text: Preheat a large metal or non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Whisk eggs and cottage cheese together in a small bowl; place in skillet.
Sprinkle Mexican seasoning on eggs (to taste).
As eggs begin to cook, start folding them together, turning as needed, until done cooking.
Serve with or on wheat toast.

recipes.title: Yeasted Kifli
recipes.description: Węgierskie kifli drożdżowe z nadzieniem, pieczone w małych rogalikach.

steps.text: Mix together milk, yeast, and 1 tsp sugar, then set aside. Ensure it does not clump.
Using a pastry knife, mix flour, butter, salt in a bowl until crumbly.
Add 3½ tbsp sugar and baking powder to the flour mixture.
In a separate bowl, whisk the egg yolks. Add the yeast mixture, then the sour cream and vanilla.
Mix the wet ingredients with the dry ingredients. You should get a dough with the consistency of peanut butter cookie dough. Add additional flour if the dough is too sticky.

Knead dough well and let stand 2 hours in a warm place. To allow the dough to rise, place the bowl with the dough (covered with a tea towel) onto the top rack of the oven and place a bowl of hot water on the lower rack. Leave the oven off, and this setup will gently warm and allow the dough to rise.
Divide the dough into 5 equally-sized balls.
Sprinkle sugar on a board, put a dough ball on the board, and roll out into a circle about 12 inches across.
Flip the dough over and put more sugar on the board. Cut like a pizza into wedges about 1½ inches at the widest. Put about 1 tsp filling on each wedge and roll in sugar.
Bake on a cookie sheet at 325°F for 15 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: African Cabbage Stew
recipes.description: A delicious and nutritious stew that is very easy to prepare.

steps.text: Heat the avocado oil in a large saucepan over a medium heat.
Add the neatly chopped onions and cook until tender for about 2 minutes.
Stir in the garlic and celery and cook until fragrant.
Add the cabbage, potatoes, carrots, Italian seasonings, onion powder, garlic powder, bouillon cubes, smoked paprika, and water. Cover the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat and let simmer for about 20 minutes.
Check the seasonings and adjust where necessary.
Remove and serve warm with any complimentary dish of your choice.

recipes.title: Century Egg with Ham and Ginger
recipes.description: A Chinese dish of century eggs served with Jinhua ham and pickled stem ginger, with dark vinegar for dipping.

ingredients.text: *1 small bowl of dark vinegar (use for dipping)
ingredients.name: ocet ciemny

steps.text: Wash century eggs clean.
Shell the eggs, and cut each into 4 slices.
Cut the pickled stem ginger into thin slices.
Cut the Jinhua ham into thin slices.
Soak the Jinhua ham in water for a while.
Sandwich a slice of ginger with one of ham and a sliced century egg.
Serve with vinegar.

recipes.title: Rugbrødslagkage
recipes.description: Rye bread layer cake with whipped cream and layers of grated rye bread. Layered cakes of this type are eaten at birthday parties in Denmark.

ingredients.text: 125 g dark rye bread without sunflower seeds etc.
ingredients.name: chleb żytni
ingredients.note: dark rye bread without sunflower seeds etc.

steps.text: Leave a couple of slices of unwrapped rye bread to dry outside of the fridge.
Grate the now-dry rye bread.
Turn on oven at 220°C (or 200°C for convection ovens).
Separate the eggs and whip the egg whites to stiff peaks.
In a separate bowl, whip the egg yolk with sugar, cocoa, potato flour, baking powder, and grated rye bread. Carefully fold in the beaten whites with a spoon.

Spread the batter 1 cm thick on buttered baking paper in a cake form. The dough should be enough for 4 or 5 layers. Bake for 10 minutes at 220°C. Only in case of convection oven, more layers can be baked above each other.
Let the layers cool completely.
Whip two-thirds of the cream, and spread it between the layers. Cover and chill in the fridge overnight.
Cover top and sides with whipped cream.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock
Recipes using vegetable broth and stock

recipes.title: Tuscan Mushroom Risotto
recipes.description: Risotto z grzybami porcini i białymi pieczarkami, z masłem, parmezanem i śmietanką.

ingredients.text: 5 cups chicken broth or vegetable broth
ingredients.name: bulion drobiowy lub warzywny

ingredients.text: 1 cup choice of Parmesan, Romano cheese, or Asiago cheese
ingredients.name: ser parmezan, romano lub asiago
ingredients.note: choice of Parmesan, Romano or Asiago

ingredients.text: Salt and freshly ground pepper to taste
ingredients.name: sól

steps.text: Keep broth heated in a medium-size saucepan.
On medium heat in a large pan combine butter, garlic or garlic oil, shallots, mushrooms, and rice.
Heat for about 2 minutes, stirring well.
Add white wine and let simmer on low for 2 minutes.
With lid off, add chicken or vegetable broth, add cream, and let simmer on low until liquid is absorbed, approximately 25 minutes, stirring regularly.
Add cheese of choice and salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with parsley and grated choice.

recipes.title: Onion Dip
recipes.description: Sour cream and onion dip with a richer, fresher flavor, served with potato crisps.

ingredients.text: ½ medium onion (white or yellow), minced
ingredients.name: cebula

ingredients.text: 1 instant vegetable bouillon cube (enough to make 1 cup of bouillon), crushed
ingredients.name: bulion mięsno-warzywny w proszku
ingredients.note: crushed, enough to make 1 cup of bouillon

steps.text: In a small saucepan, sweat the onion gently with a pinch of salt and pepper until it becomes transparent.
Increase the heat and sauté until the onion becomes golden-brown and forms a sticky mass.
Add the water and crushed bouillon cube, and simmer until some of the water has evaporated and the liquid is thick.
Remove the pan from the heat and add the sour cream. Stir until smooth.
Add the onion powder and taste. Add salt and pepper if desired.
Refrigerate before serving.

recipes.title: Salt Cod and Potato Casserole (Bacalhau à Gomes de Sá)
recipes.description: A Portuguese dish of salt cod and potatoes created in the 19th century by Gomes de Sá at the restaurant Restaurante Lisbonense in Porto.

steps.text: Starting the day before, soak the salt cod, refrigerated, in a container of water for 16–24 hours, changing the water 3–4 times.

Drain and rinse the cod. Place in a saucepan and fill with water to cover the fish by 1 inch (2.5 cm). Bring to a boil and then simmer for about 20 minutes until the fish flakes easily when tested with a fork.
Drain thoroughly and flake the fish coarsely, removing any skin or bones with a paring knife. Set aside.
Boil the potatoes in their skins until easily pierced with a fork or skewer but not soft. Drain, cool and peel. Slice into ¼-inch (6 mm) slices. Set aside.
In a heavy frying-pan, heat a ½ cup of olive oil over medium high heat for two minutes. Add the sliced onion and sauté for about 6–7 minutes until the onions are translucent and slightly brown.
Stir in the garlic and remove from the heat.
To assemble, lay half the potatoes in the bottom of a casserole. Cover them with half the cod and then half the onion. Repeat with the rest and drizzle the rest of the olive oil over the top.
Bake for about 20 minutes in a 400°F/200°C oven until the top is lightly browned.
Garnish with olives and hard-boiled egg slices. Sprinkle with parsley.
Serve from the casserole with a cruet of olive oil and port vinegar on the side.

recipes.title: Marshmallow Rice Squares I
recipes.description: This recipe for quick marshmallow rice squares is super-simple and requires little knowledge of cooking!

steps.text: Combine marshmallows and cereal in microwaveable bowl.
Microwave for 1–2 minutes, depending on your machine's power.
Stir to coat the cereal with marshmallow. Press into a buttered baking pan or dish.
Cut it into squares and allow it to cool and set.

recipes.title: Roasted Oysters with Madeira
recipes.description: Small live oysters roasted in their shells, served with a warm butter and Madeira sauce seasoned with salt and cayenne.

ingredients.text: salt and cayenne pepper to taste
ingredients.name: sól
ingredients.note: salt and cayenne pepper to taste

ingredients.text: salt and cayenne pepper to taste
ingredients.name: pieprz cayenne
ingredients.note: salt and cayenne pepper to taste

steps.text: Rinse the oysters in a colander and drain well.
Roast the oysters in their shells in a large pot over medium high heat until they are done and dry, but not scorched.
Remove the oysters from the shell onto a plate, without any of their liquor. Discard any oysters that failed to open.
Add the butter. When the butter has melted, add to another pan and place on low heat.
Add the Madeira, a little salt and cayenne. Serve when the Madeira is heated.

recipes.title: Baloney Sandwich
recipes.description: A very basic bologna (baloney) sandwich with brown mustard on a Kaiser bun.

steps.text: On one slice of the bun, pile the bologna slices in the shape of a Venn diagram, alternating between those on the left and those on the right, so that your Venn diagram is made of bologna that hangs off the edges of the bottom of the Kaiser bun.
Smear brown mustard on the soft part of the other half of the bun. Top sandwich with the bun.

recipes.title: Alsatian Chicken Fricassée
recipes.description: A French-Alsatian chicken dish braised in red wine with mushrooms, bacon, onions and garlic.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 180°C (350°F).
Remove the skin from the chicken. Season all the pieces.
Pour the oil into a flame-proof casserole.
Render the bacon and add the onions.
Add garlic, the mushrooms, and then the chicken. Add the wine and herbs.
Bake for about 45 minutes.
Several minutes before the end of the cooking period, add the flour mixed with the olive oil to the liquid in the casserole, and mix well, turning the chicken pieces to coat well with the sauce.
Sprinkle the chicken with chopped parsley before serving.

recipes.title: Corom Chatni (Mango Chutney with Hot Chillies)
recipes.description: Mango chutney with hot chillies, cilantro or mint, and orange or lime juice, marinated before serving.

ingredients.text: 1 fresh red or green chilli pepper, stemmed, slit lengthwise, seeded and chopped (see note)
ingredients.name: papryczka chili
ingredients.note: fresh red or green, stemmed, slit lengthwise, seeded and chopped (see note)

ingredients.text: 2–3 Tbsp fresh orange juice, or a mixture of orange and lime juice
ingredients.name: sok pomarańczowy
ingredients.note: 2–3; fresh orange juice, or a mixture of orange and lime juice

steps.text: Place the mango on one side on a work surface and make a slit in the tip across its width with a sharp knife.
Then, hold the mango upright on its stem end on the work surface, and carefully slice the flesh, with the skin attached, off one side of the stone, as close to it as possible.
Turn it the other way and cut off the flesh from the other side of the stone.
Place each mango half, skin-side down, on the work surface, and cut lines through the flesh down to the skin in a lattice pattern so that you end up with a checker-board pattern with ½-inch squares.

Grasp the mango half with both your hands, skin down and your two thumbs on the flesh and your four fingers of each hand underneath on the skin. Now turn the skin inside out by pushing the skin inwards with your four fingers of each hand while pushing the two sides downward with your two thumbs.
You will now have the inverted skin of the mango with cubes of flesh attached—cut the cubes off with a sharp knife.
Place the mango cubes in a small bowl.
Add the chilli, cilantro, cayenne, orange/lime juice and salt and mix gently with a spoon.
Leave to marinate in the refrigerator for 1–2 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Dirt Pudding
recipes.description: Deser z pudingu waniliowego i ciasteczek typu Oreo, opcjonalnie z żelkowymi robakami.

ingredients.text: 2 pkgs. (4 serving size) vanilla instant pudding
ingredients.name: budyń waniliowy

ingredients.text: 1 tub (12 oz / 320 g) frozen whipped topping, thawed
ingredients.name: bita śmietana

ingredients.text: 1 pkg (16 oz / 450 g) chocolate sandwich cookies
ingredients.name: ciastka czekoladowe

steps.text: Crush cookies in zipper-style plastic bag with a rolling pin or in food processor.
Make the pudding as directed on the package using the milk; let stand 5 minutes.
Stir 3 cups of the whipped topping and half of the crushed cookies into the pudding OR alternate layers of crushed cookies and pudding/whipped topping.
Spoon mixture it into any bowl or dish of your choice.
Sprinkle the top with the remaining crushed cookies. Refrigerate for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Bête Noire (Flourless Chocolate Cake)
recipes.description: Bête Noire is a rich flourless chocolate cake.

ingredients.text: 4 oz (120 g) bittersweet chocolate, finely chopped
ingredients.name: czekolada gorzka

ingredients.text: 8 oz (230 g) unsweetened chocolate, finely chopped
ingredients.name: czekolada gorzka

steps.text: Heat the water and sugar together until fully dissolved.
Melt butter in a large saucepan over a low heat.
Add the chopped chocolate to the melted butter, and whisk until smooth.
Whisk in the sugar syrup and allow to cool slightly.
Add the eggs and whisk until well blended.
Pour the mixture into a greased and parchment-lined 9-inch (23 cm) springform pan.
Wrap the bottom and sides of the springform in aluminum foil so that no water can seep to the cake while it is cooking in the water bath.
Cook in a bain-marie at 350°F (180°C) in an oven for 25–30 minutes.

recipes.title: Rye Bread
recipes.description: Rye bread (Danish: rugbrød) is a type of bread common to Northern Europe in many varieties, but almost unknown in the south. This version is a typical Danish example.

steps.text: Mix the salt with the rye flour in a big bowl.
Add 1.8 L of the water and mix it.
Mix in the sourdough starter. The result should be wet enough to flow very slowly.
Cover it with a cloth and let it rise for at 12–30 hours as convenient. Then add the cracked rye seeds.
If the resulting dough feels dry, add a bit of water. The result should be just dry enough to retain an approximate shape, but no drier.
Take out 300 ml of dough to act as the starter next time you make this recipe.
Butter 3 bread forms and put the dough into it, forcing it into all corners with a spoon. Then using a fork, make deep holes as close as you can all over the bread.
Let it rise for 5–10 hours, and then bake it for about 90 minutes at about 180°C.
Let the bread cool for 15 minutes, and then tip them out to cool further on a table.
The loaves can keep for about a week in a plastic bag. Do not refrigerate.

recipes.title: Garlic Lemon Dressing
recipes.description: Dressing do sałatek z czosnkiem, rozmarynem, skórką i sokiem z cytryny oraz oliwą.

ingredients.text: 1 strip lemon peel (1 x ½ inch)
ingredients.name: skórka cytrynowa

steps.text: Place the garlic and rosemary on a cutting board and lightly crush with the flat side of a heavy knife.
Put the rosemary, garlic and lemon peel in a clean bottle with a tight-fitting cap.
Pour in the oil and lemon juice. Cap the bottle and shake well.
Refrigerate and use within one week.
Shake before serving. Drizzle on steamed vegetables, or seafood, pasta, potato salad, or other salads.

recipes.title: Braai (Zambian Barbecue)
recipes.description: Traditional Zambian barbecue of marinated beef skewers grilled over medium-high heat.

ingredients.text: 2 pounds beef, cut into skewer-friendly pieces
ingredients.name: wołowina

steps.text: In a mixing bowl, combine the finely chopped onion, minced garlic, vegetable oil, lemon juice, paprika, cayenne pepper, ground cumin, ground coriander, and salt. Mix well to create a marinade.

Add the beef pieces to the marinade and toss them until they are evenly coated. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap or a lid and let the beef marinate in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour, or preferably overnight, to enhance the flavors.
If you are using wooden skewers, soak them in water for about 30 minutes to prevent them from burning during grilling.
Preheat the grill or braai stand to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated beef pieces onto the skewers, ensuring they are evenly spaced.
Place the skewers on the grill and cook the beef for about 8–10 minutes, turning occasionally, until they are charred and cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Once the beef is cooked, remove the skewers from the grill and let them rest for a few minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Smothered Okra
recipes.description: Smothered okra is an easy dish that works well as a side vegetable. It can also be added to seafood and okra gumbo as the okra base.

steps.text: Remove okra tips and heads, and slice into ¼–½ inch wide pieces.
Sauté onion, celery, and bell pepper in butter until soft over medium heat, adding garlic to sauté shortly before the onion is soft.
Add okra and tomatoes. Stir a few times to incorporate. If the mixture seems a bit dry, add a small amount of water.
Simmer over medium heat until the okra is no longer sticky and stringy. The okra will change to a darker green color.
Serve over rice or freeze to use in your next gumbo.

recipes.title: Deep Fried Chickpea Dough Curry Snacks (Pakoda)
recipes.description: Pakoda is a savoury South Indian fried snack made from gram flour, spices and onions.

ingredients.text: 1 cup (240 g) besan or gram flour
ingredients.name: mąka z ciecierzycy

ingredients.text: 2 tsp green gram flour (optional, for added crunch)
ingredients.name: mąka z fasoli mung

steps.text: Combine all the dry ingredients except the salt, peanuts, and onions. Mix well.
Add the onions, peanuts, 1 tsp oil, and salt. Mix well, then keep aside for about 10 minutes. The moisture from the onions will ooze out into the batter.

Adding a little bit of water at a time, make a dough that will form chunks but break into pieces with a little bit of pressure. The consistency should be the same as when making scones. Too much water and the pakoda will not be crunchy.
Heat oil in a heavy-bottomed cooking vessel.
Shape the dough into chunks, and deep-fry them in medium-hot oil until golden-brown and crispy. Too much turmeric might give it a darker color.
Serve hot or room temperature.

recipes.title: Cream of Mushroom Soup
recipes.description: Creamy soup made from sliced mushrooms, butter, flour, onion, bay leaves, and milk or white stock.

steps.text: Heat the butter in a heavy sauce pot or pan, add chopped onion and mushroom, and stir for few seconds until just transparent. Don't let the mushroom brown.
Add flour, and stir to make roux. Don't let it brown.
Gradually whisk in the milk or stock, and bring to boil.
Simmer the soup for 10 to 15 minutes until mushroom is cooked.
Pass the soup through a food mill or use a blender to purée it.
Add the purée of mushroom into the soup, then add enough hot milk or cream to the soup to bring it to proper consistency. Do not boil.
Season to taste, and garnish with brunoised mushroom and parsley.

recipes.title: Henry Thiele's Pancake
recipes.description: A German-style oven-finished pancake developed in the 1930s at Henry Thiele's Restaurant in Portland, Oregon, traditionally enjoyed on New Year's Day.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 500°F.
Combine milk, salt, and sugar.
Mix in flour gradually.
Mix in eggs.
For each pancake, melt 2 Tbsp butter in a pan.
Pour about 1¼ cups batter into melted butter.
While batter is frying gather up the batter in some places to make ridges.
When batter is consistency of medium scrambled eggs, put into oven for 5 minutes.
Remove from oven; flip pancake in pan; replace into oven for another 2.5 minutes.
Remove from oven; add generous amount of lemon juice and small amount maple syrup.
Roll pancake into a cigar shape.
Add lemon juice, maple syrup, and powdered sugar in that order.

recipes.title: Blue Cheese Dressing
recipes.description: Amerykański sos sałatkowy z serem pleśniowym, na bazie majonezu, kwaśnej śmietany i maślanki.

ingredients.text: 2 tbsp (30 ml) lemon juice or vinegar (cider or white wine)
ingredients.name: sok z cytryny

ingredients.text: 4 oz (115 g) any variety of blue cheese
ingredients.name: ser pleśniowy

steps.text: Combine all ingredients except the blue cheese and whisk until smooth and homogeneous.
Dice the blue cheese into approximately ½ inch (1 cm) cubes. Most blue cheese is crumbly, so you'll wind up with a lot of crumbs as well as larger chunks.
Pour the mayonnaise mixture into a serving container and stir in the cubes and crumbs of cheese.

recipes.title: Galaretka mleczno-migdałowa
recipes.description: Delikatna galaretka na bazie mleka i migdałów, zagęszczona żelatyną.

steps.text: Oba rodzaje migdałów sparzyć, obrać z łupinek, utłuc tłuczkiem w miseczce.
Rozdrobnione migdały ucierać, dodając po kilka kropli przegotowanej i ostudzonej wody.
Do gęstej masy wlać bardzo gorące mleko i cukier, nie przerywając mieszania.
Żelatynę namoczyć i rozpuścić, połączyć z mlekiem migdałowym.
Wstawić do lodówki, a gdy zacznie gęstnieć, przełożyć do pucharków.

recipes.title: Knoephla (Small Flour Dumplings)
recipes.description: Knoephla are dumplings commonly used in knoephla soup, a popular dish in the American Midwest.

ingredients.text: ½ cup (250 ml) milk or water
ingredients.name: mleko

steps.text: In a mixing bowl, combine the flour, baking powder, egg, and then the milk or water. Mix to form a firm dough that is not sticky. Add a bit more flour if needed to keep dough from being sticky or a bit more liquid if too dry.
Roll pieces of dough between the hands to the length of a pencil (6 in / 15 cm). Snip off small pieces with a knife or scissors.
Use the knoephla as specified in your given recipe.

recipes.title: Racuszki (Polish Pancakes)
recipes.description: Traditional Polish pancakes made from batter fried on a hot griddle or pan, often with apple and cinnamon.

ingredients.text: 1 L sour milk or cultured buttermilk
ingredients.name: maślanka

steps.text: In large bowl, mix the baking soda, salt, and flour together well.
Add sour milk and eggs, and mix until smooth.
Pour small ladlefuls of the mixture into a non-stick pan, one at a time OR dip slices of peeled apples in batter and put them in the pan.
Cook until the edges are dry. Turn; cook until golden.

recipes.title: Indian Beans
recipes.description: Indyjska potrawa z soczewicy i fasoli nerkowatej w pomidorach i przyprawach, wegańska i pasująca do ziemniaków lub ryżu.

steps.text: Chop and sauté the onion.
Add the tomatoes.
Add all the spices.
Add the lentils and kidney beans.
Cook everything for 20 minutes over medium heat.

recipes.title: Tomato Sauce Piquante
recipes.description: A classic piquant tomato sauce flavoured with ham, vegetables, herbs, vinegar and white wine, finished with lemon juice, sugar and butter.

ingredients.text: 6 tomatoes, cut up and strained of all their liquid
ingredients.name: pomidor
ingredients.note: cut up and strained of all their liquid

steps.text: Cut up the ham, onion, carrot, and celery very finely. Fry them in butter together with the bay leaf, thyme, clove and peppercorns.
Over this pour the vinegar, and when the liquid is all absorbed, add the Chablis and stock, then the tomatoes.
Cook this in a covered stew pan and pass it through a sieve, making sure none of the bay leaf or thyme goes through.
Mix this sauce with an equal quantity of Veloute sauce (No. 2) or Espagnole sauce (No. 1), let it boil and pass through a sieve again.
Add the castor sugar, the lemon juice, and butter.

recipes.title: Cheese Pierogi Filling
recipes.description: A filling for pierogi made from farmer's cheese, cream cheese, egg and flour.

ingredients.text: 8 oz farmer's cheese (a soft, NOT a hard cheese)
ingredients.name: twaróg
ingredients.note: a soft, NOT a hard cheese

steps.text: Mash together all of the ingredients until well mixed.

recipes.title: Madras Filter Coffee
recipes.description: Traditional Madras filter coffee made with instant coffee containing chicory, water and hot milk.

ingredients.text: ½–2 tsp instant coffee with chicory root
ingredients.name: kawa rozpuszczalna z cykorią

steps.text: Bring the water to a boil, and stir in the coffee. Ensure there are no lumps.
Bring the milk to a boil.
Add the coffee mixture to the milk, and sweeten with sugar to taste.
While the coffee is still boiling hot, pour it into a mug or, preferably, a stainless steel tumbler.
While pouring the coffee, slowly raise the saucepan so the coffee falls into the mug from a height of about 1–1½ ft. This will cause the coffee to froth like espresso.
If desired, you can dip a teaspoon in the coffee and lightly spread a few drops of it over the froth in the mug.
Serve piping hot.

recipes.title: Barbecue Sauce (Sweet)
recipes.description: A sweet barbecue sauce made from ketchup, cider vinegar, mustard, Worcestershire sauce and brown sugar, used for chicken or pork.

ingredients.text: Garlic powder or minced garlic to taste (optional)
ingredients.name: czosnek granulowany
ingredients.note: garlic powder or minced garlic, optional

steps.text: Combine all ingredients together and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 10 to 15 minutes, until it thickens slightly.
Arrange chicken pieces or pork chops in a greased baking dish.
Pour half of sauce over and bake at 350°F (175°C) for 30 to 40 minutes.
Pour remaining sauce over before serving.

recipes.title: Sauerkraut I
recipes.description: Tradycyjna fermentowana kiszona kapusta z kapusty, z żywymi bakteriami. Nie wymaga gotowania.

steps.text: Clean and dry a large (3 litres) preserves jar or crock, chopping board, and large bowls if needed.
Quarter the cabbage and remove the core.
Slice the cabbage finely or thickly, as you prefer.
If desired, bruise the sliced cabbage by beating with a rolling pin or mortar and pestle.
Layer the cabbage in the jar or crock, sprinkling salt in between the layers.
Pack tightly into the jar, leaving 1 cm space at the top; don't seal the jar yet.
Juice should rise to top of jar as you tightly pack the cabbage in; if not, add a little chlorine-free water.

Cover the jar with a clean cloth or cling-wrap. Set the jar in a bowl or on a plate, so that any juice that might overflow will be collected and won't make a mess. Don't seal the jar while it is fermenting, as it will build up gas pressure and might break the jar.

Every morning and evening, insert a narrow long object into the jar to let the air out, then collect the juice from the plate and re-add it to the jar. Ensure the temperature is kept constant during the fermentation—otherwise the fermentation may not proceed correctly, and the wrong bacteria may grow. If you don't heat your kitchen in winter then you will need to store the jar in your bedroom or another area with a steadier temperature throughout day and night.

The sauerkraut will be fermented in three days to about a week. Wipe any excess liquid from around the jar, and put the lid on tightly before moving it to a cool place (e.g. the refrigerator) to mature. It is ready to eat after the first week, but it will improve with age as the bacteria slowly consume the more complex sugars in the cabbage.

recipes.title: Cookbook:40 Cloves in a Roast Chicken
recipes.description: Pieczony kurczak z czterdziestoma ząbkami czosnku, cytryną i ziołami.

ingredients.text: ¼ cup Country Roast Chicken Seasoning
ingredients.name: przyprawa do pieczonego kurczaka

steps.text: Rub the Country Roast Chicken Seasoning under the skin of the chicken.
Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Tie the chicken's legs together and wing tips under the back with butcher's twine.
Heat garlic in a microwave on low for 6 minutes.
Work quickly. If using a bag, place garlic in and stuff it in the cavity. If not, just stuff it in.
Coat chicken with olive oil. Place herbs in the bottom of a roasting pan and put lemon slices on top.
Put chicken breast side up on top and bake in an oven for 45 minutes at 375°F (190°C).
Turn the temperature up to 425°F (220°C) and bake for 45 more minutes or until the internal temperature in both the thigh and breast reaches 165°F (75°C) and the juices run clear.
Let rest for 10 minutes and serve.

recipes.title: Albanian Vegetable Pie
recipes.description: Albanian vegetable pie (Byrek Shqipëtar me perime) made of thin filo layers filled with spinach, feta, green onions and egg.

ingredients.text: 1 cup (240 ml) oil, preferably olive oil
ingredients.name: oliwa z oliwek

ingredients.text: 1½ packets (or about 30 ea.) filo pastry leaves
ingredients.name: ciasto filo

ingredients.text: ½ cup (120 ml) chopped green onions
ingredients.name: szczypiorek

steps.text: Brush a medium-sized baking pan with some of the oil, and start layering the pastry leaves inside. First, lay two leaves, sprinkle or brush with oil, then lay two more leaves, and repeat the procedure until half of the leaves are in place. Make sure that they cover the pan by hanging them about one inch over the edges of the pan.

Sprinkle spinach with salt, then mix well by hand. Add the feta cheese, oil, onions, eggs and salt, and spread this mixture over the already laid pastry leaves. Finish by covering the spinach with the rest of the pastry leaves, repeating the first-half procedure.
Roll the hanging edges of the bottom leaves over the pie (think of a pizza crust).
Sprinkle top with oil and bake moderately at 350°F (175°C) for about 45 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve hot, accompanied with buttermilk, or beaten yogurt, thinned down in cold water or with chilled stewed prunes. Sometimes a green salad adds to the meal!

recipes.title: Snickerdoodles (Idaho Daily Statesman)
recipes.description: Szybko przygotowywane małe ciasteczka, przepis z gazety z 1901 roku.

steps.text: Stir together sugar and butter until creamy.
Add eggs.
Dissolve baking soda in milk, then add.
Add flour, cream of tartar and salt.
Beat the batter thoroughly.
Pour in shallow pans.
Dust the top of the cake with cinnamon and sugar.
Bake for 15 minutes.
Cool, then cut in squares.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Spanish Rice
recipes.description: Tex-Mex style rice cooked in chicken broth with chorizo, chiles and herbs.

ingredients.text: ¼ cup fresh cilantro, finely chopped (optional)
ingredients.name: kolendra świeża

ingredients.text: ½ cup shredded cooked chicken or pork
ingredients.name: kurczak gotowany lub wieprzowina gotowana

ingredients.text: ¼ cup minced chorizo, casing removed
ingredients.name: chorizo

steps.text: Melt butter in a large pot over medium high heat. Add onion, chiles, garlic, meats, and rice, and cook until chorizo and rice are golden brown.
Add broth and bay leaves. Bring to a boil and cook until liquid has evaporated and rice is tender.
Sprinkle with cilantro before serving, if desired.

recipes.title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
recipes.description: Zapiekanka z tuńczykiem i makaronem w sosie śmietanowo-grzybowym, z tartą bułką i serem na wierzchu.

ingredients.text: 2 cans (drained) or pouches (12 ounces each) tuna
ingredients.name: tuńczyk

ingredients.text: 4 cups hot, cooked medium egg noodles
ingredients.name: makaron jajeczny

ingredients.text: 2 cans (21 ounces) condensed cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.name: zupa krem z pieczarek

ingredients.text: ¼–1 teaspoon Texas Pete or other hot sauce (optional)
ingredients.name: sos ostry

ingredients.text: 3–4 ounces cheese, shredded or sliced to cover casserole
ingredients.name: ser
ingredients.note: shredded or sliced to cover casserole, 3–4 ounces

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Shred tuna and stir into 3-quart casserole with milk, noodles, peas, and soup.
Add onions and hot sauce if desired.
Bake until hot, about 25–30 minutes.
Remove from oven, and top with bread crumbs mixed with butter or with cheese.
Bake another 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Faten Wake (Hausa Bean Porridge)
recipes.description: Faten wake is a traditional Hausa bean porridge from Northern Nigeria. This hearty and nutritious dish is made with soft-cooked beans, vegetables, and spices, and it is typically served as a main meal for lunch or dinner.

ingredients.text: 2 cups dried beans (black-eyed peas or brown beans)
ingredients.name: fasola czarna (sucha)

ingredients.text: 1–2 Scotch bonnet chiles or chile powder to taste
ingredients.name: papryczka chili
ingredients.note: 1–2 Scotch bonnet chiles or chile powder, to taste

ingredients.text: 1–2 tablespoons groundnut oil or palm oil
ingredients.name: olej arachidowy

ingredients.text: 1 small bunch of leafy greens, such as spinach, sorrel, ugu, amaranth, or bitterleaf, chopped (optional)
ingredients.name: szpinak
ingredients.note: small; optional; such as spinach, sorrel, ugu, amaranth, or bitterleaf, chopped

steps.text: Rinse the beans thoroughly, removing any dirt or stones.
Place the beans in a pot, cover with enough water, and simmer over medium heat until soft and the water is almost absorbed (about 40–60 minutes).
Add chopped onions, tomatoes, chile, and oil to the cooked beans. Stir and allow to simmer for 10–15 minutes, until the mixture thickens and the flavors combine.
Stir in chopped leafy vegetables, ground crayfish, seasoning cubes, and salt. Continue cooking for another 5–10 minutes, stirring occasionally until the porridge thickens and is well blended.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Dump Cake
recipes.description: A fast and easy cake to make.

ingredients.text: 1 can (20 ounces) crushed pineapple with juice, undrained
ingredients.name: ananas z puszki (w soku)

steps.text: Preheat Dutch oven in a 350°F oven. Grease the Dutch oven.
Dump in pineapple with juice and spread evenly.
Dump in pie filling and spread evenly over the pineapple.
Sprinkle cake mix evenly over cherry layer.
Dot with butter.
Bake about 50 minutes at 350°F.
Sprinkle chopped pecans on top.

recipes.title: Tod Mun (Thai Fish Cakes)
recipes.description: Thai fish cakes sold as a popular street snack, also good as an appetizer at home.

ingredients.text: ½ cup (120 ml) vegetable oil (for frying)
ingredients.name: olej roślinny

ingredients.text: 360 grams (about ¾ lb) ground fish or fish paste (pla kuud)
ingredients.name: ryba mielona
ingredients.note: about ¾ lb; ground fish or fish paste (pla kuud)

steps.text: Stack the lime leaves and roll them together into a tube shape. Slice them into thin strips.
Slice the green beans into small (½ inch) pieces.
Mince the fish.
Mix all the ingredients except the green beans and lime leaves in a bowl.
Stir until the mixture is smooth.
Add the green beans and lime leaves to the mixture and stir again.
Add the oil to a frying pan and heat to a medium temperature.
Drop a tablespoon of the mixture into the pan and flatten slightly. When the bottom is cooked, turn over.
When cooked on both sides, place on a paper towel to drain any extra oil. Continue with the rest of the mixture.

recipes.title: Raspberry Filled Pastry Strips (Alexandertorte)
recipes.description: Alexandertorte or Aleksander torte is a layered pastry filled with fruit preserves.

ingredients.text: ½ lb (225 g) unsalted butter, chilled and cut into small pieces
ingredients.name: masło
ingredients.note: unsalted, chilled and cut into small pieces

steps.text: In a large mixing bowl, combine the chilled butter, 3 cups of the flour, and the sugar. With your fingertips, rub until the mixture resembles flakes of coarse meal.
Beat in the egg and continue to mix until the pastry is smooth. Shape it into a ball, wrap it in wax paper, and refrigerate 1 hour, or until the dough is firm.

With the back of a spoon, rub the preserves through a fine sieve set over a 1-quart saucepan, then cook over moderate heat, stirring constantly, for 3–5 minutes, or until they thicken into a thin purée. Set aside off the heat.
Preheat the oven to 250°F (120°C).

Cut the chilled pastry in half and shape each half into a rectangle. One half at a time, roll the pastry between two sheets of lightly floured wax paper into a rectangle approximately 10 inches wide and 15 inches long.

With a pastry brush, coat each of 2 cookie sheets with 1 tablespoon of butter and sprinkle them with flour, tipping the sheets from side to side to coat them evenly. Then invert the sheets and tap them against a hard surface to dislodge any excess flour.
Peel off the top sheets of wax paper and use the bottom ones to lift the 2 rectangles of pastry onto the 2 cookie sheets. Peel off the remaining sheets of wax paper.
Bake 40 minutes, or until the pastry begins to turn a pale gold. Watch carefully for any sign of burning and regulate the heat accordingly. Let cool.
With a metal spatula, spread the raspberry purée evenly over one sheet of the pastry, covering it completely and smoothly. Slide the second sheet of pastry gently onto the first.

With a spoon, stir the confectioner's sugar, water and lemon juice together in a large mixing bowl to form a thin icing. Spread the icing over the top layer of pastry with the spatula, and set the cake aside to cool to room temperature.
With a small, sharp knife or pastry wheel, slice the Aleksander Torte into strips 1 inch wide and 2 inches long, cutting the ends on the diagonal.

recipes.title: Date Nut Bars
recipes.description: Kruche batoniki z orzechami i daktylami, polane lukrem cytrynowym.

steps.text: Grind the nuts and dates; sift in the granular sugar.
In another bowl, whip egg whites until stiff.
Gradually add the sugar mixture, whipping constantly. Fold in the cream.
Sift the flour, then re-sift the flour with the baking powder. Fold into the egg mixture.
Grease and flour a baking sheet.
Pat dough ½-inch thick on the baking sheet, and bake for 10 minutes at 350°F (175°C).
Mix confectioner's sugar with lemon juice and vanilla in a blender.
When the cookies are still hot, spread the glaze over them.

recipes.title: Chicken Fried Rice
recipes.description: Fried rice with minced chicken, carrot, garlic and chilli, seasoned with oyster sauce and Worcestershire sauce.

ingredients.text: 2 red chiles, cut into 1 cm pieces
ingredients.name: papryczka chili

steps.text: Melt the butter in a non-stick pan. Fry the garlic, chilli, and scallion, stirring, for 15 seconds.
Add the chicken and carrot. Cook until the chicken changes color from pink to white.
Add the rice, then the oyster sauce, Worcestershire sauce, salt, and pepper. Continue to cook until well-combined.
Serve hot with the sides.

recipes.title: Hoppin John
recipes.description: Amerykańska potrawa z ryżem, czarnookimi grochami i boczkiem, podawana jako dodatek.

ingredients.text: 2 packs long grain rice (3–4 cups cooked)
ingredients.name: ryż długoziarnisty

ingredients.text: 3 jalapeños, seeded and diced (about ½ cup)
ingredients.name: jalapeño

steps.text: Brown bacon in large Dutch oven, remove, and reserve 2 tablespoons of grease in pan.
Add onion, celery, and bell pepper, and sauté 5 minutes.
Add rice and seasoning packet, water, and black-eyed peas; cover and simmer 25 minutes.
Add bacon and jalapeños, cover and heat 5–10 minutes more.

recipes.title: Light Fluffy Pancakes
recipes.description: Lekko puszyste placuszki na maślance i mleku, smażone na patelni z olejem roślinnym.

steps.text: Heat a large non-stick skillet or griddle over low heat while preparing ingredients.
Mix flour, sugar, salt, baking powder, and baking soda in medium bowl.
Microwave buttermilk and milk in a 2-cup Pyrex measuring cup until room temperature (20–30 seconds).
Whisk in egg, butter, and vanilla.
Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients and whisk until just mixed.
Return batter to measuring cup, stirring in 1–2 teaspoons water if necessary to make a thick but pourable batter.
Increase heat to medium and generously brush skillet or griddle with oil.
When oil starts to spider, but before it starts to smoke, ladle in batter about ¼ cup at a time to make pancakes. Work in batches, if necessary, to avoid overcrowding.
When pancake bottoms are golden brown and tops start to bubble (2–3 minutes), flip pancakes.
Cook until pancakes are golden brown on remaining side.
Repeat, brushing skillet or griddle with oil between batches of pancakes.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Calzone
recipes.description: Calzone to popularna włoska forma pizzy, zawinięta jak skarpeta, z nadzieniem z sera ricotta i mozzarelli.

ingredients.text: 4 ounces (115 g) any topping (such as ham, bacon, salami, pepperoni, and/or sausage) (optional)
ingredients.name: dodatek (np. szynka, boczek, salami, pepperoni, kiełbasa)
ingredients.note: any topping (such as ham, bacon, salami, pepperoni, and/or sausage) (optional)

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Combine ricotta, mozzarella, toppings, and oregano.
Roll the pizza dough between 2 pieces of waxed paper.
Spoon the cheese mixture into the center of the dough.
Moisten edges of dough slightly. Fold the dough over, and seal edges by pressing with a fork.
Bake until golden brown, about 10 or 12 minutes.
Serve with marinara sauce.

recipes.title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
recipes.description: A moist chocolate cake with grated zucchini, cinnamon and cloves, topped with walnuts and chocolate chips. It can be frozen for up to 6 months.

steps.text: Cream together butter, vegetable oil and sugar.
Add eggs, sour milk, and vanilla. Blend well.
In a separate bowl, sift dry ingredients together.
Blend dry ingredients into the butter mixture.
Add grated zucchini, and mix well.
Spread in a greased floured 9 x 13-inch (23 x 33 cm) pan. Sprinkle walnuts and chocolate chips on top.
Bake in a preheated 325°F (165°C) oven for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Phulourie (Split Pea Fritters)
recipes.description: A side dish eaten with spicy dhaal or a sour mango-style chutney.

ingredients.text: ½ pt split peas, or 1 lb ground split pea flour
ingredients.name: groch łuskany
ingredients.note: or 1 lb ground split pea flour

steps.text: If using whole split peas, soak overnight in lightly salted cold water. Drain and grind finely using a mill or food processor.
Mix all the ingredients, adding enough water to make a dropping consistency.
Drop dollops of batter into hot oil, squishing through thumb and forefinger to make balls about ¾ inch in diameter.
Fry until golden brown, remove from oil, and drain on brown paper or kitchen towel.

recipes.title: Zupa czekoladowa
recipes.description: Deser z biszkoptów moczonych w mleku z brandy, zalanych masą czekoladową i udekorowanych bitą śmietaną z migdałami.

steps.text: Oddzielić żółtka od białek.
Żółtka wymieszać z cukrem, białka ubić na sztywną pianę.
Na małym ogniu rozpuścić czekoladę z masłem.
Dodać krem z żółtek, następnie białka i wymieszać, aż powstanie masa o konsystencji gęstego kremu.
Biszkopty zmoczyć w mleku wymieszanym z brandy i ułożyć na dnie miseczek.
Zalać biszkopty masą czekoladową i odstawić do lodówki na dwie godziny.
Śmietanę ubić na sztywną pianę.
Szprycką udekorować masę i ozdobić pokrojonymi w plasterki migdałami.

recipes.title: Semolina Pudding
recipes.description: Semolina pudding is a simple but tasty dessert that can be prepared quickly with just a few ingredients.

ingredients.text: 125 g (¼ liter) of soft wheat semolina flour
ingredients.name: semolina pszenna

ingredients.text: 30 g of butter or 1 tbsp of nutty-tasting cold-pressed cooking oil (hazelnut oil, walnut oil, poppy seed oil, rapeseed oil)
ingredients.name: masło
ingredients.note: or 1 tbsp of nutty-tasting cold-pressed cooking oil

ingredients.text: 1 egg white, whipped to soft peaks
ingredients.name: białko jaja

steps.text: Bring the milk, salt, lemon zest, and grated cinnamon to a boil in a large saucepan.
Stir in the semolina. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until the swollen (this happens very quickly).
Stir in the sugar, vanilla sugar, and butter.
Remove the porridge from the heat.
If desired, stir in whisked egg yolk and/or fold in whipped egg whites.
Serve.

recipes.title: Coconut Chutney (North Indian)
recipes.description: Coconut chutney served as an accompaniment to many South Indian dishes, such as dosa and idli. This is a North Indian variant.

steps.text: Grind all ingredients well in a blender.
Serve within 2 days.

images: Chinese fried rice by stu spivack in Cleveland, OH.jpg

recipes.title: Yeung Chow Fried Rice
recipes.description: Smażony ryż w stylu Yeung Chow z boczkiem, krewetkami, char siu i jajkiem.

ingredients.text: ¼ cup (50 g) Char siu (barbecued pork), diced
ingredients.name: char siu (wieprzowina pieczona)

steps.text: Heat the oil in a non-stick skillet, and fry the garlic until golden brown.
Add the bacon, prawn, and char siu, then cook slightly for 5 minutes.
Add the scallion, peas, and egg, and cook until all cooked.
Stir in the rice, salt, pepper and jalapeno.

recipes.title: Marinated Cucumbers and Onions
recipes.description: A light, cooling salad or side dish for hot summer months.

steps.text: Mix vinegar, oil, salt and sugar for the marinade.
Trim the ends from the cucumbers, peel them, and slice them.
Peel the onion and slice it as thinly as possible.
Pour the marinade over the cucumbers and onions and mix well.
Let it sit in a cool place or refrigerator for at least two hours, stirring occasionally.
Serve in a bowl, marinade and all, using salad tongs or a slotted spoon to dish out servings.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Microwave Risotto
recipes.description: Microwave risotto is made using the microwave. It requires very little stirring and turns out quite well.

ingredients.text: 3 cups (750 ml/1.6 pints) simmering hot chicken broth
ingredients.name: bulion drobiowy

ingredients.text: 1 dash ground white or black pepper
ingredients.name: pieprz czarny mielony

ingredients.text: ½ cup (90 g/3.2 oz) minced yellow onion
ingredients.name: cebula

ingredients.text: 1 cup (125 g/4.4 oz) uncooked medium grain rice
ingredients.name: ryż do sushi / okrągłoziarnisty

steps.text: In a saucepan, bring chicken broth, salt and pepper to a low simmer, and keep warm until needed.
In an oven-proof dish (or 10-inch/25 cm quiche dish), heat oil and butter in microwave for 2 minutes.
Add minced onion to the dish, stir to coat with oil, and cook in microwave for 4 minutes.
Add uncooked rice to the dish, stir to coat with oil, and cook in microwave for another 4 minutes.
Pour simmering chicken broth into the dish and stir well. Microwave 9 minutes.
Stir rice and chicken broth well and microwave another 9 minutes.
If a creamier risotto is desired, add ¼ cup (60 ml) warm water, stir well and microwave for another 2 minutes.

recipes.title: Dole Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
recipes.description: The original Dole-brand pineapple upside-down cake.

ingredients.text: 1 large can (~397 g / 14 oz) crushed or sliced pineapple
ingredients.name: ananas z puszki
ingredients.note: large, ~397 g / 14 oz, crushed or sliced

ingredients.text: ⅔ cup (160 g / 5.6 oz) butter or butter substitute
ingredients.name: masło

ingredients.text: 1 cup (225 g / 7.9 oz) white granulated sugar
ingredients.name: cukier

ingredients.text: ½ cup (125 ml / 4.2 fl oz) milk
ingredients.name: mleko

steps.text: Drain the juice from the can of pineapple.
Sift flour into a mixing bowl. Sift again with baking powder and salt.
Cream ½ cup (125 g / 4.4 oz) butter in another bowl, then gradually add sugar; cream well.
Beat the yolks and whites of eggs separately. Add the yolks to creamed mixture and mix well, then add flour and milk alternately, mixing well.
Fold in the egg whites and vanilla.
Melt the rest of butter in large frying pan.
Spread the brown sugar over the pan.
Add pineapple. If sliced is used, place slices closely together on the sugar; if crushed, simply pour in the well-drained fruit.
Pour cake batter over fruit.
Bake 45 minutes at 350 F.
Turn upside-down on serving dish and garnish with maraschino cherries.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Bake
recipes.description: Zapiekanka z makaronem spaghetti, mięsem mielonym w sosie pomidorowym i serowym nadzieniem.

ingredients.text: 1 pound (450 g) ground turkey or beef
ingredients.name: mięso mielone indycze lub wołowe

ingredients.text: 1 box (16 oz . 500 g) of spaghetti noodles
ingredients.name: makaron spaghetti

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C).
Sauté ground meat with onion.
When cooked through, mix in spaghetti sauce and seasoning.
Combine cream cheese, cottage cheese, and sour cream; mix well.
Cook spaghetti noodles according to package directions.
Spray 3-quart baking dish with cooking spray.
Layer half the spaghetti noodles on the bottom of the dish.
Spoon cheese mixture on top of noodles.
Layer remaining noodles on top of cheese mixture.
Spread meat mixture on top of second noodle layer.
Mix bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese and sprinkle on top.
Bake 30 minutes until bubbly and heated through.

recipes.title: Dutch Oven Beans
recipes.description: Fasola z boczkiem, mieloną wołowiną i cebulą, zapiekana w holenderskim garnku, w stylu biwakowym.

ingredients.text: 1 large can (53 ounces) pork and beans
ingredients.name: fasola w sosie pomidorowym z wieprzowiną

steps.text: Cut bacon into bite-sized pieces and begin cooking in heated Dutch oven.
Chop onion into ½-inch pieces.
When bacon is nearly cooked, crumble ground beef and chopped onion into Dutch oven. Cook until onion is translucent.
Add all the beans, ketchup, brown sugar, mustard, molasses, and Worcestershire sauce. Stir mixture.
Heat to a simmer and let bubble lightly for 10 or 15 minutes or as long as you can stand it.
Stir in liquid smoke.
Taste and adjust with additional ketchup, brown sugar, mustard, molasses, and Liquid Smoke or whatever it takes.

recipes.title: Chuck Wagon Beans
recipes.description: Fasola z boczkiem i mieloną wołowiną, zapiekana w piekarniku z brązowym cukrem, melasą i musztardą.

ingredients.text: ½ pound bacon, cut into bite-sized pieces
ingredients.name: boczek wieprzowy surowy

steps.text: Brown bacon, ground chuck, and onion.
Stir in remaining ingredients in order; mix well in between each addition.
Bake at 350°F for about 40 minutes, or until thickened.

recipes.title: Homemade Mixed Spice
recipes.description: A typical blend of sweet spices used for baking, desserts and fruit, common in British cuisine.

steps.text: Blend all spices together, and store in a sealed jar away from light.

recipes.title: Vorschmack (Finnish Ground Meat)
recipes.description: Finnish baked meat dish of lamb, beef, herring and anchovy, served hot with baked potatoes and sour cream.

ingredients.text: 4 lb (1800 g) boned leg of lamb, cut into 1-inch (2.5 cm) cubes
ingredients.name: udziec jagnięcy

ingredients.text: ½ lb (225 g) boned beef, diced
ingredients.name: wołowina

steps.text: Let the herring fillets soak in cold water over night.
Dry the fillets on paper towels.
Preheat the oven to 400°F (220°C).
Arrange the meat and onion in a greased baking dish and roast on the medium shelf until golden brown (about 15–20 minutes).
Let the dish cool, and then grind the contents with the herring and anchovy using a meat grinder.
In a large bowl, add some water to the mixture to give it the consistency of thick porridge.
Season with white pepper and garlic.
Place the contents in a baking dish.
Spread out some tomato paste over the surface of the mixture.
Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 2 hours. Add water if the Vorschmack looks dry.
If the consistency is too light, continue baking to evaporate excess water. The consistency should resemble thick hot porridge.
Serve hot with baked potatoes, smetana, and a shot of ice cold vodka, filled to the rim.

images: Vendedor de camotes - Ciudad de México..jpg

recipes.title: Camotes Enmielados (Mexican Sweet Yams)
recipes.description: Baked or stovetop Mexican yam or sweet potato dessert in a dark, syrupy sauce of piloncillo, water and cinnamon.

ingredients.text: 1 large yam or sweet potato, optionally peeled
ingredients.name: batat

steps.text: Place whole or thickly-sliced yams in a large baking dish.
Place piloncilo cone atop the yams, then add water and cinnamon.
Cover dish, and bake for about 60 minutes, basting the yams with the now sweetened cooking liquid as needed.

categories: Recipes using beef broth and stock

recipes.title: Bulgarian Tripe Soup (Shkembe Chorba)
recipes.description: Shkembe chorba is a popular meat dish in Bulgarian cuisine.

ingredients.text: 1 ea. bell pepper, cut into thin-strips
ingredients.name: papryka

steps.text: Combine onion, red pepper, butter in large saucepan.
Sprinkle flour over onion mixture, then stir in the tomato paste.
Cut tripe into thin strips.
Add tripe pieces, stock, salt, marjoram and bay leaf to onion mixture.
Partially cover the pot and simmer 30 minutes.
Remove and discard bay leaf.
Pour soup into a tureen or serve in individual bowls.
In a small bowl, combine parsley, garlic and cheese. Sprinkle over hot soup and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Maitorieska (Finnish Barley Flatbread)
recipes.description: Maitorieska (milk rieska) is a barley-based flatbread that is a local specialty and a very traditional food in the Ylivieska area of Finland.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 300°C (570°F), or as high as it will go.
Combine milk and salt, and add flour. Mix the ingredients well to make a dough.
Knead into a flat, round bread (about 0.5 cm / ¼ inch thick).
Bake on an oven tray for about 10 minutes or until the surface gets some darker spots.
Alternatively, fry it in a pan on the stove or on open fire.
Eat fresh with butter and cold milk.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad with Orange Soda (Ensalada de Fruta)
recipes.description: A refreshing fruit salad dessert, traditionally served at Christmas in Uruguay and throughout the summer, made with fresh and canned fruit and chilled orange soda.

ingredients.text: 1 can (150 g) pineapple pieces (in natural juice)
ingredients.name: ananas z puszki w soku

ingredients.text: 1.25 L (or less) Fanta orange soda, chilled
ingredients.name: napój pomarańczowy gazowany

steps.text: Place canned fruit in a large bowl along with its juice, making sure you cut the peaches into small pieces.
Wash remaining fruit thoroughly.
Place cherries and grapes (minus stalks and any leaves) in the bowl.
Cut up remaining fruit into small pieces, place in the bowl, and chill.
Prior to serving, mix lightly and cover with chilled Fanta.
Serve with a slotted spoon for a lovely summer dessert, especially during the holidays when we need a stomach cool down after a heavy meal.

recipes.title: Maple Syrup Planked Salmon
recipes.description: Maple syrup planked salmon mixes the hint of sweetness from the maple syrup with the rich smoky flavour imparted from the cedar plank.

ingredients.text: 4 salmon steaks or individual fillets (preferably wild-caught)
ingredients.name: łosoś

ingredients.text: 4 tbsp (60 ml) fresh lemon juice, divided
ingredients.name: sok z cytryny

ingredients.text: 2 tbsp (30 ml) grapeseed oil (or other neutral oil)
ingredients.name: olej winogronowy

ingredients.text: 1½ tsp (7 g) chipotle powder (chipotle barbecue sauce may be substituted for this)
ingredients.name: proszek chipotle
ingredients.note: chipotle barbecue sauce may be substituted for this

steps.text: Completely immerse cedar planks in water for several hours or overnight.
Heat grill to medium-high.
Mix 2 tablespoons (30 ml) lemon juice, the oil, rosemary, maple syrup, and half of the chipotle powder in a small bowl.
Coat the salmon with the mixture and let rest at room temperature for 20 minutes.
Mix the remaining lemon juice with the remaining chipotle powder with a fork and set aside as a garnish.
Place plank(s) on grill and close lid. Allow plank to heat for a couple minutes.
Lightly sprinkle salt on plank(s).
Put salmon on plank, keeping fish at least an inch from the edge of the plank (in the case of fillets, place skin-side down). Reduce heat to low and close lid.

Grill for roughly 15 minutes without turning or moving salmon until desired doneness is reached. Generally, salmon should be cooked until the flesh loses its transparency and the meat can easily be broken with a fork. Spray with water to douse any flames that light on the sides of the plank.
When cooked, place the salmon on a serving platter and sprinkle with the scallions.
Immerse the cedar plank in water as a safety precaution.
Serve the salmon with the optional lemon juice/chipotle sauce.

recipes.title: Crispy Santa Fe Chicken
recipes.description: A lot of crispy baked chicken recipes use things like breadcrumbs or cracker crumbs. Here, the croûtons add a little flavor.

ingredients.text: 4 ea. (28–32 ounces) boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.name: pierś z kurczaka

ingredients.text: ¾ cup grated Monterrey Jack cheese
ingredients.name: ser monterey jack

steps.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Combine butter, seasonings, and salt in a pie plate or a large wide dish.
Dip chicken into egg mixture then dredge into croûton crumbs.
Let rest 2–3 minutes.
Coat chicken pieces on olive oil then place on a greased baking pan.
Insert a probe thermometer into one of the pieces, and bake in the oven until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Sprinkle chicken pieces evenly with cheese and bake until cheese is melted. Serve warm.

recipes.title: White Bean Soup (Bob Chorba)
recipes.description: A simple vegetable soup made with white beans, carrots, celery, tomatoes, peppers and chiles, finished with fresh herbs.

steps.text: Soak the beans in cold water for 3–4 hours. Drain and cover with fresh water.
Boil the beans in an earthenware pot together with the oil, finely chopped carrots, onion and celery. Cook until the beans are tender.
Add sliced peppers, grated tomatoes and mint.
Season with salt and boil for another 15–20 minutes.
Serve sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.

recipes.title: Tuna Casserole
recipes.description: A baked casserole of tuna, cream soups, frozen vegetables and egg noodles, topped with crispy fried onions.

ingredients.text: 1 can each of cream of celery soup, cream of chicken soup, and cream of mushroom soup (substitute cream of potato if you don't like mushrooms)
ingredients.name: zupa krem z selera
ingredients.note: cream of celery soup, cream of chicken soup, and cream of mushroom soup (substitute cream of potato if you don't like mushrooms)

ingredients.text: 1 bag of frozen vegetables (peas, carrots, and corn)
ingredients.name: mieszanka warzyw mrożona

ingredients.text: 1 can of fried onion rings, 1 packet potato chips, or 1 small packet corn flakes
ingredients.name: cebula smażona
ingredients.note: fried onion rings, or 1 packet potato chips, or 1 small packet corn flakes

steps.text: Cook egg noodles as directed on package. While boiling water, preheat oven to 400°F.
Drain egg noodles. Mix together all ingredients except fried onion rings. Put in a casserole dish or a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.
Bake for 20 minutes.
Sprinkle fried onion topping on top of baked casserole.
Bake for an additional 3 minutes, or until fried onion is slightly brown.
Let cool for 5 minutes and serve.

recipes.title: Beet-Pickled Eggs
recipes.description: Eggs pickled with beets in a vinegar solution, which keeps them longer than raw eggs stored in a refrigerator.

steps.text: Place eggs in a large pot with enough water to cover them. Bring to a boil.
Boil uncovered for 12 minutes.
Drain water.
Place eggs in ice-cold water. Crack and peel off shells.
Put eggs in a pot with the remaining ingredients, except for the beets.
Mix in one can of beet juice, and set the beets aside. Discard any extra juice.
Simmer 2–3 minutes.
Add beets, and pour into a large container.
Refrigerate for one or two weeks before serving.

categories: Recipes using chile paste and sauce

recipes.title: Yogurt Curry Soup (Kadhi)
recipes.description: Kadhi, znany też jako Karhi lub Gujarati Kadhi, to słodki curry z jogurtem, zwykle podawany z rotı i sabzi w Indiach.

ingredients.name: pasta z imbiru i zielonego chili

steps.text: Combine the gram flour, curds and 3 teacups of water in a pot. Beat well.
Add the chilli-ginger paste, curry leaves, sugar, and salt. Bring to a boil.
Boil whilst stirring for a while.
Heat the ghee in a pan, add the cumin and mustard seeds, and toast until light brown. Don't let burn.
Add the asafoetida and red chilli.
Add the seasoning mixture to the curry, and boil for a few minutes.
Sprinkle coriander on top and serve hot.

recipes.title: Pulled Pork Sandwiches
recipes.description: Brined and smoked pork butt with a dry rub, shredded and served on hamburger buns.

ingredients.text: 2 tbsp cayenne pepper (more if you like)
ingredients.name: pieprz cayenne

steps.text: Combine water, salt, and honey in a 6-quart cooler. Add pork and refrigerate or place a large bag of ice on top for 8–12 hours.
Remove pork from brine and pat dry with paper towels. Combine remaining seasonings and rub on pork.
Light a few chunks of apple wood and place in the firebox of a smoker. Keep temperature in smoker around 210°F.
Place in a smoker and cook for 8–12 hours, changing wood as needed. The meat should be tender at this point—if not, continue smoking.
Let rest 1 hour, then shred with two forks. Serve on hamburger buns.

recipes.title: Spaetzle
recipes.description: Spaetzle to swabskie kluski z mąki, jajek, wody i soli, gotowane we wrzącej wodzie.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients using hands or an electrical mixer.
Add enough water to make a dough that is slightly sticky, but still elastic and stiff.
Beat long enough for bubbles to rise.
Boil a large pot with salted water.

If using only a board, sweep a spoon of dough over the kitchen board with the grater. Cut/grate small pieces of the dough with the grater into the hot water. If using a spaetzle-maker, put a spoon of dough into the maker and press through the holes into the water. The spaetzle are done when they rise and swim on the water surface.
Remove spaetzle from the water with a slotted spoon and put into a lightly oiled bowl.

recipes.title: Cola de Mono
recipes.description: Chilean spiced coffee and milk drink with brandy, served chilled.

steps.text: Mix the nutmeg, the cloves and the cinnamon in a small pot with the water. Boil the mixture for 10 minutes.
If desired, remove the spices from the water, although it is better to leave them there.
Transfer the water into a pot with a capacity of 3 liters.
Add the coffee along with some more water and sugar.
As soon as the sugar gets dissolved, add the rest of the milk and the Chilean brandy.
Bottle the Cola de Mono and put it in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: Yoda Soda
recipes.description: Yoda Soda is a fun drink that looks like Master Yoda's head.

ingredients.text: 1 cup Mountain Dew soda (or any yellowish-green soda you like)
ingredients.name: napój gazowany cytrynowo-limonkowy
ingredients.note: or any yellowish-green soda you like

steps.text: Fill glass with soda.
Add ice cream.
Drop a few chocolate sprinkles on the ice cream to look like hair.

recipes.title: Peanut Curry Sauce
recipes.description: Sos curry z orzeszkami ziemnymi i mleczkiem kokosowym, podawany jako dip lub sos do grillowanego mięsa.

steps.text: Chop or grind peanuts into a fine meal.

Heat half the coconut milk in a medium saucepan on high heat, and add red curry paste. Stir until curry paste is dissolved and then continue to heat on high for 10–12 minutes (not stirring) until the oil from the coconut milk has risen to the top.
Decrease heat to medium-high and add ground peanuts. Stir and add the rest of the coconut milk, bring to a full boil then decrease heat, and add the sugar, lemon juice and fish sauce.
Continue to cook (stirring occasionally) for 15–20 minutes, until the sauce has thickened and the oil has risen to the surface again.

Take off heat and let set for about ½ hour. Stir to blend in the oil that has risen, the sauce should be not quite as thick as peanut butter. If it seems too thick add about a teaspoon of water or coconut milk.

recipes.title: Montreal Steak Seasoning
recipes.description: A coarse spice blend for seasoning steak, made from garlic powder, coriander, salt, dill, paprika, chili flakes and black pepper.

ingredients.text: 4 teaspoons crushed red pepper flakes (or 3 teaspoons cayenne pepper)
ingredients.name: płatki chili

steps.text: Combine the ingredients, then use them to season steak.
Can be stored in an airtight container for a number of months.

recipes.title: Vegetarian Soft Tacos
recipes.description: Wegetariańskie tacos z zamiennikiem mięsa mielonego, podawane z fasolą refried i dodatkami.

ingredients.text: 1 pound ground beef substitute (e.g. MorningStar Farms Grillers Recipe Crumbles)
ingredients.name: zamiennik mięsa mielonego
ingredients.note: np. MorningStar Farms Grillers Recipe Crumbles

steps.text: In a frying pan brown onions on medium-low heat.
Add garlic, chilli powder, paprika, salt, and red pepper. Stir and cook for 1 minute.
Add beef substitute and water. Cook for 10–15 minutes until most of the water is gone.
Meanwhile chop and shred the toppings as needed. Put toppings in bowls on table.
Start to warm refried beans in a small pot.
Heat another frying pan on medium-low heat.
Put vegetarian taco meat and refried beans in bowls and place on table.
Put floured tortilla in pan and lightly brown both sides. As tortillas are ready allow guests to select their own toppings.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock
Recipes using vegetable broth and stock

recipes.title: Saka-saka (Cassava Leaf Stew)
recipes.description: West African stew of tender cassava leaves cooked with spices, meat and smoked fish.

ingredients.text: 2–3 tablespoons palm oil (substitute with vegetable oil if needed)
ingredients.name: olej palmowy
ingredients.note: substitute with vegetable oil if needed; 2–3 tablespoons

ingredients.text: 1 pound (about 500 g) meat (e.g. chicken, beef, or goat), cut into bite-sized pieces
ingredients.name: mięso
ingredients.note: e.g. chicken, beef, or goat, cut into bite-sized pieces

ingredients.text: 1–2 fresh Scotch bonnet chile peppers (adjust according to your spice preference)
ingredients.name: papryczka Scotch bonnet
ingredients.note: adjust according to your spice preference; 1–2

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon dried shrimp (optional, but adds depth of flavor)
ingredients.name: suszone krewetki
ingredients.note: optional, but adds depth of flavor

ingredients.text: 1 African smoked fish (tilapia or mackerel), deboned and flaked
ingredients.name: wędzona ryba (tilapia lub makrela)
ingredients.note: deboned and flaked; tilapia or mackerel

steps.text: Wash the cassava leaves thoroughly in a bowl of water to remove any dirt or debris. Drain and set aside.
Using a blender or food processor, blend the cassava leaves until they are finely chopped. Set aside.
Heat the palm oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and minced garlic to the pot, and sauté until they become translucent and fragrant.
Add the meat to the pot and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add the diced tomatoes, Scotch bonnet peppers, ground crayfish, and dried shrimp to the pot. Stir well to combine, then allow the mixture to cook for a few minutes until the tomatoes start to soften.
Add the blended cassava leaves to the pot, along with the flaked smoked fish. Stir everything together to ensure the leaves are well coated with the flavors.
Pour in enough chicken or vegetable broth to cover the mixture. If you prefer a thicker stew, add less broth.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and let the stew simmer for about 1–2 hours. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking and to ensure even cooking.
After the stew has simmered and the flavors have melded together, taste and adjust the seasoning with salt and pepper as desired.
Serve hot with a side of cooked rice, fufu, or plantains. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Pork Tenderloin with Asparagus and Prosciutto
recipes.description: Pork tenderloin wrapped in prosciutto, served with linguine in a cream and wine sauce with asparagus and garlic.

steps.text: Trim off any small patches of white connective tissue from the pork, as they will be tough and elastic.
Wash and slice the asparagus into small pieces, using angled cuts for improved presentation.
If you wish, you may set aside a few slices of prosciutto (chopped), as you may want to include it in the sauce.
Preheat the oven to 375°F (200°C).
Place the pork on a clean cutting board. Wrap the tenderloin with the slices of prosciutto, trying to wrap as tightly as possible so it will stay in place.

While you are doing this, also preheat an oven-safe pan to medium heat. Pour a few tablespoons of olive oil into the pan and place the pork inside. Start browning the meat on all sides. Once that is done, place the entire pan into the oven.
While you are doing this, heat up another pan (preferably a saucepan) and pour a few tablespoons of olive oil into it. Once it's heated up, toss the garlic and shallots in and sauté them lightly.
Once the garlic has been sautéed to a very light brown colour, add a small amount of olive oil and the asparagus.
When the asparagus is slightly sautéed, add about half of the cream and about a quarter of the wine.
Fill a medium-sized pot three-quarters full with salted water and set on high heat on a back burner.
Turn the tenderloin over in the pan, ensuring that the prosciutto does not fall off the meat. Sprinkle with a bit of salt and pepper.
Reduce the sauce to about half of the original volume, and pour in the rest of the cream and wine.
Turn the tenderloin over again.
Put the linguine in the boiling water and stir occasionally. You may choose to put the chopped prosciutto in at this point.
Once the sauce has reduced down again, lower the heat and remove the pork from the oven. Place it on a clean cutting board and let it sit for a few minutes.
Strain the linguine and start slicing the tenderloin into small medallions.
Place the desired amount of linguine on each plate, and place a few medallions on top. Spoon sauce over the top.

recipes.title: Bint as-Saḥn (Yemenite Layered Pastry)
recipes.description: Bint al-sahn (Arabic: بنت الصحن), or Sabayah, is a layered pastry traditionally made in Yemen, and now popular in other regions. The procedure takes a long time.

ingredients.text: ½ cup warm margarine (or melted butter)
ingredients.name: margaryna

steps.text: Combine the yeast and warm water. Stir in the warm milk.
Stir the salt, sugar, vegetable oil, and eggs into the yeast mixture.
Mix the flour and semolina into the above mixture. Knead well to make a dough.
Cover dough and let it sit until dough rises.
Divide the dough into pieces the size of your hand, and transfer to a flour-dusted surface to prevent sticking.
Work each dough ball, stretching and folding the dough over itself multiple times. This stretching and folding process helps produce an airy and light-textured dough.
Let dough balls rest for 10–15 minutes.
Prepare a flat working surface by rubbing it with some margarine. Roll out one piece of dough into a very thin round.
Brush the dough round with margarine, then lightly sprinkle with crushed almonds, pistachios, black cumin, and sesame seeds.

Roll another piece of dough into a thin round. Stack on top of the first round, then brush with margarine and sprinkle with more almonds, pistachios, etc. Repeat this step, stacking the rounds, until all the dough is used up.
Bake the stacked dough in oven. Serve with honey.

recipes.title: Indian Pudding
recipes.description: Tradycyjny amerykański pudding kukurydziany z melasą, przyprawami i jajkami, pieczony w piekarniku.

ingredients.text: 4 egg whites, whipped to stiff peaks
ingredients.name: białko jaja

steps.text: Set aside ½ cup of the milk. Boil the remaining milk.
Add cold water to cornmeal to wet it.
Slowly pour the cornmeal mixture into the boiling milk. Add salt.
Boil for 15 minutes, stirring constantly. If skin forms, remove it. Remove from heat, set aside.
In a small bowl, mix molasses with baking soda, the ½ cup cold milk, and brown sugar.
Add the spices and the beaten egg yolks to this mixture.
Slowly pour the molasses mixture into the cornmeal mixture.
Fold in the whipped egg whites.
Grease or butter a baking dish, add the batter, and bake for 1 hour at 350°F.

recipes.title: Pudding with Pistachios and Rose Water (Muhallebi)
recipes.description: Muhallebi, also called muhallabia or mihallabiya, is a milk pudding thickened with rice flour and optionally perfumed with rosewater or orange flower water.

ingredients.text: ½–1 cup white granulated sugar (or to taste)
ingredients.name: cukier

ingredients.text: ½ cup rose water or orange flower water (optional)
ingredients.name: woda różana

steps.text: Mix the milk and sugar in a large saucepan and heating slowly, so as not to burn the milk, bring to a simmer.
Make a slurry by dissolving the rice flour and cornstarch in the water and, stirring constantly, slowly add this mixture to the simmering milk.
Simmer gently for 30–40 minutes, stirring frequently, until the mixture has thickened sufficiently to coat a spoon.
Remove from the heat.
Stir in the rose water or orange flower water.
Pour into a 9x13-inch baking pan and refrigerate until chilled and set.
Cut into pieces about 4 inches square.
Place the squares on individual dessert plates and garnish with the chopped pistachios.

recipes.title: Toad in the Hole
recipes.description: A baked Yorkshire pudding or thick pastry round with sausages in it.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Bake the sausages with the oil in a roasting pan for 10 minutes.
Add batter to the hot pan. The oil should sizzle as the cold batter is added to the pan.

Bake in the oven for about 40–45 minutes. The oven door must not be opened while the batter is baking; once the crust has risen and browned, you can open the oven. The outside should be crispy and the inside should be firm.
Remove and serve hot.

recipes.title: Borhani (Spiced Yogurt Drink)
recipes.description: Borhani are yoghurt-based drinks popular in Bangladesh. It's traditionally served in wedding ceremonies around the country.

ingredients.text: ½ tsp fresh green chile peppers
ingredients.name: papryczka chili

steps.text: Dry-roast cumin seeds by cooking them over low heat in small pan until you can smell the seasoning, about 2 minutes.
Cool and grind to a powder.
Beat yoghurt with water until it becomes smooth.
Strain green chili, mint, leaf and coriander pastes with some water blend into the yoghurt.
Combine all other ingredients and mix well.
Serve cold.

recipes.title: Meatloaf V
recipes.description: Klopsik mięsny z dodatkiem ciecierzycy lub fasoli, w którym akwafaba zastępuje jajko.

ingredients.text: 1 can (400–425 g/14–15 oz) chickpeas or other beans
ingredients.name: ciecierzyca z puszki

ingredients.text: 400 g (14 oz) mixed ground beef and pork
ingredients.name: mięso mielone wołowo-wieprzowe

ingredients.text: 1 tsp Dijon or other prepared mustard
ingredients.name: musztarda

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F).
Drain the chickpeas or white beans, reserving the liquid. Mash the peas or beans to a paste.
Combine the mashed peas/beans, the liquid from the can, the meat, milk, salt, pepper, Worcestershire, garlic powder, sage, mustard, and oats in a large bowl and mix thoroughly.
Pour the mixture into an ungreased loaf pan; spread ketchup on top.
Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 1–1¼ hours.
Allow to stand for 15 minutes or so after removing it from the oven before cutting into it.

recipes.title: Okra Plantain Porridge
recipes.description: Okra plantain porridge is a typical Nigerian food prepared from unripe plantain and okra. It is easy to prepare.

ingredients.name: purée z papryczek chili i pomidorów

steps.text: Combine the plantain and water in a saucepan.
Bring to a boil, then simmer for 3–5 minutes.
Add the catfish, stock cube, onions, palm oil, okra, and ugu leaves.
Stir until a porridge is formed, then cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Season with the salt and chile-tomato. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Spicy Corn Bread
recipes.description: Spicy Texas-style cornbread with jalapeños, optionally with whole corn added to the batter.

ingredients.text: 1 tsp–¼ cup chopped jalapeños, to taste
ingredients.name: jalapeño

ingredients.text: ½ of a 15 ounce can whole corn, drained (optional)
ingredients.name: kukurydza konserwowa

steps.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Grease an 8-inch baking pan.
Combine corn meal, flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar in a large mixing bowl.
Add egg, sugar, and shortening.
Beat until fairly smooth (about 1 minute).
Bake for 20–25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. If corn is added to batter, increase time by about 50%.
Serve hot!

recipes.title: Chakalaka
recipes.description: A spicy South African vegetable relish made from beans, peppers, carrots, and tomatoes, often served as a side dish with bread, pap, or meat.

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon curry powder, or to taste
ingredients.name: curry

ingredients.text: Salt and ground black pepper to taste
ingredients.name: sól
ingredients.note: and ground black pepper to taste
