recipes.description: Sukuma wiki is a Swahili dish of cooked kale or collard greens, popular throughout several East African nations like Kenya and Tanzania. It is often served with ugali, a corn-based swallow.

ingredients.text: ½ teaspoon or more ground cayenne pepper (optional)
ingredients.name: pieprz cayenne

steps.text: Heat oil in a medium-sized pot. Add onions and garlic, and stir fry for about 2–3 minutes. Don't let burn.
Stir in the tomato, coriander, curry powder, and paprika. Cook for about 2 minutes.
Stir in the meat and bouillon powder until well-mixed. Cook for at least 5 minutes.
Add the greens, cayenne, and lemon juice. Cook, stirring, for 5–10 minutes until the greens are done.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: Peri-Peri Chicken
recipes.description: Peri-peri chicken is a mouth-watering and spicy African chicken dish. It is very easy to prepare and can be made using an oven or grill.

ingredients.text: 5 small bird's eye chillies (adjust to your taste)
ingredients.name: papryczka chili

steps.text: Blend together the red bell pepper, bird's eye chillies, garlic cloves, onion, thyme, black pepper, salt or to your taste, paprika, vinegar, lemon juice, olive oil, and bouillon cubes to make a marinade.

Pour the marinade over the chicken in a large bowl. Use your hands to massage the marinade into the chicken, then cover the bowl and leave it in the fridge for at least 1 hour and up to overnight. The longer it marinates, the better the flavor.
Arrange the chicken in a baking pan, and pour the marinade over it.
Bake in a preheated 350 °F oven for 30 minutes, basting the chicken periodically. Flip the chicken over and bake for another 30 minutes.
Turn on the broiler of your oven, and broil the chicken for about 3–5 minutes to char it.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Miyan Shuwaka (Hausa Bitter Leaf Soup)
recipes.description: Miyan shuwaka is a bitterleaf soup eaten in the northern part of Nigeria.

ingredients.text: 2 pieces fresh red chile pepper, puréed
ingredients.name: papryczka chili

steps.text: If using fresh bitter leaf, wash with salt and squeeze to reduce the bitterness.
Boil the meat in a pot of water for a few minutes until cooked through.
Remove the meat and set aside.
Heat a skillet over medium heat, and add the palm oil.
Add the onion, pepper, and tomatoes, and simmer for 5 minutes.
Combine the cooked purée, meat, and bitterleaf in a pot.
Add enough water to cover everything.
Add the daddawa, stir the soup well, and cook for 3 more minutes over low heat.
Season with salt to taste and serve.

recipes.title: Thai Green Curry Paste
recipes.description: Zielona pasta do tajskiego curry, do przygotowania w moździerzu lub w blenderze.

steps.text: Grind the green chilli peppers, garlic, lemongrass, and scallions in a mortar.
Add the remaining ingredients except for the oil, and keep grinding to a fluid paste.
Mix in the oil.
Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 1 month.

recipes.title: Pad Kra Pao Gai (Thai Basil Chicken Stir Fry)
recipes.description: A spicy Thai stir fry of minced chicken with basil, typically served with jasmine rice and a fried egg.

steps.text: Add the oil to a pan over high heat. Wait until the oil has heated up.
Once the oil is hot, add the chillis and garlic to the pan and stir fry for roughly 10 seconds.
Add the minced chicken and stir fry with a spatula.
When the chicken is nearly done, add the green beans.
Add the fish sauce, oyster sauce, and sugar. Stir fry for 2 minutes.
Turn the heat off, add basil, and stir for 5 seconds.
Serve with rice and a fried egg on top.

recipes.title: Tofu Tamale Pie
recipes.description: Zapiekanka z tofu, kukurydzą i przyprawą chili, zapiekana z serem cheddar.

ingredients.text: 4 ounces tofu, washed, drained well, and broken up
ingredients.name: tofu
ingredients.note: washed, drained well, and broken up

ingredients.text: 2 teaspoons chili powder or to taste
ingredients.name: chili w proszku

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
In non-stick skillet, add onion, celery, green pepper.
Add instant beef bouillon, tomato juice, and cook until vegetables are tender.
Add tofu, carrot, garlic salt, chili powder.
Simmer a few more minutes.
Add corn meal and mix thoroughly.
Pour into a one quart casserole and top with grated cheese.
Bake at 350°F for 20 minutes or until browned.

recipes.title: Indian Potatoes
recipes.description: This dish is extremely creamy and rich; don't expect to be able to eat much of it.

ingredients.text: 6 small potatoes, peeled and cut in half
ingredients.name: ziemniak
ingredients.note: small, peeled and cut in half

steps.text: Sauté the garlic in olive oil.
Add tomatoes. Cook for 10 minutes, until the oil and tomatoes separate (they will bubble).
Stir in the coconut milk.
Add ½ teaspoon red pepper, and salt to taste. Boil it all together.
Add the potatoes. Cook over low-medium heat until the potatoes are done. They will become fairly soft; check with a fork.

recipes.title: Pecan Blondies
recipes.description: Blondies are a type of baked bar cookie, similar to brownies but not chocolate-flavored.

ingredients.text: ½ cup (120 g) unsalted butter, melted
ingredients.name: masło

ingredients.text: 1 cup (240 g) firmly packed dark brown sugar
ingredients.name: cukier trzcinowy brązowy

steps.text: Preheat oven to 325°F (170°C).

Dry toast the chopped pecans until fragrant and slightly colored, in a dry skillet over medium-high heat while stirring frequently or by roasting them in the oven on a cookie sheet while you prepare the batter.
In a small bowl stir together the flour, baking powder, and salt. Set aside.
In a large bowl, stir the melted butter, brown sugar, and vanilla until uniform, breaking up any large lumps of sugar.
Beat in egg until creamy.
Gently fold in flour mixture. When flour is nearly incorporated, gently fold in toasted pecans. Do not overmix.
Spread mixture into buttered 8 x 8-inch (20 x 20 cm) baking dish.
Bake at 325°F (170°C) for 30 minutes or until desired doneness.
Let cool and cut into bars.

recipes.title: Sesame Noodle Salad
recipes.description: A cold pasta salad with sesame oil, cilantro, scallions and carrots, inspired by a corner bakery's recipe.

ingredients.text: 1 cup or more finely-chopped fresh cilantro
ingredients.name: kolendra świeża

steps.text: Cook angel hair pasta according to package instructions, then drain.
Add sesame oil, olive oil, and salt (to taste) to drained pasta.
Toss in cilantro, scallions, and carrots.
Chill before serving.

recipes.title: Yerushalmi Kugel (Sweet Noodle Casserole)
recipes.description: Sweet noodle casserole named after Jerusalem, traditionally made with caramelized sugar, cinnamon and raisins.

ingredients.text: 8 oz (200 g) noodles (egg noodles are preferred, but others work fine as well)
ingredients.name: makaron jajeczny
ingredients.note: egg noodles are preferred, but others work fine as well

ingredients.text: ⅔ cup (160 g) sugar (white sugar is helpful because it's more obvious when it begins to brown)
ingredients.name: cukier
ingredients.note: white sugar is helpful because it's more obvious when it begins to brown

steps.text: Boil noodles according to the package instructions and drain.
Heat the olive oil in a frying pan, and add ⅓ cup (80 g) sugar.
Stir continuously until the sugar begins to brown. Remove from heat.
The sugar will continue to brown for a few more minutes, creating a thick caramel.
Add the caramel to the noodles.
Add the sugar, eggs, cinnamon, pepper, and raisins. Stir.
Bake in a pan at 350°F (180°C) until the top begins to brown (about 40 minutes).

recipes.title: Apricot Wine
recipes.description: Domowe wino morelowe z suszonych moreli, rodzynek i cytrusów, fermentowane przez około miesiąc.

steps.text: Wash the apricots in several changes of water, then dry and cut in halves.
Place apricots in a large crock, and pour on the warm water. Reserve ½ cup of water, and dissolve the yeast cake into it.
Stir in the sugars, fruit, raisins, and ginger.
Add the dissolved yeast and mix well.
Cover with the top of the crock and let stand.
Stir every other day.
After thirty days, strain the mixture and bottle it.

recipes.title: Gurudi (Nigerian Coconut Biscuit)
recipes.description: Gurudi, also called gurundi, is a Nigerian coconut biscuit made from finely-grated coconut, cassava starch, and sugar.

steps.text: Gently crack open the coconut, and separate the meat from the shell.
Use a grater or food processor to shred the coconut.
Combine the grated coconut, sugar, cassava starch, and nutmeg.
Stir in water until it forms a dough ball.
Roll out the dough until thin.
Cut out square biscuits, and transfer them to a buttered baking tray.
Bake the biscuits for about 20–25 minutes at 150°C (300°F) until golden brown and crisped.
Remove the biscuits from the oven, and let cool.

recipes.title: Mus czekoladowy
recipes.description: Delikatny deser z ciemnej czekolady, ubitych jajek i bitej śmietany.

ingredients.text: łyżka posiekanych migdałów lub orzechów laskowych
ingredients.name: migdały

steps.text: Żółtka utrzeć z połową cukru do białości.
Czekoladę połamać na nieduże kawałki, włożyć do miski ustawionej na garnku z wrzącą wodą.
Mieszać, aż czekolada się roztopi, po czym zdjąć z ognia i wymieszać z ubitymi żółtkami.
Z białek ubić na parze sztywną pianę.
Pod koniec ubijania dodać resztę cukru.
Połączyć pianę z masą czekoladową i dokładnie wymieszać z bitą śmietaną.
Rozłożyć mus do pucharków, udekorować migdałami lub orzechami, wstawić na godzinę do lodówki.

recipes.title: White House Honey Ale
recipes.description: Honey ale brewed from hops, malt extract and White House honey, then bottled with priming sugar.

ingredients.text: ¾ cup corn sugar (powdered glucose) for priming
ingredients.name: cukier kukurydziany (glukoza w proszku)

steps.text: Place each type of hop pellets in a separate hops steeping bag.
In a 12 qt pot, steep the hops bags in 1½ gallons of sterile water at 155°F for ½ hour. Remove the bag.
Add the light malt extract and the dried malt extract and bring to a boil.
For the first flavoring, add the Kent Goldings hop pellets and gypsum. Boil for 45 minutes.
For the second flavoring, add the Fuggles hop pellets at the last minute of the boil.
Stir in the honey and boil for 5 more minutes.
Add 2 gallons chilled sterile water into the primary fermenter and add the hot wort into it. Top with more water to total 5 gallons. There is no need to strain.
Add the yeast when wort temperature is between 70–80°F. Fill airlock halfway with water.
Ferment at 68–72°F for about 7 days.
Rack the mixture to a secondary fermenter after 5 days and ferment for 14 more days.
To bottle, dissolve the corn sugar into 2 pints of boiling water for 15 minutes.
Pour the sugar mixture into an empty bottling bucket. Siphon the beer from the fermenter over it. Distribute priming sugar evenly.
Siphon everything into bottles and cap. Let sit for 2–3 weeks at 75°F.

recipes.title: Otong Soup
recipes.description: Otong soup is a popular soup amongst the Efik tribe of the Southern part of Nigeria. It is made from ugu leaves, uziza leaves, and okra.

steps.text: Purée the okra and chile pepper with a blender.
Boil the meat with the blended onion, stock cube, and other spices to taste.
Add the okra purée and a little palm oil. Cook the mixture until it boils.
Stir in the uziza and ugu leaves.
Remove from the heat, and let rest for 2 minutes.
Season with salt to taste, and serve.

recipes.title: Hot Cocoa
recipes.description: Gorąca czekolada przygotowana z mieszanki słodowej Ovaltine i kakao.

ingredients.text: 4–5 tablespoons malted chocolate mix or Ovaltine (Ovomaltine), or dry malt extract
ingredients.name: mieszanka czekoladowo-słodowa

steps.text: Mix the Ovaltine and cocoa powder together.
Pound with a spoon until very fine—this will help reduce stirring time.
Shake the Ovaltine and cocoa powder for 10 seconds.
Pour the mix into the hot water. Stir well.
Top with whipped cream if desired and serve, sprinkled with cinnamon or chocolate powder, if desired.

recipes.title: Hyderabadi Fried Bread with Syrup and Nuts (Double ka meetha)
recipes.description: Double ka meetha is a popular dessert in Hyderabad, India.

steps.text: Trim the edges of the bread slices and cut each slice into four.
Fry them in ghee till golden brown.
Make a sugar syrup by adding half a litre of water to the sugar.
Add the milk to the sugar syrup. Boil until the syrup starts thickening.
Grind the cardamom seeds to a powder.
Add the powdered cardamom seeds and khoa to the thickened milk. Stir the mixture well.
Arrange the fried bread pieces on a flat tray. Pour the syrup over the bread pieces while they are still hot. Garnish with the raisins and nuts.
Refrigerate and serve.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Locrio (Dominican Chicken and Rice)
recipes.description: A locrio is a common Dominican dish similar to paella, with tomato paste for coloring and caramelized sugar.

ingredients.text: 4 lbs (1.8 kg) chicken, cut in pieces
ingredients.name: kurczak

ingredients.text: 2 tbsp oil, for when rice is almost done
ingredients.name: olej roślinny
ingredients.note: for when rice is almost done

steps.text: Heat the ¼ cup oil in a pot over high heat.

Add the sugar to the pot. Let it melt and caramelize, turning light brown. Pay close attention and don't let the sugar burn. Do not use plastic utensils to stir the sugar, since it will be at around 350°F (175°C).
Add the meat to the caramel and let it brown on all sides. Remove and reserve the meat.
Add the garlic, onions, and celery to the pot. Fry.
Add rice and cooked meat to pot with the vegetables. Whisk together chicken stock and tomato paste until smooth, then stir it into the rice mixture. Stir in the salt, pepper, thyme, and olives.

Check the seasoning. If the salt level is good, add an extra ½ tsp of salt. This is because the rice will absorb some of the salt, and it will come out a bit flat in the end unless you add extra salt.

Bring to a boil over high heat. Let it boil, stirring occasionally, until the water is absorbed. The high heat is needed to bring the rice temperature up so that it cooks. If you lower the flame at this point, the rice might not cook all the way.
Cover, lower the heat, and let it cook for 15 minutes.
Uncover, sprinkle 2 Tbsp oil on top, and stir so that the uncooked rice on top goes to the bottom. Cook for another 5 minutes.
If rice still not cooked, give it another stir and cook for another 5 minutes. Sometimes you may need more time; see notes below.
Turn heat on high for a couple of minutes to brown and toast the rice on bottom. Sometimes it does this by itself during the main cooking so you don't have to do this. Experience will tell.
Serve.

recipes.title: Yam Casserole
recipes.description: Zapiekanka z batatów (yams) z bourbonem, skórką pomarańczową i kruszonką z orzechów pekan i brązowego cukru.

ingredients.text: 2 cans (2 lb + 8 oz / 900 g) yams or sweet potatoes, drained (or 4 lb / 1.8 kg cooked, peeled, and sliced yams)
ingredients.name: batat
ingredients.note: 2 lb + 8 oz / 900 g; or 4 lb / 1.8 kg cooked, peeled, and sliced yams

steps.text: In mixing bowl with electric mixer, beat yams. Add in remaining main ingredients, beating until mixture is light and fluffy.
Butter a 12-inch porcelain quiche dish or a shallow 2 quart casserole dish (7x11 inches / 18 x 28 cm).
Pour in yam mixture, smoothing top evenly.
Make praline topping by mixing all ingredients together in small bowl.
Spread evenly over the yams. May be refrigerated covered overnight.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 45–50 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly.
Remove from oven and let stand 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Italian Meatballs
recipes.description: Meatballs made from minced veal with breadcrumbs, Parmesan, garlic and herbs, fried and then baked.

ingredients.text: 500 g (18 oz/1½ lb) minced veal meat
ingredients.name: mięso cielęce mielone

ingredients.text: 30 g (1 oz/1 Tbsp) grated Parmesan cheese
ingredients.name: parmezan

steps.text: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl. Using your hands, squeeze all ingredients.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat and drizzle on a little olive oil. Preheat oven to 175°C (350°F) in the meantime.
Use your hands to roll meat into bite sized balls.
Place the meatballs in the skillet and cook uncovered for 3 minutes, then roll them over and cook another 3 minutes.
Transfer the meatballs onto a baking sheet and bake in the oven for 20–25 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegetable Stuffed Mushrooms
recipes.description: Portobello mushrooms marinated in balsamic vinegar, then baked with a spinach and eggplant filling and topped with cheese.

ingredients.text: 4 large portobello mushrooms, wiped clean and stems removed
ingredients.name: pieczarka portobello
ingredients.note: large, wiped clean and stems removed

ingredients.text: 1 jar (6 ounces) artichoke hearts in brine, drained and chopped
ingredients.name: serca artyszoka w zalewie

steps.text: Combine balsamic vinegar, garlic, and onion powder together in a bowl. Place your mushrooms in a gallon size bag, and evenly pour the vinegar, garlic and onion powder mixture on the mushrooms.
Place the mushrooms and vinegar mixture in the fridge to marinate for 1 hour.
In a small pan, heat the olive oil on median high heat, and gradually stir in the eggplant and spinach.
Cook thoroughly until the eggplant is slightly browned.
Set your oven temperature at 350°F (180°C), and lightly grease a 9x13-inch (22 x 32 cm) oven-safe dish.
After your mushrooms have marinated for 1 hour in the fridge, remove your mushrooms from the bag and place them in your pre-greased oven dish with the lid of the mushroom facing downward.

Evenly place the eggplant and spinach mixture over the mushrooms, and garnish with mozzarella cheese. If you so choose to use tomatoes and artichoke hearts, evenly distribute them between the mushrooms. Lastly, sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Place your dish in your preheated oven, and bake just until you see the cheese start to melt, which will be no more than 15 minutes. For best flavor, eat while still hot out of the oven.
Eat alone or serve over a small portion of brown rice or whole wheat angel hair pasta.

recipes.title: Meatloaf III
recipes.description: Klasyczny meatloaf z mielonej wołowiny, krakersów Ritz i sosu pomidorowego, pieczony w piekarniku.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C).
Pound the Ritz crackers until fine like bread crumbs.
In a separate bowl, add the meat and the other ingredients and mix with your hands until the mixture is smooth.
Grease a glass baking dish with vegetable shortening.
Put the meat mixture in the pan and shape like a football.
Bake in the oven for 1 hour.
Take out the meat loaf and serve warm.

recipes.title: Tortillas with Spicy Chocolate Sauce
recipes.description: Baked tortilla wedges served warm with a spicy chocolate sauce flavored with habanero and orange juice.

ingredients.text: ¾ cup white granulated sugar, divided
ingredients.name: cukier

ingredients.text: 12 wheat flour tortillas, each cut into 10 wedges
ingredients.name: tortilla pszenna

steps.text: Toss tortilla wedges with butter. Sprinkle with ¼ cup sugar and place on a half-sheet pan.
Bake at 375°F for 15 minutes. Remove and set aside.
Heat an inch of water in a large saucepan to a simmer. Place a stainless steel bowl that hangs over the edges on top to make a double boiler.
Remove bowl from pot and add egg yolks, whisking continuously, and place back on top of the pot. Cook, whisking continuously, until eggs fall off of whisk in a ribbon.
Add chocolate, chilli, orange juice, remaining sugar, and vanilla extract. Cook, whisking continuously, until chocolate is melted and all ingredients are heated through.
Drizzle sauce over tortillas, and serve warm.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Chicken
recipes.description: Chicken breasts simmered in a tomato sauce with onion, garlic, cinnamon sticks and a touch of peach or honey, served over pasta.

ingredients.text: ¼–½ peach, chopped finely OR 1–2 tablespoons honey
ingredients.name: brzoskwinia

ingredients.text: ¼–½ peach, chopped finely OR 1–2 tablespoons honey
ingredients.name: miód

ingredients.text: Enough pasta for 4 servings (cheese tortellini is good)
ingredients.name: makaron
ingredients.note: enough for 4 servings (cheese tortellini is good)

steps.text: Heat olive oil in a medium saucepan.
Lightly brown the chicken breasts in the oil—don't cook them through.
Add the onion and fry for a couple of minutes.
Add peach (if you're using peach) and fry for another minute.
Cut the tomatoes in half and add them.
Add everything else and simmer, covered, for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove the lid and let it simmer for about 15 more minutes.
In the meantime, cook the pasta according to the directions on the package.
Remove cinnamon sticks from sauce. Serve over hot pasta with freshly-grated Parmesan and garlic bread.

recipes.title: Cuban Picadillo
recipes.description: Cuban picadillo: ground beef simmered in a tomato sauce with raisins, green olives and cumin, served over rice.

ingredients.text: ½ cup chopped pimento-stuffed green olives
ingredients.name: oliwki zielone

ingredients.text: Salt and fresh ground black pepper to taste
ingredients.name: sól
ingredients.note: salt and fresh ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: In large skillet, brown beef in 2 tablespoons olive oil over high heat; drain and reserve.
In same skillet, lightly brown onion, pepper, and garlic in remaining oil.
Add tomato sauce, cumin, and oregano; bring to boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until mixture has thickened.
Stir in beef, raisins, olives and season to taste with salt and pepper.
Bring back to boil, simmer 10 minutes, and serve over steamed rice with sautéed sliced ripe plantains and black beans.

recipes.title: Bulgarian Fresh Sausage (Kebapcheta)
recipes.description: Bulgarian fresh sausages made from minced pork and beef, seasoned with cumin and black pepper, fermented in the refrigerator and grilled.

steps.text: Salt the meat, and mix well with spices and water.
Cover, and let stand in the refrigerator for 1–2 days. This is the most important and tricky part of the recipe, as the goal is to allow the meat to ferment.
Form mixture into oblong rissoles (skinless sausages) by passing through a grinder with a funnel at the end.
Grill sausages on medium-high heat. Do not flip more than once when grilling—flipping multiple times will produce a dry instead of juicy product.
Serve hot with your choice of sides. They are best with golden French fries and cold beer.

recipes.title: Fiddlehead-Portobello Linguine
recipes.description: A simple way to serve fiddleheads, with sautéed portobello, sun-dried tomatoes and linguine.

ingredients.text: 1 pound (450 g) fiddleheads, cleaned and trimmed
ingredients.name: zwijka paproci

steps.text: Slice the mushrooms, onions, and sun-dried tomatoes into long strips and set aside.
Sauté the ferns and garlic in the olive oil for about 5 to 10 minutes.
Add the onions, and sauté until they start to wilt.
Add the mushrooms and sun-dried tomatoes. Continue to sauté for another 5 minutes or so.
Season with salt and pepper, toss in the pine nuts, add a splash of water, reduce heat and cover. Let sweat for about 10 minutes (or so).
During this, begin to cook the linguine so that it is ready when the topping is ready.
In a large bowl, add the veggies to the linguine, sprinkle on the cheese, and toss well.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Apple Pudding
recipes.description: A simple baked apple pudding with walnuts, suitable for camping.

ingredients.text: 1 cup chopped walnuts or hickory nuts
ingredients.name: orzechy włoskie

steps.text: Beat sugar and egg until smooth.
Beat in flour, baking powder, salt, and vanilla.
Stir walnuts or hickory nuts and apples into the mixture.
Pour into a greased Dutch oven or 9 x 9-inch pan.
Bake at 325°F (160°C) for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Béchamel Sauce (Beeton)
recipes.description: Béchamel or French white sauce is a white rich sauce, used as a basic sauce for many dishes.

ingredients.text: 700 ml (1¼ pints) of milk (or white stock)
ingredients.name: mleko

steps.text: Put the milk into a saucepan and place on the hob. Add the onion or shallot, the bouquet garni, peppercorns, mace, and bay leaf, and bring to a boil.
In another saucepan, melt the butter, stir in the flour, and cook a little without browning to make a roux.
Stir in your hot milk mixture and whisk over the heat until it boils, then bring down the temperature and let it simmer for 15 to 20 minutes.
Strain and pass through a sieve or muslin, return to the saucepan, and season lightly with ½ tsp nutmeg, ½ tsp cayenne, and ½ tsp salt.
Serve.

recipes.title: Cheese Enchilada
recipes.description: This cheese enchilada recipe was handed down from the grandmother and mother of the original contributor.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Fry chili powder and flour in oil in a 10–12-inch (25–30 cm) skillet until emulsified.
Add water, bring to a simmer, and then stir for ~5 minutes until slightly thickened.
Turn down heat to low.
Soak one tortilla in the chili gravy until softened (20–30 seconds).
Remove tortilla from gravy, place flat on a plate, and add ~1 tbsp cheese and ~1 tbsp onion to center of the tortilla.
Roll it up, and place with edges facing down in a 9 x 12-inch (23 x 30 cm) baking pan.
Repeat this until you have used all the tortillas.
If you get low on the gravy at the end, stir in ⅛–¼ cup of water.
Cover the enchiladas with the remaining cheese, onions, and chili gravy.
Bake in oven for about 5 minutes—longer will toughen the cheese.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Silvash Gombotz (Hungarian Plum Dumplings)
recipes.description: A traditional Hungarian dessert of plum dumplings made from potato dough, popular during freezing cold winters.

ingredients.text: Fresh plums, plum jam or plum compote
ingredients.name: śliwka
ingredients.note: fresh plums, plum jam or plum compote

steps.text: Cook potatoes until very soft (at least an hour). Peel and mash with a fork.
Add the egg to the mixture, along with the little salt and oil. Mix well.
Gradually mix in the flour to make a smooth dough. You may need a little more or less than the listed quantity.
Knead the potato dough, then roll it out into a thin sheet (about 5 mm thick), and cut into squares.
Put half a plum or 1 tsp of plum jam on each square. Wrap the dough around the filling and seal the edges.
Cook in boiling water for 10–15 minutes until the dumplings are floating and cooked through.
Serve with bread crumbs fried in butter.

recipes.title: Stovetop Mac n' Cheese
recipes.description: Makaron z serem na kuchni, z sosem na bazie czterech serów i żółtek jaj.

ingredients.text: 1 cup each shredded mild Cheddar, Gruyere, Fontina, and Monterey Jack cheese
ingredients.name: ser cheddar

ingredients.text: 1 cup each shredded mild Cheddar, Gruyere, Fontina, and Monterey Jack cheese
ingredients.name: ser gruyère

ingredients.text: 1 cup each shredded mild Cheddar, Gruyere, Fontina, and Monterey Jack cheese
ingredients.name: ser fontina

ingredients.text: 1 cup each shredded mild Cheddar, Gruyere, Fontina, and Monterey Jack cheese
ingredients.name: ser monterey jack

steps.text: Heat 1 gallon water to a rolling boil. Add salt and macaroni, and cook macaroni until al dente.
While pasta boils, melt butter in a saucepan or a saucier over medium low heat, and cook until bubbling ceases.
Whisk in flour and cook, whisking continuously, until blonde color is achieved.
Temper in egg yolk. Add cheese and bring to just below a simmer. Cook, whisking continuously, until slightly thickened.
Fold in macaroni and serve warm.

recipes.title: Chicken and Broccoli Casserole
recipes.description: A casserole of chicken breast and broccoli in a creamy celery soup and mayonnaise sauce, flavored with curry powder.

ingredients.text: 10.5 oz canned cream of celery soup
ingredients.name: zupa krem z selera w puszce

steps.text: Sear the cubed chicken in saucepan.
Place cooked chicken and remaining ingredients into a casserole dish.
Cover with foil and bake in oven at 375°F for 30 minutes.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Shrimp Hooman (Goan Shrimp Curry)
recipes.description: A Goan shrimp curry made with a ground coconut and chile paste, cooked with shrimp and drumsticks.

ingredients.text: 1 cup (240 ml) grated coconut, preferably fresh
ingredients.name: wiórki kokosowe

ingredients.text: 1 piece of tamarind (the size of a small marble)
ingredients.name: tamarynd
ingredients.note: the size of a small marble

ingredients.text: 1 drumstick (frozen works fine), cut into 8–10 pieces
ingredients.name: podudzie z kurczaka
ingredients.note: frozen works fine, cut into 8–10 pieces

steps.text: Put the shrimp, onion, drumsticks, and asafoetida in a saucepan. Add a little water and cook until the shrimp and drumsticks are done. If using white fish instead of shrimp, then omit the shrimp at this stage.

Grind the grated coconut, chile peppers, turmeric, pepper and tamarind to a fine paste. If needed, add a tiny amount of water to form a thick fine paste. Avoid watering down the paste as far as possible.
Add to the shrimp mix and bring to a boil. If using white fish, add at this point.
Add salt to taste.
Serve with hot white rice.

recipes.title: Soji (Indian Wheat Pudding)
recipes.description: Indian wheat pudding made with cream of wheat, cashews, raisins, cardamom and milk.

ingredients.text: ½ cup (120 g) cashew nuts, broken
ingredients.name: orzech nerkowca

steps.text: Wash the cashews and raisins and keep them ready.
Crush the cardamom pods to remove the contents and discard the husks.
Pound the contents of the pods into a black powder, and mix with the cream of wheat.
Add the sugar and salt to the cream of wheat and mix thoroughly.
Melt the butter in a saucepan and gently fry the cream of wheat in it.
Add the cashews and raisins to the saucepan and continue to fry until the cream of wheat is light brown.
Add the milk to the saucepan and stir. The mixture will thicken and you will need to keep stirring to prevent it sticking to the bottom of the saucepan and burning.
When the mixture solidifies, turn off the heat and take the saucepan off the heat.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Acorn Squash with Orange Marmalade
recipes.description: Acorn squash with orange marmalade is a quick, easy vegetable side dish with a slight sweetness.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (204°C).
Remove seeds and strings from squash halves.
Cut a small piece off outside of each half to make a flat space on which the half can stand level.
Place halves in a shallow pan or casserole in ¼ inch (6 mm) water with insides facing down.
Bake for 35 minutes.
Combine marmalade and butter in a small bowl.
Remove squash from oven, and invert in pan or dish.
Salt lightly.
Spread marmalade and butter mixture on edges of squash, allowing excess to run into center.
Place under broiler for 5 minutes or until lightly browned.

recipes.title: Tamate Ka Kut (Hyderabadi Tomato Curry)
recipes.description: Tamate Ka Kut is a tomato curry of Hyderabadi cuisine.

ingredients.text: 10 large, ripe tomatoes, washed and quartered
ingredients.name: pomidor

ingredients.text: 2 dried red chillies, each split into two
ingredients.name: suszona papryczka chili

steps.text: Put the quartered tomato pieces in a large non-stick saucepan on medium low heat. Add a cup of water to it, mix, and cover with the lid. Let it cook till the tomatoes are mushy and soft, giving it a stir every once in a while. Let it cool.
Once cooled, pour the tomatoes into a blender container and add the gram flour. Blend until puréed. If you are using canned crushed tomato, add the gram flour to it and mix well.
Strain this mixture through a wire mesh strainer back into the saucepan. Throw away the leftover seeds and skin in the strainer. Add 2 cups water to it and let it simmer.

Pour oil into a small frying pan at medium heat and add the cumin seeds, whole red chillies, garlic pod, and curry leaves when the oil heats up. As they start to splutter, remove from heat and add this to the tomato sauce being cooked in the saucepan.

Add the cumin and coriander seed powder, red chilli powder and salt to the sauce and mix well. Bring it to a boil, and let it cook at medium low heat until the raw aroma of gram flour is gone. You can add a little water to it if required. Taste and adjust the salt and chilli powder.
Make light slits on all 4 sides of the eggs, making sure the slits are just on the surface and not deep into the yolk. Add these to the simmering tomato sauce.
Cook the tomato sauce until the raw smell of the gram flour is gone, about 30 minutes. Keep stirring it occasionally.
Stir in the chopped cilantro and mint just before serving.
Pour it into a warm bowl and serve it warm.

recipes.title: Green Leaf Juice
recipes.description: A blend of green leaf vegetables, pineapple, herbs and ginger, with extra lime for a more palatable green juice.

ingredients.text: 238 g (8 oz / 6 leaves) Swiss chard or collard greens
ingredients.name: boćwina

ingredients.text: 26 g (1 oz / 1 piece) fresh ginger root
ingredients.name: imbir świeży

steps.text: Squeeze the lime juice into the container where the juice extractor dispenses the juice.
Cut the pineapple, removing the outer spiny flesh, the top, the bottom and the pithy core.
Cut the pineapple into long thin strips that can be easily inserted into the juice extractor. Run the pineapple through the juice extractor.
Tear the greens into smaller pieces that can be put into the juice extractor easily. Run the greens through the juice extractor.
Run the cilantro through the juice extractor.
Run the ginger root through the juice extractor.
Stir the juice mixture well, and serve the green juice over ice.

recipes.title: Hazelnut Torte
recipes.description: A light, airy hazelnut torte made from whipped egg whites and hazelnut meal, layered with coffee-flavored cream.

steps.text: Preheat oven to very hot—about 230°C (450°F).
Whip egg whites with electric mixer to soft peaks.
While whipping, very gradually add the caster sugar, and continue whipping to stiff peaks.
Gently fold hazelnut meal into the beaten egg whites.
Line a 40 x 25 cm (16 x 10-inch) baking pan with foil. Spread mixture evenly into tray. Do not bang the tray—it is important to keep as much air in the cake as possible.
Once cake is in oven, immediately turn temperature down to 180°C (350°F). Bake for 20 minutes, or until cake is sealed and springs back when touched lightly with finger.
Allow cake to cool in the tray. It should only be about 1 inch high.
Once cooled, cut cake into 3 equal sections to be stacked on top of each other.
In a bowl, dissolve coffee and cocoa into cream. Once dissolved, whip cream to stiff peaks.
Layer cream between the sections of cake to make a log. Decorate top with extra cream.

recipes.title: Grilled Aubergine
recipes.description: Grilled aubergine slices topped with a sweet miso sauce and toasted sesame seeds.

steps.text: Wash the aubergine, and cut it into 2.5 cm slices lengthwise.
Brush the cut surfaces with oil.
Grill 7–10 cm from the source of the heat until the aubergine is tender and browned all over (about 5 minutes).
In a small saucepan combine the miso, sugar, and soup stock. Cook, stirring, over low heat until the mixture is smooth and hot. Do not let it boil.
Pour the sauce mixture over the aubergine.
In a small frying pan toast the sesame seeds until they jump, then sprinkle them over the aubergine.

categories: Recipes using pork broth and stock

recipes.title: Pork Pot Pie
recipes.description: Zapiekany pot pie z wieprzowiną, kukurydzą i groszkiem w sosie na bazie bulionu i mleka.

steps.text: Heat oven to 425°F.
Prepare pie crusts as directed on package for two-crust pie using 9-inch pie pan.
In a medium saucepan, melt margarine over medium heat.
Add onion; cook 2 minutes or until tender.
Stir in flour, salt, and pepper until well-blended.
Gradually stir in broth and milk; cook, stirring constantly, until bubbly and thickened.
Add pork, corn, and peas; remove from heat.
Spoon pork mixture into crust-lined pan.
Top with second crust and flute; cut three slits on top.
Bake for 30–40 minutes or until crust is golden-brown.
Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Ibihaza (Rwandan Beans)
recipes.description: Ibihaza is a traditional dish from Rwanda that features flavorful and hearty beans cooked to perfection. It can be enjoyed as a main course or as a side dish.

ingredients.text: 2 cups dried beans (such as red kidney beans or black-eyed peas)
ingredients.name: fasola sucha
ingredients.note: such as red kidney beans or black-eyed peas

steps.text: Rinse the dried beans thoroughly under running water. Place them in a large bowl and cover with water. Allow the beans to soak overnight or for at least 8 hours. Drain and rinse the beans before cooking.
In a large pot, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and minced garlic, and sauté until the onion is translucent and fragrant.
Add the soaked and rinsed beans to the pot, along with enough water to cover the beans by about an inch. Bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and add the cumin, paprika, coriander, thyme, and bay leaf to the pot. Stir well to combine.

Cover the pot partially with a lid and simmer the beans for about 1–1½ hours, or until they are tender and cooked through. Stir occasionally and add more water if necessary to maintain the desired consistency.
Season the beans with salt, to taste, and continue cooking for another 5–10 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Remove the pot from the heat and let the beans rest for a few minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Nigerian Tiger Nut Milk (Kunun Aya)
recipes.description: Tiger nut milk, locally known as kunun aya, is a refreshing traditional beverage commonly consumed in Northern Nigeria. It is made from blended tiger nuts and often sweetened with dates or other natural sweeteners.

ingredients.text: 1-inch (2.5 cm) piece of fresh ginger, peeled
ingredients.name: imbir świeży

ingredients.text: Sweetener of choice (e.g., honey or sugar), to taste
ingredients.name: słodzik

steps.text: Rinse and soak the tiger nuts in 2 cups of water for at least 24 hours to soften.
Drain and blend the soaked tiger nuts with the dates and ginger, adding water as needed to form a smooth paste.
Strain the blended mixture using a fine mesh sieve or cheesecloth to remove the chaff.
Dilute the extracted milk with the remaining water to the desired consistency.
Add your preferred sweetener to taste, and stir well.
Serve chilled. Refrigerate leftovers and consume within 1–2 days.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Chicken Marsala II
recipes.description: Classic Italian-American Chicken Marsala with detailed instructions.

ingredients.name: mąka pszenna
ingredients.note: ¼–½ cup, depending on how thick you like it

steps.text: Combine ¼–½ cup (depending on how thick you like it) all-purpose flour with rosemary and thyme in a gallon size zip-top bag. Set aside.

Pound chicken breasts flat under a water-spritzed sheet of plastic wrap with a pie plate and a heavy food can, or pound down lightly with a tenderizing hammer. Depending on the size of the chicken breasts, you may first wish to cut them vertically or horizontally to achieve the desired serving sizes and shapes.
Season each piece with kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper.
Dip each piece of chicken into eggs then toss in seasoned flour.
Heat oil in large stainless steel skillet over medium high heat (don't even think about using a nonstick surface).
Add chicken breasts and cook until deeply browned on each side. Remove and keep warm.
Add marsala to pan and ignite either by tilting or fire stick/lighter. Whisk to loosen browned bits until reduced by ¾.
Add broth and tomato paste to pan and whisk to combine.
Add chicken breasts and lower heat to medium low heat. Simmer for 7 minutes.
Serve warm with garlic bread and some espresso.

recipes.title: Ragi Dosa (South Indian Millet and Rice Pancake)
recipes.description: Traditional food from Karnataka, India (especially South Karnataka). It can be served with onion and garlic chutney.

steps.text: Soak ragi, rice and urad dal separately in water for 5 hours.
Grind the soaked rice with water first and next with urad dal and ragi (both) with water.
Mix up all the ground batter. Leave it for about 10 hours to ferment.
After 10 hours put some salt as per your taste to the batter and water if needed.
Take a cup of batter and spread it onto a hot tava.

recipes.title: Drover's Damper
recipes.description: Australian bread made by stockmen over a campfire; this is the "flash" version made with butter and milk.

steps.text: Add salt to flour, then add sugar.
Rub in butter.
Mix in milk to make a medium-soft dough.
Knead lightly on flat surface until smooth.
Pat dough into a round shape.
Place damper mixture on coals or hot ash. Cook for maximum of 40 minutes.
Discard burnt outside and eat the inside.
Serve with butter, (golden syrup) or jam.

recipes.title: Lemon Sponge
recipes.description: A light, vegetarian lemon dessert with a sponge top and creamy custard layer, baked in a water bath.

steps.text: Lightly beat egg yolks.
Mix the sugar and flour together, then add the lemon juice and zest, yolks, butter and salt.
Stir in the milk and mix well.
Whip the egg whites until stiff and fold into the first mixture.
Pour batter into custard cups or ramekins.
Set the cups in a pan of hot water and bake at 350 F for about 40 minutes.

categories: Recipes using fish broth and stock

recipes.title: Baked Lemon Thyme Halibut
recipes.description: Halibut fillet baked in parchment and foil with lemon, thyme, olive oil and fish stock.

steps.text: Place the fish in the center of the baking pan.
Drizzle fish with olive oil and fish stock.
Add thyme sprigs, slices of lemon, and sprinkle with pepper.
Cover with parchment paper and foil.
Bake in oven on sheet pan at 400 °F (200 °C) for 15–20 minutes until flesh is flaky.

recipes.title: Pasta, Meat and Cheese Casserole (Mostaccioli)
recipes.description: A baked casserole of mostaccioli pasta in a spiced meat sauce, layered with a ricotta and Parmesan egg mixture.

steps.text: Cook mostaccioli until al dente in boiling salted water. Drain and set aside.
In skillet, combine meat, sausages, onion, green pepper and garlic. Cook while breaking up meat, until browned. Drain off fat.
To the meat, add all remaining ingredients, except egg and cheeses. Bring meat sauce to a boil. Reduce heat.
Cover and simmer for 15–20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Combine egg and cheeses. To assemble, stir cooked pasta into meat sauce. Place half in buttered 1-quart baking dish.
Spread cheese mixture evenly over the top. cover with remaining pasta.
Bake, covered, at 350°F for 30–35 minutes or until cooked through.

recipes.title: Triple Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.description: Soft cookies made with cocoa powder and two kinds of chocolate chips, white and milk.

ingredients.text: 110 g (3.9 oz / 1 stick) unsalted butter, plus extra for greasing
ingredients.name: masło

ingredients.text: 180 g (6.3 oz / 1 cup) soft light brown sugar
ingredients.name: cukier trzcinowy brązowy

ingredients.text: 30 g (1.1 oz / ¼ cup) cocoa powder
ingredients.name: kakao

ingredients.text: 60 g (2.1 oz / ¾ cup) white chocolate chips
ingredients.name: czekolada biała

ingredients.text: 60 g (2.1 oz / ¾ cup) milk chocolate chips
ingredients.name: czekolada mleczna

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 190 C. Grease 3 baking trays.
Mix the flour, cocoa, bicarbonate of soda and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter and sugar in a mixing bowl until soft and fluffy.
Beat in the egg.
Fold the dry ingredients into the wet ingredients.
Fold the chocolate chips into the dough.
Spoon heaped tablespoons of dough onto the baking trays, well spaced apart.
Bake for 12–15 minutes. If you want a chewy texture, reduce the time to 10 minutes.
Transfer the cookies to wire racks and leave them to cool.

recipes.title: Alkubus (Nigerian Steamed Bread)
recipes.description: Alkubus is a steamed wheat bread from northern Nigeria. It originated from Arabs.

steps.text: Sift the flour into a mixing bowl. Mix in the yeast, salt, and baking powder.
Mix in the water to make a dough, and knead it until cohesive and fully combined.
Cover the dough and let rise for 1 hour.
Gently deflate the dough.
Grease a cooking mold, and transfer the dough to the mold.
Cover the mold and place it in a steamer setup. Steam until cooked through and a skewer inserted into the center comes out clean.
Remove from the heat and let cool.
Unmold the steamed bread and serve.

recipes.title: Christmas Pudding II
recipes.description: Sussex recipe for Christmas pudding, traditionally made well in advance and reheated before serving.

ingredients.text: ½ lb (225 g) white granulated sugar (or less)
ingredients.name: cukier

ingredients.text: ¾ lb (340 g) shredded suet (can be vegetarian; see note below)
ingredients.name: łój wołowy
ingredients.note: can be vegetarian; see note below

ingredients.text: 2 oz (55 g) almonds, chopped but not too small
ingredients.name: migdały

steps.text: Mix all ingredients together, stirring well to combine.
Divide batter between 2 pudding basins. Cover with cloths or buttered greaseproof paper, tied tightly in place with string.
Steam for 7 hours, then cool and keep until Christmas Day.
To prepare for serving, steam for 2 hours. Times can be reduced by using a pressure cooker.

recipes.title: Blackberry Oat Bars (Gluten-Free)
recipes.description: Gluten-free, vegan-friendly blackberry oat bars that could be breakfast Monday morning.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 °F. Line a 9×9-inch baking pan with parchment paper and set aside. The easiest way to do this is to cut two strips of parchment paper and criss-cross them in the pan.
In a food processor fitted with the blade attachment, add the oats, almond flour and salt. Blend well.
Add the melted coconut oil, brown sugar, honey, vanilla, cinnamon, and almond butter. Pulse to blend.

Place ⅔ of the oat mixture in the prepared baking pan. Reserve the remaining ⅓ for the crumble topping. Using your hands, press firmly to form a bottom crust layer. Lightly prick the dough with a fork or paring knife to prevent bubbling. Place in the oven and pre-bake for 10 minutes to set.
While the crust is baking, place the blackberries and sugar in a food processor and pulse to rough chop the berries and incorporate the sugar.

Remove the baking pan from the oven and evenly spread the blackberry filling on top. Sprinkle the remaining crumble topping on top of the blackberries. Place back in the oven and bake for an additional 25 minutes or until slightly golden.
Allow to cool completely before slicing.

recipes.title: Honey Apple Glazed Pork
recipes.description: Pork butt roast with a spice rub, baked and glazed with applesauce and honey.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 325°F (about 165°C).
Mix together pepper, flour, mustard, sage, and salt to get a rub.
Apply rub to pork roast and set aside.
Line a roasting pan with foil and spray with cooking spray.
Place roast in pan and bake for 30 minutes.
Mix together applesauce, cinnamon, honey, and nutmeg as a glaze.
Remove roast from oven and spread with glaze.
Return glazed roast to oven and bake until you get an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C), about 50–60 minutes.

recipes.title: Luciabullar (Scandinavian Saffron Buns)
recipes.description: Scandinavian saffron buns served on St. Lucia Day (13 December).

ingredients.text: ½ tsp crushed (¼ tsp powdered) saffron threads
ingredients.name: szafran

ingredients.text: ¾ cup (180 ml) half and half, lukewarm
ingredients.name: śmietanka

ingredients.text: ¾ cup (180 g) white granulated sugar
ingredients.name: cukier

steps.text: Combine the yeast and warm water.
Mix saffron into the warm half and half and let stand.
Combine the yeast and saffron mixtures. Mix in the melted butter, eggs, sugar, and salt.
Mix half of flour into the wet mixture and beat until well-blended.
Mix in additional flour until dough is smooth but not too firm. Knead on floured surface for ten minutes.
Place dough in buttered bowl and let rise about 1½ hours or until doubled in volume.
Divide the dough into multiple pieces. Roll each piece into a 7 inch-long snake, and form into an 'S' shape with the ends curled in. Place a raisin in each curl.
Place buns on buttered sheet pan, cover, and let rise 45 minutes.
Brush with beaten egg and bake at 375–400°F (190–200°C) for 10–15 minutes until golden and cooked through.

recipes.title: Steamed Rice
recipes.description: Steamed rice is a simple dish that can be cooked without a special rice cooker or microwave.

ingredients.text: 1 cup (250 ml or 8.5 fl oz) dry rice
ingredients.name: ryż biały

steps.text: Wash the rice if desired.
Place the rice in a deep saucepan with lid. Add salt if using, and stir.
Bring rice to a boil over high heat. Stir.
Reduce heat to low and cover the pot. Cook on low for 12 minutes.
Uncover rice and serve.

recipes.title: Chorba Frik (Freekeh Soup)
recipes.description: Algerian and Tunisian soup made from crushed green wheat, a specialty of the Sétif highlands region of Algeria.

steps.text: Mix all the ingredients together in a pot large enough to contain everything.
Place the pot over low heat. Cook for 90 minutes, stirring often.
Serve with lemon.

recipes.title: Coffee Cake
recipes.description: A cake with a cream cheese batter, fresh raspberries, chocolate chips and a cinnamon-pecan topping.

ingredients.text: 1 ½ cup butter or margarine, softened
ingredients.name: masło

steps.text: In a large mixing bowl, combine the butter, cream cheese, and 1¼ cups of sugar. Beat until creamy.
Beat in eggs and vanilla.
In a separate bowl, combine the flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt; slowly add it to the creamed mixture alternately with the milk.
Stir in chocolate chips.
Gently fold in the raspberries.
Pour batter into a greased 9x13-inch pan.
With a fork, mash brown sugar, cinnamon, and remaining butter until chunky, mixing in pecans if desired. Sprinkle over batter.
Bake at 350°F for 50–55 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in several places comes out clean.
Cool for 15 minutes. Carefully run a knife or spatula around the edge of the pan to loosen.
Cool completely before cutting.

categories: Recipes using vegetable broth and stock

recipes.title: Carrot and Coriander Soup
recipes.description: A classic soup combining carrot with both ground and fresh coriander, with the fresh coriander added near the end for a bright flavour.

ingredients.text: 1 large bunch fresh coriander (cilantro), roughly chopped
ingredients.name: kolendra świeża

steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add the onions and carrots. Cook for approximately 5 minutes until they start to soften.
Add the ground coriander, salt and pepper. Cook for another minute.
Add the vegetable stock and bring the mixture to the boil. Simmer for 10–15 minutes until the carrots are very soft.
Purée until smooth.
Add the fresh coriander and serve.

recipes.title: Kulfi (South Asian Frozen Custard)
recipes.description: Kulfi or qulfi is a popular Indian frozen dessert similar to ice cream but denser and creamier.

ingredients.text: ½ tsp ground green cardamom seeds
ingredients.name: kardamon

steps.text: Put the milk into a wide, heavy pan, and bring to boil over high heat, stirring constantly.
Lower the heat and cook the milk, stirring constantly until it has thickened and reduced to ¾ cup—this will take about 40–45 minutes.
Stir the sides of the pan constantly to avoid scorching.
Stir in the sugar, nuts, and cardamom powder. Set aside to cool.
Pour the mixture evenly into kulfi moulds or small ramekins. Cover with plastic wrap or foil, and freeze for about 6 hours until set.
To serve, run a sharp knife dipped in hot water along the sides of the moulds, and unmold them onto a serving plate.

categories: Recipes using beef broth and stock
Recipes using vegetable broth and stock

recipes.title: Key Wat (Ethiopian Red Stew)
recipes.description: A flavorful Ethiopian stew of tender beef simmered in a rich, spicy red sauce, traditionally served with injera.

ingredients.text: 500 grams (1.1 lbs) beef, cut into cubes
ingredients.name: wołowina gulaszowa

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons niter kibbeh (Ethiopian spiced clarified butter) or regular butter
ingredients.name: masło
ingredients.note: niter kibbeh (Ethiopian spiced clarified butter) or regular butter

ingredients.text: ½ teaspoon cayenne pepper, or to taste
ingredients.name: pieprz cayenne

ingredients.text: Fresh cilantro or parsley, chopped, for garnish
ingredients.name: kolendra świeża

steps.text: Heat the niter kibbeh or butter in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions to the pot and sauté until they become soft and translucent.
Add the minced garlic and stir for a minute until fragrant.
Stir in the berbere spice blend, paprika, cayenne pepper, cumin, cardamom, coriander, cinnamon, ginger, turmeric, and salt. Mix well to coat the onions and garlic with the spices.
Add the beef cubes to the pot and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are browned on all sides.
Pour the beef or vegetable broth into the pot, ensuring that the beef is fully submerged.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and simmer for about 1.5–2 hours or until the beef is tender and the flavors have melded together.
Adjust the seasoning with salt and additional spices if desired.
Serve hot, garnished with freshly chopped cilantro or parsley.

recipes.title: Banana Bread with Walnuts
recipes.description: Banana bread is a type of quick-bread or cake. This recipe yields a dense and moist banana bread, studded with walnuts.

steps.text: Combine the flour, baking powder, and salt.
Cream the butter and sugar together until light and fluffy.
Whisk the eggs, and gradually beat them into the butter mixture.
Mix in one third of the flour mixture, followed by half the banana. Continue alternating in this way until all the dry mixture and mashed banana is incorporated.
Stir in the walnuts.
Grease and line 2 loaf pans. Divide batter evenly between pans. Sprinkle the tops with additional turbinado sugar.

Bake at 350°F for at least 1 hour. After this point, check the banana bread every 10 minutes or so until it is done. It will be browned, and a skewer inserted into the center of the loaf should come out clean with no more than moist crumbs attached.
Let cool to room temperature in the pans. Unmold.

recipes.title: Plank-Grilled Salmon
recipes.description: Salmon grilled on a cedar plank, a common method traditional to the Native Americans of the Pacific Northwest of the United States and British Columbia in Canada.

steps.text: Preheat the grill or charcoal pit.
Combine the Worcestershire sauce, beer, garlic powder, and lemon pepper to make a marinade.
Add the salmon, and marinate for 15 minutes.
Remove the salmon from the marinade, and place on the plank skin side down. It should not hang over the edge.

Place the plank over the grill, and cook while watching carefully. A glass of water can be used to partially douse the fire when it gets too hot. As an alternative, a squirt-bottle or mister filled with water can douse any fire that commences on the plank. Individual planks give flexibility in moving to get all done evenly. Don't turn the fish on the plank; just move the plank(s) around, rotate, etc.
Remove the plank to onto a baking pan when the fish is cooked to the desired "doneness", and transfer to plates or a serving platter.

recipes.title: South Side Cocktail
recipes.description: A south side is an alcoholic beverage made with gin, lime juice, simple syrup and mint. A variant, the southside fizz, adds soda water.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients except mint into a cocktail shaker, fill shaker with ice, and shake well.
Open shaker and add mint, leaving 1 mint leaf around the size of your thumb for garnish.
Close cocktail shaker and roll the mint from one end of the shaker to the other to gently express the mint oils but to not bruise the mint.
Use a hawthorn strainer and a fine mesh strainer to filter the contents into a chilled cocktail coupe.
Garnish with the spare mint leaf you left aside.

recipes.title: No-Bake Chocolate Cake
recipes.description: A simple, no-bake chocolate cake made with margarine, cocoa, and crumbled biscuits.

ingredients.text: 2½ packs graham crackers, plain digestive biscuits, or whole wheat biscuits; crumbled
ingredients.name: herbatniki
ingredients.note: graham crackers, plain digestive biscuits, or whole wheat biscuits; crumbled

steps.text: Melt the margarine.
Mix the sugar and the egg.
Add the melted butter to the egg/sugar mixture.
Add the cocoa and the vanilla extract.
Add crumbled graham crackers. Mix well until all crackers are covered.
Line a cake pan with aluminum foil and pour in mixture.
Leave in refrigerator for 1 hour (preferably longer).
Unmold and serve.

recipes.title: Macaroni and Cheese (Vegan)
recipes.description: Macaroni and nutritional yeast is a vegan alternative to macaroni and cheese.

ingredients.text: 3 ½ cups water or rice milk, boiling
ingredients.name: woda

steps.text: Bring 4 quarts of water to a boil, add salt to taste, and add the macaroni.
Melt the margarine over low heat.
Beat in flour with a wire whisk. Continue to beat over medium heat until mixture is smooth and bubbly.
Whisk in the 3 ½ cups water.
Add salt, garlic powder, soy sauce, and turmeric to the liquid.
The sauce should cook until it thickens and bubbles.
When that happens, beat in nutritional yeast flakes; if the sauce is too thick, add more water.
When the macaroni is cooked, drain and add the sauce. Serve immediately.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Simple Biryani
recipes.description: A quick one-pan biryani with chicken, basmati rice, raisins and curry paste, made with only a few ingredients.

ingredients.text: 300 g basmati rice, soaked in warm water for 30 minutes
ingredients.name: ryż basmati
ingredients.note: soaked in warm water for 30 minutes

steps.text: Wash the rice with cold water until it runs clear.
Cook the onion, cardamom pods, bay leaves, and cinnamon in the butter for 10 minutes.
Add the chicken, turmeric, and curry paste, and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the rice and raisins and then the chicken stock.
Cover the pan tightly and bring to the boil.
Reduce the heat to low and cook for 5 minutes.
Remove from the heat and rest for 10 minutes, allowing the rice to absorb any remaining moisture.
Stir in half the coriander and serve with the rest sprinkled over the top.

recipes.title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
recipes.description: Słodkie ziemniaki zapiekane z jabłkami, rodzynkami i miodowo-maślaną polewą.

ingredients.text: 4 medium sweet potatoes, peeled and sliced
ingredients.name: batat

ingredients.text: 4 Granny Smith apples, peeled, cored, and sliced
ingredients.name: jabłko

steps.text: Arrange sliced sweet potatoes, apples, and raisins in a greased 2-quart baking dish.
Mix the liquids and butter together. Pour over the dish's contents.
Cover with foil and bake at 350°F for 30 to 45 minutes, until sweet potatoes are tender and glazed.

categories: Recipes using vegetable broth and stock

recipes.title: Potato and Leek Soup
recipes.description: A light soup that can be prepared from freezer to table in under 2 hours.

ingredients.text: 1 leek, white and light green parts only, sliced and rinsed well
ingredients.name: por
ingredients.note: white and light green parts only, sliced and rinsed well

ingredients.text: 1.25–1.5 pounds (2 large) russet or Yukon gold potatoes, peeled and diced
ingredients.name: ziemniak
ingredients.note: 1.5 pounds (2 large) russet or Yukon gold potatoes, peeled and diced

ingredients.text: A few sprigs each of parsley and thyme (optional), tied together
ingredients.name: natka pietruszki i tymianek

ingredients.text: 5 ounces lettuce leaves, washed and coarsely chopped (4 cups)
ingredients.name: liście sałaty

steps.text: In a large, heavy soup pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat and add the onion and leeks. Cook, stirring occasionally, for about 5 minutes until soft.
Add ½ teaspoon salt and the garlic. Cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute or until the garlic is aromatic.
Add the potatoes, stock, leek green, bay leaf, and parsley/thyme bundle. Bring to a simmer, and season with salt to taste.
Cover and cook for 45 minutes on low heat.
Add the lettuce, and simmer for another 15 minutes. The potatoes should be completely soft and fall apart when you press them.

Blend the soup until smooth with an immersion blender, blender, or food processor fitted with the steel blade (working in stages and covering the blender lid or food processor with a kitchen towel to keep the hot soup from spilling). If you want the soup to have a smoother, silkier texture, strain it through a medium sieve.
Return the soup to the boil, and season with salt and freshly ground pepper to taste.
Serve.

recipes.title: Applesauce Cake
recipes.description: Ciasto z sosem jabłkowym, rodzynkami i migdałami, doprawione goździkami, korzenną przyprawą i cynamonem.

ingredients.text: ½ cup (1 stick/125 g/4.4. oz) butter, plus extra for greasing
ingredients.name: masło

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180 C. Grease and line two round cake pans.
Cream butter and sugar in a mixing bowl until light and fluffy.
Mix in the raisins, flour, spices, almonds and applesauce.
Dissolve baking soda in hot water and stir into the batter.
Pour the batter into the prepared cake pans.
Bake for 45 minutes until golden.
Transfer the cakes to a wire rack and leave them to cool.

recipes.title: Homemade Pie Crust
recipes.description: Unlike with bread, pie crust and other pastries should be made in a way that minimizes the development of gluten.

ingredients.text: 30 ml (2 tablespoons) cold water (add 15 ml of water as needed)
ingredients.name: woda
ingredients.note: add 15 ml of water as needed

steps.text: Combine flour and salt in medium bowl.
Cut in vegetable shortening with a pastry blender or two knives, until mixture is crumbly.
Sprinkle with cold water; mix just until mixture holds together.
Shape dough into a ball; place on lightly floured surface.
Roll out dough to 3 mm (⅛ inch) thickness.
Line pie plate with pastry.
Trim around perimeter for 2 cm (1 inch) overhang to fold under and crimp as desired (see pie crust edges below).

recipes.title: Biscuits and Gravy
recipes.description: Biscuits and gravy is a dish enjoyed nearly everywhere in the United States, though it is most commonly associated with the southern states.

ingredients.text: ¼ tbsp (4 mL) ground black pepper
ingredients.name: pieprz czarny mielony

steps.text: Make 'cut' biscuit dough.
Place the cut biscuits in the oven when you add the bacon grease to the skillet in the gravy procedure below (step 3).
Remove from oven after 10 to 12 minutes; the biscuits should be warm when served with the gravy.
Brown the sausage in a large skillet.
Remove the browned sausage from the skillet and reserve in a bowl, being careful to leave as much of the drippings as possible in the pan.
Add the bacon grease to the skillet, and place the skillet on low to medium-low heat.
Once the bacon grease is up to temperature, mix the flour into the grease.
Add the milk slowly, mixing as you pour.
Bring to a gentle boil, stirring constantly scraping the bottom and edges of the skillet. Stirring keeps the gravy from becoming too lumpy or burnt.
Continue stirring until the gravy has nearly reached the desired consistency, usually about 10 minutes.
Add the browned sausage held in reserve.
Remove from heat and allow to set for 1 minute.
Serve with biscuits.

recipes.title: Simple Ayurvedic Sprout Salad
recipes.description: A simple and tasty salad made from a variety of sprouts and vegetables.

ingredients.text: 1 cup fresh mung bean sprouts (sprout your own and use them when the sprouts are about ½ inch long)
ingredients.name: kiełki fasoli mung
ingredients.note: sprout your own and use them when the sprouts are about ½ inch long

ingredients.text: ½ cup peeled, deseeded, diced cucumber
ingredients.name: ogórek

steps.text: Combine the veggies and sprouts in a glass bowl.
Whisk together the salt, pepper, lemon juice, and olive oil in a separate bowl. Add to the salad and toss well to mix.
Garnish with the cilantro and sunflower seeds, and serve at room temperature or cool.

recipes.title: Bacon-Wrapped Scallops
recipes.description: Scallops wrapped in bacon, deep-fried until golden and tossed in a soy-teriyaki sauce.

ingredients.text: 1 quart (1 liter) vegetable oil for frying
ingredients.name: olej roślinny

steps.text: Heat oil in a deep-fryer or other pot to 350 °F (180 °C), making sure that the pot is large enough that the oil doesn't fill it more than halfway.
Combine teriyaki glaze, soy sauce and sugar in a medium bowl. Set aside.
Cut bacon strips in half lengthwise.
Wrap each scallop with one of these half strips of bacon, and secure by skewering with a wooden toothpick.
Working in batches so as not to crowd the fryer, fry the scallops until golden brown, about 4 minutes.
Remove from oil, drain briefly and toss in the soy-teriyaki sauce.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Hobo Burgers
recipes.description: Hobo burgers are a camping classic. Wrapping the meal in cabbage leaves helps to preserve moisture and prevent burning.

steps.text: Mix Worcestershire sauce into beef.
Cut four large sheets of heavy duty aluminium foil and place a cabbage leaf onto the shiny side of each one.
Shape beef into 4 patties and place onto cabbage leaves.
Top each portion with onion and potato slices, add a pat of butter, and season with salt and pepper.
Wrap another cabbage leaf around the top of each portion and seal each package.
Place on medium-hot coals for about 20–30 minutes, turning twice (carefully) while cooking.
Discard cabbage leaves if they become charred during cooking.

recipes.title: Carrot and Raisin Salad
recipes.description: A simple salad of shredded carrots and raisins dressed with citrus zest and juice.

steps.text: Mix carrots with raisins in a bowl.
Add approximately 1 teaspoon of finely-grated lemon and orange zest, then add the juices.
Add sugar or honey to taste, and toss everything together well.
Refrigerate and serve.

recipes.title: Christmas biscuits
recipes.description: Christmas cookies are traditional biscuits generally used during the holiday season. They are quick and easy to make and can be cut into any shape with cookie cutters.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Mix all the ingredients together, in any order, to make a dough.
Cool dough in a refrigerator for 1 hour.
Flatten dough with a rolling pin.
Cut out desired shapes with a cookie cutter.
Bake for 10 minutes.
Cool.

recipes.title: Turkey Biscuit
recipes.description: Leftover turkey baked in a creamy sauce under a layer of biscuits, designed for use after a holiday meal.

steps.text: Sauté the onion until tender.
Combine in a small bowl all the other ingredients except the cheese and biscuits.
Stir this mixture, then place it into a baking dish, and bake for 15 minutes at 350°F until it is quite warm throughout.
Remove the baked mixture from the oven and sprinkle the shredded cheese on it.
Add a layer of frozen biscuits on top of this. Bake for about 20–30 minutes longer.
Serve.

recipes.title: Palaver Sauce
recipes.description: A West African (especially Liberian) stew of meat, fish and greens, usually eaten with rice or starches such as yam.

ingredients.text: 1 lb meat (e.g. stew beef), cut into ½-inch cubes
ingredients.name: wołowina gulaszowa
ingredients.note: e.g. stew beef, cut into ½-inch cubes

ingredients.text: ½ teaspoon salt or to taste
ingredients.name: sól

ingredients.text: 1 medium-size dried red chile pepper, ground
ingredients.name: suszona czerwona papryczka chili

ingredients.text: 1 lb frozen tilapia or cod fillet (or other firm white fish; optional)
ingredients.name: mrożony filet z tilapii lub dorsza
ingredients.note: frozen; or cod fillet or other firm white fish; optional

ingredients.text: 1 cup palm oil or vegetable oil
ingredients.name: olej palmowy

ingredients.text: 3 lb mixed chopped greens (e.g. kale, spinach, or mustard leaves)
ingredients.name: mieszanka zielonych liści
ingredients.note: chopped; e.g. kale, spinach, or mustard leaves

steps.text: Combine the beef, 1 cup water, and salt. Sprinkle some of the onions, garlic, and red pepper over the beef. Bring to a boil over medium heat, then cover and cook for about 15 minutes.
Add the remaining onions and red pepper, along with the tomatoes, tomato paste, fish, salt cod, and palm oil. Cook for about 5–10 minutes.
Add the chopped greens, then stir well and let it simmer over medium heat for another few minutes.
While the sauce simmers, clean the smoked fish, removing the head, skin, and bones. If you notice the sauce is boiling you can reduce the heat.
Gently put the smoked fish into the saucepan, and let it simmer uncovered.
Grind the agushi seed in a blender with an equal amount of water. Transfer the mixture to the saucepan along with the bay leaves.
Try to avoid stirring the contents at this point, and leave the saucepan to simmer for about another 10 minutes.
Uncover the saucepan and mix the sauce. After that, continue to simmer on low heat until majority of the liquid is gone.
Taste and adjust the seasonings as needed to your desired taste. Enjoy with any complimentary dish of your choice.

categories: Recipes using vegetable broth and stock

recipes.title: Egyptian Lentil Soup
recipes.description: Hearty and nutritious soup made with red lentils, aromatic spices, and a touch of tanginess from lemon juice.

ingredients.text: Fresh parsley or cilantro, chopped (for garnish)
ingredients.name: natka pietruszki

steps.text: In a large pot or Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the finely chopped onion to the pot and sauté until it becomes translucent and slightly golden.
Stir in the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant.
Add the rinsed red lentils to the pot and stir to coat them with the onion and garlic mixture.
Sprinkle the ground cumin, ground coriander, ground paprika, and ground turmeric over the lentils. Stir well to combine and coat the lentils with the spices.
Pour in the vegetable broth or water, ensuring that the lentils are fully submerged.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and cover the pot. Let the soup simmer for about 20–25 minutes or until the lentils are tender and fully cooked.
Using a blender, purée the soup until smooth and creamy. If using a regular blender, allow the soup to cool slightly before blending, and be careful when transferring hot liquids.
Return the soup to the pot and place it back over low heat.
Stir in the lemon juice and season the soup with salt and pepper to taste. Adjust the seasoning according to your preference.
Continue to heat the soup for a few more minutes until it is warmed through.
Ladle the soup into bowls and garnish with chopped parsley or cilantro. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Whole Wheat Pancakes (Vegan)
recipes.description: Vegan whole wheat pancakes sweetened with brown sugar or jaggery and flavored with cinnamon.

steps.text: Mix together flour, baking powder, and sugar.
Mix soy milk into the dry mixture.
Heat a griddle until water sprinkled on it quickly evaporates. Spread a thin film of oil on the griddle.
Pour pancake batter on griddle to form 2–3-inch circles. Bubbles should start forming.
When the underside is light brown, flip the pancake.
When the other side is light brown, serve.

recipes.title: Brown Sugar Nutmeg Cookies
recipes.description: Miękkie ciasteczka z brązowym cukrem i gałką muszkatołową, formowane w wałek i pieczone w plasterkach.

ingredients.text: 205 g shortening, melted and cooled slightly
ingredients.name: tłuszcz roślinny

steps.text: Combine flour, cream of tartar, baking soda and nutmeg in a bowl. Set aside.
Beat together in a large bowl the melted shortening and the brown sugar. Beat in the eggs, then the vanilla extract. Gradually blend in the dry ingredients.
Shape dough into a log measuring 1½ inches in diameter. Wrap log in waxed paper or foil and chill for 4 hours or overnight.
Preheat oven to 375°F (180°C). Lightly grease 2 baking sheets.
Slice log into slices ¼ inch thick. Place slices 1 inch apart on the baking sheets.
Bake for 8–10 minutes until lightly colored. Cool on wire racks.

recipes.title: Zereshk Palau (Iranian Rice with Barberries)
recipes.description: Zereshk Palau is an Iranian rice dish cooked with barberries.

steps.text: Soak dried barberries in water for 20–30 minutes.
Strain to remove any stones.
Sauté the chopped onion in a frying pan with a dash of oil.
Mix in the barberries, and cook over low heat.
Cook chicken on top of rice in a rice cooker.
When rice is done, fluff and put in a large bowl.
Grind saffron with mortar and pestle.
Mix in 1 teaspoon of water, then stir in some of the cooked rice.
Return the saffron rice to the main dish, and add the onion mixture.
Toss rice to mix well with other ingredients.
Serve with lavash or barbari bread.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Bouchée à la Reine
recipes.description: Klasyczna francuska przystawka z kurczakiem, pieczarkami i sosem śmietanowym w ciastku vol-au-vent.

ingredients.text: 4 oz small or medium button mushrooms
ingredients.name: pieczarka

steps.text: Place the chicken stock and the bouquet garni in a saucepan. Bring to a boil and allow to infuse 10–11 minutes.
Cut the chicken breasts into small dice.
Wash the mushrooms rapidly and cut in halves or quarters depending on the size.
In a sauteuse (or a frying pan), melt the butter on a medium-high heat and add the chopped shallot. Cook for about 1 minute stirring.
Add the flour and cook 1 petite minute, mixing with a whisk or a wooden spoon, without browning.
Add the chicken stock little by little and cook for 2 minutes, stirring.
Add the diced chicken and the mushrooms and cook for 5–6 minutes, stirring from time to time.
Preheat the oven to 350°F (gas mark 6) and bake the vol-au-vent shells for 5–10 minutes or as directed by the manufacturer, without burning them.

In a bowl, mix the cream with the egg yolk. Increase the heat under the sauteuse and add the egg yolk/cream mixture, beating to combine well with the sauce and lower the heat as soon as it reaches a boil. The sauce should be unctuous and should coat a spoon. Do not salt, only pepper.
Remove the vol-au-vents from the oven. Fill rapidly and serve without delay as they cool rapidly.

recipes.title: Zilzil Tibs (Spicy Ethiopian Beef Strips)
recipes.description: Zilzil tibs is a flavorful and tender Ethiopian dish made with marinated beef strips sautéed with aromatic spices and vegetables.

ingredients.text: 500 grams (1.1 lbs) beef sirloin or tenderloin, cut into thin strips
ingredients.name: polędwica wołowa

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons niter kibbeh (Ethiopian spiced clarified butter) or regular butter
ingredients.name: niter kibbeh (masło klarowane z przyprawami)
ingredients.note: Ethiopian spiced clarified butter, or regular butter

ingredients.text: ½ teaspoon cayenne pepper, or to taste
ingredients.name: pieprz cayenne

ingredients.text: Fresh cilantro or parsley, chopped, for garnish
ingredients.name: kolendra świeża lub pietruszka

steps.text: In a mixing bowl, combine the beef strips, sliced onions, minced garlic, grated ginger, niter kibbeh, berbere spice blend, paprika, cayenne pepper, cumin, coriander, cardamom, and salt. Mix well to ensure the beef is coated with the marinade.
Cover the bowl and let it marinate in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour, or overnight for more intense flavors.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet or frying pan over medium-high heat.

Add the marinated beef strips to the skillet, spreading them out in a single layer to ensure even cooking. Sauté for about 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the beef is browned and cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Add the sliced onions from the marinade to the skillet and cook for an additional 2–3 minutes until the onions become soft and slightly caramelized.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the beef and onions, and give it a final toss to incorporate the flavors.
Remove from heat and transfer to a serving dish.
Garnish with freshly chopped cilantro or parsley.
Serve hot as a main course, accompanied by injera (Ethiopian flatbread) or rice.

recipes.title: Quick and Delicious Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
recipes.description: A quick pineapple upside-down cake made with a yellow cake mix, brown sugar, pineapple rings and maraschino cherries.

steps.text: In a 9 x 13-inch pan, melt the butter or margarine.
Add the light brown sugar, and allow to melt.
Arrange pineapple slices in the pan, and place a maraschino cherry in each of the holes in the pineapple rings.
Sprinkle the crushed pecans over the pineapple slices.
Prepare the yellow cake mix as printed on the box, replacing some of the water with pineapple juice.
Pour cake batter over brown sugar and pineapple.
Bake according to the directions, until an inserted toothpick comes out clean.
Loosen cake around the edges, place a plate or serving tray over the cake, and turn the cake over.
Allow to cool before serving.

recipes.title: Almond Toffee Blondies
recipes.description: Batonikowe ciasto blondies z kawałkami kruszonego toffi migdałowego.

ingredients.text: ½ cup (120 g) packed brown sugar
ingredients.name: cukier trzcinowy brązowy

steps.text: Sift flour, baking powder and salt together.
Cream butter; add sugars and cream well.
Add eggs and vanilla; beat until fluffy.
Blend in dry ingredients.
Stir in chopped almond toffee.
Spread over bottom of well-greased 9 x 13-inch (18 x 30 cm) pan.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) for about 30 minutes.
When cool, cut into bars 3 inches (8 cm) long and 1 inch (2.5 cm) wide.
Serve warm with your favorite cold beverage.

recipes.title: Potato Meat Loaf
recipes.description: A layered baked casserole of potatoes, onion, ground beef and bulk sausage, topped with cheddar cheese soup.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Place sliced potatoes in baking dish.
Place sliced onion over potatoes in baking dish.
Combine all ingredients except cheddar cheese soup, and mix well.
Press into baking dish, forming an indentation in the middle.
Pour cheddar cheese soup in indentation.
Bake 1 hour at 350°F.
Stand 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread III
recipes.description: Pumpkin bread baked in two loaves, spiced with cinnamon, cloves and nutmeg, with optional chopped nuts.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Beat sugar and oil using electric hand mixer.
Add eggs and pumpkin and beat lightly.
Add flour, then baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, cloves, nutmeg, salt, and nuts if desired. Mix well.
Pour into two baking pans sprayed lightly with cooking spray.
Bake until toothpick comes out clean from the center, about 40–45 minutes.
Cool and serve.

recipes.title: Chop Rub
recipes.description: This rub is great on steak, pork, and chicken.

ingredients.text: 2 tsp hickory smoke powder (if you can't find this, use 2 drops liquid smoke in the dish.)
ingredients.name: proszek z wędzenia hikory
ingredients.note: if you can't find this, use 2 drops liquid smoke in the dish.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients and store in a cool, dark place in an airtight container.
