categories: Recipes using beef broth and stock

recipes.title: Mushroom Soup
recipes.description: A creamy, rich soup of mixed mushrooms thickened with a butter and flour roux and finished with sherry.

ingredients.text: 4 cups button mushrooms, sliced if large
ingredients.name: pieczarka

steps.text: In a large pot over medium heat, melt one stick of the butter.
Add ½ cup of the flour, stirring constantly, to form a roux.
Cook, continuing to stir constantly, until roux takes on a pale blond color, about 5 minutes.
Slowly stir in the beef stock.
Bring to a boil, stirring frequently.
Reduce heat to a simmer.
In a large saucepan over medium-high heat, melt the remaining stick of butter with the olive oil.
Add the portobellos, shiitakes, and button mushrooms and sauté until mushrooms are moist and tender, 5–10 minutes.
Remove pan from heat and dust mushrooms with the remaining ½ cup of flour, tossing gently to incorporate flour.
Combine mushrooms and beef stock in the large pot.
Stir in the sherry.
Cook, stirring occasionally, until flavors are melded and soup thickened slightly, about 10 minutes.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Kesari (South Indian Semolina Pudding)
recipes.description: Kesari or kesari baath is a sweet dessert dish that is traditionally prepared in South India for special occasions.

ingredients.text: ¾ cup jaggery or granulated sugar
ingredients.name: cukier

steps.text: Bring the water to a boil.
Soak the saffron in the warm milk.
Lightly toast the semolina in a deep-bottom pot. When the semolina is golden brown, add the boiling water, stirring continuously to avoid lumps.
Add the sugar, pineapple, and cardamom to the mix while stirring.
Keep stirring well, and cook on low heat until the mixture comes together well.
Heat the ghee or butter in a separate pan, add cashews, and fry to golden brown.
Add raisins and fry for a few seconds until they swell up.
Add the nuts and raisins to the kesari.
Add the saffron milk along with the saffron, and mix well.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Microwave Chocolate Cake I
recipes.description: A quick and easy chocolate cake recipe made in the microwave.

ingredients.text: 3 Tbsp vegetable oil (soybean or sunflower oils work best)
ingredients.name: olej roślinny
ingredients.note: soybean or sunflower oils work best

steps.text: Mix the dry ingredients well in a small bowl or large mug.
Add the egg and mix thoroughly.
Pour in the milk and oil and mix well.
Add vanilla essence and chocolate chips (if using), mix again.
Pour into two greased 9-inch round baking pans or keep in large mug.
Microwave on high for 3 minutes or until it stops rising.
Allow to cool a little; tip out onto a plate if desired.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Risotto alla Milanese
recipes.description: Klasyczne włoskie risotto z szafranem, masłem i parmezanem, podawane jako dodatek.

ingredients.text: Chopped fresh parsley, fresh parsley sprig, and tomato slices for garnish (optional)
ingredients.name: natka pietruszki

steps.text: Crush saffron in mortar with pestle to a powder. Place saffron in glass measuring cup.
Bring broth to a boil in small saucepan over medium heat; reduce heat to low.
Stir ½ cup broth into saffron to dissolve; set aside. Keep remaining broth hot.
Heat 6 tablespoons butter in large, heavy skillet or 2½-quart saucepan over medium heat until melted and bubbly.
Cook and stir onion 5 minutes or until onion is soft.
Stir in rice; cook and stir 2 minutes.
Stir in wine, salt and pepper.
Cook, uncovered, over medium-high heat 3–5 minutes until wine has evaporated, stirring occasionally.
Measure ½ cup hot broth; stir into rice mixture. Reduce heat to medium-low, maintaining a simmer throughout adding broth.
Cook and stir until broth has absorbed. Repeat, adding ½ cup broth 3 more times, cooking and stirring until broth has absorbed.
Add saffron-flavored broth to rice and cook until absorbed.

Continue to add remaining broth, ½ cup at a time, cooking and stirring until rice is tender but firm and mixture has slight creamy consistency. Not all broth may be necessary. Total cooking time of rice will be about 20 minutes.
Remove risotto from heat.
Stir in remaining 1 tablespoon butter and cheese.
Garnish, if desired.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Mushroom Soup (Gabi Supa)
recipes.description: A creamy mushroom soup thickened with flour and butter, finished with milk, lemon juice and parsley.

ingredients.text: 1 pound fresh mushrooms, sliced if too big
ingredients.name: pieczarka

ingredients.text: 2 cubes of mushroom base (bouillon) plus 1 cup of noodles OR 1 cube and 1 package of ramen-type mushroom noodle soup
ingredients.name: kostka bulionu grzybowego
ingredients.note: plus 1 cup of noodles OR 1 cube and 1 package of ramen-type mushroom noodle soup

ingredients.text: The juice of ½–1 lemon, or to taste
ingredients.name: cytryna
ingredients.note: juice of ½–1 lemon, or to taste

steps.text: In a pot, fry the flour in the melted butter until slightly golden (about 3 minutes).
Add the water and stir until smooth.
Add the milk, the mushrooms, and the cube(s) of soup base.
Boil for less than 10 minutes or until the mushrooms are cooked but not soft.
Add the noodles and boil until cooked.
Take the pot off the burner, add the lemon juice, the parsley, and more milk if you like the soup to be less thick.

recipes.title: Orange Cardamom Pancakes
recipes.description: Puszyste naleśniki na maślance z skórką pomarańczową i kardamonem.

steps.text: Heat a large non-stick skillet or griddle over low heat while preparing ingredients.
Mix flour, sugar, salt, baking powder, and baking soda in medium bowl.
Whisk orange zest and ground cardamom into dry ingredients.
Microwave buttermilk and milk in a 2-cup Pyrex measuring cup to room temperature, 20–30 seconds.
Whisk in egg, butter, and vanilla.
Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients and whisk until just mixed.
Return batter to measuring cup, stirring in a teaspoon or two of water, if necessary, to make a thick, but pourable batter.
Increase heat to medium and generously brush skillet or griddle with oil.
When oil starts to spider, but before it starts to smoke, pour batter, about ¼ cup at a time.
Work in batches, if necessary, to avoid overcrowding.
When pancake bottoms are golden brown and tops start to bubble (2 to 3 minutes), flip pancakes.
Cook until pancakes are golden brown on remaining side.
Repeat, brushing skillet or griddle with oil.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Pecan Spinach Pasta
recipes.description: Makaron z orzechami pekan i szpinakiem, z dodatkiem czosnku, cebuli i płatków chili.

ingredients.text: 1 pack of frozen spinach, or, better, a moderate amount of fresh spinach
ingredients.name: szpinak

ingredients.text: Crushed red pepper flakes, to taste
ingredients.name: płatki chili

ingredients.text: 1 cup feta cheese or feta substitute (optional)
ingredients.name: ser feta

steps.text: Bring a pan of water to a boil and once it has a good rolling boil, put in the pasta.
Start checking the pasta about 2 minutes before the time specified on the package by tasting a piece; it should be al dente. Drain the pasta once it's done.
While the pasta is cooking, combine the olive oil, red pepper flakes, and garlic in a cold skillet. Put them on medium heat.
After a brief amount of time, add the onion slices.
Once the onion is slightly browned, add the pecan halves and sauté them for two minutes.
Add the spinach.
Once the spinach is done, add salt.
Put the sauce on the drained pasta and serve.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie
recipes.description: A chilled pie with a peanut butter and cream cheese filling, layered with hot fudge and whipped topping.

ingredients.text: 8 ounces cream cheese, at room temperature
ingredients.name: serek śmietankowy

ingredients.text: 1 cup plus 2 tablespoons smooth peanut butter
ingredients.name: masło orzechowe
spód do ciasta z ciastek czekoladowych

ingredients.text: 1 jar (11.75 ounces) plus 2 tablespoons hot fudge topping
ingredients.name: gorący sos czekoladowy fudge

steps.text: In a medium bowl, stir together cream cheese, peanut butter and sugar.
Carefully stir in 3 cups of the whipped topping.
Spoon into pie shell.
Softly spread mixture to edges of the pie shell.
Put all but 2 tablespoons of hot fudge topping in a microwave-safe container and microwave for 60 seconds.
Spread hot fudge topping over peanut butter mixture in pie shell to cover.
Place in refrigerator for 2 hours.
Spread remaining ~1½ cups whipped topping carefully over top of refrigerated pie.
Knead last 2 ounces of hot fudge topping in plastic bag and cut off a corner and drizzle over top of pie.
Knead last 2 ounces of peanut butter in plastic bag and cut off a corner and drizzle over top in an artful pattern.

recipes.title: Spelt Yellow Cake
recipes.description: A recipe for a spelt cake, an ancient-wheat alternative to yellow cake.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 175°C (350°F).
Cream the butter and sugar together until fluffy.
Beat in the eggs.
Mix in vanilla.
Gradually sift in the dry ingredients, alternating with small additions of the milk.
Transfer to a greased and floured baking pan.
Bake at 175°C (350°F), until a skewer inserted shows no moist crumbs; approximately 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Curry Fried Rice
recipes.description: Smażony ryż curry z wołowiną sukiyaki, kurczakiem i kiełkami fasoli.

ingredients.text: 100 g bean sprouts, soaked in hot water
ingredients.name: kiełki fasoli

steps.text: Heat the oils in a non-stick frying pan. Add the garlic and scallion, and fry until fragrant.
Add sukiyaki beef and chicken. Cook, stirring, for 1 minute until golden brown.
Add bean sprouts, basmati rice, chilli powder and curry powder.
Add soy sauce, salt, and pepper. Stir until well-mixed.

recipes.title: Coronation Chicken
recipes.description: Chicken in a creamy curry mayonnaise with apricot, based on the 1956 'official' recipe for Coronation Chicken.

ingredients.text: 1 ea. (2.3 kg / 5 lb) chicken, poached (or other cooked chicken)
ingredients.name: kurczak gotowany
ingredients.note: 2.3 kg / 5 lb, poached (or other cooked chicken)

steps.text: Skin the chicken if needed, and cut it into small pieces. Traditionally the chicken is cooked whole in advance, but alternatively you can use raw chicken and grill the chicken pieces at this point.
In a small saucepan, warm a small amount of vegetable oil.
Add the onion to the pan and cook gently until soft (about 3 minutes).
Add the curry paste, tomato puree, wine, bay leaf and lemon juice. Simmer uncovered for about 10 minutes until well-reduced. Strain and leave to cool.
Purée the chopped apricots in a blender or processor. Beat the cooled sauce into the mayonnaise with the apricot purée.
Whip the cream to stiff peaks, and fold into the mixture.
Season with salt and pepper, and a little lemon juice if necessary.
Fold in the chicken pieces, garnish with watercress, and serve.

recipes.title: Chleb na pyrach
recipes.description: Staropolski chleb na ziemniakach, pieczony w piecu opalanym drewnem sosnowym.

ingredients.text: 1,5 do 2,5 l wody, maślanki lub kwaśnego mleka
ingredients.name: woda
ingredients.note: 1,5 do 2,5 l wody, maślanki lub kwaśnego mleka

steps.text: Zalać resztkę pozostawionego z uprzedniego wypieku ciasta wodą, maślanką lub kwaśnym mlekiem i pozostawić na 24 godziny.
Obrać ziemniaki, ugotować, podusić, zalać wodą lub mlekiem (może być rozcieńczone wodą mleko) i dodać część mąki i drożdże.
Tak przygotowane rzadkie ciasto połączyć z zakwasem i odstawić na noc.
Wyrobić ciasto dosypując stopniowo pozostałą część mąki i pozostawić do wyrośnięcia w ciepłym miejscu na około 3 godziny.
Uformować bochen i piec przez 2 godziny.

recipes.title: Chickpea Moi Moi
recipes.description: Nigerian steamed chickpea purée with onion, chiles, crayfish and nutmeg.

steps.text: Soak the chickpeas for 3 hours, then drain and peel them.
Blend the peeled chickpeas with chopped onions, chiles, and crayfish with warm water. Work in batches if needed.
Transfer the purée to a bowl, and mix in the salt, oil, and nutmeg.
Divide the mixture into molds, and place in a steamer over boiling water.
Steam for 40 minutes. Remove from the steamer and unmold.

recipes.title: Fool's Gold Loaf
recipes.description: Whole French loaf filled with margarine, bacon, peanut butter and jelly, a favorite of Elvis Presley.

ingredients.text: 1 jar of grape jelly (US) or jam (UK)
ingredients.name: dżem

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Spread the margarine generously all over all sides of the loaf. Place it on a baking sheet in the oven.
Meanwhile, fry the bacon in a bit of oil until it is crisp, and drain it thoroughly on paper towels.
Remove the loaf from the oven when it is evenly browned, after approximately 15 minutes.
Slice the loaf lengthwise and hollow out the interior, leaving as much bread along the walls as desired.
Slather a thick layer of peanut butter in the cavity of the loaf and follow with another thick layer of grape jelly. Use lots of both.
Arrange the bacon slices inside the cavity, or, if desired, layer the bacon slivers between the peanut butter and jelly. Close the loaf, slice and eat.

recipes.title: Sockerdricka (Swedish Ginger Drink)
recipes.description: Sockerdricka (Swedish for "sugar drink") is a soft drink from the 19th century. It is traditionally a fermented drink that contains ginger, but modern commercial versions consist of carbonated water, some sugar, and citric acid.

steps.text: Boil the sugar, water, lemon and crushed ginger for 15 minutes.
Strain the mixture and let it cool.
Mix in the yeast and let the mixture ferment for 2 days.
Put the drink in bottles, and add a raisin to each bottle.
Cork the bottles, and let rest for 5 days. After 5 days the sockerdricka is ready for drinking.

recipes.title: Hot and Spicy Dip
recipes.description: Ostry dip na bazie domowego majonezu z dodatkiem keczupu, chrzanu i sosu Worcestershire.

ingredients.text: 2 eggs OR 4 soft-boiled egg yolks OR 3 oz egg substitute with lecithin
ingredients.name: jajko
ingredients.note: OR 4 soft-boiled egg yolks OR 3 oz egg substitute with lecithin

ingredients.text: 2 Tbsp sweet pickle relish or chutney
ingredients.name: relish ogórkowy słodki

steps.text: Combine the eggs, lemon juice and salt in a blender.
Blend briefly.
While motor is running, add oil in a slow, steady stream until the mixture has emulsified into a mayonnaise.
Transfer to a bowl and add the remaining ingredients.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock
Recipes using vegetable broth and stock

recipes.title: Butternut Squash Soup
recipes.description: A smooth soup of roasted butternut squash and onions, flavored with garlic, cream sherry and nutmeg.

ingredients.text: 4 cups chicken stock or vegetable stock
ingredients.name: bulion drobiowy

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400 °F.
Cut squash in half lengthwise and remove seeds.
Rub onions and squash with olive oil.
Bake uncovered for about 1 hour or until done.
Cool slightly.
Spoon squash pulp into a food processor.
Add onions and 1–2 cups of chicken stock.
Purée until smooth.
Pour into cooking pot.
Add garlic, sherry and nutmeg, and stir over medium heat.
Add remaining stock and cook until hot.
Season to taste.

recipes.title: Watergate Salad
recipes.description: A dessert salad of crushed pineapple, instant pistachio pudding, mandarin oranges, marshmallows and whipped topping.

ingredients.text: 2 small cans of mandarin oranges, drained
ingredients.name: mandarynka
ingredients.catalogName: Mandarynki z puszki w lekkim syropie

ingredients.text: 1 large tub whipped cream or Cool Whip
ingredients.name: bita śmietana

recipes.title: Kunun Tamba (Finger Millet Porridge)
recipes.description: Kunun tamba is a porridge made from finger millet. It is common in the northern part of Nigeria.

steps.text: Wash the tamba and dry with a clean cloth.
Mix tamba with ginger. Grind the mixture until smooth.
Allow the ground mixture to cool down, then sieve the chaff to give a fine texture.
Boil water in a pot and add the tamba powder gradually, stirring gently to make a smooth mixture.
Add milk and sugar, then whisk until smooth and lump-free.

recipes.title: Potage Parmentier (zupa z pora i ziemniaków)
recipes.description: Klasyczna francuska zupa z pora i ziemniaków, podawana na gorąco lub na zimno.

ingredients.text: 3–4 cups (~1 lb / 450 g) sliced leeks or onions
ingredients.name: por

ingredients.text: 3–4 cups (700–900 g / 2 lb) floury potatoes (e.g. Idaho, Maris Piper), peeled and thickly sliced
ingredients.name: ziemniak mączysty
ingredients.note: floury (e.g. Idaho, Maris Piper), peeled and thickly sliced; 700–900 g / 2 lb

ingredients.text: 2 tbsp table salt or 1 tbsp sea/rock salt
ingredients.name: sól
ingredients.note: table salt or 1 tbsp sea/rock salt

ingredients.text: White pepper, freshly ground, to taste
ingredients.name: pieprz biały mielony

ingredients.text: 1–2 cups (up to 450 g / 1 lb) vegetables (optional), thinly sliced
ingredients.name: warzywa
ingredients.note: optional, thinly sliced; up to 450 g / 1 lb

ingredients.text: 1–2 handfuls flat-leaf parsley or watercress (optional), rough chopped
ingredients.name: natka pietruszki

steps.text: If using leeks, remove the roots and dark green leaves; wash twice as long as you think necessary to remove the grit.
Place the vegetables, water and salt in a pot and bring to a boil.
Lower the heat and gently simmer (partially covered) for 45–50 minutes. The soup is done when you can easily mash the vegetables against the side of the pot.
Puree the soup using a food mill fitted with the fine disc. Optionally, pulse it in a blender just until smooth and pass through a fine sieve.
Chill the soup if it is to be served cold, or gently reheat it to a simmer. Refrigerate any left-overs. It will keep for days if refrigerated in a covered container as soon as it cools.

Add 1½–2 tsp cream (or whole milk) per portion just before serving. You’ll need more cream if you’re serving the soup hot or if it’s a bit watery; the idea is to create a smooth, silky puree, but you don’t want the taste or mouth feel of the cream to predominate. Taste and adjust for salt and pepper.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Pancetta Fusilli with Herb Shallot Cream
recipes.description: Fusilli pasta tossed in a shallot and herb cream sauce with crisp pancetta and Parmesan.

ingredients.text: 1 cup tightly packed herbs (rosemary, sage, thyme, marjoram, parsley, basil)
ingredients.name: zioła
ingredients.note: tightly packed: rosemary, sage, thyme, marjoram, parsley, basil

steps.text: Place pancetta in a large sauté pan and cook over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally until crisp.
Using a slotted spoon remove pancetta from pan and drain on paper towels. Set aside. Pour off all but 1 tbsp of the fat.
Add butter to the fat in the pan. Add garlic, shallots and sugar and season lightly with salt and pepper. Reduce heat to lowest setting and cook covered until shallots are soft and transparent.
Remove lid, raise heat to medium high and cook, stirring constantly, until they have a deep golden-brown coating. Do not allow to burn.

Add the stock and simmer until reduced by one-third, stirring to loosen brown bits from bottom of pan. The sauce can be prepared up to this point several hours ahead and kept covered in the refrigerator.

Bring a large pot of water to a boil for the pasta. Reheat the shallot mixture if it was prepared in advance. If using, add cream to shallots and simmer for 2 minutes over high heat until sauce thickens slightly. Keep warm. Coarsely chop all but a small handful of herbs.
Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain and return to pot. Add chopped herbs to sauce and cook for another minute. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

Add pasta to sauce and toss together over low heat for 1 minute. As pasta and sauce heat, sauté remaining herbs in ½ tsp olive oil until crisp for garnish. Stir in pancetta and ½ cup of the grated cheese.
Divide the pasta among 4 bowls. Garnish with sautéed herbs. Serve remaining cheese on the side.

recipes.title: Cucumber and Buttermilk Soup
recipes.description: A cold tangy soup, refreshing and unique.

steps.text: Peel cucumbers.
Dice into ¼-inch dice.
Finely chop scallions.
Mix everything together.

recipes.title: Béchamel Sauce (Louisiannaise)
recipes.description: Sauce béchamel is one of the basic sauces of French Cuisine. This variation is used in Louisiana for seafood dishes, especially crab meat.

ingredients.text: ¼ ea. onion or 2 garlic cloves
ingredients.name: cebula

steps.text: Warm the milk, then add the onion and bay leaf.
Steep for 15 minutes.
Melt the butter in a saucepan.
Whisk in the flour, and cook on medium to medium-high heat to make a roux.
Gradually whisk in the milk.
Cook, stirring constantly, until thick.
Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Cornbread I
recipes.description: Cornbread is a type of quick bread made of cornmeal and sometimes supplemented with wheat flour.

ingredients.text: ¼ cup (60 g / 2.1 oz) shortening, melted
ingredients.name: tłuszcz roślinny do ciasta

ingredients.text: ¼ cup (55 g / 1.9 oz) white granulated sugar (optional)
ingredients.name: cukier

ingredients.text: ½ of a 15 oz can whole corn kernels, drained (optional)
ingredients.name: kukurydza

steps.text: Preheat oven to 425 F. Grease an 8 in baking pan.
Combine cornmeal, flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar in a large mixing bowl.
Add egg, milk, and shortening.
Beat until fairly smooth (about a minute).
If using corn and/or onion, fold in these ingredients.
Pour the mixture into the baking pan.
Bake for 20–25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. If corn is added to batter, increase time by ~50%.
Serve hot!

recipes.title: Candied Yams
recipes.description: Sweet potatoes boiled, cubed and baked in a brown sugar and vanilla syrup, a dish from United States Thanksgiving cooking.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350 °F (175 °C).
Boil yams in skins until about half done.
Drain water from yams, remove skins, and cut in cubes.
Place yam cubes in a greased baking dish and dot with margarine.
Make a syrup by boiling brown sugar, water, and vanilla together. Pour over the yams.
Bake for 45 to 50 minutes, basting frequently with syrup, until yams are tender.

recipes.title: Communion Wafers
recipes.description: Simple unleavened wafers made from flour and water, baked in a hot oven.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 450°F (230°C).
Knead together the water and flour in a bowl to get a smooth dough.
Divide the dough into 4 equally sized portions.
Divide each of the 4 equally sized portions into four smaller portions for a total of 16 portions.
Roll each of the 16 small portions into small balls.
Flatten each of the small portions into small, thin, flat disks. If desired, use a butter knife to cut a small cross onto each wafer.
Bake the wafers for 3 minutes.
Take the wafers out of the oven and flip them over using a spoon or chopstick.
Bake the wafers for another 3 minutes.
Take the wafers out of the oven and let them cool.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies (Vegan)
recipes.description: Vegan chocolate chip cookies made with shortening, margarine, brown sugar and banana.

ingredients.text: 2 cups flour (whole wheat pastry flour recommended but all-purpose white also works)
ingredients.name: mąka pszenna
ingredients.note: whole wheat pastry flour recommended but all-purpose white also works

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C).
Cream shortening, margarine, and sugar together in a mixer.
Add banana to the sugar and butter mixture.
Mix all the dry ingredients together. Slowly add to the wet mixture.
Add chocolate chips.
Roll small portions of dough into balls and place on a cookie sheet.
Bake for 10–11 minutes, or until slightly browned.

recipes.title: Snails with Garlic Butter (Escargots à la Bourguignonne)
recipes.description: Escargots à la bourguignonne is a French dish of snails with garlic butter.

ingredients.text: 24 snail shells, with snail serving dishes, and snail tongs OR 4 glazed indented earthenware snail serving dishes OR 24 small mushroom caps, trimmed and de-gilled
ingredients.name: muszla ślimaka
ingredients.note: alternatively: 4 glazed indented earthenware snail serving dishes, or 24 small mushroom caps, trimmed and de-gilled

ingredients.text: 24 small mushroom caps, trimmed and de-gilled
ingredients.name: pieczarka

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Drain and rinse the snails.
Combine the butter with the shallots, garlic, parsley, salt, and pepper, and blend well.
Sauté the mushroom caps, if using, in a small amount of garlic butter until cooked but still firm. Remove from the heat.

If using snail shells, place a snail in each shell and fill the rest of the space with garlic butter. If using a snail dish without the shells, place a snail in each indentation and fill the rest of the space with garlic butter. If using mushroom caps, place 2–3 snails in each cap and top with a generous amount of garlic butter.
Heat the snails in the oven for 5–7 minutes, and serve with copious quantities of French bread for soaking up the garlic butter.

recipes.title: Miyan Karkashi (Nigerian Sesame Leaf Soup)
recipes.description: Nigerian draw soup made from karkashi (sesame leaf), typically served in northern Nigeria with tuwo.

ingredients.text: ½ cup karkashi leaves, either fresh or dried and ground
ingredients.name: liść karkashi
ingredients.note: either fresh or dried and ground

steps.text: Grind the karkashi leaves to a paste.
Bring the water to boil in a pot, and stir in the fermented locust beans.
Add the fish and meat, and cook for 5–7 minutes.
Add the karkashi leaf paste along with the potash. Stir, and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the seasoning cube. Continue stirring with a whisk for 3 minutes until the mixture is smooth.
Serve the soup with tuwo masara, tuwo dawa, tuwo alkama, or tuwo shinkafa.

images: Making matcha sponge cake at home 04.jpg

recipes.title: Yeasted Vanilla Sponge Cake
recipes.description: Sponge cake made with oil and yeast, so the eggs don't need separating or whipping; the batter is baked in a water bath at a low oven temperature.

ingredients.text: 90 g white granulated sugar (adjust amount to taste)
ingredients.name: cukier

ingredients.text: A dash of vanilla extract (adjust to taste, optional)
ingredients.name: ekstrakt waniliowy

steps.text: Crack the eggs into the mixing bowl, and beat them to homogenize.
Mix in the sugar until well-distributed.
Mix in the oil, then the milk.
Sift in the flour, and mix just until incorporated.
Mix in the yeast powder.
Transfer the batter to a cake pan lined with baking paper. Place the cake pan into the larger baking tray, and place them into the oven.
Pour the hot water into the larger baking tray to make a water bath about 1–2 cm deep.
Set the oven to 150°C, and bake for 65 minutes or until a skewer inserted into the center comes out with no batter on it.
Remove the cake pan, and let it cool.
Unmold the cake, and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Moussaka (Bulgarian)
recipes.description: Moussaka is a Bulgarian minced meat dish, resembling a casserole. It's delicious with cold yogurt on the side.

ingredients.text: ½ kg minced meat (usually pork in Bulgaria, but don't hesitate to experiment!)
ingredients.name: mięso mielone
ingredients.note: usually pork in Bulgaria, but don't hesitate to experiment!

ingredients.text: 1 kg potatoes, peeled and finely chopped
ingredients.name: ziemniak

steps.text: Fry the onion and the minced meat in a little oil until the meat is cooked. The fattier the meat is, the less oil you need.
Combine meat and onions with the potatoes, tomatoes, and parsley. Add salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer to a baking dish. Bake for about 1 hour, or until the potatoes are cooked.
Stir the eggs, the yogurt and the flour together and pour it over the dish. Bake for 10 more minutes.

recipes.title: Spanish Flan
recipes.description: Karmelowy krem jajeczny (flan) przygotowany z mleka skondensowanego i odparowanego oraz jajek.

steps.text: Heat oven to 375°F.
Combine all ingredients except caramel topping in blender.
Blend for 2 minutes.
Place a thin layer of caramel topping on bottom of a round pie pan.
Pour egg mixture on top of caramel topping.
Place the smaller pie pan in a larger pan filled with enough water so that it comes about 1 inch up the side of the smaller pan. This will act as a bain marie and stop the flan from burning.
Place both pans in oven. Cook for 1 hour or until center is firm.
Remove from oven and let cool.
Place a round dish over the top of the smaller pan, and flip it over to unmold it.
The flan can be served on the dish.

categories: Recipes using vegetable broth and stock

recipes.title: Galician Garbanzo Soup
recipes.description: Fast and cheap, this soup will warm you on a cold day!

ingredients.text: 3 cans (45 oz / 1.26 kg) garbanzo beans, divided
ingredients.name: ciecierzyca z puszki

ingredients.text: 4½ cups vegetable broth or water (or a combination), divided
ingredients.name: bulion warzywny
ingredients.note: vegetable broth or water (or a combination), divided

ingredients.text: 1 small waxy potato (yellow Finn or Yucon gold), diced (~1 cup)
ingredients.name: ziemniak
ingredients.note: small waxy (yellow Finn or Yucon gold), diced (~1 cup)

ingredients.text: ½ cup green peas (fresh or frozen)
ingredients.name: groszek zielony

ingredients.text: 2 medium-sized ripe tomatoes, peeled and seeded or 1 cup chopped canned tomatoes
ingredients.name: pomidor
ingredients.note: medium-sized ripe, peeled and seeded, or 1 cup chopped canned tomatoes

ingredients.text: Freshly ground black pepper and cayenne pepper, to taste
ingredients.name: pieprz czarny mielony

steps.text: Rinse and thoroughly drain garbanzo beans. Place about ⅔ of them in a blender or food processor with 2 cups of broth and/or water, and purée until mostly smooth. Set aside.
Place a soup pot or Dutch oven over medium heat and wait for about a minute. Add olive oil and swirl to coat the pan.
Add onion and sauté over medium heat for about 5–8 minutes, or until onion is translucent.
Add half the garlic plus the potato, carrot, and celery and about ⅛ teaspoon salt, and sauté over medium-low heat for 5 to 8 minutes.
Add garbanzo purée, plus remaining broth and/or water and garbanzo beans, and the bay leaf, mustard, cumin, and saffron.
Bring to boil, then lower the heat.
Cover and simmer for about 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the remaining garlic, plus the peas, vinegar, and tomato.
Taste to correct salt.
Add black pepper and cayenne.
Simmer for only about 5 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Yellow Curry Paste
recipes.description: Pasta do żółtego curry w stylu tajskim, ucierana w moździerzu z trawy cytrynowej, imbiru, czosnku i szalotki.

ingredients.text: 6 red chilli peppers, seeded and chopped
ingredients.name: papryczka chili

steps.text: Toast the cumin and coriander seeds in a pan for 3–4 minutes. Set aside.
Grind lemongrass and ginger in a mortar, add chilli-peppers and salt, and grind for 4 minutes.
Add garlic and shallot and keep grinding.
Add the roasted cumin and coriander seeds and turmeric.
Add the trassi and grind to a fluid paste.
Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for storage (lasts 1 month).

recipes.title: Garlic, Tomato and Cheddar Sandwich
recipes.description: A delicious sandwich for breakfast and fast food.

ingredients.text: 5 long slices extra mature cheddar cheese
ingredients.name: ser cheddar

steps.text: Toast the two slices of brown bread, until one of the two is not soft anymore (the second one can be).
Rub the garlic clove on the hard piece of toasted bread, until only a little piece is left. Chop what's left, and scatter on the bread.
Cut the tomato in two, and crush each side on the same piece of bread. Then spread the juice, cut what's left of the tomato, and put it on the bread.
Add the olive oil, by being careful not to add more oil than there is bread.
Add the salt and pepper.
Slice or crush the chili, and scatter on the piece of bread.
Add the lemon juice.
Neatly add the slices of cheddar, then close the sandwich with the remaining piece of bread.

recipes.title: Lemon Curd
recipes.description: Lemon curd is a custard-like dessert sauce made with eggs, lemon juice and zest, sugar, and butter.

ingredients.text: ⅓ cup (80 g) white granulated sugar
ingredients.name: cukier

ingredients.text: 1 pinch salt (optional, to bring out sweetness and flavor of finished product)
ingredients.name: sól
ingredients.note: optional, to bring out sweetness and flavor of finished product

steps.text: Cut the butter into small chunks.
Put eggs, zest, sugar, and salt into saucepan.
Whisk ingredients in pan until frothy and light in color (1–2 minutes).
Add lemon juice and whisk for 30 seconds.
Add butter chunks.
Set pan on stove burner, turn on heat to medium-to-low, and start whisking contents so they don't coagulate or stick to bottom of pan.
Whisk constantly until butter melts and mixture thickens, then whisk another two minutes. Do not let mixture boil. It should be quite steamy (about 185°F / 85°C).
If desired, pour the mixture through the strainer to remove the zest and any other solids. Work the mixture through the strainer with the spatula; rake mixture off bottom of strainer into bowl.
Pour mixture from bowl into jar to within ¼ inch (0.75 cm) from top, taking care not to get mixture on rim, then seal jar with lid.
Refrigerate to thicken the product further. Store in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: Jamaican Banana Fritters
recipes.description: Jamaican banana fritters are a traditional dessert and snack dish in the Caribbean. They can be served by themselves, in a platter along with other fritters, or with different toppings, like cinnamon, coconut, or even ice cream.

steps.text: Peel the bananas and mash them in a bowl until runny.
Heat oil in a deep frying pan at medium heat.
Add the sugar, milk, vanilla, salt, and flour to the bananas and mix until approximately the consistency of pancake batter or a bit thinner.
Drop tablespoons of the mixture into the heated oil, and fry until edges are firm, then flip to cook other side until golden brown.
Drain on a towel and serve hot.

recipes.title: Backyard BBQ Chicken
recipes.description: BBQ chicken is always a barbecue favorite.

ingredients.text: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts and drumsticks
ingredients.name: pierś z kurczaka
ingredients.note: boneless skinless chicken breasts and drumsticks

steps.text: Combine dry ingredients and rub onto chicken.
Refrigerate 1 hour.
Combine liquid ingredients, bring to a boil, and simmer until reduced by ⅓.
Place on medium grill, and turn often, brushing with sauce when turned until interior temperature reaches 165 °F.
Let rest for 10 minutes; serve.

recipes.title: Albanian Mixed Vegetables (Turli perimesh)
recipes.description: Albanian mixed vegetables dish called Turli perimesh, made of various vegetables cut into pieces, sautéed and simmered together.

ingredients.text: 2 lbs of various vegetables (peppers, eggplant, okra, zucchini, potatoes, etc.)
ingredients.name: warzywa mieszane
ingredients.note: peppers, eggplant, okra, zucchini, potatoes, etc.

steps.text: Cut off inedible tips of vegetables. Wash and slice them into 1-inch squares.
Sauté vegetables in half the oil and remove them from the frying pan.
Sauté onion and tomatoes in the remaining oil, and season with parsley, salt, and pepper.
Put everything in a stock pot with a cup of water, cover tightly, and simmer until almost all moisture has cooked away.
Serve hot, accompanied by steak, meatballs, or any other main dish.

recipes.title: Barbecue Chicken Rub
recipes.description: Uniwersalna przyprawa do kurczaka w stylu teksańskim, która dobrze smakuje też na domowych chipsach.

ingredients.text: ¼ cup (35 g) dry mustard powder
ingredients.name: musztarda w proszku

ingredients.text: ¾ cup (140 g) turbinado or light brown sugar
ingredients.name: cukier turbinado lub jasny brązowy

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Oreo Pie
recipes.description: Frozen pie made with ice cream, Cool Whip and crushed Oreo cookies in crumb crusts.

ingredients.text: ½ gallon (1.9 litres) ice cream (usually vanilla)
ingredients.name: lody

ingredients.text: 3 crumb crusts (preferably Graham cracker or chocolate)
ingredients.name: spód do ciasta

steps.text: Begin by softening the ice cream enough to spread.
Mix the softened ice cream with the Cool Whip.
Crumble the Oreos. This can be done by putting the Oreos into a plastic bag and crushing them with a rolling pin.
Mix the Oreos into the ice cream mixture.
Spread the mixture evenly into the 3 pie crusts.
Freeze for at least 2 hours.

categories: Recipes using veal broth and stock

recipes.title: Bison à la Grecque
recipes.description: Bison à la grecque is a campfire fusion recipe for bison served with a velouté inspired by Mediterranean cuisine.

steps.text: Brown vegetables in bison fat in a cast iron Dutch oven.
Add bison, coriander, garlic, bay leaf, veal stock, and lemon. Cover and braise over a low fire 2–3 hours or longer until tender.
Remove bison to serving tray near fire. Strain sauce into separate bowl, and discard pulp.
Make a roux in the Dutch oven with butter and flour. Stir in wine and cream, and cook until bubbly. Stir in reserved sauce until thickened, adding more liquid as needed.
Season velouté to taste. Pour over bison.
Serve with toasted bread, wild mushrooms, and wild rice.

recipes.title: Madeleines
recipes.description: Małe francuskie ciastka pieczone w specjalnych formach nadających im kształt muszelki.

steps.text: Beat the eggs, sugar and salt in a mixing bowl until frothy.
Combine the flour, baking powder, and lemon zest, and fold into the egg mixture.
Fold in the melted butter.
Divide the dough into greased madeleine molds, keeping in mind that the dough will rise in the oven to fill the molds.
Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C / 350°F for 12–15 minutes until the cakes are springy but not browned.
Cool and unmold the madeleines.
Serve fresh.

recipes.title: Macaroni Salad
recipes.description: Chłodna sałatka z makaronem rurki w sosie majonezowo-musztardowym z cebulą i selerem.

ingredients.text: 1 lb elbow macaroni pasta, cooked, drained, and chilled
ingredients.name: makaron rurki

steps.text: Whisk together mayonnaise, mustard, sugar, and vinegar in small bowl.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Toss the pasta, onion, and celery in a large bowl.
Pour the dressing over top, and toss to combine.
Cool before serving.

recipes.title: Behari Kabab
recipes.description: Traditional Pakistani dish made with beef, lamb, or mutton marinated in spices and then grilled or baked.

ingredients.text: 1 pound beef, lamb, or mutton, cut into small pieces
ingredients.name: wołowina gulaszowa
ingredients.note: 1 pound (about 450 g) beef, lamb, or mutton, cut into small pieces

steps.text: In a small pan, dry roast the cumin seeds, coriander seeds, fennel seeds, and mustard seeds over medium heat until fragrant.
Grind the roasted spices in a spice grinder or with a mortar and pestle.
In a small bowl, combine the ground spices with the ginger paste, garlic paste, garam masala, paprika, chili flakes, turmeric, salt, yogurt, lemon juice, and oil. Mix well to make the marinade.
Place the meat in a large bowl and pour the marinade over it. Mix well to coat the meat with the marinade. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.

Preheat a grill to medium-high heat. Thread the marinated meat onto skewers and grill for 8–10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the meat is cooked through. Alternatively, you can bake the kababs in the oven at 400°F for 15–20 minutes.
Serve the behari kababs hot with rice or naan bread and a side of your choice.

recipes.title: Spicy Crab and Arugula Salad
recipes.description: A chilled salad of crab meat and arugula tossed in a spicy lemon, olive oil and herb dressing.

steps.text: Purée lemon, oil, cayenne, parsley, and dill in a blender or food processor until smooth.
Add crab and arugula and toss to coat.
Chill, if desired, before serving.

recipes.title: No-Bake Cheesecake
recipes.description: Podstawowy sernik bez pieczenia.

ingredients.text: 200 g (7 oz) tennis biscuits or digestive biscuits, crushed to fine crumbs
ingredients.name: herbatniki maślane
ingredients.note: tennis biscuits or digestive biscuits, crushed to fine crumbs

ingredients.text: 540 g (19 oz) cream cheese, softened to room temperature
ingredients.name: serek śmietankowy

ingredients.text: 750 g (26.4 oz) tinned sweetened condensed milk
ingredients.name: mleko skondensowane słodzone

steps.text: Combine melted butter with biscuit crumbs. Press into a pie dish to make a crust.
Beat cream cheese until smooth and fluffy.
Beat lemon juice and condensed milk together.
Mix the condensed milk mixture into beaten cream cheese until thoroughly combined.
Pour filling into the prepared pie dish.
Refrigerate for minimum of 24 hours until set.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: White Bean Soup with Basil, Rosemary, and Garlic Croutons
recipes.description: A smooth white bean soup flavored with basil, rosemary, garlic and red pepper flakes, served with garlic croutons.

ingredients.text: 2 cans (2 lbs) white beans, such as cannellini, drained
ingredients.name: fasola biała z puszki

ingredients.text: 1 cup of your favorite marinara pasta sauce
ingredients.name: sos pomidorowy

ingredients.text: ¼ cup packed fresh basil leaves, or 1 teaspoon dried basil leaves
ingredients.name: liść bazylii świeżej
ingredients.note: packed, or 1 teaspoon dried basil leaves

steps.text: Purée ingredients in a blender until smooth.
Pour into a large saucepan or Dutch Oven, and bring to a simmer.
Simmer, partially covered and stirring frequently, to blend flavors.
Serve, garnished with croutons.

recipes.title: Char Sui (Asian Barbecued Pork)
recipes.description: BBQ sam-chang-bak is a very simple barbecue seasoning recipe for pork meat.

steps.text: Sprinkle the tenderizer on the meat, then mix the rest of the ingredients together with the meat.
Barbecue the meat until done.

recipes.title: Homemade Corned Beef
recipes.description: Irlandzka wołowina solona (corned beef) gotowana z marchwią, cebulą, przyprawami i piwem Guinness.

ingredients.text: 1 ea. (6 lb / 2.75 kg) round/brisket of corned beef
ingredients.name: wołowina solona (corned beef)

steps.text: Put the brisket on a bed of the carrots and onions in a large saucepan.
Just barely cover everything with room temperature water, add the allspice and cloves, and simmer lightly for 4 hours.
Add the beer, and simmer for another hour.

Serve it cold on Christmas. Since there is no need to slave in the kitchen this day, the brisket should be removed and pressed between 2 dishes with a weight on top, reserving the juice for hot topping gravy; other days you can serve hot.

recipes.title: Ukazi Soup
recipes.description: Ukazi soup is an Igbo soup made from okazi and water leaf. It is similar to afang soup, but okazi soup is thicker.

ingredients.text: 2 ea. "cameroon peppers" or yellow habanero chiles, chopped
ingredients.name: papryczka habanero
ingredients.note: chopped; "cameroon peppers" or yellow habanero chiles

steps.text: Boil the meat and fish in water with stock cubes until the meat is tender.
Stir in the palm oil and chiles. Cook until yellow.
Reduce the heat and stir in the achara and crayfish.
Season to taste with stock cubes and salt, then cook for 5 more minutes.
Stir in the okazi leaf, and cook for 3 minutes.

recipes.title: Eierpunsch (German Egg Punch)
recipes.description: A lukewarm, sweetened alcoholic egg-based drink known in German as Eierpunsch.

ingredients.text: 1 packet of vanilla sugar (or 2 tsp sugar plus 1 tsp vanilla extract)
ingredients.name: cukier waniliowy
ingredients.note: or 2 tsp sugar plus 1 tsp vanilla extract

steps.text: Whisk the 5 tablespoons of sugar into the eggs (or egg yolks), add a little cold white wine, and beat vigorously.
Add the vanilla sugar to the mixture and pour in the remaining white wine, cinnamon, the cloves, lemon juice and the cooled tea. Add rum if using.
Transfer the mixture to a pan and gently heat. Do not let the mixture heat too quickly or it will curdle.
Before the mixture comes to the boil remove from the heat—the mixture should be foaming on top.
Remove the cloves.
Serve hot and foamy in a mug, optionally with whipped cream on top and a ginger biscuit.

recipes.title: Basic Lasagna
recipes.description: A basic baked lasagna with layers of noodles, tomato sauce and a creamy egg-based cheese mixture.

ingredients.text: 2 cups ricotta cheese OR shredded mozzarella cheese OR shredded cheddar cheese
ingredients.name: ser ricotta
ingredients.note: or shredded mozzarella or shredded cheddar

steps.text: In a large spotlessly clean stainless steel bowl, whip egg whites to stiff peaks and set aside.
Combine egg yolks, cheese, salt, pepper, and heavy cream.
Gently fold egg whites into cheese mixture.

Lay half the cooked noodles in the bottom of a roasting pan. Add a layer of tomato sauce on top, then a layer of the cheese mixture. Repeat this step for a second layer of noodles/tomato/cheese. The last layer should be cheese.
Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 375°F for 15 minutes. Remove foil and bake for another 20 minutes.
Remove from oven, and let rest for 10 minutes. Serve.

recipes.title: Jailhouse Chili
recipes.description: A modern version of Jailhouse Chili, as served in the Texas prison system.

ingredients.text: 2 handfuls crushed dried red chile peppers
ingredients.name: papryczka chili suszona

steps.text: Sear beef in a little cooking oil (not lard) until lightly browned.
Drop the seared beef and chili peppers in a large stock pot, and add enough water to keep the meat from burning.
Bring to a boil, then lower heat, cover, and simmer about 30 minutes.
Take pot off the stove and add spices and garlic.
Put back on the stove, bring to a boil again, lower heat, and simmer another 90 minutes, keeping the lid on as much as possible.
Stir when necessary, but remember that too much stirring will tear the meat.
Add a little more water if anything seems seriously in danger of burning (but as little water as possible).
Take pot off the stove and skim off all or most of the grease.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Hasude (Albanian Cornstarch Pudding)
recipes.description: Hasude is an Albanian dessert.

steps.text: Melt butter in pot over medium-high heat.
Gradually mix in the cornstarch.
Once all the cornstarch is added, cook until the mass becomes yellow.
Sweeten with some sugar.
Separately prepare a syrup using the remaining sugar and water.
After it is done cooking, shape the mass using a spoon or plastic shapes, and pour the syrup on top.

recipes.title: Tofu in Spiced Coconut Sauce
recipes.description: Tofu fried with onion, garlic and whole spices, then simmered in a creamy sour cream and yogurt sauce with currants, almonds and coconut.

ingredients.text: 1 extra-firm or firm tofu block, cut into ¾-inch cubes
ingredients.name: tofu
ingredients.note: extra-firm or firm block, cut into ¾-inch cubes

ingredients.text: ¼ cup (or more) slivered almonds, lightly toasted
ingredients.name: migdały

ingredients.text: ⅛ cup toasted coconut threads or flakes (optional)
ingredients.name: wiórki kokosowe

steps.text: Crack open the cardamom pods. Reserve the seeds; discard the shells.
Heat oil to quite hot but not smoking in a pan. Add spices and bay leaf. Cook until seeds crack (1–2 minutes).
Reduce heat to medium. Add onion and garlic, then cook until tender and translucent.
Reserve onion, garlic, spices to a side dish.
Season tofu with salt and pepper. Fry, adding oil if needed. When tofu is heated through, sauté until lightly brown (5–8 minutes).
Add reserved onion/spice mixture.
Add currants and sauté for 3–5 minutes. At this point, the tofu may be cooled and chilled for re-heating the following day.
Add sour cream, yogurt, coconut milk, and butter. Simmer until sauce has cooked down a little.
Add toasted almonds and toasted coconut.
Serve hot with Saffron Sweet Rice.

recipes.title: Beef Muchomo (Ugandan Beef Skewers)
recipes.description: Beef muchomo is a Ugandan street food that can be made at home for any backyard get-together. The inside is very tender and it is served with skewered onions.

steps.text: In a mixing bowl, whisk together the oil, lemon juice, salt, ground cumin, garlic powder, ground cardamom, and cayenne powder.
Add the beef and onions, and stir to combine. Cover and refrigerate for about 9–10 hours and up to overnight.
Preheat the grill to high heat and the oven to 200°F.
Remove the beef and onions from the marinade, and thread alternately on metal skewers.
Grill the skewers until a crust forms (about 2 minutes on each sides).
Transfer the skewers to a baking sheet, and roast in the preheated oven until cooked through and tender (about 45 minutes).
Serve the beef muchomo with peri peri sauce for dipping.

recipes.title: Nigerian Egg Roll
recipes.description: Egg rolls are a popular Nigerian snack, consisting of a boiled egg wrapped in dough and fried.

ingredients.text: ½ cup evaporated milk or whole milk
ingredients.name: mleko odparowane

steps.text: Combine the flour, baking powder, nutmeg, salt, and sugar in a bowl.
Mix in the butter until crumbly.
Mix in the egg and evaporated milk to make a dough.
Cover the dough with plastic wrap, and leave to rest for about 5–10 minutes.
While the dough is resting, preheat several inches of vegetable oil in a pot to 350–375°F (medium heat).
Divide the dough into six parts, flouring your palms to prevent the dough from sticking.
Flatten each piece of dough with your hands.
Place one boiled egg on the dough, and wrap the dough around the egg to completely enclose it.
Pinch the dough to tightly seal it around the egg.
Repeat this process until all the eggs are wrapped.
Carefully transfer the egg rolls to the preheated oil, and fry until golden brown.
Remove the egg rolls from the oil, and place on paper towels to remove excess oil.
Serve with the drink of your choice.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Radish Stew
recipes.description: A simple, inexpensive radish stew made with chicken broth, bay leaf and thyme, said to calm an upset stomach.

ingredients.text: ¼ pound red radish, cut in 1-inch strips, or about 5–6 slices
ingredients.name: rzodkiewka
ingredients.note: cut in 1-inch strips, or about 5–6 slices

ingredients.text: 3 pounds non-red radish, cut in 1-inch chunks (red, yellow, or variety)
ingredients.name: rzodkiew
ingredients.note: non-red, cut in 1-inch chunks (red, yellow, or variety)

steps.text: In a large saucepan or Dutch oven, cook the radish until crisp.
Add onions and cook until they soften somewhat, about 4–5 minutes.
Sprinkle flour over the onions, add bay leaves and thyme, and increase the heat to high.
Pour in wine and stir to loosen brown bits from the bottom of the pan. Cook for about 2 minutes, or until wine has evaporated.
Add non-red radishes, broth, and pepper. Cover and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to medium low and simmer until radishes are tender, about 45–60 minutes.
Sprinkle with paprika, if desired. Taste and adjust seasonings.
Remove bay leaves before serving.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cookies II
recipes.description: Chewy oatmeal cookies with semi-sweet chocolate chips, brown and white sugar.

ingredients.text: 3 sticks (12 oz / 340 g) butter, softened to room temperature
ingredients.name: masło

steps.text: Cream butter and both kinds of sugar with an electric mixer until smooth.
Combine the water, eggs, and vanilla in a separate container.
Gradually beat the egg mixture into the butter mixture until smooth.
Combine the flour and baking soda, then sift this mixture into the butter mixture. Mix to form a dough.
Use a sturdy mixing spoon to stir in the chocolate chips and 6 cups of the oats.
Stir in additional oats until the dough is stiff and almost crumbly.
If desired, chill dough until ready to bake.
Scoop teaspoon-sized balls of dough and place on a greased or parchment-lined cookie sheet.
Bake in a preheated 350°F (175C) oven for about 10 minutes, until a toothpick inserted into the cookies comes out clean.

recipes.title: Peanut Milk
recipes.description: Peanut milk is a variety of nut milk that can be used as a non-dairy alternative to milk.

steps.text: Rinse peanuts in colander. If salted peanuts are used, rinse well with hot water.
Place peanuts in blender with half of the water, and blend on high speed for about 1–2 minutes.
Add the rest of the water and blend on high speed for maybe 1 minute, until smooth.
Pour into a bottle, add the salt, shake, and put in the fridge for a few hours.
When most of the peanut flour has settled at the bottom of the bottle, pour carefully through a filter into another bottle.

When the filter starts clogging with peanut flour, squeeze out the milk, and rinse the filter. You can also use a spoon or something similar in the filter to help most of the milk get through before squeezing.

recipes.title: Euneo-juk (Korean Sweetfish Porridge)
recipes.description: Euneojuk is a traditional Korean food. In English, it can be translated as sweetfish porridge.

ingredients.text: 200 g whole sweetfish, cleaned and gutted
ingredients.name: ryba słodkowodna

steps.text: Soak rice in cold water.
Remove fish viscera, and wash fish well in cold water.
Place fish in a pot and cover with water.
Boil until the fish is cooked through.
Remove the fish, and save the cooking water.
Remove the fish flesh from the bones, and reserve it.
If desired, return the remaining fish carcass to the cooking water and continue cooking to make a stronger broth. Remove the fish carcass.
Add the doenjang, gochujang, and ginger to the fish broth.
Drain the rice and add to the broth. Cook until rice is tender.
Add water celery, crown daisy, chili, and perilla leaves to the soup.
Simmer soup until greens are cooked as desired.
Return the cooked fish meat to the soup, and serve.

recipes.title: Liberian Chicken Gravy
recipes.description: Liberian chicken gravy is a delicious African stew. A lot of oil is required to cook most African stews, but when it comes to this dish, you don't need so much.

ingredients.text: 3 lb chicken, cut into medium pieces
ingredients.name: kurczak

ingredients.text: Ground red or black pepper to taste
ingredients.name: pieprz mielony
ingredients.note: ground red or black, to taste

ingredients.text: 2 lb any type of dried fish steak of your choice, cleaned
ingredients.name: suszona ryba w steku
ingredients.note: any type of dried fish steak of your choice, cleaned

steps.text: In a medium-size saucepan, boil the chicken with salt, pepper, some chopped onions, and 1 tablespoon of the chicken bouillon. Let them cook until tender, the cooking time varies according to the chicken.
Remove the chicken to a bowl, reserving the stock.
In a blender, purée the tomatoes, red bell pepper, onions, garlic, basil, and parsley.
Add ½ cup oil to a pot, then add the blended mixture followed by the tomato paste. Allow it to cook for about 15 minutes, stirring the pot frequently as the sauce simmers.
Add the reserved chicken broth, then the chicken, dried fish, smoked paprika, ginger powder, cayenne pepper, and habanero pepper. Let simmer for about 10 minutes.
Add the shrimp and cook for about 5 minutes.
Adjust the stew with water, broth, and/or bouillon cubes if needed.
Enjoy with any complimentary dish of your choice.

recipes.title: Jamaican Jerk Spice I
recipes.description: Jamaican jerk spice is a pungent, hot mixture of spices used to flavor meats before grilling or roasting.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients together.
Store in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Jerk Lobster
recipes.description: Jerk lobster is a dish made popular by Nathanyay Chang.

ingredients.text: 2 tsp lemon juice or lime juice
ingredients.name: sok z cytryny lub limonki

ingredients.text: ½ tsp Jamaican pickapeppa sauce or 3 drops of Jamaican hot pepper sauce (optional)
ingredients.name: sos pickapeppa lub jamajski ostry sos
ingredients.note: optional; pickapeppa sauce or 3 drops of hot pepper sauce

steps.text: Thinly slice the scallions.
Melt the butter in a small skillet.
Lightly sauté the scallions until golden.
Add the lemon juice.
Add Jamaican pickapeppa sauce or hot pepper sauce (optional, depending on your taste).
Let it simmer for about 1 minute, then set aside.
Remove the membrane from the lobster tails.
Use a sharp knife to split the lobster tail in half lengthwise.
Brush butter sauce onto each tail.
Using the same brush, spread the jerk sauce over the tails, especially on the exposed meat. Set oven to broil.
Put the lobster tails in oven on the meat side for 4 minutes, turn, and cook the shell side for 2 minutes.
If you want a more smoked taste, cook for 2 minutes on each side in the oven, then place on a barbecue grill for 3 minutes. You may need to add more jerk sauce if using a grill.
Serve with Jamaican festival and/or bammy. You can also serve with Jamaican hardo bread.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Juice
recipes.description: Sok z rabarbaru zagęszczony z cytryną, do rozcieńczenia i podania z sokiem grejpfrutowym i imbirówką.

steps.text: Combine the rhubarb and water in a non-aluminum pot.
Cook until mushy.
Strain the mixture well, reserving only the juice.
Mix in lemon juice.

recipes.title: Kal Kals (Sweet Curled Fritters)
recipes.description: Kal kals are a fried sweet traditionally made during Christmas in Christian communities of India.

steps.text: Combine flour, egg, baking powder, powdered sugar, and vanilla to make a moist but not sticky dough.
Flatten teaspoon-sized balls of dough on the back of a fork (preferably with rounded tines) and roll off, forming small snail-shell-like curls.
Deep fry in hot oil (~350°F/180°C), six at a time, until golden brown.
Roll in more powdered sugar while still hot to coat.

recipes.title: Ofe Onugbu (Bitter Leaf Soup)
recipes.description: Ofe onugbu, or bitterleaf soup, is a traditional Nigerian soup from the Igbo people of Eastern Nigeria, prepared with bitterleaves, meat, palm oil, and a thickener.

ingredients.text: 300 g assorted meat (beef, tripe, cow skin)
ingredients.name: mięso wołowe mieszane

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon ogiri or iru (fermented locust beans, optional)
ingredients.name: ogiri

ingredients.text: 3–5 small cocoyam pieces or 2 tablespoons achi powder (as thickener)
ingredients.name: kolokazja
ingredients.note: 3–5 small pieces, or 2 tablespoons achi powder (as thickener)

steps.text: Wash the bitter leaves thoroughly, squeezing and rinsing several times to reduce the bitterness. Set aside.
In a pot, combine the assorted meat, stockfish, dryfish, salt, seasoning cubes, and chopped onions. Cover with water, and simmer until the meat is tender.
Add palm oil and allow it to melt into the meat stock.
If using cocoyam, boil it separately, peel, blend into a paste, and stir into the soup as a thickener. If using achi or ofor powder, stir directly into the pot.
Stir in the ground crayfish, pepper, ogiri, and ground crayfish.
Stir in the washed bitter leaves. Allow to simmer for 5–10 minutes until the soup thickens and the flavors combine.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.

recipes.title: Waffles
recipes.description: Classic breakfast waffles made with milk, vegetable oil and separated eggs, with whipped egg whites folded into the batter.

steps.text: Lightly brush grids of waffle iron with oil, close waffle iron, and preheat according to manufacturer's directions.
In small bowl, beat egg whites until stiff (but not dry) and set aside.
In large bowl, beat egg yolks until thick and lemon-colored.
Continue beating, adding milk and oil.
Add dry ingredients, beat until smooth, and fold in egg whites.
Pour 1 cup (240 ml) of batter on heated grid, close unit and cook according to manufacturer's directions.

recipes.title: Baked Custard
recipes.description: Delikatny, zapiekany krem jajeczny z mlekiem i wanilią, pieczony w kąpieli wodnej.

ingredients.text: ½ cup (120 g) white granulated sugar
ingredients.name: cukier

steps.text: Beat the eggs, the sugar, the salt, and the vanilla together.
Scald the milk and add it very slowly, stirring constantly (see tempering).
Pour the mixture into a greased or buttered baking dish or several small greased heat-proof molds.
Place the baking dish or the molds in a pan of water in a slow oven (300–325°F / 150–160°C) and bake for between 30 and 40 minutes.
Test if the custard is cooked with a knife, which will come out clean when the custard is thoroughly baked.

recipes.title: Whole Wheat Waffles
recipes.description: Gofry z mąki pełnoziarnistej z dodatkiem kiełków pszenicy i gałki muszkatołowej.

steps.text: Heat waffle iron according to the manufacturer's directions.
Combine dry ingredients and mix well.
Add milk, vegetable oil, and eggs, and mix until smooth.
Pour 1 cup of batter onto the oiled waffle iron, and cook according to the manufacturer's directions.

categories: Recipes using chile paste and sauce

recipes.title: Chilli Crab
recipes.description: Chilli crab is a Southeast Asian dish combining the natural sweetness of crab with a tantalizing mix of spicy, tangy, and savory flavors.

ingredients.text: 1 kg live, whole crab (preferably mud crab, but other similar types like blue, Dungeness, or common will also work)
ingredients.name: krab
ingredients.note: live, whole; preferably mud crab, but other similar types like blue, Dungeness, or common will also work

steps.text: Place the crab in the freezer for about 20 minutes to sedate it.
Swiftly spike the crab to kill it before proceeding.
Break the crab into pieces, making sure to retain the flavorful juices. First, pull off the apron/flap on the underside, then pull off and discard the top of the shell.
Pull out and discard the gills. Break off and reserve the claws.
Use your hands or a knife to break the body in two down the mid-line. If desired, halve each half again so you're left with four body-leg chunks. If needed, give the pieces a rinse.
Use the back of a knife or a specialized cracker to slightly crack the shell of the legs and claws for easier meat extraction when eating.
Heat the oil over medium heat in a skillet or pot large enough to hold the crab pieces. Add onion and garlic, and sauté until golden brown.
Stir in the chili paste, soy sauce, ketchup, and sugar. Cook for a few minutes until the mixture is fragrant.
Add the crab pieces and any reserved juices to the pan. Add the water, and make sure the crab is well-coated.
Cover the pan, and simmer for about 10–15 minutes until the crab is cooked through.
Beat the egg well in a bowl.
Uncover the pan, and begin gently stirring in a circular motion. While stirring, gradually pour in the egg to make ribbons like those in egg drop soup.
Let the mixture cook for about 30 seconds to set the egg—it should form soft strands in the sauce.
Remove from the heat. Before serving, garnish with cilantro. Serve with lime wedges, and eat with your hands.

recipes.title: Lumberjacks
recipes.description: Lumberjacks are a cookie from the Old Sturbridge Village Cookbook, and they reflect baking from 1830s New England.

ingredients.text: 1 cup white vegetable shortening or butter
ingredients.name: masło

steps.text: Cream together the sugar and shortening.
Add molasses and eggs, and mix well.
Sift together the flour, spices, and bicarbonate of soda. Add this mixture to the egg-butter mixture, and mix well to make a dough.
Put ¼ cup additional white sugar into a small bowl.
Dip fingers into the sugar, then pinch off a ball of dough and roll it into the size and shape of a walnut.
Roll the cookie dough ball into the sugar and place on a greased cookie sheet.
Repeat the shaping and sugar-coating process with the remaining dough, spacing the cookies about 3 inches apart on the sheet.
Bake in a preheated 350°F (175°C) oven for 10–15 minutes.
Let cool completely—the cookies should be soft when cooled.

recipes.title: Irish Soda Bread
recipes.description: Chleb sodowy z Irlandii, wypiekany na maślance i sodzie oczyszczonej zamiast drożdży.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 325°F (160°C).
Grease and flour a 9x5-inch loaf pan.
Combine flour, baking powder, baking soda, sugar, and salt in a large mixing bowl.
Blend egg and buttermilk together, and add all at once to the flour mixture.
Mix until just moistened. Too much mixing will make it tough.
Stir in butter; pour into prepared pan.
Bake for 65–70 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the bread comes out clean. The loaf should sound hollow if you tap the base.
Cool on a wire rack.
Wrap in tea-towel or foil several hours or overnight for best flavor.

recipes.title: Nutty Buddy Chocolate Cookie Bars
recipes.description: Chocolate cookie bars with a graham cracker crust, sweetened condensed milk, chocolate chips, pecans and almonds.

ingredients.text: 1 cup pecan pieces or chopped pecans
ingredients.name: orzech pekan

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Place butter in microwave-safe dish, cover with a paper towel and microwave on high, for about 45 seconds, or until melted.
Remove carefully and stir to melt completely.
Place the graham-cracker crumbs in a metal 13-by-9-inch baking pan.
Pour melted butter over crumbs, and stir and fold until all the crumbs are moistened with the butter. Press crumbs firmly and evenly into the bottom of the pan.
Pour the sweetened condensed milk over the crumb crust. Spread to the edges with the back of a spoon.
Top evenly with chocolate chips, pecans, and almonds. Press down with a fork.
Bake, uncovered, for 25–35 minutes or until bubbling slightly along the edges.
Remove from oven and cool to room temperature.
Refrigerate until firm for 1–2 hours before slicing.
Store at room temperature, covered with foil.

recipes.title: Double Chocolate Cheesecake
recipes.description: Sernik czekoladowy na kruszonych ciasteczkach waflowych, z dodatkiem roztopionej czekolady i białej czekolady do dekoracji.

ingredients.text: 4 oz semi-sweet chocolate, melted and cooled
ingredients.name: czekolada półgorzka

steps.text: Stir together crushed wafers and butter.
Press mixture evenly over the bottom and 1¾ inch up sides of 9-inch springform pan.
In large bowl, beat cream cheese, sugar, chocolate, flour and vanilla until well mixed.
Add eggs all at once. Beat with electric mixer on low speed until just mixed. Do not overbeat.
Stir in milk.
Pour filling into crust.
Bake in a 350°F (175°C) oven about 50 minutes or until center appears nearly set when gently shaken.
Cool on a wire rack for 5–10 minutes.
Loosen sides of cheesecake from pan. Cool 30 minutes.
Remove sides of pan. Cover and chill for 4–24 hours.
Pipe melted vanilla flavored pieces decoratively atop cheesecake.

recipes.title: Mandazi (East African Doughnuts)
recipes.description: East African doughnuts that originated from places like Uganda, Kenya, and Tanzania. They are popular as a street food.

ingredients.text: 4 milk cups all-purpose flour, plus extra for working the dough
ingredients.name: mąka pszenna
ingredients.note: plus extra for working the dough

ingredients.text: 2 tbsp margarine or butter, at room temperature
ingredients.name: margaryna

steps.text: Sift together the flour and baking powder in a bowl.
Mix in the salt, lemon zest, sugar, and cloves.
Rub in the butter until the flour becomes coarse.
Combine the vanilla and water, then mix this into the flour mixture to get a firm dough.
Knead the dough for about 2 minutes until it no longer sticks to your hands.
Set aside to rest for 10 minutes.
Flour a work surface, and roll out the dough to about 1-inch thickness.
Cut the dough into 10 equal squares, then roll each square into a ball.
Heat a pan of oil over medium heat. Deep fry the mandazi in batches of 5 for about 10 minutes or until they are puffed, brown all over, and cooked through.
Remove when it is fully done and enjoy your delicious East African Doughnuts.

recipes.title: Snickerdoodles (Boston Globe)
recipes.description: Ciasteczka snickerdoodles z cynamonem i cukrem, oparte na przepisie z Boston Globe z 1898 roku.

steps.text: Cream the butter and sugar together.
Beat in the eggs.
Combine the flour, cream of tartar, and baking soda.
Alternately mix the flour and milk into the batter to make a dough.
Drop dough on a greased or lined baking sheet in spoonfuls.
Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon.
Bake in a quick oven.

recipes.title: Malvani Chicken Curry
recipes.description: Malvani chicken curry with bone-in chicken pieces, coconut and garam masala, served with vade and solkadhi in the Kombdi vade dish.

ingredients.text: 800 g (1.8 lb / 8 ea.) medium-sized pieces of chicken
ingredients.name: kurczak

steps.text: Grind half of the green chillies to a paste and mix it well with the ginger and garlic pastes.
Make cuts on the chicken pieces, rub this mixture on to them well, and marinate for about an hour at least.
Toast coconut shavings in a pan with a little hot oil until light brown. Cool and grind along with half the onions to a paste.
Heat oil in a heavy-bottomed pan and sauté the onions on medium level for about 2 minutes or until they are light brown in color.
Add the remaining chopped green chillies and spice powders and fry for a few seconds. Add the marinated chicken pieces and fry on medium level for about 3 minutes or until they are lightly browned.

Add the paste and salt, then mix well. Add water according to the desired level of consistency and bring to a boil. Cover and cook on low level for about 25 minutes or until the chicken pieces are tender and fully cooked.
Garnish with finely-chopped coriander leaves.

recipes.title: Rice and Beef Soup
recipes.description: A simple soup of long grain rice and beef cooked in a rice cooker with herbs and cinnamon.

ingredients.text: 2 rice cooker cups (12 fl oz / 1½ cups / 360 mL) long grain rice
ingredients.name: ryż biały
ingredients.note: long grain, rice cooker cups (12 fl oz / 1½ cups / 360 mL)

steps.text: Add the rice, water, parsley, chives, rosemary, and pepper to a 10-cup or larger rice cooker.
For a simple rice cooker, turn it on. For a programmable rice cooker, set the rice cooker to the quick cook setting and start.
Cover and allow to come to a simmer.
Add the beef and cinnamon, cover again, and allow to cook for 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Roll
recipes.description: Traditional holiday dessert: a spiced pumpkin sponge cake rolled around a cream cheese filling. The filling keeps the cake moist.

ingredients.text: 1 cup (220 g / 7.8 oz) white granulated sugar
ingredients.name: cukier

ingredients.text: ⅔ cup (80 g / 2.8 oz) canned pumpkin
ingredients.name: dynia z puszki

ingredients.text: ¾ cup (75 g / 2.6 oz) chopped pecans
ingredients.name: orzechy pekan

steps.text: Preheat oven to 375 F.
Mix sugar, eggs, and canned pumpkin in a large bowl until well blended.
Using a second bowl, mix flour, salt, cinnamon, and baking soda.
Fold dry mixture into larger bowl with pumpkin mixture.
Line rectangular cookie sheet with greased parchment paper or waxed paper, making sure to extend over the sides of the cookie sheet.
Pour batter evenly onto the lined cookie sheet.
Sprinkle batter with the chopped pecans.
Bake at 375 F for 15 minutes.
Set aside ⅛ cup (15 g / 0.53 oz) of the powdered sugar; it will be used later.
Whip cream cheese, vanilla, butter, and remaining powdered sugar until smooth.
Set aside.
Lay a clean dish towel on a flat kitchen surface.
Evenly sprinkle towel with the powdered sugar that was set aside earlier.
Once the cake has been completely baked and before cooled, flip onto the towel with the powdered sugar.
Loosely roll cake, then cool completely to allow cake to set.
Once cooled, unroll cake.
Spread filling over cake.
Roll cake and filling up in a spiral.
Wrap in foil or plastic wrap and freeze.
Once frozen, remove foil and cut into slices while still frozen.

categories: Recipes using beef broth and stock
Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Gambian Caldo (Seafood soup)
recipes.description: Caldo is a traditional Gambian soup known for its rich and comforting flavors, made with meat, vegetables and spices.

ingredients.text: 1 pound beef or chicken, cut into bite-sized pieces
ingredients.name: wołowina
ingredients.note: beef or chicken, cut into bite-sized pieces

ingredients.text: Fresh cilantro or parsley, chopped (for garnish)
ingredients.name: kolendra świeża

steps.text: Heat the vegetable oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the finely chopped onion and minced garlic to the pot. Sauté until the onion becomes translucent and the garlic is fragrant.
Add the beef or chicken pieces to the pot and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Stir in the sliced carrots, cubed potatoes, sliced celery, chopped bell pepper, and diced tomatoes. Cook for a few minutes to allow the vegetables to soften slightly.
Pour in the beef or chicken broth, ensuring that the ingredients are fully covered.
Add the ground cumin, dried oregano, salt, and pepper to the pot. Stir well to incorporate the spices.
Bring the soup to a boil, then reduce the heat to low. Cover the pot and let it simmer for about 1–1.5 hours, or until the meat is tender and the flavors have melded together.
Taste the soup and adjust the seasoning if needed.
Remove the pot from heat and ladle the caldo into serving bowls.
Garnish each bowl with freshly chopped cilantro or parsley. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Molasses Taffy
recipes.description: Miękka, ciągnięta gumka z melasą, cukrem i masłem.

steps.text: Combine molasses, sugar, vinegar and water in a heavy saucepan over medium heat.
Cook to 255–270°F (124–132°C). The hotter the syrup, the harder the final taffy will be.
Remove from heat and stir in butter, cream of tartar, and baking soda.
Pour into buttered pan or onto marble surface, and let cool slightly.

When cool and thick enough to handle, grease your hands. Grab the candy mixture with both hands, and stretch it apart while twisting slightly. Repeat this process, pulling and twisting the candy until light in color. This pulling and twisting process incorporates air and lightens the candy.
Cut into 1-inch pieces; wrap in squares of waxed paper.

recipes.title: Pasta with Corn and Tuna
recipes.description: Quick one-pan pasta with cream cheese, sweetcorn, tuna and pesto, easy to make and popular with children and vegetarians.

ingredients.text: 4 mugfuls of your favourite dried pasta
ingredients.name: makaron pszenny
ingredients.note: mugfuls of your favourite dried pasta

ingredients.text: 1 tin of tuna of equal size to the sweet corn
ingredients.name: tuńczyk w wodzie, odsączony
ingredients.note: of equal size to the sweet corn

steps.text: Put the pasta on to boil in copious amounts of water with a little salt and a drop of olive oil added.
In a mixing bowl combine all the rest of the ingredients.
When the pasta is cooked, drain through a colander and add to the bowl.
Stir through, so that everything becomes well coated.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Chicken and Pasta Alfredo
recipes.description: Farfalle pasta with shredded chicken in a creamy Parmesan, mozzarella and butter sauce.

ingredients.text: 1 ½ cups shredded cooked chicken, reheated
ingredients.name: kurczak gotowany

ingredients.text: 1 ½ oz fresh shredded Parmiggiano-Reggiano cheese
ingredients.name: ser parmezan

steps.text: In a gallon (4 liters) of boiling salted water, cook pasta to al dente.
Drain pasta and rinse with cold water. Toss with chicken and set aside.
Melt 2 tbsp butter in a medium saucepan over medium high heat. Once bubbling ceases, add flour and cook, whisking continuously until mixture turns light blonde in color.
Add remaining sauce ingredients. Bring to a simmer and reduce heat to low. Drizzle over pasta mixture and serve warm.

categories: Recipes using vegetable broth and stock

recipes.title: Hamli (Ethiopian Spinach Stew)
recipes.description: A vegetarian Ethiopian spinach stew made with fresh spinach and aromatic spices. It is served as a side dish with injera or rice.

ingredients.text: ½ teaspoon cayenne pepper, or to taste
ingredients.name: pieprz cayenne

ingredients.text: 2 pounds fresh spinach, washed and chopped
ingredients.name: szpinak

ingredients.text: Fresh cilantro or parsley, chopped, for garnish
ingredients.name: kolendra świeża

steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan or pot over medium heat. Add the finely chopped onion and sauté until it becomes translucent.
Stir in the minced garlic, grated ginger, turmeric, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, and salt. Mix well to coat the onions with the spices.
Add the chopped spinach to the saucepan and stir to combine it with the spice mixture.
Cover the saucepan and let the spinach cook for about 10–15 minutes, or until it wilts down and becomes tender. Stir occasionally to ensure even cooking.
Pour in the vegetable broth or water, and continue cooking the stew for another 5–10 minutes to allow the flavors to meld together. Adjust the seasoning with salt if needed.
Remove from heat and let rest for a few minutes to allow the flavors to develop.
Garnish with freshly chopped cilantro or parsley. Serve hot as a side dish, accompanied by injera or rice.

recipes.title: Romanian Roasted Eggplant Spread II
recipes.description: Salată de vinete (eggplant salad) is a common Romanian spread made with eggplants and onion. It is usually eaten with bread.

ingredients.text: ½ large or 1 medium onion, finely diced or grated
ingredients.name: cebula
ingredients.note: large or 1 medium onion, finely diced or grated

steps.text: Roast the eggplants. This can be done in a variety of ways, but the flesh should be fully cooked and the skin should be burned and falling off easily. An effective method is to prick the eggplants and place them in a preheated 400 °F oven until the skin is charred and a fork easily pierces the vegetable all the way through.

Skin the eggplants—the skin should come off easily by hand. Use the back of a table knife to scrape off any residual eggplant from the skin once the skin is removed—this portion of eggplant retains the smoky flavor and should not be discarded.
Finely chop or blend the eggplant flesh. The consistency should be smooth, like a purée.
Transfer the eggplant to a bowl, and mix in the other ingredients. The amounts can be adjusted for taste.
Chill in the fridge until serving.

recipes.title: Zhug I
recipes.description: Hot condiment used for adding flavor and spice to foods.

ingredients.text: 4 red, very hot dried cayenne peppers, stems removed
ingredients.name: papryczka chili suszona

steps.text: Grind and blend all the above ingredients together.
Store in a sealed jar.

recipes.title: Bulgarian Meatball Soup (Supa Topcheta)
recipes.description: A popular Bulgarian soup with beef meatballs, rice, and vegetables, finished with an egg and lemon mixture.

steps.text: Combine beef, rice, paprika, and savory.
Season to taste with salt and pepper, and mix lightly but thoroughly.
Form mixture into 1-inch (2.5 cm) balls, then roll in flour.
Combine water, bouillon cubes, 1 tablespoon salt, 1 teaspoon pepper, green onions, green pepper, carrots, and tomatoes in large pot. Cover, bring to boil, reduce heat, and simmer 30 minutes.
Add meatballs, cover, and bring to boil again. Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes.
Add chiles and simmer, covered, 40 minutes or until rice is cooked.
