Add parsley during last 5 minutes of cooking time. Taste and add more salt and pepper, if needed.
Just before serving, beat egg with lemon juice. Stir 1 to 2 tablespoons hot soup into egg mixture, then stir egg mixture into soup.
Heat gently, stirring, until soup is thickened slightly, but do not allow to boil.

recipes.title: Guacamole Dip
recipes.description: A spicy Mexican dip made from avocado and cream, served with corn chips, totopos, or potato chips.

ingredients.text: 1 cup cream, sour cream, or yoghurt
ingredients.name: śmietana

ingredients.text: ¼ regular onion, cut in large pieces
ingredients.name: cebula

ingredients.text: Milk to thin the dip, as needed
ingredients.name: mleko

steps.text: Put the garlic, onion pieces, cilantro and serrano pepper into a blender or food processor. Pulse for a few seconds, don't overdo it.
Halve the avocado and scoop the flesh into the bowl. Add the cream and pulse the blender for a few seconds.
Taste the mixture and add salt or more seasonings as desired.
Pulse the blender a little bit more. If the mixture is too thick, add a tablespoon of milk and pulse the blender.
Serve immediately or store by covering the mixture with plastic wrap.

recipes.title: Lody śmietankowe
recipes.description: Domowe lody śmietankowe przygotowane z śmietanki, mleka i cukru, mrożone bez maszynki do lodów.

steps.text: Połowę śmietanki (ok. 200 ml) wlej do garnka, wsyp do niej cukier (65 g) i podgrzewaj na małym ogniu cały czas mieszając, aż cukier się rozpuści.
Zdejmij garnek z ognia i przełóż jego zawartość do pojemnika (jeśli nie masz maszynki do lodów to najlepiej użyj takiego, by bez problemu zmieścił się w Twojej lodówce a potem zamrażarce).
Do podgrzanej śmietanki z cukrem dodaj resztę śmietanki (pozostałe 200 ml), mleko (200 ml) i dokładnie wymieszaj – możesz użyć trzepaczki lub miksera.
Włóż pojemnik do lodówki, aby masa się schłodziła.

W zależności od urządzenia jakie masz pod ręką: przelej schłodzoną masę do maszynki do robienia lodów i postępuj dalej według zaleceń producenta sprzętu, jeśli nie posiadasz maszynki włóż pojemnik do zamrażalnika i co ok. 30 min. wyciągaj go i miksuj zawartość, aby uzyskać puszystą konsystencję i rozbić tworzące się kryształki lodu.
Po ok. 3-4 godz. mrożenia lody są gotowe – jeśli są bardzo twarde wyjmij je z zamrażalnika i nakładaj po ok. 5 min.

recipes.title: Italian Dressing I
recipes.description: A simple, quick salad dressing made with capers, garlic, shallot, olive oil, lemon juice and white wine.

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon white Chianti or dry white wine
ingredients.name: białe wino wytrawne
ingredients.note: white Chianti or dry white wine

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in a jar with tight-fitting top.
Shake well.

recipes.title: Corn Soup
recipes.description: A simple corn soup thickened with a butter and flour roux and finished with beaten egg.

steps.text: Combine the corn and water in a large pot. Bring to a boil.
Make a roux with the butter and flour.
Add the roux to the soup when the corn is tender.
Boil for an additional 10–15 minutes.
Beat the egg and add it to the soup. Immediately take the soup off the heat.
Add salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: Tuna glop
recipes.description: A simple, quick-to-make meal of macaroni, cream of mushroom soup, tuna and vegetables, topped with crushed potato chips.

ingredients.text: 1 can (10 oz / 300 g) cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.name: zupa krem z pieczarek
ingredients.note: 10 oz / 300 g, cream of mushroom soup

ingredients.text: 1 can (6 oz / 170 g) chunk tuna in water
ingredients.name: tuńczyk w wodzie

ingredients.text: 2 cups frozen vegetables, such as peas and carrots
ingredients.name: mrożone warzywa

steps.text: Prepare macaroni according to directions on the package, but without salt. Drain and return to pot.
Add cream of mushroom soup.
Drain tuna and add.
Add frozen vegetables and mix well.
If you prefer crunchy vegetables, heat for 5 minutes over low heat, stirring frequently. Heat longer if you prefer softer vegetables.
Serve topped with crushed potato chips (crisps).

recipes.title: Pear-Cranberry Crisp
recipes.description: A crisp with sliced pears and cranberries under an oat, almond and brown sugar topping.

ingredients.text: 4 ea. (2½ pounds) firm, ripe pears peeled, cored, and sliced
ingredients.name: gruszka
ingredients.note: firm, ripe, peeled, cored, and sliced (2½ pounds)

ingredients.text: ⅔ cup firmly packed brown sugar
ingredients.name: cukier trzcinowy brązowy

ingredients.text: ½ cup butter cut into pieces
ingredients.name: masło

steps.text: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Toss pears, cranberries, sugar, and ¼ teaspoon cinnamon in a 9x9-inch baking dish until blended.
Combine oats, almonds, brown sugar, butter, flour, and remaining ¼ teaspoon cinnamon in large bowl. Blend with fingertips.
Sprinkle crumble over fruit and pat down lightly.
Bake until pears are tender and topping is golden, about 45 minutes.
Serve hot or warm.

recipes.title: Creamy Aioli Salsa
recipes.description: Krzyżówka aioli (sosu podobnego do majonezu, w którym czosnek zastępuje żółtko jako emulgator) i salsy w stylu pico de gallo.

ingredients.text: 1 or more jalapeño chiles or serrano chiles, chopped
ingredients.name: papryczka jalapeño
ingredients.note: 1 or more; jalapeño or serrano, chopped

steps.text: Squeeze the lime juice into a blender-safe bowl.
Add 2 teaspoons of olive oil and all other ingredients.
Use an immersion blender to blend everything to a purée.
Gradually blend in more olive oil, tasting, until the mixture reaches your desired creaminess.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Muffins
recipes.description: A delicious muffin recipe that makes an excellent breakfast.

steps.text: Stir rolled oats and buttermilk together in a mixing bowl.
Combine flour, coconut, brown sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt in another mixing bowl. Stir together to mix. Make a well in the center.
Add egg and margarine to oat mixture. Mix well.
Pour all at once into flour mixture. Stir just to moisten.
Fill muffin cups ¾ full.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 15–20 minutes.

recipes.title: Nigerian Rice and Beans Jollof
recipes.description: Rice and beans jollof is a typical Nigerian food made from rice and beans. It is served with beef, chicken or moin moin.

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or palm oil
ingredients.name: olej roślinny

steps.text: Rinse the beans, and boil in water until tender.
Drain the cooked beans.
Grind together the chiles, tomatoes, and onions to make a purée.
Heat a thin layer of oil in a pan, and add the purée.
Season with stock cube and salt, and simmer for 3 minutes.
Stir in the parboiled rice and beans, and cook for 5 minutes.
Serve with beef, chicken, or moin-moin.

recipes.title: Fudge Frosting
recipes.description: A rich non-greasy frosting that goes on hot and stiffens as it cools.

steps.text: Melt the chocolate and margarine together in a double-boiler or, carefully, in a saucepan on low heat.
Mix in the vanilla extract and corn syrup, keeping the mixture somewhat hot.
Mix in the sugar, still keeping the mixture somewhat hot. You might not use the exact amount listed. Just keep adding sugar until the frosting is as thick as desired.
While still hot, spread the mixture on cake or brownies. Mixture will stiffen.

recipes.title: Chicago Sirloin with Cabernet Balsamic Reduction
recipes.description: A classically-inspired steak recipe, with influences from both American and European cuisine.

steps.text: Preheat a medium-sized saucepan over medium-low heat and preheat the grill to high.
Add the onions to the pan, and sauté until light yellow.
Add the shallots and garlic to the pan and sauté for a few minutes more. Make sure all ingredients are lightly crisped.
Pour in about ⅓ of the wine and ⅓ of the vinegar. Let this simmer and reduce over lower heat for about 5–10 minutes.
Place the steaks on the barbecue, seasoning with the Montreal steak spice.
Add the rest of the wine and vinegar and season by sprinkling some fresh black pepper on top. Boil off until you no longer smell the alcohol coming from the steaming wine.
Flip the steaks. You want them to be soft on the inside (cooked rare) yet quite charred on the outside, to get that charcoal flavor.
Once the sauce has gone down to about ⅓ of its original volume, take off heat.
Remove steaks from grill and take inside.
Place the steaks on your plates, cover with the sauce and serve!

recipes.title: Corn Pancakes
recipes.description: Tender, golden pancakes made with cornmeal and buttermilk, with sweet corn scattered over each pancake as it cooks.

ingredients.text: ½ cup fine yellow corn meal
ingredients.name: mąka kukurydziana

steps.text: Heat a large non-stick skillet or griddle over low heat while preparing ingredients.
Mix flour, sugar, salt, baking powder, and baking soda in medium bowl.
Whisk corn meal into dry ingredients.
Microwave buttermilk and milk in a 2-cup Pyrex measuring cup until room temperature, 20 to 30 seconds.
Whisk in egg, butter, and vanilla.
Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients and whisk until just mixed.
Return batter to measuring cup, stirring in a teaspoon or two of water, if necessary, to make a thick, but pourable batter.
Increase heat to medium and generously brush skillet or griddle with oil.
When oil starts to spider, but before it starts to smoke, pour in batter to make pancakes, about ¼ cup at a time. Work in batches, if necessary, to avoid overcrowding.
Sprinkle 2 tablespoons corn over the uncooked side of each pancake as it cooks.
When pancake bottoms are golden brown and tops start to bubble, 2 to 3 minutes, flip pancakes.
Cook until pancakes are golden brown on remaining side.
Repeat, brushing skillet or griddle with oil.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Steamed Basmati Rice
recipes.description: This is a fragrant, long-grain variety of rice often used in Indian recipes. Basmati can be cooked in the same way as other rice, in the ratio of two cups water to one cup rice.

steps.text: If adding saffron, soak it in a tablespoon or two of hot water for 10 minutes, and add the water and strands in with the lemon juice.
Rinse the rice in a sieve for 5–7 minutes under cold running water.
Add the water, rice, butter, and salt to a pot.
Bring to a rapid boil.
Mix in lemon juice and the saffron mixture if using.
Cover the pot tightly, reduce heat to minimum, and simmer for 8½ minutes.
Taste the rice to check its texture. Cook for 1–5 minutes longer depending on how underdone it is.
Fluff with a fork and serve hot with your favorite recipe.

categories: Recipes using vegetable broth and stock

recipes.title: Three Sisters Stew
recipes.description: Traditional Native American stew of maize, beans and squash, with tomatoes, chiles, cumin and cilantro.

ingredients.text: 1 ea. (2 lb) small pumpkin or butternut or carnival squash
ingredients.name: dynia
ingredients.note: small pumpkin or butternut or carnival squash, 2 lb

ingredients.text: ½ medium green or red bell pepper, cut into short, narrow strips
ingredients.name: papryka
ingredients.note: green or red, cut into short, narrow strips

ingredients.text: 1 can (14–16 ounces) diced tomatoes, with liquid
ingredients.name: pomidory krojone z puszki

ingredients.text: 2 cups cooked or canned pinto beans
ingredients.name: fasola pinto

ingredients.text: 2 cups corn kernels (from 2 large or medium ears)
ingredients.name: kukurydza

ingredients.text: 1 cup water or homemade vegetable stock
ingredients.name: woda

ingredients.text: 1–2 fresh hot chiles, seeded and minced
ingredients.name: papryczka chili

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Cut the pumpkin or squash in half lengthwise and remove the seeds and fibers. Cover with aluminum foil and place the halves, cut side up, in a foil-lined shallow baking pan.

Bake for 40–50 minutes, or until easily pierced with a knife but still firm (if using squash, prepare the same way). When cool enough to handle, scoop out the pulp, and cut into large dice. Set aside until needed.
Heat the oil in a soup pot. Add the onion and sauté over medium-low heat until translucent. Add the garlic and continue to sauté until the onion is golden.

Add the pumpkin and all the remaining ingredients except the last 2 and bring to a simmer. Simmer gently, covered, until all the vegetables are tender, about 20–25 minutes. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

If time allows, let the stew stand for 1–2 hours before serving, then heat through as needed. Just before serving, stir in the cilantro. The stew should be thick and very moist but not soupy; add additional stock or water if needed. Serve in shallow bowls.

recipes.title: Baked Pork Chops
recipes.description: A relatively simple recipe for baked pork chops.

ingredients.text: 3–4 bone-in pork chops, ¼ inch (6 mm) thin
ingredients.name: kotlet wieprzowy

ingredients.text: 1 medium apple, cored and sliced thin
ingredients.name: jabłko

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon (15 ml) caraway seed (can be salvaged from the bag your rye bread comes in)
ingredients.name: kminek
ingredients.note: can be salvaged from the bag your rye bread comes in

ingredients.text: Garlic salt, black pepper, and Dijon mustard, to taste
ingredients.name: sól czosnkowa
ingredients.note: Garlic salt, black pepper, and Dijon mustard, to taste

steps.text: Heat oven to 350 °F (180 °C)
Layer sliced onion and apple in a baking dish that can be covered; drizzle honey and half the caraway over apple and onion slices
Season meat with garlic salt and pepper; spread top of meat with Dijon
Sprinkle remainder of caraway
Cover and bake for one hour.

recipes.title: Creme de Papaya
recipes.description: A refreshing, simple Brazilian dessert of blended papaya and vanilla ice cream, finished with blackcurrant liqueur.

steps.text: Peel papaya and remove seeds. Cube the papaya.
Put papaya pieces in blender with ice cream and blackcurrant liqueur. Blend well until smooth.
Pour into a small bowl and decorate with mint.

recipes.title: Creme de Papaya (Method 2)
recipes.description: A refreshing, simple Brazilian dessert of blended papaya and vanilla ice cream, finished with blackcurrant liqueur.

steps.text: Peel papaya and remove seeds. Cube the papaya.
Put papaya pieces in blender with ice cream and blend until creamy consistency.
Pour some blackcurrant liqueur on the bottom of a large dessert glass.
Add the cream mixture. Add a swirl of blackcurrant liqueur on the top.

recipes.title: Creme de Papaya (Method 3)
recipes.description: A refreshing, simple Brazilian dessert of blended papaya and vanilla ice cream, finished with blackcurrant liqueur.

steps.text: Cut papaya in half and remove seeds. Scoop papaya from peel with a spoon (this is easier and cleaner than peeling the fruit).
Place approximately equal portions of papaya and vanilla ice cream in a blender. Blend until creamy.
Place the mixture into a serving dish and pour about an ounce of Crème de Cassis on top.

recipes.title: Garlic Salt
recipes.description: Garlic salt is a spice commonly found in the U.S., a mixture of garlic and salt. It is used on garlic bread, salads, subs, pasta, and french fries.

steps.text: Combine the garlic powder and salt.
Adjusting the ratio of salt to garlic powder will alter the taste of the seasoning slightly.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies IV
recipes.description: Chocolate chip cookies are an all-round dessert.

ingredients.text: ½ cup (100 g / 3.5 oz) granulated sugar
ingredients.name: cukier

ingredients.text: ¾ cup (140 g / 5 oz) light brown sugar, packed
ingredients.name: cukier brązowy

ingredients.text: ½ cup (1 stick / 125 g / 4.5 oz) unsalted butter, melted
ingredients.name: masło

ingredients.text: 4 oz (115 g) milk or semi-sweet chocolate chunks
ingredients.name: czekolada mleczna lub półgorzka

steps.text: Cream the butter, sugars and salt in a mixing bowl until combined.
Beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Sift the flour and baking soda into the mixture and fold in.
Fold in the chocolate.
Cover the dough with clingfilm and chill for at least 2 hours.
Preheat the oven to 180°C (356°F). Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper.
Scoop the dough onto the baking sheets, making sure the cookies are at least 4 inches (10 cm) apart from each other.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until the edges are light brown in color.
Take the cookies out of the oven and leave them to cool.

recipes.title: Tea Eggs
recipes.description: Jajka gotowane w herbacie z sosem sojowym, imbirem i czosnkiem, z pękniętą skorupką.

steps.text: Bring water and spices to a boil.
Add eggs, and boil for 3 minutes.
Remove eggs from the liquid and roll them gently on a hard surface to crack the shell all over.
Return the eggs to the pot of liquid, reduce to a simmer, and simmer for 1 hour.
Reduce to low heat and allow eggs to sit in brine until served.

recipes.title: Puff Pastry with Nuts and Whipped Cream (Om Ali)
recipes.description: Om Ali is a traditional Egyptian dessert.

ingredients.text: 1 package (17.5 ounces) frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed
ingredients.name: ciasto francuskie mrożone

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Butter a 9x13-inch baking dish.

Place the pastry sheets in the baking dish and place the dish in the oven. Watch it closely. When the top layer turns crunchy and golden, remove it from the oven. Continue until all the sheets are cooked.
Preheat the oven broiler.
In a bowl, combine walnuts, pecans, hazelnuts, raisins, coconut and ¼ cup sugar. Break cooked pastry into pieces and stir into nut mixture. Spread mixture evenly in a 9x13 inch dish.
Bring milk and ½ cup sugar to a boil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Pour over nut mixture.
Whip the heavy cream with the remaining ½ cup sugar until stiff peaks form. Spread evenly over nut mixture in dish.
Place dessert under oven broiler until top is golden brown, about 10 minutes. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Bean and Bacon Bake
recipes.description: A simple microwave casserole of green beans, potato and bacon topped with sliced almonds.

ingredients.text: 6 strips bacon, cooked until crisp, or microwave ready fully cooked bacon
ingredients.name: boczek
ingredients.note: cooked until crisp, or microwave ready fully cooked bacon

ingredients.text: ⅛ cup (15 g / 0.53 oz) sliced almonds
ingredients.name: migdały płatki

steps.text: Peel and dice the potato.
Crumble crisp bacon into small pieces.
Drain green beans, keeping ½ cup of the liquid.
Put beans, bean juice, bacon, and potato in a microwave-safe baking dish.
Sprinkle onion powder and salt on top.
Cover with clear wrap.
Cook in microwave oven 5 minutes, stir, and cook another 5 minutes.
Let stand 5 minutes.
Garnish with sliced almonds.

ingredients.text: 2 packs (8 ea./800 g/1.8 lb) carrots, cut into  pieces
ingredients.name: marchew
ingredients.note: 8 ea./800 g/1.8 lb, cut into pieces

ingredients.text: 1 pack (200 g) bean sprouts, soaked in hot water and drained
ingredients.name: kiełki fasoli mung
ingredients.note: 200 g, soaked in hot water and drained

ingredients.text: 1 pack (200 g) broccoli florets, soaked in hot water and drained
ingredients.name: brokuł
ingredients.note: 200 g, florets, soaked in hot water and drained

ingredients.text: 1 pack (200 g) mushrooms, quartered and soaked in hot water
ingredients.name: pieczarka
ingredients.note: 200 g, quartered and soaked in hot water

ingredients.text: ½ pack (250 g) cabbage, cut into 2 cm pieces
ingredients.name: kapusta biała

ingredients.text: 1 tbsp vegetarian oyster sauce substitute (or omit)
ingredients.name: wegetariański zamiennik sosu ostrygowego

steps.text: Heat the oil in a non-stick pan, add onion and garlic, and stir-fry for 25 seconds until fragrant.
Add the rice, all the vegetables, some salt, light soy sauce, oyster sauce and pepper. Stir until mixed well.
Serve.

recipes.title: Crawfish Boil
recipes.description: Small-batch Louisiana-style crawfish boil seasoned with cayenne, dill, paprika and lemon zest.

steps.text: Bring water to a boil in a stockpot or your tallest pot.
Stir in seasonings.
Add crawfish, making sure to leave any dead ones behind.
Cook for 7 minutes.
Turn off the heat and leave on the burner for 8 minutes.
This allows the crawfish to soak in and absorb the flavorful broth without overcooking.
Drain through a colander and serve.

recipes.title: Tofu Scramble I
recipes.description: Wegańska jajecznica z tofu z cebulą, czosnkiem, suszonymi pomidorami i szpinakiem.

ingredients.text: Olive or vegetable oil (or veggie butter)
ingredients.name: olej roślinny
ingredients.note: Olive or vegetable oil (or veggie butter)

ingredients.text: ⅓ block soft tofu, drained for 15 minutes
ingredients.name: tofu
ingredients.note: block soft tofu, drained for 15 minutes

ingredients.text: 2 dashes ground turmeric or curry powder
ingredients.name: kurkuma

ingredients.text: 1–3 ea. flour tortillas, or vegan bread (optional)
ingredients.name: tortilla pszenna

steps.text: Heat about 1–2 tablespoons (15–30 g) oil in a saucepan.
Add onion, garlic, and sun-dried tomato to pan, then cook until soft and golden.
While that is cooking, mash tofu until it gets an even scrambled texture, and add seasonings as specified or to taste.
Mix it all in until evenly distributed.
When onion mix is cooked, add tofu and spinach.
Heat through until spinach is soft and wilted looking.
Serve with tortillas like a breakfast burrito or in bread like a breakfast sandwich.

recipes.title: Pikelet (Australian Mini Pancakes)
recipes.description: Pikelets are small, thick pancakes, and are standards of the New Zealand kitchen. They are also made in Australia.

steps.text: Sift the flours into a large mixing bowl, adding half a teaspoon of the bicarbonate of soda and the salt.
Crumble the yeast into a small bowl and slowly add the water until you have a brown paste.
Pour the liquid yeast into the mixing bowl.
Mix it about a bit until you have a very thick batter. You can use a wooden spoon, but you get much better results if you get stuck in and use your hands.
Cover the bowl with a warm and damp cloth and leave in a warm place for 2 hours.
Return to the now frothy batter (if it is not then you have done something wrong). Dissolve the rest of the bicarbonate of soda in the lukewarm milk and slowly add it to the batter.

Heat a lightly greased griddle or ordinary frying pan until very hot. Now, using one spoonful at a time, cook the mixture for about 2 minutes on each side. The indication to turn should be when the bubbles that will form dry out.

recipes.title: Rocky Road Confectionery I
recipes.description: Rocky road is a type of confectionery commonly made in Australia. It is made from chunks of marshmallow in a matrix of chocolate.

ingredients.text: ¾ cup walnut meats, shelled and chopped
ingredients.name: orzech włoski

steps.text: Measure all ingredients.
Butter an 8x8x2-inch square pan. Reserve.
Place chocolate morsels, milk and butter into a heavy-bottomed pot. Set heat control dial at 350°F (175°C).
Begin stirring immediately. Stir constantly until chocolate is melted and milk and butter are incorporated. Stir in remaining ingredients.
Spread the mixture into the prepared pan.
Refrigerate until firm, about 2 hours.

recipes.title: Tex-Mex Sliders
recipes.description: Mini burgery w stylu Tex-Mex z mielonej wołowiny przyprawionej kminkiem i chipotle, z serem Monterey Jack.

ingredients.text: ½ tsp freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: pieprz czarny

ingredients.text: 16 ea. 1-inch buns, split in half and toasted
ingredients.name: bułka do hamburgera

steps.text: Preheat an electric griddle to 350°F.
Combine seasonings. Set aside.
Place meat out on a parchment-lined sheet pan and cover with plastic wrap. Roll out with a rolling pin until meat fills pan.
Remove entire sheet of parchment, including meat, from pan. Remove meat and cut into 16 equal patties with a pizza cutter.
Sprinkle both sides of each patty with seasoning mixture. Cook on preheated griddle 1 minute per side, putting cheese on cooked side after flipping.
Meanwhile, spread butter on each bun. Place a patty in each bun and close. Serve warm with desired condiments.

recipes.title: Chicken Sopas
recipes.description: Sopas is a Filipino macaroni soup made with elbow macaroni, meat, vegetables, and milk.

ingredients.text: 250 grams chicken meat, still attached to the bones
ingredients.name: mięso z kurczaka

steps.text: Preheat oil in a pot.
Add onion and garlic, and sauté them. Be careful not to burn them, as this will give your soup a burnt and bitter taste.
Add the chicken, salt, and pepper. Let it cook but don't let it brown. Browning the meat will give you a dark broth with an unpleasant taste.
Pour in water and bring everything to a boil.
As soon as the water boils, the scum from the chicken will rise to the top—you can skim it off.
Season again with salt and pepper—this is called "layering" in cooking.
Add the elbow macaroni and cook for 7 minutes or so.
The macaroni will have absorbed some of the salt by now, so season again with salt.
Add the carrots and cabbage. Mix well.
Add in the milk but don't let it boil—boiling will make the milk separate and ruin the soup's texture.
Serve immediately because the elbow macaroni will absorb most of the milky broth if you let it stand too long.
Enjoy!

recipes.title: Neapolitan Sauce
recipes.description: Neapolitan sauce refers to a tomato-based sauce derived from those in Italian cuisine.

ingredients.text: ½ cup game stock or essence
ingredients.name: bulion z dziczyzny

steps.text: Fry the chopped onion in a saucepan of butter with the ham.
Add the marsala wine and blond of veal.
Add the thyme, bay leaf, peppercorns, clove, and mushroom.
Cook until reduced by half.
In another saucepan heat the Espagnole sauce, tomato sauce, and game stock or essence.
Cook until reduced by a third.
Add the contents of the first saucepan, boil the sauce a few minutes, and pass it through a sieve.
Warm it up in a bain-marie before using.

recipes.title: Tuwon Dawa (Nigerian Sorghum Swallow)
recipes.description: Traditional Nigerian swallow dish made from sorghum flour, with a distinctive brown color, served with draw soups.

ingredients.text: 2 cups whole guinea corn (sorghum) or 1½ cups sorghum flour
ingredients.name: mąka sorgo
ingredients.note: whole guinea corn (sorghum) or 1½ cups sorghum flour

steps.text: If using whole sorghum, wash the grains thoroughly and spread them out to dry completely, covering them to keep out dust and debris.
Grind or pound the dried grains into a fine powder.
Sieve to remove any chaff.
In a pot, bring 3–4 cups of water to a boil.
Mix some of the sorghum flour with a small amount of water to form a smooth, semi-thick batter.
Gradually stir the batter into the boiling water, mixing continuously to avoid lumps.
Add potash, and stir well.
Allow to cook on medium heat, stirring regularly, until the mixture thickens.
For a firmer tuwo, add more sorghum flour directly and stir vigorously until it reaches the desired consistency.
Once cooked, mold and serve hot with soup.

recipes.title: Midwestern Chicken Wings
recipes.description: Skrzydełka kurczaka marynowane w sosie sojowym i dżemie morelowym, grillowane. Nie są ostre.

ingredients.text: 12 ounces apricot preserves (not preserved apricots, not apricot jelly)
ingredients.name: dżem morelowy
ingredients.note: not preserved apricots, not apricot jelly

steps.text: Place all ingredients except chicken into a bowl and mix to make a marinade.
Marinate the chicken in the refrigerator with the marinade for at least 3 hours. A plastic bag sealed tight without much air or free space is believed to provide the best marinating.
Clean and preheat grill to medium heat.
Place wings on grill. Turn 1–4 times over the next 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Lemon Chicken Pasta
recipes.description: Pieces of chicken breast dredged in flour and seared, then tossed with lemon slices, artichokes, sun-dried tomatoes, white wine, cream, spinach and linguine.

ingredients.text: 12 ounces (340 g) boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into ½-inch (1 cm) thick slices
ingredients.name: pierś z kurczaka
ingredients.note: boneless skinless, cut into ½-inch (1 cm) thick slices

ingredients.text: 2 artichoke hearts, cut into quarters (canned is fine)
ingredients.name: serce artyszoka

ingredients.text: ½ cup (120 g) oil-packed sun-dried tomatoes, drained
ingredients.name: suszone pomidory w oleju

ingredients.text: ½ cup (120 ml) dry white wine
ingredients.name: wino białe wytrawne

ingredients.text: 3 ounces (¼ cup plus 2 tablespoons / 90 g) heavy cream
ingredients.name: śmietanka 36%

ingredients.text: ½ pound (225 g) linguine, cooked al dente and drained
ingredients.name: makaron linguine

steps.text: Season the chicken slices with salt, pepper, and oregano.
Dredge chicken in flour, shaking off excess flour.
Heat a heavy-bottomed skillet or large sauté pan (not non-stick) over high heat until very hot.
Add olive oil.
When oil begins to smoke, add the chicken pieces.
Cook until pieces are seared on both sides (1–2 minutes per side).
Remove chicken to a plate and keep warm, leaving the oil in the pan.
Add the lemon slices to the hot pan and cook until caramelized (about 1 minute per side).
Add the artichokes, sun-dried tomatoes, garlic, capers, and red pepper flakes, and sauté for 2 minutes.
Add the white wine and cook until reduced to a glaze.
Return the chicken to the pan with the cream, and sauté for 2 minutes.
Add the spinach, rosemary, and cooked linguine.
Cook, tossing to combine linguine and sauce, just until spinach is wilted, about 1 minute.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Carquinyoli (Catalan Almond Cookies)
recipes.description: Carquinyoli are Catalan cookies much like biscotti.

steps.text: Combine the flour, cinnamon, and baking powder.
Combine the egg, sugar, and lemon zest. Whip until very foamy.
Stir the flour mixture and almonds into the egg mixture to get a dough.
Shape the dough into two flattened logs of about 6 x 3 cm on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Brush the dough with the beaten egg.
Bake in the oven at moderate heat (180°C) for 25 minutes.
While still hot, cut the baked dough into thin slices less than 1 cm thick. Arrange slices on baking sheets without letting them touch.
Bake them for 5 minutes more in the oven to brown their surfaces.
Allow to cool before eating.

categories: Recipes using vegetable broth and stock

recipes.title: Beer Cheese Risotto
recipes.description: A hearty variation on classic cheese-flavored risotto, with beer adding a Welsh Rarebit overtone.

ingredients.text: ¼ cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese (to taste)
ingredients.name: ser cheddar

steps.text: Heat the stock to near boiling. Keep hot.
Sweat the onion in a heavy, medium saucepan with the olive oil, adding a generous pinch of salt.
When the onions are soft and transparent, add the rice, sautéeing until each grain is coated.
Add the beer and heat to simmer, stirring constantly.
When the beer is mostly absorbed, add around ⅓ to ½ cup of hot stock. Stir constantly while simmering.

Repeat procedure for around twenty minutes—most of the stock should be consumed and the rice should be tender to the taste before proceeding. The rice will produce a thick, creamy sauce in the course of cooking.
Remove from heat, adding the Parmesan cheese and stirring to incorporate.
Give the cheese a chance to dissolve and melt, then add the cheddar. Stir to melt and incorporate. If a cheesier rice is desired, add more.

recipes.title: Royal Icing
recipes.description: Royal icing is a type of icing that dries to a hard sheen.

ingredients.name: krem z kamienia nazębnego (cream of tartar)

ingredients.text: 2 ½ cups (300 g / 11 oz) confectioners' sugar
ingredients.name: cukier puder
barwnik spożywczy w płynie lub paście

steps.text: In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the whisk attachment, beat the egg whites on low for about 1 minute until they become loose.
Add the cream of tartar and continue mixing on low until the whites become frothy, about 2 minutes.
Gradually add the confectioners' sugar with the mixer on low.
Continue to mix until the icing holds a stiff peak and is dull in appearance, about 2 minutes. The icing is ready to use for piping lines.

recipes.title: Potatoes with Green Sauce
recipes.description: Green sauce is a dish that originates from the Frankfurt/Main region of Germany.

ingredients.text: 3–4 cups (200 g / 7 oz per cup) sour cream
ingredients.name: śmietana 18%

ingredients.text: 1 tbsp sunflower oil (or other oil of neutral taste)
ingredients.name: olej słonecznikowy
ingredients.note: or other oil of neutral taste

ingredients.text: 1–1½ empty sour cream cups filled with dill
ingredients.name: koperek
ingredients.note: 1–1½ empty sour cream cups filled with dill

ingredients.text: 1–1½ empty sour cream cups filled with other mixed herbs (e.g. chives, parsley, onion leaves, lemon balm, burnet, a small amount of sorrel if available)
ingredients.name: mieszanka ziół
ingredients.note: 1–1½ empty sour cream cups; e.g. chives, parsley, onion leaves, lemon balm, burnet, a small amount of sorrel if available

steps.text: Combine sour cream, oil, and lemon juice. Add milk until the mixture takes the consistency of a thick sauce.
Mix herbs well, and mix them into the sauce.
Cut hard-boiled eggs to small pieces and add them to the sauce along with some salt and pepper.
Leave the sauce in the fridge for about 1–1½.
Boil potatoes and serve hot with the cold sauce. More hard-boiled eggs can also be served along with this.

recipes.title: Raspberry Cuts
recipes.description: A simple, very tasty cake with raspberries, cream and butter cookies; the cookies form the top layer, so slices are cut along the biscuit borders.

ingredients.text: 3 packets (120 g) Dr Oetker Rote Grütze powdered dessert mix (see notes)
ingredients.name: deser w proszku Rote Grütze
ingredients.note: 3 packets, Dr Oetker Rote Grütze powdered dessert mix (see notes)

steps.text: Mix the eggs, sugar, oil, sparkling water, flour, baking powder, vanilla sugar and a little lemon juice in a bowl to a smooth dough.
Place baking paper in a small baking sheet (approx. 25 x 40 cm) and spread the dough evenly over it.
Bake the dough in the oven at approx. 175 °C for approx. 30 minutes until golden yellow and then let it cool well.
Bring the dessert mix to the boil with 0.75 l of water.
Add the frozen raspberries to the red groats, stir well and wait until the raspberries are thawed.
Spread the warm mass evenly on the dough.
Now cool the cake, preferably overnight.
Whip the cream with the cream stiff until stiff, lightly sweeten with vanilla sugar depending on your taste, and then distribute the mixture evenly over the cake.
Put on the butter cookies and lightly dust with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Lemon Impossible Pie
recipes.description: Ciasto bez spodu, które podczas pieczenia samo rozdziela się na warstwy.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 190°C (375°F).
Whisk all ingredients until thoroughly mixed. The optimal method is to whisk the wet ingredients first and slowly add the dry ingredients while whisking slowly.
Pour into greased baking dish.
Bake until an inserted skewer comes out clean. It should take at least 45 minutes.
Serve hot or cold with ice cream.

recipes.title: Fresh Egg Pasta (Pasta Fresca All'uovo)
recipes.description: Homemade egg pasta made from flour, eggs, oil and salt, shaped by hand or with a pasta machine.

ingredients.text: 300 g (1½ cups) all-purpose flour or durum semolina flour
ingredients.name: mąka pszenna

steps.text: Pour the flour and salt into a food processor.
Beat the eggs with the oil. With the processor running, slowly pour the egg through the feed tube.
Continue to mix until the dough comes together and forms a ball. If it doesn't form a ball, add a little water through the feed tube 1 teaspoon at a time until it does.
Remove the dough from the food processor and knead for 10 minutes on a floured work surface. If the dough is too sticky, work in a little extra flour.
Wrap the dough in cling wrap and let it rest in the refrigerator for 30 minutes.
Remove from the fridge and knead it some more until it has warmed to room temperature.
Divide the dough into 2 balls.
Roll each ball out on a floured surface or pastry cloth in the shape of a rectangle.
Rotate the dough 90º and roll across its width.
Rotate 90º and roll some more. Keep turning and rolling until the dough is paper thin.
If at any time the dough begins to stick, lift it carefully and flour the work surface.
Dust the rectangle of rolled dough lightly and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Roll it up from the shorter side into a roulade (jelly-roll) shape.
With a sharp knife, slice the roll into even strips: 3 mm (⅛ inch) wide for tagliarini; 6 mm (¼ inch) wide for fettuccine and tagliatelle; 100 mm (4 inches) wide for lasagna.
By pasta machine: cut the dough into roughly 3 equal pieces.
On its widest setting, feed each piece of dough through the machine 5 or 6 times, folding it in thirds between each rolling, until smooth, shiny and elastic.
Set the machine to the second setting and feed a portion of the dough through.
Set the machine to the third setting and roll the dough through again.
Keep changing the setting and rolling until the dough is about 1 mm (1/16 inch) thick.
Use the appropriate attachment to cut the pasta into strips.
Hang the pasta over a clean broomstick handle to dry, supported on the backs of two chairs. Or place on waxed paper or clean tea towels.
Homemade pasta may be cooked immediately or wrapped, well floured, in cling wrap and refrigerated for up to 24 hours.
Cook fresh pasta in 6–8 litres of water for 5–10 minutes or until al dente.

images: Roast Butternut, Brown Rice and Biltong Salad.jpg

recipes.title: Roast Butternut, Biltong and Brown Rice Salad
recipes.description: A salad of roasted butternut squash, biltong, brown rice, cucumber and feta, tossed with herbs.

ingredients.text: 1 small butternut squash, peeled and chopped
ingredients.name: dynia

ingredients.text: 3 tbsp onion roasted seeds (or plain roasted seeds)
ingredients.name: prażone pestki słonecznika
ingredients.note: onion roasted seeds (or plain roasted seeds)

ingredients.text: 2 tbsp fresh chopped parsley or mint
ingredients.name: natka pietruszki

steps.text: Preheat oven to 180°C
Cook brown rice according to packet instructions.
Drain and set aside.
Toss butternut, olive oil and seasoning into a roasting pan.
Roast butternut until cooked through and slightly charred.
Stir through rice, butternut, bilton, roasted seeds, cucumber, feta and herbs.
Serve tossed with your favourite vinaigrette, or honey mustard dressing.

recipes.title: Baked Tilapia with White Wine
recipes.description: Whole tilapia baked with white wine, garlic, herbs and butter, finished with a creamy wine sauce.

ingredients.text: 2 fresh whole tilapia, approximately 8–10 oz each, gutted and descaled
ingredients.name: tilapia
ingredients.note: fresh whole, approximately 8–10 oz each, gutted and descaled

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon cornstarch, blended with a little cold water
ingredients.name: mąka ziemniaczana
ingredients.note: blended with a little cold water

steps.text: Arrange the tilapia side-by-side in a lightly oiled roasting tin or ovenproof dish.
Pour the wine over the fish, then sprinkle over the chopped garlic, most of the herbs, the salad onions, and seasoning to taste. Place half the butter on each fish.
Cover with a sheet of lightly oiled foil to seal in the fish, then bake in a preheated 350°F oven, for 30–35 minutes.
Transfer the tilapia to a serving dish and keep warm. Pour the juices into a pan, stir in the blended corn flour, and simmer for 2 minutes. Stir in the creme fraiche.
Pour the sauce over the fish, and serve immediately, sprinkled with the remaining herbs.

recipes.title: Out of Salad Dressing
recipes.description: Sos sałatkowy z cytryną, parmezanem, majonezem i mlekiem, przygotowany z podstawowych składników i schłodzony przez noc.

steps.text: Mix together lemon juice, Parmesan cheese, garlic salt, and mayonnaise until smooth.
Stir in milk, adjusting the amount or adding a little water, to make the dressing as thin or thick as you like.
Cover and refrigerate 8 hours, or overnight.

recipes.title: Cherbet Mazhar (Algerian Flower Water Drink)
recipes.description: Orange Blossom Cherbet is a refreshing Algerian drink originating from Algiers, served during marriage proposals.

ingredients.text: 1 large glass of orange blossom water
ingredients.name: woda pomarańczowa z kwiatów

ingredients.text: 2–3 tbsp of granulated sugar (depending on taste)
ingredients.name: cukier

steps.text: Combine water and orange blossom water in a large saucepan over medium heat. Stir with a wooden spoon.
Add the cinnamon powder and stir until it fully dilutes.
Then add the sugar, and mix everything well.
When the sugar is completely dissolved, transfer the drink to a pitcher and let it cool in the fridge.
Serve with quince jam or seasonal fruit.

recipes.title: Roast Pork Loin with Cranberry Stuffing
recipes.description: A boneless pork loin brined in salt, honey, and vinegar and roasted, served with a cornbread and cranberry stuffing.

ingredients.text: ½ cup dried apple rings, finely diced
ingredients.name: jabłko suszone

ingredients.text: ½ cup shredded Monterey Jack cheese
ingredients.name: ser Monterey Jack

steps.text: Combine salt, honey, vinegar, peppercorns, and garlic in a gallon size zip-top bag.
Add ice and shake until ice is almost completely melted and mixture has cooled down.
Add pork and refrigerate for 2½–3 hours.
Combine remaining ingredients except mozzarella and Jack cheese.
Pour into a 9x9-inch baking pan and sprinkle with remaining ingredients.
Bake in the center of a 400°F oven for 30–35 minutes or until browned and bubbly on top.
Remove stuffing and keep warm.
Place pork roast on a roasting rack in a roasting pan and insert a probe thermometer into the center.
Bake at 375°F until internal temperature reaches 140°F for medium rare.
Remove to a plate and let rest 10 minutes.
Serve pork warm with stuffing.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Tortilla Soup
recipes.description: Tradycyjna zupa z południowego zachodu USA, dobra także do wykorzystania czerstwych tortilli.

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro or 1 teaspoon dried cilantro
ingredients.name: kolendra świeża

ingredients.text: 1 jalapeno, seeded and diced, or ½ teaspoon dried cayenne pepper (optional, Tabasco sauce can be added to individual bowls to adjust heat to taste)
ingredients.name: papryczka jalapeño
ingredients.note: seeded and diced, or ½ teaspoon dried cayenne pepper; optional

ingredients.text: Grated Monterey Jack or other Mexican cheeses
ingredients.name: ser Monterey Jack

steps.text: Place oil, chopped onion, minced garlic, tomatoes, tomato paste, cilantro, chicken, stock, salt, pepper, and jalapeño/red pepper in a crock pot.
Cook on low for 6–9 hours.
When chicken is cooked, remove from soup, coarsely chop, and return to soup.
Serve soup in individual bowls with chips, cheese and olives to garnish.
Sauté the onion and garlic in olive oil prior to adding other ingredients.
Simmer on medium heat until chicken is cooked thoroughly and otherwise follow slow cooker directions.

recipes.title: Hyderabadi Haleem (Ground Meat and Wheat)
recipes.description: A thick, slow-cooked dish of ground mutton and whole wheat, seasoned with ginger, garlic, chiles and garam masala.

steps.text: De-bran the wheat, wash, and soak for 2 hours.
Grind the ginger, garlic, chilies, and salt to make a paste. Rub the mutton with the mixture, and marinate for 1 hour.
Pressure cook the soaked wheat and marinated meat for about 45 minutes. Mince and grind to a fine paste.
In a pan, heat oil, add the sliced onions. Fry until brown, then add the spices.
Add the ground paste, and cook over low heat until the mixture leaves the sides of the pan, stirring occasionally.
Adjust the seasoning. Serve hot, with lime wedges coriander and fried onions as garnish.

recipes.title: Boilo (Hot Spiced Citrus Whiskey)
recipes.description: Boilo is a traditional Yuletide drink of the north-eastern United States, specifically Pennsylvania. It is a whiskey-based liqueur made with oranges, lemons, sugar and various spices such as cinnamon.

ingredients.text: 12 oz (355 ml) whiskey or more to taste
ingredients.name: whisky

ingredients.text: ½–1 teaspoon each of any or all of these spices: cinnamon, nutmeg, cloves, caraway seed, aniseed
ingredients.name: cynamon
ingredients.note: 1; each of any or all of: nutmeg, cloves, caraway seed, aniseed

steps.text: Peel the oranges and lemons. Cut up the fruit and squeeze them into a crock pot. A garlic press or potato-ricer works, or some kind of juicer or fruit squeezer. Put the remaining fruit pulp into the crock pot as well.
Add the raisins, honey, and spices. Stir. Do not add whiskey yet!
Start the crock pot, and let the mixture cook for about 2–4 hours. Stir occasionally. It's complete when the fruit pulp gets cooked down.
Strain into a pitcher. Mash down the fruit in the strainer to get all the liquid.
Add the whiskey to the pitcher and stir. If you cook the whiskey, even for a short time, the alcohol will start to evaporate. Taste, and add more whiskey to your liking.
Serve hot in shot glasses, espresso cups, or coffee mugs. After the first round, each individual serving can be reheated in the microwave.

recipes.title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
recipes.description: An easier version of peanut brittle that can be prepared in under 10 minutes using a microwave.

steps.text: Lightly grease a cookie sheet and set aside.
In 1½-quart casserole dish, stir together sugar and syrup. Microwave on high for 4 minutes.
Stir in peanuts. Microwave on high for 3–5 minutes or until light brown.
Add butter and vanilla, mixing well. Microwave at high 1–2 minutes more. The peanuts will be lightly browned and syrup very hot.
Add baking soda and stir gently until light and foamy.
Pour mixture onto greased cookie sheet. Let cool ½–1 hour.
When cool, break into small pieces and store in airtight container.

recipes.title: Brazilian Black Bean Soup
recipes.description: A vegan Brazilian soup of black beans simmered with garlic, onion, cumin and lime.

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon caribe or another ground hot pepper
ingredients.name: chili w proszku
ingredients.note: caribe or another ground hot pepper

steps.text: Place beans in a large pan and cover with water. Bring to a boil and remove from heat. Cover and let stand for 1 hour. Simmer for 2 hours and drain.

Place beans in a large pan and add 8 cups water, garlic, salt, white onions, cumin, ground chili and lime juice. Tie cloves in cheesecloth for easy removal if desired. Bring to a boil; reduce heat, cover and simmer for 2 hours or until beans are tender and soup is thick.
Mix in green onions and serve with lime wedge.

recipes.title: White House Honey Porter
recipes.description: White House honey porter is the much-anticipated recipe to White House beer.

ingredients.text: 2 (3.3) lb cans light unhopped malt extract
ingredients.name: ekstrakt słodowy jasny

ingredients.text: ¾ cup corn sugar for bottling
ingredients.name: cukier kukurydziany do butelkowania

steps.text: In a 6 qt pot, add grains to 2.25 qts of 168°F water. Mix well to bring the temperature down to 155°F.
Steep on stovetop at 155°F for 45 minutes.
Meanwhile, bring 2 gallons of water to 165°F in a 12 qt pot.
Place strainer over, then pour and spoon all the grains and liquid in. Rinse with 2 gallons of 165°F water. Let liquid drain through.
Discard the grains and bring the liquid to a boil. Set aside.
Add the 2 cans of malt extract and honey into the pot. Stir well.
Boil for an hour. Add half of the bittering hops at the 15 minute mark, the other half at 30 minute mark, then the aroma hops at the 60 minute mark.
Set aside and let stand for 15 minutes.
Place 2 gallons of chilled water into the primary fermenter and add the hot wort into it. Top with more water to total 5 gallons if necessary. Place into an ice bath to cool down to 70-80°F.
Activate dry yeast in 1 cup of sterilized water at 75–90°F for 15 minutes. Pitch yeast into the fermenter. Fill airlock halfway with water.
Ferment at room temp (64–68°F) for 3–4 days.
Siphon over to a secondary glass fermenter for another 4–7 days.
To bottle, make a priming syrup on the stove with 1 cup sterile water and ¾ cup priming sugar, bring to a boil for five minutes.
Pour the mixture into an empty bottling bucket. Siphon the beer from the fermenter over it. Distribute priming sugar evenly. Siphon into bottles and cap.
Let sit for 1–2 weeks at 75°F.

recipes.title: Snickerdoodles I
recipes.description: One recipe for the production of snickerdoodle cookies is as follows.

ingredients.text: 344 g (2 ¾ cups or 24 oz) all-purpose flour
ingredients.name: mąka pszenna

ingredients.text: 300 g (1 ½ cups or 12 oz) white sugar
ingredients.name: cukier

ingredients.text: 205 g (1 cup or 8 oz) soft shortening
ingredients.name: tłuszcz roślinny stały

steps.text: Preheat oven to 205°C (400°F or Gas Mark 6).
Combine the flour, salt, baking soda, and cream of tartar.
Cream together the sugar and shortening.
Beat in the eggs.
Mix the flour mixture into the batter to make a dough.
Shape dough into little balls, then transfer to a greased or parchment-lined baking sheet.
Bake for 10 minutes or until crisp and light brown.
Sprinkle generously with cinnamon while hot.

recipes.title: Blackberry Mush
recipes.description: Gęsty deser z jeżyn zagęszczony skrobią kukurydzianą, podawany na gorąco z lodami lub na zimno jak dżem.

ingredients.text: 80 g (2.8 oz / ⅓ cup) white granulated sugar
ingredients.name: cukier

steps.text: Put the fruit in a saucepan.
Add sugar, cornstarch, and water, and mash to a pulp.
Simmer or boil, uncovered, to reduce moisture.
Serve hot over ice cream, or cold as jam.

recipes.title: Florida Style Crab Cakes
recipes.description: Crab cakes seasoned with Florida Bay seasoning and lime, pan-fried in butter until golden.

ingredients.text: 2 pounds lump crab meat, picked over to remove shell bits and cartilage
ingredients.name: mięso z kraba
ingredients.note: lump, picked over to remove shell bits and cartilage

steps.text: Combine Florida Bay seasoning, mayonnaise, egg, mustard, cayenne, chives, cilantro, coriander, and lime juice in a large mixing bowl.
Season to taste with white pepper and kosher salt.
Fold in the bread crumbs and crab meat as gently as possible, trying to avoid breaking up the lumps.
Rest mixture in the refrigerator ½ to 2 hours.
Divide and shape into 5 patties.
Heat butter in a large heavy-bottomed skillet or sauté pan over medium-high heat.
Cook the crab cakes in the butter about 2 minutes per side, until golden brown on both sides.
Lower heat to medium and cook until the cakes are hot but still moist on the inside, about an additional 3 to 5 minutes per side.

recipes.title: Brazilian Shrimp and Cassava Sauce (Bobó de Camarao)
recipes.description: A Brazilian dish of shrimp cooked in a creamy mashed cassava sauce with coconut milk and palm oil.

ingredients.text: 6 medium tomatoes, peeled and seeded (or a large can of whole tomatoes)
ingredients.name: pomidor
ingredients.note: medium, peeled and seeded (or a large can of whole tomatoes)

ingredients.text: ¼ cup palm oil (also known as dendê)
ingredients.name: olej palmowy

steps.text: Peel and cut the manioc and put in a pan with cold water and salt.
Cook until tender, drain and reserve both the cooked manioc and the liquid.
Discard any manioc fiber.
Using a fork, mash the manioc while still hot. Use some of the liquid to help in the process. Do not use a blender or food processor.
Peel and de-vein the shrimp.
Sauté the onion and garlic in the olive oil until wilted.
Add ½ of the chopped cilantro and the tomatoes, stirring well.
Add the shrimp, and cook it for about 15 minutes.
Add the puréed manioc. Check the amount of liquid and add more of the reserved manioc liquid to thin the mixture, if necessary.
Add the coconut milk, the remaining cilantro and the palm oil.
Check for salt and pepper.
Serve over Brazilian white rice.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Babi Panggang Sauce
recipes.description: A tomato-based sauce served with babi panggang, a fusion dish prepared in the Netherlands.

steps.text: Peel and chop the onion.
Heat the oil in a saucepan, and add the onion and garlic.
Combine bouillon, sugar, sherry and tomato mash, and add this mixture to the saucepan.
Keep stirring and leave to boil for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Microwave Chocolate Cake II
recipes.description: An easy chocolate cake made in the microwave with cheap, common pantry ingredients.

ingredients.text: 3 tbsp (15 ml) chocolate chips, pine nuts, or hazelnuts
ingredients.name: czekolada w kawałkach, orzeszki piniowe lub orzechy laskowe
ingredients.note: chocolate chips, pine nuts, or hazelnuts

steps.text: Mix all the dry ingredients directly in a microwave-safe mug or bowl.
Add the egg and mix well.
Stir in the milk and oil.
Add the chocolate chips and vanilla. Stir well.
Microwave for 3 minutes at 1000w / 4 minutes at 700w / 3:30 minutes at 750w.
Cool slightly and enjoy.

recipes.title: Butterbeer
recipes.description: Butterbeer is a drink from the Harry Potter book series.

steps.text: Mix all ingredients thoroughly in a bowl.
Divide between mugs.
Heat as desired, and serve.

recipes.title: Herrencreme (German Custard Dessert)
recipes.description: Herrencreme is a German dessert based on custard and cream.

ingredients.text: 2 packets (88 g) German custard powder (e.g. Dr. Oetker)
ingredients.name: budyń waniliowy w proszku

steps.text: Combine milk, sugar, salt, and custard powder in a saucepan.
Cook, stirring, over medium heat until it has thickened.
Place a sheet of cling film on the surface of the pudding to prevent a skin from forming, and let cool completely.
Transfer the pudding to a bowl.
Stir in rum and chocolate to taste.
Fold in the whipped cream.
Chill in fridge for about 2 hours.
Serve.

recipes.title: New Mexico Chili Verde
recipes.description: New Mexico Chile Verde is the most popular version of chili con carne in the U.S. state of New Mexico, made with roasted green chile peppers, pork, garlic-free stew base with oregano and cumin.

ingredients.text: 2 green bell peppers, chopped (not frequently used in New Mexico)
ingredients.name: papryka zielona
ingredients.note: chopped (not frequently used in New Mexico)

steps.text: Combine bell peppers, chili peppers, water, tomatoes, bouillon, oregano, cumin, and coriander in a large pot. Cook over medium heat until peppers are tender.

Meanwhile, cook pork and onion in a skillet over medium heat, stirring occasionally, about ten minutes, or until pork is browned and crumbly. Drain pork and add to chile mixture. Simmer for 20 minutes.
Heat butter in the skillet over medium-low heat. Add flour. Cook, stirring frequently, until flour browns, about 2 minutes.
Add flour mixture to chile. Continue cooking and stirring until thickened to preference.

recipes.title: Spinach Artichoke Dip
recipes.description: Formal or informal, spinach artichoke dip is a great appetizer at any party. It is quick and easy taking very little time to prepare.

ingredients.text: ¾ cup (180 ml) heavy cream (use half milk, if desired)
ingredients.name: śmietanka

ingredients.text: ⅓ cup (80 ml) grated Parmesan cheese
ingredients.name: parmezan

ingredients.text: 16 ounces (450 g) frozen cut leaf spinach, thawed and well drained
ingredients.name: szpinak mrożony

ingredients.text: 1 can quartered artichoke hearts, rinsed and well-drained
ingredients.name: serca artyszoka

ingredients.text: ⅔ cup (160 ml) shredded Monterey Jack cheese
ingredients.name: ser Monterey Jack

ingredients.text: Crackers or tortilla chips, for serving
ingredients.name: krakersy lub chipsy tortilla

steps.text: In a food processor fitted with a metal blade, process the cream cheese, cream, Parmesan cheese, and garlic powder until smooth and creamy.
Add the spinach and process until thoroughly mixed.
Add the artichokes and process just until coarsely chopped.
Turn the mixture into a 3½-quart electric slow cooker; smooth the top.
Cover and cook on the high heat setting for 1¼–1½ hours, until hot in the center.
Sprinkle the top evenly with the Jack cheese and spoon the salsa in a ring around the inside edges of the slow cooker.
Cover and continue heating on high 15 minutes longer, or until the cheese is melted.
Reduce the heat to the low setting and serve warm with crackers or tortilla chips for dipping.
Refrigerate any leftovers.

recipes.title: Hominy Bread
recipes.description: Bread made from cooked hominy grits and cornmeal, bound with eggs and milk and baked until golden.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
In a large bowl combine grits, cornmeal, baking powder, salt, butter, and sugar.
In another bowl beat 2 eggs thoroughly, then add milk and mix together completely.
Add egg and milk mixture to dry ingredients.
Grease a large baking dish or 2 loaf pans. Pour mixture into pan(s).
Bake in preheated oven for 35 minutes, until golden brown and a knife inserted in the bread comes out clean.

recipes.title: Basic Cobbler
recipes.description: Deserowy kobbler z owocami, pieczony w ciastowym cieście na maśle.

ingredients.text: Salt (optional; add only if butter is unsalted)
ingredients.name: sól
ingredients.note: optional; add only if butter is unsalted

ingredients.text: 1 cup fresh fruit (e.g. peaches, blackberries, cherries, etc.)
ingredients.name: owoce świeże

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Place the butter in a deep 9½ x 12-inch baking dish. Put dish in oven to melt butter while preparing other ingredients.
If butter is unsalted, add a touch of salt to the pan as well.
Add flour and sugar to a bowl and sift together lightly.
Create a well in the center of the mixture, and pour the milk into the well. Mix together with a wire whisk until smooth.
Remove pan from oven. Pour batter into dish on top of melted butter. Do not stir.
Spoon the fresh fruit out evenly across the top, but again, do not stir.
Place cobbler in oven and bake uncovered until golden brown.

recipes.title: Simple Chocolate Cheese Pie
recipes.description: Quick and tasty chocolate cheese pie that is easy to make from simple ingredients.

ingredients.text: ¼ cup (60 ml) unsweetened cocoa powder
ingredients.name: kakao

steps.text: Melt the cream cheese, and cool slightly. Transfer to a mixing bowl.
Mix in the cocoa powder and powdered sugar.
Fold in the whipped topping.
Pour mixture into the ready-made crust.
Cover and place in a refrigerator/freezer. Remove when solid.
Serve.

recipes.title: Cappelletti in Brodo (Cappelletti Pasta Soup)
recipes.description: A very simple and delicious Italian pasta soup made with small meat or vegetable filled cappelletti ravioli.

ingredients.text: 250 g packet of Cappelletti pasta pillows
ingredients.name: makaron cappelletti

ingredients.text: ½ litre of water plus more to thin out the soup if required
ingredients.name: woda
ingredients.note: plus more to thin out the soup if required

steps.text: Bring the water to a rolling boil, add the stock cubes, and let them dissolve.
Add the Cappelletti pasta, and cook according to the instructions on the packet.
Add the cream and the parsley about 2 minutes before the end of the cooking. Turn down the heat.
Add the slug of sherry just before serving. If serving to children, the sherry can be added to the grown-up's plate after serving!
Let stand for a few minutes.
Serve sprinkled with grated Parmesan cheese. Further serving suggestion might include a green salad, or a cold bean salad.

recipes.title: Krokodyle łzy
recipes.description: Nalewka z imbiru, cytryny, cukru i miodu zalana wódką.

steps.text: Imbir umyć, osuszyć i pokroić w cienkie plasterki.
Cytryny sparzyć i pokroić w ósemki.
Do dużego słoja włożyć imbir, cytrynę, zasypać cukrem, dodać miód i zalać wódką.
Potrząsnąć, zamknąć szczelnie i odstawić na około 2 miesiące.
Co kilka dni potrząsać słojem.
Po dwóch miesiącach przecedzić i rozlać do butelek.
Zamknąć szczelnie i odstawić na około 30 dni.
Po tym czasie nalewka jest gotowa do spożycia.

recipes.title: Sesame Shrimp Toast
recipes.description: Chrupiące tosty z krewetkami obtoczone w sezamie, smażone na głębokim tłuszczu.

ingredients.text: 3 slices (or more as needed) sandwich bread
ingredients.name: chleb tostowy biały

steps.text: Remove shells and tails from shrimp.
Remove back veins from shrimp.
Cut down back of shrimp with sharp knife.
Chop shrimp into a very small dice.
Beat 1 egg, cornstarch, salt, pepper, and finely-chopped green onions in a small bowl until blended.
Add shrimp to egg mixture, and toss until shrimp are completely coated.
Remove crusts from bread. Cut each slice into quarters.
Place one spoonful of shrimp mixture on each piece of bread. Gently press to adhere to bread.
Brush or rub small amount of egg mixture over each shrimp toast.
Dip moist side into the sesame seeds spread out on a plate.
Heat oil in skillet over medium-high heat until it reaches 375°F (190°C).
Fry 3–4 shrimp toast pieces at a time in the hot oil until golden, 1–2 minutes on each side. Drain on absorbent paper.

recipes.title: Yogi Tea
recipes.description: Yogi tea is a spiced tea similar to chai.

ingredients.text: 8 or more ¼-inch (0.75cm) slices of fresh ginger root
ingredients.name: imbir świeży

ingredients.text: ½ tsp black tea (decaffinated black tea is acceptable)
ingredients.name: herbata czarna

steps.text: Bring 2 quarts (about 2 L) water to boil in 3–4-quart pot.
Add cloves and boil for 1 minute.
Add peppercorns, cinnamon, cardamom pods and ginger.
Cover and simmer gently for at least 30 minutes. For best flavor, cover tightly and simmer over low heat for 2–3 hours.
Remove from heat and add tea.
Let cool.
Strain ingredients from the finished tea.
When ready to drink, sweeten to taste with honey or maple syrup. Add soy milk or dairy milk.

recipes.title: Apple Parsnip Soup
recipes.description: This is a nice soup to make. It tastes good both hot and cold.

steps.text: Chop up the onions, and sauté them in a pot with the olive oil until the onions are golden.
Chop up the apples, the carrot, and the parsnip, and put them into the pot.
Put the water, the nutmeg, the soup mix (if you are using the soup mix), lemon juice into the pot.
Cook for one hour, or until the carrots are soft.
Put the soup into a blender, and blend it up until it is smooth; there should not be any lumps in it.
Serve cold or hot!

recipes.title: Chocolate Bourbon Pecan Pie
recipes.description: Pie pekan z czekoladą i bourbonem, w stylu południowych stanów USA.

ingredients.text: Pastry dough for 9-inch pie (commercial or your own)
ingredients.name: ciasto kruche na spód

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Beat eggs until yellow and creamy, in a large bowl.
Whisk in half-and-half, sugar, and syrup, until smooth.
Stir in bourbon, chocolate chips, and pecans.
Oil a springform pan lightly.
Roll out the pastry dough and press it into a pan, pressing out any air bubbles.
Pour mixture into oiled springform pan.
Put pie on a baking sheet with a raised edge or border.
Bake until only the center is sightly jiggly, about 2 hours.
Do not remove the pie from the mold until absolutely cooled, at least an hour.

recipes.title: Neapolitan Anchovy Sauce
recipes.description: Neapolitan anchovy sauce is a delicious, creamy sauce, perfect for meat or vegetables.

steps.text: Wash anchovies in vinegar.
Bone and pound with fennel and a cinnamon using a mortar and pestle.
Mix in parsley and marjoram, a squeeze of lemon juice, flour, cream, and the bones of the fish for which you will use this sauce.
Pass through a sieve, add garlic, and boil.
Take out the garlic before serving.

recipes.title: Orange Chocolate Chip Muffins
recipes.description: Muffins with milk and white chocolate chips and a hint of orange.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 220°C (350°F).
Sift flour into bowl, then rub in butter.
Add sugar, chocolate bits, eggs, milk, orange juice, and orange rind.
Mix well.
Spoon heaped tablespoons of mixture into greased muffin pans.
Bake for 15–20 minutes until cooked through.

images: A transparent bowl of kuli kuli.jpg
categories: Recipes using chile paste and sauce

recipes.title: Kuli-kuli
recipes.description: Kuli-kuli is a beloved traditional snack from Northern Nigeria, made primarily from groundnuts. It is known for its satisfying crunch and rich flavor.

ingredients.text: ½–1 teaspoon salt or to taste
ingredients.name: sól

steps.text: Toast the peanuts in a dry frying pan over medium heat, stirring occasionally to avoid burning.
Once roasted, remove the skins by rubbing them between your hands or using a cloth to gently press and peel off the skins.
Using a food processor or blender, grind the roasted peanuts to form a peanut butter, working in batches as necessary.
Transfer the peanut mixture to a large mixing bowl. Add water, ¼ cup (60 ml) at a time, kneading with your hands after each addition, until the mixture starts releasing oils.
Continue to knead for a further 5 minutes to release as much oil as possible.
Put the mixture into a cheesecloth and squeeze to release the oils. Transfer the peanut mixture back to the bowl and set aside the oils for deep-frying.
Stir in the remaining ingredients, mixing well to combine.
Mix in enough water, a tablespoon at a time, until you get a moldable dough, and knead well.

Take teaspoonfuls of the dough and roll them into small balls or form them into flat discs, depending on your preference. You can also shape them into small cylinders or oval shapes, like traditional kuli-kuli. You can experiment with different shapes.

Heat the reserved oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Fry the kuli-kuli pieces in batches, without overcrowding the pan, until golden brown and crispy on all sides (about 4–5 minutes), flipping them carefully for even frying.
Once fried, remove the kuli-kuli from the oil and place them on a paper towel to drain excess oil. Allow them to cool completely before serving.

recipes.title: Hot Wings
recipes.description: Hot wings are a dish of seasoned and fried chicken wings tossed in a spicy sauce.

ingredients.text: 12 whole chicken wings, tip removed and cut in half
ingredients.name: skrzydełko kurczaka
ingredients.note: whole, tip removed and cut in half

steps.text: To make the sauce, combine melted butter, hot sauce, minced garlic, and soy sauce in a stainless steel bowl.
Preheat oil to 350°F (180°C).
Combine seasoning salt, pepper, and wings. Toss to coat.
Fry wings in batches in oil for 11 minutes.
Drain on a rack. Do not use paper towels—they will make the food greasy.
Toss wings with sauce and serve warm.

recipes.title: Oven Pancakes
recipes.description: Puszyste naleśniki pieczone w piekarniku na patelni żaroodpornej.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 232°C (450°F), and oil an 8-inch oven-safe skillet.
Combine flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, and sugar.
Add the milk, oil, and vanilla; stir well.
Stir in the apple cider vinegar, mix well, and pour immediately into the skillet.
Bake at 232°C (450°F) for 18 to 20 minutes, and serve.

recipes.title: Zimtsterne (German Cinnamon Star Cookies)
recipes.description: Zimtsterne are German cinnamon cookies often eaten for the advent season.

steps.text: Whip the egg whites until creamy.
Sift in powdered sugar, and mix into egg whites.
Set aside almost a third of the resulting mass for casting.
Stir in the remaining mass of cinnamon and almonds, or hazelnuts and lemon zest, and knead into a dough.
Roll out the dough, cut out star shapes and place on the greased baking sheet.
Mix the remaining stiff egg white with rum until a glaze mass forms.
Brush the cinnamon stars with glaze.
Bake in a preheated oven at 160°C for about 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Duonos gira (Lithuanian Rye Drink)
recipes.description: Low- to no-alcohol drink made from fermented dark rye bread, often served in Lithuania as a summertime drink but also good served hot in winter.

ingredients.text: 1 lb dried black rye bread (Lithuanian rye-like sourdough)
ingredients.name: chleb żytni

steps.text: Boil water and pour over the cubed bread. Let soak for 24 hours.
Strain the liquid off, and reserve it. Mix yeast and sugar into this liquid. Keep in a warm place for 48 hours.
Transfer liquid to bottles. Add raisins or other dried fruit and close off bottles.
The duonos gira is now ready to drink. Store bottles in cool place for up to 2 months.

recipes.title: Ice Cream Sandwich
recipes.description: A frozen dessert of ice cream sandwiched between two cookie layers.

ingredients.text: 80 g (2.8 oz / ⅔ stick) unsalted butter
ingredients.name: masło

ingredients.text: 125 g (4.4 oz / ⅝ cup) superfine sugar
ingredients.name: cukier

ingredients.text: 180 g (6.3 oz / 1¼ cups) plain flour, plus extra for dusting
ingredients.name: mąka pszenna

ingredients.text: 20 g (0.71 oz / 1 heaped tablespoon) cocoa powder
ingredients.name: kakao

steps.text: Mix the flour, cocoa, bicarbonate of soda, and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter and sugar in a mixing bowl until soft and fluffy.
Beat in the egg.
Fold the dry ingredients into the wet ingredients, and bring together until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 2 minutes on a floured surface until smooth.
Shape the dough into a flat disc.
Cover with cling film and chill for 30 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 190 C.
Cover 2 baking trays with baking paper.
Roll out the dough to 5 mm thick.
Cut out into 24 circles, and arrange on the baking trays.
Bake for 10–12 minutes until well-cooked.
Place the biscuits on a wire rack and leave to cool.
Scoop 1 scoop of ice cream on a biscuit.
Sandwich together with another biscuit.
Repeat steps 15–16, using remaining biscuits and ice cream.
Enjoy!

recipes.title: Chess Pie
recipes.description: Chess pie - klasyczne amerykańskie ciasto z cukrowym nadzieniem na kruchym cieście.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Mix sugar, butter, and vinegar in saucepan.
Bring to a boil.
Beat eggs in bowl.
Gradually whisk the saucepan contents into the eggs, then add vanilla.
Pour mixture into pie crust.
Bake pie in 375°F (190°C) oven for 35 minutes.
Let cool.

recipes.title: White Sauce
recipes.description: Classic white sauce (béchamel-style) made from butter, flour and whole milk, seasoned with onion salt, white pepper, mustard, nutmeg and a bay leaf.

steps.text: Make a white roux: melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat until the foam subsides.
Add the flour and whisk together, still over the heat, for 2–3 minutes. The flour should lose its raw smell but should not brown.
Add the milk to the roux while whisking quickly but smoothly to create a smooth mixture.
Add the seasonings and cook over medium-low heat, stirring frequently.
Simmer the sauce until it lightly coats the back of a spoon.
Remove the bay leaf, taste and adjust for salt and pepper, and serve.

recipes.title: Curried Chiles (Mirchi ka Salan)
recipes.description: Indian curry of green and red chiles cooked with ground spices, tamarind juice and onions.

steps.text: Lightly roast the poppy seed, sesame seeds, coriander seeds, cumin seeds, and desiccated coconut, then grind in a mortar and pestle.
Heat oil in frying pan and use to stir fry the green chiles with some salt.
Drain the oil from the green chillies and keep aside.
Heat some oil in a pan. Add the red chiles, fenugreek seeds, and a couple of curry leaves, and heat until popping.
Add chopped onions, and fry until golden brown.
Mix in ground spices, chili powder, turmeric, ginger garlic paste, and nigella seeds. Stir well and cook for 2 minutes.
Mix in tamarind juice, and cook for a minute.
Add the green chillies and remaining curry leaves, and simmer for 15–20 minutes.
Serve with any meat accompaniment or rice dish like biryani.

recipes.title: Tapenade
recipes.description: Traditional Provençal paste of olives, anchovies and capers.

steps.text: Blend the anchovies, capers and olives. For this a blender is better than the traditional mortar and pestle.
Mix in a few tablespoons olive oil until smooth.
Serve on toast as an amuse-bouche, or with boiled eggs, with goat cheese and roasted peppers, or on potato gnocchi.

recipes.title: Central Texan Pinto Beans
recipes.description: Traditional Central Texan side dish of pinto beans simmered with a ham bone, bay leaves and optional brewed coffee.

ingredients.text: 1 ham bone or a rough equivalent of salt bacon
ingredients.name: kość z szynki
ingredients.note: or a rough equivalent of salt bacon

ingredients.text: A very small amount (3 oz / ~90 g) of that day's brewed coffee (optional)
ingredients.name: kawa

steps.text: Wash beans carefully and soak overnight in 8 cups of water.
Drain and refill with 5 cups of water.
Add all the other ingredients.
Bring to a boil and simmer at least 1 hour, or until tender.
Remove bay leaves.
Do not drain prior to serving, the liquid is an important aspect of the dish.
Can be served using slotted spoon, to allow draining, or with a ladle into small side-dish bowls.

recipes.title: Lemon Pickle II
recipes.description: Lemon pickle is a traditional condiment used with Indian food. Many pickle recipes from India have oil to help preserve the pickle, but this recipe uses no oil.

steps.text: Cut lemons into small pieces, and place in a bowl.
Cover with salt and set aside for at least 4 hours (24 is better).
Dry-roast the yellow mustard seeds, fenugreek seeds, star anise, and chopped chilis in a pan over high heat, shaking constantly—don't burn them!

Strain the juice from the lemons into a small saucepan, add the turmeric, ginger and sugar, and simmer for 2–3 minutes until the sugar has dissolved. If there isn't enough juice, add 1–2 tablespoons water.
Add the spices and sugar mixture to the bowl of lemons, and mix together well.
Pack into a pint jar, pressing the pieces in if needed, to ensure that the liquid covers all the lemon pieces.
Set aside to mature for 1 month.

recipes.title: Baked Eggplant
recipes.description: Festive baked eggplant halves filled with a sautéed mushroom, tomato, onion and walnut mixture.

ingredients.text: ¼ lb (113 g) button mushrooms, sliced
ingredients.name: pieczarka

steps.text: Cut eggplants in half lengthwise, leaving a ¼-inch (0.5 cm) rind.
Scoop out flesh using a curved serrated grapefruit knife, and coarsely chop it.
Place chopped eggplant into a large, deep skillet or flat-bottomed wok.
Rub inside of eggplant shells with olive oil and set aside on a baking sheet.
Add mushrooms, tomatoes, onions, garlic, salt, cinnamon, pepper, and olive oil to skillet, and sauté 5 to 10 minutes until soft but still chunky.
Place eggplant shells under the broiler, and broil 3 inches (7.5 cm) from heat source for 8–12 minutes, until fork tender (be careful not to burn).
Remove from heat source and set aside.
Coarsely grind walnuts, add to skillet along with capers and tomato paste, and mix well.
Fill eggplant shells with sautéed mixture and top with tomato slices.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Bake uncovered at 375°F for 25–35 minutes.

recipes.title: Tembleque (Puerto Rican Coconut Pudding)
recipes.description: Tembleque is a thickened coconut pudding originating from Puerto Rico.

ingredients.text: ¼ cup cornstarch or rice flour
ingredients.name: skrobia kukurydziana

steps.text: Put sugar, coconut milk, coconut cream, and salt into a saucepan. Cook until sugar dissolves and the milk starts to simmer.
Mix 3 tablespoons or more of cold heavy whipping cream into the cornstarch. Whip until all the cornstarch is diluted but still thick. You want a smooth thick paste with no lumps.
When milk starts to simmer, add the remaining heavy whipping cream and cornstarch mixture into the saucepan.
Keep the heat on low and stir constantly until the pudding thickens.
Pour into pudding cups or small bowls.
Cool in the fridge for 2 hours.
To serve, flip the pudding bowls onto a plate to remove the pudding, then sprinkle cinnamon on top.

recipes.title: Cajun Burger
recipes.description: Hamburgery z mielonej wołowiny doprawione cajun seasoning, podawane z serem pepper jack i majonezem z przyprawą.

steps.text: Combine mayonnaise and 1 Tbsp cajun seasoning. Refrigerate until needed.
Form meat into 4 equal patties, ½ inch (1.25 cm) thick. Sprinkle liberally on both sides with seasoning.
Preheat grill. Add burgers and cook, turning often, until desired doneness is achieved (165°F).
Spread mayo on buns and place the burgers in.
Eat!

recipes.title: Pork Stomach Filled with Meat and Vegetables (Saumagen)
recipes.description: A German dish of pork stomach stuffed with meat, potatoes, vegetables and rolls, cooked gently in hot water.

ingredients.text: 1 small pork stomach (order from your butcher)
ingredients.name: żołądek wieprzowy

steps.text: Soak the pork stomach overnight and use twine to close two of the three apertures.
Cut the meat and potatoes into small cubes.
Stew the onions, carrots, and parsley in butter.
Smash the garlic.
Mix everything with the rolls and eggs and spice it well; then put everything into the pork stomach and close the third aperture.
Put the stomach in hot water and cook for 2–3 hours. The water must not boil.
Cut the stomach in 2 cm thick slices and serve them with mashed potatoes and sauerkraut. Alternatively you can store the cooked stomach in the fridge and fry it when you are ready to eat it.

recipes.title: Bourbon Apples
recipes.description: Honeycrisp apple slices sautéed in butter and spiced with allspice, clove and cinnamon, then deglazed with bourbon and cooked until fork tender.

ingredients.text: 1 Honeycrisp apple, cored, peeled, and sliced into 12ths
ingredients.name: jabłko

steps.text: Coat apples with butter and lemon.
Combine sugar, allspice, cloves, and cinnamon. Sprinkle over apples and toss to coat.
Preheat a small stainless steel skillet over medium high heat. Add apples and sauté until lightly browned.
Add bourbon to pan and deglaze. Bring to a boil, and cook, stirring occasionally, until apples are fork tender. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Halva (Wheat-based)
recipes.description: Wheat-based halva, a sweet confection made from flour fried in butter or margarine and sugar syrup.

steps.text: Heat the margarine very gently in a saucepan.
Add the flour, and cook for 40 minutes over low to moderate heat until golden brown.
When the flour turns light golden, combine the sugar and water in a separate saucepan.
Boil gently to make a syrup.
Add the syrup to the saucepan with flour, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Scoop out small portions of halva with a wooden spoon, form into balls, and place on a serving plate.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Coconut Pudding I
recipes.description: Tajski deser kokosowy z agarem, mlekiem i mlekiem skondensowanym, podawany schłodzony w miseczkach.

steps.text: Purée the young coconut flesh in a blender, and keep aside.
In a saucepan, combine the tender coconut water and china-grass strands. Heat gently until the china-grass strands melt completely.
In another saucepan, heat milk and condensed milk over medium heat. Let it come to a boil.
To the boiled milk, add the melted china-grass mixture, and combine well.
Remove from the flame and let it cool down for at least 5 minutes.
Add the pureed tender coconut to the cooled milk mixture, and mix everything well.
Pour the mixture into a cake pan or stainless steel pan.
Place the pudding in the freezer for about 15 minutes or until it begins to set.
Remove the pudding from the freezer and place it in the refrigerator until fully set.
Using a knife, gently cut the pudding and serve it in dessert bowls.
