recipes.title: Persian Apple Dessert
recipes.description: Persian apple dessert blended in a blender with lemon juice and flower water.

ingredients.text: 3 medium apples, peeled and cut up
ingredients.name: jabłko

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon rose or orange flower water
ingredients.name: woda różana lub woda pomarańczowa

steps.text: Place half the apples and the remaining ingredients in blender.
Cover and blend until coarsely chopped, 20–30 seconds.
Add remaining apples; blend until coarsely chopped.

recipes.title: Chipotle BBQ Sauce
recipes.description: This chipotle BBQ sauce is really smoky and hot, so if you can't stand the heat, adjust it to your liking.

ingredients.text: 2 cans chipotle in adobo including all of adobo sauce
ingredients.name: chipotle w adobo

steps.text: Whisk together oil and flour and cook on medium heat, stirring constantly until light blonde color is achieved.
Add remaining ingredients and bring to a boil; reduce heat to low and cook 15 minutes.
Cool for 15 minutes and purée in batches until smooth.
Store in nonreactive container for up to 1 week.

recipes.title: Passover Orange Walnut Cake
recipes.description: A light, nut-based Passover cake flavored with orange extract and ground walnuts.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Beat eggs and add sugar, mix.
Mix in oil and add matzah meal.
Add walnuts and mix.
Add orange extract generously and mix.
Pour into 9-inch cake pan.
Bake for 30–40 minutes in the preheated oven.

recipes.title: Mascarpone Chocolate Sauce
recipes.description: Mascarpone cheese makes this sauce light and fluffy, while chocolate adds flavor and richness.

steps.text: Whisk together all ingredients in your serving bowl.
Serve as a dipping sauce with beignets or fruit; or, serve over ice cream.

categories: Recipes using fish broth and stock

recipes.title: Smoked Salmon Chowder
recipes.description: A creamy chowder made with smoked salmon, potatoes, and vegetables flavored with tarragon.

steps.text: Place stock pot over medium heat, add oil.
Add carrots, onions, celery, stirring until onions turn clear.
Add tarragon and salmon stock to deglaze bottom of pan.
Stir in smashed potatoes, smoked salmon.
Continue to stir and bring to a simmer.
Add milk and pepper.
Serve and enjoy.

recipes.title: Grape Lassi
recipes.description: A chilled Indian yogurt drink blended with black grapes, sugar and milk, served over ice.

ingredients.text: 1 cup fresh curd (thick plain Indian yogurt)
ingredients.name: jogurt naturalny

steps.text: Blend black grapes, sugar, curd, milk, and salt in a blender until smooth.
Crush ice-cubes, divide it into 4 portions, and divide between 4 glasses.
Pour the lassi over the ice cubes.
Serve chilled.

recipes.title: Stinging Nettle Pesto
recipes.description: A pesto made from stinging nettles, nuts, garlic, Parmesan, olive oil and lemon juice.

ingredients.text: ⅓ cup hazelnuts, pine nuts, and/or walnuts
ingredients.name: orzech laskowy

ingredients.text: ⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
ingredients.name: oliwa z oliwek

steps.text: Dry sauté or roast nuts until slightly browned.
With thick gloves, place nettles in boiling water for 1 minute.
Transfer nettles to an ice water bath to stop the cooking process. Drain.
Blend all ingredients until smooth. Alternatively, smash with mortar and pestle for a coarser consistency.

recipes.title: Coriander Chutney
recipes.description: Coriander chutney goes well with a papadum or chapati. It is suitable for refrigeration and freezes fairly well.

ingredients.text: 1 tsp cumin seeds or ground cumin (optional)
ingredients.name: kminek

ingredients.text: juice of ½ lemon or lime
ingredients.name: sok z cytryny

steps.text: Wash the coriander.
Finely chop the onion, chillies, and coriander.
Add the salt, juice, and cumin.
Blend to a fine paste.

recipes.title: Mbahal (Gambian Fish and Okra)
recipes.description: Mbahal is a traditional Gambian stew of smoked fish, dried okra and palm oil, popular among the Mandinka and usually served with rice or couscous.

ingredients.text: 500 g Gambian smoked fish (such as catfish or mackerel)
ingredients.name: ryba wędzona
ingredients.note: Gambian smoked fish (such as catfish or mackerel)

ingredients.text: 2 red or green bell peppers, diced
ingredients.name: papryka

ingredients.text: 2 Scotch bonnet chile peppers (or to taste), finely chopped
ingredients.name: papryczka chili

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper (optional, for added spiciness)
ingredients.name: pieprz cayenne

steps.text: If the smoked fish still has bones, carefully debone it and flake the flesh into small pieces. Set aside.
In a large pot or saucepan, heat the palm oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and minced garlic. Sauté until they become soft and translucent.
Add the diced tomatoes, diced bell peppers, and finely chopped Scotch bonnet peppers to the pot. Stir well to combine. Cook for a few minutes until the vegetables begin to soften.
Add the dried, ground okra to the pot, stirring continuously to prevent lumps from forming.
Stir in the tomato paste, ground ginger, ground coriander, and ground cayenne pepper (if using). Mix well to combine all the ingredients.
Reduce the heat to low and cover the pot. Allow the mixture to simmer for about 15–20 minutes, or until the okra is cooked and the flavors have melded together.
Add the flaked smoked fish to the pot and gently stir it into the stew. Be careful not to break up the fish too much.
Taste the mbahal and adjust the seasoning with salt and pepper according to your preference.
Serve hot with a side of steamed rice or couscous.

recipes.title: Feijão Tropeiro (Brazilian Beans and Sausage)
recipes.description: A traditional side dish from many parts of Brazil, made with pinto beans, sausage, bacon, and collard greens.

ingredients.text: 2 lbs sausage of your choice (mild Italian is good in this dish)
ingredients.name: kiełbasa
ingredients.note: of your choice (mild Italian is good in this dish)

steps.text: Prepare beans according to their package. Drain and set aside to cool.
In large pan, cook bacon and sausage. Remove sausage and bacon.
Slice sausage into 1 inch-thick pieces.
In the pan with bacon grease, sauté white onion and garlic.
Slice collard green into small (⅛-inch) strips.
Mix all ingredients except hard-boiled eggs in large bowl using a wooden spoon.
Drizzle with olive oil and stir gently.
Garnish with sliced boiled eggs.
Serve hot or cold.

recipes.title: Hachee (Dutch Beef Stew)
recipes.description: Dutch beef stew with onions, beer and vinegar, simmered for about 3 hours until tender and served over cooked rice.

ingredients.text: about 1 pound (450 g) stewing beef, cut in bite-sized pieces
ingredients.name: wołowina gulaszowa

ingredients.text: 1 cube of beef bouillon or 1 ½ tsp powdered stock, combined with 1 cup water
ingredients.name: bulion wołowy
ingredients.note: or 1 ½ tsp powdered stock, combined with 1 cup water

ingredients.text: 1 bottle of dark beer or 12 ounces of beef stock
ingredients.name: piwo ciemne

steps.text: Combine flour, salt, and pepper. Dredge meat pieces in this mixture.
Melt butter in heavy pan, add meat, and sear until lightly browned.
Add onions and seasonings. Cook, stirring, until onions start to get translucent.
Stir together water and bouillon cube/powder until well-dissolved. Add to meat/onion mixture along with vinegar and beer.
Bring to a boil, then lower heat and let simmer about 3 hours until meat is tender. Stir occasionally to avoid scorching.
Check seasoning, and add salt and pepper if needed.
Serve over cooked rice.

recipes.title: Wisconsin Ackawi Cheese Triangles
recipes.description: Appetizer triangles of puff pastry filled with shredded Wisconsin Ackawi cheese, parsley, onion and red pepper.

ingredients.text: 2 cups (8 ounces / 225 g) shredded Wisconsin Ackawi cheese
ingredients.name: ser

ingredients.text: ½ cup (120 ml) chopped fresh parsley
ingredients.name: natka pietruszki

ingredients.text: ¼ teaspoon (1.25 ml) ground red pepper
ingredients.name: pieprz cayenne

steps.text: Combine cheese, parsley, onion, egg white, and red pepper; set aside.
On a lightly floured surface, roll 1 sheet pastry into a 12 x 12-inch (30 x 30 cm) square; cut into 16 ea. 3 x 3-inch (7.5 x 7.5 cm) squares.
Place 1 tablespoon (15 ml) cheese mixture on each square; fold pastry over each filling, forming a triangle. Seal edges with tines of a fork; place on an ungreased baking sheet.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 10 minutes or until golden brown. Repeat process with second sheet of puff pastry.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Ibisuba (Rwandan Bean Salad)
recipes.description: A refreshing and nutritious bean salad from Rwanda, made with cooked beans, fresh vegetables and a tangy lemon dressing.

ingredients.text: 2 cups cooked beans (such as red beans, white beans, or black-eyed peas)
ingredients.name: fasola czerwona, gotowana
ingredients.note: such as red beans, white beans, or black-eyed peas

steps.text: In a mixing bowl, combine the cooked beans, chopped onion, diced tomato, diced cucumber, diced green bell pepper, grated carrot, and chopped parsley or cilantro.
In a separate small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and black pepper to create the dressing.
Pour the dressing over the bean and vegetable mixture, and gently toss to combine, ensuring all the ingredients are evenly coated.
Adjust the seasoning with additional salt and black pepper, if needed.
Let the salad marinate in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld together.
Before serving, give the salad a final toss and transfer it to a serving dish.
Garnish with additional chopped parsley or cilantro, if desired.
Serve chilled as a side dish with grilled meats, fish, or other Rwandan dishes.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Garlic Seared Halibut
recipes.description: Halibut fillets marinated in garlic, white wine, lemon and chicken broth, pan-seared and finished with a butter pan sauce.

steps.text: Combine garlic, ¼ cup white wine, lemon, and ½ cup chicken broth in a gallon-size zip-top bag.
Add fish and toss to coat.
Refrigerate for 1 hour.
Take fish out of marinade and reserve marinade.
Sprinkle on both sides liberally with kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper and set aside.
Melt 1 tbsp butter with olive oil in a 12-inch stainless steel sauté pan over medium high heat.
Add fish and cook until golden brown and cooked through, about 3–4 minutes per side.
Remove and keep warm.
Deglaze pan with reserved marinade and reserved wine and chicken broth.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and cook until reduced by ⅓.
Whisk in butter 1 tbsp at a time, waiting until the tbsp before it is melted before adding a new one.
Spoon sauce over halibut and serve warm.

recipes.title: Crunchy Baked Chicken
recipes.description: This is a surprisingly easy and filling dish.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a shallow bowl, melt butter and place chicken breast in bowl to coat.
In another shallow bowl, mix Italian bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese.
Transfer chicken from butter bowl to breadcrumb bowl. Roll chicken in breadcrumb mixture until coated.
Place in greased pan.
Bake for 35–40 minutes.

recipes.title: Vichyssoise (Chilled Potato Leek Soup)
recipes.description: A simple chilled soup combining potatoes and leeks with a cream roux.

ingredients.text: 4 large diced leeks (white and yellow parts only)
ingredients.name: por
ingredients.note: large, diced, white and yellow parts only

ingredients.text: 1 bunch diced shallots (white bases only) or green onions
ingredients.name: szalotka
ingredients.note: diced, white bases only, or green onions

ingredients.text: 1½ tbsp chicken bouillon or add homemade stock
ingredients.name: bulion drobiowy

steps.text: Peel potatoes and remove all brown and discolored areas.
Boil potatoes for 20 minutes or until the interiors are soft when stuck with a knife. Do not overcook potatoes.
Drain potatoes, retain liquid, let the potatoes cool, then mash with fork.
In a braiser over low heat, sauté leek and shallot bottoms in the butter until translucent, or about 10 minutes.
Add chicken base, white pepper, white wine, heavy cream, and milk; simmer until soup starts to bubble.
Add mashed potatoes and whisk vigorously; if the soup is too thick add some of the potato water.
Chill the soup.
Just before serving, put the soup in a blender, and blend on low speed for 20 seconds. Garnish with shallot tops

recipes.title: Potato, Courgette, and Cavelo Nero Pancakes
recipes.description: Vegetable fritters made from grated courgette and potato, with cavelo nero, spring onions, dill, egg and flour, fried in a pan and served with sour cream, applesauce or ketchup.

steps.text: In a food processor, coarsely grate the courgette. Alternatively, use the coarse grating side of a cheese grater.
Sprinkle the courgette with the salt and let sit in a bowl for about 15 minutes.
Squeeze the courgette through a fine mesh or cheesecloth to remove moisture.

Finely grate the potatoes with the fine grating side of a cheese grater. Alternatively, coarsely shred the potato in the food processor, then use the knife blade sparingly to make it slightly chopped. Remove moisture with a cheesecloth or fine mesh.
Remove the stem from the cavelo nero, then finely slice it.
Combine the grated courgette, grated potato, sliced cavelo nero, sliced spring onions and chopped dill in a bowl. Add the eggs, flour and pepper. Mix with a mixing spoon.

Heat a pan on medium heat and add a few tablespoons of oil. Place a spoonful of batter in the pan and flatten with a spatula; aim for no more than 4 inches in diameter. Cook for 3–4 minutes, then flip and cook for another 3–4 minutes. Add more oil as needed.
Place a paper towel or two on a plate and put the fritter pancakes on it to let the oil drain off.
Serve with sour cream, applesauce, or ketchup.

recipes.title: Idiyappam (South Indian Rice Noodles)
recipes.description: Idiyappam (rice noodles) is a South Indian food, usually served for breakfast.

ingredients.text: 1 cup raw (i.e. not roasted) rice flour
ingredients.name: mąka ryżowa

ingredients.text: 1 cup water (hot water preferred by some)
ingredients.name: woda

steps.text: Mix rice flour with hot water and salt.
Knead it into a smooth dough.
Press the dough through an idiyappam presser or sieve onto banana leaves on which a little grated coconut has been sprinkled. Alternatively, press it directly onto an idli pan without banana leaves.
Steam for 5–10 minutes.
Some people add a little grated coconut on top before steaming.

recipes.title: Mushroom Caps Stuffed with Bacon and Cheese
recipes.description: Mushroom caps stuffed with a cream cheese, bacon and bread crumb filling, then baked.

ingredients.text: ¼ cup (25 g) diced green onions
ingredients.name: zielona cebulka

steps.text: Preheat oven to 325°F (about 160–165°C).
Soften cream cheese and put in food processor.
Add Worcestershire sauce, salt, and pepper; pulse until mixed.
Fold in chopped bacon, chopped mushroom stems, diced green onions, and green peppers.
Set stuffing aside.
Mix bread crumbs with just enough butter to hold together.
Stuff mushroom caps with stuffing.
Top with bread crumbs.
Bake for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Buttery Noodles with Cheese
recipes.description: A simple vegetarian pasta with butter, goat cheese and garlic, inspired by Alfredo.

ingredients.text: Dry linguine or Spaghetti (enough for 2 people)
ingredients.name: makaron pszenny

ingredients.text: Goat cheese (2 pats of butter worth)—Parmesan is an acceptable substitute
ingredients.name: ser kozi
ingredients.note: 2 pats of butter worth; Parmesan is an acceptable substitute

steps.text: Fill pot with enough water for 2 servings of linguine.
Put pot over high heat, and add vegetarian bouillon cube.
As soon as the water boils, add linguine and textured vegetable protein.
When the linguine is done, pour out most of the water, so that there is approximately an inch left.
Add butter, cheese, chopped tomato, and herbs.
Crush in garlic cloves and add to pot.
Stir frequently until it is of desired thickness.

recipes.title: Farofa
recipes.description: Farofa is a typical Brazilian dish made of toasted manioc flour, usually served as a side dish with feijoada or grilled meat.

ingredients.text: 1-2 tbsp butter or vegetable oil, preferably olive oil.
ingredients.name: masło

ingredients.text: A few pieces of chopped processed fatty meat (typically bacon)
ingredients.name: boczek

ingredients.text: 500 g manioc (cassava) flour or premade farofa mix
ingredients.name: mąka z manioku

steps.text: Heat a skillet over medium heat. Add the meat and fry for a minute or so. Depending on how much fat is released from it, add up to 1 tbsp of the oil or butter, enough to fry the garlic and onions.
Add the garlic, and stir for a minute or so, making sure not to let it burn.
Add the onion and seasonings, and cook for about another minute.

Add the flour and any additional ingredients. Stir well and continue toasting for a couple minutes more. If using premade farofa mix, stir until the extra ingredients are well-done. If using raw cassava flour, slowly add the remaining butter or oil and stir until toasted and golden.
Turn off the heat, and add chopped cilantro if desired. Serve hot to warm.

recipes.title: Rice with Coconut (Arroz con Coco)
recipes.description: Rice cooked with coconut milk, water, sugar and raisins, served as a side dish.

ingredients.text: 1 small jar (4.3 oz / 125 g) concentrado de coco or 1 cup (250 ml / 8.5 fl oz) fresh coconut milk
ingredients.name: mleko kokosowe
ingredients.note: or 1 small jar (4.3 oz / 125 g) concentrado de coco

steps.text: Combine everything in a pot. Cover, bring to a simmer, and reduce to very low heat.
Cook until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender.
Served with a half of avocado and grilled meats of all varieties.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Sweet Italian Sausage Skillet
recipes.description: A skillet dish of sweet Italian sausage, pasta, stewed tomatoes, green beans and cheese.

ingredients.text: 2 cups (480 ml) rotini or other spiral pasta
ingredients.name: makaron spiralny

ingredients.text: 12 oz (330 g) sweet Italian sausage links
ingredients.name: kiełbasa włoska słodka

ingredients.text: 14.5 oz (410 g) cut green Italian beans, drained
ingredients.name: fasolka szparagowa zielona

ingredients.text: 2 oz (55 g) shredded provolone or mozzarella
ingredients.name: ser provolone lub mozzarella

steps.text: Cook pasta and drain.
Meanwhile, brown sliced sausage in hot oil in large skillet for 5 minutes, then drain away the fat.
Stir in undrained tomatoes, tomato paste, broth, and drained beans. Bring to boil, then reduce heat.
Simmer, covered, 10 minutes.
Stir in cooked pasta.
Sprinkle with cheese.

recipes.title: Banga Soup
recipes.description: Banga soup is a traditional Nigerian soup made from palm nut extract, typically enjoyed by the Urhobo and Itsekiri people of the Niger Delta. It is rich, flavorful, and often served with starch or other swallow foods.

ingredients.text: 4 cups raw palm nuts or 800 ml canned palm nut extract
ingredients.name: orzech palmowy lub ekstrakt z orzechów palmowych
ingredients.note: raw palm nuts or 800 ml canned palm nut extract

ingredients.text: 500 g assorted meat (beef, goat meat, tripe)
ingredients.name: mieszane mięso (wołowina, koźlina, flaki)

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon Banga spice mix (optional but traditional)
ingredients.name: przyprawa Banga

steps.text: If using raw palm nuts, boil until soft, then pound lightly and extract the juice using warm water.
Strain to remove the chaff. If using canned extract, skip this step.
Place the assorted meat and dried fish in a pot.
Add chopped onions, stock cube, and salt.
Add a small amount of water and boil until the meat is tender.
Pour in the palm nut extract.
Add more water if too thick.
Stir well and bring to a boil.
Add ground crayfish and Banga spice mix.
Allow to cook uncovered on medium heat for 15–20 minutes, or until the oil begins to rise to the top.
Add scent leaves (or basil) and cook for another 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and serve hot with starch, fufu, pounded yam, or rice.

recipes.title: Pan de Jamón
recipes.description: A sweet and savory Venezuelan rolled loaf, traditionally made at Christmas, filled with ham, raisins and pimento-stuffed olives.

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon (4 g / ½ packet) active dry yeast
ingredients.name: drożdże suszone

ingredients.text: ¼ lb (220 g) thin-sliced, cured ham
ingredients.name: szynka surowa dojrzewająca

steps.text: In a large bowl, stir 1 teaspoon of the brown sugar into the water and sprinkle the yeast on top. Let sit 5–8 minutes until the yeast is foamy.

While the yeast is proofing, lightly chop the raisins and olives, or pulse them a few times in a food processor. Drain the olives of liquid before chopping, then put them in a small bowl and set aside.
Once the yeast is foamy, add 1 cup of the flour, one egg, and 4 tablespoons of the butter. Mix thoroughly with a fork or dough hooks.

Add the second cup of flour, the milk, 4 teaspoons of the brown sugar, the olive oil, and the salt. Blend until it pulls together, then knead by hand or with dough hooks for 5–6 minutes. The dough should be smooth and slightly sticky.
Place the dough in an oiled bowl and lightly cover the top with spray oil. Put it in a warm place to rise for about 90 minutes.
Once risen, turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and roll it into a square about 12 inches to a side. Brush with the remaining melted butter.
Place a layer of ham slices, leaving a strip about 1 inch wide uncovered on one side. This will form the outermost edge of the roll.
Spread the raisin and olive mixture evenly over the ham.
Starting from the inner edge, roll up the dough tightly. It should make 3–4 full revolutions.

Wet the uncovered strip of dough and roll the loaf until that edge sits on the bottom. This lets the dough stick to itself and form a tight seal. Pinch and twist the ends of the loaf with wet fingers to seal.
Place the loaf on parchment paper on a large baking sheet.
Beat the remaining egg with the remaining 1 teaspoon of brown sugar. Evenly brush the outside of the loaf with the mixture, wiping away any puddles that form.
Put the loaf in a warm place to rise for about 40 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 350°F. Bake the loaf for 30–40 minutes. Remove and cool on a wire rack. To serve, cut into slices about the width of your finger.

recipes.title: Fancy Crêpes
recipes.description: A fancy variation on crêpes that incorporates cream and vanilla.

ingredients.text: 172 ml (¾ cup / 6 fl oz) heavy cream
ingredients.name: śmietanka

ingredients.text: 1 tsp vanilla (you can use essence or bean or paste, or substitute other flavors like orange zest)
ingredients.name: wanilia
ingredients.note: you can use essence or bean or paste, or substitute other flavors like orange zest

steps.text: In a mixing bowl, combine flour, salt, and sugar.
Whisk eggs in the other bowl. Mix in milk, cream, and vanilla. Whisk well.
Pour half of the wet mixture into the dry ingredients bowl, and whisk very well. This is where some gluten develops, so experiment with more or less whisking to your taste.
Pour the rest of the wet mixture in, and whisk to combine. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour, preferably overnight. This is when the flavor and the rest of the gluten develops.
Let batter come to room temperature for about 30 minutes.
Heat the pan over medium heat. Melt the butter and mix into batter.
When the pan is hot but not smoking, pour ⅓ cup batter in the middle, then tilt and rotate the pan to spread evenly. If you mess up, no worries, just cook it through and eat it.

When the crepe starts separating from the pan, you can flip it. If you like it crispier, let it cook more but don't burn it. You can flip with any utensil a few inches wide and thin enough to slide under the crepe. The hotter the pan, the faster it will cook. It's possible to cook a crepe in 20 seconds or so with high heat, but there's nothing wrong with cooking it slow on low heat.
Serve crepes warm.
To store, wrap airtight so they don't lose moisture, and refrigerate. Reheat on the stovetop.

recipes.title: Vanilla Ice Cream (Custard-Based)
recipes.description: Custard-based vanilla ice cream made from milk, cream, sugar and egg yolks, churned in an ice cream machine or frozen in a tub.

ingredients.text: A few drops of vanilla essence
ingredients.name: ekstrakt waniliowy

steps.text: Pour milk into a pot with vanilla and bring almost to a boil.
Beat together the egg yolks and sugar.
Pour some of the milk into the egg mixture, whisking constantly.
Pour egg and milk mix back into the pot, still whisking. Heat gently until thickened.
Pour into a bowl and place in sink half-filled with cold water to cool.
Stir occasionally, then chill in the fridge.
Whip the cream and fold into the mix.
Pour into an ice cream machine. Prepare as per your ice cream machine's instructions. Alternately, freeze in tub for 3 hours. Every hour, whisk the ice cream to stop ice crystals from forming.

recipes.title: Fresh Herb and Cheese Ravioli Filling
recipes.description: Farsz do ravioli z ricottą, serem pleśniowym, mozzarellą i świeżymi ziołami.

ingredients.text: 4 oz (½ cup) ricotta or cottage cheese
ingredients.name: ricotta

ingredients.text: 4 tbsp fresh finely-chopped herbs (basil, chives, parsley, thyme)
ingredients.name: świeże zioła (bazylia, szczypiorek, natka pietruszki, tymianek)

steps.text: Beat eggs and place in a bowl.
Beat in the cheeses with a fork until well blended.
Mix in the herbs and seasoning.
Refrigerate until the pasta dough is rolled out.

recipes.title: Coconut Cream and Pound Cake with Moscatel (Bienmesabe)
recipes.description: A popular and tasty dessert of coconut custard layered with wine-soaked pound cake and cinnamon.

ingredients.text: * ½ cup (120 g) of white granulated sugar
ingredients.name: cukier

ingredients.text: * 3–4 pound cakes (biscochuelo) cut in ½-inch slices
ingredients.name: ciasto pound cake (biscochuelo)

steps.text: Grate the coconut meat.
Separate the flesh from the milk of the coconut.
Combine the coconut flesh with the sugar, reserving the milk.
Cook until a thick syrup is made.
Remove from heat and allow to rest.
Beat the yolks with a little bit of the coconut milk, then whisk this into the syrup.
Mix well and return to the heat.
Stir constantly until it thickens, to obtain a rather thick coconut custard.
Remove custard from the heat and let cool.
Soak the cake pieces in wine.
In a glass dish, layer the coconut custard and the cake slices.
Continue alternating biscochuelo layers with the coconut custard.
Sprinkle the top generously with cinnamon.

recipes.title: Hickory Smoked Chicken Breasts
recipes.description: Boneless chicken breasts brined in salt, honey, herbs and vinegar, then rubbed with a spicy seasoning and smoked over hickory.

ingredients.text: 2 cups very hot apple cider vinegar
ingredients.name: ocet jabłkowy

ingredients.text: Several pounds of large hickory chunks
ingredients.name: drewno hikorowe

steps.text: Combine salt, honey, herbs, and vinegar in a gallon-size zip-top bag. Add ice and shake until the ice is mostly melted and the mixture has cooled.
Add the chicken and brine in the refrigerator for 1–2 hours.
Take the chicken out of the brine and pat dry with paper towels. Set aside.
Combine lemon pepper, peppercorns, chili powder, cayenne pepper, and paprika. Rub the mixture gently into both sides of each chicken piece.

Place enough hickory wood chunks into the firebox of a smoker to keep the temperature around 225°F. Insert a probe thermometer into one of the chicken pieces and place it in the smoker. Cook, changing chunks as needed, until the internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Remove to a plate and let rest, uncovered, for 5 minutes. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Two-Ingredient Brownies
recipes.description: 2-ingredient brownies is a dessert that only contains 2 ingredients: eggs and Nutella (or other chocolate hazelnut spread).

ingredients.text: 1 cup (300 g / 10.5 oz) Nutella (or any chocolate hazelnut spread), plus extra for topping
ingredients.name: krem czekoladowo-orzechowy
ingredients.note: 300 g / 10.5 oz; or any chocolate hazelnut spread, plus extra for topping

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180°C (356°F).
Line a 20 cm (8-inch) square cake pan with parchment.
Beat the eggs in a bowl for 5 minutes until light and airy.
Beat in the Nutella spread until combined.
Pour the mixture into the lined cake pan.
Bake for 25 minutes.
Take the brownie out of the oven and leave it to cool.
Spread the brownie with extra Nutella spread.
Trim the brownie and cut into 16 squares.

categories: Recipes using vegetable broth and stock

recipes.title: Pasta Soup for Kids
recipes.description: A mild vegetable soup with small pasta, tofu and corn, designed for children.

ingredients.text: ½ cup carrots, in tiny cubes (the size of small peas)
ingredients.name: marchew
ingredients.note: in tiny cubes (the size of small peas)

ingredients.text: ½ cup diced yellow crooked-neck squash
ingredients.name: kabaczek żółty

ingredients.text: ½ cup baby corn, ¼-inch pieces (or ¼ cup frozen corn—see notes)
ingredients.name: kukurydza baby
ingredients.note: ¼-inch pieces (or ¼ cup frozen corn—see notes)

steps.text: Bring broth to boil in a medium-sized saucepan.
Add carrots, and lower the heat to a simmer.
Cook for 5 minutes, or until carrots are just tender.
Add zucchini, squash, and corn.
Simmer for 5 minutes, then stir in peas, tofu, and cooked pasta.
Simmer just a couple of minutes longer.
Serve hot (or very warm) in small bowl with small spoons.

ingredients.text: 4 ea. (about 2 pounds) duck leg portions with thighs attached, excess fat trimmed and reserved
ingredients.name: udko kacze
ingredients.note: about 2 pounds; excess fat trimmed and reserved

steps.text: Lay the duck leg portions on a platter, skin side down. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of the salt and the black pepper.
Place the garlic cloves, bay leaves, and sprigs of thyme on each of 2 leg portions. Lay the remaining 2 leg portions, flesh to flesh, on top.
Put the fat from the ducks in the bottom of a glass or plastic container. Top with the sandwiched leg portions, and sprinkle with the remaining ⅛ teaspoon salt.
Cover and refrigerate for 12 hours.
Preheat the oven to 200°F (95°C).
Remove the duck from the refrigerator. Remove the garlic, bay leaves, thyme, and duck fat and set aside.
Rinse the duck with cool water, rubbing off some of the salt and pepper. Pat dry with paper towels.
Put the garlic, bay leaves, thyme, and duck fat in the bottom of an enameled cast-iron pot. Sprinkle evenly with the peppercorns and table salt.
Lay the duck on top, skin side down. Add the olive oil.
Cover and bake for 12 to 14 hours, or until the meat pulls away from the bone.
Remove the duck from the fat. Strain the fat and set aside.

To store the duck confit, place the duck leg portions in a container, cover with the cooking fat, and store in the refrigerator. Alternately, pick the meat from the bones and place it in a stoneware container. Cover the meat with a thin layer of some of the strained fat.

Store in the refrigerator for up to 1 month. The excess oil can be stored in an airtight container in the refrigerator and used like butter for cooking. The tinge of duck taste in the oil is wonderful.

recipes.title: Corny Soufflé
recipes.description: Lekki, puszysty sufle z kukurydzy mrożonej, mleka i jajek, zapiekany w piekarniku.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 325°F.
Put frozen corn, milk, eggs, sugar, and salt into a blender.
Blend on medium until ingredients are mixed thoroughly.
Pour into a medium-sized baking dish coated with cooking spray.
Dot the top with butter pieces.
Bake for 70 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Cream II
recipes.description: Deser mleczny z bananami, oparty na przepisie Mrs Beeton's Book of Household Management.

ingredients.text: 2 oz (57 g / ¼ cup) caster sugar
ingredients.name: cukier

steps.text: Mix the cornstarch smoothly with a little milk to form a paste.
Put the remaining milk into a pan with the sugar.
When boiling add the cornstarch paste, and boil for about 10 minutes.
Let the mixture cool a little, then add the beaten egg yolks, and stir until they thicken.
Add the vanilla, the bananas. When cool, pour into the prepared mould.
Chill for a few hours to set.

recipes.title: Flourless Chocolate Cake
recipes.description: Flourless chocolate cake is a type of baked chocolate confection. Without flour to provide structure, it is dense and rich.

ingredients.text: ½ cup (120 g) white granulated sugar
ingredients.name: cukier

ingredients.text: ¾ cup (150 g) chocolate (suitable for melting)
ingredients.name: czekolada

steps.text: Melt the chocolate and butter in a bowl set above another pan of simmering water (or use a double boiler).
Lightly whisk chocolate mix until smooth, then remove from heat and allow to cool, whilst still stirring.
Beat eggs and sugar in a bowl until the mixture is creamy.
Gradually mix in the melted chocolate along with any other variants (see below).
Pour mixture into mould (baking tray or 8 individual moulds).
Cover moulds with aluminium foil and place the moulds in a deeper baking tray.
Pour boiling water into the deep baking tray at a depth that is half that of the moulds.
Bake for approximately 30 minutes in a preheated oven at gas mark 2 (300°F or 150°C). Insert a skewer to check if ready: if skewer comes out clean, then it is ready.
Remove from oven and allow to cool at room temperature.
Cool for approximately 10 hours in a fridge.
Remove from mould, place on a plate and garnish.

recipes.title: Chargrilled Asparagus Salad
recipes.description: A salad of chargrilled asparagus with garlic, capers, chickpeas, lemon juice, fresh herbs and baby spinach.

ingredients.text: 1 bundle (about 500 g whole, 350 g trimmed) asparagus
ingredients.name: szparagi

steps.text: Snap the ends off of the asparagus, then snap the remaining stalks in half. Rinse them well.
Toss the asparagus with the salt and 1 tbsp oil.
Heat a non-stick pan or wok on high heat. Toss in asparagus and char on high for around 5 minutes. Put the asparagus into a (non-plastic) salad bowl.
Add 2 tbsp of oil to the pan, then add the garlic and drained capers to the pan and fry for 2 minutes. Then add the garlic oil to the bowl with the asparagus.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas, and add to bowl along with the lemon juice. Toss well to combine.
Chop the parsley and mint finely, add to the salad, and toss well to combine.
Wash and dry the spinach leaves, add to the salad, and toss well.

recipes.title: Tuna Rice Casserole
recipes.description: Tuna rice casserole is a simple, quick-to-make meal that even kids can make!

ingredients.text: 1 package (10 ounces / 280 g) frozen peas, cooked
ingredients.name: groszek zielony

ingredients.text: 1 can (10 ounces / 280 g) cheddar cheese soup
ingredients.name: zupa serowa cheddar

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
In large bowl, combine tuna, peas, and rice, and mix well.
In another large bowl, combine cheddar cheese soup and water.
Place soup mixture in bowl with tuna mixture.
Place combined mixture in greased casserole dish.
Bake in a preheated 400°F (200°C) oven for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Sour-Cream Icing
recipes.description: Chocolate sour-cream icing is an icing or frosting with a bit of tang to take the edge off the sugar overload.

steps.text: Melt the chocolate and butter together in a double boiler.
Remove mixture from the heat, then stir in the sour cream, vanilla extract, and salt.
Slowly beat or stir in the icing sugar until the mixture has the desired consistency. An icing will be thinner and require less icing sugar than a thicker frosting.
Spread mixture on the cake of your choice.

recipes.title: Isombe (Rwandan Cassava Leaves with Eggplant)
recipes.description: Isombe is a flavorful and nutritious dish from Rwanda, made with tender cassava leaves and eggplant, often served as a main course with ugali or steamed rice.

steps.text: Remove the tough stems from the cassava leaves, and wash them thoroughly under running water.
Chop the leaves into smaller pieces.
In a large pot, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic, and sauté until the onion is translucent and fragrant.
Add the diced eggplant to the pot and cook for about 5 minutes, until slightly softened.
Add the chopped cassava leaves and diced tomato to the pot. Stir well to combine all the ingredients.
Pour in the water and season with salt to taste. Stir again to ensure even distribution of the ingredients.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and let the mixture simmer for about 1 hour, or until the cassava leaves are tender and cooked through.
Stir occasionally during cooking, and add more water if necessary to prevent sticking and to achieve the desired consistency.
Taste and adjust the seasoning if needed, adding more salt or other spices according to your preference.
Remove the pot from the heat and let the isombe rest for a few minutes before serving.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Moroccan Couscous
recipes.description: Moroccan-style couscous flavored with lemon juice, hot pepper paste, coriander and cumin, served as a side dish.

steps.text: Combine liquids in a bowl. Set aside.
Heat a large pot over medium high heat.
Pour some oil into the pot and add couscous. Sauté until couscous is slightly browned.
Add liquid mixture and remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil, cover, remove from the heat, and set aside, 5 minutes or until couscous is tender and all liquid has been absorbed.
Open pot and fluff couscous thoroughly with a fork or chopsticks. Serve immediately with lamb.

recipes.title: Crab and Corn Salad
recipes.description: This salad is very easy to make.

ingredients.text: 16 oz canned whole kernel sweet corn
ingredients.name: kukurydza konserwowa

steps.text: Chop imitation crab meat and green onions.
Combine the above, corn and mayonnaise in an appropriately-sized bowl.
Mix well.
Add shredded cheese to taste and mix again.

recipes.title: Pizza-Flavored Omelet
recipes.description: A small omelet flavored like pizza, with tomato sauce, mushrooms, green bell peppers and mozzarella.

ingredients.text: Salt, pepper, and other seasonings to taste (see tips below)
ingredients.name: sól

steps.text: Mix spices and tomato sauce and allow to meld flavors while preparing the rest of the recipe.
Beat eggs well.
Heat a small skillet over low heat, sprayed with cooking spray.
Pour beaten eggs into skillet, then cover skillet.
Cook for 3 minutes. Eggs should be almost set.
Carefully flip omelet over. Cook another minute.
Combine mushrooms and peppers and cook 30 seconds in microwave oven.
Spread tomato-spice mix over omelet. Sprinkle cheese over tomato sauce. Top cheese with hot mushrooms and peppers.
Cover skillet. Cook another 2 minutes. Cheese should be melted.

recipes.title: Asparagus with Sesame Seeds and Soy Sauce
recipes.description: Asparagus with sesame seeds and soy sauce pairs very well with grilled beef, lamb or salmon. It can also be served chilled as part of a brunch menu.

ingredients.text: 2 tbsp (30 ml) sesame seed (If available, use Gomasio instead, and omit the salt)
ingredients.name: nasiona sezamu
ingredients.note: If available, use Gomasio instead, and omit the salt

steps.text: Prepare steamer and bring water to a boil.
Trim asparagus spears in half, discarding (or composting) the thicker ends.
Steam the asparagus for 8–10 minutes, until tender, but still crisp.

Heat a small skillet or frying pan on medium heat. Add the sesame seeds and shake or stir. They are done when they just begin to darken and give off a pleasant toasted aroma. Be careful not to leave unattended as they can easily burn.
Remove asparagus from steamer, shake to drain water, and arrange on serving plate.
Drizzle the soy sauce and the sesame oil over the asparagus.
Sprinkle with the sesame seeds, and give a very light sprinkle with the Kosher salt.

recipes.title: Orange Julius
recipes.description: An orange julius is a beverage made by blending orange juice and milk, with other ingredients added for flavor.

ingredients.text: 1 can (6 ounces/180 ml) of concentrated orange juice
ingredients.name: sok pomarańczowy skoncentrowany

ingredients.text: ¼ cup (60 g) sugar (or less, to taste)
ingredients.name: cukier

steps.text: Place all ingredients in a blender.
Blend thoroughly and serve immediately.

images: Smokey Millet Super Grain Bowl With Crispy Tofu.jpg

recipes.title: Smokey Millet Super Grain Bowl With Crispy Tofu
recipes.description: A grain bowl with millet, crispy tofu, corn and riced cauliflower, seasoned with chipotle and served warm or at room temperature.

ingredients.text: 1 cup walnuts, lightly toasted and finely chopped
ingredients.name: orzechy włoskie

ingredients.text: 4 ears of corn, off the cob
ingredients.name: kukurydza

ingredients.text: 2 packages gluten-free baked tofu, teriyaki flavor, diced into ¼-inch squares (optional)
ingredients.name: tofu pieczone teriyaki
ingredients.note: gluten-free, teriyaki flavor, diced into ¼-inch squares, optional

ingredients.text: 1–2 tsp chipotle pepper in adobo sauce, chopped
ingredients.name: chipotle w sosie adobo

steps.text: Cook the millet per the package instructions using water or vegetable stock. Once cooked, remove from the pan and place in a medium size mixing bowl. Set aside.
Preheat the oven to 350°F. Lightly toast the walnuts until fragrant, about 8 minutes. Set aside to cool. When cool enough to handle, finely chop and add to the cooked millet.

Place a large sauté pan over medium-high heat. Add 1 tablespoon olive oil. When hot, but not smoking, add the corn. Add ½ teaspoon of salt and stir to incorporate. Cook until the corn is a vibrant yellow color, about 4–5 minutes. Add the scallions and cook an additional 30 seconds. Remove from the heat and place in the bowl with the millet.

Place the pan you used for the corn back on medium-high heat. Add an additional 1 tablespoon of olive oil. When hot, add the cauliflower rice, ½ teaspoon salt and cook, stirring occasionally, until cooked through and beginning to brown. Remove from the heat and add to the millet mixture.

Wipe out the pan and add 2 tablespoons olive oil. When hot, add the diced tofu and remaining ½ teaspoon salt and cook, stirring occasionally as needed until the tofu begins to brown and get crispy, about 7–8 minutes. Remove from the heat and add to the millet mixture.
Add the desired amount of chipotle to the millet-tofu mixture based on your desired heat preference. Adjust the seasoning as needed. Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil and toss to coat.
To serve, divide among serving bowls. Garnish with sliced radishes and chopped chives. This grain bowl can be served warm or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Chicken Fajitas
recipes.description: Tex-Mex fajitas z kurczakiem, paprykami i cebulą, podawane w tortillach.

ingredients.text: 1–2 lb (½–1 kg) skinless, boneless chicken breast
ingredients.name: pierś z kurczaka
ingredients.note: ½–1 kg, bez skóry i kości

ingredients.text: 1 Tbsp crushed red pepper (or to taste)
ingredients.name: płatki chili

steps.text: Cut chicken into roughly 1x1-inch (2.5 x 2.5 cm) pieces.
Marinate the chicken with a spoonful of turmeric, salt and black pepper.
Cook chicken in olive oil, cumin and red pepper over high heat in a large skillet or wok.
While meat is cooking, chop/julienne vegetables (peppers and onion).
When meat is completely cooked, add vegetables, stirring frequently so that all are evenly cooked.
Remove from heat when vegetables are soft.
Serve with tortilla shells and toppings such as cheese, sour cream, lettuce, tomato, onions, and/or guacamole.

recipes.title: Mozzarella Tuna Melts
recipes.description: Kanapki z tuńczykiem, selerem, cebulą i majonezem, zapiekane z mozzarellą i pomidorem.

ingredients.text: 1 can (6 ounces) water-packed tuna, drained and flaked
ingredients.name: tuńczyk w wodzie

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
In a small bowl, combine tuna, celery, onion and mayonnaise.
Spread on bottom of buns.
Top tuna mixture with a slice of cheese and tomato.
Place on an ungreased baking sheet.
Bake for 12–15 minutes or until heated through and cheese is melted.
Top each with a lettuce leaf; replace bun tops.

categories: Recipes using beef broth and stock

recipes.title: Classic Pot Roast
recipes.description: Bottom round beef braised slowly in broth, red wine and tomato juice with garlic, herbs, carrots, onion and potatoes.

ingredients.text: 1 ea. (2 ½ pounds / 1.1 kg) bottom round roast
ingredients.name: pieczeń wołowa (udziec)
ingredients.note: (2 ½ pounds / 1.1 kg) bottom round roast

ingredients.text: 3 carrots, peeled and cut into ¾-inch (2 cm) pieces
ingredients.name: marchew
ingredients.note: peeled, cut into ¾-inch (2 cm) pieces

steps.text: Season roast liberally with kosher salt and freshly-ground black pepper.
In a 6-quart (6-liter) Dutch oven, heat ¼ cup olive oil over medium-high heat. Add roast and cook until browned on all sides.
Remove roast to a plate and keep warm.
Add remaining oil and vegetables. Cook until onions are lightly browned around edges.
Remove vegetables and keep warm.
Deglaze pan with broth and add remaining ingredients. Reduce heat to low, then add vegetables and beef.
Cover and place into a 225°F (110°C) oven and cook 6 hours.
Serve warm.

categories: Recipes using vegetable broth and stock

recipes.title: Lentil Burgers
recipes.description: Burgery z soczewicy z marchewką, selerem i bułką tartą, smażone na patelni.

ingredients.text: 1 medium to large carrot, finely diced
ingredients.name: marchew

ingredients.text: ¼–1 cup plain or Italian bread crumbs
ingredients.name: bułka tarta

steps.text: Place the lentils in a large saucepan, and add water or stock so that it covers the lentils by at least 2 inches (check the cooking instructions for the type of lentil you are using, as some may require soaking before cooking).
Cook for the approximate time as suggested by the lentil package (usually 30–45 minutes at a boil).
Place the cooked lentils into a fine sieve and allow to drain and cool.
Sauté the carrot and celery in the butter and oil over medium heat until softened (about 10 minutes).
Just before the carrot and celery are done, add the dried onion and parsley.
Place the drained and cooled lentils in a large bowl, add the carrot mixture, and mash everything with a potato masher. Don't over-mash; it is fine to leave some of the lentils whole.
Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary.
Add the eggs and about ¼ cup bread crumbs, and stir to combine all the ingredients. Continue to add bread crumbs until you have a slightly moist but not wet mixture.
Form mixture into patties. Place the formed patties onto a plate and layer with waxed paper in between. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.

To cook, it is best to use either a large sauté pan or a griddle on the grill—these burgers don't do well on grill grates. Cook over medium to medium-high heat until warmed through and a nice crust has formed on the outside. Depending on the thickness of the burgers, this will take anywhere from 3–7 minutes per side.

To serve, you can place on a bun with the usual accoutrements or go crazy with whatever you think will go (garlic aioli, roasted peppers, etc). You could also serve without the bun with grilled pineapple, barbecue sauce, etc—the choices are endless.

recipes.title: Pork Burritos with Green Pepper Sauce
recipes.description: Slow-cooked pork loin in chunky salsa, shredded and rolled into burritos topped with a green chile sauce and Monterey Jack cheese.

ingredients.text: 1 ea. (4 pounds) boneless pork loin roast, tied or netted
ingredients.name: schab wieprzowy bez kości

ingredients.text: 8 ounces (~2 cups) shredded Monterey Jack cheese
ingredients.name: ser Monterey Jack tarty

steps.text: Heat oil in 12-inch skillet over medium heat.
Add garlic and onion and cook until tender.
Stir the next 10 ingredients into the skillet.
Put the pork roast into a 5-quart slow cooker. Cover roast with salsa mixture.
Cover and cook on low for 8–10 hours or until meat is fork-tender.
Remove roast and let stand 10 minutes on cutting board.
Shred pork with forks.
Transfer 5 cups salsa mixture from cooker into 2-quart saucepan. Stir in chiles.
Cook over medium heat to a boil.
Reduce heat to medium-low.
Cook and stir 15 minutes to thicken mixture.
Spoon a cup of shredded pork down center of each tortilla.
Top with 2 tablespoons green chile sauce.
Roll sides of tortilla over and then fold up ends to hold filling.
Cover burritos with rest of green chile sauce and cheese.

recipes.title: Pepperoni Pasta Salad
recipes.description: A simple pasta salad with orzo, mozzarella, pepperoni and tomatoes in Italian dressing.

ingredients.text: 6 ounces orzo, cooked and well drained
ingredients.name: makaron ryżowy

steps.text: Combine all of the ingredients in a large bowl and toss well to combine.
Serve warm or chill before serving.

recipes.title: Sylheti Beef Curry
recipes.description: Sylheti beef curry with cardamom, cinnamon, cloves and fresh coriander, simmered until the beef is tender.

ingredients.text: ½ teaspoon chile powder (adjust to taste)
ingredients.name: chili w proszku

steps.text: Heat the vegetable oil in a large, heavy-bottomed pan over medium heat.
Add the cloves, green cardamom pods, cinnamon stick, and bay leaves. Sauté for a minute until fragrant.
Add the chopped onions and sauté until they turn golden brown.
Add the ginger-garlic paste and sauté for another 2 minutes until the raw smell disappears.
Add the beef cubes and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Stir in the cumin powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder, and chili powder. Cook for a couple of minutes to toast the spices.
Add the hatxora, chopped tomatoes and green chilies. Cook until the tomatoes are soft and the oil starts to separate from the mixture.
Pour in enough water to cover the beef, season with salt, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pan, and let the curry simmer for about 1.5–2 hours or until the beef is tender and the flavors meld.
Garnish with fresh coriander leaves and serve hot with steamed rice or naan.

recipes.title: Prata
recipes.description: Prata, also known as roti prata, is a popular South Indian flatbread that's crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. It's a beloved street food in Singapore and Malaysia, often enjoyed for breakfast or as a late-night snack.

ingredients.text: 2 tbsp melted ghee or vegetable oil
ingredients.name: ghee lub olej roślinny

ingredients.text: Additional ghee or oil for cooking
ingredients.name: olej roślinny
ingredients.note: additional ghee or oil for cooking

steps.text: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, salt, and sugar.
Add the ghee and mix well.
Gradually add water while kneading the mixture until you get a smooth and elastic dough.
Cover the dough with a damp cloth and let it rest for at least 1 hour.
Divide the dough into small balls, each about the size of a golf ball.

On a lightly oiled surface, flatten each ball with your hands. Then, use a rolling pin and your hands to stretch the dough as thinly as possible into a rectangle without tearing it. Ideally, it should only be 1–3 mm thick for greater flakiness later. If necessary, let the dough rest to help it relax.
Brush the surface of the dough sheet with some ghee or oil.
Fold one side of the dough to the center, then fold the opposite side over it. You should now have a long, thin strip of dough.
Take one end of the strip and start coiling it into a spiral, like a snail shell. Tuck the end under the coil to secure it. Press the coil down with your palm to flatten it into a round.
Heat a little ghee or oil in a skillet or other flat pan over medium heat.
Place a piece of the shaped dough on the pan and cook for 2–3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and crispy. Remove from the heat.
Repeat the cooking process with the remaining dough.

recipes.title: Bojo - Surinamese Cassava and Coconut Dessert
recipes.description: A Surinamese dessert made from grated cassava and coconut, eggs, butter and milk, baked until firm on top.

steps.text: Peel and grate the cassava. Grate the white coconut meat.
Beat the eggs and sugar until firm. Add the vanilla and almond essence.
Combine the eggs and sugar with the grated coconut and cassava.
Add the cinnamon, milk, raisins and salt.
Melt the butter and add it to the mixture.
Rub the dish you want to use with butter or use Pam.
Put the mixture in the dish. Put the dish in a pre-heated oven at 350°F (175°C). Bake the Bojo for about an hour. It needs to be firm on top but not dry on the inside.
Sprinkle some cinnamon on top of the bojo before serving.

recipes.title: North Staffordshire Oatcakes
recipes.description: Oatcakes are a type of pancake made from oatmeal, cooked on a griddle. North Staffordshire oatcakes are a local delicacy made with flour and yeast.

ingredients.text: 220 g (1 cup or 8 oz) fine oatmeal
ingredients.name: płatki owsiane

ingredients.text: 220 g (1 cup or 8 oz) wholemeal or plain flour
ingredients.name: mąka pszenna

ingredients.text: 14 g (2 ½ tsp or ½ oz) fresh yeast
ingredients.name: drożdże świeże

ingredients.text: 850 ml (3 ½ cups or 1 ½ pints) warm milk and water, mixed half and half
ingredients.name: mleko i woda

steps.text: Add the salt to the flour and oatmeal.
Dissolve the yeast with a little warm liquid and add the sugar. Allow the mixture to become frothy.
Mix the dry ingredients with the yeast liquid to make a batter.
Cover the batter with a clean cloth and leave it in a warm place for an hour.
Cook the oatcakes on a well-greased griddle. Put enough batter onto the griddle to produce an oatcake about 8–9 inches in diameter. The surface will be covered in holes as it cooks.
Flip the oatcake after 2–3 minutes when the upper side appears dry and the underneath is golden brown, and cook for another 2–3 minutes.

recipes.title: Homemade Applesauce
recipes.description: A simple applesauce made with chopped apples, a little sugar and sugar substitute, lemon juice and cinnamon, mashed with a potato masher. Good any time, especially with latkes.

ingredients.text: 3 pounds (1300 g / about 8 cups) peeled, cored, and chopped apples
ingredients.name: jabłko

ingredients.text: ½ teaspoon ground cinnamon or apple pie spice
ingredients.name: cynamon mielony

steps.text: Put chopped apples in a large non-stick saucepan. Stir in water, sugar, sugar substitute, and lemon juice.
Bring mixture to a boil, cover, and reduce heat to medium-low.
Cook until apples are tender (about 10 minutes).
Use a potato masher to break cooked apples up into a nice purée.
Stir in ground cinnamon or apple pie spice.
Serve warm or cold.

recipes.title: Maple Barbecue Sauce
recipes.description: This maple barbecue sauce is great with chicken.

ingredients.text: 1 ½ cups maple syrup (preferably a dark grade)
ingredients.name: syrop klonowy

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan or pot.
Bring to a boil over high heat and cook until liquid has reduced by ⅓.
Remove chiles and discard.
Keep refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 3 weeks.

recipes.title: Biscuits II
recipes.description: Simple Southern-style biscuits made with flour, butter, baking powder and milk.

ingredients.text: 1 cup (140 g / 4.9 oz) all-purpose flour, plus extra for dusting
ingredients.name: mąka pszenna

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200 C.
Sift flour, salt and baking powder twice in a bowl.
Cut butter in with a knife until the mixture resembles breadcrumbs.
Add milk to the mixture and mix just until you get a soft dough—don't overmix.
Place dough on a floured board. Knead the dough gently until smooth. Roll out to ½ inch (1.3 cm) thick.
Cut out biscuits with a small cutter and place biscuits onto a greased pan.
If you have scraps of dough, knead into a ball, re-roll, and cut out more biscuits.
Bake for 15 minutes until nicely browned. Transfer the biscuits to a wire rack and leave it to cool.

recipes.title: Simple Chicken Salad
recipes.description: A simple salad of cooked chicken, bacon, lettuce and mayonnaise-based dressing.

steps.text: Toss together all ingredients until well-combined.
Serve cool or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Kendal Mint Cake
recipes.description: Confection originating from Kendal in Cumbria, England. It consists primarily of sugar and peppermint flavoring, and some athletes and climbers consider it a quick source of energy.

steps.text: Grease a square baking tin with vegetable oil.
Combine the sugar, glucose, and water in a saucepan over low heat. Stir periodically until the sugar dissolves.
Increase the heat to medium-high, and put a candy thermometer into the mixture. Cook, without stirring, until the mixture reaches about 150°C (300°F).

Remove the pan from the heat, and thoroughly stir in the peppermint extract. Continue stirring for several minutes until the mixture becomes cloudy/opaque and slightly thickened, but still pourable and spreadable.
Pour the sugar mixture into the prepared baking tin. Let rest for 30 minutes to cool and partially set.
Use a sharp knife to score the confection into squares or rectangles as desired. This makes it easier to break the confection into individual pieces after it sets fully.
Transfer the baking tin to the refrigerator, and chill for at least 2 hours to fully set the confection.
Remove the confection from the baking tin, and break into individual pieces.

recipes.title: Yorkshire Pudding (Vegan)
recipes.description: Yorkshire pudding is a dish popular across the UK but originating in the county of Yorkshire in England. It's traditionally eaten with beef or lamb with vegetables.

ingredients.text: 1 cup (240 g) whole wheat pastry flour
ingredients.name: mąka pszenna pełnoziarnista

ingredients.text: Ener-G egg replacer equivalent of 2 eggs
ingredients.name: zamiennik jajek
ingredients.note: Ener-G egg replacer equivalent of 2 eggs

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 425°F (210°C).
In a mixing bowl, combine the flours and salt.
Make a well in the center and add the egg replacer mixture.
Stir together until just combined, then add the soy milk and water, a bit at a time.
Stir until smooth, but don't overbeat.
Swirl the melted margarine around a shallow, 9x13-inch (22-32 cm) baking pan.
Pour out any excess and reserve.
Pour the batter into the pan and pour any remaining margarine over the top.
Bake for 20 minutes, or until golden on top and a knife inserted into the center comes out clean.
Let cool, then cut into squares to serve.

recipes.title: Sauce Gombo (Okra Stew)
recipes.description: A West African stew made with okra as the main ingredient, typically prepared with meat or seafood, tomatoes, onions and spices. The okra gives it a thick, slightly slippery texture.

ingredients.text: 500 g meat (chicken, beef, or goat) or seafood (shrimp or fish)
ingredients.name: mięso lub owoce morza
ingredients.note: chicken, beef, or goat or seafood (shrimp or fish)

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons palm oil or vegetable oil
ingredients.name: olej palmowy lub roślinny

ingredients.text: 2 scotch bonnet chile peppers (optional for heat), chopped
ingredients.name: papryczka scotch bonnet

ingredients.text: Fresh cilantro or parsley, chopped (for garnish)
ingredients.name: kolendra lub pietruszka świeża

steps.text: Wash the okra and trim off the tops and tails. Cut the okra into small rounds or slice them lengthwise. Set aside.
If using meat, wash and season it with salt, pepper, and spices. If using seafood, clean and season it with salt and pepper. Allow the meat or seafood to marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat the palm oil or vegetable oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the chopped onions and minced garlic, and sauté until they become translucent and fragrant.
Add the seasoned meat or seafood to the pot and cook until it browns on all sides. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking.
Once the meat or seafood is browned, add the diced tomatoes, tomato paste, scotch bonnet pepper, ground crayfish, nutmeg, ginger, and paprika. Stir well to combine all the ingredients.
Allow the mixture to cook for a few minutes until the tomatoes start to soften and release their juices.

Add the chopped okra to the pot and stir to coat the okra with the tomato mixture. The okra will release a slippery liquid, which will help thicken the stew. If desired, you can add a little water or broth to prevent the stew from becoming too thick.
Cover the pot and let the stew simmer on low heat for about 30–40 minutes, or until the okra is tender and cooked through. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking.
Taste the stew and adjust the seasoning with salt and pepper according to your preference.
Once the stew is cooked and the flavors have melded together, remove it from the heat. Garnish with freshly chopped cilantro or parsley.
Serve hot with cooked rice or fufu.

recipes.title: Roasted Spiced Chicken Drumsticks
recipes.description: Chicken drumsticks coated in a paprika, onion powder, chili and salt spice blend, then baked until crispy.

steps.text: Combine the paprika, onion powder, chili powder, and salt together in a bowl.
Preheat oven to 400°F.
Pat the chicken dry with paper towels.
Coat the chicken with oil and the prepared spice blend, ensuring all sides are well-coated. Transfer to a baking dish.
Bake the chicken drumsticks until the skin is brown and crispy (about 25 minutes).
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Montreal Russian Borscht
recipes.description: Montreal Russian borscht was a prize winner in Montreal, Canada's Russian community.

ingredients.text: 1 can stewed tomatoes, or an equivalent amount of fresh tomatoes
ingredients.name: pomidor
ingredients.note: stewed tomatoes, or an equivalent amount of fresh tomatoes

steps.text: Fill large stock pot with water. Add can stewed tomatoes, tomato paste, sugar, salt, onion, garlic, and beets, and boil for 20 minutes.
Add carrots, cabbage, and potato.
Return to a boil and cook for 1.5 hours.

recipes.title: Margarita Grilled Chicken
recipes.description: Grillowany kurczak marynowany w tequili, soku z limonki i wędzonym chipotle w adobo.

ingredients.text: ½ cup tequila (recommended: José Cuervo Especial Gold)
ingredients.name: tequila

ingredients.text: 1 cup mesquite chips, soaked in water 30 minutes
ingredients.name: wiórki mesquite

ingredients.text: 3 chipotle chiles in adobo, finely chopped
ingredients.name: papryczka chipotle w adobo

steps.text: Combine tequila, oil, mix, lime, cumin, cilantro, adobo, and the chiles in a blender until smooth.
Pour into a gallon size zip-top bag and add chicken.
Toss to coat and refrigerate overnight.
The next day, preheat grill.
Sprinkle both sides of chicken with salt and pepper and place on grill.
Cook, turning often, until internal temperature reaches 165°F (74˚C).
While chicken cooks, run the marinade through a cheesecloth and skim off the oil.
Bring to a boil in a large saucepan over high heat and cook until liquid has reduced to 3 ounces.
Once chicken is done, remove to a plate and pour marinade over top.
Cover tightly with foil and let rest 15 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Ground Tofu
recipes.description: Ground tofu marinated in tamari, beet juice and mushroom powder, then browned in a skillet, usable as a meat substitute.

ingredients.text: ½ teaspoon beet juice (for example, from canned beets)
ingredients.name: sok z buraka

ingredients.text: ¼ teaspoon powdered shiitake mushroom (see notes)
ingredients.name: grzyby shiitake suszone w proszku

steps.text: Make the marinade by mixing together tamari, yeast extract, beet juice, shiitake powder, and onion powder in a small mixing bowl. Make sure the mushroom powder and yeast extract are evenly incorporated with no lumps.
Drain the tofu, pressing it to get rid of as much moisture as possible.

Combine marinade with tofu, crushing the tofu into small pieces and allowing it to absorb the liquid evenly. Placing the tofu in a zip-top bag, pouring the marinade over it, sealing it, and then crushing the tofu with the fingers works well. You want no pieces of tofu larger than a fingernail.
Allow sufficient time for the marinade to soak completely into the tofu, such as several hours or overnight.

Heat a medium-sized non-stick skillet over medium heat. Using a small amount of canola oil—just enough to coat the cooking surface—sauté the tofu, browning it to a golden color. Between the marinade and heat, it will achieve a medium-brown, but won't achieve the deep brown of ground beef or commercial ground beef substitute.
Once the tofu is browned, it will still be quite soft. You can improve its texture by spreading it out in the hot pan and allowing it to cool for some time.

Store the ground tofu in the refrigerator. It can be reheated by heating it through in a skillet for whatever application you desire. It can be used as a filling for tacos, sloppy joes, meat sauces for pasta, and the like.

recipes.title: Cabbage Rolls in Tomato Sauce (Holubtsi)
recipes.description: Cabbage leaves stuffed with a beef and rice filling, baked in a sweet-sour tomato sauce.

ingredients.text: 2 Tbsp cornstarch mixed with ½ cup cold water
ingredients.name: skrobia kukurydziana
ingredients.note: mixed with ½ cup cold water

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Put cabbage into pot of boiling water, cover, let sit for three minutes, then drain.
Combine ground beef, milk, egg, rice, onion, pepper, and salt. Divide into twelve portions.
Place 1 meat portion on each cabbage leaf.
Roll leaf around filling and fasten with toothpick.
Place the rolls in a baking dish.
Combine tomato paste, tomatoes, sugar, water, and vinegar, then pour over cabbage rolls.
Cover baking dish, and bake at 350°F (175C) for 40 minutes.
Remove cabbage rolls from pan, and take out toothpicks. Place on the serving dish.
Add cornstarch and water to sauce mixture and stir together. Warm, if needed, to allow the cornstarch mixture to thicken the sauce.
Pour the completed sauce over the rolls on the serving dish.
Garnish as desired and serve.

recipes.title: Arisa (Malaysian Blended Chicken)
recipes.description: A unique dish from the state of Johor, Malaysia, traditionally served to royalty and social elites at formal functions and celebrations.

steps.text: Clean the chicken, and cut into fourths.
Place the chicken in a stock pot.
Blend the ginger and garlic.
Cut red onion into quarters, and put the blended ingredients and onion into the stock pot.
Add 12 glasses of water, salt, cardamom seeds, cinnamon sticks and cloves.
Bring the chicken to boil.
Take out the chicken, debone it, and blend it into puree.
Sieve the chicken stock, bring it to boil again, add in the chicken puree, oats, white pepper, and salt to taste.
Stir nonstop until it thickens. Add in half of the ghee, and stir until the mixture is smooth.
Pour the mixture into a square mold, and make a depression in the middle.
Use the rest of the ghee to fry the onions. Place the fried onions into the depression.
Sprinkle additional fried onions on top to garnish.

recipes.title: Salted Fish Fried Rice
recipes.description: Smażony ryż z solonymi rybami, kurczakiem i kiełkami fasoli.

steps.text: Heat the oil in non-stick pan.
Add the garlic, chilli, and spring onion, and stir-fry for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the salted fish and chicken.
Stir until the chicken and salted fish are changing color.
Add the rice and bean sprouts, then add the salt, pepper, and fish sauce.

recipes.title: Shrewsbury Cakes
recipes.description: A Shrewsbury cake is a British dessert. The cakes are often served multiple at a time.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Place butter in mixing bowl along with sugar. Cream until the mixture is fluffy.
Break the egg into the mixture, and stir it in completely.
Add the nutmeg and flour to the mixture, and stir in completely.
Spray or butter the cookie sheets.
Place teaspoons of the batter onto the cookie sheets about two inches apart.
Place in the oven and bake at 350°F for 10 minutes.
Take the cakes out of the oven, if the cakes have stuck together, use a knife to cut them apart.
Use spatula to place the cakes onto a plate.
Enjoy.

recipes.title: Potato Gnocchi with Basil and Sun-dried Tomatoes
recipes.description: Potato gnocchi with basil, garlic, sun-dried tomatoes and pine nuts.

steps.text: Prepare the gnocchi as per the package instructions, and drain.
Finely dice the sun-dried tomatoes.
Add the sun-dried tomato oil to a pan and heat.
Fry the minced garlic in the oil for 2 minutes.
Add the diced sun-dried tomatoes, gnocchi, and fresh basil, and stir until the basil has wilted.
Add the pine nuts, toss, and serve.

recipes.title: Lemon Custard Pastry Cups (Pastel de Nada)
recipes.description: Small puff pastry cups filled with lemon custard, broiled and chilled before serving.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).
Roll half the dough out to a 14×10-inch rectangle. Use a 4 ½-inch round cookie cutter to cut out circles.
Press the dough circles into 12 muffin cups. Line each with foil, then fill with pie weights. Freeze about 15 minutes.
Bake pastry shells in bottom third of oven for 10 minutes. Remove foil and weights; let cool for 10 minutes.

Meanwhile, in microwaveable bowl, whisk together cream, flour, egg yolks, sugar, and lemon zest. Microwave at medium for about 8 minutes, or until it reaches the consistency of pudding, whisking every minute or so.
Strain pudding into bowl; let cool for 5 minutes.
Pour pudding into shells. Broil 6 inches from the heat source for 3 minutes. Let cool on rack for 15 minutes.
Remove pastries from pan, and refrigerate for about 4 hours.
Sprinkle with icing sugar and serve.

recipes.title: Veggie Salad
recipes.description: A light vegetable salad with a dash of spice.

steps.text: Cut the green pepper into long thin strips.
Toss vegetables together in a large bowl.
Using a mortar, grind the spices together, and sprinkle over salad.
Sprinkle walnut chunks over salad.
Serve.

categories: Recipes using chile paste and sauce

recipes.title: Thai Grilled Chicken I
recipes.description: Boneless chicken breasts marinated in a blended chile, soy, fish sauce, garlic and ginger mixture, then grilled. The marinade can also be used as a sauce or dip.

ingredients.text: 1 tsp (5 ml) Thai chile paste (Sriracha recommended)
ingredients.name: pasta chili

ingredients.text: 4 ea. (24 ounces / 680 g) boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.name: pierś z kurczaka

ingredients.text: A flame-resistant towel tied into a roll with twine and soaked in oil
ingredients.name: ręcznik ogniotrwały
ingredients.note: tied into a roll with twine and soaked in oil

steps.text: In a blender, purée the chiles, chile paste, sauces, garlic, ginger, and vinegar until smooth. Pour into a gallon-size zip-top bag and add chicken breasts. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Heat a grill to medium heat. Quickly swab the grill with the towel and add chicken breasts. Cook 4–6 minutes per side or until internal temperature reaches 165°F (75 °C).
Remove to a plate and let rest 5 minutes. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Soy Protein Bread
recipes.description: A very easy bread in which texturized soy protein enhances the natural flavor.

steps.text: Heat the milk until it is about to boil, then add the salt and the soy protein. Mix it for the salt to be well dissolved. Let it rest until is warm again.
Put the milk and the rest of the ingredients, including the yeast, in blender. Mix it for a few seconds until it is homogeneous.
Pour the mixture into a bowl and start mixing in the flour to keep the bread homogeneous all the time.
Work the bread with your hands all the time, always keeping it smooth. You may have to add some extra flour while you work with it. Keep doing this until the bread stops being sticky.
Let it rest for about 25 minutes at a warm place.
Separate out several small balls of bread of about 1 inches (2.5 cm) in diameter and half that in height.
Put the breads on a baking tray with some distance between them and leave them for another 15 minutes.
Preheat the oven to about 200°C and put the tray in the middle of the oven.
Let them bake for about 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Hot Pepper Sauce
recipes.description: A fiery Caribbean hot sauce made by blending habanero peppers with onion, garlic, sugar and vinegar, then simmering and aging it for a month.

ingredients.text: 4 Tbsp white malt vinegar (or white wine vinegar)
ingredients.name: ocet słodowy biały

steps.text: Blend all ingredients to whatever consistency you desire.
Heat to boiling and simmer for 15–20 minutes.
Spoon the cooked sauce into a preheated preserve jar and seal.
Leave the jar in a cool, dark place for one month (at least) to develop a good flavour.

recipes.title: Fruit for the Day Smoothie
recipes.description: Smoothie z mandarynek z puszki, mrożonych bananów, truskawek i mleka.

ingredients.text: 1 can (397 g / 14 oz) Mandarin oranges (including syrup)
ingredients.name: mandarynka z puszki w syropie
ingredients.catalogName: Mandarynki z puszki w lekkim syropie

steps.text: Add all ingredients to a blender in the order listed above.
Hold down the lid, and blend on low speed for 30 seconds.
Blend on high speed for 1 minute.
Pour into a glass and enjoy.

recipes.title: Wacky Cake
recipes.description: A common recipe for wacky cake, a vegan chocolate cake made with cocoa, oil and vinegar.

steps.text: Combine flour, sugar, cocoa, and baking soda in a large bowl.
Add water, oil, vinegar and vanilla. Blend thoroughly.
Pour into a greased square cake pan.
Bake at 180°C or 350°F for 35–40 minutes.
Cool completely.

recipes.title: Nutty Brownie Bars
recipes.description: Brownie bars topped with sweetened condensed milk, chopped almonds, walnuts and chocolate coconut candy bars.

ingredients.text: 10 miniature chocolate coconut candy bars, chopped
ingredients.name: batonik czekoladowy kokosowy

steps.text: Prepare brownie mix according to package directions, reducing oil to 3 tablespoons.
Pour into lightly greased 9-by-3-inch pan.
Spread condensed milk over the brownie batter.
Sprinkle with chopped nuts and candy bars.
Bake at 350°F for 35–38 minutes or until done.
Cool completely and cut into bars.

recipes.title: Choco-Nutty Pie
recipes.description: Deserowy placek z czekoladowymi kawałkami i orzechami na maślanym cieście jajecznym.

ingredients.text: ½ cup butter, melted and cooled
ingredients.name: masło

steps.text: Combine the first four ingredients and mix until well blended.
Stir in chocolate chips, vanilla, and nuts.
Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 350°F for 45–50 minutes.
Let cool before cutting.

recipes.title: Apple BBQ Sauce
recipes.description: This barbecue sauce is great on ribs and chicken on the grill.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan and bring to a boil over medium high heat.
Cook until reduced to 4 cups.
Keep refrigerated for up to 3 weeks in a large mason jar or a squirt bottle.

recipes.title: Potato Salad (Southern Ontario Style)
recipes.description: Classic potato salad with hard-boiled eggs, corn, basil and a lemon-olive oil dressing, served chilled.

ingredients.text: 2 pounds small white potatoes (use waxy or red potatoes)
ingredients.name: ziemniak

steps.text: Place potatoes mixed with mustard and HP steak sauce along with 2 tablespoons of salt in a large pot of water. Bring the water to a boil, cook for 45–55 minutes, until the potatoes are tender when pierced with a knife.
Drain the potatoes in a colander.
Meanwhile, boil the eggs in water for about 30 minutes until hard-boiled.
Drain water and let cold water run over the eggs before peeling the shell. Once shells are peeled, dice the eggs and place in a large bowl.
Sauté some diced onions until light golden brown and add to the bowl with eggs.
When the potatoes are cool enough to handle, cut them in quarters, or smaller, depending on their size. Place the potatoes in the bowl with the eggs.
Add the corn along with some salt, pepper and pasta seasoning to the potato and egg mixture. Set aside.
In a small bowl add the lemon juice while whisking in olive oil slowly. Add to the potatoes, mix all ingredients.
Chill for 3 hours, cover with extra HP sauce, enjoy.

recipes.title: Cape Malay Butter Chicken
recipes.description: Butter chicken is a Cape Malay dish.

ingredients.text: 1 ½ tablespoon freshly pounded red chillies
ingredients.name: czerwona papryczka chili

steps.text: Mix yoghurt, oil, ginger/garlic paste, half the lemon juice, and spices together. Smear this mixture over the chicken halves and allow to marinate for a few hours.
Grill chicken over live coals or rotisserie until browned. Alternatively, lightly pan-fry and cook them.

Combine butter, tomato purée, and the remaining lemon juice. Mix in the leftover marinade from the chicken. Bring this mixture to a boil and simmer for a few minutes. Remove from the heat, and stir in the cream.
Place the chicken on a platter, and spread the sauce over top. Garnish with mint sprigs, and serve hot.

recipes.title: Macaroni and Cheese I
recipes.description: Classic macaroni and cheese made with a roux-based white sauce and a mix of cheddar and Parmesan or Monterey Jack cheese.

ingredients.text: ½ cup (8 tbsp / 1 stick / 125 g / 4.4 oz) butter
ingredients.name: masło

ingredients.text: 1 cup (125 g / 4.4 oz) Parmesan or Monterey Jack cheese
ingredients.name: parmezan
ingredients.note: Parmesan or Monterey Jack; 125 g / 4.4 oz

ingredients.text: ½ tsp cayenne pepper, or to taste
ingredients.name: pieprz cayenne

ingredients.text: 1 pound (450 g) macaroni noodles, boiled and drained
ingredients.name: makaron pszenny

steps.text: Make a roux using the butter and flour.
Add the heated milk, and whisk until smooth to complete the white sauce.
Mix in the cheese and cayenne pepper.
Mix the cheese sauce into the cooked macaroni noodles until well-coated.

recipes.title: Pasta marinata
recipes.description: Batter used for frying meat, fish, vegetables or sweets in the Italian manner.

steps.text: Mix the semolina flour, egg yolks, a little salt, and melted butter.
Add the water so as to form a liquid substance.
Whip the egg whites to soft peaks, and fold into the batter.

recipes.title: Holzknechtnocken (Austrian Boiled Dumplings)
recipes.description: Traditional dumplings from Ebensee in Austria, boiled and then fried in lard, served with sauerkraut or stewed apples or plums.

steps.text: Mix flour and salt in a large bowl and add water. Knead until you get a dough.
Form dumplings and add them to a pot of boiling water. When dumplings rise to the surface of the water, they are done.
Melt lard in a heavy-bottomed skillet with deep sides. Add dumplings, and fry until they are golden.
Serve with sauerkraut or steamed apples.

recipes.title: Indian Rice
recipes.description: This makes an excellent side dish, and goes well with a large variety of things, from spicy eggplant to tofu to potatoes in coconut sauce.

steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a pot.
Add the cumin, then the raisins and cashews. Sauté for two minutes.
Add the rice, and sauté for another minute.
Add water, and bring everything to a boil.
Lower the heat, cover, and cook for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Mince Pie with Meat I
recipes.description: Traditional mince pie with beef, apples, fruit mix, sugar, butter or lard, and spices, baked in shortcrust pastry shells.
