ingredients.text: 454 g (1 lb) butter, lard, or vegetable shortening, diced
ingredients.name: masło
ingredients.note: diced; butter, lard, or vegetable shortening

ingredients.text: 1815 g (4 lb) cored and sliced apples
ingredients.name: jabłko

ingredients.text: 1 citrus fruit (e.g. orange), zested and juiced
ingredients.name: owoc cytrusowy

steps.text: Sear diced beef in a pan until well-coloured (this can be done in batches).
Set aside until cool.
Combine all ingredients except dough in a bowl.
Mix well (this step can be done in batches).
Use the pastry dough to line 3 deep, greased pie pans (or 5 greased muffin pans, for tartlets) and create pie shells.
Place shells into oven and set to 150 °C (300 °F).
Bake until lightly golden.
Remove from oven and let rest until cooled.
Fill pie shells with filling mixture until level or slightly mounded above the rim.
Trim with excess pastry.
Bake at 150 °C (300 °F) for 45 minutes per tray (or 35 minutes per muffin tray).

recipes.title: Apple Crisp II
recipes.description: Deser z jabłek z kruszonką z płatków owsianych, brązowego cukru i cynamonu.

ingredients.text: ¼ cup melted margarine or butter
ingredients.name: masło

steps.text: Put apple slices in shallow 9-inch (23 cm) pan.
Sprinkle the apples with lemon juice.
Combine all dry ingredients with butter and mix until crumbly.
Sprinkle all this over apples.
Bake at 375 °F (190 °C) for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cappucino Mousse
recipes.description: Lekki deser z kawą espresso, czekoladowym syropem i ubitą śmietanką.

ingredients.text: 2 cups heavy cream, whipped to soft peaks
ingredients.name: śmietanka

steps.text: Combine espresso, sugar, chocolate, salt, and chocolate syrup.
Gently fold in the whipped cream.
Chill for 20 minutes; serve.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Crock Pot Potato Soup
recipes.description: Creamy potato soup cooked slowly in a slow cooker with onions, celery, chicken broth and butter, finished with evaporated milk.

steps.text: In a slow cooker, combine potatoes, onions, water, parsley, celery, salt, pepper, chicken broth and butter.
Cook until done -- on low heat, 9 to 11 hours, or on high heat, 3 to 4 hours.
When done, add milk and reheat.
Serve plain or use an immersion blender/put mixture in blender for a smoother soup.
Reheat if necessary.

recipes.title: Pastry Dough
recipes.description: Maślane ciasto kruche z cukrem pudrem i jajami, na jedną tartę.

ingredients.text: 1⅛ cups (2 sticks plus 2 tablespoons / 260 g) butter (see notes, below)
ingredients.name: masło

ingredients.text: 1 cup plus 2 tablespoons (220 g) confectioner's sugar
ingredients.name: cukier puder

steps.text: With an electric stand mixer or hand-held mixer, mix flour, butter, and sugar until the mixture has the consistency of small peas.
With the machine on low speed, add eggs and yolk, and mix just until well-incorporated, about 25 seconds.
Wrap dough tightly in plastic wrap and chill for at least 30 minutes before rolling out.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Liberian Country Beans Torborgee
recipes.description: Popularne w Liberii danie z gotowanej fasoli, zagęszczonej rozgniecioną fasolą, z palmowym olejem i habanero.

ingredients.text: ½ teaspoon country soda or 2 pinches of baking soda, dissolved in warm water
ingredients.name: soda oczyszczona
ingredients.note: country soda or 2 pinches of baking soda, dissolved in warm water

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon of salt or to taste
ingredients.name: sól

steps.text: Pick over the beans and remove any unwanted ones.
You may soak them overnight to reduce the cooking period.
Place beans in a pot and cover with water. Boil until tender, adding water if needed.
Drain and mash the beans to your preferred consistency.
Bring the vegetable broth to a boil in a separate pot. Stir in the mashed beans along with the onions, 1 cup water, seitan, and habanero pepper. Boil for about 20–25 minutes.
Stir in the palm oil. Reduce to low heat and simmer for about 5 minutes, stirring to prevent burning.
Stir in the potash and salt to taste.
Remove from the heat and let rest for about 5 minutes.
Enjoy with any complimentary dish of your choice such as bread, rice, or garri.

recipes.title: Chicken Brown Rice Soup
recipes.description: This is a tasty and filling soup.

steps.text: Cut the chicken into small pieces.
Fill the stock pot half full with water. Add the chicken and chicken broth in the large stock pot.
Let boil for about an hour, stirring frequently.
After an hour combine the rest of the ingredients and simmer for 1 hour to 1 hour and 30 minutes, stirring frequently.

recipes.title: Falafel Salad
recipes.description: A fast and easy salad with falafel balls, fresh vegetables and tahini yogurt sauce.

steps.text: In a large bowl, add water to falafel mix and stir well.
Let stand 15 minutes to absorb the water.
Form mix into ¾-inch balls.
Place balls into mini-cupcake tins or onto a cookie sheet.
Bake in oven at 375°F for 12 minutes.
Heat about ½ inch vegetable oil to 375°F.
Fry balls until brown and crisp (about 3 minutes).
Drain and set aside.
Toss vegetables with falafels and douse with tahini yogurt sauce. Falafel may be cold or hot for a delicious salad straight outta the PNW.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Tuscan Bean Soup
recipes.description: A hearty Italian soup of beans, spelt, sausage, kale and vegetables, finished with rosemary, sage and Parmigiano-Reggiano.

ingredients.text: 1 cup spelt or wheat berries (available at gourmet-food shops)
ingredients.name: orkisz (ziarno)

ingredients.text: ¼ cup extra-virgin olive oil, plus more for drizzling
ingredients.name: oliwa z oliwek

ingredients.text: ½ pound sweet Italian sausage, casings removed
ingredients.name: kiełbasa surowa (biała)

ingredients.text: 1 pound kale, preferably Tuscan, coarse stems removed, cut into thick ribbons
ingredients.name: jarmuż
ingredients.note: preferably Tuscan, coarse stems removed, cut into thick ribbons

ingredients.text: 1 large rib celery, trimmed and diced
ingredients.name: seler naciowy

ingredients.text: 5 cups homemade chicken stock, or canned low-sodium stock, plus more if needed
ingredients.name: bulion drobiowy
ingredients.note: homemade or canned low-sodium, plus more if needed

ingredients.text: 1 cup peeled, seeded, and diced tomatoes, or drained canned diced tomatoes
ingredients.name: pomidor
ingredients.note: peeled, seeded, diced; or drained canned

ingredients.text: Sea salt and freshly ground pepper
ingredients.name: sól
ingredients.note: sea salt and freshly ground pepper

ingredients.text: ½ cup freshly grated Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese
ingredients.name: parmezan

steps.text: Soak beans and spelt overnight in separate bowls of cold water.
Drain and set aside.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add sausage.
Cook stirring occasionally, until meat begins to separate and brown (3–5 minutes).
Stir in kale, onion, carrot, celery, and garlic.
Cook until softened (about 10 minutes).
Add beans, spelt, chicken stock, and tomatoes.
Bring to boil.
Stir in rosemary and sage.
Reduce heat.
Simmer mixture for 60–70 minutes, until beans are tender; if soup is too thick, add chicken stock.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Ladle soup into bowls.
Drizzle with olive oil, and sprinkle on cheese.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Southwest Pasta
recipes.description: Pasta tossed with spices and vegetables from the Southwest United States.

ingredients.text: 1 can (15 oz) sweet corn kernels, drained
ingredients.name: kukurydza konserwowa

ingredients.text: 1 can (14.5 oz) peeled and diced tomatoes with juice
ingredients.name: pomidory z puszki

ingredients.text: ¼ cup sliced black olives, drained
ingredients.name: oliwki czarne

steps.text: In a large pot bring 1 quart of lightly-salted water to a boil.
Add pasta and cook for 8–10 minutes until pasta is al dente; drain water.
While pasta is cooking, heat olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat.
Cook onions and bell pepper in oil until lightly browned, about 10 minutes.
Stir in corn, beans, tomatoes, salsa, olives, taco seasoning, salt and pepper. Cook until thoroughly heated, about 5 minutes.
Toss heated vegetables into pasta, mix well and serve.
Serve warm or cold.

recipes.title: Roasted Vegetable Pasta
recipes.description: Roasted vegetable pasta is a tried and true favorite. You can add whatever vegetables you prefer.

ingredients.text: 3 large leeks, white parts only, split in half lengthwise and cut into bite-sized pieces
ingredients.name: por
ingredients.note: white parts only, split in half lengthwise and cut into bite-sized pieces

ingredients.text: 1 medium red onion, cut into eighths
ingredients.name: cebula czerwona

ingredients.text: 1–2 red bell peppers, cut into wide strips
ingredients.name: papryka czerwona

ingredients.text: ½ cup (120 ml) chopped fresh basil
ingredients.name: bazylia świeża

ingredients.text: ¾ pound (330 g) dried penne or other pasta
ingredients.name: makaron pszenny

ingredients.text: ⅓ cup (80 ml) grated Parmesan cheese
ingredients.name: parmezan

ingredients.text: 3 ounces (85 g) mozzarella or goat cheese (optional)
ingredients.name: mozzarella

steps.text: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).

Put leeks, onion, and red bell pepper in a shallow roasting pan, tossing them with a tablespoon of olive oil to coat them. Add thyme and roast in the preheated oven until they are cooked and start to brown (about 30–45 minutes). Check early to make sure they're not burning, and add a little water or vegetable stock if the juices are evaporating.
While vegetables are roasting, sauté the garlic in a tablespoon of olive oil until it begins to colour.
Add the tomato sauce and simmer 1 minute. Then, turn off heat and add the basil. Stir the roasted vegetables into the sauce.
Turn oven down to 375°F (190°C). Add wine to roasting pan and stir, scraping up bits of vegetables that are stuck to pan, and add these deglazed juices to the sauce.
Boil a large pot of water, and add the salt and pasta. Cook the pasta for about 6–8 minutes until al dente.
Drain pasta, and add it to the sauce and vegetables. Add the cheese and mix it all.
Grease a 2–2 ½ quart casserole dish, and pour it all in. Top with the optional mozzarella or goat cheese if you like, then bake it all for another 15 minutes in the 375°F (190°C) oven.

recipes.title: White Russian Cocktail
recipes.description: A White Russian is a creamy, coffee-flavored cocktail made by combining vodka, coffee liqueur, and cream or milk.

steps.text: Fill a glass with ice.
Pour in the vodka, followed by the coffee liqueur.
Top with heavy cream or milk.
Gently stir to mix.

recipes.title: Mexican Chocolate Cake with Mocha Buttercream

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon cinnamon (increase to 2 teaspoons if using the semisweet chocolate)
ingredients.name: cynamon
ingredients.note: increase to 2 teaspoons if using the semisweet chocolate

ingredients.text: 1 cup plus 2 white granulated tablespoons sugar
ingredients.name: cukier

ingredients.text: Cinnamon, unsweetened cocoa, and confectioner's sugar, optional toppings
ingredients.name: cynamon, kakao i cukier puder

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Generously spray a deep 9-inch springform pan with nonstick cooking spray.
Melt the chocolates in a double boiler or in a microwave oven at low power.
Set aside to cool.
Sift together the flour, baking powder, salt, and cinnamon into a medium-size bowl.
Place the butter and sugar in a large mixing bowl and cream at high speed with an electric mixer.
Add the vanilla and the eggs, one at a time, beating well after each.
Pour in the cooled chocolate mixture, and beat well until everything is incorporated.
Add ⅓ of the flour mixture, and stir until it is just barely incorporated, then pour in half the milk.
Stir briefly, then repeat with another ⅓ of the flour and the remaining milk.
Add the rest of the flour mixture and stir just enough to blend. Don't over mix, or the cake will toughen.
Spread into the prepared pan and bake for 55 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Cool completely before assembling and frosting.
Cut the cake into 3 equal layers, using a long serrated knife and a gentle sawing motion.
Spread mocha buttercream between the layers, and stack them evenly.
Spread more buttercream on the sides and the top.
Artfully sprinkle the top with extra cinnamon, cocoa, and confectioner's sugar, if desired.

recipes.title: Granola Bars
recipes.description: Chewy granola bars with oats, brown sugar, corn syrup and chocolate chips, baked in a pan and cut into bars.

ingredients.text: ½ cup (120 g) soft butter or margarine
ingredients.name: masło

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C).
Grease 13 x 9-inch (30 x 23 cm) baking pan.
Combine butter, sugar, and corn syrup.
Mix in egg and vanilla.
Stir in oats and chocolate chips.
Spread mixture in prepared pan.
Bake 20–22 minutes.
Let cool. Cut into bars, and enjoy.

recipes.title: Nigerian Puff Puff
recipes.description: Nigerian snack of fried dough, similar to doughnuts and Ghanaian bofrot, soft, spongy and fluffy.

steps.text: Sift the flour into a bowl, and mix in the nutmeg, yeast, sugar, and salt.
If using instant yeast, mix it directly into the flour mixture.
Using your hands, mix small amounts of lukewarm water into the flour until all of the ingredients are thoroughly combined. The mixture should be smooth but not runny—i.e. it should not pour.
Cover the bowl with thin plastic film, and allow it to rise for about 45 minutes until doubled in volume.
Add oil to a deep pot to a depth of at least 3 inches.

Heat the oil over medium heat. Put a small piece of dough in the oil to see if it's hot enough—if the dough sizzles and rises to the surface of the oil, it is ready to fry the puff puff. If the oil isn't hot enough, the batter will sink to the bottom and remain there.
Roll the dough into small balls, and place into the oil. Make sure to fry in batches so that you don't overcrowd the oil and lower the temperature.

Flip the balls after the underside has gotten golden brown so that the topside may be fried as well. It can be difficult to control the balls when they keep flipping by themselves; in this case, just keep swirling until the puff puff is evenly golden.
Remove the puff puff from the oil when golden brown, and set them in a sieve lined with paper towels to drain away any excess oil.

recipes.title: Egg Roast
recipes.description: Simple but tasty dish of hard-boiled eggs roasted in a masala sauce, originating from Kerala. Often served with chapattis, poratas or steamed rice.

ingredients.text: 1 small tomato, chopped into large chunks
ingredients.name: pomidor

ingredients.text: 1 sprig curry leaves, leaves separated from the stalk
ingredients.name: liście curry

steps.text: Heat oil in a kadai, add onions and a pinch of salt, and fry until golden brown.
Add the ginger-garlic paste, and cook until the raw smell disappears.
Add the coriander, chili, and turmeric powders, and sauté for 2 minutes.
Add the minced tomato to the kadai, and sauté until the oil separates from the mixture.
Add the green chillies, and fry for a few minutes. Add the eggs, and coat the pieces with the mixture.
Add the chunked tomatoes, curry leaves, cinnamon, and clove. Sauté for a couple of minutes, and serve.

recipes.title: Sinasir (Nigerian Rice Pancake)
recipes.description: A rice pancake popular in the northern part of Nigeria, made from cooked and soaked short-grained rice as used in tuwo shinkafa.

steps.text: Place the rice in a bowl, and cover it with about 1 inch of water. Soak for several hours.
Blend the soaked and parboiled rice in a blender until you get a smooth batter, adding water as necessary.
Transfer the batter to a bowl, then mix in the yeast and sugar. Cover and let ferment at room temperature for a few hours.
Mix in onion, salt, and baking powder.
Heat a non-stick frying pan, and grease with a thin layer of oil.
Scoop in enough batter to make a thin layer in the pan. Cook until the bottom is browned and the pancake is cooked through.
Remove the pancake, and repeat the greasing and cooking process with the remaining batter.

recipes.title: Breakfast Dürüm
recipes.description: A Middle Eastern wrap-style breakfast combining a spinach and mushroom omelet, hash browns, hummus and beef steak in toasted lavash flatbread.

ingredients.text: 1 large sheet of lavash or yufka flatbread
ingredients.name: chleb lavash

ingredients.text: 4 tbsp butter or olive oil, divided
ingredients.name: masło

ingredients.text: ½ cup thinly sliced baby bella or Crimini mushrooms
ingredients.name: pieczarka

ingredients.text: 5 thin slices cooked beef sirloin or flank
ingredients.name: wołowina

steps.text: Brush the flatbread with the tablespoon of water to keep it soft.
Toast the bread using a skillet or in a toaster oven until brown on edges. Set aside.
Combine the grated potato with half the hot water in a bowl. Let sit for 3 minutes, then stir thoroughly and drain the water from the bowl.
Repeat this process with the remaining hot water, then drain the potatoes in a colander.
Shake gently in a horizontal motion to remove excess starch and water, then set aside to dry.
Sauté the mushrooms in 1 tbsp butter. Add spinach, and cook on medium heat until slightly wilted.
Whisk together the eggs, seasonings and milk, then pour over the spinach and mushrooms.
When the eggs are half-set, sprinkle the cheddar on top, then fold the omelet in half and remove from the skillet.
Heat the remaining butter in the skillet. Turn the heat to high, then add the potatoes, onions, and steak, evenly and fully covering the bottom of the skillet.
Season to taste, then let them sear to your desired brownness and crunch, taking care to turn them over. Remove from the heat.
Assemble the dürüm by laying the bread sheet flat, with the longer edges to the left and right sides.
Spread the hummus evenly on the half of the bread farthest from you.
Pile the potato mixture and the omelet evenly on the nearest half.
Pinch and fold the nearest edge over, then roll into a 5-cm (2-inch) thick cylinder and serve.

recipes.title: Hickory Maple Glazed Wings
recipes.description: Smażone skrzydełka kurczaka w panierce z kukurydzy, polane glazurą z syropu klonowego i ostrego sosu.

ingredients.text: 36 chicken wingettes or 18 whole chicken wings, tips removed and halved
ingredients.name: skrzydełko kurczaka
ingredients.note: wingettes or 18 whole chicken wings, tips removed and halved

ingredients.text: Maple syrup as needed plus 6 tbsp
ingredients.name: syrop klonowy

steps.text: Season chicken with salt and pepper.
Dip chicken in maple syrup, then dredge in cornmeal.
Heat oil to 350°F, add chicken pieces, and deep fry for 12 minutes.
Drain on a cooling rack.
Combine 6 tbsp maple syrup with remaining ingredients.
Add wings and toss to coat. Serve.

recipes.title: Egg Casserole
recipes.description: Egg casserole is great at any time of the day and is good to serve when family gets together or in other large groups.

ingredients.text: 1 dash each of red pepper, paprika, and garlic powder
ingredients.name: papryka słodka mielona
ingredients.note: 1 dash each of red pepper, paprika, and garlic powder

steps.text: Put bread in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix melted butter, milk, seasonings, and beaten eggs.
Pour mixture over bread.
Sprinkle with diced ham and top with grated cheese.
Refrigerate overnight.
Bake for 1 hour at 350°F.

recipes.title: Lemon Icing
recipes.description: Lukier cytrynowy z żółtka jaja i soku z cytryny, zagęszczany cukrem pudrem.

steps.text: Break the egg yolk into a small bowl.
Add the lemon juice and salt; beat lightly.
Gradually beat in confectioner's sugar.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Spicy Chickpea Soup
recipes.description: Gładka, pikantna zupa z ciecierzycy na bazie mleczka kokosowego, salsy i przypraw.

steps.text: Purée all ingredients in a blender until smooth.
Heat in a large saucepan or Dutch oven, and bring to a simmer.
Simmer, stirring often, 4–5 minutes, to blend flavors.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Chicken Tagine with Lemon and Olives
recipes.description: Chicken breast pieces dredged in spiced flour, browned and simmered in broth with olives, lemon zest and cinnamon.

ingredients.text: 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut in three pieces
ingredients.name: pierś z kurczaka
ingredients.note: boneless, skinless, cut in three pieces

ingredients.text: ¼ teaspoon freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: pieprz czarny

ingredients.text: ½ cup fat-free low-sodium chicken broth
ingredients.name: bulion drobiowy

steps.text: In a large zip-close plastic bag, combine the juice and chicken. Seal and marinate in the refrigerator 30 minutes.
Remove chicken from bag and discard marinade. Pat chicken dry with paper towels.
In a shallow bowl, combine the flour, salt, and black and red peppers, and turmeric.
Dredge the chicken through the flour mixture, lightly coating both sides, and set aside.
In a large, deep nonstick skillet, heat the oil over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook for 3 minutes per side, or until lightly browned.
Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside.
Add the onion, ginger, and garlic to pan. Fry until tender.
Return the chicken to the pan. Add the broth, olives, lemon zest, and cinnamon stick.
Bring to a boil, then cover, reduce heat, and simmer 1 hour or until chicken is tender.
To serve, discard the cinnamon stick and stir in cilantro.

categories: Recipes using vegetable broth and stock
Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Molokhia (Egyptian Jute Mallow Soup)
recipes.description: Molokhia is a popular Egyptian soup made from the leaves of the jute mallow plant, often enjoyed with rice or bread.

ingredients.text: 2 cups fresh or frozen jute mallow (molokhia) leaves
ingredients.name: molokhia (liście jutu)

ingredients.text: Cooked rice or bread for serving
ingredients.name: ryż lub chleb

steps.text: If using fresh molokhia leaves, remove any tough stems and wash the leaves thoroughly. If using frozen molokhia, thaw it according to the package instructions.
In a saucepan, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the finely chopped onion and minced garlic. Sauté until the onion becomes translucent and the garlic becomes fragrant.
Add the fresh or thawed molokhia leaves to the saucepan and stir well to combine with the onion and garlic mixture.
Pour in the vegetable or chicken broth, ensuring that the molokhia leaves are fully submerged.
Season the soup with ground cumin, salt, and black pepper to taste. Stir to incorporate the spices.
Bring the soup to a gentle boil, then reduce the heat to low and let it simmer for about 20–30 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld together.
Remove the soup from the heat. Optionally, squeeze the juice of a lemon into the soup and stir well to enhance the flavors.
Serve the molokhia hot, accompanied by cooked rice or bread.

recipes.title: Firfir (Ethiopian Spicy Scrambled Eggs with Injera)
recipes.description: Firfir is a popular Ethiopian dish made with spicy scrambled eggs and pieces of injera, the traditional Ethiopian flatbread.

ingredients.text: 4–6 pieces of leftover injera, torn into small pieces
ingredients.name: injera

ingredients.text: ¼ teaspoon salt, or to taste
ingredients.name: sól

steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet or frying pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions to the pan and sauté until they become translucent and slightly browned.
Stir in the minced garlic and chopped green chilies, and sauté for an additional minute until fragrant.
Add the chopped tomatoes to the pan and cook until they begin to soften.
In a mixing bowl, beat the eggs and add the berbere spice blend, paprika, turmeric, and salt. Mix well to combine.
Push the sautéed vegetables to one side of the pan, creating a space for the eggs.
Pour the beaten eggs into the empty space in the pan and scramble them with a wooden spoon or spatula until they are fully cooked.
Mix the scrambled eggs with the sautéed vegetables in the pan.
Tear the pieces of injera into small bite-sized pieces and add them to the pan. Stir well to combine all the ingredients.
Cook for a few more minutes, allowing the injera to absorb the flavors and soften slightly.
Remove the pan from heat and garnish with freshly chopped cilantro. Serve hot, and enjoy the spicy and savory flavors of this traditional Ethiopian dish.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Risotto II
recipes.description: This is a traditional Italian risotto.

steps.text: Bring the stock to a simmer in a saucepan. Keep the temperature as high as possible throughout the cooking process, without letting the stock boil. The surface of the stock should just be moving a little.
Sauté the onion until soft.
Add the rice and mix well until it is coated the oil.
Add the wine and stir constantly over medium heat until it evaporates.
Add enough hot broth to cover the rice and continue to stir until the liquid is absorbed.
Keep adding hot broth, a little at a time, while constantly stirring until the rice is done.
In a small bowl, dissolve the saffron in a little hot broth and add it to the rice.
Stir in the Parmesan cheese and season with salt to taste.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Ẹba (Cassava Flake Swallow)
recipes.description: Ẹba is a popular Nigerian swallow made from cassava flakes (garri) and is eaten with various soups, such as ẹgusi, ẹfọ riro, and ọgbọnọ soup.

ingredients.text: 2 milk tins of processed cassava flakes (garri)
ingredients.name: garri (prażona mąka z manioku)
ingredients.note: milk tins of processed cassava flakes (garri)

steps.text: Boil water in a pot.
Gradually stir in the cassava flour, and cook until it forms a smooth dough.
Serve with your soup of choice.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Pancakes II
recipes.description: Fluffy buttermilk pancakes studded with miniature chocolate chips.

ingredients.text: 1 cup (140 g / 4.9 oz) all-purpose bleached flour
ingredients.name: mąka pszenna

steps.text: Heat a large non-stick skillet or griddle over low heat while preparing ingredients.
Mix flour, sugar, salt, baking powder, and baking soda in medium bowl.
Microwave buttermilk and milk in a 2-cup glass measuring cup until room temperature (20 to 30 seconds).
Whisk in egg, butter, and vanilla.
Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients and whisk until just mixed.
Return batter to measuring cup, stirring in a teaspoon or two of water, if necessary, to make a thick but pourable batter.
Increase heat to medium and generously brush skillet or griddle with oil.
When oil starts to spider, but before it starts to smoke, pour in batter, about ¼ cup at a time, to make pancakes. Work in batches, if necessary, to avoid overcrowding.
Sprinkle 1 tablespoon miniature chocolate chips on uncooked side of each pancake as it cooks.
When pancake bottoms are golden brown and tops start to bubble (2 to 3 minutes), flip pancakes.
Cook until pancakes are golden brown on remaining side.
Repeat, brushing skillet or griddle with oil.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Kedjenou Chicken (Chicken and Vegetable Stew)
recipes.description: Kedjenou chicken is a popular and delicious dish eaten in Ivory Coast. It usually does not need any added liquid and this helps to bring out its concentrated flavours.

ingredients.text: 2 whole chickens, cut into medium pieces
ingredients.name: kurczak cały

ingredients.text: 2 fresh red or green bell peppers, chopped
ingredients.name: papryka

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Trim excess fat of chicken and pat dry with a cloth or paper towel.
Season chicken with salt, garlic, ginger, thyme, smoked paprika, green onions, chicken bouillon cube, and onions. Let rest in the fridge for at least 2 hours to season well.
Combine the tomatoes, onions, green onions, and red or green pepper in a Dutch oven. Add the chicken, and cover with the lid.
Place it in the oven, and bake for about an hour or until the chicken is cooked through. Shake the pot once or twice during cooking without opening the pot.
Remove from the oven. Serve with attieke or white rice and enjoy.

recipes.title: Lumpiang Shanghai (Filipino Pork Spring Rolls)
recipes.description: A version of lumpia that Filipinos love to share at a party.

ingredients.text: 1 pack lumpia or spring roll wrappers
ingredients.name: ciasto na wontony

steps.text: Combine the pork, garlic, and carrot in a mixing bowl.
Add the egg, and mix well to combine.
Lay one wrapper flat on your work surface. Place a small amount of the filling mixture on it, shaped like a log.
Fold two opposite sides of the wrapper over the filling to enclose the two ends of the filling. Then, use the rest of the wrapper to roll everything up length-wise.
Moisten the edge of the wrapper and press it against the roll to seal and prevent it from unwrapping.
Repeat the filling and rolling steps with the remaining filling and wrappers.
Deep fry the rolls in the oil until golden brown all over and cooked through.
Serve with the banana ketchup.

recipes.title: Yemiser Selatta (Ethiopian Lentil Salad)
recipes.description: Yemiser selatta is a vibrant and refreshing Ethiopian salad made with cooked lentils, fresh vegetables, and a zesty dressing. This salad is a popular dish in Ethiopian cuisine and is enjoyed as a side dish or a light meal.

steps.text: Rinse the lentils thoroughly to remove any impurities.
In a medium saucepan, bring the water to a boil. Add the rinsed lentils and salt.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for about 15–20 minutes, or until the lentils are tender but still hold their shape.
Drain any excess water and let the lentils cool.
In a mixing bowl, combine the cooked lentils, diced tomato, chopped red onion, diced cucumber, chopped parsley, and chopped mint.
In a separate small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, olive oil, cumin, coriander, salt, and pepper to make the dressing.
Pour the dressing over the lentil mixture and toss gently to combine, ensuring that the lentils and vegetables are evenly coated.
Taste and adjust the seasoning with salt and pepper if needed.
Refrigerate the salad for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld together.
Before serving, give the salad a gentle stir and adjust the seasoning if desired.
Serve chilled as a side dish or a light meal.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Peanut Butter Toast
recipes.description: You've heard of Reese's Peanut Butter Cups, and you've heard of peanut butter toast. Why not combine them!?

ingredients.text: 2–4 tablespoons peanut butter, smooth or crunchy
ingredients.name: masło orzechowe

steps.text: Toast the bread on both sides in a toaster oven, using the broiler setting.
Smear the peanut butter on the bread.
Sprinkle chocolate chips lightly (or heavily, if you want!) over the peanut butter.
Put the toast back under the broiler for about 20 seconds to melt the chocolate.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Cheese
recipes.description: Cauliflower cheese or cauliflower gratin (French: Choufleur au Gratin) is a filling and cheesy dish, great as a side to a roast dinner or any other dish.

ingredients.text: 300 ml (10 oz / 1 ¼ cups) white sauce
ingredients.name: sos beszamelowy

steps.text: Cut your cauliflower into small florets, and place them heads down into a bowl of salty water to dress them for an hour.

Drain florets, and add them to a saucepan of salted boiling water. Cook, uncovered, regularly checking the feel of the cauliflower with a knife to see when they are ready. Your knife should go smoothly, but with some firmness to the cauliflower still.
Preheat your oven to 200°C (180°C fan/390°F/gas 6).

Once the cauliflower has cooked, drain the florets and lay them in a dish of your choice. Combine the white sauce with ⅔ of the parmesan cheese, and pour over the cauliflower. Sprinkle over the breadcrumbs and remaining cheese.
Place your dish into the oven for about 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Easy Onion Chicken
recipes.description: Kurczak panierowany w krążkach cebuli smażonej ze zwykłej puszki, zapiekany w piekarniku.

ingredients.text: 4 ea. (1–1½ pounds) boneless, skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.name: pierś z kurczaka

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Crush French-fried onions.
Place beaten egg in medium wide bowl.
Cut chicken breasts into halves.
Dip chicken breasts in beaten egg.
Roll or dredge chicken breasts in onions.
Place on sprayed baking pan.
Bake 20–25 minutes until chicken is done.

recipes.title: Chapati Za Maji (Tanzanian Pancakes)
recipes.description: Thin Tanzanian pancakes very similar to crêpes.

steps.text: Combine the milk, eggs, and water.
Combine the flour, sugar, and salt.
Gradually whisk the wet mixture into the dry mixture until you get a thin batter similar to crêpe batter. If it feels too thick, add some additional water.
Cover the batter and let rest for 30–60 minutes.
Preheat a frying pan over medium heat.
Grease the pan with a small amount of canola oil, swirling the pan to coat the entire surface.
Scoop or pour a small amount of batter into the pan. Immediately tilt the pan in all directions to coat the whole surface with a thin film of batter.
Cook the pancake for about 1 minute. Then, carefully raise the edge with a spatula, flip it over, and cook for another minute. The pancake should be faintly browned on both sides.
Remove the pancake and set aside.
Repeat the greasing and frying process until all the batter is used up.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Liberian Jollof Rice
recipes.description: Liberyjski ryż jollof z kurczakiem, wołowiną lub wieprzowiną, warzywami i pastą pomidorową.

ingredients.text: 2 large chicken breasts, cut into cubes
ingredients.name: pierś z kurczaka

ingredients.text: 2 pounds boiled pork or beef, cut into cubes
ingredients.name: wieprzowina lub wołowina gotowana

ingredients.text: 2 bags of frozen mixed vegetables (such as sweet corn, string beans, etc), thawed and drained
ingredients.name: mieszanka warzyw mrożonych
ingredients.note: such as sweet corn, string beans, etc; thawed and drained

steps.text: Season the chicken with salt and red pepper.
Leave the chicken to stand for about 5 minutes.
In a frying pan, brown the chicken in hot vegetable oil. Then transfer the chicken to a large pot.
In the same frying pan, add the onions and beef or pork. Fry lightly and add to the pot with the chicken.
Combine the mixed vegetables, tomato paste, bouillon cubes, salt to taste, shrimp, and bell pepper. Leave to simmer for about 10 minutes.
Add the rice, stir well, and cook over low heat for about 40–45 minutes.
Serve hot.

categories: Recipes using vegetable broth and stock
Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: N'gakasse (Groundnut Sauce)
recipes.description: A West African sauce made with groundnuts (peanuts) as the main ingredient, commonly served with rice, yams, plantains, or fufu.

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper (adjust to taste)
ingredients.name: pieprz cayenne

ingredients.text: Chopped fresh cilantro or parsley (optional; for garnish)
ingredients.name: kolendra świeża

steps.text: If using raw peanuts, roast them in a preheated oven at 350°F (175°C) for 10–15 minutes until golden brown.
Remove the skins from the roasted peanuts by rubbing them together in a clean kitchen towel.
Place the roasted and peeled peanuts in a blender or food processor. Blend until you achieve a smooth paste consistency. Set aside.
Heat the oil in a large saucepan or pot over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and sauté until it becomes translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger, and sauté for another minute until fragrant.
Stir in the chopped tomatoes and diced bell pepper. Cook the mixture for about 5 minutes until the vegetables soften.
Add the blended groundnut paste to the pot, stirring well to combine it with the vegetables. Allow the mixture to cook for 2–3 minutes, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking.
Sprinkle in the ground cayenne pepper, ground paprika, ground coriander, and salt. Adjust the seasonings according to your taste preference.
Pour in the vegetable or chicken broth, and stir to combine all the ingredients. Reduce the heat to low, and let the sauce simmer for about 15–20 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld together.
Once the sauce has thickened to your desired consistency, remove it from the heat. Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro or parsley, if desired.
Serve over cooked rice, yams, plantains, or fufu.

recipes.title: Salade Frisee
recipes.description: Sałata frisée z winegretem szampańskim, serem kozim i chrupiącym bekonem.

ingredients.text: Crumbled crisp bacon pieces, for garnish
ingredients.name: boczek

steps.text: In a large mixing bowl, toss frisee with the Champagne Vinaigrette.
Divide salad among 8 salad plates.
Top each salad with a goat cheese cake.
Garnish with crumbled bacon.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock
Recipes using vegetable broth and stock

recipes.title: Benachin (Gambian Rice with Meat and Vegetables)
recipes.description: Benachin, also known as "one-pot" or "jollof rice", is a flavorful and vibrant Gambian rice dish made with meat, fish or vegetables.

ingredients.text: 500 g chicken, beef, or fish, cut into pieces
ingredients.name: kurczak, wołowina lub ryba
ingredients.note: chicken, beef, or fish, cut into pieces

ingredients.text: 1 cup chopped vegetables (such as green beans, peas, or corn)
ingredients.name: warzywa (np. fasolka szparagowa, groszek, kukurydza)
ingredients.note: such as green beans, peas, or corn

steps.text: Heat the vegetable oil in a large pot or saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and minced garlic. Sauté until they become translucent and fragrant.
Add the chicken, beef, or fish to the pot and cook until browned on all sides. Stir occasionally to ensure even cooking.
Stir in the tomato paste, paprika, thyme, and curry powder. Cook for a few minutes to enhance the flavors.
Add the diced bell peppers, carrot, and other chopped vegetables of your choice. Stir well to combine.
Rinse the rice under cold water until the water runs clear. Drain the excess water.
Add the rice to the pot and stir until it is well-coated with the vegetable and meat mixture.
Pour in the chicken or vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a boil. Avoid stirring the rice during this time to prevent it from becoming mushy.
Once the rice is cooked, gently fluff it with a fork.
Taste the benachin and season with salt and pepper according to your preference.
Serve hot as a main course or as a side dish alongside grilled meat or fish.

recipes.title: Cucumber and Tomato Salad
recipes.description: A very easy salad of chopped cucumber, tomato and onion dressed with sunflower oil and salt.

ingredients.text: ½ tsp salt or to taste
ingredients.name: sól

steps.text: Chop cucumbers and tomatoes into small cubes (approx. ¼ inch on the side).
Peel and chop the onion.
Combine all of the above in an appropriately sized bowl.
Add sunflower oil and mix well.
Add salt to taste and mix again.

recipes.title: Thiebou Yapp
recipes.description: Senegalese dish of rice cooked with meat and vegetables, served with boiled eggs.

steps.text: Cut the meat into smaller sizes, put oil in a pot and boil at medium heat.
Add Garlic, salt, pepper and hot pepper, cover and allow cook.
Add 1 liter of water, add rice according to the quantity you want.
Add salt and seasoning cube, cover and allow to cook for 2 minutes.
Wash the vegetables and add pepper, hot pepper, lemon juice. pour half cup of water and mix well allow to cook for 10 minutes and leave to heat.
Slice tomatoes, mix with vinegar in a small bowl, (you can add ketchup if you want).
Add sliced meat into the pot of rice and allow to cook for 5 minutes.
And your food is ready.

recipes.title: Spinach Calzones
recipes.description: Calzones z ricottą, mozzarellą i szpinakiem, zapiekane w cieście chlebowym.

ingredients.text: 284 g frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
ingredients.name: szpinak mrożony

ingredients.text: 908 g frozen white bread dough, thawed
ingredients.name: ciasto chlebowe pszenne mrożone

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a large bowl, mix together the ricotta cheese, eggs, Italian seasoning, mozzarella cheese, Parmesan cheese and spinach. Set aside.
Divide the bread dough into 8 pieces and roll each piece out to about an 8-inch circle.
Spoon about ½ cup of the ricotta filling onto each circle, fold over and seal the edges.
Place onto a greased cookie sheet.
Bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven, or until nicely browned on the tops and bottoms.

recipes.title: Turkey and Bacon Salad
recipes.description: A tasty salad for any meat-eating salad lover. Salad consists of bacon, olive, carrot, and turkey piled on a bed of lettuce.

steps.text: Cook bacon completely.
Remove excess grease by pressing cooked bacon on disposable paper towel.
Chop bacon strips into small pieces.
Clean lettuce, carrots, and olives.
Shred lettuce either by hand or with a knife.
Lay desired amount of lettuce in clean bowl, a minimum of 2 cups recommended.
Roll deli turkey to form a slender shape.
Slowly slice turkey into circular shapes.
Pile carrots, olive, bacon, and turkey on lettuce.
Top off with your favorite dressing.

recipes.title: Burmese Pork Curry
recipes.description: Burmese pork curry is a light, flavoursome pork dish.

ingredients.text: 45 ml (3 tbsp) tamarind juice or 5 ml (1 tsp) tamarind pulp concentrate
ingredients.name: sok tamarynd
ingredients.note: or 5 ml (1 tsp) tamarind pulp concentrate

steps.text: Soak the dried chilli in warm water for 20 minutes.
Crush the ginger, chilli, lemongrass, and galangal in a mortar and pestle until they form a coarse paste.
Add the shrimp paste and fine sugar, and continue grinding to a dark grainy paste.
Place the pork in a wok or large frying pan over medium heat, and stir in the curry paste until the meat is well coated.
Cook the pork over a low heat, stirring occasionally, until the meat changes colour and renders some of its fat, and the curry has started to release its aroma.
Stir in the turmeric, water, and soy sauce, then simmer gently, uncovered, for 40 minutes until the meat is tender.
Steam the beans separately for about 10 minutes.
Stir the sugar, tamarind, garlic, shallots, and fish sauce into the meat until the sugar and tamarind are dissolved.
Garnish with the fresh chillis and steamed beans, and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Awug
recipes.description: Awug to tradycyjne sundajskie ciasto z mąki ryżowej, podawane z tartym kokosem i syropem z cukru palmowego.

steps.text: Steam the rice flour for 20 minutes.
Remove the rice flour from the steamer and set aside.
Combine the steamed rice flour with the coconut, white sugar, and salt in a bowl.
Stir until the mixture becomes uniformly crumbly.
Prepare molds by greasing the insides with a little oil.
Fill one mold halfway with the rice flour mixture, add a thin layer of palm sugar, then fill the rest of the mold completely with the rice flour mixture.
Repeat with the rest of the rice flour mixture, palm sugar, and molds.
Preheat a steamer pot and basket over high heat so the water is boiling.
Steam the awug cakes over the boiling water for 25 minutes.
Let the molds cool fully, then remove the cakes from the molds. Serve.

categories: Recipes using beef broth and stock

recipes.title: Soup Joumou (Haitian Beef and Squash Soup)
recipes.description: A hearty Haitian soup of marinated beef and winter squash with root vegetables and cabbage, finished with lime.

ingredients.text: 2 scallions, sliced, plus more for garnish
ingredients.name: szczypiorek

ingredients.text: 1 scotch bonnet chile, stemmed and seeded
ingredients.name: papryczka chili

ingredients.text: Juice of 1 lime, plus wedges for serving
ingredients.name: limonka

ingredients.text: 1 lb beef chuck, cut into ½-inch pieces
ingredients.name: wołowina gulaszowa

ingredients.text: 1 small leek, trimmed, halved lengthwise and cut into 1½-inch pieces; rinsed
ingredients.name: por
ingredients.note: small, trimmed, halved lengthwise, cut into 1½-inch pieces; rinsed

ingredients.text: 1 small yellow onion, cut into 1½-inch pieces
ingredients.name: cebula

ingredients.text: 1 large Yukon gold potato, peeled and cut into 1½-inch pieces
ingredients.name: ziemniak
ingredients.note: large Yukon gold, peeled, cut into 1½-inch pieces

ingredients.text: 1 medium turnip, peeled and cut into 1½-inch pieces
ingredients.name: rzepa

ingredients.text: ½ small green cabbage, cored and cut into 1½-inch pieces
ingredients.name: kapusta zielona

ingredients.text: ½ small calabaza or kabocha squash, cut into 1-inch pieces
ingredients.name: dynia
ingredients.note: small calabaza or kabocha, cut into 1-inch pieces

steps.text: Purée garlic, scallions, parsley, thyme, shallots, chile, juice, salt and pepper, and ½ cup water in a blender until smooth; mix with beef in a bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight.
Remove beef from marinade and dry with paper towels; set aside.
Heat oil in a 8 qt saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add beef; cook, turning as needed, until browned, about 8 minutes.
Add stock and bring to a boil; reduce heat to medium, and cook, stirring occasionally, until beef is tender, about 1½ hours.
Add carrots, celery, leeks, onion, potatoes, turnips, and cabbage; cook, slightly covered and stirring occasionally, until vegetables are tender, about 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, bring squash and 2 cups water to a boil in a 2 qt saucepan over high heat; reduce heat to medium-low and cook, covered, until squash is tender, about 10 minutes.
Drain, reserving ½ cup cooking liquid and transfer squash and liquid to a blender; purée until smooth and set aside.
When vegetables are tender, uncover, and stir in reserved squash purée; cook, stirring occasionally, until soup is slightly thick, 5–10 minutes more.
Season soup with salt and pepper and serve with scallions and lime wedges.

recipes.title: Oat Milk (Homemade)
recipes.description: Homemade plant milk made by blending oats with water and straining.

steps.text: Put oats in a blender. Blend the oats to the finest powder you can get
Add as much of the water as possible to the blender. Blend some more.
Strain the mixture into a jug, and add the rest of the water.

recipes.title: Italian seasoning
recipes.description: A dried herb blend traditionally containing basil, oregano, rosemary, thyme, garlic powder, sage, and/or coriander.

steps.text: Mix together well or pulse about a minute in a food processor.
Store in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Marzipan Muffins
recipes.description: Muffins with oatmeal and marzipan filling.

steps.text: Finely dice the marzipan or mash it with a fork. Beat it well with butter, milk, and eggs.
Mix the remaining dry ingredients. Add them to the butter and egg mixture, and mix to make a smooth batter. If it is too dry, add a little more milk.
Place muffin tins on a baking sheet. Spread the batter in the tins and bake at 180°C for 20–25 minutes.
If desired, decorate the muffins with chocolate icing and sprinkles.

recipes.title: Khatti Dal (Spiced Tamarind Pigeon Peas)
recipes.description: A sour South Asian dal of split pigeon peas, flavoured with tamarind, mustard seeds and cumin.

ingredients.text: 1 cup (240 ml) toor daal (split pigeon peas)
ingredients.name: toor daal

steps.text: Wash toor daal and boil for about 20 minutes until soft. Drain and smash the dal.
In a kadai, heat the oil until hot. Add curry leaves, mustard seeds and jeera seeds. Fry for a minute. They will pop at first, so a cover will help to avoid a mess.
Add onion and fry until slightly brown.
Add ginger and garlic paste. Fry for a minute, then add the tomatoes. Cook until the oil separates.
Add tamarind pieces, turmeric powder, and red chilli powder. Cook it for 4–5 minutes.
Add the toor daal and enough water for your desired thickness.
Add salt to taste, and garnish with coriander leaves.
Serve with a roti or poured over rice.

recipes.title: Pickled Green Mango (Aavakaaya)
recipes.description: A spicy Indian pickle of raw sour green mangoes preserved in mustard, chili, fenugreek, garlic and sesame oil.

ingredients.text: 250 g (8.75 oz) red chile powder (increase as desired)
ingredients.name: chili w proszku
czosnek
ingredients.note: flakes, optional addition at the end

steps.text: Soak the raw mangoes in water for 10 minutes and dry them with a clean cloth.
Slice each of the mangoes vertically in half in such a way that the hard stone in the inside of the mango is also cut into two parts, with each part firm on the two halves.
Remove the seed. Scrape the wafer-thin layer attached to the stone with a spoon.
Cut each half of the sliced mango into 4–5 pieces. Each and every piece should contain a portion of the stone, without which the piece will soften too quickly.
Clean the cut pieces with dry cloth. Transfer the cleaned pieces to a basin.
Sprinkle the turmeric powder on the mango pieces and mix with dry hands.

Pour half of the oil on the pieces, and mix well with your hands. It is essential to mix the pieces with oil first before adding any other ingredients. This will help the pieces to retain their firm texture.
Mix the powdered salt with the mango.

Mix the mustard powder, red chili powder, garlic paste, and fenugreek powder together in another container. Add half of the remaining oil to the powders and mix to a consistency that can be held in a fist.
Mix the paste well with the mango pieces. Add the remaining oil to the pieces and mix well.

Cover the basin firmly with a lid. If the basin used for mixing doesn't have a proper lid, transfer the contents to a porcelain jar or a clean plastic container with a firm lid. Tie a neat thick cloth over it and store it in a cool dark shelf.

Open the lid after 3–4 days, mix well, and taste it. The quantity of salt and chili powder needed in the pickle differ depending on several factors. Add salt and/or chili powder if necessary but be cautious in the quantity. The added quantities should be small to only tweak the taste and not alter completely. Those who want to add garlic flakes can do so now.
Transfer the contents to glass, plastic, or porcelain jars.

recipes.title: Chicken and Corn Empanadas
recipes.description: Baked empanadas filled with chicken, corn, peppers, onion and Monterey Jack cheese, made with frozen crescent rolls.

ingredients.text: Kosher salt and fresh ground black pepper to taste
ingredients.name: sól

ingredients.text: 1 egg, lightly beaten with 1 tablespoon water
ingredients.name: jajko

steps.text: In large skillet, heat oil and lightly brown onions.
Add pepper, crushed red peppers, corn, and oregano. Cook 5 minutes over moderate heat or until liquid has mostly cooked away.
Remove from heat; stir in chicken and cheese, season to taste and chill.
Unroll crescent dough into two perforated squares.
Place one square over second square.
Roll out with a little flour to form a single large rectangular sheet.
Cut out four circles about 5 inches in diameter.
Repeat with remaining package of rolls.
Refrigerate circles on waxed paper until firm, about 30 minutes.
Spoon ¼ cup filling into center of each circle, leaving a 1-inch border.
Brush edges with egg mixture.
Fold over to seal, stretching dough slightly.
Press edges together while pushing out any air pockets.
Seal by crimping with the tines of a fork.
Brush top with egg wash. Prick with fork.
Arrange empanadas on buttered and floured baking sheet.
Refrigerate until ready to bake, up to two days ahead of time.
Preheat oven to 400°F.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until puffy and brown and filling in bubbling hot.

recipes.title: Peach Chutney
recipes.description: This is great served with pork chops or curry.

ingredients.text: 1 hot banana pepper, seeded and chopped
ingredients.name: papryczka bananowa

steps.text: Blanch, peel, and pit peaches.
Coarsely chop peaches and combine with lemon juice in a large stainless steel or enamel saucepan. Stir in sugar.
Bring to a boil and cook, stirring frequently until the peaches are tender (about 15 minutes).
Add remaining ingredients. Boil over medium-high heat for about 45 minutes or until thick, stirring frequently.
Ladle chutney into six hot, sterilized, 1-pint (2-cup) preserving jars, leaving ½ inch of headspace. Wipe rims clean and seal according to manufacturer's directions.
Process for 15 minutes in a boiling water bath. Allow chutney to mature for at least one month before using.

recipes.title: Spinach and Ricotta Ravioli Filling
recipes.description: A filling of spinach, ricotta or cottage cheese, bread crumbs, Parmesan, egg and seasonings for ravioli.

ingredients.text: 15 oz cooked spinach (fresh, frozen, or canned)
ingredients.name: szpinak

ingredients.text: ½ tsp grated or minced garlic
ingredients.name: czosnek

steps.text: Squeeze the spinach to remove excess water.
Place in a mixing bowl.
Add the other ingredients and mix well with a fork.

recipes.title: Vanilla Crisps
recipes.description: A vanilla crisp is a tasty cookie that is much like a sugar cookie, but takes less time to make.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Cream butter, shortening and sugar together.
Add salt and vanilla.
One at a time, beat eggs into mixture.
Stir flour into mixture to make dough.
Roll dough into small balls and press into circular shapes on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake for 8–10 minutes.
Remove immediately from pan and allow to cool.

recipes.title: Zitumbuwa (Malawian Banana Pancakes)
recipes.description: Zitumbuwa are Malawian banana pancakes that are loved by both kids and adults. These fluffy and flavorful pancakes make for a delicious breakfast or snack option.

steps.text: In a mixing bowl, combine the mashed bananas, all-purpose flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt. Mix well.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the milk, egg, and vanilla extract.
Gradually pour the wet ingredients into the banana-flour mixture, stirring until a smooth batter forms.
Heat the vegetable oil in a frying pan or griddle over medium heat.
Pour a small amount of the pancake batter onto the hot pan, forming a circle.
Cook the pancake for about 2 minutes or until bubbles form on the surface. Then, flip the pancake and cook for an additional 1–2 minutes on the other side until it is golden brown and cooked through.
Repeat the process with the remaining batter, adding more oil to the pan as needed to prevent sticking.
Serve warm, and enjoy them plain or with your favorite toppings, such as honey, syrup, or fresh fruit.

recipes.title: Chicken with Orange, Spinach and Cherry Tomatoes
recipes.description: A simple recipe that combines vegetable and fruit with chicken, baked in foil packets for a low-fat, tender and juicy result.

ingredients.text: 4 skinless boneless chicken breast halves, thinly sliced crosswise
ingredients.name: pierś z kurczaka

ingredients.text: 4 cups firmly packed torn fresh spinach leaves (about 8 ounces)
ingredients.name: szpinak

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Place large baking sheet in oven to heat.
Mix dill, orange peel, garlic and salt in medium bowl. Season with pepper.
Combine tomatoes, oil and 1 teaspoon dill mixture in small bowl.
Add chicken to remaining dill mixture in medium bowl and toss to coat.
Cut 4 sheets of foil each about 20 inches long.
Arrange 1 cup spinach on 1 sheet of foil.
Place a quarter of the sliced chicken mixture atop spinach.
Spoon a quarter of the tomato mixture atop chicken.
Fold foil over, enclosing contents completely and crimping edges tightly to seal.
Repeat with remaining 3 foil sheets, forming 4 packets total.
Arrange foil packets in single layer on heated baking sheet.
Bake until chicken is just cooked through, about 15 minutes.
Transfer to plates; let stand 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Honey Mustard Salad Dressing
recipes.description: There are many variations of this salad dressing. This should serve as a basic template.

ingredients.text: ½ teaspoon (7.5 ml) freshly-ground black pepper
ingredients.name: pieprz czarny

steps.text: Combine the mustard, honey, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Gradually whisk the safflower oil into the mixture to form a creamy dressing.

recipes.title: Smoked Garlic Chicken
recipes.description: Chicken leg quarters rubbed with a spice mixture, smoked over mesquite, then charred on a very hot grill.

ingredients.text: 4 whole chicken leg quarters, skin removed
ingredients.name: udko z kurczaka

steps.text: Combine seasonings. Set aside.
Brush chicken with mustard. This will help make a crust.
Press seasoning mixture into both sides of meat.
Refrigerate 30 minutes.
Preheat smoker to 225°F with mesquite.
Add chicken pieces and insert a probe thermometer into one of them.
Cook, adding wood as needed, until internal temperature reaches 170°F.
Move to a very very high grill and cook until charred and marked.
Flip and repeat.
Serve immediately with desired side dishes.

categories: Recipes using beef broth and stock

recipes.title: Picadillo (Beef with Potatoes and Tomatoes)
recipes.description: The Mexican dish picadillo is a popular filling for tacos.

ingredients.text: 1 large green bell pepper, stemmed, seeded, and chopped
ingredients.name: papryka zielona

ingredients.text: 14.5 oz canned diced tomatoes in juice
ingredients.name: pomidory krojone w puszce

ingredients.text: Black pepper, cumin, oregano and garlic powder to taste (about 2-2½ tablespoons total)
ingredients.name: pieprz czarny
ingredients.note: black pepper, cumin, oregano and garlic powder; about 2-2½ tablespoons total

steps.text: In a large, heavy pan, heat oil over medium-high heat.
Dump onions, garlic, bell pepper and seasonings into heated oil.
When the bell pepper starts to discolor, add the ground beef, stirring to break up large pieces.
Brown evenly, cooking for about 7 minutes.
As meat is browning, add potato, beef broth and diced tomatoes.
Simmer until picadillo thickens, stirring occasionally.
Serve hot with Spanish (Mexican) rice and tortilla.

recipes.title: Three Sisters Soup
recipes.description: Three sisters soup is a classic Indigenous recipe made from corn, squash, and beans. It is wonderful on its own or served with freshly baked Indigenous bread.

ingredients.text: 2 cups drained canned white or yellow hominy corn (can be substituted with regular corn)
ingredients.name: kukurydza konserwowa
ingredients.note: can be substituted with regular corn

ingredients.text: 2 cups trimmed and snapped fresh green beans
ingredients.name: fasolka szparagowa

ingredients.text: 2 cups peeled and cubed butternut squash
ingredients.name: dynia piżmowa

ingredients.text: 1½ cups white or yellow potatoes, peeled and diced (for a sweeter variation, you can use sweet potatoes)
ingredients.name: ziemniak
ingredients.note: peeled and diced; sweet potatoes optional

steps.text: In a large pot, combine the hominy, green beans, squash, and potatoes.
Add water and chicken bouillon.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer until the vegetables are soft (approximately 10 minutes).
In a separate pan, melt the butter and whisk in the flour.
Stir the mixture into the soup.
Increase heat to medium and cook until the soup thickens (approximately 5 minutes).
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve your delicious three sisters soup. Garnish with fresh herbs or Indigenous spices for added flavor.

recipes.title: Homemade Ketchup
recipes.description: Homemade tomato ketchup, simmered with spices and vinegar, then sealed in sterilized jars for canning.

ingredients.text: ½ cup (120 g) white granulated sugar
ingredients.name: cukier

steps.text: Scald tomatoes, and press through a coarse sieve to remove seeds and skins.
Let cool.
Measure out 1 gallon (3.8 litres) of tomato pulp, and combine with the remaining ingredients.
Let simmer slowly for 3 hours.
Pour hot ketchup into hot sterilized 1-pint jars and seal.
Process for 15 minutes in boiling water bath.

recipes.title: Amala (Yoruba Yam Swallow)
recipes.description: Àmàlà is a preparation native to the Yoruba people of Nigeria, made from yam flour, cassava flour, and/or unripe plantain flour. It is served with a variety of soups.

steps.text: Heat water in a pot and bring to boil.
Gradually stir in the yam flour, mixing continuously to avoid lumps. You should get a smooth paste or dough.
Adjust the amount of water or yam flour to get your desired consistency.
Stir well, cover, and cook on low heat for about 10 minutes.
Serve with soups.

recipes.title: Hickory BBQ Chicken
recipes.description: Chicken pieces brined in salt, honey and cider vinegar, then baked on a rack over hickory chips and glazed with homemade barbecue sauce.

ingredients.text: 2 each boneless skinless chicken thighs, drumsticks, and breasts
ingredients.name: udko z kurczaka
ingredients.note: boneless skinless chicken thighs, drumsticks, and breasts

steps.text: Combine salt, honey, and vinegar in a gallon size zip-top bag until salt has dissolved. Add ice and shake until ice is almost completely melted and mixture has cooled down. Insert chicken pieces and refrigerate 1½–2 hours, turning once.
Place a good amount of hickory chips in the bottom of a large roasting pan. Place a roasting rack in that pan. Set aside.

Drain chicken and discard mixture. Pat dry with paper towels and season chicken liberally on both sides with rub. Gently pat into meat and refrigerate for at least 1 hour (more rub will stick if you wear gloves).

Toss chicken pieces in barbecue sauce. Place on the prepared roasting pan and insert 1 probe thermometer into one of the breasts and one into the thighs. Bake in the center of a 375°F oven until both the thigh and the breast's internal temperature reach 165°F.
Bring remaining sauce to a boil in a large saucepan over medium high heat for 5 minutes. Set aside.
Remove and cover with aluminum foil. Let rest 10 minutes. Serve warm with remaining sauce.

recipes.title: Rava Dosa (Indian Semolina Pancake)
recipes.description: Cienki, chrupiący naleśnik z mąki ryżowej, mąki pszennej i kaszy manny (suji), z zielonymi chilli, kminkiem i maślanką.

steps.text: Mix all the ingredients together to a watery batter.
Heat a griddle or pan, and grease it with oil.
Sprinkle the batter on the pan with your hand.
Cook it on medium temperature for 3–4 minutes, or until it is completely cooked.
Serve it with tomato or peanut chutney.

recipes.title: Three Ginger Soup
recipes.description: Zupa z trzema rodzajami imbiru, przepis z restauracji La Cascade w Langwedocji we Francji.

ingredients.text: 3 tsp finely grated fresh ginger root, divided
ingredients.name: imbir świeży

ingredients.text: 3 tsp minced stem ginger in syrup
ingredients.name: imbir w syropie

steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a pot over medium heat.
Add the onions with 1 tsp grated ginger root, and sauté, stirring, until translucent but not browned.
Add the carrot, and sweat for another few minutes.
Add the orange and tomato juices, 1 tsp grated ginger root, the ginger powder, parsley, thyme, and bay leaf.
Bring to a boil, then simmer for 40 minutes.
Remove from the heat, and stir in the remaining 1 tsp grated ginger root along with the syruped stem ginger.
Purée the mixture until smooth using a full-size or immersion blender.
Season with salt, taste, and adjust the seasoning as needed.

recipes.title: Lafun (Nigerian Cassava Swallow)
recipes.description: Lafun, zwany też white amala, to typowa nigeryjska kluska z mąki z manioku, podawana z zupami.

steps.text: Boil the 2 cups of water in a pot, then stir in cassava flour.
Stir in the ¼ cup hot water, and allow the mixture to steam for a few minutes.
Stir until the mixture is smooth and lump free.
Serve the lafun with your choice of soup.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Texas Style Chicken Fried Steak
recipes.description: Crispy, peppery breaded beef cube steaks smothered in a rich cream gravy, in the Texas style.

ingredients.text: ¼ cup freshly ground black pepper, divided
ingredients.name: pieprz czarny

ingredients.text: 1 cup whole milk, combined with ¼ cup heavy cream
ingredients.name: mleko pełne
ingredients.note: combined with ¼ cup heavy cream

steps.text: Season steaks with salt and 2 tbsp freshly ground black pepper.
In a pie plate, combine eggs with paprika and cayenne. Dip steaks into egg mixture.
In another pie plate, place some all-purpose flour. Dredge battered steaks with flour.
Move to a cooling rack and let rest 10–15 minutes. Wash this once you start frying, or get a clean one.
Heat a 12 inch cast-iron skillet over medium high heat. Once hot, pour in 2 tbsp drippings. Add steaks in a triangle formation around the edges of the pan. Fry for 4 minutes per side.
Remove steaks from pan and drain on a cooling rack above a sheet pan. Keep steaks warm in a 250°F oven.
Add remaining drippings and 3 tbsp flour. Whisk continuously until blonde color is achieved.
Add chicken broth and deglaze pan. Bring to a boil over medium heat until reduced by ¾.
Add milk mixture and remaining black pepper. Keep over medium heat until gravy coats back of spoon.
Remove steaks to serving platters and drizzle with gravy. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Chocolate-Jalapeno Truffles
recipes.description: Rich dark chocolate truffles with butter, instant coffee and roasted jalapeño, rolled in cocoa powder.

ingredients.text: 10 ounces best-quality semisweet chocolate, in small pieces or chips
ingredients.name: czekolada gorzka
ingredients.note: best-quality semisweet, in small pieces or chips

ingredients.text: 10 tablespoons (1¼ sticks) best-quality unsalted butter, cold and cut into small pieces
ingredients.name: masło
ingredients.note: best-quality unsalted, cold and cut into small pieces

ingredients.text: 2–3 jalapeños, roasted, peeled, seeded, and finely chopped (wear rubber gloves)
ingredients.name: papryczka jalapeño

ingredients.text: ½ cup unsweetened cocoa powder, sift onto a plate
ingredients.name: kakao

steps.text: In a metal 1-quart mixing bowl, dissolve coffee in water.
Add the chocolate and set on top of a pan of gently simmering water.
When the chocolate has softened completely but is not hot, remove from heat and stir until smooth.
Beat in the cold butter a small piece at a time, adding a new piece as soon as the previous one is almost absorbed.
Beat with a hand-held electric mixer until creamy, about 10 minutes.
Continue beating for a few minutes to cool. This can also be done in a stand mixer, fitted with the whip attachment.
Add half of the jalapeños and taste. Add more jalapeño to your taste; remember that the heat will intensify with time. Try for a balance of sweet and heat.
Scrape into a small, deep container, press a piece of plastic wrap on the surface, and chill overnight, until completely firm.
Scoop out small balls and roll in the cocoa powder.
Keep refrigerated until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Ensalada de Pallares (Peruvian Lima Bean Salad)
recipes.description: A Peruvian salad of large dried lima beans dressed with a mustard vinaigrette, red onion, tomatoes and parsley.

ingredients.text: 1 lb (500 g) pallares (large dried lima beans)
ingredients.name: fasola jaś sucha

steps.text: Soak pallares overnight or at least 6 hours. Change water 2–3 times.
Boil the beans without salt in enough water to cover them. Use high heat until water reaches boiling point.
Skim and reduce the heat. Simmer for about 1 hour; cooking time depends on the dryness of the beans.
When the beans are plump and tender, take them off the heat and drain. You might reserve the boiling liquid to process leftovers into a soup.
Season the beans lightly with salt (kosher works great) and, while the beans cool down, prepare your vinaigrette.
Mix olive oil, vinegar, mustard, salt and pepper to taste, red onion, and tomatoes.
Once the beans are at room temperature, check the seasoning of the vinaigrette. It should taste a bit stronger than expected.
Carefully mix the vinaigrette with the beans, then mix in the parsley.
Garnish the top with more parsley, and serve.

recipes.title: Spicy Mexican Omelet
recipes.description: Omlet z jajek z ostrą salsą, serem Monterey Jack i chili habanero lub serrano.

ingredients.text: 1 habanero or serrano chile, finely minced and seeded if you like
ingredients.name: chili habanero lub serrano
ingredients.note: finely minced and seeded if you like

ingredients.text: ½ cup salsa, at room temperature
ingredients.name: salsa

ingredients.text: 1 cup grated Monterey Jack cheese, at room temperature
ingredients.name: ser Monterey Jack

steps.text: Cover whole eggs with warm but not scalding water. Let sit 5 minutes or until room temperature.
Beat eggs with salt. Set aside.
Combine chiles, salsa, cilantro, and cheese. Set aside.
Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Quickly swirl with butter and crack in the eggs. Cook until egg is set and well browned on side facing pan.
Sprinkle salsa mixture evenly on uncooked side of egg. Fold in half and cook raw side until set and well browned.
Sprinkle with chopped cilantro and serve warm.

recipes.title: Traditional Tuna Casserole
recipes.description: Traditional tuna casserole is a simple, quick-to-make meal, mentioned by Garrison Keillor on A Prairie Home Companion.

ingredients.text: 1 cup (240 g) uncooked macaroni, or other short pasta
ingredients.name: makaron
ingredients.note: uncooked macaroni, or other short pasta

ingredients.text: 1 can (10.75 ounces / 305 g) cream of mushroom or cheddar cheese soup
ingredients.name: zupa kremowa z pieczarkami lub cheddar
ingredients.note: cream of mushroom or cheddar cheese soup, 10.75 ounces / 305 g

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350–400°F (180–200°C).
Mix all ingredients, except cheese slices, in a large casserole dish.
Bake for 1 hour, stirring 2 or 3 times.
When macaroni is tender, cover top with cheese slices, and return to oven for 5 minutes to melt.

recipes.title: Traditional Tuna Casserole - Skillet
recipes.description: Traditional tuna casserole is a simple, quick-to-make meal, mentioned by Garrison Keillor on A Prairie Home Companion.

ingredients.text: 1 cup (240 g) uncooked macaroni, or other short pasta
ingredients.name: makaron
ingredients.note: uncooked macaroni, or other short pasta

ingredients.text: 1 can (10.75 ounces / 305 g) cream of mushroom or cheddar cheese soup
ingredients.name: zupa kremowa z pieczarkami lub cheddar
ingredients.note: cream of mushroom or cheddar cheese soup, 10.75 ounces / 305 g

steps.text: Assemble all ingredients, except sliced cheese, in large skillet with 1–1½ cups (240–360 ml) hot water.
Bring to boil, and simmer 15 minutes, frequently stirring.
Melt cheese on top before serving.

recipes.title: Smoked Salmon Breakfast Burrito
recipes.description: A breakfast burrito with scrambled eggs and smoked salmon cream cheese spread.

ingredients.text: ¼ cup smoked salmon cream cheese spread
ingredients.name: serek kremowy z łososiem wędzonym

steps.text: In a small bowl, whisk together eggs, milk, lemon juice, and pepper.
In sauté pan over medium heat, add oil to coat the pan, add egg mixture to scramble.
Toast the tortillas in a cast iron skillet over medium heat.
Spread cream spread in a circle with 2 inches from the edge of tortilla.
Add eggs.
Wrap and enjoy.

recipes.title: Tandoori Tofu
recipes.description: Tofu marynowane w przyprawach, jogurcie i sosie pomidorowym, a następnie grillowane na szaszłykach.

ingredients.text: 120 ml tomato sauce or tomato paste
ingredients.name: sos pomidorowy

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons olive oil or canola oil
ingredients.name: oliwa z oliwek

ingredients.text: Preferred seasonings (suggested seasonings: turmeric, pepper, hot sauce, salt)
ingredients.name: przyprawy
ingredients.note: suggested seasonings: turmeric, pepper, hot sauce, salt

steps.text: Cut tofu into 2.5 cm (1-inch) cubes.
Spread out the tofu on a cookie sheet and bake for 20–25 minutes at 170 -. This releases the extra water from the tofu and dries it out to be able to absorb the marinade.
Mix the spices, tomato sauce, yogurt, and oil in a bowl.
Let the tofu marinate well (about 8 hours) in this mixture, preferably in the refrigerator.
After marinating, thread the tofu onto skewers and grill it.

recipes.title: Crème Pâtissière
recipes.description: Thick vanilla custard made from egg yolks, sugar, flour and milk, cooked on the stove and cooled under parchment.

steps.text: In a 3-quart mixing bowl, beat the sugar into the egg yolks with a wire whisk until the mixture is pale yellow and forms a ribbon.
Beat in the flour.
While beating continuously, pour the hot milk onto the egg yolk mixture in a thin stream.
Pour the mixture into a saucepan and set over moderate heat, stirring constantly.
Bring to the boil slowly while stirring well to avoid lumps.
When it reaches the boil, stir for 2 to 3 minutes to cook the flour well, being careful not to burn it in the bottom of the pan.
Remove from the heat, then beat in the butter followed by the vanilla extract.
Cover the surface with a sheet of parchment paper to prevent a skin from forming and allow to cool.

recipes.title: Meatless Sloppy Joes
recipes.description: A vegetarian take on Sloppy Joes made with chili beans, brown rice and vegetables, served on hamburger buns.

ingredients.text: ¼ cup hickory-smoked barbecue sauce, or to your preference
ingredients.name: sos barbecue

steps.text: Add olive oil to pan over medium-high heat.
Add onions, bell pepper, and carrots and cook for 3–4 minutes.
Add rice, chili beans, and barbecue sauce and cook for approximately 10–15 minutes, stirring frequently to heat thoroughly.
Serve on hamburger buns.

recipes.title: Dry Rub
recipes.description: Sucha pasta przyprawowa do żeberek, pieczeni wieprzowej lub innych mięs. Po natarciu mięso odstawia się w lodówce na około godzinę.

steps.text: Combine ingredients in a Zip-Lock bag, shaking thoroughly.
Store in airtight container.

recipes.title: Sheer Khurma
recipes.description: Sheer khurma is a sweet noodle soup served by Muslims in Indian and other South Asian countries to guests during the holy month of Ramadan.

ingredients.text: 100 g dried dates, soaked overnight, pitted and chopped thin
ingredients.name: daktyl suszony
ingredients.note: soaked overnight, pitted and chopped thin

steps.text: Heat the ghee in a large pot over a low heat.
Add the cashew nuts to the ghee, and fry until browned.
Turn off the flame and add the raisins. When the raisins swell up, take both them and the cashews out of the ghee with a spoon and set aside.
Switch the low heat back on and heat the ghee. Add the vermicelli and fry, stirring so it turns golden-brown. Watch it carefully so it does not burn.
Pour in the milk and water. Add the cashews and raisins back into the mixture.
Add the sliced dates and almonds. Cook for about 2 minutes, or until the vermicelli starts to get flexible; then add sugar.
Keep on the low flame for another 2 minutes, then add cream and cardamom powder.
Heat just a little longer and mix well.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Shirmal (Persian Saffron Flatbread)
recipes.description: Shirmal, also sheermal, is a traditional flatbread made in Pakistan and in the Hyderabad region of India, probably from Persian influences.

steps.text: Soak the saffron strands in the warm milk. Set aside.
Sift together flour and salt, then sprinkle in sugar.
Add the melted ghee, and mix with your fingers until evenly distributed.
Add milk a little at a time, and knead the mixture to a dough. When it forms a soft smooth lump, cover with a moist cloth and set aside for 2 hours.
Knead, then set aside again for 2 hours.
Knead again, and divide the dough into 7 parts.
Rub saffron strands in the milk to dissolve them.
Place an inverted heavy iron pan on the lower shelf of oven. Keep the grill on upper rack. Preheat to 250°C (480°F).
On a floured surface, roll each piece of dough into a thick round about 6 inches in diameter. Prick with fork all over.
Slap dough onto the hot pan base, and allow to bake until brown spots appear.
Move sheermal to the grill with tongs. Dip fingers in saffron milk and splash on sheermal. Keep in oven few more seconds.
Remove sheermal, and either immediately serve hot or wrap in slightly moist towel.
Apply butter or ghee on top if desired. Serve with gravies, veggies, curds, pickles or jams.

recipes.title: Shrimp and Cheese Grits
recipes.description: Southern U.S. breakfast of creamy cheddar grits topped with sautéed shrimp, bell peppers and onion.

ingredients.text: ½ large sweet onion, cut into thin strips
ingredients.name: cebula
ingredients.note: large sweet, cut into thin strips

ingredients.text: ½ yellow bell pepper, cut into strips
ingredients.name: papryka żółta

ingredients.text: ½ red bell pepper, cut into strips
ingredients.name: papryka czerwona

ingredients.text: ¼–½ teaspoon hot sauce, or to taste (optional)
ingredients.name: sos ostry

steps.text: Fry bacon until crisp, remove and set aside.
Sauté onions, garlic, and peppers in bacon grease, add lime juice and hot sauce and set aside.
Prepare grits per the directions on box. Add cheese and butter when done cooking to allow for them to melt, then set aside.
Stir when done melting.
Sauté the shrimp until they turn pink, about 2–3 minutes.
Place the grits and cheese in large serving container and place the shrimp down the center of the container.

recipes.title: Chukauni (Nepalese Potato Salad)
recipes.description: Chukauni is a potato salad dish from Palpa district in Nepal. It is mainly served with roti, steamed rice or batuk.

ingredients.text: 4 boiled potatoes, peeled and roughly cubed
ingredients.name: ziemniak gotowany

steps.text: Put the boiled potatoes in a bowl.
Add chopped chilies and chilies.
Pour the yoghurt over the potatoes.
Add salt and red chili powder as per your taste.
In a small wok or pan, heat some oil with red chilies and fenugreek seed.
When the seeds turn black, remove the pan from heat.
Add turmeric powder over the oil immediately.
Pour the oil over the potatoes and yoghurt mixture.
Mix the mixture evenly with a ladle or a spoon.

recipes.title: Okpo Ogede (Plantain Moi-Moi)
recipes.description: Nigerian dish of overripe plantains, also known as plantain moi-moi.

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon palm oil or to taste
ingredients.name: olej palmowy

steps.text: Blend the plantains, plantain flour, onion, and crayfish together with a little water.
Transfer the mixture to a bowl, then mix in salt and palm oil.
Divide the mixture between molds, such as ramekins or aluminum pouches.
Place the filled molds in a steamer basket over boiling water. Cook until set.
Serve with custard, oatmeal, and/or cooked ground corn (akamu).

recipes.title: Strawberry Shortcut Cake
recipes.description: A moist 1970s-style cake in which the syrupy strawberry mixture sits on top and soaks through the batter as it bakes.

ingredients.text: 2 cups (20 oz) frozen, sliced strawberries in syrup, completely thawed
ingredients.name: truskawki
ingredients.note: frozen, sliced, in syrup, completely thawed (20 oz)

ingredients.text: 1 pkg (3 oz) strawberry jello powder (known as jelly outside of North America)
ingredients.name: galaretka truskawkowa w proszku
ingredients.note: strawberry, 3 oz; known as jelly outside of North America

steps.text: Generously grease the bottom of a 13x9-inch cake pan.
Sprinkle marshmallows evenly over bottom of pan.
Thoroughly combine completely thawed strawberries and syrup with dry jello; set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, combine remaining ingredients. Mix at low speed until moistened; beat 3 minutes at medium speed, scraping sides of bowl occasionally.
