recipes.description: Fresh salsa made from tomatoes, jalapeño, onion, garlic and cilantro.

ingredients.text: 4 jalapeño chilis, sliced in half, seeded, and veined
ingredients.name: papryczka jalapeño
ingredients.note: sliced in half, seeded, and veined

steps.text: Chop the ingredients in order listed.
If using food processor or blender, drop in with the blades running, but avoid liquefying the tomatoes.

recipes.title: Cheese-Stuffed Crust Pizza
recipes.description: Pizza z nadzieniem serowym w brzegach ciasta, z sosem, pepperoni i kiełbasą.

ingredients.text: 7 ea. 1-inch (2.5 cm) pieces of string cheese
ingredients.name: ser sznurowy

steps.text: Preheat oven to 425°F (220C)
Spray 12-inch (30 cm) pizza pan with cooking spray. Sprinkle lightly with cornmeal, if desired.
Starting in the center, press pizza dough in pan beyond the sides of the pan by an inch.
Fold the hanging edge of the dough back toward the middle, placing the sticks of string cheese in the pouch, all the way around the circle.
Pinch the dough to seal in the cheese.
Bake the crust 8 or 10 minutes, or until the edges are light golden and the dough has started to set.
Remove from oven and spread the sauce over the crust with the back of a spoon.
Scatter on the sauce the pepperoni, sausage, and shredded Italian cheese.
Replace in oven and bake until crust is deeply golden brown and the (topping) cheese is melted.
Cut into 6–8 slices.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Lemon Cream Sauce
recipes.description: Kremowy sos cytrynowy z maślanką z wermutu i bulionu, z dodatkiem ubitej śmietany i ziół.

ingredients.text: 4 oz (1 stick) chilled butter, cut into 8 pieces
ingredients.name: masło

steps.text: Boil the vermouth, chicken stock and lemon juice in a small non-reactive saucepan until reduced to about 2 tablespoons.
Remove from the heat and beat in two pieces of chilled butter.
Set over a very low heat and beat in the rest of the butter, a piece at a time.
Remove from the heat and stir in the whipped cream and chopped herbs.

recipes.title: Hawthorn Tea
recipes.description: Sweetened beverage made from hawthorn, herbs, and lemon juice.

ingredients.text: *1 one small sprig rosemary (just the leaves)
ingredients.name: rozmaryn świeży

ingredients.text: *1 one small sprig sage (just the leaves)
ingredients.name: szałwia świeża

steps.text: Combine the water, tea bag, rosemary, sage, and ginger. Boil briefly, then remove from heat and let steep for 5–10 minutes.
Filter the tea to remove solids, and mix in the sugar and the lemon juice.
Cool and serve.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Muffins
recipes.description: Muffinki z dynią, z cynamonem i olejem roślinnym.

ingredients.text: 1 cup cooked and mashed pumpkin (canned pumpkin can be used as well)
ingredients.name: dynia
ingredients.note: cooked and mashed; canned pumpkin can be used as well

steps.text: Sift flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, and cinnamon into a bowl.
Beat egg; mix in milk, pumpkin, and oil.
Make a well in center of flour mixture; pour in pumpkin mixture all at once.
Stir quickly until flour is just moistened.
Fill greased muffin cups ⅔ full.
Bake at 425°F for 25 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Run spatula around each muffin to loosen; serve immediately.

recipes.title: Beer Batter
recipes.description: A mixture used to coat various foods before deep-frying, such as onion rings, fish, shrimp, chicken, and vegetables.

steps.text: Stir together dry ingredients.
Stir in beer.
Mix together thoroughly.

recipes.title: Homemade Paneer
recipes.description: Paneer is a fresh curd cheese of Indian origin made by curdling milk with an acid and pressing out the water and whey.

steps.text: Bring milk to a boil in a large pan.
Just before the milk starts to boil, add the lemon juice or vinegar to coagulate the milk.
Pour the coagulated milk through a cheese cloth to discard most of the water within.
Press the water out firmly and place a weight on top of the paneer.
Allow to rest and harden for 2–3 hours in the refrigerator.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock
Recipes using beef broth and stock
Recipes using vegetable broth and stock

recipes.title: Rice and Turnip Minestrone
recipes.description: An Italian soup of turnips, crushed tomatoes and white rice simmered in stock.

ingredients.text: 4 cups chicken, beef, or vegetable stock, brought to a boil
ingredients.name: bulion
ingredients.note: chicken, beef, or vegetable stock, brought to a boil

steps.text: Arrange the turnip slices on a rack over a cookie sheet, sprinkle with salt, cover with a dish and let stand for about 2 hours until the water has run out of them.
Put the slices in a frying pan and fry them slightly in butter until softened.
Add the gravy and tomatoes and cook for a few minutes, then pour the mixture into the boiling stock.
Boil for 30 minutes. Serve hot.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Meatballs with Honey Lime Sauce
recipes.description: Pan-fried beef meatballs finished in a honey and lime sauce made from the pan deglazed with chicken broth.

steps.text: Combine beef, salt, pepper, red pepper flakes, ¼ cup breadcrumbs, rosemary, thyme, and egg.
Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Shape into 1-ounce balls and dredge meatballs in remaining breadcrumbs.
Melt butter in your largest sauté pan over low heat.
Raise the heat to medium. Place balls in skillet, working in batches if needed. Cook until well-browned with an internal temperature of 160 °F.
Place meatballs in a 200°F oven to keep warm.
Deglaze pan with broth. Add honey and lime juice, and boil until reduced by ¼.
Return meatballs to pan and toss to coat.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Chipotle Lime Tortilla Chips
recipes.description: Chipsy tortilla z limonką i sosem chipotle, smażone we frytkownicy lub na głębokim oleju.

ingredients.text: 10 corn tortillas, each cut into 10 wedges
ingredients.name: tortilla kukurydziana

steps.text: Combine hot sauce, salt, and lime juice in a large dish. Add tortillas and soak for 2 hours.
Remove to a cooling rack and let dry for 2 hours.
Deep fry at 375°F until pieces float and are lightly browned around edges. Drain on a cooling rack set above a baking pan. Serve.

recipes.title: Beef Skewers with Baguette Slices
recipes.description: Easy beef skewers, usually served as a treat when friends and family get together, with baguette slices and fresh tomato.

ingredients.text: 800 grams beef, cut into medium sizes
ingredients.name: wołowina

steps.text: Soak the old bread in lukewarm water. Squeeze well to remove excess liquid.
Halve the chili peppers lengthwise. Remove the seeds and chop the peppers finely.
Heat a little oil in a pan, and add the shallots and garlic. Cook until translucent.
Add the parsley and chili pepper. Mix together and remove from the heat.
Combine the cooked mixture with the meat, then mix with the egg and bread. Season with salt and cayenne pepper to taste.
Form small oblong balls of the mixture and thread on wooden skewers.
Brush with the remaining oil and cook on a hot grill, turning frequently until golden brown on all sides.
Rinse the medium size tomatoes and remove any stems inside.
Cut the baguette along its length into 8–10 cm pieces.
Serve the skewers with the bread and tomato.

recipes.title: Khichdi (South Asian Rice and Lentils)
recipes.description: A popular dish from the Indian state of Gujarat, often served as dinner.

ingredients.text: 1 teacup dal (e.g. moong dhal, arhar dal or masoor dal or combination thereof)
ingredients.name: soczewica
ingredients.note: e.g. moong dhal, arhar dal or masoor dal or combination thereof

steps.text: Wash rice and lentils and soak them for 10–15 minutes in water.
Add salt and turmeric powder.
Pressure cook with 3–4 cups of water.
After the first whistle, reduce the heat and cook for 4–5 more minutes.
Allow to cool. Serve with ghee or buttermilk.

recipes.title: Caramelized Sweet and Sour Onion Marmalade
recipes.description: Sweet and sour onion marmalade cooked slowly in oil with sugar and balsamic vinegar.

ingredients.text: 4 large yellow or white onions, sliced into thin strips
ingredients.name: cebula
ingredients.note: large yellow or white, sliced into thin strips

ingredients.text: ⅛ teaspoon coarse ground black pepper
ingredients.name: pieprz czarny mielony

steps.text: Heat oil in a large frying pan over medium heat.
Add onions, and sauté, stirring, for about 15 minutes, or until they begin to brown.
Do not cook over high heat, as the outside of the onions will char too quickly before the insides have softened and sweetened.
When onions have softened and turned a light golden brown, add sugar.
Continue stirring until sugar melts and begins to bubble.
As the onions turn a richer brown, clear a space in the center of the pan.
Pour balsamic vinegar directly onto the hot pan, then stir it into onions.
When vinegar has reduced, leaving a syrupy coating on the onions, turn off the heat.
Stir in salt and pepper, and allow onions to cool.

recipes.title: Hilda Rolls
recipes.description: German sandwich cookies filled with jam, very similar to Linzer cookies.

steps.text: Knead the flour, butter, sugar, vanilla sugar, and egg into a dough. Chill for a while.
Roll out the dough to about ¼ cm thick.
Cut round cookies out of the dough. For half the cookies, cut a small shape out of the middle—these will be the tops.
Place the cookies on a greased tray and bake at 150°C for about 20 minutes. Let cool.
Combine the powdered sugar and water to make a smooth icing. Carefully dip the top cookies in the icing to coat one face.
Spread some jam on the bottom layer cookies. Top with the iced cutout cookies.

recipes.title: Bassi-Salté (Senegalese Couscous with Meat and Vegetables)
recipes.description: Senegalese couscous served with meat, vegetables, kidney beans and a thick sauce with raisins.

ingredients.text: 500 g meat, cut into sizeable pieces
ingredients.name: mięso

ingredients.text: 150 g cassava root, peeled and diced
ingredients.name: maniok

steps.text: Bring 500 ml water to a boil, then pour it over the couscous in a bowl. Cover and let rest.
Heat the oil in a pan. Add the meat, and fry until golden brown.
Add the tomato, onions, salt, and tomato paste. Stir well.
Add 1 liter of water to the pot, and bring to a boil.
Add the cassava, carrots, chile pepper, and garlic. Season with black pepper. Cook over low heat, aiming to make a sauce with a consistent thickness.
Briskly boil the kidney beans until soft, then drain them.
Stir the raisins into the sauce. Season to taste with salt.
Fluff the couscous. Serve the couscous, beans, and sauce together.

recipes.title: Pasta and Bean Soup (Pasta fagioli)
recipes.description: A classic Italian peasant soup of pasta and borlotti beans in a tomato broth, finished with parsley and cream.

ingredients.text: 1 large dash of premium olive oil
ingredients.name: oliwa z oliwek

ingredients.text: 5 cloves of garlic, peeled and chopped
ingredients.name: czosnek

ingredients.text: 4 very red tomatoes, chopped finely or one tin (235 g) chopped tomatoes
ingredients.name: pomidor
ingredients.note: very red, chopped finely, or one tin (235 g) chopped tomatoes

ingredients.text: 3 large squeezes of Italian tomato purée
ingredients.name: koncentrat pomidorowy

ingredients.text: 1 sprig of rosemary about 3 inches long
ingredients.name: rozmaryn świeży

ingredients.text: 1 large pinch of freshly ground pepper
ingredients.name: pieprz czarny mielony

ingredients.text: 5 handfuls of pasta shells or penne
ingredients.name: makaron pszenny

steps.text: Heat the olive oil in the pan, add the chopped garlic and onions, and fry gently for about 3 minutes until translucent but not coloured.
Add the cayenne pepper and mix well in the pan.
Add the glass of white wine and allow to evaporate slightly.
Add the water, the stock cubes, the tomato paste, pepper, salt, pasta, and the 2 tins of beans, and allow to simmer gently for as long as the pasta needs to cook (see packet), stirring occasionally.
Once the pasta is al dente, stop the cooking process, add the chopped parsley and the cream, and stir in well.
Add the rosemary sprig, and allow the whole thing to infuse for about 2 hours.

recipes.title: Seasoned Salt I
recipes.description: A simple all-purpose seasoned salt blend made by combining salt with garlic powder, paprika, celery seed, dehydrated lemon peel, rosemary and parsley.

ingredients.text: ¼ cup (30 g) dehydrated lemon peel
ingredients.name: skórka cytrynowa suszona

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in an airtight container.
Stored in a cool dark place, this will keep indefinitely.

recipes.title: Biscuits III
recipes.description: Very thin butter biscuits adapted from Mrs. Beeton's Book of Household Management.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 220 C.
Grease a baking pan.
Beat the egg and milk together in a bowl.
Mix the other ingredients into the egg mixture to form a soft dough.
Roll out the dough to 5 mm and cut out into very thin biscuits with a round cookie cutter.
Place the biscuits on the baking pan.
Bake for 6 minutes until golden.
Take the biscuits out of the oven and leave them to cool.

recipes.title: Asida bil zibda (libijski pudding z semoliny)
recipes.description: Tradycyjny libijski deser z semoliny, masła, mleka i cukru, gładki i kremowy, podawany na specjalne okazje.

steps.text: In a large pot or saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the semolina to the pot and cook, stirring continuously, for about 10 minutes, or until it turns golden brown and gives off a nutty aroma.
Reduce the heat to low and add the sugar and ground cardamom to the pot. Mix well to combine.
Gradually pour in the milk while stirring constantly to prevent lumps from forming.
Continue to cook the mixture, stirring continuously, for about 10–15 minutes, or until it thickens and pulls away from the sides of the pot. The consistency should be smooth and creamy.
Remove the pot from the heat and cool slightly.
To serve, transfer the asida bil zibda to individual serving bowls or a large platter. Smooth the surface with the back of a spoon or a spatula.
If desired, sprinkle ground cinnamon and chopped nuts on top for garnish. Serve warm or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Buñuelos (Sweet Fried Pastry)
recipes.description: Buñuelos are a type of Latin-American fried pastry.

steps.text: In a large bowl combine eggs with ¼ cup sugar, and beat until thick and lemon-colored. Add the oil.
Combine 1 ½ cups of the flour, the baking powder, and the salt. Gradually add this to the egg mixture and beat well.
Turn dough out onto a floured board (use remaining ½ cup flour) and knead thoroughly until dough is smooth.
Shape dough into 16 balls. Roll each one into a circle about 5 inches (13 cm) in diameter. Let stand uncovered on waxed paper for about 10 minutes.
Heat oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (175°C). Fry dough circles until golden brown, turning once. Drain on paper towels.
Combine the cinnamon and 1 cup sugar. Sprinkle fried dough with sugar/cinnamon mixture. Store in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Rainbow Jell-O
recipes.description: Multilayered, multiflavored Jell-O alternating opaque and clear layers of five colors, based on a Kraft recipe.

ingredients.text: 5 (or more) packages Jell-O flavored gelatin (4-serving-size each; different flavors and colors)
ingredients.name: galaretka w proszku
ingredients.note: or more; different flavors and colors

ingredients.text: 1 cup (240 g) sour cream or plain or vanilla yogurt
ingredients.name: śmietana 18%
ingredients.note: 240 g; sour cream or plain or vanilla yogurt

steps.text: Select one or more molds. The total volume will be approximately 8 cups; a ring mold, 2–3 glass containers (as pictured), or any other assortment should work; for best results, the container should be at least 3 in (10 cm) deep, allowing for about ten 1cm-thick layers.
Stir 1¼ cups boiling water and one package gelatin in a small bowl for at least 2 minutes, until completely dissolved. In practice, it may not quite completely dissolve.
Pour ¾ cups dissolved gelatin into the mold(s).
Refrigerate for about 15 minutes, until the gelatin sets but is not yet firm: the gelatin should stick to your finger when you touch it. The aim is for the layers to stick, but not mix.
Refrigerate the remaining gelatin for about 5 minutes, until it is slightly thickened (to the consistency of unbeaten egg white).
Gradually stir 3 tablespoons sour cream or yogurt into the remaining, thickened gelatin.
Spoon the gelatin on top of the previous layer (gently, so as to maintain a smooth surface).
Refrigerate again for about 15 minutes.
Repeat the above layering process for each of the remaining flavors. Be sure to cool adequately between layers to prevent melting and mixing.
Refrigerate for about 2 hours, until firm.

Remove the gelatin from the mold and place it (probably upside down) on a plate or smooth cutting board. Store refrigerated under saran wrap or aluminum foil. For best effect, serve sliced perpendicular to the layers, so each slice (approximately 1 cm thick) displays the full rainbow.

recipes.title: Mishkaki (East African Meat Skewers)
recipes.description: East African beef skewers marinated in vinegar, oil and spices, then grilled.

steps.text: Whisk together the vinegar, oil, water, thyme, spices, ginger paste, and garlic paste to make a marinade.
Add the meat and toss well, then transfer everything to a large ziplock bag.
Seal the bag and marinate in the refrigerator for 24–48 hours.
Take the meat out of the refrigerator, and give it at least an hour to come to room temperature.
Thread the meat on the skewers.
Preheat a charcoal grill for some time.
Grease the grill grate, and place the skewers on the grate.
Cook until medium-done (internal temperature of 65°C / 145°F).
Serve hot with fresh coriander.

recipes.title: Crab Meat Canapé
recipes.description: Danie na przyjęcie lub specjalną okazję, duże jak na lunch, ale może też służyć jako przystawka. Dania z Galatoire's Restaurant na Bourbon Street w Nowym Orleanie.

ingredients.text: 1 lb (about 0.5 kg) jumbo or regular-size fresh white lump crab meat (from the body only, not the claws)
ingredients.name: mięso krabowe
ingredients.note: about 0.5 kg, fresh white lump, from the body only

steps.text: Pick over crabmeat carefully with your fingers to assure the absence of crab shell.
Sauté green onions in butter over medium heat until soft, do not allow onions to brown.
Add white lumpfish crab meat, then fold in béchamel sauce. When mixture begins to simmer, remove from heat and fold in beaten egg yolks.
Refrigerate mixture for 10 minutes in order to form canapés, or let stay in refrigerator overnight until ready to use.
Preheat oven to 350 °F (190 °C).
Combine breadcrumbs and Parmesan cheese in a mixing bowl.
Trim the ends of the toast. Place trimmed toast on a baking sheet and spoon refrigerated crabmeat mixture onto toast using an ice-cream scoop.
Sprinkle canapés with breadcrumbs and Parmesan cheese mixture. Dot each canapé with soft butter.
Bake canapés for 20 minutes.
Garnish each serving with flat-leaf parsley and a wedge of lemon.

recipes.title: Coconut Rice (Nasi Lemak)
recipes.description: Malaysian coconut rice cooked in coconut milk with optional pandan and ginger.

ingredients.text: 1–2 pandan leaves tied in a knot (optional)
ingredients.name: liść pandanu

steps.text: Rinse the rice and set it aside.
Meanwhile put the coconut milk on the stove, and add the salt.
Add the rice, pandan leaves, and ginger.
Let it simmer until the coconut milk evaporates.
Cover it with lid and let it sit for about 15 minutes until it is well cooked.

recipes.title: Spice Rubbed Grilled Chicken Breast
recipes.description: Grillowana pierś z kurczaka w mieszance przypraw z musztardą Dijon.

steps.text: Combine paprikas, salt, pepper, rosemary, cayenne, cinnamon, and lemon peel. Set aside.
Rub mustard all over chicken. Apply seasoning mixture, and press lightly to aid adhesion.
Grill on a preheated charcoal grill, turning often, until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Remove and let rest for 3 minutes. Serve.

categories: Recipes using fish broth and stock
Recipes using vegetable broth and stock

recipes.title: Boule-Di (Senegalese Fish and Rice)
recipes.description: Boule-di, also known as boule (pronounced "boo-lay"), is a traditional West African dish that originated in Senegal. It is a hearty and flavorful one-pot meal made with a combination of fish, vegetables, and rice.

ingredients.text: 2 pounds firm white fish fillets (such as cod or tilapia)
ingredients.name: filet z ryby białej
ingredients.note: firm white fish fillets (such as cod or tilapia)

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper (adjust to your preferred level of spiciness)
ingredients.name: pieprz cayenne
ingredients.note: ground; adjust to your preferred level of spiciness

ingredients.text: Chopped fresh parsley or cilantro (for garnish)
ingredients.name: natka pietruszki

steps.text: Rinse the fish fillets under cold water and pat them dry with paper towels.
Cut the fish into medium-sized chunks and set aside.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and minced garlic, and sauté until they turn translucent and fragrant.
Add the diced tomatoes, red and green bell peppers, carrots, and frozen okra to the pot. Stir well to combine with the onions and garlic.
Add the tomato paste, paprika, cayenne pepper, black pepper, dried thyme, and salt to the pot. Stir everything together to evenly distribute the spices and coat the vegetables.
Gently place the fish chunks on top of the vegetable mixture. Then add the rice, spreading it evenly over the fish and vegetables.
Carefully pour the fish or vegetable broth into the pot, making sure it covers the fish and rice mixture. The liquid should be about 1 inch above the ingredients.
Bring the mixture to a boil over medium-high heat. Once it starts boiling, reduce the heat to low and cover the pot with a lid.
Allow to simmer for about 20–25 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the fish is cooked through.
Remove the pot from heat and let it sit for a few minutes with the lid on. This allows the flavors to meld together.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.

recipes.title: Puri (Indian Fried Flatbread)
recipes.description: Puri, also spelled poori, is a fried Indian bread.

ingredients.text: 1 tbsp vegetable oil for the dough
ingredients.name: olej roślinny

ingredients.text: About 500 ml (1 pint) vegetable oil for deep frying
ingredients.name: olej roślinny

steps.text: Put all the dry ingredients into a bowl.
Add salt and drizzle the 1 tbsp oil over top. Mix well.
Gradually mix in enough water to get a stiff dough.
Knead the dough well for a few minutes.
Cover the dough and leave to rest for about half an hour.
Pour the oil for deep frying in a wok or other deep pan. Heat the oil.
Meanwhile, divide the dough into 8 small balls and roll each into a small circle (about 3 in / 7.5 cm in diameter). You can use a bit of hot oil to roll the dough so it will not stick to the surface.

Check if the oil is hot enough—when you put a tiny piece of dough in the oil it should immediately rise to the surface. When the oil is ready, lay the flattened dough over the oil, press the top slightly with the slotted spoon until it inflates itself, and turn to other side. Adjust the flame as necessary.
Remove the puri from the oil after it turns golden brown and place on a wire rack or kitchen paper towel for excess oil to drain.

recipes.title: Vanilla Coconut Caramel
recipes.description: Vegan caramel sauce made from sugar, corn or cane syrup, coconut milk and margarine, flavored with vanilla.

ingredients.text: 1 cup light corn syrup or cane syrup
ingredients.name: syrop kukurydziany
ingredients.note: light corn syrup or cane syrup

steps.text: Boil sugar, corn syrup, margarine, and coconut milk to firm-ball stage (245°F).
Remove from heat and add vanilla.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Ponche de Crème
recipes.description: A seasonal Christmas beverage, usually enjoyed as a cocktail, similar to eggnog.

ingredients.text: 1½ cans (14 oz / 380 g) sweetened condensed milk, or to taste
ingredients.name: mleko skondensowane słodzone

ingredients.text: ½ cup (120 ml) rum or brandy, or to taste
ingredients.name: rum
ingredients.note: 120 ml, or brandy, or to taste

steps.text: Beat eggs and lime peel until light and fluffy.
Add evaporated milk.
Sweeten to taste with condensed milk.
Add bitters, grated nutmeg and rum according to taste.
Remove lime peel and serve over crushed ice.

recipes.title: Kitfo (Ethiopian Minced Raw Meat)
recipes.description: Kitfo is a traditional Ethiopian dish made with minced raw meat that is highly seasoned and spiced. It is typically made with beef and often served with injera.

ingredients.text: 500 grams (1 lb) lean beef, finely minced
ingredients.name: wołowina mielona chuda

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons clarified butter or olive oil
ingredients.name: masło klarowane

ingredients.text: Collard greens, blanched and chopped, for serving (optional)
ingredients.name: jarmuż

steps.text: Place the minced beef in a large bowl.
In a separate small bowl, combine the mitmita spice blend, salt, black pepper, and berbere spice blend.
Sprinkle the spice mixture over the minced beef. Mix well with a spoon or spatula to evenly distribute the spices throughout the meat.
Heat the clarified butter or olive oil in a small skillet over low heat until melted.
If using niter qibe, add it to the skillet and let it melt with the clarified butter or olive oil.
Pour the melted butter or oil over the seasoned minced beef. Mix thoroughly until all the ingredients are well combined.
Let the kitfo marinate in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour to allow the flavors to meld and develop.
To serve, place the kitfo on a plate and shape it into a mound or individual portions.
Accompany the kitfo with injera, collard greens, and crumbled ayib on the side.
To eat, tear off a piece of injera, scoop a small portion of kitfo onto it, and wrap it before taking a bite.

images: Fusion Cuisine - HARISSA CHICKEN LAYERED SOFIYANI DUM BIRYANI - Bangalore - Karnataka - IMG 0591.jpg
categories: Recipes using chile paste and sauce
Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Harissa bil Djaj (Libyan Chicken Harissa)
recipes.description: A flavorful and aromatic Libyan chicken dish with tender chicken pieces simmered in a rich, spicy tomato sauce.

ingredients.text: ½ teaspoon ground cayenne pepper (adjust according to spice preference)
ingredients.name: pieprz cayenne

steps.text: In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic. Sauté until the onion becomes translucent and fragrant.
Add the chicken pieces to the pot and brown them on all sides.
Stir in the diced tomatoes, tomato paste, harissa paste, cumin, paprika, cayenne pepper, coriander, caraway seeds, salt, and pepper. Mix well to coat the chicken with the spices.
Pour in the water or chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot with a lid, and let simmer until the chicken is tender and cooked through.
Taste and adjust the seasoning if needed.
Serve hot, garnished with freshly chopped parsley. Accompany with bread or couscous to soak up the flavorful sauce.

recipes.title: Stuffed Zucchini
recipes.description: Stuffed zucchini can be served as an appetizer or as a side dish.

ingredients.text: 10 oz (280 g) chopped frozen spinach, thawed and drained
ingredients.name: szpinak mrożony

ingredients.text: 8–10 oz (220–280 g) button mushrooms (canned or fresh), finely chopped
ingredients.name: pieczarka
ingredients.note: 8–10 oz (220–280 g), canned or fresh, finely chopped

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C).
Trim ends of zucchini and boil, covered, for 5 minutes. Drain and cover.
Cut in half lengthwise.
Scoop out pulp, leaving a ¼ inch (0.75 cm) shell. Chop the removed pulp.
Heat olive oil in sauté pan.
Sauté zucchini pulp, spinach, onions, and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add mushrooms and sauté another 3 minutes.
Remove from heat, add eggs, salt, and pepper, and mix well.
Spoon filling into shells.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Bake for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Fanke (Hausa Puff Puff)
recipes.description: Nigerian fritter made with wheat flour or semovita, commonly eaten in the Northern part of Nigeria, especially among the Hausa people.

steps.text: Sift the flour into a clean bowl. Mix in the yeast, sugar, and baking powder.
Stir in the warm water and vanilla to make a thick batter.
Cover the bowl, and let rise for about 1 hour.
Heat enough oil in a pan for deep-frying. Shape the batter into balls, and drop them into the hot oil in batches.
Deep fry the fritters until golden brown on all sides.
Remove from the oil and let drain.

recipes.title: Hickory BBQ Rub
recipes.description: This rub is great for spicing up pork ribs cooked indoors, or just general seasoning. It's even good on fried chicken.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in an airtight container with a shaker lid.
Keep in a cool, dark place for up to 2 years.

recipes.title: Barbecue Meatloaf
recipes.description: Meatloaf made from ground beef chuck and sirloin with croutons, vegetables and spices, glazed with barbecue sauce, Worcestershire, Tabasco and molasses.

ingredients.text: 2 tbsp Tabasco or something that tastes like it
ingredients.name: sos ostry w stylu Tabasco
ingredients.note: Tabasco or something that tastes like it

steps.text: Heat oven to 325 °F.
In a food processor bowl, combine croutons, black pepper, cayenne pepper, chili powder, and thyme. Pulse until the mixture is of a fine texture. Place this mixture into a large bowl and set aside.
Combine the onion, carrot, garlic, and red pepper in the food processor bowl. Pulse until the mixture is finely-chopped, but not pureed.
Combine the vegetable mixture, ground sirloin, and ground chuck with the bread crumb mixture.
Season the meat mixture with the salt, and add the egg.
Combine thoroughly, but avoid squeezing the meat.
Pack this mixture into a 10-inch loaf pan to mold the shape of the meatloaf. Onto a parchment paper-lined baking sheet, turn the meatloaf out of the pan onto the center of the tray.
Insert a temperature probe at a 45 degree angle into the top of the meatloaf. Avoid touching the bottom of the tray with the probe. Set the probe for 155°F.
Combine the glaze ingredients. Brush the glaze onto the meatloaf after it has been cooking for about 10 minutes.
Once the meatloaf has reached 155°F, take it out of the oven and let it sit for about 8–10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Lemon Poppy Seed Pancakes
recipes.description: Puszyste naleśniki z nutą cytryny i makiem, z maślanką i mlekiem.

steps.text: Heat a large non-stick skillet or griddle over low heat while preparing ingredients.
Mix flour, sugar, salt, baking powder, and baking soda in medium bowl.
Whisk lemon zest and poppy seeds into dry ingredients.
Microwave buttermilk and milk in a 2-cup Pyrex measuring cup to room temperature, 20 to 30 seconds.
Whisk in egg, butter, and vanilla.
Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients and whisk until just mixed.
Return batter to measuring cup, stirring in a teaspoon or two of water, if necessary, to make a thick, but pourable batter.
Increase heat to medium and generously brush skillet or griddle with oil.
When oil starts to spider, but before it starts to smoke, pour batter, about ¼ cup at a time. Work in batches, if necessary, to avoid overcrowding.
When pancake bottoms are golden brown and tops start to bubble, 2 to 3 minutes, flip pancakes.
Cook until pancakes are golden brown on remaining side.
Repeat, brushing skillet or griddle with oil.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Vegetable Soup
recipes.description: A soup made from vegetables, with bread in the bowl.

ingredients.text: 1 slice of bread, toasted and buttered
ingredients.name: chleb tostowy

steps.text: Boil the onion, turnip, potatoes, carrot, and celery in the water until the vegetables are cooked.
Insert the bread into a bowl. Pour the soup over it.

recipes.title: Thong Yib (Thai Candied Egg Yolks)
recipes.description: Słodki, soczysty tajski deser podawany podczas uroczystości z życzeniami błogosławieństwa.

steps.text: Combine 2 cups of sugar and 2 cups of jasmine water in a saucepan.
Bring to a simmer, and wait until the sugar is dissolved.
Remove from the heat and let cool.
Bring 5 cups of sugar and 4 cups of jasmine water to a simmer in a saucepan. Wait for it to dissolve without stirring.
Separate the egg yolks from egg white.
Whisk the egg yolks constantly for about 3–5 minutes. The more you whisk the egg yolks, the softer the egg. If too soft, it will be hard to crimp once the eggs are cooked.
When the syrup is boiling, remove from the heat.
Immediately use a spoon to pour dollops of egg yolk into the hot syrup. The yolks will spread into circles.
Return the pot to the heat, and keep flipping the egg yolks until completely cooked.
Spoon the cooked yolks into the cooled syrup. Cool slightly, then crimp it into flower-like shape of 3, 4, or 5 petals.
Put the crimped yolks in small bowl and wait for them to cool down completely.
Serve.

recipes.title: Chocolate Sauce
recipes.description: A simple recipe that is a delicious sauce for Éclairs and other desserts.

steps.text: Melt all the ingredients in a saucepan and allow to bubble for a while until the mixture darkens in colour slightly. Be careful not to let the chocolate burn.
Remove from the heat and allow to cool until it thickens.

recipes.title: Churri (Indian Yogurt Herb Sauce)
recipes.description: Indyjski sos z jogurtem i ziołami, z kuminem, miętą, kolendrą, imbirem i zielonym chili.

steps.text: Add cumin seed to a skillet over medium heat, and toast until fragrant. Don't let burn.
Grind the toasted cumin seeds with a mortar.
Grind the mint, coriander leaves, ginger, and chili peppers into a paste.
Add the yoghurt, buttermilk and salt and make sure everything gets mixed up well.
Add the onion and the ground cumin.

recipes.title: Sydney Smith's Salad Dressing
recipes.description: Sydney Smith's salad dressing is a type of salad dressing, popular in the 19th century among American cooks.

steps.text: Pass the potatoes through a sieve or a ricer.
Combine potatoes and remaining ingredients. Mix well.

recipes.title: Granola
recipes.description: Domowa granola z orzechami, migdałami, płatkami owsianymi i suszonymi owocami, pieczona w niskiej temperaturze.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients except the raisins and blueberries.
Spread the mixture on a tray and bake for 1 hour at 250°F, stirring every 10 minutes.
Let cool, then mix in the raisins and blueberries.

recipes.title: Tomatoes with Cheese Stuffing
recipes.description: Stuffed tomatoes with a bread crumb and cheese filling, baked until tender.

steps.text: Select medium-sized tomatoes and hollow out the centers, reserving the pulp.
Mix the crumbs, cheese, salt, pepper, butter, and hot water with the pulp from the centers of the tomatoes.
Fill the tomatoes with this stuffing, place in a pan, and bake in a moderate oven until the tomato can be pierced easily with a fork.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Rice with Tofu and Nuts
recipes.description: Basmati rice cooked with whole spices and bay leaf, then combined with fried tofu, almonds, cashews and raisins.

steps.text: Wash the rice with several changes of cold water. Drain.
Add the water, bay leaf, peppercorns, cinnamon, cloves and salt and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to medium low and cook covered for about 12 minutes until all the water has evaporated and the rice grains are tender yet separate.
Heat the oil in a pan.
Add the tofu and shallow-fry for a few minutes on each side.
Scoop out of the oil and set aside.
To the same oil, add the nuts and the raisins and shallow-fry until the nuts are golden brown and the raisins have plumped up.
Remove from heat.
Turn the rice into a serving bowl and fluff gently with a fork.
Fold in the tofu and the nuts gently and mix well.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Chipotle BBQ Rub
recipes.description: A Southwestern-style spice rub that is great on pork, steak, fish, and chicken.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients and keep in airtight container in cool, dark place.

recipes.title: Khao Pad (Thai Fried Rice)
recipes.description: Khao pad is Thai fried rice.

ingredients.text: 1 cup cooked meat (e.g. shrimp, pork, chicken, etc.)
ingredients.name: mięso
ingredients.note: cooked; e.g. shrimp, pork, chicken, etc.

steps.text: Heat up a frying pan or wok and add the oil, then the minced garlic. Stir fry until fragrant.
Add the eggs, and stir fry the eggs until cooked.
Add the rice and stir fry.
Season with fish sauce, soy sauce, and sugar, then continue frying until the rice is crumbly.
Add meat, pepper, and spring onions. Stir again until heated through, then transfer to a serving dish.

recipes.title: Chicken Pot Pie I
recipes.description: Placek z kurczakiem i warzywami w kremowym sosie, zapiekany w cieście.

steps.text: Mix soup, vegetables, and chicken in a large bowl.
Pour mixture into one of the pie crusts.
Cover with other pie crust and press around edges to seal.
Cut several small slits in top of pie.
Bake at 375 °F for 30–40 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Chili with Meat
recipes.description: A hearty chili made with ground meat, tomato sauce, three kinds of beans and diced tomatoes, seasoned with cumin, chili powder and black pepper.

ingredients.text: 2 lb ground meat (e.g. beef, pork, turkey)
ingredients.name: mięso mielone

steps.text: Cook the ground meat in a large pot on medium-high heat.
Drain off and discard the fat.
Add all remaining ingredients in order and bring to a boil.
Reduce to low heat and simmer for 2 to 3 hours, stir every 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Pie Floater
recipes.description: The pie floater is a meal consisting of a meat pie served upside down in a dish of pea soup. It is common in South Australia.

steps.text: Heat the pie in an oven.
A microwave will not work as well, as the pie pastry will not be crisp.
Heat the pea soup separately.
Place the pie upside down in the dish.
Pour the pea soup around it until the dish is full.

recipes.title: Scottish Wheat Bannock Bread
recipes.description: A recipe from Nova Scotia that is called both Scottish bannock and Irish soda bread.

ingredients.text: ½ cup (120 ml) white granulated sugar
ingredients.name: cukier

ingredients.text: 4 tbsp butter, cut into pea-sized cubes
ingredients.name: masło

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C).
Combine dry ingredients. Rub in butter until crumbly.
Mix in buttermilk to make a soft, workable dough. Knead dough briefly.
Make dough into a disc about 3 inches thick. Cut an X shape in dough with a knife (1 cm or so deep). Transfer to an oiled or parchment-lined baking sheet.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 50–70 minutes (depending on your oven) until a skewer stuck in comes out with no "gooeyness" on it.
Let cool 5–10 minutes after taking from the oven, then break apart with your hands into serving-sized chunks.

recipes.title: Chunky Guacamole
recipes.description: Chunky guacamole made from diced ripe avocados, lime juice and fresh salsa.

steps.text: Peel and dice avocados.
Sprinkle the avocados with lime juice.
Add salsa fresca, and toss to mix.

recipes.title: Stewed Vegan Maki
recipes.description: A non-traditional vegan sushi roll filled with stewed carrot, onion, celery and daikon in miso sauce.

ingredients.text: ¼ cup (60 ml) thinly-julienned daikon radish
ingredients.name: rzodkiew daikon

steps.text: In a wok or saucepan, combine vegetables and sake. Bring to a simmer and let cook until most of the sake is gone, stirring often.
Add the water and miso, bring this to a simmer, and let it cook until the vegetables are soft (but not mushy), stirring often.
Remove the vegetables from the pan, and reduce the remaining liquid to a thick sauce consistency.
Pour the sauce over the vegetables and mix thoroughly. Let cool, then mix in vinegar.
Evenly spread rice over nori, dab half the wasabi across each, then place the vegetable mix across this. Roll tightly.

recipes.title: Yubeshi (Japanese Walnut Mochi Confection)
recipes.description: A Japanese confection of brown sugar and glutinous rice flour dough with walnuts, dusted with starch and cut into pieces.

ingredients.text: Cornstarch or potato starch, as needed
ingredients.name: mąka ziemniaczana

steps.text: Generously dust a cookie sheet with cornstarch.
Combine the sugar, soy sauce, and water in a saucepan. Simmer until the sugar fully dissolves, stirring so as not to burn.
Add the rice flour, and stir well to form a cohesive dough.
Transfer the dough to a microwave-safe container. Heat it in the microwave for 30–40 seconds, then take it out and mix well. Repeat this process until it is thoroughly brown.
Mix the walnuts into the dough.
Pat the dough evenly onto the prepared cookie sheet in a layer about 5 cm (2 in) thick. If it's too hot, let it cool a bit first.
Dust the top of the dough with additional starch. Let cool fully.
Cut the confection into pieces.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock
Recipes using vegetable broth and stock

recipes.title: Tchari (Jollof Rice)
recipes.description: Tchari, also known as jollof rice, is a popular West African one-pot rice dish cooked in a rich tomato-based sauce with spices and vegetables.

ingredients.text: 2–3 cups chicken or vegetable broth (or water)
ingredients.name: bulion drobiowy
ingredients.note: 2-3, chicken or vegetable broth or water

ingredients.text: 1 cup frozen mixed vegetables (e.g. peas, carrots, corn)
ingredients.name: warzywa mieszane mrożone

steps.text: Heat the vegetable oil in the large pot over medium heat. Add the chopped onions and sauté until they become translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the pot, and cook for about 1 minute until fragrant.

Stir in the blended or finely chopped tomatoes, red and green bell peppers, and blended Scotch bonnet peppers. Cook the mixture for 10–15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens and the oil starts to separate.
Add the thyme, curry powder, paprika, ground nutmeg, and bay leaf to the sauce. Stir well to ensure the spices are evenly distributed.
Rinse the rice thoroughly in cold water until the water runs clear. Drain the excess water.
Add the rice to the pot with the sauce, stirring gently to coat the rice with the flavorful mixture.
Pour in the chicken or vegetable broth (or water) into the pot. The liquid level should be about 1 inch above the rice. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low. Cover the pot with the lid, ensuring it is tightly sealed to trap steam inside.

Let the rice simmer for about 20–25 minutes or until the rice is tender and fully cooked. Avoid opening the lid too frequently, as this may interfere with the cooking process. If the liquid is absorbed before the rice is fully cooked, add a little more water or broth as needed.
Once the rice is cooked, add the frozen mixed vegetables to the pot. Stir them gently into the rice.
Optionally, add a tablespoon of butter for extra richness. Stir it into the rice until it melts.
Remove the pot from the heat and let it sit, covered, for a few minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Fluff the rice with a fork and serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.

categories: Recipes using beef broth and stock

recipes.title: Braised Shortribs
recipes.description: Shortribs cooked in beef broth with aromatic herbs and vegetables makes a fork-tender, flavorful entrée.

ingredients.text: 2 ½ pounds (1.35 kg) English cut beef shortribs
ingredients.name: żeberka wołowe

ingredients.text: 4 carrots, peeled and cut into 1-inch (2.5 cm) slices
ingredients.name: marchew

ingredients.text: 3 red-skinned potatoes, cut into 2-inch (5 cm) cubes
ingredients.name: ziemniak czerwony

steps.text: Heat bacon fat in a 6-quart (6-liter) cast iron Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Season shortribs with salt and freshly ground black pepper, then dredge in flour.
Place 1 or 2 shortribs in the pot at one time and cook until browned on all sides. Repeat until all shortribs have been browned. Keep warm.
If there is not enough fat in the pan to coat the bottom, add olive oil.
Add ¼ of the vegetables at a time and sauté until browned around the edges. Repeat until all vegetables have been sautéed.
Add remaining ingredients and browned shortribs.
Place into a cold oven and then set for 250°F (120°C). Cook 5 ½ hours.
Move to serving bowls and sprinkle each serving with finely chopped rosemary. Serve warm.

categories: Recipes using vegetable broth and stock

recipes.title: Brown Gravy
recipes.description: Basic brown gravy similar to what you get from a pouch of supermarket instant gravy.

ingredients.text: 1½ cup vegetable stock (or beef or mushroom stock)
ingredients.name: bulion mięsno-warzywny

steps.text: Sauté the onion in the oil over medium heat with salt and pepper, until the onion begins to turn golden brown.
Add the flour and stir. A roux should form; cook it for several minutes until it starts to darken.
Add the stock and stir until smooth.
Add the yeast extract—as the gravy warms it will become incorporated.
Taste and season if necessary. When the gravy simmers, it is done.
Strain into a gravy boat or other serving container and allow to cool a few minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Sudanese Ful Medames
recipes.description: Ful medames is a traditional Sudanese dish made from cooked fava beans, commonly enjoyed for breakfast or as a light meal. The beans are seasoned with olive oil, lemon juice, garlic and spices.

ingredients.text: Optional toppings: chopped parsley, diced tomatoes, chopped onions, hard-boiled eggs, feta cheese
ingredients.name: dodatki opcjonalne

steps.text: Rinse the dried fava beans under cold water, place them in a large pot, add 4 cups of water and let them soak overnight, or for at least 8 hours.
Drain the soaked fava beans, rinse them under cold water, return them to the pot and add 4 cups of fresh water.
Bring the water to a boil over medium-high heat, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for about 1–1½ hours until tender, stirring occasionally and skimming off any foam.

Drain the tender beans in a colander or strainer and transfer them to a mixing bowl. Add minced garlic, extra-virgin olive oil, lemon juice, ground cumin, ground coriander and salt, and mix until the beans are evenly coated.
For a smoother consistency, lightly mash some of the beans with a fork or potato masher (optional).

Transfer the seasoned ful medames to a serving dish. Serve warm or at room temperature, with optional toppings such as chopped parsley, diced tomatoes, chopped onions, hard-boiled eggs or crumbled feta cheese.

recipes.title: Grilled Filet Mignon with a Cognac Reduction
recipes.description: One of the best, tenderest cuts of beef, filet mignon is pure luxury. Here, we coat it with coarsely ground black pepper and grill it to perfect medium rare.

steps.text: Sprinkle filet mignons with kosher salt on both sides.
Coat filet mignons with mustard on both sides and press into the black pepper, pressing lightly to help adhesion.
Grill steaks over high heat for 1 minute per side, then place on a new medium burner until interior temperature reaches 140°F (60°C). Remove and keep warm.
Place cognac in a small saucepan, and boil over high heat until reduced by ⅓.
Serve filet mignons with cognac reduction drizzled on top.

recipes.title: Mild Salty Lassi
recipes.description: Mild, salty yogurt drink flavored with roasted cumin, lime or lemon juice and optional mint and cayenne.

ingredients.text: ¼ teaspoon mint (finely crumbled, dried; optional)
ingredients.name: mięta suszona

steps.text: Dry-roast cumin seeds by cooking them over low heat in a small pan until you can smell the seasoning (about 2–3 minutes).
Cool and grind.
In blender, blend cumin seed powder with yoghurt, milk, lemon juice, salt, and ice cubes.
Serve chilled, optionally garnished with crumbled mint and a small pinch of cayenne.

recipes.title: Zambian Beef Stew
recipes.description: Zambian beef stew is a hearty and comforting dish that brings together tender beef and a flavorful blend of vegetables and spices. It is enjoyed with nshima or rice.

ingredients.text: 1 pound beef, cut into bite-sized pieces
ingredients.name: wołowina

steps.text: In a large pot, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the finely chopped onion and minced garlic to the pot. Sauté until the onions are soft and translucent.
Add the bite-sized beef pieces to the pot and brown them on all sides.
Pour in the beef broth or water and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Add the diced carrot, potato, tomato, green bell pepper, and red bell pepper to the pot. Stir well to combine with the other ingredients.
Season the stew with paprika, cayenne pepper, ground cumin, ground coriander, and salt to taste. Adjust the seasoning according to your preference.
Let the stew simmer for about 1–1.5 hours or until the beef is tender and fully cooked. Stir occasionally during cooking to prevent sticking and to ensure even cooking of the beef and vegetables.
Remove the pot from the heat and let the stew rest for a few minutes before serving.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Whiskey Barbecue Sauce
recipes.description: A barbecue sauce made with whiskey, ketchup, Worcestershire sauce, soy sauce, cider vinegar and chicken broth, boiled and then refrigerated.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan.
Bring to a boil over high heat and cook, stirring, for 10 minutes.
Refrigerate in a nonreactive container for up to 2 months.

recipes.title: Focaccia with Onion Marmalade, Blue Cheese, and Walnuts
recipes.description: Focaccia topped with sweet and sour onion marmalade, blue cheese and walnuts.

ingredients.text: 1½ cups Sweet and Sour Onion Marmalade
ingredients.name: marmolada cebulowa

ingredients.text: ¼ pounds blue cheese, crumbled or cut into ½-inch pieces
ingredients.name: ser pleśniowy
ingredients.note: crumbled or cut into ½-inch pieces

steps.text: Preheat oven to 500°F.
When the focaccia is fully risen and ready to bake, gently spread onion marmalade evenly over surface.
Evenly distribute blue cheese over onion marmalade and scatter walnuts over the top.
Place the sheet pan on the middle shelf of the oven, lower temperature to 450°F, and bake for 20 minutes.
Rotate pan 180 degrees and bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until the dough is golden on the bottom and top.

When the baking is complete, set up a cooling rack inside a sheet pan and immediately remove the focaccia from the pan by using a metal spatula or pastry blade to break all contact with the walls of the pan.
Place the spatula or blade between the focaccia and the parchment or pad and lift the edge up. Then jiggle the focaccia out of the pan onto the cooling rack.
Pour any excess oil from the pan over the top of the focaccia. Let the focaccia cool for at least 20 minutes before slicing and serving.

recipes.title: Ibirayi n'Ibinyomoro (Rwandan Bean Soup with Smoked Beef)
recipes.description: A hearty and flavorful Rwandan soup that combines beans and smoked beef, popular during cold seasons.

ingredients.text: 2 cups dried beans, soaked overnight and drained
ingredients.name: fasola sucha

ingredients.text: 1 pound smoked beef, cut into bite-sized pieces
ingredients.name: wołowina wędzona

ingredients.text: Fresh parsley or cilantro leaves, for garnish (optional)
ingredients.name: natka pietruszki lub kolendra świeża

steps.text: In a large pot, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and minced garlic, and sauté until the onion is translucent and fragrant.
Add the diced tomatoes to the pot and cook for a few minutes until they soften and release their juices.
Add the smoked beef to the pot and cook for about 5 minutes, allowing it to brown slightly.
Add the soaked beans to the pot and stir well to coat them with the onion, tomato, and beef mixture.
Pour enough water into the pot to cover the beans and beef. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and let it simmer for about 1–1.5 hours, or until the beans are tender.
Stir occasionally during cooking and skim off any foam that forms on the surface.
Season the soup with thyme, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Adjust the seasoning according to your preference.
Continue to simmer the soup for another 15–20 minutes to allow the flavors to meld together.
Remove from heat and transfer to serving bowls. Garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro leaves, if desired, before serving.

recipes.title: Sweet Pork Condiment
recipes.description: Sweet pork condiment (Thai: หมูหวาน) is a popular Thai food served with other kinds of foods such as chili paste, fried rice, and hot glutinous rice.

ingredients.text: 350 g (0.77 lb) pork shoulder, neck, or belly
ingredients.name: wieprzowina, łopatka

steps.text: Mix the light soy sauce and sugar together in a bowl. Add pork and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 36–48 hours, in order to maintain the quality and the taste of the pork.
Steam the pork over boiling water for about 20 minutes.
After the steaming is finished, let the pork rest for about 10 minutes.
Slice the pork into pieces.
Put the palm sugar into a pan, and stir it over a low heat until it melts. Simmer until the sugar browns. Add fish sauce and water all together.
Add the pork to the sauce, and mix well to coat.
Simmer the pork in the sauce for about 5–10 minutes, then mix the pork and the sauce together.

recipes.title: Peach, Strawberry and Ice Cream Smoothie
recipes.description: A rich smoothie made with yogurt and vanilla ice cream, plus peaches and strawberries.

ingredients.text: ½ cup (150 g or 5.3 oz) plain yogurt
ingredients.name: jogurt naturalny

ingredients.text: ½ cup (125 ml or 4.2 oz) vanilla ice cream
ingredients.name: lody waniliowe

ingredients.text: ½ cup (40 g or 1.4 oz) sliced peaches
ingredients.name: brzoskwinia

ingredients.text: ½ cup (40 g or 1.4 oz) sliced strawberries
ingredients.name: truskawka

steps.text: In a blender, blend the peaches, strawberries, yogurt, and ice cream until smooth.

recipes.title: Stuffed Tomatoes
recipes.description: A whole tomato stuffed with mushrooms, onion and herbs, then roasted until tender.

ingredients.text: 1 sliced onion slab, or coin, about ¼ inch (0.5 cm) thick
ingredients.name: cebula
ingredients.note: sliced slab or coin, about ¼ inch (0.5 cm) thick

ingredients.text: 4 fresh basil leaves or 2 tsp dried basil
ingredients.name: bazylia świeża
ingredients.note: fresh leaves or 2 tsp dried basil

ingredients.text: 2 tbsp fresh parsley or 2 tsp dried parsley flakes
ingredients.name: natka pietruszki
ingredients.note: fresh, or 2 tsp dried parsley flakes

steps.text: On the head of a fresh tomato, cut two concentric rings, one near the stem, the other near the slope of the tomato's shoulder.
Remove this ring to expose the juicy seed compartments.
Slice the mushrooms into small, flat slabs, and cut the onion coin in quarters, like a pie or quiche. Separate the layers.
In the open ring sprinkle the dried spices.

Force the mushrooms and small arcs of onion through the spices and into the seed compartments, pushing the basil/dill/parsley/etc in with them. Stuff in as many as possible without forcing out tomato pulp. If using fresh basil leaves, fold them over the slices of mushrooms and push them in together.
Drizzle five or so drops of cooking oil in a spot on a baking sheet or small roasting flat. Rub in a small circle with a diameter equal to the foot, or butt of the tomato.
Place the tomato on the oil and the pan into an oven preheated to 350°F (180°C).
Roast for 15–20 minutes.

recipes.title: Memphis-Style BBQ Ribs
recipes.description: This is a classic U.S. style of BBQ pork ribs.

steps.text: Season spareribs with rib rub.
Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Place chunks in smoker or charcoal grill set for indirect heat at 250°F (120°C).
Combine liquid ingredients and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce liquid by ⅓.
Place spareribs into smoker or grill for 4–5 hours, basting occasionally with sauce.
Brush remaining sauce on top of ribs and place on a medium-high grill until browned. The internal temperature of the ribs before removing from the grill needs to be at least 145°F (63°C).
Let rest for 10 minutes, covered, and carve.

recipes.title: Rosemary Balsamic Chicken Wings
recipes.description: Chicken wingettes marinated in balsamic vinegar, rosemary and spices, then dredged in cornmeal and deep fried.

steps.text: Place chicken in a zip-top plastic bag.
Combine remaining ingredients except for oil and cornmeal and refrigerate overnight.
Heat oil to 350°F.
Meanwhile, dredge chicken in cornmeal.
Fry in batches for 12 minutes.
Drain on a cooling rack.
Rest 5 minutes and serve.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Shrimp with Broccoli
recipes.description: A quick stir-fry of shrimp and broccoli flavored with garlic and oyster sauce.

ingredients.text: 300 g broccoli, cut into florets and rinsed
ingredients.name: brokuł

steps.text: Heat a pan, add the oil and garlic, and fry until golden.
Add the shrimp and broccoli.
Season with salt and oyster sauce, and add a little water.
Stir together.
Put on a plate and serve.

recipes.title: Pinakbet
recipes.description: Filipino vegetable stew cooked with bagoong alamang, tomato and onion.

ingredients.text: 1 small (4 ounces / 115 g) yellow onion, finely chopped
ingredients.name: cebula

ingredients.text: 2 plum tomatoes (about 8 ounces / 225 g), cored and chopped
ingredients.name: pomidor

ingredients.text: 1 ea. (about 8 ounces / 225 g) bitter melon, halved lengthwise, seeded, and sliced ¼ inch thick
ingredients.name: goryczka (owoc)
ingredients.note: halved lengthwise, seeded, and sliced ¼ inch thick

ingredients.text: 1 small (about 8 ounces / 225 g) sweet potato, peeled, quartered, and cut into ¼-inch slices
ingredients.name: batat
ingredients.note: peeled, quartered, and cut into ¼-inch slices

ingredients.text: 8 ounces (225 g) string beans, stem ends trimmed and beans cut into 2-inch lengths
ingredients.name: fasolka szparagowa
ingredients.note: stem ends trimmed and beans cut into 2-inch lengths

ingredients.text: 1 medium (about 6 ounces / 170 g) eggplant, halved lengthwise, and sliced ½ inch thick
ingredients.name: bakłażan
ingredients.note: halved lengthwise, and sliced ½ inch thick

ingredients.text: 8 ounces (225 g) okra, caps trimmed, pods cut in half on the bias
ingredients.name: okra
ingredients.note: caps trimmed, pods cut in half on the bias

steps.text: Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Add the oil, then garlic to the pan. Sauté briefly until aromatic.
Add the onion, and cook until softened.
Add the tomato, bagoong alamang, and salt; simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the bitter melon and sweet potato. Cover and cook until almost, but not quite, tender.
Add the string beans, eggplant, and okra. Cover and cook for a few minutes until all the vegetables are tender.
Serve the vegetables with rice.

recipes.title: Sylheti Doner Kebab
recipes.description: Sylheti doner kebab is a tantalizing dish influenced by Turkish doner kebab but infused with Sylheti flavors, including hatxora.

ingredients.text: 500 g boneless meat (chicken, lamb, or beef), thinly sliced
ingredients.name: mięso bez kości
ingredients.note: chicken, lamb, or beef, thinly sliced

ingredients.text: Sliced vegetables (e.g. lettuce, tomatoes, onions) for serving
ingredients.name: warzywa pokrojone do podania

ingredients.text: Garlic, tomato, and naga sauce (extremely spicy)
ingredients.name: sos czosnkowo-pomidorowy z naga

steps.text: In a bowl, combine yogurt, vegetable oil, minced garlic, chopped onion, shatkora, ground cumin, ground coriander, ground paprika, salt, and black pepper. Mix well to create the marinade.
Add the thinly sliced meat to the marinade, ensuring it's coated thoroughly. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour, allowing the flavours to meld.
Preheat your grill or stovetop grill pan over medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated meat onto skewers, creating kebabs.
Grill the kebabs for about 10–15 minutes, turning occasionally, until the meat is cooked through and has a nicely charred exterior.
While the kebabs are cooking, warm the pita bread or flatbreads on the grill.
Once the kebabs are done, remove them from the skewers.
Serve the kebab by placing slices of grilled meat into warmed pita bread or flatbreads. Add sliced vegetables and drizzle with tahini sauce or yogurt-based sauce.
Roll up the bread to encase the filling, and enjoy your sylheti doner kebab!

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Pumpkin Soup with Curry
recipes.description: A smooth pumpkin soup flavoured with curry powder, nutmeg and bay leaf, finished with cream.

ingredients.text: 2 cans (30 oz) chicken broth (reduced sodium is best)
ingredients.name: bulion drobiowy

steps.text: Sauté onions with olive oil until translucent.
Add pumpkin and broth; mix well.
Add all spices and simmer for at least 15 minutes; remove bay leaf.
Let soup cool to lukewarm temperature and purée in a blender for smooth texture.
Return to saucepan and add milk. Reheat on lower temperature to serve immediately or forgo reheating and store in a suitable airtight container.

recipes.title: Sharba Libya (Libyan Soup)
recipes.description: A traditional, hearty Libyan soup made with vegetables, legumes, aromatic spices and tender chunks of meat.

ingredients.text: 500 grams (1 lb) lamb or beef, cut into small cubes
ingredients.name: jagnięcina lub wołowina

ingredients.text: 1 cup macaroni or other small pasta
ingredients.name: makaron

ingredients.text: Fresh parsley or cilantro, chopped, for garnish
ingredients.name: natka pietruszki

steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and minced garlic, and sauté until they become translucent and fragrant.
Add the diced lamb or beef cubes to the pot and cook until browned on all sides. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking.
Once the meat is browned, add the diced carrots, potatoes, celery, green and red bell peppers, zucchini, green peas, and chickpeas to the pot. Stir well to combine with the meat.
Add the diced tomatoes, tomato paste, cumin, paprika, turmeric, cayenne pepper, cinnamon, coriander, salt, and pepper to the pot. Stir to coat the ingredients with the spices and tomato paste.

Pour enough water into the pot to cover all the ingredients. Bring the soup to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and let it simmer for about 1 hour. This allows the flavors to meld together and the meat to become tender.
In the meantime, cook the macaroni or small pasta according to the package instructions. Drain and set aside.
After the soup has simmered for an hour, taste and adjust the seasoning with salt and pepper if needed.
Add the cooked macaroni or small pasta to the soup and stir to incorporate. Let the soup simmer for another 10 minutes to allow the pasta to absorb the flavors.
Remove the pot from the heat. Ladle into serving bowls and garnish with fresh chopped parsley or cilantro.
Serve the soup hot with crusty bread on the side.

recipes.title: Potato and Garlic Ravioli Filling
recipes.description: Nadzienie do ravioli z ziemniaków z czosnkiem, szczypiorkiem i sokiem z cytryny.

ingredients.text: 6 cloves garlic, grated with a micro plane or finely chopped
ingredients.name: ząbek czosnku
ingredients.note: grated with a micro plane or finely chopped

steps.text: Boil the potatoes in their skins until tender when pierced with a fork.
Peel them as soon as they are cool enough to handle and mash in a bowl.
Sauté the garlic in the oil for 1 minute.
Add the potatoes and mix well.
Add the chives, lemon juice and seasoning and mix well.
Cover and allow to cool while you prepare the pasta dough.

recipes.title: Spiced Flour
recipes.description: A flour and spice mix used in preparing Onion Blooms.

steps.text: Mix together ingredients thoroughly.

recipes.title: Poppyseed Chicken
recipes.description: Poppyseed chicken is a savory casserole. It is simple to prepare, hearty, and a crowd favorite.

ingredients.text: 4 pieces of chicken breast, boiled and diced
ingredients.name: pierś z kurczaka

ingredients.text: 2 cups (about 1 sleeve) crushed Ritz crackers (or similar)
ingredients.name: krakersy
ingredients.note: crushed Ritz crackers (or similar), about 1 sleeve

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Mix chicken with mayonnaise and sour cream. Spread this in the bottom of a 9x13 inch casserole dish.
Sprinkle cheese, crackers, then poppy seeds on top.
Evenly pour melted butter on top.
Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Sugar Pie
recipes.description: Traditional American pie also known as Sugar Cream Pie, the official pie of the state of Indiana.

ingredients.text: ¼ cup cornstarch (flour can work if cornstarch is unavailable)
ingredients.name: skrobia kukurydziana
ingredients.note: flour can work if cornstarch is unavailable

ingredients.text: Cinnamon or nutmeg to sprinkle on top of pie (optional)
ingredients.name: cynamon
ingredients.note: or nutmeg, to sprinkle on top of pie (optional)

steps.text: Preheat oven to about 375°F (190–200°C).
In large saucepan, simmer milk without boiling.
Dissolve sugar, cornstarch and butter into milk.
Stir gently and allow to thicken for about 5 minutes.
Pour mixture into pie crust and gently transfer into oven. Bake for about 22 minutes.
Optionally engage broiler for a few minutes to caramelize the top of the pie.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Beef Stew
recipes.description: A hearty and flavoursome beef stew inspired by the Mediterranean, with olives and tomatoes.

ingredients.text: 500 g (1.1 lb) of lean beef stewing/braising steak (in steaks, not diced)
ingredients.name: wołowina gulaszowa
ingredients.note: lean beef stewing/braising steak (in steaks, not diced)

ingredients.text: 600 g (1.3 lb) of green olives, stones removed
ingredients.name: oliwka zielona

ingredients.text: 1 large clove of garlic, finely chopped
ingredients.name: czosnek

steps.text: In a large saucepan or casserole dish, gently fry the onion and garlic in plenty of good olive oil for a few minutes, taking care not to brown them.
Season the beef well with salt and black pepper and immediately add to the pan. Fry until evenly sealed and lightly browned.
Add the olives and tomatoes to the pan and simmer gently for two hours with the lid on.
Serve.

recipes.title: Carrot Jam
recipes.description: Simple Danish carrot jam, a sweet preserve made from carrots, lemon juice and sugar.

ingredients.text: 1 kg carrots, peeled and finely grated
ingredients.name: marchew

steps.text: Boil the water and carrots until tender.
Add juice and sugar, and continue to boil for a further 15–20 minutes.

recipes.title: Calamansi Juice Drink
recipes.description: A Filipino version of lemonade made with calamansi, cold water and sugar.

steps.text: Halve the calamansi with a sharp knife.
Use your hands to squeeze the juice from the calamansi.
Combine the juice with the cold water in a glass.
Stir in sugar until dissolved.
Add ice cubes.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Baby Back Ribs
recipes.description: Baby back ribs slow-cooked in a sweet and tangy vinegar, honey and Worcestershire sauce.

ingredients.text: 2½ pounds cut-up baby back pork ribs
ingredients.name: żeberka wieprzowe

steps.text: Season ribs liberally with rib rub. Refrigerate overnight.
The next day, combine remaining ingredients. Place ribs in the bottom of a slow cooker and pour mixture over.
Cover and cook on low for 8–9 hours, or until ribs are tender. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Pufftaloons
recipes.description: In Australia these pufftaloons are usually made with a yeast-based bread dough, but this recipe uses baking powder instead.

steps.text: Combine flour and baking powder.
Rub in the butter.
Add enough milk to make a soft dough.
Deep fry in hot vegetable oil.
Serve hot with jam or golden syrup.

recipes.title: Vanilla Kifli
recipes.description: Vanilla kifli is the traditional Hungarian holiday cookie.

steps.text: Cream together the butter with the sugar in a large mixing bowl.
Beat in egg yolks and vanilla.
Gradually beat in flour to make a dough.
Shape the dough into a ball, cover, and let stand at room temperature for 2 hours.
Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
To form the crescents, roll about 1 tbsp of the dough in the palms of your hands.
Continue rolling to form a rope about 3 inches long and ½ inch thick, then bend the rope to form a crescent.
Repeat with remaining dough, placing crescents on ungreased cookie sheets about 1 inch apart.
Bake for about 10–12 minutes. Cookies should be white in color.
Let cool on cookie sheets for 5 minutes to prevent breaking.
While cookies are still warm, carefully roll them in vanilla sugar. Repeat with remaining cookies.
Cool cookies completely.
Melt chocolate in a double boiler set over low heat.
When cookies are cool, dip the tips of each cookie in melted chocolate, then set on waxed paper to set.

recipes.title: Glazed Sweet Potatoes
recipes.description: Sweet potatoes cooked in a maple-flavored syrup and butter glaze until coated.

ingredients.text: 1 can (40 oz / 1100 g) sweet potatoes, drained
ingredients.name: batat z puszki

steps.text: Bring syrup and butter just to boil in large skillet on medium heat.
Reduce heat to low, and simmer about 2 minutes.
Add sweet potatoes.
Cook on low heat 10 minutes, gently turning sweet potatoes frequently to glaze.
Garnish with pecan halves, if desired.

recipes.title: Haupia (Hawaiian Coconut Pudding)
recipes.description: Haupia is a Hawaiian pudding made of coconut milk and cornstarch (originally Polynesian arrowroot starch).

steps.text: Mix coconut milk with sugar and salt over a medium heat.
Slowly add cornstarch and stir until thickened.
Pour into a pan or square form.
Cool for 1 hour or until fully set.
Unmold and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Taco Casserole
recipes.description: Taco casserole is a casserole with taco ingredients.

steps.text: Brown the ground beef in skillet on medium heat.
Drain the ground beef.
Dump the ground beef back in the skillet.
While on medium heat mix in the taco seasoning, the chili powder, the garlic powder, and the tomato sauce.
Simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Mix the ground beef mixture, tortilla bits, and the cheese together in a casserole dish.
Bake in oven at 375°F (190°C) for 20 minutes.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Crispy Buffalo Shrimp
recipes.description: Crispy cornmeal-coated shrimp fried in peanut oil and tossed in a spicy hot sauce and butter mixture.

ingredients.text: 2 pounds medium shrimp with tails, peeled and deveined
ingredients.name: krewetki
ingredients.note: medium, with tails, peeled and deveined

ingredients.text: 3 cloves garlic, smashed and very finely minced
ingredients.name: ząbek czosnku

steps.text: Combine butter, hot sauce, soy, and garlic. Set aside.
Dip shrimp into lemon juice. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Dredge shrimp into cornmeal. Let rest 2–3 minutes.
Heat oil to 375°F. Fry shrimp in batches until golden brown, about 2 minutes. Drain on a cooling rack.
Toss shrimp in butter mixture. Serve warm with blue cheese dressing, if desired.

recipes.title: Ekwang (Cameroonian Taro Leaf Stew)
recipes.description: Ekwang is a traditional Cameroonian dish that combines cocoyam leaves, beef, crayfish, and aromatic spices.

steps.text: Wash the cocoyam leaves thoroughly and remove the tough stems. Chop the leaves into smaller pieces and set aside.
In a large pot, heat the palm oil and groundnut oil over medium heat. Add the chopped onions and minced garlic, and sauté until fragrant.
Add the beef cubes to the pot and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the crayfish, ground crayfish, dried bitterleaf, and dried utazi leaves to the pot. Stir well to combine the ingredients.
Pour in the water and season with salt to taste. Stir again to ensure even distribution of the ingredients.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and let it simmer for about 1 hour, or until the beef is tender.
Add the chopped cocoyam leaves to the pot and stir to incorporate them into the mixture.
Cover the pot and cook for an additional 15–20 minutes, or until the cocoyam leaves are cooked and tender.
Taste and adjust the seasoning if needed, adding more salt or spices according to your preference.

recipes.title: Salmon Cakes
recipes.description: Patties made from ground wild salmon, breadcrumbs and lemon, baked until parcooked, then dredged in breadcrumbs and fried until golden.

ingredients.text: 1¼ pounds skinless wild salmon filet, cut into 2-inch cubes
ingredients.name: łosoś dziki
ingredients.note: skinless wild salmon filet, cut into 2-inch cubes

steps.text: Run salmon through a meat grinder on medium setting.
If you don't have a grinder, ask your butcher to do so, but ask for it to be clean before they do.
Combine ground salmon, ¼ cup breadcrumbs, salt, pepper, lemon juice, and lemon zest.
Form into 4 patties, each about 1¼ inch thick.
Insert a probe thermometer into one of the cakes.
Place on a greased baking pan and bake at 350°F until internal temperature reaches 130°F.
While the salmon cooks, heat olive oil in a cast iron skillet to 375°F.
Once salmon is parcooked, dredge into more breadcrumbs then immediately transfer to oil.
Cook until golden brown on both sides.
Serve immediately with melted butter.

recipes.title: Russian Salad
recipes.description: In this Armenian version of Russian salad (Սալադ Րուս), there are equal amounts of peas, diced carrots, corn, diced potato, and about half that amount of diced cucumber pickles and mayonnaise.

steps.text: Boil together the vegetables, then drain and transfer to a bowl.
Add the diced pickles and cool to room temperature.
Add the mayonnaise, and stir until uniformly mixed.
Finish by seasoning with some salt to taste.

images: Yam Sweet Potato Porridge with Peppered Ponmo.jpg

recipes.title: Nigerian Yam and Potato Porridge
recipes.description: Yam and potato porridge with peppered ponmo, an upgraded version of yam porridge popular in southern Nigeria, particularly among the Yoruba people.

ingredients.text: 6 pieces of ponmo (cow skin), properly cleaned and cut into small pieces
ingredients.name: ponmo (wołowa skóra)
ingredients.note: properly cleaned and cut into small pieces

ingredients.text: 1 medium-sized yam, peeled and sliced into 4 pieces of 10 cm diameter and 2–2.5-inch thickness
ingredients.name: jam
ingredients.note: medium-sized, peeled, sliced into 4 pieces of 10 cm diameter and 2–2.5-inch thickness

ingredients.text: 5 medium-sized sweet potatoes, peeled and sliced 2–2.5-inch thick
ingredients.name: batat

steps.text: Place the ponmo in a pot with water, 2 seasoning cubes, garlic, and salt to taste. Boil until the ponmo becomes soft.
Blend the chile peppers until about 70% smooth.
Heat a dry frying pan over medium heat. Pour 1 cooking spoon of palm oil and ½ spoon of vegetable oil into the pan, and heat them for about 2 minutes.
Add one-third of the finely chopped onions to the pan and fry them, stirring continuously for approximately 2 minutes.
Add the blended peppers, curry powder, ½ teaspoon of salt, and pepper. Let the mixture fry for about 8 minutes.
Add the cooked ponmo to the pan and stir to combine. Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for approximately 5 minutes.
Keep warm until time to serve.
In a large pot, combine 1 cup of water and 1 teaspoon of salt. Add the yam, sweet potato, and sliced onions.
Boil the yam and sweet potatoes until they are about 60% softened (approximately halfway done). Do not drain.
Blend the ginger-garlic paste, remaining seasoning cubes, and tomato paste together until smooth.
Heat a dry frying pan over medium heat. Add 2 spoons of palm oil and 1½ spoons of vegetable oil to the pan, and heat them for about 2 minutes.
Add half the remaining finely chopped onions to the pan and fry them, stirring continuously for approximately 2 minutes.
Add the tomato mixture and salt to taste. Stir continuously until the mixture fries and has lost some liquid.
Stir the fried tomato mixture into the pot with the yam and potatoes. Add the crayfish and remaining chopped onions. Stir well and cover the pot, allowing it to cook for 5 minutes.
Using a wooden stirring rod, stir and mash the yam and potato, leaving some chunks for texture.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for an additional 5 minutes.
Stir the porridge and remove it from the heat, allowing it to steam. Serve the hot porridge on a plate with the peppered ponmo.

recipes.title: Shakshuka bil Lahm (Libyan Meat Shakshuka)
recipes.description: A hearty Libyan dish of tomato-based sauce with tender chunks of beef or lamb and poached eggs.

ingredients.text: 500 grams (1 lb) beef or lamb, cut into small cubes
ingredients.name: wołowina
ingredients.note: cut into small cubes; beef or lamb

ingredients.text: ½ teaspoon ground cayenne pepper (optional, for extra heat)
ingredients.name: pieprz cayenne

ingredients.text: Fresh parsley or cilantro, chopped (for garnish)
ingredients.name: natka pietruszki

steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet or frying pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic. Sauté until the onion becomes translucent and fragrant.
Add the cubed meat to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the diced bell peppers and tomatoes to the skillet. Stir well to combine.
Sprinkle the cumin, paprika, cayenne pepper (if using), salt, and pepper over the ingredients in the skillet. Stir to evenly distribute the spices.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the skillet with a lid, and let the mixture simmer for about 15–20 minutes, or until the meat is tender and the flavors have melded together.
Using a spoon, create small wells in the sauce and carefully crack the eggs into each well.
Cover the skillet again and let the shakshuka cook for an additional 5–7 minutes, or until the eggs are cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Garnish with freshly chopped parsley or cilantro.

recipes.title: Marinated Green Olives
recipes.description: Green olives marinated in herbs and garlic, commonly served as a Spanish appetizer.

ingredients.text: 2 cups (16 oz/450 g) unpitted large green Spanish olives
ingredients.name: oliwki zielone

steps.text: Lightly crush the olives with a mallet, or make slight slits on each olive with a knife, to ensure that the marinade permeates them.
Place the olives in a sealable glass jar and add the remaining ingredients.
Fill the jar with water and shake well.
Marinate at room temperature for several days to a week.
Serve the olives with toasted almonds and fresh bread.

recipes.title: Ashoka Halwa (Mung Bean Pudding)
recipes.description: Asoka halwa is a very famous dessert in the district of Thiruvaiyaru in Tamil Nadu, India. The traditional dish is made with moong dal, sugar, and ghee, and it is served at wedding ceremonies.

ingredients.text: 1 pinch red food colouring in 1 teaspoon water
ingredients.name: barwnik spożywczy czerwony

steps.text: Dry roast the moong dal until it smells nutty and browns slightly.
Add 3 cups of water and pressure cook for about 7–8 whistles until the dal is soft and mushy.
Add 4 tablespoons ghee to a heavy-bottomed pot over medium-low heat, and cook the wheat flour in it until golden brown.
Stir the cooked dal into the flour mixture, and let it thicken for 5 minutes.
Add the sugar.
