ingredients.text: Finely-grated zest and juice of 1 small lemon
ingredients.name: skórka cytrynowa

ingredients.text: 200 g red jam of your choice such as plum, cherry, raspberry or strawberry
ingredients.name: dżem
ingredients.note: red jam of your choice such as plum, cherry, raspberry or strawberry

steps.text: Stir the flour, suet, salt and lemon zest together then work to a firm dough with the lemon juice, egg and milk or water.
Roll out to a rectangle about 25 x 20.5 cm (10 x 8 in) and spread jam to within 2.5 cm (1 in) of the edges. Roll up starting from a short end and seal the edges well with a little water.
Set the roll on a sheet of well buttered foil and wrap, making sure you seal the ends well. If you are feeling traditional use cheesecloth or a shirt sleeve to steam in.
Set in a steamer and steam for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Italian-American Spaghetti alla Puttanesca
recipes.description: Spaghetti z ostrym sosem pomidorowym z cebulą, czosnkiem, anchois, kaparami i oliwkami.

ingredients.text: 4 ounces (110 g / 2 small tins) anchovy fillets or anchovy paste
ingredients.name: anchois
ingredients.note: 110 g / 2 small tins; fillets or anchovy paste

ingredients.text: 1–3 fresh or dried hot chile peppers, deseeded and finely chopped
ingredients.name: papryczka chili
ingredients.note: 1–3, fresh or dried, deseeded and finely chopped

ingredients.text: 1 standard, American-sized can (6 ounces / 170 g) pitted, black or kalamata olives, quartered
ingredients.name: oliwki czarne

ingredients.text: 3 standard, American-sized cans (43.5 ounces / 1.23 kg) tomatoes, diced
ingredients.name: pomidor

steps.text: Fill a large pot with water and add a handful of salt.
Set heat on high to boil water.
Heat 4 tablespoons oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add onions to skillet and cook until soft, stirring occasionally. Be careful not to burn the onions.
Add garlic and anchovies to skillet. Cook for 1 minute maximum, stirring to break up the anchovies.
Add capers, chili peppers, olives, tomatoes, pepper and 1 tablespoon of salt to skillet.
Bring to a boil then reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Taste to see if you want to add more salt.
Boil the pasta until al dente while the sauce is simmering. This should take about 12 minutes.
Drain the cooked pasta in a colander and replace it in the same pot.
Pour the sauce on top of the pasta and toss over low heat until it's thoroughly coated.
Take it off the heat and top with parsley and 1 tablespoon olive oil.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Thai Rice Balls in Coconut Milk (Bua Loi)
recipes.description: Thai dessert of glutinous rice flour balls served in warm sweetened coconut cream, optionally with a boiled egg.

steps.text: Mix the rice flour with enough water to make a stiff paste, adding the pandan essence to the water before mixing with the rice flour.
Knead well, then form the dough into pea-sized balls.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil.
Add the rice balls, and remove them when they float to the surface. Drain.
Bring half the coconut cream to a boil, stirring constantly to prevent it from separating, then add the flour balls.
When the mixture returns to a boil, remove from heat and stir in the remaining coconut cream.
If serving this dish with eggs, in a separate saucepan bring water to a boil and reduce heat, then crack eggs one at a time into the water.
When eggs are done, remove from water and set aside.
Serve as dessert in small bowls, adding one egg per bowl.
Thais often add sweet corn kernels to the final product.

recipes.title: Beach Tropicana
recipes.description: A tropical fruit drink made from mango and pineapple juice with banana.

steps.text: Blend all except the crushed ice in a blender.
Serve with crushed ice.

recipes.title: Microwave Applesauce
recipes.description: Easy applesauce made in the microwave from apples, apple jelly, maple syrup and orange juice.

ingredients.text: ¼ cup Grade B Amber maple syrup (Grade A Dark Amber would be okay too)
ingredients.name: syrop klonowy
ingredients.note: Grade B Amber (Grade A Dark Amber would be okay too)

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in a microwave-safe container.
Cover container, leaving 1 corner open, and microwave on high 7–8 minutes or until apples are easy to mash.
Remove cinnamon stick and discard.
For a chunky sauce, mash the apples with a potato masher. For a slightly smoother sauce, use a hand mixer. For a smooth pureé, use an immersion blender.

recipes.title: Grilled Peaches with Vanilla Maple Sauce
recipes.description: Halved peaches grilled cut-side down and served warm with a maple vanilla sauce.

ingredients.text: 4 ripe yellow peaches, halved and pitted
ingredients.name: brzoskwinia

steps.text: Combine all ingredients except peaches and sugar. Bring to a boil over high heat in a large saucepan, and simmer until reduced by half.
Dip cut side of peaches into hot mixture. Sprinkle cut side liberally with sugar.
Place peaches cut-side down on a high-heat grill until marked and slightly charred. Serve warm with remaining sauce.

recipes.title: Brown Sauce
recipes.description: A tangy, slightly sweet sauce accompanying cooked breakfasts and chips (fries).

steps.text: Mix together the sugar, vinegar, olive oil, mustard, salt, and pepper.
Serve or store in a bottle.

recipes.title: Steak Enchiladas
recipes.description: Tender, juicy, marinated steak rolled with Monterey Jack cheese sauce in a corn tortilla, baked and topped with more cheese sauce and green chile sauce.

ingredients.text: 1 ea. (8–10 pounds) inside skirt steak, cut into 2 equal pieces and 1 smaller piece
ingredients.name: stek wołowy
ingredients.note: (8–10 pounds) inside skirt steak, cut into 2 equal pieces and 1 smaller piece

ingredients.text: 4 serrano chiles, minced (you can seed it if you want)
ingredients.name: papryczka serrano
ingredients.note: minced (you can seed it if you want)

steps.text: Combine oil, lime, chipotles, adobo, salt, pepper, and cumin in a blender. Pour into a gallon size zip-top bag and add steak. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Heat a charcoal grill, but use a chimney or else you will have a solvent flavored steak. Ditch the grate and place the steak right on the coals and cook 60 seconds per side for medium rare.
Remove and wrap tightly with aluminum foil. Keep warm.
Meanwhile, purée the chiles with the vinegar in a blender until smooth. Pour into a large saucepan and bring to a boil over medium high heat until reduced by ⅓. Keep warm over low heat.
Melt butter in a saucier over medium heat. Cook until bubbling ceases. Add the flour and whisk continuously until it looks like blonde library paste.
Melt in cheese. Heat to just below a simmer then reduce heat to low and cook until slightly thickened. Set aside.

Slice steak as thinly as possible across the grain. Place a nice handful into each tortilla and top with some cheese sauce. Roll and place seam side down on a parchment-lined sheet pan. Repeat until all tortillas have been used up. While you're at it, eat any remaining steak.
Pour remaining cheese sauce evenly over the tortillas and bake at 375°F for 45 minutes or until browned and bubbly on top. Remove to serving platters.
Drizzle the chile purée over each enchilada and serve warm.

recipes.title: Dill Cucumber Salad
recipes.description: Sałatka z ogórka z koperkiem w kremowym sosie na bazie śmietany.

steps.text: Combine sour cream, vinegar, sugar, garlic powder, dill, and salt.
Add cucumbers and onion, and toss to coat.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Serve with slotted spoon.

recipes.title: Lemon Italian Ice
recipes.description: Italian ice, also known as water ice, is a frozen dessert made from either concentrated syrup flavoring or fruit purees.

steps.text: In heavy, medium-sized saucepan, stir together water, corn syrup, and sugar.
Heat to boiling over medium-high heat.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, uncovered, 5 minutes.
Remove from heat; cool for 30 minutes.
Stir in lemon juice.
Pour mixture into a 9 inch square baking pan. Cover surface with plastic wrap.
Freeze 3–4 hours, or until frozen but still soft in center.
Spoon into blender container; cover. Blend on high speed until mixture becomes white and creamy.
Turn back into the pan. Cover with plastic wrap. Freeze mixture about 3 hours or until firm.

recipes.title: Fruity White Sangria
recipes.description: Lekka sangria z białym winem, sokiem owocowym i świeżymi owocami, podawana z lodem.

steps.text: Evenly combine all ingredients in 2 very large pitchers; cover and refrigerate for 2 hours to blend flavors.
Serve over ice cubes.

recipes.title: Burrito Mix
recipes.description: A filling mix of meat, beans, corn, tomatoes, salsa and rice for making burritos.

steps.text: Brown the meat and onion in saucepan.
Mix in black beans, corn, tomatoes, salsa, rice, water, and taco seasoning.
Simmer until done.
Use as a filling in burritos.

recipes.title: Brown Rice Casserole
recipes.description: A baked side dish of brown rice, processed cheese, mushrooms, peas and slivered almonds.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Combine cheese, mushrooms, peas, and rice in large bowl.
Coat 1½ quart baking pan with cooking spray.
Move mixed ingredients to baking dish.
Cover and bake for 20 to 25 minutes.
Sprinkle almonds on top.
Bake 5 minutes more.

recipes.title: Wassel
recipes.description: Hot spiced fruit punch made from apple, cranberry, grape and orange juices with mulling spices, served at holidays.

steps.text: Mix together liquid ingredients, then stir in mulling spices and orange slices.
Warm, but do not boil.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Honey-Peppered Salmon
recipes.description: Salmon fillets marinated in a honey, mustard, garlic and cayenne mixture, then baked.

steps.text: In a shallow dish, combine oil, honey, mustard, garlic, cayenne, coriander, lemon juice, and salt. Mix well.
Add salmon and let marinate at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Preheat oven to 350°F (175˚C).
Grease a baking dish.
Remove salmon from marinade and place in the prepared dish.
Bake for 10–12 minutes or until desired "doneness".

recipes.title: Jamaican Rice and Peas
recipes.description: Jamaican rice and peas cooked in coconut milk with Scotch bonnet pepper, scallions and thyme.

ingredients.text: 3 cups dried red peas (kidney beans) or gungo peas (pigeon peas)
ingredients.name: fasola czerwona sucha
ingredients.note: dried red peas (kidney beans) or gungo peas (pigeon peas)

ingredients.text: 2 cups coconut milk or 1 packet coconut powder
ingredients.name: mleko kokosowe

ingredients.text: 1 bunch scallions or 1 small white onion, chopped
ingredients.name: dymka

ingredients.text: 1 ½ lb white or brown rice, rinsed and drained
ingredients.name: ryż biały
ingredients.note: white or brown rice, rinsed and drained

steps.text: Wash peas with clean water. Place them in a pot with the water, salt, and garlic. Stir and leave to soak overnight.

Transfer the entire pot of soaked peas and liquid to the stovetop. Cover and bring to a boil over medium heat. Simmer, stirring occasionally, until the peas become tender (about 20 minutes). Add more hot water if the level drops too low.
Lower the heat, then add the coconut milk, scotch bonnet pepper, scallion, thyme, margarine, all-purpose seasoning, seasoning salt, and chicken seasoning. Stir well.
Cover and boil over medium heat for 10 minutes.
Stir in the rice until evenly distributed. Cover, lower heat, and boil until the rice is soft and liquid is boiled out (about 10–15 minutes).
Serve and enjoy!

recipes.title: Spinach Fritters
recipes.description: These are delicious and healthy spinach fritters.

ingredients.text: 3 handfuls of spinach and rocket leaves
ingredients.name: szpinak i rukola

steps.text: Combine the yogurt, flour, minced garlic, olive oil, salt and pepper in the mixing bowl.
Chop the spinach and rocket leaves, and add them to the mixing bowl.
Mix in the baking powder.
Preheat a frying pan, and grease with olive oil.
Dollop spoonfuls of batter on the pan to make a few fritters about 3 cm apart from each other.
Cook fritters until the bottoms of the fritters are golden brown. Flip the fritters with a spatula, and cook until the second side is golden brown. Remove from the pan.
Repeat the cooking steps until all the batter is used up.
Enjoy and share with friends and family!

recipes.title: Mbong Tchobi (Cameroonian Spicy Black Stew)
recipes.description: Mbong tchobi is a popular Cameroonian dish with a unique colour and taste. It can be served with ripe plantain or any complimentary dish of your choice.

ingredients.text: 4 pounds white fish or catfish, cleaned and cut into steaks
ingredients.name: ryba biała lub sum

steps.text: Lightly fry the njansan for about 5 minutes. Set aside.
Blend the onions, green onions, tomatoes, njansan, garlic, basil, and parsley together in a blender. You can add some water to the blender to facilitate its blending to a purée.
Place a saucepan on the fire and heat it with a little oil. Add the blended mixture with very little water and bring it to a boil. Let it simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.

Mix in the mbongo spice, fish, bouillon powder, and salt. Simmer for another 15 minutes or until the fish is fully cooked through. Add a little water if necessary to prevent the stew from getting burnt.
Adjust the seasonings as desired. Enjoy warm with boiled plantains or any complementary dish of your choice.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Mints
recipes.description: Miętowe cukierki z serka kremowego, kruche i słodkie, bez gotowania.

ingredients.text: ¾ cup (175 ml) white granulated sugar
ingredients.name: cukier biały

steps.text: Combine cream cheese, icing sugar and peppermint flavouring in large bowl. Stir until mixed.
Roll dough into small balls.
Roll balls in bowl of icing sugar.
Press small balls with bottom of glass until flat.
Chill. Store in airtight container.

recipes.title: Socca (Italian Chickpea Flatbread)
recipes.description: Socca (French), torta di ceci or farinata (Italian), is a type of flatbread made from chickpea flour.

ingredients.text: Black pepper to taste; 2–3 decent grinds of a grinder should do
ingredients.name: pieprz czarny mielony
ingredients.note: 2–3 decent grinds of a grinder should do

steps.text: Heat oven as high as it can go—around 300°C / 570°F is traditional, but do whatever your oven can manage that gets close to this. If using a cast-iron pan, get it into the oven at the start so that it is hot when the batter goes into it.
Whisk all the ingredients together well, ensuring there are no lumps. This should make a very thin, easy-to-pour batter.

Once the oven is up to temperature, pour some of the batter into the hot pan or onto the plaque, and put into the oven for 8–9 minutes at 300°C / 570°F, or 13–15 minutes at 250°C / 480°F. With a 50 cm plaque or pan, cook half the batter at a time—the batter should cover the plaque or pan very thinly.
Remove from the oven and cut into triangular wedges. Serve hot.
Repeat for the rest of the batter.

recipes.title: Microwave Chocolate Chip Cookie
recipes.description: A microwave cookie is a dessert that only takes 2 minutes to cook.

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, softened at room temperature
ingredients.name: masło

ingredients.text: ¼ cup (45 g / 1.5 oz) light brown sugar
ingredients.name: cukier trzcinowy brązowy

ingredients.text: ½ cup (70 g / 2.5 oz) all-purpose flour
ingredients.name: mąka pszenna

ingredients.text: ½ cup (40 g / 1.5 oz) dark chocolate chips
ingredients.name: czekolada gorzka

steps.text: Line a large microwave-safe plate with parchment.
Beat the butter and sugar in a small bowl until light and fluffy.
Beat in the egg and vanilla.
Sift the flour and salt and fold into the butter mixture.
Fold in most of the chocolate chips.
Scoop the dough into center of plate. Decorate with remaining chocolate chips.
Microwave the cookie for 1.5–2 minutes, depending on microwave's power.
Leave the cookie to cool.

recipes.title: Spice Rub
recipes.description: An all-purpose spice rub built on paprika, with salt, black pepper, chipotle, brown sugar, dehydrated lemon peel, rosemary and cayenne.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in an airtight container.
Store in a cool, dark place; it will last for a long time.

images: Warm Black Bean Salad with Kale and Tomatoes.jpg

recipes.title: Warm Black Bean Salad with Kale and Tomatoes
recipes.description: A warm black bean salad with kale, tomatoes, lemon juice and spices.

steps.text: In a medium saucepan, heat oil over medium heat for 2–3 minutes.
Add onion, garlic, and a pinch of salt into the pan.
Cook and stir 2–3 minutes or until onion is tender.
Stir in chili powder, cumin, cinnamon, and black beans with their liquid.
Cook 2 minutes; mash the beans with the back of your spatula, leaving some beans intact.
Reduce heat to low; add kale, cook and stir 2–3 minutes or until kale is tender and mixture has thickened.
Stir in lemon juice and tomato; taste and add more salt if desired.
Garnish with white sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Cocoa Mix
recipes.description: Cocoa mix made from milk powder, cocoa, sugar and salt, to be stirred into hot water.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients.
Mix thoroughly.
Store in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Ifumbe (Rwandan Cassava Fritters)
recipes.description: Ifumbe is a Rwandan snack made from cassava flour and other simple ingredients. These cassava fritters are crispy on the outside and soft on the inside.

steps.text: In a mixing bowl, combine the cassava flour, baking powder, salt, sugar, and ground cinnamon (if using). Mix well to evenly distribute the dry ingredients.
Add the milk, water, and beaten egg to the dry ingredients. Stir until a smooth batter forms. The batter should have a slightly thick consistency.
In a frying pan, heat enough vegetable oil over medium heat for frying.
Once the oil is hot, drop spoonfuls of the batter into the hot oil, making small fritters. Be careful not to overcrowd the pan; fry in batches if needed.
Fry the fritters for about 2–3 minutes on each side, or until they turn golden brown and crispy.
Use a slotted spoon to remove the fried fritters from the oil and place them on a plate lined with paper towels to drain excess oil.
Serve the ifumbe warm as a tasty snack or dessert.

recipes.title: Suqaar (Somali Spiced Meat Stir-fry)
recipes.description: A flavorful and aromatic Somali meat stir-fry commonly served as a main course, with tender beef cooked with spices, onions and bell peppers.

ingredients.text: Fresh cilantro or parsley, chopped, for garnish
ingredients.name: kolendra świeża

steps.text: In a large skillet or frying pan, heat the vegetable oil over medium-high heat.
Add the finely chopped onion to the hot oil and sauté until it becomes soft and translucent.
Stir in the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant.
Add the thinly sliced beef to the pan and cook until it browns and develops a nice sear on both sides.
Toss in the diced tomato and thinly sliced bell pepper. Continue to stir-fry until the vegetables soften slightly.
Sprinkle the ground cumin, coriander, turmeric, and cayenne pepper over the meat and vegetables. Mix well to evenly coat everything with the spices.
Season with salt to taste, adjusting the seasoning according to your preference.
Lower the heat to medium-low, cover the skillet, and let the suqaar simmer for a few minutes to allow the flavors to meld and the meat to become tender.
Once the meat is fully cooked and tender, remove the skillet from the heat.
Garnish with freshly chopped cilantro or parsley before serving.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Cognac Beef Stew
recipes.description: Beef stew cooked slowly in a Dutch oven with cognac, red wine and tomato paste.

ingredients.text: 2 pounds (1 kg) beef stew meat, cut into 2 in. (5 cm) cubes
ingredients.name: wołowina gulaszowa

ingredients.text: ½ pound (225 g) red-skinned potatoes, quartered
ingredients.name: ziemniak czerwony

steps.text: Dredge beef in flour. Heat oil in a 6-quart Dutch oven.
Working in batches, add beef and thoroughly brown on all sides.
Remove beef and add cognac. Bring to a boil and ignite.
Deglaze pan by scraping the bottom.
Once reduced by half, remove and pour over beef.
Melt butter over medium heat and add onion. Cook 1–2 minutes before adding garlic. Sauté until pale gold color is achieved.
Add everything else, place in a 250°F (120C) oven, and bake 5 hours.
Let rest 10 minutes and serve.

recipes.title: Banana Chocolate Chip Muffins
recipes.description: Banana muffins with chocolate chips, made with a blend of white, einkorn and whole-grain flours.

ingredients.text: ½ cup King Arthur organic all-purpose flour
ingredients.name: mąka pszenna

ingredients.text: ½ cup Farmer Ground all-purpose flour (sub KA all-purpose for a fluffier muffin)
ingredients.name: mąka pszenna
ingredients.note: Farmer Ground all-purpose; sub KA all-purpose for a fluffier muffin

ingredients.text: ½ cup organic whole-grain einkorn flour
ingredients.name: mąka orkiszowa

ingredients.text: ½ cup granulated coconut palm sugar
ingredients.name: cukier z palmy kokosowej

ingredients.text: ¼–½ cup organic granulated cane sugar
ingredients.name: cukier trzcinowy

ingredients.text: 1 cup mashed very ripe bananas (from about 2 bananas)
ingredients.name: banan
ingredients.note: mashed, very ripe, from about 2 bananas

ingredients.text: 1 cup chocolate chips (can omit or use only half)
ingredients.name: kawałki czekolady
ingredients.note: can omit or use only half

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Whisk together the flours, sugars, baking soda, baking powder, and salt.
Whisk together the mashed banana, egg, buttermilk, melted butter, and olive oil.
Add dry ingredients to the wet, and mix just until combined. Over-mixing will make them tough.
Add the chocolate chips, if including, and mix.
If needed, prepare the muffin tins by greasing them or lining them with liners (see notes).
Divide the batter between the prepared muffin cups, filling each cup about ⅔ full.
Bake for about 20 minutes or until cooked through—a tester inserted into the center should come out clean.

recipes.title: Orange-Glazed Sweet Potatoes
recipes.description: Batat zapiekany w sosie pomarańczowo-cynamonowym z brązowym cukrem.

ingredients.text: ½ cup firmly packed brown sugar
ingredients.name: cukier trzcinowy brązowy

steps.text: Slice sweet potatoes about ⅛ inch thick and spread evenly in an 8-inch square baking dish.
Combine orange juice, brown sugar, wheat germ, margarine, orange peel, cinnamon and nutmeg in bowl.
Pour liquid mixture over the sweet potatoes.
Cover dish with foil or lid. Bake for 1 hour at 350°F until potatoes are tender.

recipes.title: Hazelnut Cream Soda
recipes.description: An easy homemade soda made from hazelnut-flavored syrup, heavy cream and seltzer water, served cold over ice.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients.
Serve cold over ice.

recipes.title: Steak and Peppers
recipes.description: A simple dish to throw together with leftover meat, served as a main dish.

steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet.
Sear steak strips, bell peppers and onion together with salt and red pepper flakes for a few minutes, then turn heat down and add crushed tomatoes and capers.
Simmer, covered, for 10 minutes or until steak is cooked through and tender.
Chiffonade the basil and add, then simmer for another couple of minutes.

recipes.title: Beef Tenderloin Steak
recipes.description: Grillowane steki z polędwicy wołowej podane z cebulą i sosem winno-stekowym.

ingredients.text: 4 beef tenderloin steaks, 1 inch (2.5 cm) thick
ingredients.name: stek z polędwicy wołowej

ingredients.text: 1 cup thinly-sliced onion, separated into rings
ingredients.name: cebula

steps.text: Combine pepper, salt, and minced garlic in a small bowl; rub both sides of each steak with this mixture.
Place steaks on a broiler pan coated with cooking spray; broil 5 minutes on each side or until desired degree of doneness.
Set aside; keep warm.
Place a medium nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray over medium-high heat.
Add onion to skillet; cover and cook 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove onion from skillet; set aside, and keep warm.
Add wine to skillet, scraping pan to loosen the browned bits.
Cook over medium-high heat until reduced to ⅓ cup (about 1 minute), and stir in steak sauce.
Spoon wine sauce over steaks, and top with onion.
Serve with French fries.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Green Chicken
recipes.description: Chicken pieces marinated in a green herb, mustard and lemon marinade, then baked.

ingredients.text: 1 whole chicken, cut up (or any 8 chicken pieces—any combination of leg, breast, thigh, and wing)
ingredients.name: kurczak

steps.text: In a blender or food processor, combine parsley, shallots, garlic, olive oil, mustard, Italian herb blend, lemon juice, pepper, and salt. Purée.
Transfer mixture to a gallon zip-lock bag.
Add chicken, making sure it's covered on all sides by the marinade.
Seal bag and refrigerate for an hour.
Preheat oven to 300°F (150C).
Transfer chicken pieces to a rimmed baking sheet.
Bake about 40 minutes, turning pieces after 20 minutes, until juices run clear.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Crumble II
recipes.description: A rhubarb crumble with oats in the crumble mixture and a layer of crumble on the bottom as well as on top.

steps.text: Mix brown sugar, oats, flour, butter, and cinnamon until crumbly.
Press half the mixture into a 9 inch square pan.
Cover crumb mixture with diced rhubarb.
Mix white sugar, cornstarch, and water. Cook until clear and thick, stirring constantly. Add vanilla and stir.
Pour over rhubarb. Sprinkle with remaining crumb mixture over the top.
Bake for 1 hour at 180°C.

recipes.title: Watermelon Mojito Smoothie
recipes.description: This watermelon mojito smoothie recipe incorporates the flavors of a mojito, although it contains no actual alcohol.

ingredients.text: 3–4 oz water (depending how on thick you want it)
ingredients.name: woda
ingredients.note: 3–4 oz, depending how thick you want it

steps.text: Blend all ingredients together in a blender.
Adjust the amount of liquid as desired.
Garnish with mint if you like.

recipes.title: Sweet Pumpkin Scones
recipes.description: Słodkie scones z dyni, z dodatkiem gałki muszkatołowej i imbiru.

ingredients.text: ¼ cup butter or margarine, softened slightly
ingredients.name: masło

ingredients.text: 1 cup cooked, mashed butternut squash, pumpkin, or other squash
ingredients.name: dynia gotowana, rozgnieciona

steps.text: Stir together the flour, cream of tartar, baking soda, salt, ground nutmeg and ground ginger.
In a separate bowl, beat butter and sugar together with an electric mixer.
Add in the egg and corn syrup, and mix with a spoon to prevent over-mixing.
Stir in the squash and half of the sifted dry ingredients.
Add the rest of the dry ingredients with just enough of the milk to make a soft dough. If it is too sticky to work, add a sprinkle (or two) of flour.
Knead only a little, gently, until you can pat it out into a big flat rectangle about ¾ inch thick.
Cut into 12 pieces with a floured knife. Transfer to a lightly greased oven tray.
Bake at 230°C (450°F) for 18 minutes.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Diri Na Njar (Chadian Spiced Rice with Vegetables)
recipes.description: Diri na njar is a flavorful Chadian rice dish cooked with tomatoes, onions, and various seasonings. It can be enjoyed on its own or as a side with meat or vegetables.

ingredients.text: Fresh cilantro or parsley, for garnish (optional)
ingredients.name: kolendra świeża (liście)

steps.text: Rinse the rice under cold water until the water runs clear. This helps remove excess starch and prevents the rice from becoming sticky.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and sauté until it becomes translucent and slightly golden, stirring occasionally.
Add the minced garlic to the saucepan and cook for another minute until fragrant.
Stir in the chopped tomatoes and tomato paste, combining them with the onions and garlic. Cook for a few minutes until the tomatoes start to soften and release their juices.
Add the ground paprika, ginger, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper to the saucepan. Stir well to coat the tomatoes and onions with the spices.
Add the rinsed rice to the saucepan and stir gently to combine it with the tomato mixture, ensuring that each grain of rice is coated with the flavors.
Pour in the water or chicken broth, ensuring that the liquid covers the rice by about an inch.

Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low. Cover the saucepan with a tight-fitting lid and let it simmer for about 15–20 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed. Avoid lifting the lid during cooking to maintain steam and ensure even cooking.
Once the rice is done, remove the saucepan from the heat and let it sit, covered, for an additional 5 minutes. This allows the rice to steam and fluff up.
Fluff the rice gently with a fork to separate the grains. Taste and adjust the seasoning if needed.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro or parsley if desired.

recipes.title: Fried Cheese Balls with Sausage
recipes.description: Cheese and sausage balls rolled in cracker crumbs, either fried until golden or baked.

ingredients.text: 1 lb (500 g) mild or hot sausage
ingredients.name: kiełbasa surowa (biała)

ingredients.text: ¾ cup (180 ml) fine cracker crumbs
ingredients.name: krakersy zwykłe

steps.text: Combine the cheese, flour, sausage and cracker crumbs.
Using your hands, mix well and shape into 1-inch (2.5 cm) balls.
Put enough oil in a skillet to fill the skillet to a depth of about ¾ inches (2 cm).
Heat the oil. When it is hot, place the balls in the pan without crowding them.
Cook over medium-high heat, turning until all sides are golden brown.
Drain on paper towels.

recipes.title: Baked Cheese Balls with Sausage
recipes.description: Cheese and sausage balls baked on cookie sheets until golden brown.

ingredients.text: 1 lb (500 g) mild or hot sausage
ingredients.name: kiełbasa surowa (biała)

ingredients.text: ¾ cup (180 ml) fine cracker crumbs
ingredients.name: krakersy zwykłe

steps.text: Preheat oven to 375°F (230°C).
Mix all ingredients together thoroughly.
Form into 1-inch (2.5 cm) balls, and place on ungreased cookie sheets.
Bake for 15 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Split Peas (Cooked)
recipes.description: Plain cooked split peas, simmered in salted water until tender.

ingredients.text: 2 cups dry split peas, picked over
ingredients.name: groszek łuskany (suchy)

steps.text: Rinse the split peas well, and discard the water.
Simmer the split peas in salted water for ¾–1 hour.
Serve.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Spicy Chicken Stew
recipes.description: Tired of the same old stews? This spicy chicken stew will have your taste buds jumping right off your tongue!

ingredients.text: 2 pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into 1 ½-inch cubes
ingredients.name: udko z kurczaka
ingredients.note: boneless skinless, cut into 1 ½-inch cubes

steps.text: Dredge chicken in flour. Set aside.
Heat oil in a 6-quart cast-iron Dutch oven. Add 6 chicken pieces and cook until browned on all sides.
Repeat until all chicken has been browned, then remove from pot.
Sauté onion in remaining oil until translucent and slightly browned around edges.
Mix in the curry paste, chiles, fish sauce, broth, tomato paste, potatoes, and garlic.
Return the chicken to the pot. Cover tightly and place in 250°F oven for 4½ hours, or until chicken is cooked through and tender.
Sprinkle individual serving bowls with chopped parsley and serve warm.

recipes.title: Egyptian Roast Lamb (Kharouf Mahshi)
recipes.description: Egyptian roast lamb, known as kharouf mahshi, is a traditional dish of leg of lamb marinated in a blend of herbs and spices and slow-roasted. It is often served as a centerpiece during festive occasions.

ingredients.text: 1 ea. (approximately 2.5–3 kg) whole leg of lamb
ingredients.name: udziec jagnięcy

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F).
In a small bowl, combine the minced garlic, olive oil, lemon juice, cumin, coriander, paprika, cinnamon, salt, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Place the leg of lamb in a roasting pan and generously rub the marinade all over the lamb, ensuring it is evenly coated.
Cover the roasting pan with foil and let the lamb marinate in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours, or overnight for maximum flavor.
Remove the roasting pan from the refrigerator and let the lamb come to room temperature for about 30 minutes before roasting.

Place the roasting pan in the preheated oven and roast the lamb for approximately 25 minutes per pound (or 55 minutes per kilogram) for medium-rare doneness. Use a meat thermometer to check the internal temperature of the lamb. It should read around 60°C (140°F) for medium-rare. While the lamb is roasting, baste it occasionally with the pan juices to keep it moist and flavorful.

Once the lamb reaches the desired doneness, remove it from the oven and cover it loosely with foil. Let it rest for about 15–20 minutes to allow the juices to redistribute and the lamb to become tender.
Carve the roasted lamb into slices and serve it hot as the centerpiece of your meal.

recipes.title: Chocolate Milkshake
recipes.description: A thick chocolate milkshake made from vanilla ice cream, chocolate milk and chocolate powder, with optional crushed Oreo cookies stirred in.

steps.text: Pour all ingredients into the blender and blend until well mixed.
Adjust the consistency as desired with ice cream and chocolate milk.
Stir in crushed Oreo cookies if desired.

recipes.title: Cherries Jubilee
recipes.description: Wiśnie maraschino flambirowane w occie z rumu, z masłem, cynamonem i skórką pomarańczową, podawane z lodami.

ingredients.text: ½ tsp orange zest, finely grated
ingredients.name: skórka pomarańczowa

steps.text: Sprinkle cherries with sugar and spices. Set aside.
Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add cherries and sauté until slightly browned, 4–5 minutes.
Combine rum and orange zest.
Pour over cherries and carefully ignite with a firestick.
Shake pan until flames die.
Serve warm with some ice cream.

recipes.title: Manhattan Clam Chowder II
recipes.description: Zupa z małży w stylu Manhattan na pomidorowej bazie z wędzonym boczkiem i warzywami.

ingredients.text: 2 jars (23 ounces) clams or 2 packages (24 ounces) frozen clams
ingredients.name: małże

steps.text: Strain the clam juice.
Put the clams through food chopper, using the coarse blade.
Fry pork in a heavy iron pot.
Remove pork, and sauté onions in the fat until tender and lightly browned.
Add tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Add water, carrots, celery, and herbs.
Cover pot and gently simmer for 1½ hours.
Add clams, strained clam juice, and potatoes; cook until potatoes are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Bring to a boil, pour over crumbled soda crackers in individual plates, and serve at once.

recipes.title: Beet and Cabbage Stew
recipes.description: A hearty stew of beets, cabbage and vegetables cooked with meat and bones in a tomato base.

steps.text: If you are starting with fresh beets, boil them in water for 1.5–2 hours or roast at 350 °F for 90 minutes. When they are soft enough that a fork will go in easily then they are done.

Put the beets in a sink or large bowl full of cool water. Once they are cool, press your thumbs into the skin to start peeling them; sometimes they are not soft enough for this and you just need to cook them longer. If you use canned beets they will be ready right out of the can.

While the beets are cooking, start cooking the meat. Place the meat and bones into a large 12-quart stock pot. Add the crushed tomatoes and a similar quantity of water. Stir it up and bring to a boil.
After the meat has been boiling for between an hour and 90 minutes, add the cabbage, garlic, carrots, onion, and celery. Cook until the vegetables are soft.
Add the beets and stir well.
Add as much or as little lemon juice and sugar as you like, to suit your own taste. Cook for 5 more minutes and serve.

recipes.title: Korean Shortribs
recipes.description: Korean shortribs or bulgogi is a kind of Korean barbecue, using shortribs that have been marinated in soy sauce, scallion, ginger, chiles, garlic, and sesame oil.

steps.text: Process all ingredients except meat in a blender until smooth. Pour into a gallon size zip-top bag, and add shortribs.
Toss to coat the meat in the marinade, and refrigerate overnight. Note that this flavors but does not tenderize the meat.
Preheat grill to 225–300°F. Add shortribs and cover. Cook 5 hours or until meat falls right off the bone and is extremely tender. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Crispy Sweet Potato Fries
recipes.description: Crispy on the outside, coated in a sweet maple glaze.

steps.text: Cover potatoes with water. Bring to a rolling boil and cook until tender.
Drain thoroughly and cold shock in a bowl of iced water. Drain again.
Combine syrup and vanilla; set aside.
Heat oil to 375°F and deep fry potatoes in batches until golden brown and crispy. Drain on a cooling rack.
Combine remaining ingredients and sprinkle on potatoes once all fried.
Warm syrup mixture in a large saucepan over low heat; toss with potatoes and serve.

recipes.title: Peas Supreme
recipes.description: Zapiekanka z zielonym groszkiem, kawałkami kasztana wodnego i pieczarkami w sosie maślanym.

ingredients.text: 1 can (4 ounces) sliced mushrooms, juice reserved
ingredients.name: pieczarki konserwowe

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Cook peas according to package instructions, then drain.
In a separate pan, melt butter.
Add mushroom juice and flour to melted butter. Stir until thickened.
Add mixture to peas, then add water chestnuts and mushrooms.
Place in medium baking pan coated with cooking spray.
Sprinkle breadcrumbs on top if desired.
Bake for 12–15 minutes, or until heated through.

recipes.title: Smoked Salmon Ravioli Filling
recipes.description: Filling for ravioli made with smoked salmon, ricotta or cottage cheese, egg and Parmesan.

steps.text: Mix the salmon, chives, lemon zest and seasonings in a bowl until salmon is well coated.
Mix the ricotta or cottage cheese, egg, and Parmesan cheese.
Add to the salmon and mix until well blended but not homogeneous.
Cover and refrigerate until the dough is ready.

categories: Recipes using vegetable broth and stock

recipes.title: Couscous bil Khodra (Libyan Vegetable Couscous)
recipes.description: Fluffy couscous cooked with a medley of vegetables and aromatic spices, popular in Libyan cuisine.

ingredients.text: 1 cup green beans, trimmed and cut into bite-sized pieces
ingredients.name: fasolka szparagowa
ingredients.note: trimmed and cut into bite-sized pieces

ingredients.text: 1 cup canned chickpeas, rinsed and drained
ingredients.name: ciecierzyca

ingredients.text: Fresh parsley or cilantro, chopped (for garnish)
ingredients.name: natka pietruszki

steps.text: In a large pot, heat olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic. Sauté until the onion becomes translucent.
Add the diced carrot, zucchini, bell pepper, and green beans to the pot. Stir and cook the vegetables for a few minutes until they start to soften.
Add the diced tomatoes, chickpeas, cumin, coriander, turmeric, paprika, salt, and pepper to the pot. Stir well to coat the vegetables with the spices.
Pour the vegetable broth into the pot. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low. Cover the pot and let the vegetables simmer for about 15–20 minutes, or until they are tender.
Meanwhile, prepare the couscous according to the package instructions. Typically, couscous is steamed or soaked in hot water until it becomes fluffy and tender. Fluff the cooked couscous with a fork.
Once the vegetables are cooked, remove the pot from the heat. Gently stir in the cooked couscous, ensuring that it is well-incorporated with the vegetables.
Taste and adjust the seasoning if needed. You can add more salt, pepper, or spices according to your preference.
Serve hot, garnished with freshly chopped parsley or cilantro.

recipes.title: Maja Blanca (Coconut Milk Pudding)
recipes.description: Maja blanca is a gelatin-like comfort food.

steps.text: In a bowl, dissolve cornstarch in 1 cup of coconut milk. Set aside.
In a pot, combine the remaining coconut milk, condensed milk, coconut cream, and sugar. Bring to a gentle boil over medium heat.
Gradually pour the cornstarch mixture into the pot while continuously stirring. Lower the heat and continue stirring until the mixture thickens, about 10–15 minutes.
If desired, add corn kernels into the mixture and stir for an additional 2–3 minutes.
Pour the mixture into a greased baking dish or other mold. Let it cool and set for at least an hour in the refrigerator.
Once set, slice the pudding into squares and sprinkle toasted coconut flakes on top before serving.

recipes.title: Shrimp Scampi Angel Hair Pasta with Lemon and Pine Nuts
recipes.description: Angel hair pasta tossed with garlic-butter shrimp scampi, lemon zest and juice, parsley and toasted pine nuts.

ingredients.text: 1 package (12 ounces) shrimp scampi, garlic and butter flavor
ingredients.name: krewetki

ingredients.text: ½ cup fresh flat-leaf parsley leaves, roughly chopped
ingredients.name: natka pietruszki

ingredients.text: Finely grated zest and juice of 1 lemon
ingredients.name: cytryna

ingredients.text: Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: sól
ingredients.note: kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper

steps.text: Boil large pot of cold water and salt it generously.
Add the pasta and cook, stirring occasionally until al dente, 4–5 minutes.
Drain the pasta reserving about 1 cup of the cooking water.
Prepare the shrimp in a large skillet according to package directions.
Stir the lemon zest and juice into the shrimp.
Add the pasta, reserved pasta water, parsley and pine nuts, and toss in the skillet to coat the pasta evenly.
Divide shrimp and pasta among warm pasta bowls and serve.

recipes.title: Greek Chicken Wrap
recipes.description: Tortille z kurczakiem, serem feta, sosem jogurtowym i oregano, podawane na zimno.

ingredients.text: ½ cup fresh oregano, finely chopped
ingredients.name: oregano świeże

steps.text: Combine feta, chicken, yogurt sauce, and oregano. Set aside.
Brush one side of each tortilla with olive oil. Add ¼ of chicken mixture and roll the longer side up.
Repeat until all tortillas have been rolled.
Sprinkle with additional chopped oregano, and serve cold as a snack.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Sauce
recipes.description: Sos maślano-czosnkowy, dobry do filetów, owoców morza i smażonego kurczaka.

ingredients.text: ¼ tsp freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: pieprz czarny

steps.text: Melt 2 tbsp butter in large straight-sided sauté pan over medium high heat.
Add garlic and shallot, and cook until garlic is golden.
Add remaining ingredients, and cook just until butter is melted.
Remove from heat and allow to come down to room temperature.
Purée sauce in batches until smooth.
Return to pan and heat through on low heat.

recipes.title: Parmesan Encrusted Tilapia
recipes.description: Tilapia fillets coated in a crust of croutons, Parmesan and spices, then baked until flaky.

ingredients.text: ½ cup garlic-flavored croûtons, finely crushed
ingredients.name: grzanki czosnkowe

steps.text: Combine salt, cayenne, pepper, croûtons, and cheese. Set aside.
Coat fish with melted butter. Dredge both sides in cheese mixture. Let rest 2–3 minutes.
Dip fish in olive oil. Place on a shallow roasting pan and bake in a 400°F oven for 11–12 minutes or until fish is opaque and flakes easily when tested with a fork.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Veal Stock
recipes.description: White (fond blanc) and brown (fond brun) veal stock in the French style, cooked for several hours from bones and vegetables.

ingredients.text: 5 lb veal shank, sawn into 2-inch lengths
ingredients.name: goleń cielęca

ingredients.text: 2 lb veal shin bones, sawn into 2-inch lengths
ingredients.name: kość cielęca

ingredients.text: ½ lb (2 medium) onions, in medium dice
ingredients.name: cebula

ingredients.text: 4 oz (2 medium) carrots, peeled and in medium dice
ingredients.name: marchew
ingredients.note: 2 medium, peeled and in medium dice

ingredients.text: 4 oz (2 stalks) celery with leaves, sliced
ingredients.name: seler naciowy

ingredients.text: 4 oz (2 medium) leeks including 2 inches of the green part, sliced and washed thoroughly
ingredients.name: por
ingredients.note: 2 medium, including 2 inches of the green part, sliced and washed thoroughly

ingredients.text: 2 medium ripe tomatoes (for brown stock only), peeled, seeded, juiced, and diced
ingredients.name: pomidor
ingredients.note: for brown stock only, ripe, peeled, seeded, juiced, and diced

ingredients.text: ½ cup tomato purée (for brown stock only)
ingredients.name: purée pomidorowe

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons of butter (for browning, brown stock)
ingredients.name: masło
ingredients.note: for browning the bones and vegetables (brown stock)

steps.text: Put the veal and chicken bones into a stock pot, and add enough water to cover the bones by 2 inches.
Bring to a simmer over medium heat, and skim off any scum as it forms. Simmer for 30 minutes - do not boil.
Add the vegetables and seasonings and simmer for 6 to 8 hours.
Remove the bones with tongs or a spider and strain into another container. Rinse the pot.
Strain the stock back into the stock pot through a double layer of damp cheesecloth.
Place the pot in a sink of cold water and allow to cool. Refrigerate.
Remove from the refrigerator and lift off the layer of fat.
Divide into suitably sized portions and freeze.
Brown the bones and vegetables in a 400°F (180°C) oven in 2 tablespoons of butter, turning from time to time. Do not allow them to burn.
Add bones and vegetables to the stock pot, then deglaze the browning pan with water, and add it to the pot.
Simmer for 30 minutes, removing scum as it forms.
Add the tomato and the tomato purée and proceed with the recipe as above.

recipes.title: Taco Meat
recipes.description: Mięso mielone w stylu tex-mex z cebulą, pomidorem i przyprawami do tacos.

ingredients.text: 1 pound (about 500 g) ground beef or turkey
ingredients.name: wołowina mielona

ingredients.text: 1 medium onion, finely chopped (or 1 ½ teaspoons onion powder)
ingredients.name: cebula
ingredients.note: medium, finely chopped (or 1 ½ teaspoons onion powder)

ingredients.text: 1 medium tomato, chopped (or 1 small can of tomato sauce)
ingredients.name: pomidor
ingredients.note: medium, chopped (or 1 small can of tomato sauce)

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon chili powder (or ⅓ teaspoon each oregano, cumin, garlic powder)
ingredients.name: chili w proszku
ingredients.note: or ⅓ teaspoon each oregano, cumin, garlic powder

steps.text: Brown beef and onion together. Drain grease.
Add the rest of the ingredients to the browned meat.
Stir well.
Heat this mixture thoroughly.
Add more tomato sauce if the mixture is dry.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes, or less if the mixture begins to dry out.

recipes.title: Mesir Wat (Spicy Ethiopian Lentil Stew)
recipes.description: A spicy vegetarian Ethiopian stew of red lentils, berbere, and tomato paste, traditionally served with injera.

ingredients.text: ½ teaspoon salt, or to taste
ingredients.name: sól

ingredients.text: Fresh parsley or cilantro, chopped, for garnish
ingredients.name: natka pietruszki
ingredients.note: fresh parsley or cilantro, chopped, for garnish

steps.text: Place the rinsed red lentils in a large pot and add the water. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the lentils for about 15–20 minutes or until they are soft and cooked through. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking. Once cooked, remove from heat and set aside.
In a separate large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and sauté until it becomes translucent and slightly browned.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and sauté for an additional minute until fragrant.
Stir in the berbere spice blend, tomato paste, ground cumin, ground turmeric, salt, and black pepper. Mix well to combine the spices with the onions and garlic.
Add the cooked lentils to the pot, including any remaining cooking liquid. Stir well to incorporate the lentils with the spices.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for an additional 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, to allow the flavors to meld together.
Taste the stew and adjust the seasoning with salt and pepper if needed.
Remove the pot from the heat and let rest for a few minutes before serving.
Garnish with fresh chopped parsley or cilantro. Enjoy hot with injera or bread.

images: Turkey and Barley Cabbage Roll in Tomato Sauce.jpg

recipes.title: Turkey & Barley Cabbage Rolls with Fresh Dill
recipes.description: Cabbage rolls adapted with pearl barley instead of rice and lean ground turkey instead of red meat, seasoned with fresh dill.

ingredients.text: 2 cloves garlic, minced (or ½ tsp garlic powder)
ingredients.name: czosnek

ingredients.text: ¼ cup chopped fresh dill, loosely packed (plus extra for garnish)
ingredients.name: koperek
ingredients.note: chopped fresh, loosely packed (plus extra for garnish)

ingredients.text: 1 can (796 mL) no-salt-added crushed or diced tomatoes
ingredients.name: pomidory z puszki

ingredients.text: 1 tsp maple syrup or brown sugar (optional)
ingredients.name: syrop klonowy
ingredients.note: optional, maple syrup or brown sugar

steps.text: Simmer barley in the broth until tender (about 30–40 minutes). Drain excess liquid if needed and set aside to cool.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Core the cabbage and place it in the pot. Simmer for 5–10 minutes, removing leaves as they soften. Reserve 10–12 large leaves for rolling.
In a large bowl, make the filling by combining the cooked barley, ground turkey, onion, garlic, egg, dill, salt, and pepper.

Spread a cabbage leaf out flat on a work surface. Place 2–3 tablespoons of filling near the base of each cabbage leaf. Fold in the sides and roll up tightly to enclose the filling. Repeat with the remaining filling and cabbage leaves.

Prepare the sauce by mixing the crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, canola oil, paprika, and apple cider vinegar in a bowl or large measuring cup. Add the sugar or maple syrup if you like your sauces a bit sweeter.

Spread a few spoonfuls of the sauce on the bottom of a large baking dish or pot. Arrange the cabbage rolls over the tomatoes, seam-side down. Pour the rest of the sauce over top of the rolls. Sprinkle with extra dill if desired.
For the oven method, cover with foil and bake at 175 °C (350 °F) for 1 hour. For the stovetop method, simmer gently, covered, on low heat for 1 hour.

categories: Recipes using chile paste and sauce

recipes.title: Sour Cream Chili Sauce
recipes.description: A creamy, mildly spicy dip made from mayonnaise, sour cream, chili sauce and cayenne pepper.

steps.text: Stir all ingredients together well.

recipes.title: Homemade Five-Spice Powder
recipes.description: Chinese five spice powder is a convenient seasoning for Cantonese cuisine, combining sweet, sour, bitter, pungent and salty flavours.

steps.text: Toast the Szechuan peppercorns in a dry frying pan for about 3 minutes.
Grind the peppercorns in a pepper grinder or coffee grinder together with the star anise pods.
Sift the ground spices to remove any larger bits.
Mix together the cloves, cinnamon, and fennel seeds.
Grind the completed mixture until it is a very fine powder.
Use sparingly, as it is extremely pungent.

recipes.title: Orange Soda II
recipes.description: Orange soda is a sweetened, carbonated beverage flavored with orange.

steps.text: Remove the zest from the oranges in strips, leaving behind the bitter white pith.
Combine the sugar and orange zest in a container, and let this sit in the fridge for 24 hours. The sugar will extract the liquid from the citrus peels and produce a syrupy liquid.
Stir the orange juice into the sugar mixture until everything is dissolved. Strain out the solids to yield slightly under ½ cup (120 ml) syrup.
To make the finished soda, combine 1 volume of syrup with 3 volumes of carbonated water.

recipes.title: Cheese Tart
recipes.description: A tart filled with a mixture of Brie and mascarpone cheese, sugar and melted butter, baked in a pie dough shell.

ingredients.text: ½ cup Brie cheese, rind removed
ingredients.name: ser brie

ingredients.text: ½ dough from Classic American Apple Pie, made with mascarpone cheese instead of applejack
ingredients.name: ciasto kruche
ingredients.note: from Classic American Apple Pie, made with mascarpone cheese instead of applejack

steps.text: Mash together all ingredients except dough. Set aside.
Roll out dough into a rough circle.
Place dough in a 10-inch tart pan to make a tart shell, and remove the excess dough from the edges.
Transfer the cheese mixture into tart shell and bake at 425°F on the bottom of the oven for 15 minutes.
Move to the bottom rack and bake for 10 minutes more.
Remove and let rest 10 minutes.
Serve.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Glazed Apples
recipes.description: Apples cooked in butter and then finished with a sauce of sugar, cinnamon, orange juice and brandy. Serve with pork chops or as a dessert.

ingredients.text: 2 Honeycrisp apples, cut into ½-inch wedges
ingredients.name: jabłko

steps.text: Melt 2 tbsp of the butter in a large stainless steel skillet over medium heat.
Add apples and cook, tossing often, until lightly browned around edges. Remove and keep warm.
Add sugar, salt, orange, and cinnamon to pan. Scrape with a metal whisk to loosen browned bits.
Melt in butter, 1 tbsp at a time, while whisking continuously. Once all butter has been melted, bring to a boil (the fiercer the boil, the flashier the show).
Carefully add brandy and, if it hasn't ignited by itself, do so with a long match or a firestick.
Add apples and cook 1–2 minutes, depending on how soft you want your apples.
Remove apples from pan and drizzle with sauce. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Rosemary Garlic Baked Potatoes
recipes.description: Baked potatoes infused with rosemary and garlic, a delicious side dish.

steps.text: Heat oven to 400ºF (205°C).
Wash potatoes and pierce all over with fork.
Lay each potato on an individual 9-inch (23 cm) square piece of aluminum foil (or sized to fit potato).
Pour 1 tablespoon of olive oil on each potato. Make sure the entire potato skin is coated in oil.
Sprinkle ¼ of the chopped garlic, rosemary, salt and pepper over the entire skin of each potato.
Wrap each potato in aluminum foil.
Place foil-wrapped potatoes on baking sheet (to catch any leaking olive oil).
Bake in oven for 1 hour.

categories: Recipes using vegetable broth and stock

recipes.title: Ikijumba (Rwandan Sweet Potato Stew)
recipes.description: A comforting and flavorful sweet potato stew from Rwanda, made with tender sweet potatoes, vegetables, and aromatic spices.

ingredients.text: ½ teaspoon cayenne pepper (optional, adjust to taste)
ingredients.name: pieprz cayenne

ingredients.text: Fresh parsley or cilantro, chopped, for garnish
ingredients.name: natka pietruszki lub kolendra świeża

steps.text: In a large pot, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and minced garlic, and sauté until the onion is soft and translucent.
Add the diced sweet potatoes, carrot, and green bell pepper to the pot. Stir well to combine with the onions and garlic.
Sprinkle the curry powder and cayenne pepper (if using) over the vegetables, and season with salt and black pepper to taste. Stir again to coat the vegetables with the spices.
Pour in the vegetable broth or water, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and let the stew simmer for about 15–20 minutes, or until the sweet potatoes are tender and cooked through.
Stir occasionally during cooking to prevent sticking and to ensure even cooking of the vegetables.
Once the sweet potatoes are cooked, add the diced tomatoes to the stew. Stir well and let it simmer for an additional 5 minutes to allow the flavors to meld together.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed, adding more salt or spices according to your preference.
Remove the pot from the heat, and let the ikijumba rest for a few minutes before serving.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro before serving.

recipes.title: Mango and Yellow Split Pea Curry
recipes.description: Mango Dal, also known as Amchur Dal, is a vegetarian dish from Southern India which is also popular in the West. It is popular amongst vegetarians and people who wish to limit the amount of meat in their diet.

ingredients.text: 2 cans mango (or fresh mango if available), sliced
ingredients.name: mango
ingredients.note: or fresh mango if available, sliced

steps.text: Soak dal overnight.
Boil dal in water. Rinse, drain, and keep in separate container.
Boil mango slices in their juice. Add boiled dal and add additional water if required.
In a separate pan, sauté onion, ginger paste, and garlic paste in oil until golden brown.
In a separate pan heat ghee, hing, turmeric, garam masala, chilli powder, mustard seeds, and cumin.
Add all mixtures together in boiling mango and dal pot.
Add fenugreek leaves, and continue boiling.
Allow to cool and serve with rotis or naan and rice.

recipes.title: Spicy Feta Burger
recipes.description: Burgery z mielonej wołowiny z pikantnymi przyprawami i nadzieniem z sera feta.

steps.text: Mix spices into beef, using hands, until well-mixed.
Form 8 small balls of meat, then press into very flat pancake shapes.
Top four with about 2 tbsp crumbled feta cheese, then cover with the other four.
Press together firmly to flatten, then crimp edges tightly to make four burgers. Chill.
Cook as regular burgers in a skillet or on the grill. Handle gently to avoid crumbling.
Serve on toasted white or rye bread with spicy mustard.

recipes.title: Chipotle BBQ Ribs
recipes.description: Smoky but sweet, Southwestern U.S. style ribs.

steps.text: Season ribs with BBQ rub.
Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Combine BBQ sauce with molasses.
Place hickory chunks into a 325–350°F smoker or in a charcoal grill set for indirect heat at 325–350°F.
Place ribs into smoker or grill and cook for 3–4 hours, brushing with molasses mixture often.
Brush ribs with remaining sauce and place on a medium-high grill and sear until well-browned.
Let sit for 15 minutes; serve.

recipes.title: Sweet and Spicy Shrimp
recipes.description: Shrimp dredged in flour and cornmeal, deep-fried, then tossed in a sweet and spicy orange, honey and hoisin glaze.

ingredients.text: ½ cup frozen orange juice concentrate
ingredients.name: koncentrat soku pomarańczowego

steps.text: Dredge shrimp in flour, then dip into cornmeal.
Set aside for 2–3 minutes.
Heat oil in a deep-fryer or a pot to 375°F.
Add shrimp and fry until golden brown.
Drain on a wire rack.
Heat remaining ingredients in a large saucepan over medium-high heat until boiling.
Add shrimp and toss to coat.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: New Orleans Style Chicken Wing Dipping Sauce
recipes.description: A creamy blue cheese dipping sauce with Creole mustard and scallions, served with chicken wings or raw vegetables.

ingredients.text: 1 jar (12 ounces) of refrigerated chunky blue cheese dressing
ingredients.name: sos ranch z kawałkami sera pleśniowego

ingredients.text: ⅓ cup scallions, finely chopped (reserve a teaspoon of chopped green tops for garnish)
ingredients.name: szczypiorek
ingredients.note: finely chopped; reserve a teaspoon of chopped green tops for garnish

steps.text: Combine all ingredients and refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving (overnight is preferable).
Garnish with the reserved scallions.

recipes.title: Inyama y'isugi (Rwandan Grilled Pork)
recipes.description: Inyama y'isugi is a traditional Rwandan dish of succulent grilled pork. The pork is marinated in a flavorful blend of spices and grilled to perfection, resulting in tender and juicy meat with a smoky flavor.

ingredients.text: 2 pounds (900 grams) pork loin or pork chops
ingredients.name: schab wieprzowy

steps.text: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a small bowl, combine the vegetable oil, minced garlic, grated ginger, paprika, cayenne pepper, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper. Mix well to form a paste.
Rub the spice paste all over the pork loin or pork chops, ensuring they are well coated.
Place the marinated pork on the preheated grill and cook for about 4–5 minutes per side, or until the internal temperature reaches 145°F (63°C) for medium doneness.
While grilling, baste the pork with any remaining spice paste using a basting brush to enhance the flavor and keep it moist.
Once cooked, remove the pork from the grill and let it rest for a few minutes before slicing.
Slice the grilled pork into thin strips and serve hot. If desired, drizzle fresh lemon juice over the grilled pork slices for a tangy twist.

recipes.title: Taro Fish
recipes.description: Vegetarian Chinese dish of mashed taro rolled in nori to resemble a fish, served with stir-fried pepper, ginger and spring onions.

steps.text: Peel and chop taro into 1-inch chunks. Steam until soft.
Meanwhile soak black beans in a little water.
Mash taro with the vegetable stock powder.
Place 2 sheets of nori on the bench, moistening one to join them together.
Place the mashed taro mixture in the centre of the sheets and roll the nori sheets over the top.
Cut the nori at one end to resemble fish fins.
Slice green pepper, ginger and spring onions into thin strips and stir fry for a few minutes.
Add the Shaoxing wine and black beans.
Make cuts halfway through the taro fish at about 1 inch intervals and pour the sauce over it.
Serve on a platter.

recipes.title: Honey Mustard Salmon
recipes.description: Prosty przepis na łososia zapiekanego w miodowo-musztardowej glazurze.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F/180°C.
Wash and pat dry the salmon fillet.
Remove the pin bones (if there are any), and cut salmon into portions if desired.
Mix honey and mustard, and adjust mixture to taste.
Spread mixture generously over and under the salmon.
Cook in oven on top rack for about 15–18 minutes (depending on how you like your salmon cooked).
Finish under broiler for 2–3 minutes, but remove before glaze starts to char.

recipes.title: Gambian Chicken with Lemon and Mustard (Yassa)
recipes.description: Yassa is a popular Gambian dish known for its tangy and flavorful marinade made with onions, lemons, and mustard. It is commonly prepared with chicken or fish and is loved for its zesty and aromatic taste.

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon fresh thyme leaves (or 1 teaspoon of dried thyme)
ingredients.name: tymianek świeży

ingredients.text: 500 g chicken or fish, cut into pieces
ingredients.name: kurczak lub ryba
ingredients.note: chicken or fish, cut into pieces

steps.text: In a large bowl, combine the sliced onions, lemon juice, vegetable oil, Dijon mustard, minced garlic, thyme leaves, paprika, black pepper, and salt to make a marinade.

Add the chicken or fish pieces to the marinade and mix well to ensure they are evenly coated. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or preferably overnight, to allow the flavors to develop.
Remove the chicken or fish from the marinade, reserving the marinade for later use.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken or fish to the hot skillet and cook until browned on all sides and cooked through. Remove from the pan and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the sliced onions from the marinade and sauté until they become soft and translucent.

Return the cooked chicken or fish to the skillet with the sautéed onions. Pour the reserved marinade over the meat and onions. Reduce the heat to low and let the mixture simmer for about 15–20 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld together.
Taste and adjust the seasoning with salt and pepper if needed.
Serve hot with steamed rice, couscous, or bread.

recipes.title: Glazed Onion Canapes
recipes.description: Caramelized onions glazed with honey and brown sugar, served on crackers with sour cream.

steps.text: Melt half the butter in a small saucepan.
Turn the burner to medium heat. Add the diced onions to the pan.
Slowly caramelize the onions, adding in the rest of the butter as needed to keep from burning.
Once caramelized, add the brown sugar and the honey. Combine thoroughly until all the onions are glazed.
Place onions attractively onto the crackers, and finish with a small dollop of sour cream.

categories: Recipes using beef broth and stock

recipes.title: Chili Colorado
recipes.description: Gulasz chili z suszonych papryczek New Mexico i wołowiny chuck.

ingredients.text: 9 New Mexico dry chiles, washed, with stems and seeds removed
ingredients.name: papryczka chili suszona
ingredients.note: washed, with stems and seeds removed

ingredients.text: 5 pounds boneless beef chuck roast, trimmed of fat
ingredients.name: wołowina, udziec bez kości

steps.text: Place chiles and 3 cups water into a medium stockpot, and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and steep for 30 minutes to soften. Strain into a bowl, reserving the cooking liquid.

Place the chiles and some of the liquid into a blender, and purée until smooth. Add more liquid as necessary to form a smooth sauce. Pass sauce through a fine mesh strainer to remove any seeds and the tough skins; set aside.
Cut the beef into 1–2-inch chunks. In a medium bowl, combine flour, salt, and pepper. Dredge the beef chunks in the seasoned flour; set aside.

Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Sauté onion until tender and translucent, about 5 minutes. Add beef chunks a few at a time, so as not to overcrowd the pot, and cook until evenly brown. Remove cooked meat, and continue browning remaining meat.
Return reserved cooked meat to the pot. Stir in pureed chile mixture. Add beef stock to just cover beef chunks, or to personal preference. Bring to a boil over medium heat.
Reduce heat to lowest setting, and simmer for 3 hours, or until meat is tender. If necessary, adjust with more stock during cooking.

recipes.title: Taboon Bread
recipes.description: Taboon bread, also spelled tabun bread, is one of the various baked flatbreads found primarily in the areas surrounding the Palestinian village of Al-Jabal.

steps.text: Mix the dry ingredients together.
Add olive oil, then gradually knead in enough water to make a dough.
Knead for 10 minutes.
Divide the dough into balls, and allow them to rest for an hour until risen.
Sprinkle a flat working surface with flour, and roll the dough balls into flat, circular-shaped patties.
Preheat an oven containing a bed of smooth beach stones to 200°C (400°F). Alternatively, you can place the stones on a tray or pan in the oven.
Place the flat dough upon the stones, and bake for about 8 minutes until it produces bubbles.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Carrot Fufu
recipes.description: Carrot fufu is a swallow made from carrot, common in Nigeria due to its low carbohydrate content.

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon psyllium husk powder or xanthan gum
ingredients.name: łuska babki jajowatej w proszku lub guma ksantanowa
ingredients.note: psyllium husk powder or xanthan gum

steps.text: Blend the chopped carrot until smooth.
Transfer the carrot to the cheesecloth, and squeeze out all the water from the carrot paste.
Cook the carrot paste in a pot over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Stir in the psyllium husk to thicken and bind the fufu.

recipes.title: Mince Pie Tartlets with Pork
recipes.description: Mince pie tartlets filled with a fruit mince mixture, sliced apples and browned pork mince.

ingredients.text: 800 g cored and sliced apples (from about 12 large apples)s
ingredients.name: jabłko
ingredients.note: cored and sliced, from about 12 large apples

steps.text: Preheat oven to 150 °C (300 °F).
In a pot, bring the sugar, wine, cider, orange, and lemon juice to a simmer.
Add mace, nutmeg, and cinnamon.
Split the vanilla pod and scrape seeds into pot. Discard vanilla pod.
Stir in sliced apples and fruit mix.
Grease the muffin tins, and line with pastry dough to make tartlet cases. Trim to fit.
Place cases into oven, and bake until lightly golden. Remove from oven and let cool.
Melt butter in a pan. Add minced pork, and sauté until browned.
Remove cinnamon stick from the fruit mixture, and mix in the pork.
Using a tablespoon, fill tartlet cases with the filling—it will probably be mounded.
If desired, trim with excess pastry.
Bake each tray at 120 °C (250 °F) for half an hour.

recipes.title: Gooey Butter Cake
recipes.description: This rich dessert originates from Saint Louis, Missouri, USA.

ingredients.text: 1 box (18.25 oz) of yellow cake mix
ingredients.name: mieszanka do ciasta żółtego

steps.text: Combine the cake mix, one egg, and 4 oz butter to create a stiff dough.
Spray a 9 × 13-inch pan with oil.
Spread the dough evenly in the pan and up the sides.
Melt the remaining butter, and mix the remaining ingredients to create the filling, adding the cream cheese and then the confectioner's sugar last.
Gently warming the cream cheese aids mixing.
Pour the filling into the crust, and bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.
Allow to cool and firm up.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Croutons
recipes.description: Sweet cinnamon croûtons that can be served with a fruit salad or added to pumpkin, sweet potato, or carrot soups.

steps.text: Combine sugar and cinnamon in a small bowl, and set aside.
Preheat the oven to 350°F (~180°C).
Heat the walnut oil in a frying pan.
Add the bread cubes, then fry them, tossing to coat with oil.
Spread the bread cubes on a baking sheet and sprinkle with cinnamon sugar.
Bake for 8 minutes or until crispy and dry.
Allow to cool well before handling, as the sugar will make these croûtons easier to brown, and thus hotter to handle initially.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cream Pie
recipes.description: A tasty pie that doesn't require baking.

ingredients.text: ¼ cup (60 ml) white granulated sugar
ingredients.name: cukier

ingredients.text: 2 pounds (900 g) fresh strawberries, cleaned and sliced
ingredients.name: truskawka

steps.text: Combine sugar and cream in large mixing bowl, and whip until soft and fluffy.
Spread whipped cream in pie crust.
Spread strawberries over whipped cream.
Cover and chill overnight.

recipes.title: East African Beef Pilaf
recipes.description: A fragrant East African rice dish cooked with beef and spices, usually served with kachumbari.

ingredients.text: 400 g rice, washed and soaked for 10 minutes
ingredients.name: ryż

steps.text: Place beef in a pot with water, ginger-garlic paste, salt, grated tomato, and grated onion. Bring to a boil, and cook until the meat is tender.
Remove the meat and set aside. Save the resulting broth for cooking the rice.
Heat a layer of cooking oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the cumin, cardamom seeds, pepper, cinnamon, and cloves; then, cook until the spices splutter.
Add the chopped onion. Cook, stirring, until translucent. If you want a darker pilaf, fry the onions until they are caramelized.
Stir in the turmeric and coriander powder. Let fry for a few minutes.
Stir in the garlic paste and a bit of chopped fresh coriander.
Add the cooked meat, and stir together for 2 minutes.
Add the broth, and bring to a simmer. Adjust the seasoning with salt to taste—make sure to add enough salt because you still need to add the rice.
Stir in the rice and a little coriander. Cook on high heat for about 3 minutes.
Reduce the heat to medium, and cover the pot. Cook, stirring periodically, until the rice has absorbed the water.
Reduce the heat to low, and let the rice finish steaming for 5 minutes.
Remove from the heat and serve with kachumbari.

recipes.title: Egg with Cabbage and Turkish Sausage
recipes.description: Eggs cooked with Turkish sausage (sucuk) and spicy cabbage, served on their own or with rice.

ingredients.text: 1 tbsp red pepper paste (like Korean gochujang or similar)
ingredients.name: pasta z czerwonej papryki

ingredients.text: 1 large tbsp peanut butter (organic peanut butter without added hydrogenated oils recommended)
ingredients.name: masło orzechowe
ingredients.note: large; organic without added hydrogenated oils recommended

steps.text: Heat olive oil in a medium-sized pot with lid.
Add sliced sucuk and quickly brown.
Mix in chopped cabbage and red pepper paste.
Mix in the water and peanut butter.
Cover lid and cook for around 5–10 minutes, depending on how crispy you want the cabbage.
Crack 2–3 eggs into the pot. Cover, and cook until the eggs are done.
Serve with rice or meat. If desired, garnish with a little tabasco and/or finely-chopped herbs.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Banana Oatmeal
recipes.description: A version of oatmeal with peanut butter, banana, and honey.

ingredients.text: 1 cup rolled oats or instant oats
ingredients.name: płatki owsiane

ingredients.text: ½ tbsp (or more) honey, to taste
ingredients.name: miód

steps.text: Cook the oats in water. If using regular oats this should take around 10 minutes, while instant oats will cook more quickly.
Put the cooked oats in a bowl.
Add milk, peanut butter, honey and sliced banana.
Mash until the banana and ingredients are all thoroughly combined.
Top with honey and serve warm.

recipes.title: Applewood Bacon
recipes.description: Homemade bacon from a pork belly, cured in an apple cider brine and cold-smoked over applewood.

ingredients.text: 1 pork belly from the loin end
ingredients.name: boczek wieprzowy

steps.text: In a large pot, bring the apple cider to a boil.
Stir in salt and sugar until dissolved.
Transfer the cider mixture to a very large container and add iced water.
Once the ice has melted and the brine is cool enough, submerge the pork belly in the brine.
Refrigerate for 3 days.
Remove the belly and place it on top of a running box fan for 30 minutes per side to dry out.
Place dry applewood chunks in the firebox of a cold smoker.
Insert the pork belly and smoke for 3–4 hours.
Remove from the smoker and place in the freezer for up to 2 hours.
Slice the bacon as thick or as thin as you like, and cook or refrigerate for up to 3 weeks.

recipes.title: Dosa I
recipes.description: Cienkie, chrupiące naleśniki (dosa) z ciasta z ryżu i urad dal, fermentowanego przez noc.

steps.text: Put the rice and dal in a large pot and wash twice.
Fill with water until the rice and dal are submerged by 2 inches.
Soak for 6 hours.
Grind in a blender, water and all, for 30 minutes. If the weather is cold, grind in a handful of cooked rice and a pinch of sugar to help with the fermentation process.
Let ferment overnight in a warm place. Make sure the pot is twice as large as the amount of batter, as it will rise a great deal.
Add salt; at this point the batter can be kept in the refrigerator for more than a week until you wish to fry the dosas.
Heat a tava (large flat pan) or griddle over a high flame.
Sprinkle water on the pan to cool it a little.
Pour ½–¾ cup batter in the middle of the pan, depending on preferred thickness and crispiness.
Spread the batter with the back of a spoon, starting from the centre and spiralling outwards until the dosa is about 10 inches across and very thin.
Sprinkle a little oil around the edges of the dosa.
Cover until the dosa shows brown through the thinnest parts.
Flip the dosa to the other side, and allow it to cook for a few seconds.
Fold in half and remove with a metal spatula.

recipes.title: Chicken with Paprika and Cream
recipes.description: Boneless chicken breasts baked with paprika, half and half, lemon juice and processed cheese.

ingredients.text: 3 slices of Provel (a brand of processed cheese product) or Muenster
ingredients.name: ser topiony w plastrach
ingredients.note: Provel (a brand of processed cheese product) or Muenster

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in a baking dish.
Bake at 400°F (205°C) until internal temperature of the chicken breasts reaches 165°F (74°C).

recipes.title: Quiche Lorraine
recipes.description: A tall, fluffy custard quiche with pork belly lardons, onion confit, cheese and thyme, a brief version of Thomas Keller's Bouchon recipe with less filling and more custard.

ingredients.text: ¾ lb pork belly, skinned and cut into lardons 1½ x ⅜ inches
ingredients.name: boczek wieprzowy
ingredients.note: skinned and cut into lardons 1½ x ⅜ inches

ingredients.text: ¼ tsp fresh ground black pepper
ingredients.name: pieprz czarny mielony

ingredients.text: 1 tall quiche shell, baked as directed in a 9x2-inch quiche ring on parchment
ingredients.name: spód do quiche
ingredients.note: baked as directed in a 9x2-inch quiche ring on parchment

ingredients.text: ½ cup grated Comté or Emmentaler cheese
ingredients.name: ser Comté lub emmental

steps.text: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Bake pork belly lardons on baking sheet for 20–25 minutes. The fat should be rendered, but the pork should not be crisp.
Drain pork belly lardons on paper towels.
Lower oven heat to 325°F (163°C).
Add onion confit, pork, salt, pepper, and thyme to the frying pan over medium heat. Allow to warm up for 4 minutes.
Drain the mixture on paper towels.
Arrange ¼ cup cheese and half the pork mixture in the bottom of the quiche shell.

Pour half the quiche batter into the shell, and check for leaks. If the shell is leaking a tiny bit or not at all, you can continue; if it's leaking a lot, it's best to bake the mixture in a casserole dish and serve the crust on the side.
Sprinkle the rest of cheese evenly over the filling, then top with the remaining pork mixture.
Add enough quiche batter to fill the rest of the crust without spilling. You may not need all of it.

Bake the quiche for about 90 minutes, checking every so often. The quiche is done when it's browned on top and it jiggles slightly like a properly set custard when you shake the pan. If it still looks quite liquid, it probably needs more time. If it's hard, puffed up a lot, and doesn't really jiggle, it might be overbaked. Adjust the time and temperature accordingly for your oven.
Cool completely at room temperature, then chill in the fridge at least overnight and up to 3 days.

Cut the excess crust off the top of the quiche ring, then run a paring knife carefully between the ring and the crust to separate them. Remove the ring, then slice the quiche. Serve at room temperature or warm up for 15 minutes at 350–375°F.

recipes.title: Liberian Fried Fish
recipes.description: Crispy on the outside and tender inside, this Liberian fried fish is coated in buttermilk and a seasoned flour mixture, then deep-fried.

ingredients.text: 2 pounds fresh fish (tilapia, snapper, or any firm white fish)
ingredients.name: ryba biała
ingredients.note: tilapia, snapper, or any firm white fish

steps.text: Clean and gut the fish, removing any scales and innards. Rinse the fish thoroughly under cold running water and pat them dry with paper towels.
In a large bowl, mix the all-purpose flour, salt, ground black pepper, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, and cayenne pepper (if using).
Pour the buttermilk into another bowl.
Dip each fish into the buttermilk, allowing any excess to drip off, and then coat the fish with the seasoned flour mixture, pressing the flour onto the fish to adhere.
