Heat about 1 inch of vegetable oil in a deep frying pan or pot over medium-high heat. To test if the oil is hot enough, drop a small piece of bread into the oil; it should sizzle and turn golden brown.
Carefully place the coated fish in the hot oil, working in batches if necessary to avoid overcrowding the pan.
Fry the fish for about 3–4 minutes per side, or until they are golden brown and cooked through. Use tongs or a slotted spoon to flip the fish during frying.
Remove the fried fish from the oil and place them on a plate lined with paper towels to drain any excess oil.
Serve the fish hot, with your favorite side dishes like plantains, rice, or salad.

recipes.title: Orange Soda I
recipes.description: Quick and easy homemade orange soda.

ingredients.text: 2¼ cups (560 ml / 19 oz) water, warm or room temperature
ingredients.name: woda

ingredients.text: 2¾ cups (650 ml / 625 g / 1.38 lb) white granulated sugar
ingredients.name: cukier

ingredients.text: 1 oz (30 ml / 28 g) orange juice concentrate or orange syrup
ingredients.name: koncentrat soku pomarańczowego

steps.text: Combine the water and sugar in a 2-quart or larger saucepan.
Stir over medium heat until the sugar dissolves into a syrup, then remove from the heat.
Stir the orange juice concentrate into the syrup.
Using a funnel, transfer the syrup to an empty bottle and let it cool.
To make the finished syrup, mix one volume of syrup with one volume of carbonated water.

recipes.title: Chishimba (Zambian Cassava Cake)
recipes.description: Chishimba is a Zambian dessert made from cassava, showcasing the unique flavor of this root vegetable in a sweet and moist cake.

steps.text: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and grease a 9-inch round cake pan with vegetable oil.
In a mixing bowl, combine the grated cassava, shredded coconut, and brown sugar. Mix well to evenly distribute the ingredients.
Add the beaten eggs, coconut milk, vegetable oil, and vanilla extract to the bowl. Mix thoroughly until all the ingredients are well combined.
Sprinkle in the ground cinnamon, ground nutmeg, baking powder, and a pinch of salt. Stir the mixture until the spices and baking powder are fully incorporated.
Pour the batter into the greased cake pan, smoothing the top with a spatula or the back of a spoon.
Place the cake pan in the preheated oven and bake for approximately 40–45 minutes, or until the cake is golden brown and a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Once the chishimba is fully baked, remove it from the oven and let it cool in the cake pan for a few minutes.
After cooling slightly, transfer the cake to a wire rack to cool completely before slicing and serving.

recipes.title: Mohingha (Burmese Fish Noodle Soup)
recipes.description: Mohingha is a traditional Burmese dish made of colored soup with rice vermicelli.

steps.text: In a large bowl, mix sunflower oil, garlic cloves, soup powder, and lemonade.
In a small bowl, mix boiling water, diced jalapeño peppers, and ketchup.
Combine both mixtures, and continue mixing.
Add rice vermicelli to the bowl; cover it and wait.
Top it with toppings as desired.

recipes.title: Firecracker Marinade
recipes.description: A very hot marinade made from habanero chiles, lemon juice, white wine, butter and olive oil.

steps.text: Run everything in a blender until smooth.
Keep refrigerated for up to 1 ½ weeks.
Shake well before using.

recipes.title: Ifisashi (Zambian Peanut and Spinach Stew)
recipes.description: Ifisashi is a delicious and hearty Zambian stew made with a flavorful combination of peanuts and spinach.

ingredients.text: 2 cups raw shelled and skinned peanuts
ingredients.name: orzeszki ziemne

steps.text: In a large pot, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the pot. Sauté until the onions are soft and translucent.
Add the diced tomato, green bell pepper, and red bell pepper to the pot. Cook until the vegetables are tender.
Meanwhile, in a blender or food processor, blend the shelled peanuts until they form a smooth paste. You may need to add a little water to achieve the desired consistency.
Add the peanut paste to the pot with the cooked vegetables. Stir well to combine.
Pour in enough water to reach your desired consistency for the stew. Stir to mix the water with the peanut and vegetable mixture.
Season the stew with ground cayenne pepper, ground cumin, ground paprika, and salt to taste. Adjust the seasoning according to your preference.
Let the stew simmer for about 15–20 minutes, stirring occasionally, to allow the flavors to meld and the stew to thicken.
Add the chopped spinach to the pot and stir to incorporate it into the stew. Cook for an additional 5 minutes until the spinach wilts and becomes tender.
Remove the pot from the heat and let the stew rest for a few minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Steak Melts
recipes.description: Kanapki z pieczonym steikiem wołowym, serem Monterey Jack lub pepper jack i masłem, grillowane na patelni.

ingredients.text: 2 ea. (12–16 ounces) boneless strip steaks, cooked to your liking
ingredients.name: stek wołowy

ingredients.text: 4 slices pepper jack or Monterrey Jack cheese
ingredients.name: ser Monterey Jack

steps.text: Slice steaks thinly across the grain on the bias. Place ¼ of the strips onto each slice bread.
Place a slice of cheese on top of that, then press 2 slices together and then repeat with the other. Brush the sides facing out with melted butter.
Heat a griddle over high heat. Add sandwiches and cook until golden brown on each side. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Cocoa-Coconut Bites
recipes.description: Chocolate-like bites made from coconut oil, cocoa powder and maple syrup, set in the freezer or fridge.

ingredients.text: ¼ cup (25 g) unsweetened cocoa powder
ingredients.name: kakao

ingredients.text: ⅛ cup + 1 tsp (30 ml + 1 tsp) maple syrup
ingredients.name: syrop klonowy

steps.text: Melt the coconut oil in a small saucepan over low heat.
Once melted, transfer to a bowl and whisk in unsweetened cacao powder, maple syrup, and salt until smooth and lump-free.
Pour the chocolate mix into small chocolate molds. You can also use a regular baking tray.
Place them in the freezer/fridge to harden for a few hours. If using a regular baking tray, cut the chocolate into pieces with a sharp knife.

recipes.title: Tofu Chocolate Mousse
recipes.description: Eggless and creamless chocolate mousse made with silken tofu to add body.

ingredients.text: 340 g (12 oz) semi-sweet chocolate, chopped, or dark chocolate chips (see Note)
ingredients.name: czekolada gorzka
ingredients.note: semi-sweet chocolate, chopped, or dark chocolate chips (see Note)

ingredients.text: 1 package (349 g / 12.3 oz) firm silken tofu (see notes)
ingredients.name: tofu jedwabiste

steps.text: Melt the chocolate in a double boiler.
Empty the tofu into the blender and pulse several times.
Transfer all chocolate from double boiler to blender.
Blend until smooth and thoroughly combined. Stop blender and scrape sides with spatula if necessary.
Transfer to single dish or individual serving bowl. Chill in refrigerator for 6–8 hours or overnight.

recipes.title: Queen's Sauce (Hartshorne)
recipes.description: A thick, creamy sauce for heart meals.

steps.text: Place the gravy into a saucepan and simmer, stirring the breadcrumbs into it until thickened.
Add the almonds, egg yolks, fowl breast, and cream. Mix well until combined.
Place onto a simmer and add salt and pepper to serve.

recipes.title: M'semen (Layered Algerian Flatbread)
recipes.description: Algerian layered flatbread made from all-purpose flour, semolina, sugar, yeast and warm water, folded into square envelopes and fried until browned.

steps.text: Combine both flours, sugar, salt, and yeast in a bowl.
Gradually mix in the warm water until you get a soft dough. If it feels too sticky, mix in a little more all-purpose flour. If too dry, mix in some more water.
On a lightly-floured surface, knead the dough for 10 minutes or until it is smooth.
Divide the dough into smaller pieces, and roll each out into very thin rounds.
Brush each dough round with oil.
Fold the rounds into square envelope shapes, making 4 folds into the center.
Cook each flatbread in a hot, lightly-greased skillet until browned.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Tuscan Soup (Meatless)
recipes.description: A simple Italian vegetable and bean soup with pasta, served with escarole or spinach.

ingredients.text: 1 can (15–16 ounces) kidney beans or great northern beans, rinsed and drained
ingredients.name: fasola czerwona z puszki
ingredients.note: 15–16 ounces; kidney or great northern beans

ingredients.text: ⅔ cup uncooked small spiral pasta
ingredients.name: makaron pszenny

ingredients.text: 3 cups thinly-sliced fresh escarole or spinach
ingredients.name: eskariola

steps.text: In a 2-quart saucepan, sauté onion and carrot in oil until onion is tender.
Add broth, water, salt and pepper; bring to a boil.
Stir in beans and pasta; return to a boil.
Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 15 minutes or until pasta and vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally.
Add escarole or spinach and heat through.

recipes.title: Hot Fudge Sauce
recipes.description: Hot fudge is a chocolate sauce for putting on ice cream.

ingredients.text: 1 ½ cups (350 g) white granulated sugar
ingredients.name: cukier

steps.text: Mix milk, sugar, cocoa and salt in a saucepan and bring to a full rolling boil.
Turn off heat and add butter and vanilla.
Let rest for a couple minutes until butter is melted. Beat with a spoon and serve.

recipes.title: Dud Patti (Milk Tea)
recipes.description: Instead of adding milk to tea brewed with water, this method steeps the tea leaves directly in hot milk.

steps.text: Pour in the milk into the pan. Let it simmer on medium-low heat.
When it is nearly boiling, add the tea.
Stir it a little with a spatula to allow it to brew before it boils over.
Take it off the heat when it boils over and pour it into a cup through a strainer.
Sweeten it with sugar and enjoy!

recipes.title: Garlic Shrimp Scampi Pasta
recipes.description: A quick pasta with garlic, butter and shrimp, finished with lemon juice, chile flakes and parsley.

ingredients.text: ¼ cup (25 g / 1 oz) chopped parsley
ingredients.name: natka pietruszki

steps.text: Boil the spaghetti in water until al dente.
Meanwhile, melt the butter in a pan over medium heat.
Add the garlic and stir.
Add the shrimp and cook for 6 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they turn pink-red in color.
Season with salt and pepper, then stir in lemon juice, chili, and parsley.
Drain the pasta in a colander and stir into the pan of shrimp.
Divide the pasta between 4 plates and serve.

recipes.title: Pear Pie
recipes.description: Pie z gruszkami Bartlett w cynamonowym syropie cukrowym, pieczony w cieście z dwóch spodów.

steps.text: Core, peel, and slice the pears into ¼ or ⅛-inch segments.
Add the lemon juice to the pear segments.
In a separate pot, set the water and white and brown sugar to boil to make a simple syrup.
In a separate bowl, mix the cinnamon, nutmeg, flour, and cornstarch.
When the syrup is done boiling, bring all of the ingredients together.
Arrange one of the pie crusts on top of the pie pan.
Add the pear filling into the pie pan. Transfer excess juices to the pie pan as well.
Cover the filling with the other pie crust and make three slits on top.
Bake in the oven at 350°F for 60 minutes or until golden brown.
Take out the pie and let cool.
If desired, serve warm with ice cream or frozen custard.

recipes.title: Manx Smoked Salmon
recipes.description: Pasta z wędzonego łososia i śledzia z kremem, szczypiorkiem i ogórkiem - tłumaczenie opisu: Fish dishes are popular in Isle of Man; Kippers are especially popular and this recipe is a tasty alternative to many standard meals.

ingredients.text: ½ tomato, sliced, de-seeded, and skinned
ingredients.name: pomidor

steps.text: Boil the kippers in a pot of salty water
Add 4 rings of smoked salmon to a greaseproof tray in foil (slices can go over the edge)
Wait for the kippers to finish boiling then refresh them with cold water for 3–5 minutes. Fillet them, then skin and place them in a blender.
Add cream gradually and blend.
Add chives to the mix.
Add the mixture to the rings and remove any air pockets by shaking.
Fold over the salmon slices and turn over the rings. Cover with clingfilm and refrigerate.
Add about 6 slices of the cucumber to the centre of each plate.
Remove food from refrigerator, remove from oven tray and put them upside down on top of the cucumber slices.
Add more strips of cucumber and tomato to the top of the food. Serve!

recipes.title: Alsatian Fresh Noodles (Nouilles fraîches à l'Alsacienne)
recipes.description: Fresh egg noodles from Alsace, rolled thin, dried, cut and boiled, then tossed with melted butter.

steps.text: Break the eggs and place in a large bowl. Mix in salt and vinegar.
While mixing, gradually add the flour.
Work the dough for several minutes until it is smooth.
Roll dough into a ball and wrap in a dry cloth. Allow to rest for 1 hour.
Divide the dough into pieces the size of a tennis ball and flatten on the work surface to a thickness of 2 mm (⅛ inch).
Allow the dough to dry for 30 minutes, turning the rounds frequently. One can also dry them by suspending them from a cord or over a broom handle place on the backs of two chairs.
Flour each round and roll it up on itself. Cut into slices 3–4 mm (¼ inch) thick.
Unroll to obtain the noodles, and spread out on a large tray without tangling them.
Fill a large pot with salted water; bring to a boil and plunge in the noodles. Simmer for 7–8 minutes.
Drain the noodles and toss with melted butter.

recipes.title: Gluten Veggie Meat
recipes.description: Gluten veggie meat is an excellent supplement to meatless dishes.

ingredients.text: 1 bag (22 oz/623 g) Vital wheat gluten flour
ingredients.name: gluten pszenny
ingredients.note: 22 oz/623 g, Vital wheat gluten flour

steps.text: In a large bowl, combine the gluten flour, garlic powder, parsley flakes, and cup of water.
Knead for about 2 minutes, cover, and set aside for 10 minutes.
Slice gluten into pieces. The smaller the pieces, then firmer the final texture.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil and add bouillon cubes.
Add sliced pieces of gluten to the seasoned, boiling water.
Reduce heat to subtle simmer. Cover with lid and simmer for 55 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Drain substantially larger gluten pieces, and place in another bowl to cool.
In another bowl with a lid, combine all-purpose flour, onion powder, and salt; cover and shake.
In another bowl, pour in soy sauce for dipping.
Dip several pieces of cooled gluten into bowl with soy sauce.
Place gluten pieces in bowl with seasoned flour, cover, and shake.
Fry pieces in frying pan with oil until browned.

recipes.title: Meringata with Ginger and Cream
recipes.description: A dessert of crumbled meringue folded into lemon-zested whipped cream with preserved ginger.

ingredients.text: 1 container store-bought or homemade meringue cookies
ingredients.name: bezy

steps.text: Strain the lemon juice and mix with the zest.
Mix the juice and zest with the heavy cream.
Whip the cream to soft peaks.
Fold in the powdered sugar.
Mix the ginger into the cream.
Crumble the meringues and mix into the cream. Do this just before serving.
Serve immediately, otherwise the meringue will dissolve in the cream over time.

recipes.title: Vegetable Party Sandwiches
recipes.description: Party sandwiches filled with a gelatin-bound mix of grated carrot, celery, cucumber and onion in mayonnaise.

ingredients.text: 2 cucumbers, peeled, seeded and chopped fine
ingredients.name: ogórek

steps.text: Dissolve gelatin in water according to directions.
In a large bowl, mix dissolved gelatin with carrots, celery, cucumber, onion, lemon juice, and mayonnaise.
Refrigerate for 25 hours.
If the mixture becomes too jelled to spread well, add ⅓ to ½ cup more mayonnaise.
Using a knife, trim crusts from bread edges.
Spread vegetable mixture on bread and make 28 sandwiches.
Cut into quarters.
Layer cut sandwiches in a large covered plastic container with damp paper towels between layers until serving time.

categories: Recipes using beef broth and stock

recipes.title: Hamburger Stoup
recipes.description: Gęsta zupa-gulasz z mielonej wołowiny, pomidorów, kukurydzy, grochu, selera, ziemniaków i ryżu.

steps.text: Fry the onions in a skillet with a dash of oil until the onions are translucent.
Add the ground beef to the onions. Cook, breaking the meat up, until browned.
Combine meat mixture and remaining ingredients in a large stockpot. Add enough water to cover everything by a few inches (usually about 2 cups).
Place pot in a 325°F oven, and bake for 6 hours.
If using pasta, stir in after removing from the oven.

recipes.title: Cola BBQ Sauce
recipes.description: Great on ribs or chicken!

ingredients.text: 1 ½ cans good cola (Pepsi is recommended)
ingredients.name: cola

steps.text: Combine all ingredients and bring to a boil.
Cook over high heat for 10 minutes.
Store refrigerated in a nonreactive container for up to 1 week.

recipes.title: Mocha Icing
recipes.description: Mocha icing is traditionally used to frost hot milk cake or other cakes.

steps.text: An hour before baking the cake, take the butter out of the refrigerator to reach room temperature.
Cream the butter.
Add the cocoa and liquids alternately.
Then add the sugar alternately with the liquids.
Stop at spreading consistency even if you have not used all the sugar.
Spread on a hot milk cake or other cake.

recipes.title: Paste for Tarts
recipes.description: A stiff pastry dough for tarts, made from flour, butter, sugar and boiling cream.

steps.text: Combine the sugar and flour.
Make it into a stiff paste with the boiling cream and butter.
Work the dough well, and roll it very thinly.

recipes.title: Homemade Coffee Liqueur
recipes.description: Coffee liqueur is a sweet alcoholic beverage made with distilled spirits and flavored with coffee.

ingredients.text: *2 vanilla beans, split (or 2 tsp vanilla extract)
ingredients.name: laska wanilii

steps.text: In a large saucepan, combine the brewed coffee and sugar. Heat over medium heat, stirring continuously until the sugar is fully dissolved. Remove from heat and let it cool to room temperature.
Once cooled, stir in the vodka or rum.
If using vanilla beans, scrape out the seeds and add both the seeds and the pods to the mixture. If using vanilla extract, add and stir it in.
Transfer the mixture to a glass bottle or jar and seal tightly. Store it in a cool, dark place for at least one week, gently shaking the bottle daily.
After the infusion period, strain the mixture to remove the vanilla pods and any sediment. Transfer the cleared liquid back to the bottle for storage.

recipes.title: Boiled Cucumber and Grated Coconut (Pachadi)
recipes.description: A very popular dish from the Kerala region of India, quick to prepare and a tasty accompaniment to rice or roti.

ingredients.text: 1 cucumber (large variety, with dark green and yellow skin)
ingredients.name: ogórek
ingredients.note: large variety, with dark green and yellow skin

steps.text: Skin the cucumber. Cut in half along the length and remove the central core of seeds. Discard the seeds.
Grate the cucumber. Alternatively, cut into very small pieces.
Cook the cucumber in the microwave for about 4–5 min.
Meanwhile, make a fine paste from the grated coconut and the cumin seeds.
In a deep pan (kadhai), heat the oil. Add the mustard seeds and red chillies, and let them splutter.
Add the cooked cucumber and the coconut paste and salt to taste. Mix well and let it cook on slow fire. Do not allow it to boil—it just needs to be warmed.
As the mixture starts to boil, take it off the stove. Serve.

recipes.title: Firecracker Ribs
recipes.description: These ribs pack a kick from cayenne pepper.

steps.text: Season ribs with rub, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Preheat oven to 225°F (110°C).
Combine liquid ingredients.
Place ribs in a large foil pouch, pour in liquid mixture, and seal pouch.
Bake at 225°F (110°C) for 5–6 hours.
Remove ribs from pouches and set aside. Save liquid.
Reduce liquid by half over high heat, then lightly brush some reduction on top of ribs and place under a preheated broiler. Watch carefully and remove when nicely browned.
Rest 15 minutes; serve.

recipes.title: Pizza Rollups
recipes.description: Small pizza-flavored rolls made from croissant dough, filled with pepperoni and provolone.

ingredients.text: Pizza spices as desired (anise, basil, fennel, garlic, oregano, etc.)
ingredients.name: przyprawy do pizzy
ingredients.note: as desired (anise, basil, fennel, garlic, oregano, etc.)

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Unroll 2 croissant rolls and place together on ungreased cookie sheet, pointing in opposite directions, forming a rectangle by pinching sides together.
Lay 6 slices of pepperoni on top of each dough rectangle.
Lay a slice of provolone cheese on top of pepperoni slices.
Roll each into a tube.
Bake 12–15 minutes.

recipes.title: Holiday Pork Loin
recipes.description: This is perfect for serving at Christmas instead of ham, or even as a main dish when guests come over.

ingredients.text: 1 ea. (4 pounds) boneless pork loin roast
ingredients.name: schab wieprzowy bez kości

ingredients.text: ¼ cup crushed ginger snap cookies
ingredients.name: ciastka imbirowe

steps.text: Combine salt, honey, vinegar, and wine in a gallon size zip-top bag. Add ice and shake until ice is mostly melted and mixture has cooled down.
Add pork loin and refrigerate 2 ½–3 hours.
Drain pork and pat dry. Discard remaining brine. Set aside.
Combine remaining ingredients except mustard. Brush pork with mustard and press spice mixture into all sides of meat.
Place roast on a roasting rack in a roasting pan. Insert a probe thermometer into the center and bake at 410°F until internal temperature reaches 140°F for medium rare.
Remove to a plate and let rest 10 minutes before carving. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Corn and Kelp Chowder
recipes.description: A chowder of corn kernels, dried sea kelp, milk and bell pepper, sautéed in butter and simmered until soft.

ingredients.text: 1 quart corn kernels (removed from the cob)
ingredients.name: kukurydza

ingredients.text: ½ cup dried sea kelp (or laver)
ingredients.name: kelp suszony

ingredients.text: 1 green or red bell pepper, chopped
ingredients.name: papryka

steps.text: Melt butter in a pan, add the kelp, and sauté until it begins to dissolve in the butter.
Add the remaining ingredients, turn down to low heat, and cover.
Simmer for 30–40 minutes until soft.
Remove cover and cook on low heat until most of the liquid is evaporated.

recipes.title: Yeasted Rolls I
recipes.description: Soft yeasted rolls made with bread flour, milk, butter and egg.

steps.text: Knead all the ingredients together, and let rise for 1 ½ hours.
Alternatively, use the dough setting on a bread machine.
Preheat oven to 350°F (177°C).
Divide dough into 12 rolls.
Brush melted butter over the top.
Bake for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Chereh Tamba (Gambian Groundnut Stew)
recipes.description: Chereh tamba, also known as Gambian groundnut stew, is a flavorful and hearty stew that showcases the use of groundnuts (peanuts) as a key ingredient.

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper (optional, for added spiciness)
ingredients.name: pieprz cayenne

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F).
Spread the groundnuts evenly on a baking sheet.
Roast the groundnuts in the preheated oven for about 10–15 minutes, or until they are golden brown and fragrant.
Remove the roasted groundnuts from the oven and allow them to cool.
Once cooled, transfer the roasted groundnuts to a food processor or blender and grind them into a smooth paste. Set aside.
In a large pot, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat. Add the chopped onions and minced garlic. Sauté until they become soft and translucent.
Add the diced tomatoes, diced bell pepper, ground ginger, ground paprika, and ground cayenne pepper (if using) to the pot. Stir well to combine.
Mix in the tomato paste and the groundnut paste, ensuring that they are evenly incorporated into the mixture.

Add the chicken pieces to the pot and stir to coat them with the sauce. Pour enough water or broth into the pot to cover the chicken and create a stew-like consistency. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and cover the pot with a lid.
Allow the chereh tamba to simmer for about 30–40 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and tender. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking.
Taste the chereh tamba and adjust the seasoning with salt, pepper, and additional spices if desired.
Serve hot with rice or couscous.

recipes.title: Brown Sugar Icing
recipes.description: Puszysta polewa z brązowego cukru, śmietanki i masła, gotowana do stadium miękkiej kulki i ubijana do gęstości pozwalającej rozsmarować.

steps.text: Boil sugar and cream together until a soft ball forms in cold water.
Cool to 125 F.
Add vanilla and butter; beat until thick enough to spread.

recipes.title: Bean and Green Chili Soup
recipes.description: An easy, surprising soup from easily stored ingredients

ingredients.text: 1 small can (4 oz, 110 g) green salsa
ingredients.name: salsa zielona

ingredients.text: 1 ⅓ cup (300 ml) dried, bulk black bean soup mix
ingredients.name: mieszanka do zupy z czarnej fasoli

steps.text: Bring 1 cup (240 ml) dry rice and 2 cups (480 ml) water to a boil.
Turn heat to low and steam rice for 25–30 min (or prepare rice using rice cooker).
Prepare soup mix by combining with 3 cups (720 ml) boiling water, then simmer about 5 minutes.
Add remaining ingredients and rice to soup.
Heat through, stirring occasionally.
If desired, just before serving, spoon a teaspoon of sour cream in to the middle of the bowl.

recipes.title: Lumpia (Fried Filipino Spring Rolls)
recipes.description: Lumpia are a variety of fried Filipino spring rolls, and they make a tasty dish.

ingredients.text: 1½ pounds (680 g) ground chicken or pork
ingredients.name: mięso mielone z kurczaka lub wieprzowe

ingredients.text: salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste
ingredients.name: sól

ingredients.text: 2 packages (about 40 ea.) small-to-medium size egg roll wrappers (wonton wrappers)
ingredients.name: ciasto na wontony

steps.text: In a large bowl, combine meat, water chestnuts, onion, eggs, soy sauce, salt, and pepper. Mix well and set aside.
On a clean, dry surface, place one egg roll wrapper with one corner facing you (like a baseball diamond).
Place about 1 tablespoon of the meat mixture in the center of the wrapper.
Dip your fingers in a glass of water and lightly wet the corner pointing away from you (second base).
Fold the corner closest to you (home base) over the mixture, then fold the side corners over that and roll away from your body. The wet corner should seal the roll.
Repeat the filling and shaping process with the remaining ingredients.
Place the rolls in large zip-close plastic bags and freeze overnight.
In a large saucepan, heat the oil to about 350°F (175°C) or until it begins to shimmer and the oil bubbles lightly when a wooden chopstick is inserted.
Using tongs, place each frozen lumpia roll in the hot oil and fry until brown, about 3 to 4 minutes. Use tongs to turn rolls to ensure even cooking.
Remove the rolls to a plate covered with paper towels to absorb excess oil.

recipes.title: Asian Barbecue Ribs
recipes.description: Pork spareribs seasoned with barbecue rub, smoked slowly, and glazed with a soy, hoisin, honey and mirin mixture.

ingredients.text: 2 slabs St. Louis style/cut pork spareribs
ingredients.name: żeberka wieprzowe

steps.text: Peel off the thin membrane on each rib. Season ribs with the barbecue rub and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Place hickory chunks in the firebox of a 250°F (120°C) smoker.
Combine remaining ingredients in a large sauce pan over high heat and bring to a boil. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes or until slightly thickened. Set aside.
Place ribs in smoker and cook for 5–6 hours, brushing with soy mixture often.
Brush meat sides generously with soy mixture and place under a preheated broiler until deeply browned. Watch carefully or it will burn!
Slice into 1-rib portions and serve.

recipes.title: Steak and Pepper Stir-Fry
recipes.description: A quick Asian-style stir-fry of thinly sliced rib-eye steak with red and green bell pepper, ginger, garlic and bird chili.

ingredients.text: 6 oz beef rib-eye steak, sliced thinly across the grain on a bias
ingredients.name: antrykot wołowy
ingredients.note: sliced thinly across the grain on a bias

ingredients.text: ½ each red and green bell pepper, julienned
ingredients.name: papryka czerwona

ingredients.text: ½ each red and green bell pepper, julienned
ingredients.name: papryka zielona

steps.text: Season beef liberally with salt and black pepper.
Set aside.
Preheat a large stainless steel or cast iron skillet, or a wok, over medium high heat.
Add peanut oil and seasoned beef and cook, tossing often, until meat is browned and slightly charred on both sides.
Remove and keep warm.
Toss remaining ingredients together and place into the wok.
Cook, tossing often, until vegetables are slightly browned around edges.
Add steak and heat through.
Serve warm with soy sauce on the side.

recipes.title: Mofletta (Maghrebi Pancake)
recipes.description: Mofletta is a thin, crepe-like pancake made by communities in North Africa, and made popular in Israel.

ingredients.text: 2 tbsp of olive oil, plus a little extra for pan-frying
ingredients.name: oliwa z oliwek
ingredients.note: plus a little extra for pan-frying

steps.text: Dissolve the yeast and sugar in the water. Let rest in a warm place for 10–15 minutes.
Combine flour, salt, and 1 tablespoon of oil in a bowl. Stir in the yeast mixture to make a dough.
Knead the dough on a flat, flour-dusted surface until smooth and elastic.
Return dough to the bowl and pour the remaining tablespoon of oil onto it, rolling the dough in the bowl until it becomes oiled.
Cover the dough with a tea towel and leave in a warm place until it rises.
Divide the dough into smaller equal portions, and begin to roll the rounded portions out on an oiled work-surface, making them as thin as possible.
Heat a frying pan over medium heat, and grease the bottom with a little oil.
Fry the rolled-out dough portions one at a time until they are lightly browned on one side. Flip over and cook until browned on the second side.
Keep the finished mofletta in a stack, covered with a cloth to retain heat and moisture.
Serve with butter and honey.

recipes.title: Rock Cookies
recipes.description: Kruche ciasteczka z suszonymi porzeczkami, skórką z cytryny i wiśniami kandyzowanymi, pieczone w formie nierównych kulek.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Sift flour, salt, and baking powder; rub in butter.
Add sugar, currants, mace, and lemon zest.
Stir in eggs.
Form into rough balls about 1 inch in diameter.
If balls aren't holding together well, sprinkle with water.
Garnish with ⅛ of a candied cherry.
Bake for 9 minutes at 350°F.
Cool.

recipes.title: Red and White Onion Tapenade
recipes.description: Tapenada z kalamata oliwek, białej i czerwonej cebuli, kaparów i tymianku, podawana na tostowanym bagietce lub chlebie rustykalnym.

ingredients.text: ⅓ cup (80 ml) chopped white onions
ingredients.name: cebula biała

ingredients.text: ⅓ cup (80 ml) chopped red onions
ingredients.name: cebula czerwona

ingredients.text: 2 tbsp (30 ml) capers, rinsed and drained
ingredients.name: kapary

ingredients.text: Toasted baguette or rustic bread slices
ingredients.name: bagietka lub chleb rustykalny

steps.text: In food processor with motor running, drop in garlic and chop.
Turn off motor and add olives, onions, capers, lemon peel and thyme.
Pulse to chop to coarse consistency.
Add olive oil and pulse to just blend keeping texture in mixture.
Serve with toasted baguette or rustic bread slices.

recipes.title: Crème Chantilly
recipes.description: Whipped cream, lightly sweetened and flavoured with vanilla.

ingredients.text: 1–2 tsp vanilla extract, or cognac, rum, or liqueur
ingredients.name: ekstrakt waniliowy

steps.text: In a chilled 3-quart bowl, whip the cream until it forms soft peaks.
Fold in the powdered sugar and flavouring.
Refrigerate until ready to use.

recipes.title: Recaíto (Puerto Rican Culantro Sauce)
recipes.description: A Puerto Rican sauce of roasted garlic, culantro, cilantro, peppers and onion, blended until almost smooth.

ingredients.text: 20 culantro leaves—find this at local Latin or Asian markets
ingredients.name: liście kolendry długolistnej (culantro)
ingredients.note: find this at local Latin or Asian markets

ingredients.text: 1 large green bell pepper, seeded, diced and with the white pith from the inside of the pepper removed.
ingredients.name: papryka zielona
ingredients.note: large, seeded, diced and with the white pith removed

steps.text: Slice off the top of the head of garlic to expose some of the cloves inside. Place the head on a piece of foil. Drizzle with olive oil and wrap in the foil.
Roast until cloves are lightly browned and tender, about 30 minutes.
Remove the roasted garlic from the oven and simply pop the individual cloves out of the roasted paper outers. They should come out easily.
Combine 2 tbsp roasted garlic, culantro, cilantro, bell pepper, aji pepper, and onion in a food processor or blender.
Pulse 15 times or until consistency is almost smooth.

images: 2 of grilled pigeon at KC Seafood Restaurtant.jpg

recipes.title: Egyptian Grilled Pigeon (Fattah Meshaltet)
recipes.description: Egyptian grilled pigeons marinated in a blend of spices, cumin, coriander, cinnamon and lemon, traditionally served on special occasions.

steps.text: In a mixing bowl, combine the ground cumin, ground coriander, ground paprika, ground cinnamon, ground black pepper, salt, minced garlic, lemon juice, and olive oil. Mix well to form a marinade.
Place the cleaned and gutted pigeons in the marinade, ensuring they are evenly coated. Massage the marinade into the birds, ensuring they are thoroughly seasoned.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and let the pigeons marinate in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours or overnight to allow the flavors to penetrate the meat.
Preheat the grill or barbecue to medium-high heat.
Remove the pigeons from the marinade and shake off any excess. Reserve the marinade for basting.

Place the pigeons on the grill and cook for about 6–8 minutes on each side, or until they are cooked through and nicely browned, basting occasionally with the reserved marinade. Ensure the internal temperature of the pigeon reaches a safe temperature of 165°F (74°C) to ensure they are fully cooked.
Once cooked, transfer the grilled pigeons to a serving platter and let them rest for a few minutes before serving.
Serve hot as a main course, garnished with fresh herbs and accompanied by traditional Egyptian side dishes like rice or bread.

recipes.title: Caramelized Raspberry Sauce
recipes.description: Sos malinowy z karmelizowanych malin, podawany z lodami lub owocami.

steps.text: Place berries on a baking sheet and sprinkle with half of the sugar. Place 5–6 inches under a preheated broiler, and broil until well browned.
Remove and set aside until cool.
Combine cream, salt, and remaining sugar in a heavy saucepan over medium high heat. Add the raspberries, and boil until berries break easily.
Remove from the heat and set aside until cool. Purée in a food processor or blender until smooth. Alternatively, use an immersion blender directly in the saucepan.
Pour mixture back into saucepan, and place over medium high heat. Bring to a boil and cook until liquid has reduced by ⅔.
Stir in butter and vanilla until smooth, then cool.
Pour sauce over ice cream or fruit and serve.

recipes.title: Prime Rib Seasoning
recipes.description: This seasoning will elevate your rib roast to steakhouse quality. It also works well on steaks.

ingredients.text: ½ cup coarsely ground black pepper
ingredients.name: pieprz czarny

ingredients.text: ¼ cup coarsely ground coriander seed
ingredients.name: nasiona kolendry

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in an airtight container with a shaker lid.

recipes.title: Quick Baked Beef-Pasta Dish
recipes.description: A quick baked casserole of ground beef, pasta, spaghetti sauce and mozzarella.

ingredients.text: 1 pound pasta, such as rigatoni or penne, cooked al dente
ingredients.name: makaron pszenny
ingredients.note: such as rigatoni or penne, cooked al dente

ingredients.text: 32 ounce jar or can of your favorite spaghetti sauce
ingredients.name: sos pomidorowy

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Cook beef and onion in a large skillet until meat is lightly browned. Drain and sprinkle with Italian Seasoning.
In a large bowl, combine meat mixture and spaghetti sauce and mix well. Add cooked pasta and mix well.
Spray large baking dish with cooking spray.
Pat meat-pasta mixture level in baking pan.
Sprinkle mozzarella cheese over top.
Cover with aluminium foil, and bake in oven 20 minutes.
Remove foil, and bake uncovered another 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Crab Fried Rice
recipes.description: Fried rice with crab, bean sprouts, garlic, red onion, chilli and scallion, seasoned with fish sauce, salt and black pepper.

ingredients.text: 150 g bean sprouts, soaked in hot water
ingredients.name: kiełki fasoli mung

ingredients.text: 2 big red chilli, cut into small pieces
ingredients.name: papryczka chili
ingredients.note: big red, cut into small pieces

steps.text: Stir fry the crab in the 5 tbsp oil for 1 minute. Remove from the heat, and reserve.
Heat the remaining oil, and use to stir fry the garlic, red onion, scallion, and red chillies for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the fried crab and bean sprouts. Stir until the crab changes color.
Add the rice, fish sauce, salt, and black pepper. Stir until well-mixed.
Serve hot.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Italian Marinated Chicken
recipes.description: Chicken breast marinated in a broth, tomato, Parmesan and Italian seasoning mixture, then grilled or broiled.

steps.text: Mix broth, tomatoes, cheese, Italian seasoning and garlic powder in a shallow non-metallic dish. Reserve half of this mixture.
Add chicken to remaining marinade and turn to coat.
Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Remove chicken from broth mixture. Discard the marinade.
Grill or broil chicken for 15 minutes or until done, turning and brushing often with reserved broth mixture.

recipes.title: Barbecue Ribs
recipes.description: Żeberka wieprzowe St. Louis wędzone w dymie z drewna hikorowego i glazurowane sosem pomidorowo-melasowym.

steps.text: Massage ribs with the barbecue rub.
Refrigerate for 1 hour.
Combine remaining ingredients except for hickory in a large saucepan, and bring to a boil over high heat until reduced by ½.
Place hickory chunks in firebox of 250°F (120°C) smoker.
Place ribs in smoker and cook, brushing often with tomato mixture and changing the hickory chunks as needed, for 5–6 hours.
Brush ribs generously with mixture and grill on high heat, brushing repeatedly until well-browned on both sides.
Remove and let rest 10 minutes.
Serve.

recipes.title: Fruity Cheese Dogs
recipes.description: Hot dogs topped with melted cheese and crushed fruity breakfast cereal.

ingredients.text: 1 cup (240 ml) cheese (Mozzarella, Cheddar, Swiss, or any cheese that melts easily and is not very creamy)
ingredients.name: ser
ingredients.note: Mozzarella, Cheddar, Swiss, or any cheese that melts easily and is not very creamy

ingredients.text: ⅛ cup (30 ml) crushed froot loops (or any equivalent fruity breakfast cereal)
ingredients.name: płatki śniadaniowe owocowe
ingredients.note: crushed; or any equivalent fruity breakfast cereal

steps.text: Cook the hot dogs in any manner; the original recipe used a pan on a stove, but a toaster oven would suffice.
Once the hot dogs have cooked and split, remove them from the heat.
Melt the cheese either in the oven or the microwave (microwave works best).
Pour the melted cheese on the hot dogs.
Sprinkle the crushed Froot Loops over the cheese, and let cool.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Yassa Poulet (Senegalese Chicken)
recipes.description: Yassa poulet is a popular dish that can be found throughout West Africa, though it specifically originated from Senegal. It has a unique, sweet taste.

steps.text: Wash the chicken and pat it dry with paper towels.

Put the chicken in a large bowl with the garlic, onions, dijon mustard, lemon juice, salt, bouillon powder, cayenne pepper and smoked paprika. Mix together well and place in the fridge to marinate for 2–12 hours.
Take the chicken out of the marinade, and scrape off the marinade and the onions. Reserve the marinade.
Heat the olive oil in the large Dutch oven over medium heat, and add the chicken. Let it brown on both sides for 5 minutes. Take out and set aside the chicken.
To the pot, add the onions and remaining marinade. Cook on medium heat for 5 minutes until browned.
Return the browned chicken pieces to the sweet caramelized onions.
Add the chicken broth, and simmer for 20 minutes over medium heat until the chicken is fully cooked.
Taste for salt and other ingredients and make any necessary adjustments.

recipes.title: Yogurt Dip
recipes.description: Chłodny dip z jogurtu naturalnego, ogórka i mięty.

ingredients.text: ½ cucumber, seeded and chopped very fine
ingredients.name: ogórek

ingredients.text: ¼ tsp dried mint, crumbled, or 1 tsp fresh, chopped
ingredients.name: mięta suszona

steps.text: Mix all the ingredients, and chill thoroughly to let the flavors develop.

recipes.title: Venison Italian Style
recipes.description: Thin slices of deer loin soaked in milk, floured, pan-fried in butter and served with a wine, lemon and caper sauce with parsley.

steps.text: Slice loin across grain into ¼-inch or thinner slices, or pound flat between two pieces of waxed paper.
Combine with 1 cup of milk in shallow dish.
Cover dish in refrigerator for up to 3 hours, then discard milk.
Add remaining milk and temper outside refrigerator for 1 hour.
Discard milk, then pat slices dry.
Mix flour, salt and pepper, then thoroughly coat venison slices.
In large skillet, melt butter over medium heat, then brown venison on both sides.
Add wine and simmer two minutes more.
Transfer venison slices to heated platter with slotted spoon.
Add lemon juice, capers, and parsley to skillet, and cook on medium two minutes, constantly scraping bottom and sides of skillet.
Serve venison slices with sauce over it.

ingredients.text: 1 L (4 cups) mango nectar (strained puréed mango)
ingredients.name: nektar mangowy

steps.text: Mix sugar with the mango nectar until dissolved.
Gradually add the milk to the yoghurt.
Mix together the mango and yoghurt mixtures.

recipes.title: Polish Cauliflower with Breadcrumbs
recipes.description: Cauliflower with breadcrumbs is a popular dish and side-dish in Poland and many parts of Central Europe.

steps.text: Boil the cauliflower for about 10 minutes.
Melt some butter in the oven or a microwave.
Mix the butter with the breadcrumbs, and add dill if using.
Drain the cauliflower and add the mixture on top.
Eat!

recipes.title: Chicken Wings Asian Style
recipes.description: Deep-fried chicken wingettes coated in cornmeal and tossed in a sweet and spicy hoisin, soy, hot sauce and garlic-ginger mixture.

ingredients.text: Spicy garlic oil for deep frying
ingredients.name: olej do smażenia
ingredients.note: spicy garlic oil, for deep frying

steps.text: Coat chicken with egg. Season chicken liberally with poultry shake.
Dredge chicken in cornmeal. Fry at 350°F (180°C) in batches, if needed for 12 minutes. Drain on a cooling or oven rack.
Combine remaining ingredients in a large bowl. Add wings and toss to coat.

recipes.title: Skillet Lasagna
recipes.description: Skillet lasagna is a lasagne-style casserole that tastes just like real lasagne, but is ready a lot faster.

ingredients.text: ⅓ cup (80 ml) Italian salad dressing
ingredients.name: sos sałatkowy włoski

ingredients.text: 10 uncooked lasagne noodles, broken into squares
ingredients.name: makaron lasagne

steps.text: Boil one clove of garlic in a saucepan of water.
Add noodles and cook until tender.
Meanwhile, brown the ground beef in heavy skillet.
Drain grease.
Add pasta sauce, water, dressing, and bell pepper.
Stir until well combined and bell pepper is tender.
Cover and let simmer over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Drain noodles and add to meat. Stir until well combined.
Cover and let stand under low heat for 5 minutes.
Add cheese and stir well, then turn off heat and let cool.

recipes.title: Mussels with Potatoes
recipes.description: A chilled salad of steamed mussels, potatoes and carrots dressed with olive oil and wine vinegar.

ingredients.text: 450 g (1 lb) mussels, rinsed and scrubbed
ingredients.name: małż

ingredients.text: 225 g (8 oz) potatoes, cooked and diced
ingredients.name: ziemniak

ingredients.text: 175 g (6 oz) carrots, cooked and diced
ingredients.name: marchew

steps.text: Place the mussels in a large pot or steamer with about 1–2 inches of boiling liquid (e.g. water, wine, or seasoned broth)
Cover and steam over high heat for approximately 5 minutes or until the shells open
Discard any mussels that do not open.
Remove mussel meal from the shells
Mix together the mussels, potatoes, and carrots and arrange on a suitable serving dish.
Thoroughly blend the oil, vinegar, and seasoning and pour over the salad.
Chill well before serving.

recipes.title: Vedhmi (Sweet Stuffed Flatbread)
recipes.description: Puran poli or vedhmi is a sweet version of stuffed chapati from Gujarat, mainly stuffed with toor dal.

steps.text: Wash and boil the toor dal with water and ½ tsp salt until soft.
Cool slightly and strain the dal using a strainer.
Add cardamom powder and jaggery to the dal, then grind to make a fine paste. If the paste is sticky, keep it on the heat to dry up completely. This is known as "puran".
Knead flour with ½ tsp salt and enough water to make a dough. Do not make the dough hard.
Add oil, and knead the dough again until the oil is absorbed.
Prepare an equal number of balls from the dough and puran.
Roll out dough balls to make small un-cooked chapati.
Stuff each uncooked chapati with a ball of puran.
Roll them again into stuffed chapati just like stuffed paratha. It is called "poli".
Heat a griddle and fry each poli.
Brush ghee on both sides when done.
Serve.

recipes.title: Hot Peach Drink
recipes.description: Warm peach drink sweetened with brown sugar and flavored with cinnamon sticks, optionally with peach schnapps.

steps.text: Combine juice, brown sugar, cinnamon sticks, and margarine in a Dutch Oven.
Heat to boil.
Remove from heat.
Discard cinnamon sticks.
Add schnapps, if desired.
Garnish with additional cinnamon sticks, if desired.

recipes.title: Steak, Bacon, and Arugula Salad
recipes.description: Sałatka z grillowanym stekiem wołowym, chrupiącym boczkiem i rukolą, z dressingiem na bazie octu winnego i musztardy Dijon.

ingredients.text: ¾ cup minus 1 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil, divided
ingredients.name: oliwa z oliwek extra virgin

ingredients.text: 5 rashers bacon, cut into 1½-inch pieces and crisp-cooked
ingredients.name: boczek

steps.text: Brush steaks with 1 tbsp olive oil. Sprinkle liberally with salt and freshly ground black pepper.
Grill over very high heat 1 minute. Rotate 90 degrees, cook for another 1 minute, then flip and repeat 1 more time.
Move to medium heat and cook, turning often, until desired "doneness" is achieved (145°F for medium rare, 160°F for medium, and 170°F for toast).
Refrigerate steaks until chilled.
Combine remaining oil and bacon fat. In another bowl, combine mustard and vinegar. Slowly stream in olive oil while whisking continuously.
Slice steaks thinly across the grain at a 45 degree angle. Toss together remaining ingredients and dressing in your serving bowl and refrigerate until chilled. Serve cold.

recipes.title: Fry Bread II
recipes.description: Frybread to płaski chleb smażony w tłuszczu lub głęboko smażony, podawany samodzielnie lub z dodatkami.

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon seasoning salt or table salt
ingredients.name: sól

steps.text: Mix the flour, baking powder, salt, and water together in a bowl to make a dough.
Grease your hands with the vegetable oil in order to shape the dough into a ball.
Leave the dough in the bowl, cover it with a towel and set in a warm place for about 20 minutes. The longer you leave the dough the fluffier the bread will be.

When ready to make the bread, heat the vegetable oil to about 375°F. Make sure the oil is at least 1 inch deep in your frying pan. Put a small ball of dough in the grease as a test. If the oil is hot enough, the ball should float on the grease. If it sits on the bottom, the oil isn't hot enough.
Take a ball of dough about the size of a golf ball and stretch it out in your greased hands. Keep stretching it out until the dough is flattened out to about the size of a large cookie.
Poke a tiny hole in the center of the dough with your finger. Next, carefully lay it in the hot oil. Let your dough brown to a golden brown color before turning it over and frying the other side.
After cooking the frybread, drain it on paper towels. It's best to serve it as soon as you can.

recipes.title: Strawberry And Banana Smoothie
recipes.description: Gładki koktajl truskawkowo-bananowy z jogurtem naturalnym i sokiem jabłkowym.

ingredients.text: ¾ cup (200 ml / 6.8 oz) apple juice
ingredients.name: sok jabłkowy

ingredients.text: ⅝ cup (150 g / 5.3 oz) natural (plain) yogurt
ingredients.name: jogurt naturalny

ingredients.text: ⅔ cup (50 g / 1.8 oz) ice cubes
ingredients.name: kostka lodu

steps.text: Cut off the tops of the strawberries.
Peel the bananas.
Blend all the ingredients in a blender until smooth.
Add honey to taste.
Pour the smoothie into 2 glasses.
Enjoy!

categories: Recipes using beef broth and stock

recipes.title: Dublin Lamb Stew
recipes.description: Irish lamb stew with potatoes, carrots, celery, mushrooms and bell pepper, simmered in beef broth.

ingredients.text: *1 tbsp dill salt or herbes de Provence
ingredients.name: sól koperkowa lub zioła prowansalskie
ingredients.note: dill salt or herbes de Provence

ingredients.text: *1 ½ lb carrots, peeled and diced
ingredients.name: marchew

steps.text: In a large saucepan, brown meat over medium heat.
Remove lamb and add oil over high heat. Sauté peppers, mushrooms, carrots, celery, and onion.
Add the sautéed vegetables, beef broth, lamb, potatoes, and dill salt to a soup pot.
Cover, and cook 30 minutes on medium-high heat, stirring occasionally.
Cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer 1.5–2 hours.
Serve hot with Irish oat scones or soda bread.

recipes.title: Vetkoek (South African Fried Dough)
recipes.description: Vetkoek is a South African fried dough. It can be savory or sweet; this recipe makes sweet doughnut-like pastries.

steps.text: In a large bowl combine the flour, salt, sugar and yeast.
Add water, and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for approximately 10 minutes.
Put the dough in an oiled bowl, and cover it tightly. Let the dough rise for 1–2 hours.
Heat the oil in a pot (target temperature should be around 350–375°F).
Shape the dough into balls, and add to the hot oil. Do not overcrowd the pot or let the temperature drop too much.
Continue turning the dough balls until golden brown all over and cooked through.
Serve hot or cold with cold or hot beverage.

recipes.title: Piadina (Thin Italian Flatbread)
recipes.description: Piadina (plural: piadine) is an Italian flatbread.

steps.text: Pulse the flour, baking powder, and salt in a food processor until blended.
Add the oil and pulse a few times to blend.
Start the processor and add the water a little at a time until the dough comes together.
Remove the dough to a well floured counter top and knead a few times, shaping it into a round ball and adding flour as needed.
Divide the dough into four pieces and form each into a tight ball.
Cover all with some plastic wrap and let rest for 30 minutes.
After the rest period, roll each piece into a 9 inch round.
Heat a dry 10-inch cast iron frying pan until a drop of water sizzles and evaporates.
Dock (perforate) one of the rounds with a fork to prevent the formation of bubbles.
Cook the round in the dry pan until the bottom has a few brown spots, 1½–2 minutes. Keep the docking fork handy to knock down bubbles as they form.
Flip the round and repeat the browning step as above.
Remove to a warm plate and gently fold in half. Cover to keep warm.
Repeat the last four steps with the other rounds.
Fill each with the foods and condiments of your choice and enjoy.

recipes.title: Thai Lemonade
recipes.description: This is the Thai version of lemonade.

ingredients.text: 2 cm piece of ginger, peeled and cut into pieces
ingredients.name: imbir świeży

steps.text: Bring the water to a boil with the sugar, lemon grass, and ginger.
Boil for 20 minutes.
Allow the syrup to cool, then remove lemongrass and ginger.
Pour the syrup in 4 large glasses, and add the carbonated water.
Garnish glasses with lime discs.

recipes.title: Grilled Steak
recipes.description: Grilled sirloin beef steaks seasoned with garlic powder, herbs and salt.

steps.text: If steaks are frozen, thaw for about an hour before cooking.
Heat the grill to appropriate setting for barbecue (lower heat is better).
Sprinkle everything but the garlic powder and coriander on the steaks while grill is heating.
Lightly shake on the garlic and coriander.
Grill the blank side of steak first for about 7–10 minutes, then flip and repeat.
Cook to desired doneness—for medium cook for about another 5 minutes after the first 14, depending on your heat setting.
The internal temperature should be at least 145°F, followed by a 3 minute rest before serving.

recipes.title: Apple Stuffing
recipes.description: Nadzienie jabłkowe z kukurydzianym chlebem, orzechami i serem Fontina, odpowiednie do schabu i pieczeni wieprzowej albo do pieczonego indyka.

ingredients.text: 4 egg whites, beaten to stiff peaks with ⅛ tsp cream of tartar
ingredients.name: białko jaja
ingredients.note: beaten to stiff peaks with 1/8 tsp cream of tartar

steps.text: Combine all ingredients except cheese and egg whites.
Gently fold in whipped egg whites, in a few batches.
Pour into a roasting pan.
Top with shredded cheese and bake at 325°F for 30 minutes, or until browned and bubbly on top.
Remove and let rest for 7 minutes.
Serve warm or use for Apple Stuffed Pork Chops.

recipes.title: Honey Lime Chicken Wings
recipes.description: Crispy deep-fried chicken wingettes tossed in a honey, lime and chipotle hot sauce mixture.

steps.text: Dip chicken in beaten eggs. Season liberally with poultry shake.
Dredge chicken in cornmeal. Let rest 2–3 minutes.
Deep fry in batches at 350°F (175°C) for 11–12 minutes. Drain on a cooling rack.
Meanwhile, combine remaining ingredients in a large nonreactive bowl. Add wings and toss to coat. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread II
recipes.description: Słodka bułka z ciasta biszkoptowego z cynamonowym cukrem i masłowym sosem, pieczona w formie bundt.

ingredients.text: 4 tubes of refrigerated Pillsbury Buttermilk Biscuits
ingredients.name: ciasto na biszkopty maślankowe w tubie

steps.text: Use cooking spray to fully grease inside of a bundt pan.
Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Take biscuits out of can. Notice that they're cut up into 8 sections.
Use scissors to cut each section into quarters, so that you have 4 pieces with each section. This should be a total of 32 pieces per can.
Put pieces into bowl with cinnamon-sugar mixture. Roll pieces until they are fully covered in cinnamon sugar.
Place pieces into the bundt pan.
Melt the sugar, brown sugar, and butter together, then bring to a boil.
After glaze has thickened, pour glaze on top of biscuit pieces in the bundt pan.
Bake for 25–30 minutes.
Invert onto plate and serve.

recipes.title: Corn Sticks
recipes.description: Cornbread sticks made from cornmeal, flour, milk and egg, baked in a hot, well-greased cast iron corn stick pan.

ingredients.text: ½ can (7.5 ounces / 212 g) whole corn (optional), drained
ingredients.name: kukurydza

steps.text: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).
Grease a corn stick pan well, and preheat inside the oven. Cast iron works best.
Combine corn meal, flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar in a large mixing bowl.
Add egg, sugar, and shortening. Beat until fairly smooth (about 1 minute).
Pour into the hot, well-greased cornstick pan.
Bake for 15–20 minutes until golden brown. If corn is added to batter, increase time a little.

recipes.title: Curry Chicken II
recipes.description: A simple Sri Lankan-style curry of chicken thighs cooked with onion, garlic, ginger and butter chicken masala powder.

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoon olive oil or other vegetable oil
ingredients.name: olej roślinny
ingredients.note: olive oil or other vegetable oil

ingredients.name: przyprawa butter chicken masala w proszku

steps.text: In a cooking vessel over medium-high heat, add oil and chopped onion, and sauté until light brown.
Add chicken and salt, and leave for 3–5 minutes, stirring in between.
Add crushed ginger and garlic, and stir for 2 minutes. Stir in masala powder, and cook for 2 minutes.
Add water, and let it boil for 5 minutes.
Reduce heat to low, and let it cook for 15 minutes, or until the liquid has reduced.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Nigerian Turmeric Rice
recipes.description: Nigerian Turmeric Rice is a vibrant and aromatic rice dish from Nigeria, colored yellow with turmeric and flavored with a blend of local spices. It is enjoyed across different regions and often served during festive occasions.

ingredients.text: 1½ de Rica can of long-grain rice
ingredients.name: ryż długoziarnisty

steps.text: In a clean pot, combine chicken, stock cubes, half the onion, curry powder, and thyme. Cover with water, and cook until the chicken is tender.
Parboil the rice for about 10 minutes. Drain the rice in a sieve, and immediately rinse with cold water.
Transfer the chicken stock into a clean pot. Stir in the turmeric powder, black pepper, and curry powder. Cover, and bring to a boil.

Add the parboiled rice, making sure that the liquid is on the same level with the rice. Taste and add salt if necessary. Stir with a wooden spoon, and allow to cook on medium heat until the water is almost entirely dried up.
Add the chopped onions and tomatoes. Cover and continue to cook until the water dries up.
Stir to combine well, and serve.

recipes.title: Gin Fried Rice
recipes.description: Plain fried rice finished with gin, ignited tableside for a dramatic presentation.

ingredients.text: 4 eggs, scrambled, cooked, and roughly chopped
ingredients.name: jajko

ingredients.text: 1 tbsp plus ¾ tsp red pepper flakes
ingredients.name: płatki chili

steps.text: Melt butter in a large straight-sided sauté pan.
Add all ingredients except gin to pan. Cook until all ingredients are heated through.
Add gin and carefully ignite off of the heat.
Place pan back on heat and cook until you don't smell alcohol any more.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Plain Scones
recipes.description: Classic British-style plain scones made with butter, egg and cream, served with fruit jam.

ingredients.text: 450 g (2 cups / 16 oz / 1 lb) cake flour, plus more as needed
ingredients.name: mąka pszenna tortowa

ingredients.text: 5 tbsp cold butter, cut into pieces
ingredients.name: masło

ingredients.text: 120–180 ml (½–¾ cup / 4–6 fl oz) heavy cream, plus more for brushing
ingredients.name: śmietanka kremowa

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 230°C (450°F / Gas Mark 8).
Put the flour, salt, baking powder and 2 tablespoons of the sugar in a food processor and pulse to combine.
Add the butter and pulse until the mixture resembles cornmeal.
Add the egg and just enough cream to form a slightly sticky dough. If it’s too sticky, add a little flour, but very little; it should still stick a little to your hands.
Turn the dough onto a lightly floured surface and knead once or twice, then press it into a 2 cm (¾ inch) thick circle. Cut out 5 cm (2 inch) rounds with a biscuit cutter or glass.
Put the rounds on an ungreased baking sheet. Gently reshape the leftover dough and cut out more scones.
Brush the top of each scone with a bit of cream and sprinkle with a little of the remaining sugar.
Bake for 9 to 11 minutes, or until the scones are a beautiful golden brown.
Let them cool and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cookies (Egg-Free)
recipes.description: This variant of peanut butter cookies has no egg or baking soda, and uses vegetable oil instead of butter/margarine; it adds honey.

ingredients.text: 1 ¼ cups (300 ml) whole wheat pastry flour (other flours likely work fine)
ingredients.name: mąka pszenna pełnoziarnista

steps.text: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Cream all ingredients except flour together.
Add flour and mix sparingly—it should be dry enough to form into balls by hand without sticking.
Form into walnut-sized balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Flatten with a fork by pressing the tines of the fork across the cookie. Repeat going in the other direction to make a criss-cross pattern.
Bake for about 8–10 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Coffee Frappe
recipes.description: A chilled frappe made from vanilla ice cream, instant coffee, banana and ice cubes.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in a blender.
Blend until smooth and frothy.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Estofado de Pollo (Chicken Stew)
recipes.description: A chicken stew with carrots, potatoes, peas and wine, flavored with garlic, cumin and yellow chile pepper.

ingredients.text: 1 whole chicken, cut into pieces (breast cut into 4 pieces)
ingredients.name: kurczak
ingredients.note: cut into pieces (breast cut into 4 pieces)

ingredients.text: 3 large carrots, cut into thirds and sliced lengthwise
ingredients.name: marchew
ingredients.note: cut into thirds and sliced lengthwise

ingredients.text: 3 large potatoes, cut into 4 pieces each
ingredients.name: ziemniak

ingredients.text: 1 yellow chile pepper (aji amarillo), seeded and thinly sliced lengthwise
ingredients.name: papryczka chili żółta
ingredients.note: aji amarillo, seeded and thinly sliced lengthwise

steps.text: In large Dutch oven, heat the oil and sauté onion and garlic.
Once onion begins to soften, add chopped tomato and chicken pieces.
Slightly brown the chicken pieces.
Season with salt, pepper, and cumin.
Once chicken has lightly browned, add the water, bouillon cubes and wine.
Cover and allow chicken to simmer over medium-low heat for at least 30 minutes.
Add the carrots, potatoes, and peas.
Taste broth, as more cumin or salt and pepper may be needed.
Add just enough water to simmer vegetables if needed.
Once vegetables are done, remove from heat and allow to sit uncovered for 5 minutes.
Serve with white, steamed rice.

recipes.title: French Martini
recipes.description: A cocktail of vodka, pineapple juice and raspberry or blackberry liqueur. The modern form of the drink is presented here.

steps.text: Shake ingredients with ice.
Serve in a cocktail glass with maraschino cherries.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Banana Smoothie
recipes.description: Smoothie z masłem orzechowym i bananem, bardzo smaczny.

ingredients.text: 2 tbsp honey (or agave nectar to make it vegan)
ingredients.name: miód
ingredients.note: or agave nectar to make it vegan

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in a blender.
Blend until smooth.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Sese Plaintains (Cameroonian Plantain Stew)
recipes.description: Sese plantains is a delicious and popular meal eaten in Cameroon. It is very easy to prepare.

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons chicken-flavour bouillon cube or powder
ingredients.name: bulion drobiowy

ingredients.text: 1 bunch of fresh kale leaves, chopped
ingredients.name: jarmuż

steps.text: Cut the ends off the plantains. Make a shallow slit through the length of the peel, and remove it.
Slice the plantains into thick rounds.
Boil the meat in a saucepan with salt, cayenne pepper, half the onions, and bouillon cubes until tender.
Add the plantain, crayfish, red oil, and remaining onions. Simmer for about 15–20 minutes.
Stir in the kale, and cook for an additional 8 minutes.
Remove from the heat and serve warm.

recipes.title: Apricot Chicken Salad
recipes.description: A very easy and healthy chicken salad made with apple, dried apricots and yogurt.

steps.text: Combine shredded chicken, apricots, apple and celery.
Add yogurt, honey, and hot paprika powder, along with any other desired seasonings.
Mix well.

recipes.title: Roz bel laban (Egyptian Rice Pudding)
recipes.description: Roz bel laban is a classic Egyptian dessert loved for its creamy and comforting texture, made with rice, milk, sugar and aromatic spices.

steps.text: Rinse the rice under cold water until the water runs clear. Drain well.
In the saucepan, combine the rinsed rice, milk, sugar, vanilla extract, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt. Stir well to combine the ingredients.
Place the saucepan over medium heat and bring the mixture to a gentle simmer, stirring occasionally to prevent the rice from sticking to the bottom of the pan.
Reduce the heat to low and let the mixture simmer uncovered, stirring occasionally, for about 30–40 minutes or until the rice is tender and the mixture thickens to a creamy consistency.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let the roz bel laban cool for a few minutes.
Once the pudding has cooled slightly, divide it between serving bowls or cups.
If you prefer to enjoy the pudding warm, it can be served immediately. If you prefer it chilled, refrigerate the pudding for at least 2 hours or until it is cold and set.
Before serving, garnish with chopped pistachios or almonds for added texture and flavor.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Balls
recipes.description: These chocolate chip balls are a baked good similar to chocolate chip cookies.

ingredients.text: 2 cups (480 ml / 12 oz) semi-sweet chocolate morsels or chocolate chips
ingredients.name: czekolada półgorzka

ingredients.text: 4 oz (120 g / ½ bar) grated milk chocolate
ingredients.name: czekolada mleczna

steps.text: Preheat oven to 375°F (around 200°C).
Cream butter and both sugars in a large mixer bowl.
Beat in eggs and vanilla extract.
Sift together the flour, salt, oat flour, baking powder, and baking soda.
Stir in chocolate morsels, grated chocolate bar, and nuts.
Roll into balls and place 2 inches apart on a cookie sheet.
Bake for 10 minutes or until golden brown (cooking times may vary). Remove and let stand for about 1 minute before moving cookies to a plate or cooling sheet.

recipes.title: Table Point Boiled Beef and Vegetables (Tafelspitz)
recipes.description: Classic Austrian boiled beef, known as tafelspitz, served with vegetables and apfelkren.

ingredients.text: 2½ pounds (1200 g) fresh beef brisket, silverside, or sirloin
ingredients.name: wołowina, udziec
ingredients.note: fresh beef brisket, silverside, or sirloin

ingredients.text: 3 whole cloves garlic, slightly crushed and peeled
ingredients.name: czosnek

ingredients.text: 3 whole green (freeze dried) or white peppercorns
ingredients.name: pieprz czarny
ingredients.note: whole green (freeze dried) or white peppercorns

ingredients.text: 2 juniper berries (you may substitute with 1 bay leaf)
ingredients.name: jałowiec
ingredients.note: juniper berries (you may substitute with 1 bay leaf)

ingredients.text: 3 ea. (4 oz / 110 g) whole medium size carrots, peeled and trimmed
ingredients.name: marchew
ingredients.note: whole medium size, peeled and trimmed (4 oz / 110 g each)

ingredients.text: 1 ea. (2 oz / 55 g) small-medium onion, unpeeled, trimmed, and halved
ingredients.name: cebula

steps.text: Fill a 5-quart (700 ml) Dutch oven with water, season it with salt, and bring to a rolling boil over medium heat.
When the water boils, add meat, garlic, peppercorns, and juniper berries, then cover the pot.
Bring the water to a boil again and add carrots, onion, and parsley. Cover and let everything simmer for 60 minutes.
Turn the meat over, add salt, and let everything cook, covered, for 90 additional minutes.
Switch off the heat, and let the meat steep for 20 minutes.
Remove the meat from the broth and cut meat across the grain when you serve it.
Serve tafelspitz with apfelkren (see notes) and your choice of raw and cooked vegetables.

recipes.title: Spicy Tomato Soup
recipes.description: Spicy tomato soup made from pureed tomatoes and heavy cream, seasoned with pepper, garlic and cayenne.

steps.text: In a blender or food processor, working in batches if necessary, puree tomatoes, cream, sugar, pepper, salt, garlic and cayenne.
Transfer soup to a saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, until soup thickens, 20–30 minutes.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Funkaso (Hausa Fritters)
recipes.description: Funkaso or pinkaso is a savoury Hausa fritter eaten with soup, honey, or sugar.

steps.text: Sift the flour into a mixing bowl, and mix in the yeast, salt, sugar, and baking powder.
Mix in enough water to form a sticky and loose dough.
Cover the dough, and let rise for 2 hours in a warm place.
Gently deflate the dough and bring it together in the bowl.
Heat a few inches of oil in a skillet or pot over medium heat. If you have a thermometer, aim for 350°F / 175°C. A small piece of dough should immediately float and start bubbling.

Dip the back of a ladle or other large cooking spoon into a bowl of water to prevent sticking. Scoop a handful of dough onto the back of the ladle. Stick your finger in the center, and pull it repeatedly towards the outside to make a hole in the center.

Turn the ladle over into the hot oil to release the dough into the oil—the ring should slip off. Fry the dough until golden brown and cooked through on all sides. You can work in batches as long as you do not overcrowd the fryer.
Remove the fritter(s) from the oil, and drain off any excess on a cooling rack.
Serve as desired with soup or sugar.

recipes.title: Black Pepper Beef with Green Beans
recipes.description: Stir-fried sirloin strips with green beans in a soy, cornstarch and black pepper sauce.

ingredients.text: 2 lb green beans, ends snapped off and strings removed
ingredients.name: fasolka szparagowa
ingredients.note: ends snapped off and strings removed

ingredients.text: ¼ cup rice wine or rice wine vinegar
ingredients.name: wino ryżowe

steps.text: Snap green beans in half.
Slice steak with the grain into 2-inch wide strips, then slice the strips across the grain into ¼ inch thick slices.
Whisk together soy sauce, cornstarch, wine/vinegar, sugar and black pepper in a medium bowl. Add steak strips and mix well. Let sit for 10 minutes.

Heat 2 tbsp of oil in pan over high heat until oil is hot but not smoking. Add green beans and stir for 1 minute. Add water and reduce heat to medium. Cover and cook until tender-crisp, 6–9 minutes. Transfer beans to a medium bowl.
Add ¼ cup of oil to pan over high heat. Add onion and ginger, and stir constantly for 1 minute. Add all of the beef mixture to the pan. Cook, stirring, until steak is no longer pink, about 2 minutes.
Return green beans to pan, stir until all is mixed well together.
Serve over noodles or rice.

recipes.title: Seven Minute Icing
recipes.description: A fluffy frosting made by beating egg white and sugar over boiling water.

steps.text: Put the egg white, sugar, and water in the top of a double boiler.
Place over boiling water and beat with a rotary egg beater seven minutes.
Then add baking powder and flavoring.
Remove from heat and beat until thick.
Spread in swirls over cake.

recipes.title: Fry Sauce
recipes.description: Fry sauce is a simple condiment, used often with fries.

steps.text: Combine the mayonnaise and ketchup.
Mix until the sauce is a strong pink colour.

recipes.title: Egyptian Milk Pudding (Mahalabiya)
recipes.description: Egyptian milk pudding, also known as mahalabiya, is a classic and indulgent dessert in Egyptian cuisine. This smooth and creamy pudding is flavored with rosewater and orange blossom water and garnished with crushed pistachios or almonds and ground cinnamon.

ingredients.text: Crushed pistachios or almonds for garnish
ingredients.name: pistacje

steps.text: In a saucepan, combine the milk, sugar, and cornstarch. Whisk or stir well to dissolve the cornstarch and sugar.
Place the saucepan over medium heat and cook the mixture, stirring constantly, until it thickens and comes to a gentle boil. This will take about 10–15 minutes.
Reduce the heat to low and continue cooking for another 2–3 minutes, stirring constantly, until the pudding has a smooth and creamy consistency.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the rosewater and orange blossom water. Mix well to incorporate the flavors.
Divide the pudding into serving bowls or dessert cups. Allow the pudding to cool for a few minutes, then refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or until chilled and set.
Just before serving, garnish each pudding with a sprinkle of ground cinnamon and a generous amount of crushed pistachios or almonds.
Serve the mahalabiya chilled and enjoy its creamy and refreshing taste.

recipes.title: Sesame Ginger Marinade
recipes.description: You can use this as a sauce or a marinade for either pork or shortribs.

steps.text: Give everything a big shake in an 8-ounce mason jar until smooth.
Refrigerate for up to two weeks.

recipes.title: Meat Masala
recipes.description: Meat masala is a spice mix used in Keralan cuisine, typically as a marinade for various types of meat, especially mutton.

steps.text: Toast the chillies, coriander, peppercorn, cumin, and mustard in a frying pan.
Grind all ingredients to a powder.
Store in a glass jar with a tight-fitting lid.

categories: Recipes using vegetable broth and stock

recipes.title: Egyptian Rice with Vermicelli
recipes.description: Long-grain rice cooked with toasted vermicelli noodles, a flavorful and aromatic side dish.

steps.text: In a medium-sized saucepan, heat the butter or olive oil over medium heat.
Add the vermicelli noodles to the saucepan and toast them until they turn golden brown, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Once the vermicelli is toasted, add the long-grain rice to the saucepan and stir to combine it with the noodles.
Pour in the water or vegetable broth and add salt to taste. Stir gently to distribute the ingredients evenly.
Bring the mixture to a boil over medium-high heat, then reduce the heat to low and cover the saucepan with a lid.
Allow the rice to simmer for about 15–20 minutes, or until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender.
Once the rice is cooked, remove the saucepan from the heat and let it sit, covered, for an additional 5 minutes to steam.
Fluff the rice with a fork, mixing in the toasted vermicelli noodles evenly.
Transfer the rice to a serving dish and garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
Serve the rice as a delicious side dish alongside your favorite Egyptian main courses.

recipes.title: Grapefruit and Crab Cocktail
recipes.description: A grapefruit cocktail topped with asparagus tips, a little crab, mayonnaise and parsley.

steps.text: Cut the grapefruits in half. Carefully remove and chop the flesh.
Divide the chopped grapefruit between 4 grapefruit hulls or 4 serving glasses.
Toss the asparagus tips with the oil, lemon juice and seasoning. Pile on top of the chopped grapefruit, and top each with a little crab.
To decorate, put 1 teaspoon mayonnaise on each portion, and garnish with parsley.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Liberian Palm Oil Stew
recipes.description: Liberian palm oil stew is a delicious and hearty dish from Liberia. Made with a rich combination of palm oil, vegetables, and protein, this stew is a staple in Liberian cuisine and is often served with rice or fufu.

ingredients.text: 1 Scotch bonnet chile pepper, finely chopped (optional, for spiciness)
ingredients.name: papryczka chili

ingredients.text: 1 pound fish, cut into steaks or fillets
ingredients.name: ryba

steps.text: In a large pot, heat the palm oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the pot. Sauté until the onion becomes translucent and fragrant.
Stir in the diced green and red bell peppers and chopped Scotch bonnet pepper (if using). Cook for a few minutes until the peppers start to soften.
Add the chicken pieces to the pot and cook until they are lightly browned on all sides.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a simmer. Cover the pot and let the chicken cook for about 20–25 minutes, or until it is fully cooked and tender.
Once the chicken is cooked, add the fish steaks or fillets to the pot and let them simmer in the stew for an additional 5–10 minutes, or until they are cooked through.
Stir in the sliced okra and diced eggplant. Let the stew simmer for another 5–7 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Season the stew with salt and ground black pepper to taste. Adjust the seasoning according to your preference.
Remove the pot from the heat and let the stew rest for a few minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Tahini Cookies
recipes.description: Ciasteczka z tahini, miodem, cynamonem, płatkami owsianymi i orzechami włoskimi.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease cookie sheets.
In a medium bowl, stir together the tahini, honey, and cinnamon.
Mix in walnuts and oats until well blended.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto the prepared cookie sheets. Cookies should be about 2 inches apart.
Bake for 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are slightly brown.
Cool on the baking sheet for a few minutes before removing to wire racks to cool completely.

recipes.title: Uppittu (Indian Semolina Porridge)
recipes.description: Upma, or uppittu as it is known in Karnataka, is a wholesome Indian dish made of rava (cream of wheat) with a healthy amount of vegetables.

ingredients.text: 1 cup upma rava (common in India and also found in Indian stores in other countries)
ingredients.name: kasza manna
ingredients.note: upma rava (common in India and also found in Indian stores in other countries)

ingredients.text: 1 medium-sized onion, finely chopped (more onions may also be added to give extra flavour)
ingredients.name: cebula
ingredients.note: medium-sized, finely chopped (more onions may also be added to give extra flavour)

steps.text: In a wok or other suitable pan, heat 1 tbsp of oil. When the oil is hot add the rava, and stir it with a spoon until it starts browning. The main purpose of this is to coat the rava grains with the oil so that they don't stick. Be sure not to burn the rava or you will have to restart.
Set the rava aside, and let it cool.

In the same wok or another suitable pan, heat the remaining oil. When hot, add the mustard seeds and wait until the seeds start crackling. When the crackling starts tapering off, add the onions and fry until golden brown.
Add the ginger and the garlic, and stir for a few seconds.

Add the remaining vegetables and the water, plus enough salt such that when tasted it is slightly saltier than required. Turn the heat to medium and let it simmer until the vegetables are cooked but still crispy.
