Mix salt and gram flour. Stuff the slit peppers with this mixture, and keep aside for 15–20 minutes.
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Mix all other dry ingredients. Dip each green pepper into this mixture gently to coat it.
Deep fry in heated oil until golden brown.
Drain on kitchen paper to remove excess oil.
Serve hot with chutney or ketchup.

recipes.title: Crêpes II
recipes.description: Cienkie naleśniki z mąki pszennej, mleka, jajka i roztopionego masła, smażone na gorącej płycie do naleśników.

steps.text: Combine the egg, milk, and salt. Mix in the flour, then the melted butter to get a batter. Let batter rest for at least 30 minutes.
Stir the batter to redistribute the ingredients.

Regulate the temperature of a crêpe hot plate to 160°C if possible. If there is no temperature scale then you have to find out on yourself what is best suited. As a guideline, the batter still should be liquid when you finished your first circular move of spreading.
Grease the plate with a cloth dipped in a little vegetable oil. How often you have to repeat it depends on the plate you use but as a general rule it should be before every crêpe.

When the plate reaches temperature, ladle some batter on the plate. Quickly spread the batter across the plate with circling movements of a T-shaped batter spreader. Be careful not to rip or tear spots where the batter has already set—this takes a bit of practice. Never scrub over the surface—the move must come out of the wrist in a flowing movement, without holding the spreader too firmly.
The sides of the batter will arch up as it cooks—flip it over to cook the other side using a large offset/icing spatula or heat resistant plastic blade with no angled handle.

Begin garnishing the crêpe with solid fillings, if using. If you want to use something very liquid as a topping such as marmalade, juice, or alcohol, don't do this on the plate as the crêpe gets soggy, and the plate may get sticky. If you want to fold the crêpe when it's done, you should only garnish one half of the crêpe—otherwise the filling may fall down in the fold, liquid may flow out, and the crepe may become messy.
When the bottom starts to get brown spots, remove from the hot plate. Top with any remaining fillings.
To serve, roll it or fold it in quarters or sixths so it can be easily eaten even without cutlery. You should eat it right away if you don't want the crêpe to cool down.

recipes.title: Gored Gored (Ethiopian Raw Beef)
recipes.description: Gored gored is a dish of tender raw beef cubes marinated in traditional Ethiopian spices, typically served as part of a larger Ethiopian meal.

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons niter kibbeh (spiced clarified butter), melted
ingredients.name: masło klarowane z przyprawami

ingredients.text: ½ teaspoon freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: pieprz czarny

ingredients.text: ¼ teaspoon cayenne pepper, or to taste
ingredients.name: pieprz cayenne

ingredients.text: 1 pound high-quality beef, preferably tenderloin or sirloin, cut into bite-sized cubes
ingredients.name: polędwica wołowa
ingredients.note: high-quality, preferably tenderloin or sirloin, cut into bite-sized cubes

ingredients.text: Fresh parsley or cilantro, chopped, for garnish
ingredients.name: natka pietruszki
ingredients.note: fresh parsley or cilantro, chopped, for garnish

steps.text: In a large mixing bowl, combine the melted niter kibbeh, berbere spice blend, lime juice, salt, black pepper, cardamom, and cayenne pepper. Mix well to create a marinade.
Add the bite-sized beef cubes to the marinade and toss until well coated.
Cover the bowl and let the beef marinate in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours, or overnight for more intense flavors.
Just before serving, remove the beef from the refrigerator and let it come to room temperature.
Transfer the marinated beef cubes to a serving plate, arranging them in a single layer.
Garnish with freshly chopped parsley or cilantro.
Serve immediately with injera or other bread of your choice.

recipes.title: Kansas City Barbecue Sauce
recipes.description: Classic sweet and tangy barbecue sauce based on ketchup and molasses.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Cook, stirring often for 15 minutes.
Cool, and keep refrigerated in a nonreactive container for up to 2 months.

recipes.title: Yoghurt Bread
recipes.description: Bread made with a sourdough-like starter from yoghurt, water, honey and all-purpose flour.

steps.text: Wash a glass jar with water and leave it wet.
Sterilize by microwaving it for 4 minutes.
Mix the water, yoghurt, and honey in the jar.
Screw on the cap loosely, and let stand for 3–4 days until bubbly.
Add the flour and mix well.
Let rest until doubled in volume.
Proceed to the final assembly stage in pain au levain naturel.

recipes.title: Nigerian Dodo (Fried Ripe Plantain)
recipes.description: Dodo is a Nigerian dish of fried ripe plantain. It is often served with jollof rice, rice and beans, and beans porridge.

ingredients.text: ½ cup puréed chile pepper mixed with tomatoes
ingredients.name: purée z papryczki chili i pomidorów
ingredients.note: puréed chile pepper mixed with tomatoes

steps.text: Cut each ripe plantain into 6 small pieces.
Toss with salt and chile-tomato purée to taste.
Heat ½ cup of oil in a frying pan.
Add the 6 plantain pieces, and deep fry until all sides are golden brown.
Serve with jollof rice or bean porridge.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Honey Lime Pork Loin
recipes.description: Pieczona polędwica wieprzowa z sosem miodowo-limonkowym.

steps.text: Heat oil in a large sauté pan over high heat. Add roast and cook until thoroughly browned on all sides.
Remove from pan and keep warm. Add broth and deglaze pan, stirring to remove browned bits.
Place roast in a greased roasting pan and rub with seasonings.
Reduce chicken broth by half.
Combine chicken broth with wine and Worcestershire sauce and pour over pork.
Insert an oven-safe probe thermometer in the roast and bake at 275°F (135°C) until internal temperature reaches 145°F (63°C). Keep warm.
Place cooking liquid in the refrigerator until fat has solidified. Remove and discard fat.
Stir in honey and lime juice. Set aside.
Melt butter over medium heat in a large saucepan. Whisk in flour and cook, stirring constantly until light blonde color is achieved.
Add cooking liquid mixture to the pan and boil until reduced by ⅓.
Rewarm pork, if needed. Slice and serve with sauce.

recipes.title: Salata Hara (Libyan Spicy Salad)
recipes.description: Vibrant and spicy Libyan salad with roasted red bell peppers, chile, cumin and cayenne, served as a side dish with grilled meats.

ingredients.text: 2 red bell peppers, roasted, peeled, and finely chopped
ingredients.name: papryka czerwona

ingredients.text: 1 hot chile pepper (such as jalapeno , finely chopped
ingredients.name: papryczka chili

ingredients.text: ½ teaspoon ground cayenne pepper (adjust according to spice preference)
ingredients.name: pieprz cayenne

ingredients.text: Fresh chopped parsley or cilantro for garnish
ingredients.name: natka pietruszki
ingredients.note: fresh chopped parsley or cilantro for garnish

steps.text: In a mixing bowl, combine the roasted and chopped red bell peppers, green bell pepper, hot chili pepper, tomato, onion, and garlic.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, olive oil, cumin, cayenne pepper, salt, and pepper.
Pour the dressing over the vegetables and toss well to coat all the ingredients.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld together.
Before serving, garnish the salad with chopped parsley or cilantro.

recipes.title: Stuffed Kabocha Squash
recipes.description: Kabocha squash baked and stuffed with tempeh, shallots, ginger, jalapeño, soy sauce and rice.

steps.text: Cut off top of kabocha squash and scoop out seeds.
Bake the squash for 45 minutes at 375°F (190°C) or until a sharp knife goes through the flesh easily.
Meanwhile, fry the tempeh, shallots, ginger, and jalapeño.
Cook until tempeh is completely brown, and then add soy sauce and rice.
Take off heat and mix thoroughly.
Put tempeh mixture into kabocha squash and bake for 30 more minutes.

recipes.title: Gambian Superkanja Soup
recipes.description: A traditional Gambian soup made with leafy greens, meat or smoked fish, okra, pumpkin, eggplant and tomatoes.

ingredients.text: 500 g meat (beef, lamb, or chicken), or Gambian smoked fish
ingredients.name: mięso wołowe, jagnięce lub kurczak
ingredients.note: beef, lamb, or chicken, or Gambian smoked fish

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper (optional, for added spiciness)
ingredients.name: pieprz cayenne

ingredients.text: 2 cups mixed leafy greens (such as spinach, kale, or collard greens), washed and chopped
ingredients.name: mieszanka zielonych liści (szpinak, jarmuż lub kapusta)

steps.text: If using meat, cut it into bite-sized pieces and season with salt and pepper.
In a large pot or Dutch oven, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic. Sauté until they become soft and translucent.
Add the meat or smoked fish to the pot and cook until browned. Stir occasionally to ensure even cooking.
Add the diced tomatoes, tomato paste, ground ginger, ground paprika, and ground cayenne pepper (if using) to the pot. Stir well to combine.
Mix in the sliced okra, diced pumpkin or squash, and diced eggplant. Stir to incorporate the vegetables into the mixture.

Add enough water or broth to the pot to cover the ingredients. The amount of liquid will depend on the desired consistency of the soup. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and cover the pot with a lid.
Allow the soup to simmer for about 30–45 minutes, or until the meat is tender and the vegetables are cooked through. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking.
Add the chopped leafy greens to the pot. Stir well to combine.
Continue simmering the soup for an additional 5–10 minutes, or until the greens have wilted and become tender.
Taste the soup and adjust the seasoning with salt and pepper according to your preference.
Serve hot with a side of rice or bread.

recipes.title: Mexican Ribs
recipes.description: Pork ribs with a Southwestern chile rub, cooked low and slow over mesquite, then finished on the grill with a tequila and barbecue sauce mixture.

ingredients.text: ¼ cup tequila (recommended: José Cuervo Especial)
ingredients.name: tequila

steps.text: Combine sugar, chile powders, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Remove membrane from ribs and rub both sides with mixture.
Refrigerate for at least 1 hour to marinate.
Combine tequila, habanero, and sauce.
Bring to a boil in a large saucepan over medium high heat.
Set aside.
Place enough mesquite chunks in a smoker to keep the temperature at 200°F.
Place ribs in smoker and cook 7 hours, basting every hour with sauce mixture.
Brush meat side liberally with sauce mixture.
Place sauce side-down on a high grill and cook until well-browned.
Brush other side with sauce and repeat 1 more time.
Slice ribs into 1-rib portions and serve warm with remaining sauce.

categories: Recipes using vegetable broth and stock

recipes.title: Yetsom Shiro (Ethiopian Vegan Chickpea Stew)
recipes.description: Yetsom shiro is a flavorful and hearty dish made with ground chickpeas and a blend of aromatic spices. This vegan stew is a staple in Ethiopian cuisine and is enjoyed as a main course with injera or rice.

ingredients.text: 1 cup chickpea flour (also known as besan or gram flour)
ingredients.name: mąka z ciecierzycy
ingredients.note: also known as besan or gram flour

ingredients.text: ¼ teaspoon cayenne pepper, or to taste
ingredients.name: pieprz cayenne

ingredients.text: Fresh cilantro or parsley, chopped, for garnish
ingredients.name: kolendra świeża

steps.text: In a dry medium-sized saucepan, toast the chickpea flour over medium heat for a few minutes until it becomes fragrant and lightly browned. Remove from heat and set aside.
Heat the olive oil in the same saucepan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and minced garlic, and sauté until the onion becomes translucent.
Stir in the berbere spice blend, paprika, turmeric, cumin, cayenne pepper, and salt. Mix well to coat the onions and garlic with the spices.
Add the toasted chickpea flour to the saucepan and stir to combine it with the spice mixture.
Gradually add the vegetable broth or water to the saucepan, stirring continuously to prevent lumps from forming.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the stew for about 20–25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chickpea flour is fully cooked and the stew has thickened to your desired consistency.
Taste and adjust the seasoning with salt or additional spices if desired.
Remove from heat and let the stew rest for a few minutes to allow the flavors to meld together.
Garnish with freshly chopped cilantro or parsley. Serve hot as a main course, accompanied by injera or rice.

recipes.title: Pimento Cheese Spread I
recipes.description: A Southern U.S. spread made from sharp cheddar, mayonnaise, pimentos and optional jalapeños.

ingredients.text: ¼–2 teaspoons finely diced jalapeños, to taste
ingredients.name: jalapeño

steps.text: Mix ingredients thoroughly.
Store in well-sealed container in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Sesame Milk
recipes.description: A simple plant milk made from tahini, water and a little sweetener.

ingredients.text: 1 tsp maple syrup or other vegan sweetener
ingredients.name: syrop klonowy
ingredients.note: maple syrup or other vegan sweetener

steps.text: Roughly combine ingredients.
Process with a blender until smooth.
Chill for several hours.
Stir before serving.

recipes.title: Tisane ma Louisa (Algerian Lemon Herb Tea)
recipes.description: Tisane ma Louisa to algierska ziołowa herbatka z werbeny i soku z cytryny.

steps.text: Heat the water in a saucepan and bring it to a boil.
Add the verbena leaves to the boiling water.
Let the verbena leaves steep in water for about 10 minutes.
Stir the leaves in the water (attempt to crush them as small as possible), then strain out the leaves.
Add the lemon juice and sugar.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Chicken Soup with Pasta
recipes.description: A hearty chicken soup with dried mushrooms, vegetables and small pasta, finished with lemon and parsley.

ingredients.text: ½-ounce (15 g) package dried crimini or portobello mushrooms
ingredients.name: grzyby suszone

ingredients.text: 1¼ pounds (570 g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs, halved
ingredients.name: udko z kurczaka

ingredients.text: 1 cup small pasta, like elbows or shells
ingredients.name: makaron

steps.text: Place the mushrooms in a medium bowl and fill with hot water to cover. Set aside to reconstitute.
Place the flour in a shallow bowl. Dredge each piece of chicken through the flour to lightly coat on all sides. Set aside.
In a large stock pot over medium-high heat, combine the butter and olive oil.
When the fat begins to sizzle, add the chicken and cook, turning as needed, until lightly browned on all sides, about 5 to 7 minutes. Remove the meat from the pot and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium, and add the onion, garlic, thyme, basil, and rosemary. Sauté until onions begin to brown, about 5 minutes.
Increase heat to high and add broth and water. Bring the broth to a simmer.
Meanwhile, cut the meat into bite-size pieces.
Drain the mushrooms and squeeze any liquid from them.
When the broth is simmering, lower heat to medium-high and add the meat, mushrooms, peas, and carrots.
Return to a simmer, and cook until the carrots are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the pasta and celery and cook until just tender, about another 5 minutes.
Stir in the parsley and lemon juice, then season to taste with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Fry Seasoning for Chicken
recipes.description: A dry spice blend for seasoning fried chicken.

ingredients.text: 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce powder (you can find this easily on the Internet)
ingredients.name: sos Worcestershire w proszku
ingredients.note: you can find this easily on the Internet

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in an airtight container with a shaker lid.

recipes.title: Egyptian Stuffed Eggplant (Mahshi Betinjan)
recipes.description: Egyptian stuffed eggplant, also known as mahshi betinjan, has hollowed eggplant halves filled with a savory mixture of rice, ground meat, herbs and spices, then baked until tender.

ingredients.text: ¼ cup fresh parsley, finely chopped
ingredients.name: natka pietruszki

ingredients.text: ¼ cup fresh dill, finely chopped
ingredients.name: koperek

ingredients.text: ¼ cup fresh mint, finely chopped
ingredients.name: mięta

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F).
Wash the eggplants and cut off the stem end. Slice each eggplant in half lengthwise.
Use a spoon to carefully hollow out the eggplant halves, leaving about a ½-inch thick shell. Set aside the hollowed-out eggplant flesh to use in the filling.

In a mixing bowl, combine the ground beef or lamb, rinsed rice, finely chopped onion, minced garlic, fresh parsley, fresh dill, fresh mint, tomato paste, ground cumin, ground paprika, ground cinnamon, salt, and pepper. Mix well until all the ingredients are thoroughly combined.
Stuff each hollowed-out eggplant half with the meat and rice filling, packing it firmly into the shell.
Arrange the stuffed eggplants in a baking dish, making sure they fit snugly.
Drizzle the stuffed eggplants with olive oil to keep them moist and enhance the flavor.
Cover the baking dish with foil and bake in the preheated oven for about 45–50 minutes, or until the eggplants are tender and the filling is cooked through.
Once cooked, remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10–15 minutes to allow the tops to brown slightly.
Remove the eggplant from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the mahshi betinjan hot as a main course, garnished with fresh herbs if desired. It pairs well with a side of Egyptian bread, rice, or a salad.

recipes.title: Chocolate and Nut Covered Strawberries
recipes.description: Strawberries coated in melted semisweet chocolate flavored with hazelnut syrup, optionally rolled in chopped nuts or crushed gingersnaps.

ingredients.text: 4 ounces semisweet chocolate, melted using a double boiler
ingredients.name: czekolada półsłodka

ingredients.text: Chopped hazelnuts, pecans, walnuts, or almonds (optional)
ingredients.name: orzechy siekane
ingredients.note: hazelnuts, pecans, walnuts, or almonds; optional

steps.text: Combine melted chocolate, syrup, sugar, and salt in a large bowl.
If using cookies or nuts, place them in a pie plate.
Add strawberries to chocolate mixture and toss to coat. If using nuts or cookies, roll strawberries in them.
Insert a toothpick into the side of each fruit and refrigerate until coating sets.
Serve chilled.

recipes.title: Tofu and Couscous
recipes.description: A side dish of couscous combined with sautéed tofu, red bell pepper and raisins.

ingredients.text: ½ cup fresh red bell peppers, diced
ingredients.name: papryka czerwona

steps.text: Sauté tofu, red peppers, and raisins together until soft.
Bring the water to a boil, stir in the couscous, cover, remove from the heat, and let rest for 5 minutes until the water is absorbed.
Fluff the couscous with a fork.
Combine the tofu mixture with couscous and olive oil.
Flavor to taste with curry or other mixed spices.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock
Recipes using vegetable broth and stock

recipes.title: Nigerian Egg Pepper Soup
recipes.description: A popular Nigerian dish known for its simplicity and bold flavors, combining eggs, peppers and spices into a rich, flavorful soup.

ingredients.text: 2 bell peppers (red, green, or a combination), thinly sliced
ingredients.name: papryka
ingredients.note: red, green, or a combination; thinly sliced

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper (adjust to your preferred spice level)
ingredients.name: pieprz cayenne
ingredients.note: ground; adjust to your preferred spice level

ingredients.text: Fresh cilantro or parsley, for garnish (optional)
ingredients.name: kolendra świeża lub pietruszka

steps.text: Heat the vegetable oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the chopped onions and minced garlic, and sauté until the onions become translucent and slightly golden.
Add the sliced bell peppers and chopped tomatoes to the saucepan. Cook for a few minutes until the vegetables start to soften.
In a separate bowl, crack the eggs and whisk them until well-beaten. Set aside.

Add the chicken or vegetable broth to the saucepan with the vegetables. Stir in the ground cayenne pepper, paprika, cumin, and coriander. Season with salt to taste. Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Slowly pour the beaten eggs into the simmering soup, stirring gently with a wooden spoon or spatula in one direction. This will create thin strands of cooked egg throughout the soup.
Continue cooking the soup for about 3–4 minutes, allowing the egg to cook and thicken the soup slightly.
Taste the soup and adjust the seasoning if needed. Add more salt or spices according to your preference.
Once the soup is ready, remove it from the heat.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro or parsley if desired.

recipes.title: Portable Eggs Benedict
recipes.description: A neat to-go version of a favorite poached egg dish.

steps.text: Boil enough water to fill a deep pan.
Add vinegar to the water.
Crack eggs into the boiling water/vinegar mixture.
Leave the eggs alone for 5–7 minutes.
Cut open the top of a pita.
Line the inside of the pita with cream cheese and smoked salmon.
Take eggs out of the pan using a slotted spoon and drop them into the pita.
Eat immediately.

recipes.title: Crispy Salmon
recipes.description: Skinless wild salmon fillets coated in flour, lemon juice and panko, baked and then browned under the broiler.

ingredients.text: 4 ea. (24 ounces) skinless wild salmon fillets, pin bones removed
ingredients.name: filet z łososia dzikiego

steps.text: Combine flour, salt, and pepper in a pie pan, place panko in another pan, and place lemon juice in a large bowl.
Using wet-hand dry-hand, dredge salmon into flour then into lemon, then into panko. Coat with olive oil and place on a sheet pan.
Bake in the center of a 375°F oven for 27 minutes or until slightly underdone.
Remove from oven, and heat up the broiler. Place salmon under broiler and cook until deeply browned.
Serve immediately.

categories: Recipes using vegetable broth and stock

recipes.title: Shiro (Ethiopian Spiced Chickpea or Lentil Stew)
recipes.description: Flavorful Ethiopian stew made with spiced chickpea or lentil flour, thick and creamy, served with injera.

ingredients.text: 1 cup shiro powder (chickpea or lentil flour)
ingredients.name: mąka z ciecierzycy

ingredients.text: ½ teaspoon salt, or to taste
ingredients.name: sól

ingredients.text: Fresh parsley or cilantro, chopped, for garnish
ingredients.name: natka pietruszki lub kolendra świeża

steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and sauté until translucent and slightly browned.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and sauté for an additional minute until fragrant.
Sprinkle the berbere spice blend, ground cumin, ground turmeric, salt, and black pepper over the onions and garlic. Stir well to coat the ingredients with the spices.
Add the shiro powder to the pot and stir it into the onion and spice mixture.
Gradually pour in the vegetable broth or water while continuously stirring to prevent any lumps from forming.
Bring the mixture to a gentle boil, then reduce the heat to low and let it simmer for about 20–25 minutes, stirring occasionally. The stew will thicken and develop a rich flavor.
Taste and adjust the seasoning with salt and pepper if needed.
Remove the pot from the heat and let the shiro rest for a few minutes before serving.
Garnish the shiro with fresh chopped parsley or cilantro. Serve hot with injera or bread for dipping.

recipes.title: Masyaura Curry
recipes.description: Curry z masyaury (suszonej soczewicy/ziarna) z pomidorami, przyprawami i kolendrą.

ingredients.text: 1–2 serrano pepper or other green chiles, finely chopped
ingredients.name: papryczka serrano
mieszanka kminu i kolendry w proszku

steps.text: Heat ½ cup oil in a pan. Add the masyaura, and fry until it becomes red and crispy. Stir as you fry because it burns fast. Remove masyaura from oil once finished.
In a separate pan heat the remaining ½ cup oil. Add cumin and fenugreek seeds. Once seeds are golden brown, add potato and green chilies. Fry until it becomes golden brown.
Add fried masyaura, salt, and turmeric powder, then stir properly. Cover and cook on low to medium heat for 5 minutes.
Add tomato, cumin-coriander powder, ginger-garlic paste, pepper, and red chili powder. Stir, cover, and cook for another 5 minutes.
Add water and stir well. Cook on medium heat and let the mixture boil. Remove from the heat once you get the desired gravy consistency.
Sprinkle with cilantro to garnish.

recipes.title: Microwave Salmon in a Parchment Envelope
recipes.description: Salmon filet steamed in a parchment envelope with fresh herbs, lemon, white wine and butter, cooked in the microwave.

steps.text: Take a 15 x 36-inch piece of parchment paper, and fold it in half like a book. Draw a large half-heart on the paper, with fold of the paper being the center line of the heart. Cut out heart and open.
Place fresh herbs in the bottom of half of the heart. Place 2 lemon slices on top of the herbs and top with the salmon. Sprinkle both sides with salt, paprika, and freshly ground black pepper.
Drizzle salmon with white wine and top evenly with butter cubes. Top with remaining lemon slices.

Fold other side of heart over fish and starting at top of heart shape, fold up both edges of parchment, overlapping folds as you move along. Once you reach the end tip, twist several times to secure tightly.
Place on a microwave-safe plate and microwave on high 4 minutes, or until internal temperature reaches 131°F. Open parchment and serve warm.

recipes.title: Mango Avocado Salsa
recipes.description: Refreshingly tasty mango avocado salsa is a crowd-pleasing snack or appetizer with tortilla chips.

ingredients.text: 1 small bunch of cilantro, chopped (about 1 cup, packed)
ingredients.name: kolendra świeża (liście)

ingredients.text: 3 Hass avocados, peeled, cored, and diced
ingredients.name: awokado

ingredients.text: 1 ripe mango, peeled, cored, and diced (about 1 cup)
ingredients.name: mango

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl.
Mix well with a spoon and serve with tortilla chips or use it as toppings for another dish.

recipes.title: Grilled Mesquite Meatloaf
recipes.description: Unlike regular meatloaf, which is baked in an oven, this version is grilled over mesquite to form a nice crust and smoky flavor.

steps.text: Heat oil in a large sauté pan over medium-high heat. Add onion and a pinch of kosher salt, and cook until translucent.
Add garlic and cook until garlic reaches a golden color.
Add celery and cook until lightly browned around edges. Set aside until cool.

Mix together ground chuck, onion mixture, lemon juice, pepper, red pepper flakes, Worcestershire sauce, and breadcrumbs. Shape into a 3½ x 7½-inch loaf about 2 inches thick. Brush with ketchup and set aside.
Heat charcoal in a large chimney starter. Once hot, evenly distribute around the bottom of the grill and mix with mesquite. Reapply the grate and place the loaf on top.
Grill, covered, turning often, until internal temperature reaches 160°F (72˚C).
Remove from heat and let rest for 10 minutes.
Serve thick slices with mashed potatoes, roast vegetables, and gravy.

recipes.title: Cod, Olive Oil, and Cream Sauce (Brandade de Morue)
recipes.description: A French regional dish of salt cod puréed with olive oil, onion, garlic and milk or cream, served on toast or potato slices.

ingredients.text: 1 lb salt cod, skinless and boneless
ingredients.name: dorsz solony

ingredients.text: ½ cup milk or heavy cream
ingredients.name: mleko

ingredients.text: 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, or to taste
ingredients.name: sok z cytryny

ingredients.text: 2 cloves garlic, pressed or grated with a microplane
ingredients.name: czosnek
ingredients.note: pressed or grated with a microplane

steps.text: Place the salt cod in a large bowl of cold water.
Soak for 24 hours, changing the water several times. When the fish has completely rehydrated, it is ready for the next step.
Poach the cod in plain water for 25 minutes or until it flakes easily when tested.
Drain and break it into pieces.
Cook the onion in olive oil over low heat until translucent.
In a food processor, purée the cod, onion, and garlic with half of the olive oil.
With the motor running add the milk or cream, rest of the oil, lemon juice and pepper.
Blend until smooth. If it is too thick, thin with milk or cream.
Serve on toast or over potato slices, coated with olive oil and roasted in a 400ºF (200ºC) oven for 30 to 40 minutes, turning once.

recipes.title: Tapalapa (Gambian Bread)
recipes.description: Tapalapa is a traditional Gambian bread that is soft, slightly chewy, and perfect for sandwiches or as a side to accompany various dishes.

steps.text: In a mixing bowl, combine the all-purpose flour, instant yeast, salt, and sugar. Mix well to evenly distribute the dry ingredients.

Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients and pour in the vegetable oil and warm water. Use a whisk or fork to gradually incorporate the dry ingredients into the wet ingredients until a soft dough forms.

Transfer the dough onto a clean, lightly floured surface. Knead the dough for about 10–15 minutes, or until it becomes smooth, elastic, and slightly sticky. Add more flour if needed to prevent sticking, but avoid adding too much to keep the bread light and soft.

Shape the dough into a ball, place it back into the mixing bowl, and cover the bowl with a clean kitchen towel or plastic wrap. Allow the dough to rise in a warm, draft-free place for about 1–2 hours, or until it doubles in size.
Preheat your oven to 200°C (400°F).
Once the dough has risen, gently punch it down to release the air.

Transfer the dough onto a lightly floured surface and divide it into equal-sized portions, depending on the desired size of your bread loaves or rolls. Shape each portion into a round or oval loaf, or roll them into individual bread rolls.
Place the shaped dough onto a baking sheet or baking tray lined with parchment paper.
Place the baking sheet or tray with the shaped dough into the preheated oven. Bake for about 20–25 minutes, or until the bread has turned golden brown and sounds hollow when tapped on the bottom.
Remove the bread from the oven and let it cool on a wire rack before slicing or serving.

recipes.title: Zhug II
recipes.description: Ostra pasta z papryczek chili, kolendry i czosnku, przyprawiona kuminem i solą.

steps.text: Grind and blend together the chiles, coriander, and garlic.
Add water, salt, cumin, and pepper. Blend all together again.
Store in a sealed jar.

recipes.title: Roast Chicken on Salt
recipes.description: An old family recipe for chicken roasted on a bed of salt, from Russia.

steps.text: Stuff the chicken with the quartered lemon, garlic and rosemary.
Bind the chicken ready for roasting.
Fill a baking tray with the salt and place the chicken on top.
Roast for 90 minutes at 190°C. The flesh should be moist and the skin crisp.

recipes.title: Hot Wing Dip
recipes.description: A creamy blue cheese dip with cayenne, served with celery and hot wings.

ingredients.text: * 1 recipe Hot Wings or Buffalo Wings
ingredients.name: skrzydełka z kurczaka
ingredients.note: Hot Wings or Buffalo Wings recipe

steps.text: Combine cheese, cayenne, sour cream, garlic, and salt in a serving bowl.
Serve with celery and hot wings/Buffalo Wings.

recipes.title: Riz Gras (West African Fried Rice)
recipes.description: Riz gras is a popular and flavorful rice dish enjoyed in West Africa. This versatile recipe typically consists of cooked rice stir-fried with an array of vegetables, meats, and aromatic spices.

ingredients.text: 1 cup mixed vegetables (carrots, peas, corn, bell peppers, etc.), diced
ingredients.name: mieszanka warzyw

ingredients.text: 1 cup cooked meat (chicken, shrimp, beef, or tofu; optional), diced
ingredients.name: mięso gotowane

steps.text: Rinse the rice thoroughly under cold water until the water runs clear.
In a pot, add the rinsed rice and the appropriate amount of water, following the package instructions.

Bring the water to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover with a tight-fitting lid, and let the rice simmer for the recommended cooking time (usually around 15–20 minutes or as per package instructions).
Once cooked, fluff the rice with a fork and set it aside.
Heat a small amount of vegetable oil in the skillet or wok over medium heat.
Pour the lightly beaten eggs into the pan, and scramble them until cooked through.
Remove the scrambled eggs from the pan, and set them aside.
In the same skillet or wok, add more vegetable oil if needed, and heat it over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and garlic, and sauté until the onion turns translucent and the garlic is fragrant.
Add the mixed vegetables and cooked meat (if using) to the skillet, and stir-fry until they are tender and heated through.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet and stir-fry with the vegetables and meat until everything is well combined.
Pour the soy sauce, and oyster sauce (if using) over the rice mixture and mix well to evenly coat the rice.
Season with salt and pepper according to your taste. Drizzle the sesame oil over the fried rice and give it a final toss to enhance the flavor.
Garnish with chopped green onions, cilantro, and prepared scrambled eggs.
Transfer to a serving dish and enjoy it hot.

recipes.title: Gomen (Ethiopian Collard Greens)
recipes.description: Gomen is a popular Ethiopian dish made with collard greens and seasoned with aromatic spices. It is a staple side dish that pairs well with injera.

ingredients.text: 1 large bunch of collard greens, washed and chopped
ingredients.name: jarmuż

ingredients.text: Freshly squeezed juice from ½ lemon, for added tanginess
ingredients.name: sok z cytryny
ingredients.note: freshly squeezed juice, for added tanginess

steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions to the pot and sauté until they become translucent and slightly browned.
Stir in the minced garlic and grated ginger, and sauté for an additional minute until fragrant.
Add the turmeric, paprika, cumin, and cayenne pepper (if using) to the pot. Mix well to combine the spices with the onions and garlic.
Add the chopped collard greens to the pot and stir to coat them with the spice mixture. Cook for a few minutes until the collard greens start to wilt.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and simmer for about 20–25 minutes, or until the collard greens are tender and fully cooked. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking.
Season with salt to taste and add the freshly squeezed lemon juice. Mix well to incorporate the flavors.
Remove the pot from heat and let rest for a few minutes before serving.
Serve hot as a side dish with injera or any other bread of your choice.

recipes.title: Tuna Curry
recipes.description: A quick pan-fried curry with tuna, vegetables and milk, served over rice.

ingredients.text: 3 tablespoons (45 g / 45 ml) butter or olive oil
ingredients.name: masło

ingredients.text: 100 g (3½ oz) frozen vegetables, such as carrot slices, green beans, or peas
ingredients.name: warzywa mrożone
ingredients.note: such as carrot slices, green beans, or peas

ingredients.text: 1 can (150 g/5¼ oz) tuna in water, drained
ingredients.name: tuńczyk

steps.text: Heat the oil or melt the butter in a saucepan.
Sauté the onion in the butter or olive oil until transparent.
Add the flour and stir until the flour is completely incorporated.
Add the curry powder and stir until it is completely incorporated.
Add the milk and frozen veggies and stir until the mixture gets hot again.
Stir in the tuna.
Salt and pepper to taste. Tuna is naturally salty, so add the tuna before tasting.
Heat thoroughly and serve over rice.

categories: Recipes using vegetable broth and stock

recipes.title: Coq au Vin III
recipes.description: Chicken braised in red burgundy wine with pancetta, mushrooms, onions and carrots, thickened with a roux and flavoured with asafoetida.

ingredients.text: 1.5 kg (about 3.5 lbs) chicken, jointed (or drumsticks, thighs, breasts); get the giblets, and the blood if you can; season beforehand; marrow is important
ingredients.name: kurczak
ingredients.note: jointed (or drumsticks, thighs, breasts); get the giblets, and the blood if you can; season beforehand; marrow is important

ingredients.text: 8 thick slices pancetta, cut into strips less than width of little finger
ingredients.name: pancetta
ingredients.note: cut into strips less than width of little finger

ingredients.text: 1 bottle red burgundy wine (or côte du Rhône/Morgon)
ingredients.name: wino czerwone wytrawne

ingredients.text: Selection of wild mushrooms, sliced (dried is okay; use the soaking liquor)
ingredients.name: grzyby leśne
ingredients.note: dried is okay; use the soaking liquor

ingredients.text: 12 small fresh pickling onions, peeled and whole
ingredients.name: cebulka do marynowania

steps.text: For chicken stock, sear the giblets in a bit of oil in a pan, and simmer in water with the whole onion, 1 carrot and some peppercorns. You should have 1 cup.
In the skillet, fry pancetta and pork belly fat with butter until golden brown. Remove pancetta.

Add the seasoned chicken pieces skin side down and fry until honey-coloured, then flip. This is vital for the flavour; the skillet must be left sticky. Work in batches. Remove, leaving the pork belly behind, snipped into pieces.
Add the chopped onion and the button mushrooms; fry for 5 minutes, then add the sliced garlic and immediately flame off one of the measures of brandy.

Add the chicken pieces and pancetta, then pour over all the wine, chicken stock and vegetable stock. Bring to the boil, then add garlic and herbs. Reduce the heat and simmer for 45 minutes, turning the chicken pieces twice.

Remove the chicken pieces to the pyrex lid and pour the skillet sauce into the jug; put the jug in the freezer for 30 minutes and then remove the fat. It is recommended that you refrigerate the whole dish overnight.

In the skillet, add some butter along with the wild mushrooms, then pickling onions, remaining carrots and celery; fry until the mushrooms brown. Stir in the asafoetida and flame off the second measure of brandy.

Add the jug ingredients to the skillet sauce, along with another crushed clove of garlic, and push the veg to the edge of the skillet; reduce the sauce until glossy (about 15 minutes). It may need some flour stirred in, but it shouldn't be thick.
Pour half the sauce into the pyrex bowl, place the chicken pieces in, and pour the rest of the sauce on top; cover and bake in an oven at 170 °C for 90 minutes.
Sprinkle parsley over each portion, and serve with asparagus/green beans, and steamed potatoes/flat noodles/rice/orzo/colcannon.

recipes.title: Italian Poached Salmon
recipes.description: Łosoś duszony w czerwonym winie z koncentratem pomidorowym i kaparami, obtoczony w mące.

ingredients.text: 4 ea. (24 ounces) salmon filets, pin bones removed
ingredients.name: filet z łososia

steps.text: Combine wine, tomato paste, and capers. Set aside.
In a skillet large enough to hold all the salmon, heat 1 tbsp oil over medium high heat. Add garlic and cook until golden.
Add wine mixture to garlic. Reduce temperature to 145°F, then keep at 145°F.
Rub salmon with remaining oil. Press seasonings into meat, then dredge all sides in flour. Set aside.
Heat a nonstick skillet over high heat. Add 2 filets, skin side up, and cook until browned on all sides. Repeat with remaining salmon.
Move to 145°F wine mixture, then cook until fish is pink throughout and flakes easily when tested with a fork. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Kanafeh (Egyptian Sweet Cheese Pastry)
recipes.description: Kanafeh, a delectable Middle Eastern pastry, is a must-try dessert made of kadaif strands with cheese, butter and a rose-scented syrup.

steps.text: Adjust the oven rack to the lower-middle position and preheat it to 400°F (204°C).
In a medium bowl, combine the mozzarella cheese and cream cheese, then set it aside.
Slice the kadaif pastry crosswise into ¼–½-inch lengths and transfer it to a large bowl.

Pour the melted butter over the pastry in the bowl. Using your hands, gently toss the pastry with the butter, ensuring that all the shreds are evenly coated. Continue this process for about 5 minutes.
Transfer half of the coated pastry to the skillet, spreading it evenly along the bottom of the pan.
Spread the cheese mixture evenly over the first layer of pastry, leaving a ½-inch border along the rim.
Layer the remaining pastry over the cheese layer, firmly pressing it down.
Bake the prepared pastry in the preheated oven until it turns deeply golden brown, which takes about 40 minutes.
While the pastry bakes, prepare the syrup. In a saucepan, combine the sugar, lemon juice, and 1 cup of water.
Simmer the syrup until it reaches a temperature of 234°F (112°C), or until a small amount dropped into ice water forms a soft ball consistency. Remove from the heat and cool.
When the pastry is ready, add the rose water and orange blossom water to the syrup.
Invert the cooked pastry onto a serving platter and drizzle it with the syrup. Sprinkle chopped walnuts over the top and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Nyama Yemombe (Zimbabwean Beef Stew)
recipes.description: Nyama yemombe (beef stew) is a stew recipe in the Zimbabwean community. It's a hearty dish, often served with sadza (corn porridge) and vegetables.

ingredients.text: 1 kg beef, washed and cut into bite-size cubes
ingredients.name: wołowina
ingredients.note: washed and cut into bite-size cubes

ingredients.text: 1 beef stock cube or ½ teaspoon salt
ingredients.name: kostka bulionu wołowego

steps.text: If the meat is tough, simmer it in salted water until tender (30–45 minutes), then drain and set aside.
In a large pot or pan, heat the oil over medium heat. Add onion, garlic, and ginger, and cook for 1 minute while stirring.
Add the beef to the pot. Fry for about 10 minutes until browned on all sides.
Stir in the chopped tomatoes, then let them cook down until soft.
Add tomato paste, stock cube, paprika, and curry powder. Mix thoroughly.
Add water, cover the pot, and reduce heat to low. Let it simmer for 30–45 minutes, or until beef is soft and sauce has thickened.
Add chopped green pepper in the last 5 minutes of cooking.
Season with salt to taste.
Garnish with coriander, and serve with rice, porridge, or potato.

recipes.title: Cashew Gravy
recipes.description: A thick cashew-based sauce that tastes great on vegetables.

ingredients.text: 1½ cup milk or unsweetened soy milk
ingredients.name: mleko

steps.text: Allow the cashew butter to come to room temperature, if refrigerated.
Sauté the onion and bell pepper in the peanut oil over low to medium heat with salt and pepper, until the onion begins to turn translucent and the bell pepper is soft.
Add the wine and deglaze the pan.
Add cayenne pepper and milk, and heat through.

Add the cashew butter by the spoonful and stir until incorporated and smooth. Gravy will appear lumpy at first, but will become smooth after a few minutes of stirring and simmering. Adjust the quantity of milk or cashew butter as necessary for desired consistency.
Taste and add salt if necessary.
Serve gravy on green beans or other vegetables, or brown rice.

recipes.title: Potatoes Anna (pommes Anna)
recipes.description: Classic French dish of sliced, layered potatoes cooked in a very large amount of melted butter. It can be eaten hot or cold.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 250 °C.
Melt the butter.
Slice the potatoes thinly. Press slices against absorbent paper to dry.
Brush the tin with melted butter. Layer the potato slices into the tin, brushing each layer with butter and ending with butter on the top.
Cover and bake in the oven for 20 minutes. Uncover and cook for a further 30 minutes.

categories: Recipes using vegetable broth and stock

recipes.title: Yetakelt Wot (Ethiopian Spiced Vegetable Stew)
recipes.description: A vegetarian stew of mixed vegetables cooked in a rich, spicy sauce, often served with injera or rice.

ingredients.text: ½ teaspoon cayenne pepper, or to taste
ingredients.name: pieprz cayenne

ingredients.text: 1 cup green beans, trimmed and cut into bite-sized pieces
ingredients.name: fasolka szparagowa
ingredients.note: trimmed and cut into bite-sized pieces

ingredients.text: Fresh cilantro or parsley, chopped, for garnish
ingredients.name: kolendra świeża

steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan or pot over medium heat. Add the finely chopped onion and sauté until it becomes translucent.
Stir in the minced garlic and grated ginger, and cook for another minute until fragrant.
Add the berbere spice blend, paprika, turmeric, cumin, cayenne pepper, and salt. Mix well to coat the onions, garlic, and ginger with the spices.
Add the sliced carrots, diced potatoes, diced bell pepper, green beans, cauliflower florets, and broccoli florets to the saucepan. Stir to combine the vegetables with the spice mixture.
Pour in the vegetable broth or water, and bring the mixture to a simmer. Reduce the heat to low, cover the saucepan, and let the stew cook for about 20–25 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Check the seasoning and adjust with salt or additional spices if desired.
Remove from heat and let rest for a few minutes to allow the flavors to meld together.
Garnish the stew with freshly chopped cilantro or parsley. Serve hot as a main course, accompanied by injera or rice.

recipes.title: Vegan Pate
recipes.description: Vegetarian pate that can be used as a dip or spread, made with sweet peas and walnuts.

steps.text: Sauté onion with walnuts in a pot for about 5 minutes.
In a different bowl, combine sweet peas, salt, black pepper and cumin.
Mix the ingredients well.
Add the sweet pea mixture to the onion and walnuts, and continue sautéing for about 3 more minutes.
Turn off the heat and let cool.
Purée with a hand-held blender or in food processor until you achieve a creamy, though slightly nutty texture similar to that of pate or dip.
Serve with crackers, bread, baby carrots and other snack type vegetables.

recipes.title: Simple Chocolate Fudge
recipes.description: Chocolate fudge is a simple, sugary treat intended to be picked up and eaten at room temperature or refrigerated.

steps.text: Use a double boiler to melt the chocolate chips. Failing to use a double boiler will result in burned chocolate.
Add the sweetened condensed milk. Stir until mixed.
Pour into a lined baking dish, bowl, or other mold. Expect it to stick if you don't use wax paper or foil.
Let cool for several hours.

recipes.title: Tarta de Santiago
recipes.description: A Spanish almond cake from Galicia, easy to make with only three main ingredients and dusted with icing sugar, with Santiago's cross imprinted on top.

ingredients.text: ¾ cup (150 g) white granulated sugar
ingredients.name: cukier

steps.text: Add eggs and sugar to a bowl, and whisk rapidly until mixture turns pale.
Whisk in the citrus zests.
Combine the almond meal, cinnamon, and salt in a separate bowl. Transfer to the egg mixture, and use a rubber spatula to gently fold everything together until well combined.
Butter and flour the springform pan, then pour in the batter. Smooth the top if necessary.
Bake in preheated oven at 360ºF (180ºC) for 40 minutes or until golden brown and fully cooked in the center.
Cool completely, and unmold the cake.
Place a Santiago cross cut-out on top of the cake, then dust generous amount of icing sugar all over cake.
Carefully remove the cross cut-out. Slice and serve.

recipes.title: Bison Meatballs Baked in Hoisin Sauce (Marvin)
recipes.description: Marvins are a quick and tasty variation on the meatball.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).
Oil the bottom of a 9x12-inch Pyrex baking dish.
Thinly slice the onion to create long thin slices.
Microwave the onion slices and garlic on high for 5 minutes.
Grind the cumin, coriander, peppercorns, cloves, and salt together using a mortar and pestle.
Roughly mix the softened onions and garlic, bison, rice, spice grind, fish sauce, and basil.
Shape the meat mixture into tapered cylinders (similar to small sweet potatoes) and place into the baking dish. The Marvins should be about 1¼ inch diameter in the middle and 5 inches long.
Coat the Marvins with hoisin sauce.
Bake for 20–25 minutes in the preheated oven.

recipes.title: Caramelized Pineapple
recipes.description: Caramelized pineapple is crispy on the outside, sweet, and fruity.

ingredients.text: ½ cup dark brown sugar, divided
ingredients.name: cukier trzcinowy brązowy

steps.text: Combine vanilla bean and liquid ingredients except rum and ¼ cup brown sugar.
Heat over medium heat until sugar is dissolved and has thickened slightly, 15–30 minutes.
Remove vanilla pod and let the sugar mixture sit at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Dip pineapple into sugar mixture then dredge in remaining sugar, adding more as needed.
Place pineapple on a greased baking sheet and place under broiler, shaking constantly until well browned.
Remove pineapple; keep warm.
Place baking sheet on two burners and heat over high heat. Add rum and ignite. Scrape browned bits off of pan and boil rum until reduced by half.
Add rum to remaining sugar mixture and stir. Serve pineapple with remaining sugar mixture on the side.

recipes.title: Tiramisu (Non-Alcoholic)
recipes.description: A non-alcoholic tiramisu variation in which halved Twinkies soaked in espresso are topped with a mascarpone and egg yolk mixture and dusted with cocoa.

steps.text: Scoop out cream filling from inside of Twinkies.
Place Twinkies halves in a 9x9-inch high-sided square baking pan in a flat layer and top with espresso.
Discard cream.
Combine egg yolks, cheese, and sugar.
Drain excess espresso from Twinkies.
Pour cheese mixture over Twinkies and smooth with an offset spatula.
Place as much cocoa powder as you think you'll need into a sifter or container with a shaker lid and liberally dust on top of cheese.
Serve.

recipes.title: Ozark Pudding
recipes.description: Ozark pudding is a baked cake-type pudding that apparently originated in the Ozark region of the USA.

steps.text: Preheat oven to .
Blend all ingredients together, starting with eggs and ending with nuts.
Grease casserole dish, pour in casserole.
Bake for about 35 minutes.
Top with whipped cream or ice cream.

categories: Recipes using chile paste and sauce

recipes.title: Pad Thai Sauce
recipes.description: Uproszczony sos pad thai, który dobrze pasuje do makaronu ryżowego i dań z woka.

ingredients.text: ¼ cup (60 ml) Thai fish sauce
ingredients.name: tajski sos rybny

steps.text: Mince the garlic. Lightly brown it in a frying pan over high heat with the oil.
Combine the juice, soy sauce, fish sauce, and sugar and mix thoroughly.
After mixture starts bubbling, add the chili paste and cornstarch. Mix well and cook for another minute or two.

recipes.title: Nyama Choma (Tanzanian Barbecue)
recipes.description: A popular grilled meat recipe in Tanzania, also loved in Kenya and other African countries. Any meat of your choice can be used.

ingredients.text: 1 kg goat/lamb/beef/chicken meat, cut into thick chunks
ingredients.name: mięso kozie, jagnięce, wołowe lub kurczak

ingredients.text: 1 heaped tbsp grated raw papaya for tenderness
ingredients.name: papaja

steps.text: To keep the meat juicy and tender, clean it and preserve any extra fat on it. Place the meat in a glass or plastic dish.
Blend the remaining ingredients, then pour the resulting mixture over the meat.
Allow mixture to settle into the meat, then thoroughly massage it into the meat. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 4–5 hours.
To bring the meat to room temperature for cooking, remove it from the refrigerator approximately an hour beforehand.
Light a charcoal grill and let it burn until the coals are completely covered with white ash.

Place a wire rack over the coals, add the meat, and cook until it has a little singe and color. To ensure equal cooking on all sides, turn meat frequently. Use a fresh brush and some oil or marinade to flavor the meat and keep it from drying out while it cooks.
To allow the inside of the meat to cook slowly and effectively, wrap it in a packet of foil. Or, keep grilling until the food is done to your liking.
Once the meat is done, use a sharp knife to cut it into bite-sized pieces.
Serve.

recipes.title: Pear and Almond Smoothie (Vegan)
recipes.description: This pear and almond smoothie is simple and vegan. It contains no added refined sugar.

steps.text: Cut the pear into chunks, discarding the core.
Place the chunks of pear in a blender.
Squeeze the juice of the lemon over the pear.
Add the almond milk.
Blend.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Homemade Tomato Paste
recipes.description: Tomato paste is a basic ingredient used in innumerable dishes in the cuisines of many countries. It is prepared by reducing tomato purée on low heat for several hours.

ingredients.text: 1 cup sweet red bell peppers, chopped
ingredients.name: papryka czerwona

steps.text: Cook the ingredients over low heat in a large wide covered stockpot for an hour.
Pass the mixture through a food mill several times starting with the coarsest grid and progressing to the finest.

Return the pot to the stove and heat uncovered over very low heat for 3 hours or more until very thick, stirring frequently to avoid burning. Use a heat diffusing mat or trivet. A double boiler would be ideal as it would prevent burning but will take longer.
Pour into new sterilized ½-pint preserving jars leaving ¼-inch of space at the top. Cover with new seals and screw on the lids securely but not too tightly.

Process in a boiling water bath for 45 minutes. Remove from the water bath with tongs and allow to cool on an inverted oven rack for 12 hours. Test the seal by pressing the centre of each lid with your forefinger. If the inner lid does not move, remove the outer ring. Store in a cool, dry, dark place.

recipes.title: Sweet Lassi
recipes.description: Sweet Indian yogurt drink flavored with cardamom and rosewater.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients except ice in blender, and blend until smooth.
Add ice and continue blending until frothy.

recipes.title: Zacusca (Romanian Vegetable Spread)
recipes.description: A vegetable spread popular in Romania, usually eaten with bread. Similar spreads are found in other Balkan countries.

ingredients.text: 500 g onion, finely chopped or grated
ingredients.name: cebula

ingredients.text: 1 kg red bell pepper of the gogoșar variety
ingredients.name: papryka czerwona

steps.text: Roast the eggplants and peppers until their skins are charred and easily removable by hand. Skin the vegetables.
Dice the eggplants and peppers in 1–2 cm cubes.
In a large nonstick skillet, sauté the onions in the oil over medium until golden.
Add the peppers to the onions. Cook for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Make sure it doesn't stick to the bottom of the pan and burn.
Stir in the eggplants, tomato paste, bay leaves, salt, and peppercorns. Simmer until the oil comes to the surface.
Can the mixture in sterilized jars. Store in a cool place. If you don't want to can, zacusca can be stored in the fridge and consumed within a few days.

recipes.title: Coconut Rice (Indian)
recipes.description: In India, coconut rice is made with coconut flakes or grated or desiccated coconut, mixed with the cooked rice.

ingredients.text: ½ cup fresh/frozen grated coconut or dry coconut flakes
ingredients.name: kokos
ingredients.note: fresh/frozen grated coconut or dry coconut flakes

ingredients.text: 5–7 cups of cooked, cooled white long-grain rice (light and fluffy)
ingredients.name: ryż biały

steps.text: Heat the oil with the mustard seeds in a covered sauté pan.
When the mustard seeds have finished popping, add everything but the rice, and lightly toast in the oil until golden.
Add the seasonings to the cooked rice, mix well, and serve.

recipes.title: Lamb Sausages and Grilled Potatoes
recipes.description: An easy family recipe with lamb sausages as the main ingredient, served with baked potatoes and a lettuce and tomato salad.

ingredients.text: 12 small potatoes or 10 medium sized ones weighing approximately 971g
ingredients.name: ziemniak
ingredients.note: small; or 10 medium sized ones weighing approximately 971g

ingredients.text: 200 g Romaine lettuce, washed and cut into smaller pieces
ingredients.name: sałata rzymska
ingredients.note: washed and cut into smaller pieces

steps.text: Preheat oven to 200°C (392°F).
Rinse the potatoes, and cut into slices 0.5 cm thick using a knife, grater, or mandoline.

Put the potatoes in the cake tin, and spread them out. Add the 30 ml of olive oil to cover the entire tin and the potatoes. Sprinkle the salt all over the tin and the potatoes. Bake for 25 minutes in the preheated oven.

Heat the 15 ml olive oil and the butter in a pan over medium heat until the butter melts. Add the sausages, and cook for about 10 minutes on high heat. Turn the sausages occasionally so they fry on all sides. Remove from the heat.
Toss the lettuce and tomatoes together to make a salad.
Serve the salad with the baked potatoes and sausages.

recipes.title: Raisin Crumb Pie
recipes.description: Pie z rodzynkami i kruszonką, z ciastem w formie na tarty.

steps.text: Wash and clean raisins and add the cold water and 1½ cups of sugar.
Cook until the raisins are tender and plump.
Set aside to cool.
Preheat oven to 440°F.
Mix the flour, 1½ cups of sugar, and the shortening, crumbling well with the fingers. Take out 1 cup of these crumbs and set aside.
To the remaining crumb mixture, add the eggs and milk; mix well.
Stir in the baking powder.
Line 2 large pie tins with pie crust and fill with cooked raisins. Pour over this the batter and sprinkle the top with the cup of reserved crumbs.
Bake in a hot oven at 440°F for 10 minutes, then reduce heat to moderate oven (350°F) and finish baking, about 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Breaded Potato Wedges
recipes.description: Chrupiące, panierowane w płatkach kukurydzianych ćwiartki ziemniaków smażone dwukrotnie w głębokim oleju.

ingredients.text: 2 pounds Russet potatoes, cut into 10 wedges
ingredients.name: ziemniak

steps.text: Połącz jajka z przyprawami. Zanurz ziemniaki w masie jajecznej, następnie obtocz w płatkach kukurydzianych. Odstaw na 2-3 minuty.
Rozgrzej olej do 350°F (ok. 177°C). Smaż ćwiartki, w razie potrzeby partiami, 3-4 minuty lub do momentu, aż zmiękną. Odsącz na kratce nad blachą do pieczenia.
Rozgrzej olej do 375°F (ok. 190°C). Smaż ćwiartki ponownie, aż będą złociste i chrupiące. Ponownie odsącz na tej samej kratce. Podawaj na ciepło.

categories: Recipes using chile paste and sauce

recipes.title: Tuna Fish Cakes
recipes.description: Kotleciki z tuńczyka z puree ziemniaczanym, warzywami i bułką tartą, smażone, pieczone lub grillowane.

ingredients.text: ¾ cup (180 ml) frozen peas, thawed and drained
ingredients.name: groszek zielony mrożony

ingredients.text: ½ cup (120 ml) cooked carrots, cut into small pieces
ingredients.name: marchew

ingredients.text: 4 tablespoons fresh chopped herbs (e.g. coriander, basil, parsley)
ingredients.name: świeże zioła

steps.text: Combine all ingredients except breadcrumbs in a large bowl and mix until combined.
Shape mixture into patties and gently roll in breadcrumbs until well coated.
Place patties on a baking tray and cook in a moderately hot oven (200°C /400°F) for 30–35 minutes, turning once until golden brown and crisp.
Alternatively, place patties under a moderately hot grill and cook for 8–10 minutes each side until golden brown and crisp.
Alternatively, heat a small amount of oil in a large frying pan and fry patties for 5 minutes each side until crisp and golden, drain well and keep warm to serve.

recipes.title: Chipotle Maple Glazed Pork Tenderloin
recipes.description: Pork tenderloin is at its best when quickly cooked on the grill.

ingredients.text: 1 pork tenderloin, trimmed of silver skin
ingredients.name: polędwiczka wieprzowa

ingredients.text: 4 chipotle chiles in adobo sauce, finely minced
ingredients.name: papryczka chipotle w adobo

steps.text: Combine lime, garlic, salt, honey, and pepper in a gallon size zip-top bag. Add pork and refrigerate 24 hours.
In 24 hours, drain pork. Set aside.

Heat 4 ½ pounds of natural chunk charcoal in a large chimney starter according to accompanying directions. Once coals have heated, disperse evenly around the bottom of the grill. Reapply grill grate and swab grate with an oil-soaked towel.
Add pork to hottest part of grill and cook 1 ½ minutes. Rotate 90 degrees and cook another 1 ½ minutes. Repeat 12 times or until internal temperature reaches 140°F for medium rare.
While pork cooks, combine chipotle and maple syrup. Set aside.
Make a foil pouch and place cooked pork inside. Pour maple mixture over and tightly seal. Let rest 15 minutes and serve warm.

recipes.title: Self-rising Flour
recipes.description: Self-rising flour (sometimes called self-raising flour) is all-purpose flour that has a leavening agent such as baking soda or baking powder already blended in.

steps.text: Mix all ingredients to combine.
Store in an air-tight container in a cool, dry environment.

recipes.title: Crème Saint-Honoré
recipes.description: A crème pâtissière with stiffly beaten egg whites folded into it, used to fill profiteroles, éclairs and tarts, or served on its own as a dessert cream.

ingredients.text: 2 Tbsp superfine sugar OR granulated sugar
ingredients.name: cukier

steps.text: Mix any additional flavourings into the crème pâtissière.
Whip the egg whites with the salt until soft peaks form.
Sprinkle the sugar onto the egg whites and continue whipping to stiff peaks.
Stir a quarter of the egg whites into the hot custard.
Fold the rest of the egg whites in and chill before use.

recipes.title: Veal with Lima Beans
recipes.description: Veal with large lima beans (mish qingjji me barbunja) is an Albanian dish.

ingredients.text: 1½ lb veal shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.name: cielęcina, łopatka

ingredients.text: 1 ½ lb of large lima beans
ingredients.name: fasola lima duża

steps.text: Wash the meat thoroughly with cold water, drain, and place in a pot together with butter and onions.
Stir-fry over medium-high heat for a few minutes.
Add enough water to cover the meat.
Add salt, pepper, and 2–3 tablespoons of the tomatoes.
Cover the pot and let the meat boil.
In the meantime, cut the ends off the lima beans and clean them well (you also cut them in half if you desire).
Add the beans to the meat after it has been boiling for several minutes.
Also add water until everything in the pot is covered.
When the beans are done boiling, add the rest of the tomatoes.
Let the stew boil for a few more minutes so that the liquid can thicken.

recipes.title: Lemon Rosemary Pork Tenderloin
recipes.description: Pork tenderloin rubbed with a lemon, rosemary, thyme and garlic mixture, then roasted.

steps.text: Combine the chopped onion, oil, lemon juice, rosemary, thyme, lemon peel, minced garlic, salt, and pepper. Rub this mixture over tenderloins.
Let the tenderloins marinate, refrigerated, for as long as you want, or just immediately proceed with cooking.
Place the meat on a rack in a shallow roasting pan.
Bake uncovered at 400°F (205°C) or until a meat thermometer reads 160°F (70°C).
Cover with foil and let stand 10 minutes before slicing.

recipes.title: Daniel Webster's Chowder
recipes.description: A hearty fish chowder with sea biscuit, potatoes, oysters and port or claret, from the 1881 Household Cyclopedia.

ingredients.text: 6 pounds sea bass or cod, cut into slices
ingredients.name: okoń morski lub dorsz

steps.text: Fry the onion with the fatty pork. Transfer to a large pot.
Add all remaining ingredients to pot.
Add enough water to cover everything by 1 inch.
Bring to a boil. Simmer for 1 hour, stirring gently every so often.
Serve.

recipes.title: Domoda (Gambian Peanut Stew)
recipes.description: Domoda is a popular Gambian and Senegalese dish known for its rich and creamy peanut stew. It is often prepared with meat such as beef, lamb, or chicken, combined with an assortment of vegetables.

ingredients.text: 500 g meat (beef, lamb, or chicken), cut into bite-sized pieces
ingredients.name: mięso (wołowina, jagnięcina lub kurczak)

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper (adjust according to spice preference)
ingredients.name: pieprz cayenne

steps.text: Heat the vegetable oil in a large pot or saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and minced garlic. Sauté until they become translucent and fragrant.
Add the meat to the pot and cook until it browns on all sides. Stir occasionally to ensure even browning.
Stir in the tomato paste, ground cayenne pepper, and paprika. Cook for an additional minute to allow the flavors to meld.
Add the peanut butter to the pot and mix well with the other ingredients. Gradually pour in the water or broth while stirring continuously to create a smooth and consistent stew base.

Reduce the heat to low and cover the pot. Allow the stew to simmer for about 30 minutes, or until the meat is tender. Stir occasionally and add more water or broth if needed to maintain the desired consistency.
Add the sliced carrots, cubed potatoes, and chopped cabbage to the pot. Continue to simmer the stew for an additional 15–20 minutes, or until the vegetables are cooked to your liking.
Taste the stew and season with salt and pepper according to your preference.
Serve the domoda hot with steamed rice or couscous.

recipes.title: Mustard Dip
recipes.description: This mustard dip can be used as a dip or spread in place of butter or plain mayonnaise.

steps.text: Mix all the ingredients together.
Store refrigerated for up to a few days.

recipes.title: Tempoyak (Fermented Durian)
recipes.description: Tempoyak is a condiment made of salted fermented durian.

ingredients.text: 2 large durian fruit, flesh removed and seeds discarded
ingredients.name: durian
ingredients.note: large, flesh removed and seeds discarded

steps.text: Place the durian flesh in a clean jar. Add salt, then beat the mixture until it becomes soft and creamy.
Close the jar tightly and leave it to ferment for 1 week.
The fermented durian can be kept in the refrigerator for up to a year.

recipes.title: Fribourg Omelet
recipes.description: A Fribourg omelet is a mix of eggs, crunchy greens, and ham, with the Swiss canton of Fribourg's native Gruyère cheese adding an acidic punch to bind the flavors together.

ingredients.text: *3 thin slices of ham, cut in small squares
ingredients.name: szynka

steps.text: In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, salt, pepper, milk and nutmeg, until even and glossy.
Place half the butter in the skillet on medium heat. Swirl the pan to coat evenly with butter.
Add ham and cook until deep brown.
Stir in kale for 30 seconds, or until slightly wilted but still crunchy. Set aside the ham and greens.
Add the remainder of the butter to the skillet over low heat.
Pour egg mixture into the skillet, moving skillet to create a flat, even layer. Heat until the eggs have begun to set, with some fluff on top.
Scatter the ham and kale evenly over the top of the eggs.
Lay the Gruyère slices over the open omelet. Heat until the edges of the cheese have melted slightly.
Gently push the edges of the omelet less than half a centimeter toward the center of the skillet with two spatulas, making sure not to break it. Turn the heat off.
Use the spatulas to lift half the omelet and fold over the other half. Move the entire omelet carefully onto a plate and serve.

recipes.title: Molasses-Glazed Pork Chops
recipes.description: Grillowane schabowe wieprzowe w glazurze z melasy, z limonką i przyprawami.

steps.text: Place pork chops in a large zip-top bag. Combine liquid ingredients and pour into bag. Marinate in the fridge for at least 30 minutes.
Take pork out of marinade. Combine dry seasonings and rub on pork. Heat your grill as high as it will go.
Boil marinade for 10 minutes.
Place pork on grill and cook 2 minutes, brushing with marinade, before rotating 90 degrees to get nice grill marks. Cook another 2 minutes, brushing.
Flip to the other side and repeat. Remove from grill and let rest for 10 minutes. Serve with additional marinade.

recipes.title: Bazeen bil Lahm
recipes.description: Traditional Libyan dish of tender meat chunks cooked in a rich, aromatic sauce and served with bazeen, a dough-like bread.

ingredients.text: 500 grams (1 lb) beef or lamb, cut into small cubes
ingredients.name: wołowina lub jagnięcina

ingredients.text: ½ teaspoon ground cayenne pepper (optional, for added heat)
ingredients.name: pieprz cayenne

steps.text: In a large pot or Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic. Sauté until the onion becomes translucent and fragrant.
Add the meat cubes to the pot and cook until browned on all sides.
Stir in the diced tomatoes, sliced carrots, diced potatoes, and bell peppers.
Add the tomato paste, cumin, coriander, turmeric, cayenne pepper (if using), salt, and pepper. Mix well to coat the ingredients with the spices.
Pour in the water and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot with a lid, and let the bazeen simmer for about 1.5–2 hours, or until the meat is tender and the flavors have melded together.
While the stew is cooking, prepare the bazeen dough according to the package instructions or homemade recipe.
Once the stew is ready, shape the dough into small balls and place them in the serving bowls.
Ladle the cooked meat and vegetable mixture over the bazeen dough.
Serve hot and enjoy the delicious flavors of this traditional Libyan dish.

recipes.title: Saj Bread I
recipes.description: Saj bread (Arabic: خبز الصاج) is a thin, unleavened flatbread baked on a griddle known as a saj.

steps.text: Mix flour and water, adding water gradually, until left with a workable dough. Knead thoroughly.
Cover the dough and let rest for about 5 minutes. Add salt.
Separate from dough smaller portions and make into balls. Using a flat surface lined with flour, begin to roll out each ball into a flat piece of dough.
Place flattened dough on griddle and bake until tender. On a heated griddle, cooking only takes a few seconds. Flip-over and cook the other side for only a few seconds.
Remove from griddle and allow to cool. Fold and store.

recipes.title: Pork Chops Cacciatore
recipes.description: Boneless pork chops simmered in a tomato, onion, carrot and garlic sauce, served over polenta.

ingredients.text: 6 ea. (1 kg) 4 cm thick boneless pork chops
ingredients.name: schab wieprzowy bez kości

ingredients.text: 1 can (28 oz) tomatoes, preferably "fire roasted" or similar
ingredients.name: pomidory z puszki

steps.text: Slice onion into 1 cm half-rings.
Start making the polenta.
Once the polenta is stable, sweat onions with olive oil and butter.
When onions are translucent, clear spaces for the pork chops, and put them pork chops into these spaces.
Lightly brown the pork chops on both sides, remove from pan and set aside. Allow fond to develop slightly, then deglaze with a quarter of the tomatoes.
Grind the rest of the tomatoes, along with the garlic, in a blender until a rough paste is formed. Then, add to the onion mixture.
Turn heat to high, and allow sauce to simmer and darken slightly in color. When this occurs, turn heat to low.
Finely chop the carrot and stir it in, then nestle the pork chops into the sauce and allow to simmer until the pork chops are done to your liking, about 20 minutes or so.
Serve as soon as possible. To serve, spoon polenta on to plates or bowls and place pork chop and sauce on top.

recipes.title: Booyah (Chicken Vegetable Stew)
recipes.description: A stew from Northeastern Wisconsin created by Walloon-Belgian immigrants, made with chicken and vegetables.

ingredients.text: 2 cups tomato sauce (or 1 quart whole tomatoes)
ingredients.name: sos pomidorowy

steps.text: Place chicken in a large pot and cover with water. Simmer until chicken is well done.
Remove chicken from broth and skim off fat.
Add remaining ingredients to broth.
Remove chicken meat from bones and skin. Cut meat into small pieces and add to broth. Add salt and water to taste.
Cover and let simmer for at least 3 hours. It tastes best when cooked all day.

recipes.title: Tangy Lemon Battered Fried Chicken
recipes.description: Chicken moistened with lemon juice, coated in spices and cornmeal, then deep-fried in shortening in a cast iron skillet.

ingredients.text: 2 ea. chicken thighs, legs, and boneless breasts
ingredients.name: kurczak

steps.text: Combine paprika, salt, pepper, granulated garlic, ginger, and cayenne.
Moisten chicken with lemon juice and coat with seasoning mixture.
Dredge chicken in cornmeal and let rest 2–3 minutes only.
Melt shortening in a large cast iron skillet; heat to 350°F, watching carefully to prevent burning.
Place legs and breasts around the edges, then place thighs in the center.
Fry for 12 minutes, then flip to the other side and fry another 12 minutes.
Drain on a cooling or oven rack. Please don't use paper towels, which will make your chicken greasy.
Sprinkle with black pepper; serve.

recipes.title: Kabalagala (Ugandan Pancakes)
recipes.description: Kabalagala, also known as Ugandan pancakes, are delicious and popular street food in Uganda. These deep-fried pancakes are crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, making them a delightful treat for both kids and adults.

steps.text: In a bowl, combine the mashed bananas with the all-purpose flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.

Gradually add the milk to the banana-flour mixture, stirring continuously with a whisk or spoon until a smooth and thick batter forms. The consistency should be similar to that of regular pancake batter.
Heat vegetable oil in a deep frying pan or pot over medium-high heat. The oil should be deep enough to fully submerge the Kabalagala.
Carefully drop spoonfuls of the batter into the hot oil, working in batches to avoid overcrowding the pan. Each pancake should be about 3–4 inches in diameter.
Fry the pancakes until they turn golden brown and become crispy on both sides. This usually takes about 2–3 minutes per side.
Use a slotted spoon or spider strainer to remove the fried kabalagala from the oil and transfer them onto a plate lined with paper towels to drain excess oil.
Serve the kabalagala while still warm. They can be enjoyed on their own as a tasty snack or paired with a cup of tea or coffee.

recipes.title: Classic Salad
recipes.description: A great salad, suitable for right before dinner.

ingredients.text: 1 medium to large tomato, or 1 cup cherry/grape tomatoes
ingredients.name: pomidor
ingredients.note: medium to large, or 1 cup cherry/grape tomatoes

ingredients.text: 1 cup cheese- and garlic-flavored croutons, broken into small pieces
ingredients.name: grzanki serowe
ingredients.note: cheese- and garlic-flavored, broken into small pieces

ingredients.text: 1 cup crumbled extra-sharp Cheddar cheese (preferably aged at least 1 year)
ingredients.name: ser cheddar
ingredients.note: crumbled, extra-sharp, preferably aged at least 1 year

steps.text: Tear the lettuce into small pieces, and place lettuce in a medium-sized bowl.
Slice the tomato into small pieces and let them fall into the bowl. If using cherry or grape tomatoes, sprinkle them over the lettuce.
Sprinkle the crumbled cheese and croutons (and raisins, if desired) over the salad.
Drizzle the salad dressing over the salad.
Enjoy!

recipes.title: American Alfredo Sauce
recipes.description: A rich sauce of heavy cream, butter and grated Parmesan or asiago cheese, tossed with pasta.

ingredients.text: 8.5 ounces (240 g) grated Parmesan cheese or asiago cheese
ingredients.name: parmezan

steps.text: Combine 1¼ cups (300 ml) cream and the butter in a saucepan large enough to accommodate the sauce and later the pound of pasta.
Heat over a low flame, stirring frequently, until the butter is melted and the cream comes to a bare simmer.
Remove the pan from the heat once the butter is evenly incorporated into the cream.

Cook the pasta, draining it a little before it reaches the al dente stage. The pasta should be slightly undercooked before being added to the sauce because it will continue to cook while the sauce is being finished.
Drain the pasta.
Add the drained pasta, ½ cup (100 ml) of cream, the cheese, the salt, the nutmeg, and several grinds of the pepper mill to the pan.

Heat the pasta and sauce over a low flame, tossing continuously, until the cheese melts into the sauce and the sauce thickens slightly, about 1–2 minutes. You can add chopped parsley as a garnish mixed into the sauce.

recipes.title: High-Protein Pancakes
recipes.description: High-protein pancakes made with rolled oats, protein powder and banana, a good start to the day.

ingredients.text: ¼ cup (30 g) vanilla-flavored protein powder
ingredients.name: odżywka białkowa

ingredients.text: ½ ea. (50 g) peeled small-to-medium-size ripe banana
ingredients.name: banan

steps.text: Grind the oats for 10–15 seconds in the food processor to make a powder.
Combine the ground oats in a mixing bowl with the protein powder, coconut flour, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt.
Mash the banana in another mixing bowl, then whisk in the egg and milk until well-combined.
Fold in the dry mixture to form a thick batter.
Heat a thin layer butter or oil in a frying pan over low to medium heat.
Scoop ladlefuls of batter onto the pan, working in batches as needed.
Cook the pancakes for 3–4 minutes until small bubbles appear on top.
Flip the pancakes, then cook for another 1–2 minutes.
Transfer the pancakes to plates, and repeat the cooking process with any remaining batter.
Serve with toppings.

recipes.title: Chocolate Marmalade Layer Cake
recipes.description: A chocolate layer cake made with the 6-6-6-3 method and filled with marmalade.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 170°C fan/convection.
Grease 2 round cake tins and line with baking paper.
In a large bowl, sift together the flour, cocoa powder, and baking powder.
Beat the butter and sugar together until fluffy.
Beat in the eggs until well-combined.
Mix in the flour mixture just until combined.
Divide batter evenly between the prepared tins.
Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven until a skewer inserted into the center comes out clean.
Leave to cool for 10 minutes, then turn the cake out onto a cooling rack.
When completely cool, cover one cake layer with a generous, even layer of marmalade. Place the second cake on top.
If desired, dust the top with a small amount of powdered sugar as decoration.

recipes.title: Chipotle Ketchup
recipes.description: Domowy ketchup z chipotle w adobo, na bazie koncentratu pomidorowego.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat.
Cook, stirring occasionally, for ½ hour.
Refrigerate in a non-reactive container for up to 2 months.

recipes.title: Herring Soup
