recipes.description: A thick barley soup with pounded herring, seasoned with salt, pepper, vinegar and herbs.

ingredients.text: Salt, pepper, vinegar, and herbs, to taste
ingredients.name: sól

steps.text: Combine water and barley meal.
Boil it to the consistency of a thick jelly.
Season it with salt, pepper, vinegar, sweet herbs.
Add the herring meat.

recipes.title: Peppercorn Strip Steaks with Cognac Cream Sauce
recipes.description: Strip steaks coated in cracked black peppercorns, pan-fried and served with a cognac cream sauce.

ingredients.text: 4 ea. (24 ounces) boneless strip steaks, trimmed of excess fat
ingredients.name: stek wołowy polędwica krótka
ingredients.note: 24 ounces, boneless, trimmed of excess fat

ingredients.text: ¼ cup (4 tbsp) unsalted butter, cut into small pieces
ingredients.name: masło

steps.text: Sprinkle garlic with salt. Rub with the side of the knife repeatedly until garlic forms a thick paste.
Rub steaks with oil. Season on both sides with salt, then press peppercorns into both sides of meat. Let sit until room temperature, about 30 minutes.
Heat a stainless steel skillet large enough to hold the steaks over high heat. Pour some oil into the pan, then add steaks. Cook 4 minutes per side for medium rare. Remove and keep warm.
Pour out excess fat but do not scrape pan. Deglaze pan with cognac, then turn off heat and ignite with a firestick. Shake pan until flames die.
Bring to a boil. Cook until reduced by half, then whisk in cream and garlic.
Whisk in butter. Once butter has melted completely, spoon over steaks. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Sindhi Spiced Moong Dal
recipes.description: Yellow moong dal cooked in a pressure cooker with green chiles and ginger, then seasoned with salt, coriander, pepper and chili powder and finished with a drizzle of oil.

steps.text: Soak the dal in water for 1 hour. Drain.
Combine the dal, chiles, and ginger in a pot. Do not add salt.
Cover the dal with water. Boil in a pressure cooker for at least 3–4 minutes.
Transfer the dal to a bowl. Season with salt, coriander, and pepper.
Sprinkle with chili powder.
Drizzle with some oil.

recipes.title: Sprout Salad
recipes.description: Sprouts make for an excellent salad, both tastier and more nutritious than a lettuce-based salad.

steps.text: Cut the tomatoes into chunks, about 1.2 inches in diameter. If using tomatoes that are small, cut each one at least once. Remove the core and, optionally, the gooey parts.
Cut the celery crosswise, with 1-inch spacing near the thick base and 2-inch spacing near the narrow top.
Distribute the celery and tomato pieces evenly in the bottom of a wide bowl.
Holding the sprouts so that they do not separate and entangle themselves, wash them under running water.
Place the sprouts into a bowl full of water. Gently dunk them and change the water a few times, removing the seed casings without getting the sprouts all tangled up.
Drain the sprouts well. You may need to shake them a bit.
Spread the sprouts over the tomatoes and celery, still being careful not to make a tangled mess.
Sprinkle the bacon bits over top of the sprouts. The sprouts should be well-covered; use more bacon if needed.
Drizzle oil over the bacon. The oil will adhere to the bacon better than it does to the sprouts.
Sprinkle vinegar over everything.

recipes.title: Nigerian pepper soup
recipes.description: Pepper Soup is a spicy West African soup made with meat or fish, pepper, and aromatic local spices.

ingredients.text: 500 g goat meat, chicken, or assorted meat (or fresh fish)
ingredients.name: mięso kozie
ingredients.note: goat meat, chicken, or assorted meat (or fresh fish)

ingredients.text: 2–3 tablespoons ground pepper (or fresh blended pepper)
ingredients.name: pieprz mielony

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon pepper soup spice mix (traditional spice blend)
ingredients.name: mieszanka przypraw do pepper soup

steps.text: Wash the meat or fish thoroughly and place in a pot.
Add chopped onions, seasoning cubes, salt, and water.
Cook until the meat becomes tender.
Add ground pepper, crayfish, and pepper soup spice mix.
Stir and allow to simmer for 10–15 minutes.
Add scent leaves or uziza leaves if using.
Cook for a few more minutes until the aroma is strong and the soup is well blended.
Remove from heat and serve hot.

recipes.title: Strawberry Fromage Frais
recipes.description: A light, chilled strawberry dessert made with fromage frais, egg whites and gelatin.

ingredients.text: 6 dl (600 ml) low-fat/fat free fromage frais
ingredients.name: serek homogenizowany chudy
ingredients.catalogName: Serek homogenizowany chudy, wzbogacony witaminą D

ingredients.text: 3 saltspoons (¾ tsp) sugar or granulated sugar replacement
ingredients.name: cukier

steps.text: Soak gelatin sheets in cold water to hydrate them.
Beat fromage frais and strawberry jam until well-combined.
Whip egg whites with sugar until stiff.
Fold the whipped egg whites into the fromage mixture.
Take the gelatin sheets out of the water, and dissolve them in the boiling water.
Stir the dissolved gelatin carefully into the strawberry mixture.
Transfer mixture to individual cups or a bowl, and chill in the refrigerator for several hours until firm.
Decorate with fresh berries and serve.

recipes.title: Supercharger Tea
recipes.description: Supercharger tea is a variant of iced tea intended to give a sense of energy. The recipe is high in sugar and caffeine and thus best used before a busy day of work or study, but is easy to make.

steps.text: Place tea bags in French press or coffee pot. Make sure to keep the strings taut to prevent the paper weights from falling in.
Pour the hot water into French press. Place lid on top, with a tight grip on the paper weights.
Let the tea steep for 5 minutes.
If using a French press, slowly push the plunger onto the bags, again with a tight grip on the paper weights.
Take off the lid, scoop the teabags out, and gently squeeze the brew from the bags before disposing of them.
Add sweetener and stir thoroughly.
Let tea cool to room temperature. Serve over ice, or place open pot in freezer for 70 minutes for quicker cooling. Stir in milk or citrus juice before serving.

recipes.title: Poisson braise (Ivorian Grilled Fish)
recipes.description: Poisson braise is an Ivory Coast dish, usually eaten after work. It is also an affordable meal that can be enjoyed with any cold drink of your choice.

ingredients.text: 3 pinches grated red or black pepper
ingredients.name: pieprz czarny mielony

ingredients.text: 4 tablespoons all-purpose fish seasonings (e.g. grated garlic, cilantro,basil, thyme, paprika, salt, and pepper)
ingredients.name: przyprawy do ryb
ingredients.note: e.g. grated garlic, cilantro, basil, thyme, paprika, salt, and pepper

ingredients.text: 2 medium-size yellow bell peppers, neatly diced
ingredients.name: papryka żółta

steps.text: Combine 4 tablespoons of the extra-virgin olive oil in a large bowl, then add all the finely chopped garlic, lemon juice, 2 pinches of salt, 2 pinches of either the red or black pepper, and all of the fish seasonings.
Mix them together very well to make a marinade.
Add the fish to the marinade, cover, and marinate in the fridge for about an hour.
Combine the tomatoes, onions, yellow pepper, zucchini, tabasco sauce, remaining extra-virgin olive oil, salt, and pepper in a bowl. Set aside.
Remove the fish from the fridge.
Heat a greased stovetop grill or skillet over medium heat.
Add the fish and cook for at least 5 minutes.
Flip and cook the other side for about another 4 minutes.
While the fish is cooking, put half of the tomato paste mixture onto a sheet pan and bake in a 350°F oven for about 7 minutes.
Put the remaining half tomato paste mixture on the plate followed by each one of the sword fish fillets.
Garnish with the slice from the remaining lemon.
Serve with a side dish such as white rice or attieke.

recipes.title: Simple Restaurant Miso Soup
recipes.description: A close approximation of the miso soup served in most cheap western Japanese restaurants.

ingredients.text: A few 1 cm cubes of medium-firm tofu
ingredients.name: tofu

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon (about 15 ml) miso paste (either white, red, or a mixture)
ingredients.name: pasta miso
ingredients.note: either white, red, or a mixture

steps.text: Heat the dashi to a light simmer.
While this is heating, lay out your bowl and place the wakame and tofu in the bottom.
When the dashi simmers, take a ladle or so of liquid aside and mix it with the miso paste.
Remove the pot of dashi from the stove and stir in the miso mixture.
Ladle the prepared soup into the bowl and serve.

recipes.title: Ibijumba n'ubwoko (Rwandan Sweet Potato and Mushroom Dish)
recipes.description: A hearty Rwandan dish combining sweet potatoes and sautéed mushrooms with paprika, cumin and turmeric.

ingredients.text: 2 large sweet potatoes, peeled and cubed
ingredients.name: batat

ingredients.text: 200 g mushrooms of your choice, sliced
ingredients.name: pieczarki

ingredients.text: Fresh cilantro or parsley, chopped (for garnish)
ingredients.name: kolendra świeża

steps.text: In a large pot, bring water to a boil. Add the cubed sweet potatoes and cook until they are tender but not mushy, about 10–15 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Heat the vegetable oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and minced garlic, and sauté until the onion is translucent and fragrant.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the pan and cook for about 5 minutes, or until they are softened and slightly browned.
Sprinkle the paprika, cumin, turmeric, salt, and black pepper over the mushrooms. Stir well to coat the mushrooms with the spices.
Add the cooked sweet potatoes to the pan and gently stir to combine all the ingredients.
Cook for another 2–3 minutes to allow the flavors to meld together.
Taste and adjust the seasoning if needed.
Remove from heat and transfer to a serving dish. Garnish with fresh chopped cilantro or parsley.
Serve hot as a main dish or as a side with your favorite Rwandan accompaniments.

recipes.title: Tahu Gejrot
recipes.description: Tradycyjne danie z Cirebon w Jawie Zachodniej: smażone tofu polane słodko-kwaśnym sosem z palmowego cukru i tamaryndowca oraz rozgniecionymi papryczkami chili.

ingredients.text: 12 red or green bird's eye chiles
ingredients.name: papryczka chili

ingredients.text: 15 pieces of Sumedang tofu or tofu pong
ingredients.name: tofu Sumedang

steps.text: Grind the chiles, garlic, and shallots together, then set aside.
Combine the palm sugar, tamarind, and water in a saucepan.
Boil the mixture until all the ingredients dissolve and form a syrup.
Pour the syrup over the ground chile mixture. Mix well until evenly combined.
Cut the tofu diagonally, then press lightly until the center of the tofu is slightly crushed.
Arrange the tofu on a plate, then drizzle with the spicy and sweet sauce.

recipes.title: Swiss Meringue Buttercream
recipes.description: Swiss meringue buttercream is a variety of buttercream frosting. It is mildly sweet, and it can be used as a filling or frosting.

ingredients.text: 300 g white granulated or superfine sugar
ingredients.name: cukier

ingredients.text: 400 g unsalted butter, at room temperature and cut into small chunks
ingredients.name: masło
ingredients.note: unsalted, at room temperature and cut into small chunks

steps.text: Combine the egg whites and sugar in a heat-proof bowl.

Set the bowl over a pan of simmering water. Stir the mixture until the egg whites have warmed and the sugar is dissolved—rub a bit of the mixture between your fingers to make sure there are no grains of sugar left.
Be careful not to let the egg whites cook.
Remove the egg whites from the heat, and whip them into a stiff-peaked meringue.
With the mixer running on medium-high, gradually add the chunks of butter. Wait until the previous piece is incorporated before adding the next one.
Beat in any desired flavorings.
Use buttercream as desired.

recipes.title: Orange Brulée
recipes.description: Warm broiled orange rounds with brown sugar, butter and cinnamon, served with vanilla yogurt and mint.

steps.text: Preheat oven to broil and position rack on the second from top position.
Cut off ends of each orange, then cut off the rind using a paring knife, making certain that no bitter white pith remains.
Cut each orange crosswise into thirds and place in an oven-proof baking dish.
Combine melted butter with brown sugar, then spread over orange rounds.
Sprinkle with cinnamon.
Place oranges in the oven and broil several minutes until the oranges are hot and begin to form brown spots on the tops.
To serve, arrange oranges in pretty stemmed glassware and drizzle with any cooking juices. Top with a dollop of yogurt and a mint sprig.

recipes.title: Seasoned Pepper
recipes.description: Use this in place of regular black pepper for a burst of flavor. It's also great as a steak rub or blackening seasoning.

steps.text: Combine everything, and put it in your pepper mill.
Use like you would ordinary pepper.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Ginger Peach Glazed Ham
recipes.description: Brined city-style ham baked over peach slices and glazed with a reduction of peach nectar, honey, ginger and bay leaf.

steps.text: Place peaches in a single layer on the bottom of a roasting pan. Set aside.
Score skin and fat layers of ham in a diamond pattern with a paring knife. Place on top of peach slices.
Cover with aluminum foil. Insert an oven-safe probe thermometer into the center, but not touching bone.
Bake at 250°F until internal temperature reaches 130°F.
Meanwhile, combine remaining ingredients in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat until reduced by ⅓. Fish out ginger and bay leaf, and set aside.
Remove skin and fat layers off of ham. Pour peach mixture into pan and toss ham to coat. Remove aluminum foil and thermometer.
Reinsert thermometer into a different area and bake at 350°F until internal temperature reaches 140°F.
Remove and let rest ½ hour before carving.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock
Recipes using vegetable broth and stock

recipes.title: Herbed Tomato Soup
recipes.description: Simple vegetarian tomato soup flavored with basil and thyme, finished with optional balsamic vinegar.

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon fresh snipped basil (or 1 teaspoon dried)
ingredients.name: bazylia świeża

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon fresh snipped thyme (or ¼ teaspoon dried)
ingredients.name: tymianek świeży

ingredients.text: 4–6 fresh basil leaves (optional), sliced thinly into strips
ingredients.name: bazylia świeża
ingredients.note: 4–6 leaves, optional, sliced thinly into strips

steps.text: In a 2-quart saucepan, sauté onion in olive oil until tender but not browned.
Add tomatoes, broth, tomato sauce, basil, thyme and pepper.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat, cover and simmer 20 minutes.
Stir in vinegar, if desired, just prior to serving.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with basil strips.

recipes.title: Island Ceviche
recipes.description: Ceviche z rybą marynowaną w soku z limonki, cytryny i pomarańczy.

ingredients.text: 1 ea. (8 ounces) pompano fillet, thinly sliced
ingredients.name: filet z pompano

ingredients.text: 1 ea. (7 ounces) mahi-mahi fillet, thinly sliced
ingredients.name: filet z mahi-mahi

steps.text: Combine juices, salt, and pepper.
Pour into a gallon-size zip-top bag and add fish.
Refrigerate overnight.
Serve.

recipes.title: Lemon popsicle
recipes.description: Orzeźwiający mrożony deser z cytryny, popularny w USA wiosną i latem.

ingredients.text: 1 cup (250 ml/8.5 oz) fresh lemon juice
ingredients.name: sok z cytryny

ingredients.text: ¾–1 cup (160–225 g/5.6–7.9 oz) white or turbinado sugar
ingredients.name: cukier

steps.text: Combine the lemon juice and sugar in a pitcher or jug.
Stir until the sugar is dissolved.
Stir in the water.
Chill and/or serve over ice.
Pour into popsicle molds / tray.
Insert pop sticks; one stick into each hole.
Put the popsicle molds / tray into the freezer, and let it cool for at least 5 hours.

recipes.title: Mexican Habanero Hot Sauce
recipes.description: Ostra meksykańska salsa z habanero, pomidorową pastą i octem słodowym.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in a food processor and pulse until smooth.
Refrigerate in a non-reactive container for up to 2 months.

recipes.title: Ginger Ale
recipes.description: Ginger ale is a spicy and sweet soda flavored primarily with ginger, with added lime juice.

ingredients.text: ½ cup (120 ml) fresh or frozen ginger in ½ in (1.25 cm) dice
ingredients.name: imbir świeży
ingredients.note: fresh or frozen, in ½ in (1.25 cm) dice

steps.text: Combine the 1 cup (240 mL) water with the ginger in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, then remove from the heat and strain the liquid.
Combine the ½ cup (120 ml) water with the sugar in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, and simmer until reduced to about 5 oz (150 ml). Remove from the heat.
Combine the ginger liquid, the syrup, and the lime juice.
To make the finished soda, combine 1 volume of ginger syrup with 1 volume of carbonated water.

recipes.title: Browned Rice
recipes.description: Ryż zapiekany z konsommé wołowym, cebulą i margaryną.

steps.text: Sauté onion in margarine over medium heat.
Mix rice and consommé in a baking dish.
Pour onion and margarine over rice and consommé and mix.
Bake covered for 30 minutes at 350 °F (180 °C).
Remove from oven, and add ½ can water over rice mixture.
Cover and cook an additional 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Langar Dal
recipes.description: Langar dal is a dish consisting of stewed dal (split lentils) served at many gurdwaras and mosques.

steps.text: Rinse the dal three times and strain out the water.
Chop the onion into small cubes about 1 cm on each side.
Put the ghee in a pressure cooker and let it melt with the lid off.
Add the onions into the pot and sauté them for three minutes.
Add the turmeric powder to the pot and mix it well with the onions and ghee.
Add the dal, water, and salt.
Close the lid and seal the valve.
Pressure cook for 12 minutes.
Let the pressure release naturally.

recipes.title: Githeri
recipes.description: Traditional Kenyan dish of maize and beans boiled together, often with onion, tomato and vegetables.

ingredients.text: 2 cups dried maize kernels or fresh maize
ingredients.name: kukurydza
ingredients.note: dried maize kernels or fresh maize

ingredients.text: 2 cups dried beans (kidney beans, red beans, or mixed beans)
ingredients.name: fasola czerwona
ingredients.note: kidney beans, red beans, or mixed beans

steps.text: Wash the maize and beans thoroughly. If using dried maize and beans, soak them overnight in separate bowls of water.
Drain the soaked maize and beans and place them in a large pot.
Add enough water to cover the mixture and boil until both the maize and beans become soft. This may take 1–2 hours depending on the type used.
In another pan, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until soft and lightly golden.
Stir in the garlic, tomatoes, carrot, and bell pepper. Cook for several minutes until the tomatoes soften.
Add curry powder or turmeric if desired.
Add the cooked maize and beans to the vegetable mixture and stir well.
Season with salt and simmer for 10–15 minutes, adding a little water if necessary.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Muboora (Zimbabwean Pumpkin Leaves Stew)
recipes.description: Muboora is a popular Zimbabwean pumpkin leaf stew.

steps.text: Wash the pumpkin leaves thoroughly and remove any tough stems or veins. Chop the leaves into small pieces and set them aside.
Heat the vegetable oil in the large pot over medium heat. Add the onions and garlic. Sauté until they become translucent and fragrant.
Add the tomatoes and curry powder to the pot. Cook until the tomatoes break down and form a thick sauce, stirring occasionally.

Reduce the heat to low. Gradually spoon in the peanut butter, stirring continuously. Continue stirring until the peanut butter is well blended with the tomato sauce. This should create a creamy, thick mixture.

Start adding the chopped pumpkin leaves to the pot in batches. Stir and allow each batch to wilt and mix with the sauce before adding more. Continue this process until all the pumpkin leaves are in the pot.
Pour in enough water to cover the mixture, making it into a stew-like consistency. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Stir everything together, ensuring the leaves are submerged.

Cover the pot and let the muboora simmer on low heat for about 20–30 minutes. Stir occasionally and check for desired tenderness of the pumpkin leaves. Add more water if necessary to maintain the desired consistency.
Once the pumpkin leaves are tender and the flavors are well blended, your muboora is ready to be served.

recipes.title: Egg Noodles II
recipes.description: Homemade egg noodles made from egg yolks, a whole egg, water and flour, rolled out and cut into thin strips.

steps.text: In a bowl, beat together egg yolks, egg, salt, and pepper.
Stir in water, then flour.
Knead into ball.
Roll out on a floured surface until 2–4 mm (1/16–⅛ inch) thick.
Cut into noodles 6 mm (¼ inch) wide.
Bring water to a boil in a pot, and add oil.
Add noodles to boiling water, and cook until done.

recipes.title: Char-Grilled Strip Steak
recipes.description: Steki wołowe z polędwicy krótkiej, przyprawione ziołami i przyprawami, grillowane na węglu.

ingredients.text: 4 ea. (24–32 oz) beef strip steaks, 1 inch thick
ingredients.name: stek wołowy

steps.text: Combine seasonings. Set aside.
Brush steaks liberally with olive oil. Rub each side of steaks with seasoning mixture. Leave at room temperature for 30–45 minutes before continuing.

Prepare grill for indirect heating, high on one side, medium on the other. Add steaks to high part of grill and cook 1 ¼ minutes. Rotate 90 degrees and cook for another 1 ¼ minutes. Flip and repeat one more time.
Move steaks to medium heat and cook, turning often, until internal temperature reaches 140°F for medium-rare.
Remove to a plate and cover with aluminum foil. Let rest 7–10 minutes.
Slice steaks thinly across the grain on a bias. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Supu Ya Ndizi
recipes.description: Traditional East African soup made with green cooking bananas, vegetables and spices, popular in Tanzania and along the East African coast.

ingredients.text: 6 green cooking bananas, peeled and sliced
ingredients.name: banan plantan

steps.text: Peel and slice the green bananas into medium-sized pieces.
If using meat, cook it in a pot with water until tender and reserve the stock.
Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until soft and translucent.
Stir in the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and cook until softened.
Stir in the curry powder.
Add the bananas, carrot, and potato.
Pour in the stock or water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat and simmer for 30–40 minutes, or until the bananas are very soft.
Add the cooked meat or fish if using.
Season with salt and black pepper.
Mash some of the bananas with a spoon to thicken the soup, if desired.
Simmer for an additional 5 minutes.
Garnish with fresh coriander and serve hot.

recipes.title: Egg Noodles III
recipes.description: Domowy makaron jajeczny z mąki, jajka i wody.

steps.text: On a smooth surface, heap the flour.
Push a hole in the center of the flour (it should look like a volcano).
Break egg into flour.
Add oil now if you choose to do so—it will change the flavor and texture.
Begin kneading with hands or mixing with a fork.
Slowly add water one teaspoon at a time while kneading the dough. You probably will not need all six tablespoons of water (though you may possibly need more).
Knead dough until it has a consistent texture.
Divide dough into manageable sections. Select one section at a time and keep the rest covered. Roll each section to desired thickness and cut into noodles with a knife.

Alternatively: divide dough into manageable sections. Select one section at a time and keep the rest covered. Roll dough through smooth rollers repeatedly at progressively thinner settings. When the dough reaches desired thickness, cut with grooved rollers.

recipes.title: Tabbouleh IV
recipes.description: Tabbouleh z bulguru, świeżej natki pietruszki i mięty, pomidora, cebuli i soku z cytryny.

ingredients.text: 1 cup (240 ml) bulgur wheat (#2, medium grind)
ingredients.name: bulgur

ingredients.text: 1 cup (240 ml) fresh parsley, finely chopped
ingredients.name: natka pietruszki

ingredients.text: ½ cup (120 ml) fresh mint, finely chopped (do not use dried mint)
ingredients.name: mięta
ingredients.note: fresh, finely chopped (do not use dried mint)

ingredients.text: 1 large tomato, peeled, seeded, and diced
ingredients.name: pomidor

ingredients.text: 1 medium onion, grated on the large side of a box grater
ingredients.name: cebula
ingredients.note: medium, grated on the large side of a box grater

ingredients.text: scant ½ cup (100 ml) extra virgin olive oil
ingredients.name: oliwa z oliwek

ingredients.text: ½ cup (120 ml) fresh lemon juice
ingredients.name: sok z cytryny

steps.text: Soak bulgur in water for 15 minutes. Drain and squeeze out as much water as possible.
Chop the green onions, the white portion finely, the tops around medium.
Mix the bulgur, tomato, green onions, grated onion, parsley, and mint in a large bowl.
Whisk the olive oil and lemon juice together and pour over the salad. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Refrigerate for an hour or so to allow the flavors to meld.

recipes.title: Chickpea Flour Dessert (Mysore Pak)
recipes.description: A sweet confection made from gram flour, sugar syrup, cardamom and plenty of ghee.

steps.text: Roast the gram flour in a small amount of ghee.
Combine the sugar, cardamom, and a splash of water in a saucepan.
Boil it until the syrup reaches the single thread stage.
If more than one thread can be drawn, then more water needs to be added.
Mix half the roasted gram flour into the hot sugar syrup, keeping the heat on.
Gradually stir half the ghee into the gram flour mixture.
Keep stirring the mixture until the ghee is absorbed.
Repeat with the remaining gram flour and ghee.
More ghee can be added just until the mixture stops taking in more ghee.
After the mixture is boiled, it turns into crispy, bubble form. Pour it in a pan, and let cool.
Cut it into pieces of desired shapes.

recipes.title: Bonga Fish Domoda (Gambian Fish in Peanut Sauce)
recipes.description: Bonga fish domoda is a popular Gambian dish that features bonga fish cooked in a rich peanut-based sauce.

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper (adjust according to your spice preference)
ingredients.name: pieprz cayenne
ingredients.note: adjust according to your spice preference

ingredients.text: Fresh parsley or cilantro, chopped (for garnish)
ingredients.name: natka pietruszki
ingredients.note: fresh or cilantro, chopped, for garnish

steps.text: Heat the vegetable oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onions and garlic to the pot and sauté until they become translucent.
Stir in the diced tomatoes and tomato paste, cooking for a few minutes until the tomatoes soften.
Add the peanut butter, ground paprika, cayenne pepper, salt, and pepper to the pot. Stir well to combine all the ingredients.
Slowly pour in the water while continuously stirring the mixture to ensure the peanut butter is well incorporated.
Bring the sauce to a simmer and let it cook for about 15–20 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld together.
Gently place the bonga fish fillets into the simmering sauce, making sure they are fully submerged. Cook for another 10–15 minutes or until the fish is fully cooked and flakes easily.
Taste the sauce and adjust the seasoning if needed.
Remove the pot from heat and let it cool slightly before serving.
Garnish with freshly chopped parsley or cilantro.
Serve the bonga fish domoda hot with rice or couscous.

recipes.title: Stuffed French Toast
recipes.description: French toast z brioche nadziewany kremowym serkiem, smażony na maśle.

ingredients.text: 4 slices (⅔ inch thick) stale brioche bread
ingredients.name: chleb brioche

steps.text: Spread cream cheese on half the bread. Press into sort of a sandwich and set aside.
Combine egg, vanilla, cream, sugar, and salt in a pie pan. Add bread "sandwiches" to mixture and coat both sides.
Melt 1 tbsp butter in a small nonstick skillet heated between medium and medium high. Add 1 "sandwich" to pan and cook until golden brown on both sides.
Remove from pan. Melt remaining butter and repeat.
Serve immediately with maple syrup, powdered sugar, whipped cream, or fresh fruit.

recipes.title: Smokehouse Burgers
recipes.description: Hamburgery z mielonej wołowiny z wędzoną papryką i czosnkiem, podawane z serem pepper jack.

ingredients.text: 4 hamburger buns, split in half and toasted
ingredients.name: bułka do hamburgera

steps.text: Form meat into 4 equal patties, about ¾ inch thick. Make a depression in the center with your thumb and set aside.
Brush patties with oil. Sprinkle on both sides with seasonings.
Preheat grill. Add patties and cook, turning often, until desired "doneness" is achieved.
Remove to a plate, top each with a slice of cheese, and cover tightly with aluminum foil. Let rest until cheese is melted.
Brush cut sides of bread with oil. Add a patty onto the bottom half of a bun, then top with the upper half. Repeat with remaining meat and serve immediately.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Chile Lime Marinade
recipes.description: A marinade of lime juice, honey, serrano chiles, chicken broth and salt.

ingredients.text: *4 serrano chiles, minced (seeded if you want)
ingredients.name: papryczka serrano

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in a large mason jar and keep refrigerated for up to 2 weeks.

recipes.title: Cake Pan Goop
recipes.description: Cake goop, also called pan release, is an alternative to greasing and flouring cake pans, or buying commercial sprays. It is particularly useful for Bundt pans and other complex shapes.

ingredients.text: Vegetable oil or another neutral-flavored oil - ½ cup - 100 g
ingredients.name: olej roślinny

steps.text: Stir together the oil and shortening. This can be done with a spoon, a whisk, or an electric mixer.
Add the flour and stir until mostly smooth. Don't worry about trying to get every little lump out.

When a recipe says to prepare the cake pan by greasing and flouring it, or by spraying it with a cooking spray containing flour, instead use a brush to spread a thin layer of cake goop on the bottom and sides of the pan. If the pan has intricate details, be sure that the goop has gotten into the crevices. Then, pour in the cake batter, and bake as usual.

recipes.title: Lemoniada (extra-kwaśna)
recipes.description: Lemoniada przygotowana z soku z cytryn, wody i cukru pudru.

ingredients.text: about 6 medium lemons, juiced to yield 1 cup (250 ml/8.5 oz) juice
ingredients.name: cytryna
ingredients.note: about 6 medium, juiced to yield 1 cup (250 ml/8.5 oz) juice

ingredients.text: ¾ cup superfine sugar (160 g/5.6 oz)
ingredients.name: cukier

steps.text: Juice the lemons on a citrus reamer.
Rolling the lemons on the counter with moderate pressure prior to juicing will result in more juice from each lemon.
Try to keep out the seeds.
If you prefer lemonade with no pulp, strain the juice to remove it.
Dissolve the sugar in the water.
Heat may be helpful if using a large amount of sugar.
Combine the juice and sugar water in a pitcher.
Stir well.
Chill or serve over ice cubes.

recipes.title: Stewed Oysters II
recipes.description: Oysters stewed in a creamy butter and flour sauce, seasoned with salt, mace and pepper.

ingredients.text: Salt, mace, and pepper, to taste
ingredients.name: sól
ingredients.note: salt, mace, and pepper, to taste

steps.text: Shuck the oysters and save the liquid in the shell.
Beat the butter smooth with the flour.
Put the oysters in a pan over medium heat. When they become hot, stir in the cream, butter, and flour.
Season to taste with salt, mace, and pepper.
Serve as soon as they are taken off the fire.

recipes.title: Strawberry Italian Ice
recipes.description: A quick frozen strawberry dessert made by blending fresh strawberries with sugar, lemon juice and ice, then freezing and stirring it.

steps.text: Put a 9–10-inch metal cake pan in the freezer.
In a blender, blend the strawberries, sugar, and lemon juice until the mixture is smooth and the sugar is dissolved.
Add the ice cubes, blend the mixture until it is smooth, and pour it into the cold pan.
Freeze the mixture for 30–40 minutes, or until it is frozen around the edge, but still soft in the center.
Stir the strawberry ice, mashing the frozen parts with a fork, and spoon it into 2 bowls.

recipes.title: Sour Mix (Vegan)
recipes.description: Homemade sour mix made from three kinds of citrus juice and simple syrup, without egg.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients together.
Store in the fridge until use.

recipes.title: Date Syrup
recipes.description: Date syrup is a syrup used in various foods and drinks, both alcoholic and nonalcoholic.

ingredients.text: 1 cup (120 ml) Medjool dates, seeds removed
ingredients.name: daktyle medjool

steps.text: Bring the water to a boil, and pour it over the dates in a heat-proof bowl.
Let the dates soak for around half an hour.
Use a blender to purée the date-water mixture.
Transfer the mixture to a pot, and simmer over medium heat for 1 hour.
Remove the mixture from the heat and allow to cool to room temperature.
Strain the mixture through several layers of cheesecloth or a nut milk bag.

Return the strained liquid to a pot, and simmer until it reaches your desired syrup consistency. Keep in mind that it will thicken after cooling—if you have a thermometer, you can use it to monitor the sugar concentration, aiming for somewhere between 104–113°C (219–235°F).
Remove from the heat and allow to cool.

recipes.title: Cola V
recipes.description: Cola is a type of soda that consists of flavors derived from citrus fruits and spices.

ingredients.text: ½ in. wide strip of lemon peel cut around the fruit's circumference
ingredients.name: skórka cytrynowa
ingredients.note: ½ in. wide strip, cut around the fruit's circumference

ingredients.text: ½ in. wide strip of lemon peel cut around the fruit's circumference
ingredients.name: skórka cytrynowa
ingredients.note: ½ in. wide strip, cut around the fruit's circumference

ingredients.text: ½ in. wide strip of orange peel cut around the fruit's circumference
ingredients.name: skórka pomarańczowa
ingredients.note: ½ in. wide strip, cut around the fruit's circumference

steps.text: Boil all of the ingredients except for the vanilla extract and bitters in a pot until it becomes sticky.
Strain out the solids.
Add the vanilla extract and bitters.
To make the finished soda, combine 1 volume of syrup with 5 volumes of carbonated water.

recipes.title: Peach Curry Chutney
recipes.description: This chutney is great served with pork chops or curry.

ingredients.text: ¼ tsp freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: pieprz czarny mielony

steps.text: Blend all ingredients on high speed just until mostly liquid. There should still be chunks.
Bring to a boil over medium high heat until reduced by ⅓.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Portuguese Sweet Rolls
recipes.description: Soft, slightly sweet, lemon-scented dinner rolls made from an easy yeast dough.

ingredients.text: Potato flour (see notes) ¼ cup 45 g
ingredients.name: mąka ziemniaczana

ingredients.text: Yeast (weight given for active dry yeast) 1 packet 1 scant tablespoon 7 g
ingredients.name: drożdże suszone
ingredients.note: weight given for active dry yeast

ingredients.text: Butter, room temperature ¾ stick 6 tablespoons 85 g
ingredients.name: masło

ingredients.text: Lemon oil (see notes) ⅛–¼ teaspoon 1–2 g
ingredients.name: olejek cytrynowy

ingredients.text: Warm water (see notes) ¼ cup (2 fl oz) 55 g
ingredients.name: woda

steps.text: Put flour, salt, sugar, potato flour, yeast, and butter into a mixing bowl; stir only enough to distribute the yeast through the flour.
Pour the liquid ingredients into the flour mixture.

Stir everything thoroughly until the dough comes together; with a stand mixer this takes several minutes. If mixing by hand, turn the dough onto a clean surface and knead for up to 10 minutes, adding flour or water by the spoonful as needed.

Assess the texture: if the dough is sticky and too slack, add a generous spoonful of flour at a time (up to about ½ cup/60 g) and stir until incorporated. If there is dry flour in the bottom, add a small spoonful of warm water directly on it and mix; if you overcorrected, add a spoonful of flour until workable.
Unless it's a hot day, turn on the empty, cold oven for one minute, then turn it off.
Cover the dough so its surface doesn't dry out, by coating it with oil or covering the bowl with a lid or big plate.
Put the bowl of dough in the slightly warm oven or another warm place, double checking that the oven is off.
Let the dough rise for about 1 hour, until clearly puffy and almost twice its original volume.
Line the baking sheet with parchment paper or lightly grease the pan.
Sprinkle a big spoonful of flour on the work surface and spread it out.
Scrape the puffy dough onto the floured work surface.
Roll the dough in the flour to coat all sides, adding more flour if needed, and shape it into a rough log. Cut it into about 16 pieces of similar size with a sharp knife or bench scraper.

Shape each piece: dust the wet edges with flour, choose a smooth side as the top, stretch and pinch the edges back to the bottom, pinch the lumpy bits together on the bottom, flatten slightly, and place pinched-side-down on the baking sheet.
Repeat for the remaining pieces, leaving about an inch or two between rolls on the baking sheet.
Place the baking sheet back in the barely warm oven and proof for about 45 minutes to an hour, until puffy. If the oven has cooled, warm it for about 30 seconds and turn it off before adding the pan.
When the buns look nicely puffy, take the baking sheet out of the oven.
Preheat the empty oven to 325 °F (165 °C, gas mark 3).

When the oven is hot, put the proofed buns in and bake for about 20 minutes. Cover lightly with aluminum foil to prevent overbrowning, then bake another 10 minutes (30 minutes total). Internal temperature should reach 190 °F (88 °C) if checked with a thermometer.
Serve hot, warm, or at room temperature with butter and jam, or slice in half for sandwiches.

recipes.title: Grenadine Soda
recipes.description: Grenadine soda is a beverage made from grenadine syrup and carbonated water.

steps.text: Combine grenadine and carbonated water until well-mixed.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Southern Style Greens
recipes.description: Southern-style greens cooked with bacon, chicken broth and black pepper.

ingredients.text: 2 pounds assorted dark leafy greens, such as mustard, collard, and rainbow chard
ingredients.name: jarmuż
ingredients.note: assorted dark leafy greens, such as mustard, collard, and rainbow chard

ingredients.text: 8 rashers bacon, cut into about ½-inch pieces
ingredients.name: boczek surowy

steps.text: Cook bacon to slightly less than done in a large stainless steel pot. Drain.
If desired, pour 1 tbsp bacon fat back into pot.
Add greens, and sauté over medium-high heat for 7 minutes.
Add remaining ingredients and lower heat to medium low.
Cook for 45 minutes. Defat if needed.
Serve warm, with a vinegar-based, clear hot sauce to accompany.

recipes.title: Blackened Sirloin
recipes.description: Stek z polędwicy wołowej (top sirloin) obtoczony w pieprzu i przyprawie cajun, grillowany i podawany z sosem béarnaise.

steps.text: Brush steak with oil. Season on both sides with seasoning, peppercorns, and salt. Let sit until room temperature, about 30 minutes.
Preheat grill to 2 settings: very high, and medium high.
Add steak to hottest part and cook 3 minutes per side, rotating 90 degrees halfway through each side to mark.
Move steak to medium high heat and cook, turning often, until internal temperature is 5°F (3°C) less than the desired "doneness".
Remove to a plate and cover tightly with aluminum foil. Let rest 10 minutes.
Before serving, slice thinly across the grain on a 45 degree angle. Serve warm with Bearnaise sauce.

recipes.title: Strawberry Hibiscus Beverage
recipes.description: A refreshing drink made from hibiscus steeped in sugar syrup, combined with blended strawberries and lime juice.

ingredients.text: * 15 ripe strawberries, washed and tops removed
ingredients.name: truskawka

steps.text: In a medium saucepan over medium heat, bring 6 cups of water to a boil.
Add the sugar and mix until dissolved. Remove the pan from the heat and add the hibiscus flowers, allowing them to steep for 20 minutes.
Use a fine-mesh strainer to strain the mixture into a large pitcher. Discard the hibiscus flowers.
In a blender, combine the strawberries and 4 cups of water. Blend on high until liquefied. Strain the mixture into the pitcher and discard the remaining pulp.
Add the lime juice and the remaining 2 cups of water. Stir well to combine. Serve over ice.

recipes.title: Nigerian Miyan Giyada
recipes.description: Miyan gyada is a traditional Nigerian soup popular in northern Nigeria, especially among the Hausa people. It is made from groundnuts (peanuts), blended into a paste and cooked into a rich, creamy soup with meat or fish and leafy vegetables.

ingredients.text: 2–3 tablespoons palm oil or vegetable oil
ingredients.name: olej palmowy

ingredients.text: 2 cups leafy vegetables (e.g. spinach or ugu leaf)
ingredients.name: warzywa liściaste

steps.text: Season with onions, salt, and seasoning cubes, then boil until tender. Keep the stock.
Blend groundnuts (or use ready paste) until smooth.
Add the paste into the pot and allow it to cook, stirring to prevent burning.
Add pepper and a little palm oil or vegetable oil, then mix well.
Add your leafy vegetables and stir.
Allow the soup to cook until it thickens and oil begins to rise to the top. The soup should be thick, creamy, and rich with a nutty flavor.
Taste and add salt or seasoning if needed.
Serve with swallows like tuwo shinkafa or Tuwo dawa.

recipes.title: Sadza (Zimbabwean Corn Porridge)
recipes.description: A simple, hearty maize porridge from Zimbabwe, often served as a staple food.

ingredients.text: 2 cups white maize meal (cornmeal or maize flour)
ingredients.name: mąka kukurydziana
ingredients.note: white maize meal (cornmeal or maize flour)

steps.text: Bring the water to a boil in a large pot.
In a separate bowl, mix the maize meal with the cold water. Stir until you have a smooth, lump-free paste.
Once the water in the pot is boiling, gradually add the maize paste into the boiling water while stirring continuously. This is crucial to prevent lumps from forming.
Continue stirring the mixture vigorously with a wooden spoon or spatula. It will start to thicken.
After a few minutes of stirring, reduce the heat to low.
Cover the pot with a lid and let the sadza simmer on low heat for about 20–30 minutes. Stir occasionally to prevent it from sticking to the bottom of the pot.
Add more water or maize meal as needed to achieve your desired consistency. Some prefer a thick, stiff sadza, while others like it softer.
Season with salt to taste and continue to cook for another 5–10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Once the sadza has reached your preferred consistency and is cooked through, remove it from the heat. It should be smooth, stiff, and free from any raw taste of maize.

recipes.title: Nigerian Corned Beef Sauce
recipes.description: This corned beef sauce is also known as spaghetti sauce in Nigeria, but you can also use it for boiled rice, boiled yam, and boiled potatoes.

steps.text: Heat the vegetable oil in a saucepan.
Add the onions, tomatoes, peppers, garlic, and ginger. Stir, and fry for about 10 minutes.
Mix in the corned beef, and fry for about 10 minutes.
Add salt and seasoning cube to taste. Stir, then cover and cook for a few minutes.
Adjust seasoning as needed, and serve.

recipes.title: Bánh Chưng
recipes.description: Traditional Vietnamese dish of glutinous rice, mung beans and pork wrapped in banana leaves and boiled, eaten during Lunar New Year.

ingredients.text: 1½ cups mung beans, washed and soaked in water for 4 hours, or better overnight
ingredients.name: fasola mung
ingredients.note: washed and soaked in water for 4 hours, or better overnight

ingredients.text: 500 g pork belly (both lean pork and pork fat), cut in large cubes
ingredients.name: boczek wieprzowy
ingredients.note: both lean pork and pork fat, cut in large cubes

ingredients.text: 5½ cups sticky rice, washed and soaked in water overnight
ingredients.name: ryż kleisty biały
ingredients.note: washed and soaked in water overnight

steps.text: Place the mung beans in a pot, cover with water, and bring to a boil.
Reduce to a simmer, and cook for about 20 minutes until the beans are soft and easily mashable.
Mash the beans into a paste. Season to taste with 1 tsp salt, fried shallots, 1 tsp pepper and vegetable oil.
Season the meat with ½ tsp salt and 1½ tsp pepper, and combine with the shallots and fish sauce. Mix well and let it marinate for a few hours.
Spread about 1 cup of mashed mung bean onto plastic wrap, add a few pieces of lean pork and pork fat, and shape it into a round or squared piece.
Tear the banana leaves into very large pieces (around 18–20 inches).
Season the soaked rice with a pinch of salt.

Lay out two sheets of partially overlapping banana leaves on a flat surface. Place 1 cup of sticky rice at the center of the leaves. Place the fillings on top of the rice and then cover it up with another cup of sticky rice. Fold the leaves and wrap it up tightly like a present.

Wrap the cake a second time to prevent water penetrating during boiling. For the inner layer, make sure the darker side of the banana leaf faces the rice. For the outer layer, the darker side of the banana leaf should face outside.
After wrapping, tie the cake tightly with twines.
Arrange the cakes tightly in a large stockpot and fill with water. Bring to a boil and let it simmer for about 6 to 8 hours until the cakes feel plump and the rice is congealed.
To serve, untie and unwrap the cakes, and cut into pieces with a thread or dental floss.

recipes.title: Smokehouse Turkey Panini
recipes.description: A panini of smoked turkey breast, bacon and Monterey Jack cheese on white bread, grilled until hot.

steps.text: Assemble a sandwich with the turkey, bread, bacon, and cheese. Set aside.
Preheat 2-burner grill pan over medium high heat.
Brush both sides of sandwiches with oil then place on grill.
Cook until ingredients are heated through and bread is marked, turning as needed. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Boiled Yellow Split Peas
recipes.description: These legumes are flavorful and healthy, but require soaking.

ingredients.text: ½ pound (225 grams / 1¼ cups) dry yellow split peas
ingredients.name: groch łuskany

ingredients.text: ⅛ teaspoon baking soda, if needed (see tips)
ingredients.name: soda oczyszczona

steps.text: Quick method: Pick over beans, then add hot water.
Quick method: Boil for two minutes.
Quick method: Set aside for 1 hour.
Quick method: Drain and rinse.
Quick method: Simmer until tender.
Overnight method: Pick over beans, then add cold water.
Overnight method: Soak overnight, or 6 hours minimum.
Overnight method: Drain and rinse.
Overnight method: Simmer until tender.

recipes.title: Funje (Cassava Flour Pudding)
recipes.description: A traditional Angolan dish of cassava flour cooked in water until smooth, served with soup.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to about 350 °F.
Put the water in a medium-size pot and let boil.
Put the cassava flour in a medium-size bowl, and mix with a little cold water until it is just damp. Make sure to mix it very well so as to have an even mixture.
When the water is boiling, mix in the damp pre-mixed cassava flour.
Whisk to combine, and continue to whisk until all lump-free.
Cover with the lid and place it in the oven to cook for about 30 minutes.
Whisk any further if you want, then remove and serve with any soup of your desire.

recipes.title: Smoky Chipotle Glazed Hot Wings
recipes.description: Deep-fried chicken wingettes tossed in a glaze of melted butter, chipotle hot sauce, soy sauce and garlic.

steps.text: Heat oil to 350°F.
Fry wings in batches for 12 minutes each batch.
Drain on a rack.
Combine remaining ingredients, add wings, and toss to coat.
Serve.

categories: Recipes using vegetable broth and stock

recipes.title: Yetakelt Alicha (Ethiopian Vegetable Stew)
recipes.description: A flavorful and comforting Ethiopian vegetable stew made with a medley of vegetables cooked in a mild and aromatic sauce.

ingredients.text: ¼ teaspoon cayenne pepper, or to taste
ingredients.name: pieprz cayenne

ingredients.text: 1 cup green beans, trimmed and cut into bite-sized pieces
ingredients.name: fasolka szparagowa
ingredients.note: trimmed and cut into bite-sized pieces

ingredients.text: Fresh cilantro or parsley, chopped, for garnish
ingredients.name: kolendra świeża (liście)

steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan or pot over medium heat.
Add the finely chopped onion and sauté until it becomes translucent.
Stir in the minced garlic and grated ginger, and cook for another minute until fragrant.
Add the turmeric, cumin, paprika, cayenne pepper, and salt. Mix well to coat the onions, garlic, and ginger with the spices.
Add the sliced carrots, diced potatoes, green beans, cauliflower florets, and broccoli florets to the saucepan. Stir to combine the vegetables with the spice mixture.
Pour in the vegetable broth or water, and bring the mixture to a simmer. Reduce the heat to low, cover the saucepan, and let the stew cook for about 20–25 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Check the seasoning and adjust with salt or additional spices if desired.
Remove from heat and let the yetakelt alicha rest for a few minutes to allow the flavors to meld together.
Garnish the stew with freshly chopped cilantro or parsley.
Serve hot as a main course, accompanied by injera or rice.

recipes.title: Chibwabwa (Zambian Pumpkin Leaves with Groundnut Sauce)
recipes.description: Classic Zambian dish of tender pumpkin leaves in a flavorful groundnut sauce.

ingredients.text: 1 cup peanuts, roasted and ground into a smooth paste
ingredients.name: orzeszki ziemne
ingredients.note: roasted and ground into a smooth paste

steps.text: In a large pot, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the pot. Sauté until the onions are soft and translucent.
Add the diced tomato and chopped hot pepper (if using) to the pot. Cook until the tomato is soft and tender.
In a blender or food processor, blend the roasted peanuts until they form a smooth paste. You may need to add a little water to achieve the desired consistency.
Add the peanut paste to the pot with the cooked vegetables. Stir well to combine.
Pour in the water and bring the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Add the chopped pumpkin leaves to the pot. Stir to incorporate the leaves into the groundnut sauce.
Let simmer for about 10–15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the pumpkin leaves are cooked and tender.
Taste the sauce and season with salt according to your preference.
Remove the pot from the heat and let rest for a few minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Pizza Sauce From Scratch
recipes.description: A no-cook pizza sauce made from tomato paste, water, olive oil, garlic and herbs, mixed to taste.

ingredients.text: 6 ounce (170 g) can of tomato paste (with no additives is best)
ingredients.name: koncentrat pomidorowy

ingredients.text: 1–1½ cups (250–375 ml) of water (depending on desired consistency)
ingredients.name: woda
ingredients.note: 1½ cups (375 ml) depending on desired consistency

ingredients.text: About ⅓ cup (80 ml) extra virgin olive oil (more or less depending on taste)
ingredients.name: oliwa z oliwek
ingredients.note: more or less depending on taste

ingredients.text: About ½ tablespoon dried oregano (according to preference)
ingredients.name: oregano suszone

ingredients.text: About ½ tablespoon dried basil (according to preference)
ingredients.name: bazylia suszona

steps.text: Combine tomato paste, water, and oil.
Add garlic, basil, and oregano, mixing thoroughly.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
For best results place in refrigerator overnight or allow the mixture to rest before using.

recipes.title: Guacamole II
recipes.description: Simple, very tasty guacamole that goes well with tortilla chips or vegetables, or in enchiladas.

ingredients.text: 3 whole avocados, ripe but not over-ripe
ingredients.name: awokado

ingredients.text: 2–3 whole red chilli peppers, finely chopped
ingredients.name: papryczka chili

steps.text: Prepare avocados by halving and removing the stone. The simplest way is to hold the avocado in the palm of your hand and strike the stone squarely and firmly with a chef's knife, so the knife pulls the stone out easily. If it doesn't come out easily, the avocado isn't ripe enough.
Reserve one half avocado. Skin and blend the rest using a hand-held food processor.
Add the juice of the lime, chillies, and garlic. Add generous salt to taste.

Roughly chop the reserved avocado and add to the paste to give a chunky texture. The dip will keep for several days in a fridge, and it shouldn't brown too much if covered (the lime juice acts as an antioxidant as well as giving flavour).
Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl.
Stir with wire whisk until well blended.
Store in an airtight container in a cool place.

recipes.title: Asaro (Yam Porridge)
recipes.description: Traditional Nigerian yam porridge cooked in a richly seasoned sauce of tomatoes, peppers, onions and oil, popular among the Yoruba people.

ingredients.text: ½ cup palm oil or vegetable oil
ingredients.name: olej palmowy

ingredients.text: 200 g protein, such as fresh fish, meat, or smoked fish (optional)
ingredients.name: ryba świeża lub mięso
ingredients.note: optional, protein such as fresh fish, meat, or smoked fish

ingredients.text: 1 medium (about 1 kg) yam, peeled and cubed
ingredients.name: jam surowy
ingredients.note: medium, about 1 kg, peeled and cubed

ingredients.text: Leafy vegetables such as spinach or ugu (optional)
ingredients.name: warzywa liściaste
ingredients.note: optional, such as spinach or ugu

steps.text: Blend the tomatoes, peppers, and onion into a smooth purée.
Heat the oil in a pot and add the purée. Cook for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in seasoning cubes, salt, and any protein being used.
Stir in the water and bring to a boil.
Gently stir in the cubed yam. Cover and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the yam becomes soft and some of it has broken down to thicken the dish.
Add leafy vegetables if desired and cook for an additional 3–5 minutes.
Adjust seasoning and remove from heat.

recipes.title: Pizza Hot Dogs
recipes.description: Hot dogs split lengthwise on buns, topped with mozzarella, pizza sauce and Parmesan, then broiled.

steps.text: Split hot dogs and hot dog buns lengthwise.
Place buns on a cookie sheet.
Sprinkle mozzarella cheese over buns.
Place split hot dog on each bun.
Spread pizza sauce over the hotdogs, sprinkle with Parmesan cheese, and broil until cheese bubbles and the hot dogs are hot.

recipes.title: Beurre Manié
recipes.description: Beurre manié, meaning "kneaded butter", is a paste made from equal volumes of butter and flour. It acts a thickener for soups and sauces.

steps.text: Combine the butter and flour in a mixing bowl.
Use your hands or a small utensil such as a fork/spoon to knead the flour into the butter until fully and evenly incorporated.
Use immediately or store as indicated in the notes.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Smoky Chipotle Marinade
recipes.description: A smoky marinade of chipotle hot sauce, adobo sauce, honey, tequila, chicken broth and malt vinegar for meat.

ingredients.name: sos z chipotle na bazie ostrej papryki

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in a large zip-top plastic bag. Insert meat in and refrigerate for as long as you like.

recipes.title: Dum ka Qimah (Spiced Minced Meat)
recipes.description: Spiced minced meat cooked with onion paste, ginger, garam masala and yogurt, finished over smoked charcoal.

ingredients.text: 3 medium onions, peeled and thinly sliced
ingredients.name: cebula

ingredients.text: 1 kg lean minced meat (beef or lamb)
ingredients.name: wołowina mielona chuda

steps.text: Heat oil in a heavy-based saucepan. Add onions and, stirring frequently, fry for 8–10 minutes to a light golden color.
Remove onions from oil and fry the whole chillies just for a moment, otherwise they will burn.
Reserve the oil, put the onions and whole chillies in a chopper or food processor, and blend to a smooth paste without using water.
Thoroughly wash the minced meat, and squeeze out any water.
Put the minced meat in a bowl. Add onion paste, ginger paste, salt, garam masala and yogurt. Knead the mixture really well for a few minutes with your hands until it is smooth.
Cover and leave to marinate at room temperature for about 3–4 hours or overnight in the refrigerator. One hour before cooking, mix in the ground papaya.
Put the charcoal over medium flame, and wait until the coal is fully red and is covered by white ash.

Meanwhile place the meat mixture in a metal pan. Make a well in the center. Put a small piece of aluminum foil in it. Place the burned coal over it and put 2–3 drops of oil on it. Cover it at once with a tight fitting lid and put aside for 20–25 minutes.

Take out ½ cup of oil from the reserved oil. Reheat the oil in a heavy based pan. Discard the charcoal, and fry the mince over low heat for 4-5 minutes. Cover with a tight fitting lid and cook for 15–20 minutes or until all excess moisture has been absorbed.
Transfer to a serving dish and decorate with onion ring, green chilli, and coriander leaves.

recipes.title: Dosa II
recipes.description: Cienkie naleśniki z ryżu i urad dal, fermentowane z dodatkiem nasion kozieradki.

ingredients.text: ½ cup (90 g) split and husked urad dal (dhuli urad)
ingredients.name: urad dal

steps.text: Soak rice, dal, and fenugreek seeds separately overnight. Don't soak the dal longer than 3-4 hours. Do soak the rice for at least 6-8 hours.
Grind the soaked rice, dal, and fenugreek together to a very smooth consistency; use a blender for best results.
Add the salt and enough water to make into a dropping consistency, and leave to rise for 5–6 hours, or overnight.
Check consistency of the batter, and if needed, add enough water to make into a smooth pouring consistency.

Heat a tava (dosa pan) until very hot, and splash a little water over it. With a ladle, immediately pour some batter onto the pan, spreading it thin with a circular motion, without pressing too hard. You will need some practice to get it right.
Lower the heat and dribble a little oil around the edges. When edges start browning a bit, it is almost done.
Flip the dosa to the other side, and allow it to cook for a few seconds.
Add desired filling and fold over.

recipes.title: Fresh Tomato Galette
recipes.description: A rustic puff pastry galette topped with sliced fresh tomatoes, thyme, mustard powder, Parmesan and breadcrumbs.

ingredients.text: 3 tbsp panko or fine dry breadcrumbs
ingredients.name: bułka tarta

steps.text: Preheat your oven to 200°C (400°F).
Slice the tomatoes to 0.5 cm (¼ inch) thick, and set aside.
In a bowl, combine 2 tbsp grated Parmesan with the thyme and mustard powder.
Line a baking tray with parchment paper and lay your puff pastry on top.
Spread 2 tbsp panko or breadcrumbs, leaving about 4 cm (1½ inch) of the border uncovered.
Sprinkle the cheese mixture evenly on top.
Starting at the centre, arrange the tomato slices in concentric circles, overlapping each other.
Sprinkle the remaining breadcrumbs and Parmesan on top, season with a little pepper if you like, and carefully fold the leftover dough over the tomatoes.
Brush the galette with the beaten egg, and bake for about 30–40 minutes or until the dough is cooked through and golden brown.
Allow the galette to cool down slightly before decorating with fresh basil leaves, and serve.

recipes.title: Welsh Fruit Bread (Bara Brith) II
recipes.description: A traditional Welsh fruit bread soaked in tea and sweetened with brown sugar and jam.

ingredients.text: 1 lb dried assorted fruit (e.g. raisins, cherries, etc.)
ingredients.name: suszone owoce mieszane

steps.text: Soak the fruit in the tea for 24 hours
Mix flour, sugar, egg, spice, fruit, and jam in bowl to make a batter.
Spoon batter into a loaf tin and bake for 45 minutes at 325°F.
Let cool, remove from tin, and glaze with honey.

recipes.title: Southern Barbecue Ribs
recipes.description: Żeberka wieprzowe w stylu St. Louis, wędzone i pieczone w sosie barbecue.

ingredients.text: 2 slabs St. Louis style/cut pork spareribs
ingredients.name: żeberka wieprzowe

steps.text: Season ribs with the barbecue rub.
Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Place chunks into the firebox of a 250°F smoker or the coal area of a 250°F charcoal grill set for indirect heat.
Place ribs into food box or on top of the grate of the charcoal grill, cover, and cook, basting often with sauce, for 5–6 hours.
Brush sauce generously on top and bottom of ribs then place on a medium high grill, continually brushing with sauce until well browned, then flip and repeat 1 more time.
Place remaining sauce into a squirt bottle. Meanwhile, remove ribs and let rest for 10 minutes.
Serve with sauce in a squirt bottle.

recipes.title: Sindhi Vegetable Kofta
recipes.description: Wegetariańskie kofty z warzyw w sosie pomidorowym, w stylu sindhi.

steps.text: Combine the water, a pinch of salt, and cornstarch. It should be thick and not watery.
Combine the carrot, cauliflower, mashed potatoes, bell pepper, chiles, salt to taste, pepper, and garam masala.
Wet the bread, squeeze it out, and mix it into the vegetables.
Shape the vegetable mixture into small balls. Dip the balls in the cornstarch mixture to coat well.
Fry balls in a pan of hot oil until golden brown. Remove from the oil and place on paper towels.
Fry the onions in a pan with a little oil until golden brown. Add the tomatoes, and fry until the tomatoes and the oil separate.
Add a little water, along with salt to taste, chili powder, and coriander powder. Bring to a boil.
Add the fried kofta to the sauce, and cook for a while.
Remove from the heat, and mix in the garam masala and pepper.
Serve hot with roti, naan, or rice.

recipes.title: Apple Crusted Ham
recipes.description: Bone-in cooked ham baked with a crust of chop rub and dried apples, glazed with cola.

ingredients.text: 1 bone-in cooked city ham, skin removed
ingredients.name: szynka gotowana

ingredients.text: ½ cup dried apples, minced finely
ingredients.name: jabłko suszone

steps.text: Place ham in a large roasting pan large side down.
Bake at 250°F for 1 hour.
Take ham out from oven and brush generously with cola.
Pat on the chop rub, and then pat on apples.
Bake for another 1 ½ hours at 250°F.
Remove and let rest 10 minutes.
Slice thinly and serve.

recipes.title: Spelt Bread
recipes.description: Chleb z mąki orkiszowej drożdżowy, pieczony w formie na bochenek.

steps.text: Combine the flour, salt, sugar and yeast.
To the dry ingredients, add the oil and enough water to make a firm dough.
Knead the dough for about 10 minutes.
Place in a greased 1 kg loaf tin, cover and leave it in a warm place until doubled in size.
Uncover and bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for about 35 minutes. The bread is cooked when it makes a hollow sound when tapped on the bottom.

recipes.title: Fårikål (Norwegian Lamb and Cabbage Stew)
recipes.description: A stew of cabbage and mutton shoulder or sometimes lamb. It is the national dish of Norway.

steps.text: Cut the cabbage in half, then cut the halves into roughly even boat-shaped pieces.
Cover the bottom of the pot with a layer of meat, laying it with the fattier side down.
Add a layer of cabbage on top of the meat, then another layer of meat on top of the cabbage.
Add salt and pepper between each layer.
Continue until you have placed all the cabbage and meat into the pot.
Pour in the water, and slowly bring it to a boil.
Reduce the heat until the stew is at a slight simmer.
Let the meat simmer until it is tender and easily falls off the bone.
Let it simmer for a little shorter when using lamb meat.
Serve straight from the pot with boiled potatoes.

recipes.title: Americanized Eggplant Parmesan
recipes.description: A vegetarian main dish of breaded, air-fried eggplant layered with mozzarella and pasta sauce, served on top of pasta.

ingredients.text: Canola or olive oil in a sprayer
ingredients.name: olej roślinny

steps.text: Cut off the top and bottom of the eggplant and slice it into six slices of equal thickness.
Salt both sides of each eggplant slice generously and place the slices between several layers of paper towel.
Weight the eggplant slices down with something heavy, such as a cast-iron frying pan, an encyclopedia, or an obese cat.
Let the eggplant slices rest under weight for at least an hour, until they have released a substantial amount of moisture.
Preheat the oven to 180°C.
Slice the mozzarella roll into six slices of equal thickness and arrange on fresh paper towels and let stand for about 20 minutes while you prepare the following steps.
Put the flour in a wide, flat bowl.
Whisk the egg and milk together in a second wide, flat bowl.
In a third wide, flat bowl, combine the panko, garlic powder, pepper, oregano and 20 g of Parmigiano.
Dredge the eggplant slices first in flour, then in the egg/milk mixture, then in the panko.
Spray oil on the inside of the air fryer and on one side of each eggplant slice.

Lay eggplant slices in the air fryer basket, oiled side down, then spray the top side with additional oil. You may need to work in batches, since probably not all slices will fit in the basket at once.
Cook in the air fryer at 180°C for 10–12 minutes, turning halfway through.
While the eggplant is cooking, spread a thin layer of pasta sauce on the bottom of a rectangular baking pan.
When the eggplant is done, place the slices on top of the pasta sauce in the baking pan.
Lay one slice of mozzarella on top of each slice of eggplant.
Pour one large spoonful of pasta sauce over each slice.
Sprinkle the remaining 20 g of Parmigiano evenly over all slices.
Bake for 20–30 minutes or until the sauce is bubbling.
Turn the oven to Broil and brown the cheese on top for 2–3 minutes.
Remove from oven and arrange fresh basil leaves on top.
Cover with aluminum foil and allow to stand while you boil fusilli or penne pasta, which the eggplant parmigiana will be served on top of.

recipes.title: Firecracker Rub
recipes.description: This rub kicks it up a notch from oversalted flavorless commercial rubs by packing quite some heat.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Sour Mix (With Egg)
recipes.description: This recipe for homemade sour mix uses lemon juice with an egg white for texture.

ingredients.text: 2 cups lemon juice, preferably freshly squeezed
ingredients.name: sok z cytryny

steps.text: Whisk egg white in a medium-sized bowl until frothy.
Stir in the sugar and water or simple syrup.
Add the lemon juice, and stir all ingredients well.
Store the mix refrigerated, and use within 3 days of making it.

recipes.title: M'semen (Layered Algerian Flatbread)
recipes.description: Msemmen is a traditional layered flatbread from the Maghreb region of North Africa, particularly popular in Algeria and Morocco. It is commonly enjoyed with honey, mint tea, or coffee for breakfast.

steps.text: Mix the flour, semolina, salt, sugar, and yeast in a bowl.
Gradually add warm water and knead until a smooth dough forms.
Divide the dough into small balls and let rest for 30 minutes.
Flatten each ball into a thin sheet.
Brush with oil and butter, then fold into a square.
Let the folded squares rest for 15 minutes.
Flatten gently and cook on a hot griddle until golden brown on both sides.
Serve warm with honey, jam, tea, or savory accompaniments.

recipes.title: Spicy Apple Glazed Ribs
recipes.description: Spicy ribs glazed with a sweet apple cider mixture and slow-smoked or grilled until tender.

steps.text: Season pork with barbecue rub, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Combine wet ingredients and bring to a boil over high heat 5–10 minutes. Set aside.
Place ribs in a 250°F smoker or a 250°F charcoal grill set for indirect heat and cook 5–6 hours or until meat falls off the bone.
Brush generously with cider mixture and place on a medium high grill, turning and brushing with cider mixture until well browned.
Remove and let rest 10 minutes. Serve with remaining cider mixture.

recipes.title: Nigerian Cauliflower Fufu
recipes.description: Nigerian fufu made from cauliflower, similar to pounded yam.

steps.text: Cut cauliflower into small pieces, and blend with a blender to give a purée.
Strain the cauliflower mixture through a cloth, retaining the solids.
Squeeze the sieve cloth to drain more water until relatively dry and a dough is formed.
Transfer the dough to a saucepan over medium heat, and stir in the psyllium husk.
Stir and mold to form a paste, and shape into portions.

categories: Recipes using chile paste and sauce

recipes.title: Vietnamese Fish Dipping Sauce (Nước mắm pha)
recipes.description: Vietnamese fish sauce is a dipping sauce prepared for use at the table. It contains a more concentrated fish sauce of a similar name.

ingredients.text: ¼ cups nước mắm (concentrated fish sauce)
ingredients.name: sos rybny

ingredients.text: 1 tsp minced garlic or about 2 cloves pressed through a garlic press
ingredients.name: czosnek
ingredients.note: minced garlic or about 2 cloves pressed through a garlic press

ingredients.text: ½ tsp sambal oelek (a type of hot chile sauce)
ingredients.name: sos chili
ingredients.note: a type of hot chile sauce

steps.text: Mix all ingredients together.
If desired, bring to a boil that cannot be stirred down.
Cover and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Cinnamon-braised Chicken (Kotopoulo Kapama)
recipes.description: Kotopoulo kapama is a Greek dish of braised chicken flavored with cinnamon.

ingredients.text: 1 tin tomatoes, or 300 g of fresh tomatoes
ingredients.name: pomidor

ingredients.text: 1 stick of celery, cut into thin 3-inch strips
ingredients.name: seler naciowy

steps.text: Heat oil in saucepan and add onion. Stir gently until onion is well browned.
Add chicken, bay leaves, and cinnamon, then thoroughly brown chicken on all sides. The objective is to get as much "stock" from the skin as possible as this adds to the flavour later on.
Add tomatoes, garlic, wine, and water, and cook through. Add parsley, celery leaves, celery, carrot.

Add enough water to cover the contents of the pot. Allow to cook slowly for at least 2 hours. It is important to cook over a low heat so that sauce does not catch. Stirring or agitation will only cause the vegetables and chicken pieces to break up.
Serve with thin pasta. Grate cheese generously over dish.

recipes.title: Mashed Sweet Potatoes
recipes.description: Sweet potatoes boiled and mashed with brown sugar, orange juice, butter and cinnamon.

ingredients.text: 2 pounds sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into ½-inch pieces
ingredients.name: batat
ingredients.note: peeled and cut into ½-inch pieces

ingredients.text: 4 ounces unsalted butter, cut into pieces
ingredients.name: masło

steps.text: Cover potatoes in a large pot with cold water by at least an inch.
Cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce heat to a simmer and cook until potatoes are tender (about 15–20 minutes).
Drain potatoes into a colander.
Remove water from pot and add potatoes and remaining ingredients.
Mash potatoes with either an immersion blender or potato masher.
If you used a potato masher, combine ingredients thoroughly. If you did not, then you can skip this step.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Grilled Radicchio with Bacon Dressing
recipes.description: Grilled radicchio quarters drizzled with a warm vinegar and bacon fat dressing and topped with crumbled bacon.

ingredients.text: ½ cup extra-virgin olive oil, divided
ingredients.name: oliwa z oliwek

steps.text: Toss radicchio with ¼ cup olive oil. Sprinkle liberally with kosher salt and freshly-ground black pepper.
Place on a medium grill and cook until marked on all sides and heated through.
Meanwhile, whisk together vinegar and mustard. In another bowl, combine remaining olive oil and bacon fat. Slowly stream oil mixture into vinegar mixture while whisking continuously.
Drizzle dressing over radicchio and sprinkle with bacon. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Prickly Pear Soda
recipes.description: This prickly pear soda is popular in Mexico and the Southwestern United States.

steps.text: Remove the peel from the prickly pears, cut them into small pieces about 0.5 x 0.5 in (1.25 x 1.25 cm), and remove the seeds.
Combine the fruit flesh, water, and agave nectar in a saucepan.
Boil the mixture until it becomes very thick, then strain it to get approximately 5 oz (120 ml) of syrup.
Make the finished soda by combining 1 volume of syrup with 5 volumes of carbonated water.

recipes.title: Yataklete Kilkil (Ethiopian Vegetable Stew)
recipes.description: Yataklete kilkil is an Ethiopian vegetable stew made with a variety of mixed vegetables cooked in a flavorful sauce. This vegetarian stew showcases the diverse flavors and textures of Ethiopian cuisine.

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons niter kibbeh (Ethiopian spiced clarified butter) or regular butter/oil
ingredients.name: masło klarowane
ingredients.note: niter kibbeh (Ethiopian spiced clarified butter) or regular butter/oil

ingredients.text: 1 cup green beans, trimmed and cut into bite-sized pieces
ingredients.name: fasolka szparagowa
ingredients.note: trimmed and cut into bite-sized pieces

ingredients.text: Fresh cilantro or parsley, chopped, for garnish
ingredients.name: kolendra świeża (liście)

steps.text: Heat the niter kibbeh in a large skillet or frying pan over medium heat.
Add the finely chopped onion to the skillet and sauté until it becomes translucent.
Stir in the minced garlic, grated ginger, turmeric, cumin, paprika, and salt. Mix well to coat the onions with the spices.
Add the sliced carrots, diced potatoes, green beans, cauliflower florets, and broccoli florets to the skillet. Stir to combine the vegetables with the spice mixture.
Cover the skillet with a lid and cook the vegetables for about 15–20 minutes, or until they are tender but still retain their vibrant colors. Stir occasionally to ensure even cooking.
Add the thinly sliced cabbage to the skillet and cook for an additional 3–5 minutes, or until the cabbage becomes slightly wilted.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the vegetables and give them a final toss to incorporate the flavors.
Remove from heat and transfer to a serving dish. Garnish with freshly chopped cilantro or parsley.
Serve hot as a main course, accompanied by injera or rice.

recipes.title: Maple Cumin Glazed Grilled Bananas
recipes.description: Grilled bananas glazed with a maple syrup, dark rum and cumin mixture.

steps.text: Spray bananas and cold grill grate with nonstick cooking spray.
Place a large saucepan over high heat and add rum. Ignite.
Once flames have died, remove from heat and whisk in remaining ingredients.
Place bananas cut side down on the preheated grill, and brush with rum mixture.
Cook for 2 minutes, then flip and brush grilled side with more rum mixture.
Cook other side until well browned.
Flip and cook just until browned. Remove and serve.

recipes.title: Quick and Easy Queso Dip
recipes.description: A quick queso dip made from melted Velveeta and Monterey Jack cheese mixed with stewed tomatoes with green chiles and onion.

ingredients.text: 10 oz (280 g) stewed tomatoes with green chiles
ingredients.name: pomidor z puszki

ingredients.text: 0.5 lb (225 g) monterey jack cheese, grated
ingredients.name: ser Monterey Jack

steps.text: In small pan, heat undrained tomatoes and onion, cooking until the juice is gone.
While tomatoes are cooking, place Velveeta in microwave-safe bowl and melt in microwave.
Add monterey jack cheese and melt mixture using 50% power.
Add tomato mixture to cheese mixture.

recipes.title: Naan (Yeasted)
recipes.description: Soft yeasted flatbread with yoghurt and milk, baked in the oven.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 140°C/275°F/Gas 1.

In a small bowl, mix the yeast with 1 tablespoon of warm water. Stir in the sugar and leave it in a warm place for 5 minutes until the yeast is covered with froth. This will show that the yeast is ready to use.
Mix together the flour, onion seeds, salt and baking powder.
Stir in the oil, yoghurt and milk, then stir in the activated yeast mixture.

To knead the dough, clench your hand into a fist, wet your knuckles with a little water, then press them repeatedly into the dough. Continue pressing and kneading until you have a soft, pliable dough. It should take about 10 minutes.
Leave the dough to rest for 10 minutes.
Knead again for another 5 minutes.
Place the dough in a mixing bowl, cover it with cling film and leave it in a warm place to rise for 20–30 minutes.
Divide the dough into four balls and place on a floured surface or board. Roll each into a long oval shape about 0.5 cm (¼ inch) thick.
Place them on a greased baking tray and put them in the centre of the oven for 10–15 minutes. They are ready when they have puffed up a little.
Serve fresh from the oven.

recipes.title: Beef Tongue with Chiles, Corn and Tomato (Lengua de Res)
recipes.description: Lengua de res is a Venezuelan dish of beef tongue with vegetables.

ingredients.text: 2 cans (30 ounces) whole kernel corn, drained
ingredients.name: kukurydza konserwowa

steps.text: Wash tongue and place in a large pot of water to cover. Simmer until no longer pink (about 50 minutes per pound of tongue).
Remove from water and let rest until cool enough to handle. Peel skin from tongue and trim gristle. Cut into ½-inch slices.
Place whole peppers in a skillet over medium-high heat and roast, turning, until all sides are charred. Let cool, rub off skins. Remove stems and seeds.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Sauté chili peppers, onion, and garlic until onion is translucent.
Stir in tongue and continue to cook until tongue is brown, 5 to 10 minutes. Stir in tomatoes and cook until limp, 5 minutes. Pour in corn and heat through, 2 to 5 minutes.
Season with salt, and serve.

recipes.title: Eton Mess Easter Sharing Eggs
recipes.description: Hollow dark chocolate Easter eggs filled with whipped cream, soft cheese and raspberry jam, topped with crumbled meringue and strawberry pieces.

ingredients.text: 1 medium-sized hollow dark chocolate Easter egg
ingredients.name: czekoladowe jajko wielkanocne

ingredients.text: ⅓ cup (80 ml/2.7 fl oz) heavy cream
ingredients.name: śmietanka kremówka

ingredients.text: ¾ cup (200 g/7.1 oz) reduced-fat soft cheese
ingredients.name: serek miękki o obniżonej zawartości tłuszczu

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon strawberry-infused apple pieces or freeze-dried strawberries
ingredients.name: kawałki jabłka z truskawkami

steps.text: Halve the Easter egg carefully by running a sharp knife under hot water, wiping dry, and pressing into the joint to separate.
