Whip the cream in a mixing bowl to soft peaks.
Fold in 3 tablespoons of jam and the soft cheese.
Spoon the mixture into the egg halves.
Scatter the crumbled meringue nest and apple pieces over top.
Drizzle the egg halves with remaining jam and serve.

recipes.title: Goat Milk Caramel Sauce
recipes.description: This caramel sauce incorporates goat milk instead of the traditional cream to add a richer and more complex flavor.

steps.text: Place the sugar in a heavy-bottomed pot.
Pour the water around the sides of the sugar. The goal is to prevent sugar crystals from sticking to the sides of the pot.
Set the pot over medium heat. Stir gently every so often until the sugar is dissolved. Once the sugar is completely dissolved, do not stir any more.
Bring the sugar syrup to a boil. Cook, brushing the sides of the pot with water if any sugar crystals build up, until the syrup becomes an amber caramel.
Remove the pot from the heat, and gradually stir in the warmed goat milk. The mixture may curdle or separate slightly—this is okay and can be fixed later.
Return the pot to medium heat, and cook until the sauce reaches 230°F (110°C). This evaporates excess water from the goat milk. Be careful not to let the sauce bubble too high.
Remove the pot from the heat, and let cool until it is warm but you can safely touch it.
If the caramel sauce has split or curdled, transfer it to a blender. Blend well until the mixture is smooth.
Season the caramel to taste with salt, then cool completely.

recipes.title: Nigerian suya
recipes.description: Skewered beef thinly sliced, coated in a bold yaji spice mix with peanuts and chili, and grilled over charcoal. Served hot with onions and tomatoes.

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons ground peanuts or peanut powder
ingredients.name: orzeszki ziemne mielone

steps.text: Slice meat thinly (usually beef).
Mix yaji (ground peanuts, chili, ginger, garlic, onion, salt, seasoning).
Coat the meat with oil and the spice mix; let it rest briefly.
Skewer the meat and add more spice.
Grill over charcoal, turning often, until cooked and slightly charred.
Serve hot with onions, tomatoes, and extra spice.

recipes.title: Chocolate Sandesh
recipes.description: Indyjski deser z twarogu paneer z kakao i wanilią, formowany w kulki i schładzany.

steps.text: Combine paneer and sugar substitute, and mash together well.
Add cream, cocoa powder, and vanilla essence. Mix well.
Divide into 8 equal parts and shape into balls.
Refrigerate for at least 1 hour and serve.

categories: Recipes using vegetable broth and stock

recipes.title: Garbanzo Bean Stew
recipes.description: Wegetariańskie danie z ciecierzycy, ziemniaków i ryżu w pomidorowo-paprykowym sosie z szafranem i sherry.

ingredients.text: 1 red bell pepper, peeled, cored and chopped
ingredients.name: papryka czerwona

ingredients.text: ½ pound new or boiling potatoes, unpeeled and cut into bite-sized chunks
ingredients.name: ziemniak
ingredients.note: unpeeled and cut into bite-sized chunks

ingredients.text: 2 teaspoons smoked sweet paprika (such as Pimenton de la Vera)
ingredients.name: papryka słodka wędzona
ingredients.note: such as Pimenton de la Vera

ingredients.text: 2 cups cooked chickpeas (garbanzo beans), drained or 1 can (15 ounces) chickpeas, rinsed and drained
ingredients.name: ciecierzyca
ingredients.note: cooked, drained or 1 can (15 ounces) rinsed and drained

ingredients.text: 1 can (14½ ounces) diced tomatoes plus their liquid
ingredients.name: pomidory krojone z puszki

steps.text: In a Dutch Oven or large soup pot, heat oil over medium heat.
Sauté onion, red pepper, garlic, saffron, and potatoes, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes start to soften, about 15 minutes.
Stir in paprika, then sherry and cook about 1 minute.
Add chickpeas, tomatoes, stock, salt and pepper.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and cook partially covered until potatoes are tender and stew thickens, 30–40 minutes.
Remove from heat and let stand about 15 minutes to meld flavors and thicken slightly.
To serve, make a pyramid of rice in the center of each of 4 bowls, then ladle hot stew around rice.
Garnish with parsley, if desired.

recipes.title: Çılbır (Turkish Eggs with Yogurt)
recipes.description: Poached eggs served on garlic yogurt and topped with paprika butter.

steps.text: In a small mixing bowl, combine the yogurt, garlic and salt.
Add the vinegar and some salt to boiling water, and poach the eggs.
Remove the eggs with a slotted spoon and place an egg in each dish.
Cover the eggs with plenty of yogurt.
Melt the butter in a small skillet.
Stir in the paprika, and pour the hot butter over the eggs.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Heinz Burger Sauce
recipes.description: A classic recipe by the Heinz corporation, this sauce will go great with any burger and it's easy to make to boot.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in a bowl.
Let sit for 30 minutes to allow flavors to blend together.

recipes.title: Habas con Jamon (Broad Beans with Ham)
recipes.description: Broad beans sautéed with onion and ham in olive oil.

ingredients.text: 2 strips of ham or bacon (or vegetarian bacon)
ingredients.name: szynka
ingredients.note: strips of ham or bacon (or vegetarian bacon)

steps.text: Fry onions and ham in a pan with a little olive oil.
Add the broad beans and sauté for a few minutes until the beans are soft.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Mukhbaza
recipes.description: Traditional flatbread associated with the cuisine of Sudan and neighboring regions of Northeast Africa, made from wheat flour, water, yeast and salt.

steps.text: In a large bowl, combine the flour, salt, and yeast.
Gradually add the warm water while mixing to form a soft dough.
Knead the dough for 8–10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Cover the dough and allow it to rise in a warm place for about 1 hour, or until doubled in size.
Divide the dough into small portions and shape each into a flat round.
Heat a griddle or heavy frying pan over medium heat.
Lightly brush the surface with oil.
Cook each flatbread for 2–3 minutes on each side until lightly browned and cooked through.
Remove from heat and keep warm until serving.

recipes.title: Kerala Pachadi (Coconut Mango Condiment)
recipes.description: Pachadi is a type of condiment.

steps.text: Peel and cut the mango into small pieces. Mix with salt and set aside.
Grind the coconut with water and 2 of the dried chilies until well-blended.
Add the coconut-chili mixture to the mango, and mix well.
Heat oil in a kadai; add the mustard and remaining dried chilies, and fry.
Pour into the mango coconut mixture, and cook briefly.
Serve with plain rice.

recipes.title: Gochujang (imitation)
recipes.description: A non-traditional chili paste meant to replace gochujang when none is available.

steps.text: Mix ingredients together thoroughly.
Refrigerate any leftover portions.

recipes.title: Thai Grilled Chicken II
recipes.description: Grilled chicken marinated in soy sauce, garlic, cayenne pepper flakes, honey and lime juice.

ingredients.text: 1 ¼ pounds (4 ea.) boneless chicken breast halves
ingredients.name: pierś z kurczaka

steps.text: Prepare grill.
Place chicken in shallow dish.
Combine soy sauce, garlic and pepper flakes in measuring cup.
Pour over chicken, turning to coat.
Let stand 10 minutes.
Combine honey and lime juice in small bowl until blended. Set aside.
Place chicken on grid over medium coals.
Brush with some marinade remaining in dish. Discard remaining marinade.
Cover, and grill for 5 minutes.
Brush chicken with half of honey mixture, turn, and brush with remaining mixture.
Grill until chicken is fully cooked.

categories: Recipes using beef broth and stock

recipes.title: Strip Steaks with Pepper Cream Reduction
recipes.description: This dish of strip steaks is great on a steak or over pasta.

ingredients.text: 2 ea. (12–16 ounces) 1 inch-thick New York strip steaks
ingredients.name: stek wołowy polędwica

steps.text: Season each steak with salt and a pinch of cracked pepper on both sides. Set aside.
Melt butter with olive oil in a stainless steel skillet (don't use nonstick) over medium-high heat.
Add steaks and cook 4–5 minutes per side for medium rare, 6–7 minutes for medium, and 8–9 minutes for toast.
Remove steaks from pan and keep warm.
Pour out pan drippings but do not scrape browned bits off. Deglaze pan with broth and bring to a boil over high heat until reduced by ⅔.
Add remaining ingredients and remaining pepper. Bring to a boil and cook until reduced to ½ cup.
Drizzle sauce over steaks and serve warm.

recipes.title: Homemade Garam Masala
recipes.description: Domowa mieszanka przypraw garam masala z suszonych liści laurowych, kardamonu, cynamonu, goździków, kolendry, kminu, kopru włoskiego, gałki muszkatołowej, pieprzu i imbiru.

ingredients.text: 20 sticks cinnamon, about 2.5 cm in length
ingredients.name: laska cynamonu

steps.text: Individually toast all the whole spices and herbs in a dry skillet over low heat, shaking, until a shade darker and aromatic. Make sure not to burn.
Remove from the heat, transfer to a cool container, and let cool.
Using a grinder, blender, or mortar, grind/pound all the herbs and spices together to make an even powder.

recipes.title: Egyptian Tomato Salad
recipes.description: Simple and refreshing salad that celebrates the vibrant flavours of ripe tomatoes, with a tangy lemon dressing and aromatic herbs.

steps.text: In a mixing bowl, combine the sliced tomatoes, thinly sliced red onion, diced cucumber, fresh parsley, and fresh mint. Toss gently to combine.
In a separate small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper to create the dressing.
Pour the dressing over the tomato salad and toss gently to coat the ingredients evenly.
Taste the salad and adjust the seasoning according to your preference, adding more salt, pepper, or lemon juice if desired.
Allow the salad to sit at room temperature for about 15–20 minutes to allow the flavors to meld together.
Serve the salad as a refreshing side dish to complement a variety of main courses or as part of a mezze spread.

recipes.title: Garum (Boiled)
recipes.description: Garum is a traditional Roman fermented fish sauce or condiment, used as a condiment or sauce on its own, an additive to sauces, or as a seasoning.

ingredients.text: 1 sextarius (2 ⅓ cup/546 mL) anchovies or other fatty fish
ingredients.name: anchois

steps.text: Add anchovies and wine to a pot.
Boil the mixture until thick.
Strain the fluid through a sieve, and bottle for future use.

recipes.title: Ghee III
recipes.description: Clarified butter (ghee) made from margarine and unsalted butter, with optional smoked wood and roasted fenugreek for flavor.

ingredients.text: Hardwood of grape vine or hickory wood (optional)
ingredients.name: drewno winorośli lub hikory

ingredients.text: 1 Tbsp fenugreek seeds (optional), roasted and powdered
ingredients.name: nasiona kozieradki

steps.text: Combine the margarine and butter in a saucepan over medium heat.
Melt and bring to a boil.
Strain the mixture using a fine strainer.
Mix in the semolina.
If using, place a smoking piece of grapevine wood or hickory wood in an empty sealed jar.
Add the butter, margarine, and fenugreek.

recipes.title: Desert Rubbed Strip Steaks
recipes.description: Steki z polędwicy wołowej (New York strip) z suchą przyprawą z kminku, kolendry, rozmarynu, chili, soli, pieprzu i imbiru, grillowane.

ingredients.text: 4 ea. (24–32 ounces) New York strip steaks, 1–1¼ inches thick
ingredients.name: stek wołowy

steps.text: Brush steak with olive oil.
Set aside.
Combine seasonings in a small bowl.
Pat mixture into both sides of steaks and refrigerate as long as possible.
Preheat kettle grill with a chimney starter.
Add steaks and cook about 4–5 minutes per side for medium rare, or to desired doneness.
Remove steaks to a plate and cover tightly with aluminum foil.
Let rest about 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Maple-Glazed BBQ Ribs
recipes.description: Maple syrup and pork just sort of seem to be made for each other.

steps.text: Combine seasonings and rub on pork ribs.
Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Place hickory chunks into a 350°F (175˚C) smoker or a charcoal grill set for indirect heat at 350°F.
Combine liquid ingredients and bring to a boil over high heat until reduced by half.
Place ribs in smoker/grill and cook, basting often with maple syrup mixture, for 3–4 hours.
Brush ribs with remaining mixture and place on a medium high grill until well browned.
Rest 15 minutes; serve.

recipes.title: Fermented Soda
recipes.description: Gazowany napój otrzymywany przez fermentację z użyciem gotowego ekstraktu i drożdży lub ziaren kefirowych.

ingredients.text: ⅛ tsp (0.625 ml) champagne yeast or 2 tsp (10 ml) kefir grains
ingredients.name: drożdże szampańskie lub ziarna kefirowe

steps.text: Sterilize all your equipment before beginning.
Combine all of the ingredients in a container suitable for fermentation. Note that gas will be produced during the fermentation.
Put the container in a warm place, and allow it to ferment for 3 days.
If desired, strain the finished product. Store in the fridge.

recipes.title: Faina (Chickpea Flatbread)
recipes.description: Faina is a type of flatbread made with chickpea flour. It can be eaten plain or with a slice of pizza, called pizza a caballo.

steps.text: Mix chickpea flour, wheat flour, salt and water in a bowl. Beat slowly with a wire whisk; alternatively, you may mix in a food processor. Add 2 tbsp oil.
Place some oil in a round baking dish (approx 45 cm in diameter) and preheat this in the oven for a few minutes. Remove dish from oven and pour the faina mixture into the hot dish.
Place back into the oven for about 20 minutes, until the upper crust is golden, and the edges are dry (they should have a fried appearance).
Remove from the oven, and let rest for 2–3 minutes. Sprinkle with pepper and cut into wedges.

recipes.title: Crullers (Round)
recipes.description: Ring-shaped fritters made from choux pastry, deep fried and iced with thin confectioners' sugar icing.

ingredients.text: 1 cup (240 ml) sifted all purpose flour
ingredients.name: mąka pszenna

ingredients.text: Thin icing made from confectioners' sugar
ingredients.name: lukier z cukru pudru

steps.text: Combine sugar, salt, shortening, and boiling water in a saucepan. Mix and bring to a rapid boil.
Mix in flour all at once, and cook until thickened, stirring constantly. Remove from heat.
Cool dough slightly. Beat in eggs one at a time, beating thoroughly after each addition. Add vanilla.
Transfer the dough to a pastry bag fitted with a medium-large round tip. Pipe dough into rings on greased parchment paper.
Heat enough fat for deep frying to 375°F (195°C).
Carefully turn parchment paper upside down so crullers will drop into fat. Deep fry until golden brown all over, flipping to cook both sides.
Remove crullers from fat, and place on paper towels to drain and cool.
Ice crullers with thin confectioners' sugar icing.

recipes.title: Saj Bread II
recipes.description: Cienki chleb płaski pieczony na rozgrzanej blasze saj.

steps.text: Mix ingredients and knead thoroughly.
Cover the dough and let rest for about 30 minutes.
Once again knead the dough, and divide into smaller portions.
Roll out each portion over a flat surface with a rolling pin. The surface should be sprinkled with flour to prevent sticking.
Take up rolled-out dough with a wooden rod and apply it to heated griddle. Turn over and bake on reverse side.
Remove and let cool. Fold and store.

recipes.title: Orange Soda III
recipes.description: Orange soda is a sweetened, carbonated beverage flavored with orange.

ingredients.text: 1 tsp (5 mL) 150+ proof unflavored spirit OR a mixture of ½ tsp (2.5 mL) gum arabic with ½ tsp (2.5 mL) water
ingredients.name: spirytus bezsmakowy 150 proof
ingredients.note: OR a mixture of ½ tsp (2.5 mL) gum arabic with ½ tsp (2.5 mL) water

ingredients.text: ½ cup (120 mL) carrot powder OR a mixture of 24 drops of red food coloring and 24 drops of yellow food coloring
ingredients.name: proszek z marchewki
ingredients.note: OR a mixture of 24 drops of red food coloring and 24 drops of yellow food coloring

steps.text: Combine the spirit or gum arabic water and oils together in a small cup, mixing well.
Set aside.
Transfer this mixture into a larger container.
Put the carrot powder or coloring, citric acid, water, and white sugar into the container. Stir well.
To make the finished soda, combine 1 volume of syrup with 5 volumes of carbonated water.

recipes.title: Garlic and Tarragon Dressing
recipes.description: A simple salad dressing.

steps.text: In a small bowl or jar with a tight-fitting lid, combine vinegar, oil, garlic salt, sugar and tarragon.
Pour it on lettuce or cabbage salads.

recipes.title: Soft Spice Cookie
recipes.description: Miękkie ciasteczka przyprawowe, wariant miękkich ciasteczek cukrowych oparty na przepisie na ciasto przyprawowe.

steps.text: In a large bowl, beat eggs lightly to break the yolks as one would for scrambled eggs, then mix in the shortening. If using butter, soften it slightly beforehand by heating it a little. The shortening/egg mixture should be loose.
Mix in the sugar, then add the salt to the liquid mixture.
Mix in vanilla extract, lemon extract, coffee, cinnamon, nutmeg, and cocoa powder.

Add the baking powder, then slowly add the flour as needed to reach a proper doughy state (in essence, able to be shaped without sticking to one's hands too much). You may not need all of the flour, or you may even need a little more based on your eggs and how closely you measured.
Make balls and place onto a greased or parchment-lined pan.
Top each cookie with a generous amount of cinnamon-sugar.
Bake in a 175°C (350°F) oven for between 15-20 minutes.

recipes.title: Sweet Rice II
recipes.description: Słodki ryż z szafranem, rodzynkami i migdałami, gotowany w garnku.

ingredients.text: ¼–½ cup slivered almonds, toasted if desired
ingredients.name: migdały

steps.text: Wash rice, and transfer to a pot.
Add enough water to cover rice with water equal to the depth of the rice.
Add salt, saffron, sugar, and raisins.
Cook over high heat until water disappears and steam is rising from holes in the surface of the rice.
Reduce heat to warm. Add almonds.
Cover tightly and let stand for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Quick Sparkling Lemonade
recipes.description: A quick, fizzy lemonade made from carbonated water, sugar and lemonade-flavored drink mix.

ingredients.text: 7 cups (1.7 liters/1.8 quarts) cold carbonated water
ingredients.name: woda gazowana

ingredients.text: 1 package of lemonade-flavored Kool-Aid, or similar powdered drink mix
ingredients.name: napój w proszku o smaku lemoniady

steps.text: Pour the carbonated water into a 2-quart pitcher.
Add sugar and Kool-Aid or drink mix.
Stir thoroughly.
Serve chilled over ice, if desired.

recipes.title: Sindhi Spiced Fish
recipes.description: Ryba z Sindhu zapiekana z jogurtową masą cebulową i przyprawami.

steps.text: Shallow fry the fish on one side, then transfer it to a pan fried-side down.
Combine yogurt, onions, coriander leaves, green chile, coriander powder, cumin powder, salt, and tamarind paste.
Spread the yogurt mixture over the fish. Bake until golden.
Serve with chapatis.

recipes.title: Sindhi Chickpea Confection
recipes.description: Słodka potrawa z mąki z ciecierzycy, masła klarowanego i cukru, posypana orzechami.

steps.text: Heat the ghee in a pan.
Add the gram flour, and stir until toasted.
Remove from the heat, and stir in the sugar.
Return to the heat, and stir until the sugar melts.
Transfer mixture to a bowl, and garnish with nuts.
Serve hot or cold.

recipes.title: Cheese Ravioli Filling
recipes.description: A simple cheese filling for ravioli made with ricotta or cottage cheese, Parmigiano Reggiano, onion, egg and salt.

steps.text: Stir all the ingredients together in a bowl.
Set aside while you roll the dough.

recipes.title: Honey Apple Marinade
recipes.description: This marinade and pork were made to go together!

ingredients.text: ½ tsp freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: pieprz czarny mielony

steps.text: Mix everything together.
Keep refrigerated for up to 3 weeks.

recipes.title: Tagine
recipes.description: Traditional North African slow-cooked stew of meat, vegetables and spices, named after the clay pot used for cooking it.

ingredients.name: mięso z kurczaka, jagnięciny lub wołowiny

steps.text: Heat olive oil in a pot or tagine dish.
Add onions and garlic and sauté until soft.
Add the meat and fry lightly until it changes colour.
Add spices, salt, and pepper, then stir well.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook for a few minutes.
Pour in water or stock and cover.
Allow to simmer on low heat until the meat becomes tender.
Add carrots, potatoes, olives, or dried fruits if using.
Continue cooking slowly until the sauce becomes thick.
Remove from heat and serve hot.

recipes.title: Milk Toast II
recipes.description: Milk toast to śniadaniowe danie z grzankami zanurzonymi w gorącym mleku z sosem mącznym, popularne dawniej jako pokarm łagodny dla dzieci i chorych.

steps.text: Gradually add cold water to flour to make a smooth, thin paste.
Add paste to milk, stirring constantly until thickened.
Cover, and cook 20 minutes; then, add salt and butter in small pieces.
Dip slices of toast separately in sauce; when soft, remove to serving dish.
Pour remaining sauce over all.

recipes.title: Boxty (Irish Potato Cakes)
recipes.description: Variant of the traditional Irish fried potato cakes recipe.

steps.text: Take half of the potatoes and wash, peel, chunk, and boil them.
Mash the boiled potatoes with milk and 1 tablespoon butter and set them aside.
Grate the other pound of (raw) potatoes into a strong cloth.
Squeeze cloth to remove all possible liquid from the raw potatoes.
Mix together the grated potatoes, the mashed potatoes, baking soda, buttermilk, flour, and black pepper (to taste).
Stir thoroughly to combine.
Warm nonstick griddle or skillet over medium heat and melt butter.
Pour potato cakes on griddle, ¼ cup at a time.
Fry until edges are soft and cake is bubbling.
Cook on other side.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Orzo Salad
recipes.description: This pasta salad made with orzo is brightly flavored, lemon-forward, and colorful—perfect for anything from the dinner table to the picnic blanket.

steps.text: Bring a large pot of water to a boil with the turmeric.
Stir in the pasta, and boil until it is cooked to your taste.
Drain the pasta in a colander, and rinse briefly with cold water. Let drain.
Combine the capers, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, pepper and sugar in a jar. Seal the lid and shake well to combine and make the dressing.
Transfer the drained orzo to a large bowl, and pour the dressing over the pasta. Toss well to coat.
Add the parsley, sundried tomatoes, olives, and feta. Toss to combine.
Serve warm or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Teurgoule (Norman Cinnamon Rice Pudding)
recipes.description: Teurgoule is a cinnamon-flavoured rice pudding that is a speciality of Normandy.

steps.text: Preheat your oven to 150°C (thermostat 2).
Mix the sugar, milk, rice, salt, and cinnamon in a terrine bowl.
Put the mix in the oven for 5 hours while making sure no one opens the oven door.
The rice must absorb approximately three-quarters of the milk and must be covered by a brown skin.
Let the pudding cool down and serve at room temperature.

recipes.title: Quick Sourdough Starter
recipes.description: A quick sourdough starter made with commercial instant yeast, useful for Amish friendship bread.

ingredients.text: 1 small package (0.25 ounces / 7 grams) instant dry yeast
ingredients.name: drożdże suszone
ingredients.note: small package (0.25 ounces), instant dry yeast

steps.text: Mix all ingredients in a bowl until smooth.
Cover the bowl and place in a warm place (~70–80 °F / 20–27 °C). It should begin making some small bubbles within an hour or two (the timing depends mainly on how cold the milk is).
Proceed as directed for "Day 1" of your sourdough recipe.

recipes.title: Green Spinach Food Coloring
recipes.description: Homemade food coloring that gets its green color from spinach.

steps.text: Blanch the spinach by boiling in a large volume of water for 2 minutes (until bright green) then draining and quickly transferring to cold water.
Let the spinach rest 1–2 minutes.
Drain the spinach and blend it to a purée with the ½ cup (125 ml) water.
Using a cheesecloth, strain the purée into a bowl to extract the juice.
Pour the juice into a pan and add sugar.
Turn the heat to medium-high, and stir to dissolve the sugar.
Skim off and discard any foam that collects at the surface of the liquid.
Turn the heat to high and boil until the liquid reduces to a single-thread consistency.
Turn off the heat and stir in the lemon juice.
Cool slightly, then pour into an airtight jar and cool completely.

recipes.title: North Carolina-Style BBQ Ribs
recipes.description: Żeberka wieprzowe w stylu północnej Karoliny, wędzone lub pieczone na grillu na niskim ogniu i polewane mieszanką octu jabłkowego z miodem.

steps.text: Season ribs with Rib Rub and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Combine remaining ingredients and place in a spray bottle.
Place ribs in a 250°F smoker or a charcoal grill set for indirect heat at 250°F.
Cook for 5–6 hours, spraying often with vinegar mixture.
Spray heavily with vinegar mixture and place on a high grill, turning and spraying constantly until well browned.
Remove and let rest 15 minutes; serve.

recipes.title: Homemade Phyllo Dough
recipes.description: Phyllo dough is a simple dough, based primarily on flour and water, that is rolled out extremely thin and layered to make flaky baked goods.

steps.text: Mix all the ingredients using a mixer with a dough hook or your hands. Mix until you get a smooth, elastic but not sticky dough.
Let the dough rest for a few hours, preferably in the fridge wrapped in plastic.

Cut into small pieces. Flatten each piece using a pasta maker. Follow the same procedure of your machine as for pasta: pass it several times in the machine size 1, folding it in two until you get a nicely shaped dough. Then increment each time the size on the machine until you reached the desired size.
You can alternatively use a rolling pin with a lot of courage. The dough should be extremely thin.

recipes.title: Zalabiyeh (Sweet Fritters) II
recipes.description: Fritters made from matzah meal, eggs and water, fried in oil.

steps.text: Combine the salt and matzah meal in a bowl.
Add 4 cups of water and mix thoroughly.
Add another 2½–3 cups of water and mix thoroughly.
Add eggs, continuing to mix ingredients until left with a consistent batter.
If batter is too thin, let it rest for 7–10 minutes until it thickens.
Wet your hands with water, and form the dough into round, flat patties by using a moistened plate as a working base.
Fry patties in a skillet with oil.

recipes.title: Kek Batik (Malaysian Tiffin)
recipes.description: A no-bake Malaysian chocolate tiffin made with biscuits and cereal bound in a cocoa and condensed milk mixture.

ingredients.text: 2 packets Marie Biscuits, broken into quarters
ingredients.name: herbatniki Marie

steps.text: Melt the butter in a saucepan over low heat. Whisk in the Milo chocolate powder, cocoa powder, and condensed milk.
Mix in the eggs and water. Cook, stirring, until thickened.
Remove from the heat, and stir in the biscuit pieces and cereal flakes so everything is well coated with the chocolate mixture.
Transfer the mixture into a mold (e.g. cake pan, aluminum tin, tupperware) that has been lined with parchment or plastic.
Tap the mold a few times on a hard surface to even everything out.
Let cool completely, then unmold and cut into slices.

recipes.title: Jamaican Jerk Spice II
recipes.description: Jamaican jerk spice is a pungent, hot mixture of spices used to flavor meats before grilling or roasting.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients.
Store in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Potato-Almond Milk
recipes.description: Potato milk is an alternative non-dairy drink that can be used instead of milk.

steps.text: Pre-soak your almonds in water for 1 hour and then drain.
Cut potatoes into 5 cm chunks. Place the chunks into a saucepan with enough water to fully cover them.
Bring the saucepan to a simmer over high heat, and simmer for around 15 minutes until tender.
Drain the potatoes. Transfer to a blender with the almonds, vanilla, maple syrup, and salt. Add the water, and blend until smooth on a high speed, adding more water as necessary.
Stretch the cheesecloth over a large bowl, and pour your mixture into it. Use a fork to agitate as needed, and let the milk drain through.
When strained, taste the milk. Adjust by adding more water, vanilla, salt, or maple syrup as needed, depending on your taste.
Chill and serve, shaking the mixture beforehand.

recipes.title: Xarém (Porridge dish)
recipes.description: A thick corn flour porridge or soup from Algarve, Portugal, traditionally made with clams and also eaten in Cape Verde and Brazil.

ingredients.text: 4 cups fish stock, chicken stock, or water
ingredients.name: bulion rybny, drobiowy lub woda
ingredients.note: fish stock, chicken stock, or water

ingredients.text: 100 g chouriço or smoked sausage, sliced
ingredients.name: kiełbasa wędzona

steps.text: Rinse the clams thoroughly and discard any damaged shells.
Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Cook the bacon until lightly browned.
Add the sausage and cook for 2–3 minutes.
Stir in the onion and cook until softened.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the white wine and add the bay leaf.
Add the clams, cover the pot, and cook until the shells open.
Remove the clams and set aside.
Strain the cooking liquid and return it to the pot.
Add the stock or water and bring to a boil.
Gradually add the cornmeal while stirring continuously to prevent lumps.
Reduce the heat and cook for 20–25 minutes, stirring frequently.
Return the clams, bacon, and sausage to the pot.
Stir in the coriander.
Season with salt and black pepper.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Kik Alicha (Yellow Split Pea Stew)
recipes.description: Kik alicha is a comforting and flavorful Ethiopian split pea stew, made with yellow split peas simmered in a mild and aromatic sauce. This vegetarian stew is a staple in Ethiopian cuisine.

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons niter kibbeh (Ethiopian spiced clarified butter) or regular butter/oil
ingredients.name: niter kibbeh

ingredients.text: Fresh cilantro or parsley, chopped, for garnish
ingredients.name: kolendra świeża

steps.text: Rinse the yellow split peas under cold water in a strainer to remove any dirt or debris. Drain in a strainer.
In a medium-sized pot, combine the rinsed split peas, chopped onion, minced garlic, grated ginger, niter kibbeh, turmeric, cumin, paprika, and salt.
Add enough water to cover the split peas by about an inch.

Bring the pot to a boil over medium-high heat. Reduce the heat to low, cover with a lid, and simmer for about 35–40 minutes, or until the split peas are tender and cooked through. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking. If needed, add additional water during cooking to maintain the desired consistency.
Taste the stew and adjust the seasoning with salt, if necessary.
Remove from heat and let the stew rest for a few minutes to allow the flavors to meld together.
Garnish with freshly chopped cilantro or parsley. Serve hot as a main course or as part of a traditional Ethiopian meal, accompanied by injera (Ethiopian flatbread) or rice.

recipes.title: Prepared White Mustard
recipes.description: Domowa musztarda z białych nasion gorczycy, z żółtkami jaj, czosnkiem, mąką pełnoziarnistą i miodem.

ingredients.text: ½ cup natural apple vinegar or wine vinegar
ingredients.name: ocet jabłkowy
ingredients.note: natural apple vinegar or wine vinegar

ingredients.text: 4 tbsp honey, treacle, or date syrup
ingredients.name: miód

steps.text: Toast mustard seeds in a skillet without oil.
Let cool.
Pound the seeds with a mortar and pestle.
Crush the boiled yolks, and add to ground mustard seeds.
Crush the garlic and add to the mixture.
Toast the flour in a skillet without oil and add to the mixture.
Mix in vinegar, salt, and honey.

recipes.title: Nigerian Okra Soup (Ila Asepo)
recipes.description: Okra soup, known as Ila Asepo in Yoruba, is one of the oldest and most widely eaten soups in Nigeria. Made from finely cut or blended okra pods, it is a draw soup prized for its thick, viscous texture and deep savoury flavour.

ingredients.text: 500 grams fresh okra pods, finely sliced or blended
ingredients.name: okra

ingredients.text: 700 grams assorted meat (beef, shaki, ponmo, cow leg)
ingredients.name: wołowina
ingredients.note: assorted meat (beef, shaki, ponmo, cow leg)

steps.text: Season 700 grams assorted meat (beef, shaki, ponmo, cow leg) with diced 1 onion, 1 of 2 seasoning cubes, and a pinch of 1 teaspoons salt.
Add 200 grams stockfish (panla), soaked and cleaned midway through cooking.
Cook on medium heat until tender.
Reserve the meat stock.
Heat 0.3 cups palm oil in a pot on medium heat.
Add 1 tablespoons iru (locust bean) and stir well.
Add blended or crushed 3 scotch bonnet pepper (rodo).
Fry the pepper in the palm oil for 5–7 minutes until the rawness is gone.
Pour reserved meat stock into the pot.
Add cooked 700 grams assorted meat (beef, shaki, ponmo, cow leg), 200 grams stockfish (panla), soaked and cleaned, and 150 grams smoked fish, deboned.
Add 3 tablespoons ground crayfish and remaining 2 seasoning cubes.
Stir well and simmer on medium heat for 10 minutes.
Add the finely sliced or blended 500 grams fresh okra pods into the pot.
Stir gently to combine.
Cook on medium heat for 5–7 minutes only, do not overcook.
Taste and adjust 1 teaspoons salt.
The soup should be thick, green-tinged, and draw when lifted.
Serve hot with pounded yam (iyán), eba, amala, fufu, or starch.

recipes.title: Hartshorne Catsup for Sea-stores II
recipes.description: A historic English catsup made from anchovies, shallots, horseradish and spices, boiled with wine and water and strained.

steps.text: Combine anchovies, shallots, horseradish, mace, wine, water, lemon, anchovy liquor, cloves, and peppercorns in a saucepan.
Boil until reduced to 1 quart, then strain and cool.

recipes.title: Cassava Pone
recipes.description: Cassava pone is a dessert originating in the Caribbean.

ingredients.text: 3 lbs (1.36 kg) raw cassava, peeled and grated
ingredients.name: maniok

ingredients.text: ½ tsp (2.5 ml) ground black pepper
ingredients.name: pieprz czarny

ingredients.text: 4 tbsp (60 ml) melted butter or coconut oil
ingredients.name: masło

ingredients.text: 3 cups (720 ml) unsweetened evaporated milk or coconut milk
ingredients.name: mleko odtłuszczone
ingredients.note: unsweetened evaporated milk or coconut milk

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C).
Combine all the ingredients together, mixing well to incorporate.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish.
Bake the cassava pone for 60 minutes until firm and golden.

recipes.title: Wine-Roasted Pork Roast
recipes.description: A boneless pork loin roast browned and slowly cooked in red wine with onion over a campfire.

steps.text: Heat olive oil in 10-inch Dutch oven over campfire.
Rub seasoning on roast.
Add roast to Dutch oven, turning to brown on all sides.
Add onion, sauté 5 minutes.
Pour wine over roast.
Cover and cook slowly for three hours over fire.

recipes.title: Rajma (Sindhi Kidney Bean Curry)
recipes.description: Sindhi curry of red kidney beans cooked with onion, tomato, chiles and spices.

steps.text: Soak kidney beans in water overnight. Drain.
Cover the beans with water, and add the baking soda. Boil briskly for at least 30 minutes until tender. Drain, reserving 100 g of the cooking water.
Fry the onions in a pan until golden brown.
Add the tomatoes and chiles, and fry until it leaves the oil.
Add the beans and reserved cooking water, and cook for 5–10 minutes.
Stir in salt and chili powder.
Remove from the heat, and mix in the garam masala and pepper.
Serve hot with roti or rice.

recipes.title: Veggie Pizza
recipes.description: This veggie mini-pizza is a spin on pizza Margherita, providing a wider array of nutrients and flavors.

ingredients.text: 1 pre-made pizza crust, rolled to 30 cm (12 inches) across
ingredients.name: ciasto na pizzę cienkie

ingredients.text: ½ ea. green bell pepper, de-seeded and thinly sliced
ingredients.name: papryka zielona

ingredients.text: ½ cup thinly sliced baby bella mushrooms
ingredients.name: pieczarka brązowa

ingredients.text: 4½ tbsp pitted and sliced black olives
ingredients.name: oliwka czarna

steps.text: Preheat oven to 240° C (450° F / Gas 9).
Brush the dough surface with olive oil.
Ladle the sauce over the dough, spreading it evenly.
Distribute the cheeses evenly over the crust.

Lay the toppings evenly over the cheese. If needed, press toppings down with a utensil to provide clearance from the oven ceiling. If desired, top the vegetables with extra cheese and sauce to hold vegetables down.
Bake pizza in oven until crust edges are deep dark brown (roughly 15 minutes for pre-made crust, much longer for freshly made dough).
Take pizza out of oven and let cool.

recipes.title: Quail Egg and Chili Jangjorim
recipes.description: Jangjorim is a Korean dish of boiled or braised beef in soy sauce; this version uses quail eggs instead.

steps.text: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add the quail eggs and boil for about 10 minutes.
Carefully drain the eggs and cool them in cold water.
Peel the cooled eggs.
Combine the water, soy sauce, sugar, wine, garlic and ginger in a saucepan. Bring to a boil.
Add the eggs to the pot and simmer until the liquid is reduced by half.
Add the peppers and cook just for 1-2 minutes.

recipes.title: Coconut Biscuits
recipes.description: Biscuits made from whipped egg whites, caster sugar and desiccated coconut, baked until light brown.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 150 C.
Whip the egg whites in a mixing bowl until soft peaks form.
Add sugar gradually, whipping until stiff peaks form.
Fold in the coconut until combined.
Form the dough into pyramids. Cover each pyramid with baking parchment and place them on a baking tray.
Bake for 15 minutes until they are colored light brown.
Uncover the biscuits and leave them to cool.

recipes.title: Chipotle Dip
recipes.description: This is great as a dip to spice up garlic bread, or a spread on burger buns.

steps.text: Pulse everything except chips in a blender until smooth.
Serve with chips.

recipes.title: Coconut Rum-Battered Shrimp
recipes.description: Krewetki w kokosie, marynowane w rumie z przyprawami i smażone w głębokim tłuszczu.

ingredients.text: 24 large (15/20) shrimp, peeled, deveined, and butterflied
ingredients.name: krewetka

ingredients.text: Sweetened shredded coconut, or shredded fresh coconut
ingredients.name: kokos wiórki

steps.text: Combine rum and seasonings. Pour over shrimp and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, 8 hours for most (the alcohol will cook it after that).
Dredge shrimp in coconut. Let rest at room temperature 2–3 minutes.
Heat oil to 350°F. Fry shrimp 6 at a time 3 minutes.
Drain on a cooling rack above a sheet pan.
Squeeze some lemon juice over and serve warm.

recipes.title: Panocha (Sprouted Wheat Pudding)
recipes.description: A sweet pudding of sprouted wheat flour and all-purpose flour cooked with caramelized butter and sugar.

steps.text: Combine the flours and salt.
Melt the butter in a medium pot, then stir in the sugar. Let caramelize gently over low heat.
Carefully whisk in the boiling water, then the flour mixture. Make sure to stir until free of lumps.
Cook over low heat for 2–3 hours.

recipes.title: Macaroni and Cheese II
recipes.description: A simple macaroni and cheese made with elbow pasta, a milk and grated cheese sauce, butter, egg, and dried herbs.

ingredients.text: ½ cup cheese (of the chef's preference), grated
ingredients.name: ser

ingredients.text: dash of dried parsley and oregano
ingredients.name: pietruszka suszona i oregano suszone
ingredients.note: dash of dried parsley and oregano

steps.text: Fill a pot with water, and add macaroni and salt. Bring to boil, stirring occasionally.
While waiting for the pasta to cook, heat the milk in a pot.
Stir the grated cheese into milk. This should create a basic cheese sauce. If too thin, add more grated cheese; if too thick, add more milk.
When pasta becomes tender (chef's discretion), drain.
Melt the butter in a pot, and stir in the drained macaroni until pasta is completely coated.
Crack the raw egg into the mixture, and stir until completely incorporated.
Add cheese sauce and herbs.
Stir well, and serve hot.

recipes.title: Cherbet Meliana (Algerian Cherry Beverage)
recipes.description: A refreshing Algerian drink from Meliana, traditionally made from cherry juice and sugar syrup.

steps.text: Mix sugar cubes with warm water.
Add cherry juice and broken pits.
Bring to a boil over high heat while skimming until the syrup drips into a thin stream.
Remove from heat and strain.
Bottle.
Serve with sparkling or still water.

recipes.title: Spicy Garlic Oil
recipes.description: This spicy garlic oil is nice for frying chicken, fish, and fries.

ingredients.text: ½ gallon flavorless high smoke point oil, such as canola, peanut, safflower, grapeseed, or soybean
ingredients.name: olej roślinny
ingredients.note: gallon flavorless high smoke point oil, such as canola, peanut, safflower, grapeseed, or soybean

ingredients.text: 8 Thai bird chiles, stemmed and halved
ingredients.name: papryczka chili

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in a large stockpot.
Heat over low heat for 1 hour.
Strain, cool, and store in the refrigerator until oil smells off, looks smoky, or tastes rancid.

recipes.title: Saj Bread III
recipes.description: Cienki turecki chleb płaski (saj) pieczony na rozgrzanej blasze.

steps.text: Mix ingredients and knead thoroughly.
Cover the dough and let rest for about 30 minutes.
Once again knead the dough, and divide into smaller portions.
Roll out each portion over a flat surface with a rolling pin. Surface should be sprinkled with flour to prevent sticking.
Take up rolled-out dough with a wooden rod and apply it to heated griddle. Turn over and cook on the reverse side.
Remove and let cool. Fold and store.

recipes.title: South Side Fizz
recipes.description: A south side fizz is the same as a traditional south side, but with soda water.

steps.text: In a shaker, muddle the mint, lime juice and simple syrup.
Add the gin and fill with ice.
Shake, and strain into a highball glass filled with crushed ice.
Stir until frost appears on the outside of the glass.
Fill with club soda and garnish with another mint sprig.

categories: Recipes using beef broth and stock

recipes.title: Steakhouse Marinade
recipes.description: A marinade for steak, made from beef broth, olive oil, cognac and herbs.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan.
Bring to 190°F for 10 minutes.
Strain, cool and place into a gallon size zip-top bag. Keep refrigerated for up to 1½ weeks.

recipes.title: Isombe na Kariyo (Cassava Leaves with Pumpkin)
recipes.description: A Rwandan dish of tender cassava leaves cooked with sautéed pumpkin, onion and garlic.

steps.text: Remove the tough stems from the cassava leaves, and wash them thoroughly under running water. Chop the leaves into smaller pieces.
In a large pot, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and minced garlic, and sauté until the onion is translucent and fragrant.
Add the diced pumpkin to the pot and cook for about 5 minutes, until it begins to soften.
Add the chopped cassava leaves to the pot and stir well to combine with the pumpkin and onion mixture.
Pour in the water and season with salt and black pepper to taste. Stir again to distribute the ingredients evenly.
Cover the pot and let the mixture simmer for about 30–40 minutes, or until the cassava leaves are tender.
Stir occasionally during cooking, and add more water if needed to prevent sticking and to achieve the desired consistency.
Taste and adjust the seasoning if needed.
Remove from heat and transfer to a serving dish.
Serve hot as a main course or as a side dish with Rwandan staples like ugali or steamed rice.

recipes.title: Country Roast Chicken
recipes.description: A whole roast chicken seasoned with Country Roast Chicken Seasoning, stuffed with thyme, rosemary and lemon, with butter placed under the skin of the breasts.

ingredients.text: 1 ea. (3 lbs) broiler/fryer chicken, giblets removed
ingredients.name: kurczak

ingredients.text: ¼ cup Country Roast Chicken Seasoning
ingredients.name: przyprawa Country Roast Chicken

steps.text: Loosen skin from chicken. Rub flesh with chicken seasoning.
Place lemon slices in the bottom of a roasting pan and place chicken on top.
Stuff chicken cavity with thyme, rosemary, and lemon wedges.
Place 1 tbsp butter under the skin of each breast.
Insert an oven-safe probe thermometer into the breast but not touching the butter.
Bake in a 325°F oven until breast internal temperature reaches 165°F and thigh meat reaches 170°F.
Cover with foil and let rest 10 minutes; serve.

recipes.title: Roast Beef Round with Au Jus
recipes.description: Slow roasted eye of round made tender, served with au jus.

ingredients.text: 1 eye (2 ½ lb) of round roast, trimmed of extra fat
ingredients.name: wołowina, udziec
ingredients.note: 2 ½ lb, trimmed of extra fat

ingredients.text: 1–2 tbsp all-purpose flour, depending on how much drippings you get.
ingredients.name: mąka pszenna
ingredients.note: 1–2, depending on how much drippings you get

steps.text: Coat roast with olive oil on all sides. Combine remaining ingredients and rub into all sides of roast.
Insert a probe thermometer into the center of the roast. Place on a roasting rack in a large (not nonstick) roasting pan and roast at 200°F until the internal temperature reaches 120°F.
Remove roast from pan and heat pan over high heat while oven heats to 500°F.
Add roast to pan and place pan back in oven. Cook until internal temperature reaches 135°F for medium-rare.
Remove roast from pan and keep warm.
Skim fat from pan juices and reserve 1–2 tbsp, depending on how much jus you get. Remove remaining drippings from pan and reserve.
Whisk in flour and heat on 2 burners set on medium high heat. Cook, whisking continuously, until mixture turns light blond.
Add reserved drippings and wine to pan and deglaze. Bring to a boil and cook until reduced by ⅓.
Serve beef warm with au jus.

recipes.title: Modern Reuben Sandwich
recipes.description: A modern take on the Reuben sandwich with corned beef, Swiss cheese, sauerkraut and Thousand Island dressing, grilled on butter-spread bread.

ingredients.text: 12 oz thinly sliced cooked corned beef or deli corned beef or pastrami
ingredients.name: wołowina korned beef
ingredients.note: thinly sliced cooked corned beef or deli corned beef or pastrami

ingredients.text: 8 slices rye or pumpernickel or sourdough bread
ingredients.name: chleb żytni

steps.text: Lightly spread butter on one side of each bread slice.
Heat large non-stick skillet over medium heat until hot.
Place 2 bread slices, butter side down, in skillet.
Top each bread slice with 2 slices cheese, 1 tablespoon dressing, 3 ounces corned beef, and ¼ of the sauerkraut.
Top sandwich with bread slice, butter side up.
Cook sandwiches 4–6 minutes or until bread is golden brown and cheese is melted, turning once.
Repeat with remaining sandwiches.
Serve with additional Thousand Island dressing, if desired.

recipes.title: Tekka (Japanese Root Vegetables in Miso)
recipes.description: Japońska pasta z korzeni warzyw (łopian, lotos, marchew) duszonych w miso z imbirem.

ingredients.text: ⅔ cup chopped greater burdock root
ingredients.name: łopian (korzeń)

steps.text: Heat a pan and pour in the sesame oil.
Add the greater burdock root, and stir-fry for a few minutes.
Add the carrots and the lotus root and stir-fry for a few minutes.
Add miso and ginger. Turn down the heat and allow to cook over a low heat for 4 hours.
Stir frequently until all water has evaporated and until the mixture appears dry and dark.
Allow to cool and keep in a glass jar.

recipes.title: Cucumber and Radish Salad
recipes.description: A very easy salad of chopped cucumber, radishes and green onion dressed with sour cream and salt.

steps.text: Chop cucumbers and radishes into small cubes (about ¼ inch on the side).
Chop green onions.
Combine all of the above in an appropriately sized bowl.
Add sour cream and mix well.
Add salt to taste and mix again.

recipes.title: Garlic Lemon Marinade
recipes.description: This garlic lemon marinade works well with fish and chicken. It can also be used as a sauce to accompany lobster.

steps.text: Process all ingredients in a blender until smooth.
Keep refrigerated for up to 1 ½ weeks. Shake well before using.

recipes.title: Smoked Pork Roast
recipes.description: Boneless pork loin brined in apple cider vinegar and honey, then rubbed with paprika, cayenne and brown sugar and smoked over hickory.

ingredients.text: 1 ea. (4 pounds) boneless pork loin roast, trimmed of excess fat
ingredients.name: schab wieprzowy bez kości
ingredients.note: boneless pork loin roast, trimmed of excess fat

steps.text: Combine salt, honey, and vinegar in a 6-quart container. Add ice, cover, and shake until ice is mostly melted and brine has cooled.
Add pork roast, toss to coat, and weigh down if needed. Refrigerate 3–3.5 hours.
Take roast out of brine; rinse with cold water. Pat dry with paper towels and set aside.
Combine seasonings and sugar. Press into all sides of meat. Set aside.
Preheat smoker to 200°F with the hickory chunks. Add roast, cover, and cook until internal temperature reaches 135°F for medium rare.
Remove to a plate and cover tightly with foil. Let rest 15 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Accra Cassava (Cameroonian Cassava Fritters)
recipes.description: Accra cassava is a popular cassava fritter eaten in Cameroon. It can be eaten as breakfast, lunch, or dinner and is best enjoyed fresh.

ingredients.text: 3 pounds grated cassava (can be frozen and thawed)
ingredients.name: maniok

ingredients.text: A good amount of vegetable oil
ingredients.name: olej roślinny

steps.text: Squeeze the grated cassava using a kitchen cloth or cheesecloth (like the one used for preparing homemade pap) to remove as much liquid as possible. The cassava should be very dry with little liquid.
Mash the bananas well using a fork, masher, or food processor.
Add the cassava and salt to the mashed banana in a medium sized bowl, and mix them together very well. The mixture should be firm enough that it can be rolled into balls.
Use your palms to roll about 2 tablespoons of the mixture into bite-size balls.
Heat the vegetable oil to 375 °F in a deep skillet or a saucepan. You can check the oil temperature by dropping in a 1-inch square of bread—it should take about 1 minute to brown.
Place the cassava balls gently into the hot oil and fry until golden brown. Do not overcrowd the pan—work in batches as necessary.
Remove the fritters from the hot oil, drain, and serve fresh.

recipes.title: Long Island Iced Tea
recipes.description: A mixed cocktail originating in the prohibition era and made popular in New York speakeasies. Despite its name, it contains no tea.

ingredients.text: ¼ part tequila or triple sec
ingredients.name: tekila lub triple sec

ingredients.text: 1 part sweet and sour mix OR lemon/lime juice to taste
ingredients.name: mieszanka sweet and sour
ingredients.note: part; or lemon/lime juice to taste

steps.text: Shake all the ingredients except the cola with ice in a cocktail shaker.
Strain into a highball glass.
Float the cola on the top and serve with a lemon slice.
Fill a highball glass until it's almost full with ice.
Add vodka, gin, rum, and tequila.
Add sweet and sour mix, leaving some room on top.
Splash in the cola and enjoy.

recipes.title: Lamb Kofta
recipes.description: Lamb kofta, a Moroccan-style recipe meant to be cooked over open flame or coals rather than in a pan.

ingredients.text: 3 oz lamb or other solid and flavorful fat (optional), chopped
ingredients.name: tłuszcz jagnięcy

ingredients.text: 1 ea white or yellow onion, minced or grated
ingredients.name: cebula
ingredients.note: white or yellow, minced or grated

steps.text: Preheat a broiler or grill to moderate-high heat.
Combine all the ingredients in a mixing bowl. Use your hands to mix just until everything is combined and evenly distributed.
Use a spoon or your hands to scoop out portions of approximately 2–3 tablespoons. Use your hands to shape the meat mixture into oblong shapes about 2–3 inches (5–8 cm) in length.

If using an oven broiler, transfer the kofta onto a rack over a rimmed baking sheet to catch the drippings, and place them under the broiler. If grilling, arrange the kofta directly on the grill rack.
Broil or grill for a handful of minutes on each side, flipping halfway. You're looking for the outside to be slightly browned, and the inside should be cooked through but not dry.
Remove from the heat, and set aside to cool slightly before serving.

recipes.title: Ofe Oha (Oha Leaf Soup)
recipes.description: Traditional Igbo soup made with fresh oha leaves, cocoyam as a thickener, and assorted meats or fish.

ingredients.text: 500 g assorted meat (beef, goat meat, or chicken)
ingredients.name: mięso mieszane (wołowina, koźlina lub kurczak)

steps.text: Wash and cook the assorted meat with onion, seasoning cubes, and salt until tender.
Add stockfish and continue cooking until soft.
In a separate pot, cook cocoyam until soft, then pound or blend into a smooth paste.
Add the cocoyam paste into the meat stock to thicken the soup, stirring well to avoid lumps.
Add palm oil and allow the soup to cook for 5–10 minutes.
Add dried fish, ground crayfish, and pepper. Stir and allow to simmer.
Add ogiri if using, then adjust seasoning with salt and seasoning cubes.
Finally, add the sliced oha leaves and stir gently.
Allow to simmer for 3–5 minutes (do not overcook the leaves to preserve flavor).
Remove from heat and serve hot.

recipes.title: Posho (Ugandan Cornmeal Porridge)
recipes.description: A staple Ugandan porridge made from maize flour, served warm as a side dish with stews, beans, or greens.

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon butter or vegetable oil (optional, for added richness)
ingredients.name: masło

steps.text: In a cooking pot, bring the water to a boil over medium heat.
Gradually add the maize flour to the boiling water, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon or whisk to prevent lumps from forming.
Continue stirring the mixture until it thickens and begins to pull away from the sides of the pot, about 5–10 minutes.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot with a lid, and let the porridge simmer for an additional 5–10 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld and the porridge to reach the desired consistency.
If using, add butter or vegetable oil to the porridge and stir until well incorporated.
Remove the pot from the heat and let the posho rest for a few minutes before serving to allow it to set further.
Serve the posho warm as a comforting and nourishing side dish with stews, vegetables, or any other Ugandan delicacies.

recipes.title: Barbecue Sauce II
recipes.description: A simple barbecue sauce made from ketchup, molasses and liquid smoke.

steps.text: Mix everything in a pot.
To use, heat the sauce with some pre-cooked meat in it.

recipes.title: Pork and Lima Skillet
recipes.description: Pork loin chops browned in a skillet and served over baby lima beans in a basil-seasoned gravy.

ingredients.text: 2 packages (10 ounces) frozen baby lima beans
ingredients.name: fasola lima mrożona

steps.text: Cook lima beans according to package directions, omitting salt in cooking water; drain.
In skillet, brown chops over medium heat.
Remove chops from skillet.
Pour off all but 1 tablespoon drippings.
Add gravy base to skillet.
Blend in flour and basil.
Add ¾ cup water; cook and stir over medium heat until thickened and bubbly.
Add limas to skillet, stirring to coat with sauce.
Arrange chops over limas. Cover and cook over low heat about 5 minutes, or until heated through.

ingredients.text: 250 g tempeh, sliced into pieces 10×6×1 cm
ingredients.name: tempeh

steps.text: Combine the rice flour, tapioca starch, coriander, garlic, galangal, and salt.
Add water little by little until it forms a smooth batter.
Add the sliced green onion.
Warm the cooking oil in a frying pan.
Dip the tempeh into the batter.
Insert the tempeh into the hot oil, and fry it until done.
Take it out from the oil and serve it with small chilies.

recipes.title: Bafa (Cape Verdean Seafood Stew)
recipes.description: A traditional Cape Verdean seafood stew made with octopus, clams or mussels, and other shellfish, often served with bread to soak up the broth.

ingredients.text: 1 kg octopus, cleaned and cut into pieces
ingredients.name: ośmiornica

steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened.
Stir in the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and bell pepper and cook until tender.
Stir in the paprika, black pepper, and chili flakes.
Add the octopus pieces and cook for 5 minutes.
Pour in the white wine and allow it to simmer for 2–3 minutes.
Add the fish stock and bay leaf.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 45 minutes.
Add the clams or mussels.
Cover and cook until the shellfish open, about 5–10 minutes.
Discard any shellfish that do not open.
Season with salt to taste.
Stir in the chopped parsley.
Remove the bay leaf.
Serve hot with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Cucumber, Tomato, and Onion Salad
recipes.description: A flexible, fresh pickle-style salad of cucumbers, onion and optional tomato in diluted vinegar.

ingredients.text: 1 small white onion, diced (perhaps a sliced green onion could be substituted)
ingredients.name: cebula
ingredients.note: small, white, diced (perhaps a sliced green onion could be substituted)

ingredients.text: 1 (or more, if in season) tomato, diced or wedged (optional, adds color)
ingredients.name: pomidor
ingredients.note: or more, if in season; diced or wedged; optional, adds color

ingredients.text: Additional seasoning as you may desire (e.g. salt)
ingredients.name: sól

steps.text: Peel the cucumbers, either completely or leaving some green, in a pattern you prefer.
Slice cucumbers about ¼ inch (½ cm) thick.
Add vinegar and water, adjusting the proportions to your taste. The end result is that the other ingredients will be floating in clear liquid.
Refrigerate, then serve cool to cold, while the ingredients are still crisp.

recipes.title: Pork Roast with Cayenne Apple Glaze
recipes.description: Boneless pork loin roasts coated in Dijon mustard and spices, then glazed with a cider and brown sugar mixture.

steps.text: Combine dry powders. Set aside.
Smear mustard as needed on one end of each roast.
Attach mustard ends of roasts together.
Spread remaining mustard all over roasts.
Apply dry powder mixture.
Bake at 375°F until internal temperature reaches 135°F.
Combine remaining ingredients and brush onto pork.
Bake at 375°F until internal temperature reaches 145°F (yes, it is safe).
Let rest for 10 minutes; serve.

recipes.title: Miyan Kubewa (Okra Soup)
recipes.description: A popular Hausa soup made primarily from okra, with a viscous texture and rich flavor, typically served with starch-based swallows such as tuwo shinkafa, tuwo masara or tuwo dawa.

ingredients.text: 500 g beef, goat, or assorted meat (optional: cow tripe, kidney, or liver)
ingredients.name: wołowina
ingredients.note: beef, goat, or assorted meat (optional: cow tripe, kidney, or liver)

ingredients.text: 1–2 ea. smoked fish or dried fish (optional)
ingredients.name: wędzona ryba

ingredients.text: 2 cups fresh chopped or grated okra (or 1½ cups dried okra)
ingredients.name: okra
ingredients.note: fresh chopped or grated (or 1½ cups dried okra)

ingredients.text: Fresh or dried ground Scotch bonnet chile (to taste)
ingredients.name: papryczka Scotch bonnet
ingredients.note: fresh or dried ground, to taste

steps.text: In a pot, combine your cleaned meat, chopped onions, seasoning cubes, and a pinch of salt. Add a little water and simmer until the meat is cooked through and tender to your taste. This can take a while for tough cuts of meat.
If using smoked or dried fish, add it along with the ground locust beans (dawadawa). Allow it to simmer for 5–10 minutes.
Pour in the palm oil and stir well. Let it cook for a few minutes to combine the flavors.
Stir in the okra. If using dried okra, you may need to add some extra water. Stir continuously to encourage the characteristic "draw" (slippery texture).
Sprinkle in the ground crayfish and pepper. Adjust salt and seasoning to taste.
Allow the soup to simmer for another 5–10 minutes. Avoid overcooking the okra to maintain its texture.

recipes.title: Pouch-Roasted Snapper
recipes.description: Whole red snapper baked in a parchment pouch on a bed of couscous, with herbs, lemon, Worcestershire sauce, white wine and butter.

ingredients.text: 1 whole (2 lb/1 kg) red snapper, cleaned, fins removed, head and tail intact
ingredients.name: lucjan
ingredients.note: whole (2 lb/1 kg), cleaned, fins removed, head and tail intact

ingredients.text: ½ large bunch each of dill, oregano, thyme, and parsley
ingredients.name: koperek

ingredients.text: ½ large bunch each of dill, oregano, thyme, and parsley
ingredients.name: oregano świeży

ingredients.text: ½ large bunch each of dill, oregano, thyme, and parsley
ingredients.name: tymianek świeży

ingredients.text: ½ large bunch each of dill, oregano, thyme, and parsley
ingredients.name: natka pietruszki

ingredients.text: ¼ cup butter, cut into small cubes
ingredients.name: masło

steps.text: Rinse the couscous, then sprinkle with kosher salt and allow to sit for 10 minutes.
Lay the fish diagonally on a parchment-lined baking pan.
Sprinkle liberally with salt and black pepper, inside and out.
Stuff with the herbs and several slices of lemon. Place remaining lemon slices under fish.
Run couscous through a sieve all around the fish.
Drizzle Worcestershire sauce and white wine over fish.
Dollop butter all over top.
Top with another piece of parchment and staple shut.
Bake at 425°F (about 215°C) for 30 minutes.
Open with a paring knife and serve.

categories: Recipes using beef broth and stock

recipes.title: Italian Braised Shortribs
recipes.description: Short ribs cooked in red wine with classic Italian herbs, flavorful, moist and fork tender.

steps.text: Whisk together tomato paste and wine. Set aside.
Season shortribs with salt and black pepper.
Heat a 6-quart cast-iron or enamel Dutch oven over medium high heat. Pour in oil and add shortribs, one at a time, until browned on all sides. Remove and keep warm.
Add wine mixture to Dutch oven and whisk continuously to dissolve browned bits. Add remaining ingredients and place in a cold oven. Set oven to 250°F and cook for 5 ½ hours.
Remove shortribs and strain sauce back into Dutch oven. Discard herb pieces and shred short ribs. Discard bones.
Add shortribs back into sauce and heat over low heat just until heated through. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Soso (Coconut Rice)
recipes.description: A flavorful rice dish cooked in coconut milk, popular in various cuisines, particularly in Africa and the Caribbean.

steps.text: Rinse the rice thoroughly under cold water until the water runs clear. Drain any excess water.
In a large pot, combine the rinsed rice, coconut milk, water, salt, and pandan leaves (if using). Stir well to combine.
If desired, you can add vegetable oil at this stage to prevent the rice from sticking together.
Place the pot over medium-high heat and bring the mixture to a boil, stirring occasionally.

Once it reaches a boil, reduce the heat to low, cover the pot with a tight-fitting lid, and simmer for about 15–20 minutes or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed. Avoid lifting the lid while the rice is cooking to ensure even cooking.
After the cooking time, remove the pot from the heat but keep it covered. Let it rest for an additional 5–10 minutes to allow the steam to finish cooking the rice.
Fluff the rice with a fork to separate the grains and remove the pandan leaves if used.
Serve the coconut rice hot.

recipes.title: Cheese Stuffed Tomatoes
recipes.description: A cheese-and-herb filling piped into cherry tomatoes, served chilled as an appetizer.

ingredients.text: 30 cherry tomatoes, with the very top removed
ingredients.name: pomidor koktajlowy

steps.text: Combine all ingredients except tomatoes to make the filling.
Place filling into a gallon-size zip-top bag with a small hole snipped in one of the bottom corners.
Fill tomatoes about ¾ full.
Serve chilled as an appetizer.

recipes.title: Drunken Shrimp
recipes.description: Shrimp simmered in beer and finished with butter, seasoned with salt and black pepper.

steps.text: Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat. Add shrimp and cook until slightly undercooked.
Quickly place shrimp in ice water and drain. Set aside.
Season shrimp with salt and pepper. Deglaze pot with beer and add shrimp. Bring to a simmer over medium low heat.
Once beer simmers, lower heat to low and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in butter 1 tbsp at a time and serve warm.

recipes.title: Lody owocowe
recipes.description: Lody śmietankowe z kawałkami bezów i brzoskwiń, z dodatkiem syropu z malin i czerwonych winogron.

steps.text: Pokrojone wzdłuż winogrona i maliny wrzucamy do garnka.
Wsypujemy cukier.
Całość zalewamy wodą i gotujemy na małym ogniu mniej więcej 20-30 minut, aż uzyskamy syrop.
Następnie czekamy, aż syrop wystygnie.
Śmietanę ubijamy na sztywno, dodajemy pokruszone bezy, pokrojone w kostkę brzoskwinie i wystudzone owoce z syropu około 2-4 łyżki.
Wszystko lekko mieszamy i wstawiamy do zamrażalnika.
Podajemy z kawałkami świeżych owoców i polewamy np. musem owocowym.

recipes.title: Chicken Bog I
recipes.description: Gęsty ryż gotowany z kurczakiem, boczkiem, cebulą i zieloną papryką na bulionie z kurczaka.

ingredients.text: 1 small onion (about the size of a lemon or smaller)
ingredients.name: cebula
ingredients.note: small, about the size of a lemon or smaller

ingredients.text: 1 small green bell pepper, chopped small
ingredients.name: papryka zielona

ingredients.text: 2 lb uncooked long grain white rice (not instant rice)
ingredients.name: ryż biały
sól
ingredients.note: at least a tablespoon, to taste

ingredients.name: pieprz czarny
ingredients.note: at least a tablespoon, to taste

steps.text: Put chicken in heavy aluminum pot and cover with hot water. Be sure there is enough water so that there will be at least 6 cups of broth after cooking chicken. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer until chicken is very tender (an hour or more).
While the chicken is cooking, put 4 cups of rice into a bowl, cover with cold water, and let soak.
When chicken is very tender, remove pot from stove and let cool until the chicken can be handled.
Take chicken from pot, and pull meat from bones in large pieces; do not cut it up. Discard any fat-heavy skin.
Pour broth from pot into a bowl. If chicken was very fat and broth is very fatty, pour off about 1 cup of fat from broth.
Wash pot, then put bacon in pot and cook slowly until bacon is crisp.
Take bacon from pot and drain; leave bacon grease in pot.
Put in chopped onion, green pepper and brown slightly.
Add 6 cups chicken broth to pot, and season to taste with salt and pepper (at least a tablespoon of each—use a heavy hand since rice will absorb salt).
Increase heat, bring broth to a boil, and put chicken in pot.
Drain rice and put rice in pot.
Add a stick of butter and mix well. Reduce heat, cover with lid, and simmer very slowly for about an hour. To avoid gooey rice, avoid stirring.
When rice is tender and has absorbed the liquids, remove from stove. Serve hot. You can crumble bacon for a topping, according to taste.

recipes.title: Frito Pie (No-bake)
recipes.description: Danie z chipsami kukurydzianymi, chili, serem Monterey Jack, śmietaną i jalapeño.

ingredients.text: 1 recipe of home-made Frito Pie Chili, hot
ingredients.name: chili

ingredients.text: 1 bag (10 oz / 280 g) Fritos corn chips
ingredients.name: chipsy kukurydziane

ingredients.text: 1½ cups (350 ml) grated Monterrey Jack cheese
ingredients.name: ser Monterey Jack

steps.text: Place a handful of the chips in each of 8 shallow bowls.
Spoon the Frito Pie Chili over the chips.
Garnish with the grated cheese, sour cream, and jalapeños.

recipes.title: Quiche Batter
recipes.description: Custardy batter used in tall, fluffy quiches such as Quiche Lorraine.

ingredients.text: ¼ tsp fresh ground white pepper
ingredients.name: pieprz biały

ingredients.text: 10 gratings of nutmeg, or to taste
ingredients.name: gałka muszkatołowa

steps.text: Combine the milk and cream in the saucepan over medium heat.
Cook until scalded and a skin forms, then remove from the heat and let cool slightly.
Combine the eggs, salt, nutmeg, and pepper in the blender.
With the blender running, drizzle in the milk mixture, and keep blending on high speed for 1 minute.
Use immediately as directed in your quiche recipe, or set aside for later.

recipes.title: Muqmad
recipes.description: Traditional Somali preserved meat dish made by drying and cooking meat, then storing it in ghee or animal fat.

ingredients.text: 1 kg lean beef or camel meat, cut into small cubes or strips
ingredients.name: wołowina
ingredients.note: lean, cut into small cubes or strips

steps.text: Trim excess fat from the meat and cut it into thin strips or small cubes.
Lay the meat on a clean tray or drying rack and allow it to dry in the sun or air-dry for several hours or up to a few days.
Heat a large pan over medium heat.
Add the meat and cook slowly until most of the moisture evaporates.
Stir in the onions, garlic, cardamom, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Continue cooking until the meat becomes browned and slightly crispy.
Melt the ghee or clarified butter in a separate pot.
Pour the melted ghee over the cooked meat until fully covered.
Allow the mixture to cool before transferring it to an airtight container.
Store in a cool place or refrigerate.

recipes.title: Sweet Elderflower Kefir
recipes.description: This is an absolutely delicious sweet drink.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients.
Mix well and enjoy.

recipes.title: Kuih Lapis (Malaysian Layered Steamed Confection)
recipes.description: This layered Malaysian kuih lapis is made using wheat flour and cornstarch. It has a chewy texture.

steps.text: Preheat a baking pan in a steamer over a pot of simmering water.
Combine the flour, cornstarch, sugar, coconut milk, and salt in a blender. Process until completely smooth, then strain the batter.
Divide the batter into two bowls. Use food coloring to color each bowl a different color as desired.
Pour a thin layer of one batter into the baking pan in the steamer, making sure it's evenly distributed. Cover and let steam for 3 minutes.
Uncover the steamer, and pour an equally thin layer of the other batter on top of the first layer. Cover and let steam for 3 minutes.
Repeat the layering and steaming process, alternating colors, until you have used up all your batter.
Remove the pan from the steamer, and allow it to cool completely.
Unmold the kuih from the pan, and cut it into pieces.

recipes.title: Tall Quiche Shell
recipes.description: A tall quiche shell as used in quiches served at Thomas Keller's restaurant, Bouchon.

ingredients.text: 2 cups all-purpose flour (you can use whole grain, but softer wheat is better here)
ingredients.name: mąka pszenna
ingredients.note: you can use whole grain, but softer wheat is better here

ingredients.text: 8 oz chilled unsalted butter, cut into ¼ inch cubes
ingredients.name: masło
ingredients.note: chilled, unsalted, cut into ¼ inch cubes

steps.text: Combine the salt and half the flour in the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment.
Add the butter, and mix on medium speed until the butter blends into the flour.
Add the rest of the flour, and mix for a few seconds on low speed.
Add the ice water and mix just until blended. You don't want to develop gluten here—you just want nice butter layers.
Remove the dough from the mixer. If desired, make a few random folds of it with your hand, not kneading but creating some layers that might flake during baking.
Pat dough into an 8 inch disk, wrap in tightly in plastic wrap, and chill in the fridge for at least 1 hour.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and put the quiche ring on top.

Roll out the dough evenly until it's 14 inches in diameter and about 3/16 inch thick. A thinner shell can be done, but it will tear more easily, and patching tears is tricky. You can generously dust with flour as you're rolling.

Loosely roll the dough around your rolling pin, and center it over the quiche ring. Carefully working in a circle, tuck in the dough to make an even-bottomed, even-walled shell. Wrap the excess dough around the outside of the ring and press it down there, but keep it thick around the top of the ring. This will keep the dough from sagging or tearing around the top as it bakes. Tuck the shell well into all the gaps, patching it smoothly anywhere it tears and pressing it even wherever there are thick folds. Along the outside of the ring, cut any dough that reaches down more than 1.25 inches. You can use this to patch any tears later.
Cover with plastic wrap and chill in the fridge for at least an hour.
Preheat oven to 375 °F.

Line the shell with parchment paper, and fill with baking beans or anything heavy to weigh it down, like uncooked rice. If you use baking beans, it takes a lot, so you can put fewer beans in the middle and push them up against the sides.
Bake for 30–35 minutes until the parts of the crust that are showing on the outside are nice and golden brown.
Remove the parchment and weights, and patch any tears in the shell with the reserved dough from before. Be careful not to burn yourself on the hot ring.
Bake for another 15–20 minutes until the bottom is golden brown as well. Here, you can patch again, but take time to smooth the new dough into the dough below it or the patch won't hold very well.
Cool completely, and use as directed in your recipe.

recipes.title: Tangy Fried Shrimp
recipes.description: Jumbo shrimp dredged in flour and lemon juice, fried until golden, then seasoned with salt, black pepper and cayenne.

steps.text: Dredge shrimp in the flour, then dip in lemon juice, then dredge in flour again. Set aside.
Heat oil to 375°F.
Fry shrimp, 6 at a time, for 2 minutes or until deeply browned and cooked through.
Drain on a wire rack and repeat with remaining shrimp.
Once all shrimp have been fried, sprinkle with seasonings and serve.

recipes.title: Wilted Greens
recipes.description: This recipe is incredibly quick to prepare, rich in flavor, and makes a great side dish. The butter adds flavor but can be excluded for vegan/low-fat diets.

ingredients.text: 1 head (3–4 cups of leaves) tat soi or any other dark leafy green, base removed (tear into smaller pieces if using a large leaf plant like chard)
ingredients.name: tat soi
ingredients.note: 3–4 cups of leaves, base removed (tear into smaller pieces if using a large leaf plant like chard)

steps.text: Rinse greens thoroughly.
Melt butter and olive oil in a wok or sauté pan over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and sauté until golden.
Stir in tat soi and cook, stirring constantly, until lightly wilted.
Remove from heat and cover, allowing the greens to steam in the pan for a minute or two.
When ready to serve, toss with about 1 tbsp soy sauce.

recipes.title: Scottish Porridge
recipes.description: Scottish Porridge is a beloved traditional breakfast dish from Scotland. A creamy, satisfying porridge with a pleasant chewy texture, made from steel-cut oats soaked overnight.

ingredients.text: ½ cup (80 g) steel-cut oats, also called Irish oats
ingredients.name: płatki owsiane
ingredients.note: steel-cut oats, also called Irish oats

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon lemon juice or apple cider vinegar (for soaking)
ingredients.name: sok z cytryny
ingredients.note: lemon juice or apple cider vinegar (for soaking)

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon of buckwheat flour (for reducing phytates)
ingredients.name: mąka gryczana

steps.text: Mix the steel-cut oats with a teaspoon of buckwheat flour in a bowl.
Add warm water to soak the oats and add a splash of lemon juice or apple cider vinegar. Cover and allow to soak overnight or at least 7 to 8 hours.
Place the oats, salt and water into a small pan and gently bring it to a small boil, stirring occasionally until the porridge starts to thicken.

Once the thickening has begun, lower the heat to low to avoid burning the porridge and allow it to simmer for approximately 15 to 20 minutes (or less if the oats are tender and reached your preferred consistency).
Remove from the heat and let it stand for 1 or 2 minutes before serving.
Serve and top with your choice of toppings, such as chia seeds, walnuts, tablespoon of peanut butter, berries, cinnamon, or a dollop of Greek yogurt.

recipes.title: Hickory Smoked Pork Chops
recipes.description: Pork chops seared hot, then cooked slowly over hickory wood.

steps.text: Combine salt, honey, and vinegar in a gallon-size zip-top bag. Add ice and shake until ice is mostly melted and mixture has cooled.
Insert pork chops and brine in the refrigerator for 1–2 hours.
Drain pork and pat dry with paper towels. Discard remaining brine.
Combine remaining seasonings and rub on both sides of each pork chop.
Get your smoker ready. Place chunks in the firebox and keep the smoker at around 250°F.
Brush with olive oil and grill on high just until marked. Flip and repeat 1 more time.

Move to smoker and insert a probe thermometer into one of the chops. Cover and cook until internal temperature reaches 140°F for medium rare, 155°F for medium, and 165°F for toast. Carry-over will take it the last 5 degrees. Keep checking the temperature and microwave if needed to get above 145°F.
Move to a plate and let rest 5 minutes. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Irish Pastie
recipes.description: The pastie could be considered one of Northern Ireland's national dishes as it is regularly bought from chip shops across the province and generally can't be found anywhere else.

ingredients.text: 1 lb ground pork or beef, cooked and drained
ingredients.name: mięso mielone wieprzowe lub wołowe

ingredients.text: 3 medium-sized potatoes, boiled, mashed, and cooled
ingredients.name: ziemniak

steps.text: Combine the cooked meat, breadcrumbs, cooked onion, parsley, salt, pepper, Worcestershire sauce, water, coriander, and mashed potatoes.
Form the mixture into a disc about 3 inches in diameter.
Dip the disc into the batter so it's completely covered.
Deep-fry in 375°F oil, and remove when golden brown.
Serve hot with chips (French fries).

recipes.title: Quinoa (gotowana)
recipes.description: Gotowana quinoa, namoczona wcześniej i ugotowana w wodzie z solą.

steps.text: Place quinoa in a bowl and cover completely with water. Soak for 3–4 hours, then discard the water. Replace with fresh water and soak for another hour or so. Drain again.
Combine the drained quinoa with the 2 cups water and pinch of salt in a pot. Bring to a boil.
Lower the heat, and simmer on the lowest heat setting for 16–18 minutes.
Remove from the heat and let rest for 5 minutes.
