recipes.title: Roasted Brined Turkey II
recipes.description: A whole turkey brined in salt water, air-dried in the refrigerator, then roasted breast side down on a V-rack with butter, onion, carrot, celery and thyme.

ingredients.text: 4 cups kosher salt or 2 cups table salt
ingredients.name: sól kuchenna

ingredients.text: 1 ea. (12–14 pounds / 5.4–6.4 kg) turkey, rinsed thoroughly; giblets, neck, and tailpiece removed and reserved to make gravy
ingredients.name: indyk
ingredients.note: 12–14 pounds / 5.4–6.4 kg, rinsed thoroughly; giblets, neck, and tailpiece removed and reserved to make gravy

steps.text: Dissolve salt in the cold water in a large stockpot or clean bucket. Add turkey, and refrigerate or set in very cool spot (< 40°F / 4.4°C) for 4–6 hours.
Remove turkey from salt water and rinse both cavities and skin under cool running water for several minutes until all traces of salt are gone.
Pat dry inside and out with paper towels.
Place turkey on meat rack set over rimmed sheet pan. Place turkey in refrigerator, uncovered, and air-dry for at least 8 hours or overnight.
Adjust oven rack to lowest position, and heat oven to 400°F (204.4°C).
Toss one-third of onion, carrot, celery, and thyme with 1 tablespoon of melted butter and place this mixture in body cavity. Bring turkey legs together and perform a simple truss.
Scatter remaining vegetables and thyme over a shallow roasting pan. Pour 1 cup water over vegetables. Set V-rack in pan.
Brush entire breast side of turkey with half of remaining butter, then place turkey, breast side down, on V-rack. Brush entire backside of turkey with remaining butter.

Roast for 45 minutes. Remove pan from oven (close oven door); baste with juices from pan. With wad of paper toweling in each hand, turn turkey, leg/thigh side up. If liquid in pan has totally evaporated, add another ½ cup water.
Return turkey to oven and roast for 15 minutes. Remove turkey from oven again, baste, and again use paper toweling to turn other leg/thigh side up.
Roast for another 15 minutes. Remove turkey from oven for final time, baste, and turn it breast side up.
Roast until breast registers about 165°F (73.9°C) and thigh registers 170–175°F (76.7–79.4°C) on an instant-read thermometer (30–45 minutes).
Remove turkey from pan and let rest until ready to carve. Serve with gravy.

recipes.title: Tomato bredie
recipes.description: Tomato bredie to południowoafrykańskie danie z mięsem i warzywami duszonymi razem, typowe dla zimy.

ingredients.text: 3½ pounds lamb or mutton breast chops, chopped into portions
ingredients.name: mostek jagnięcy

ingredients.text: ½ teaspoon freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: pieprz czarny mielony

steps.text: Heat oil in a large, heavy-bottomed saucepan.
Dredge lamb in flour; shake off excess.
Cook the lamb in hot oil until it is brown.
Pour lamb onto a plate and reserve the drippings in the pan.
Cook and stir onion in drippings until soft, about 5 minutes.
Mix tomatoes with the onion.
Return lamb chops to the saucepan; season with bay leaves, salt, brown sugar, black pepper, Worcestershire sauce, white peppercorns and bouillon.
Cover, reduce the heat and simmer for 1 hour and 15 minutes, stirring occasionally so that it does not stick to the bottom of the pan.
Stir in potatoes; continue cooking until potatoes are cooked and meat is tender, about 45 minutes more.

recipes.title: Soda from Extract
recipes.description: Soda made by boiling soda extract with water and sugar into a syrup, then mixing it with carbonated water.

steps.text: Boil the soda extract, water, and sugar together to make a syrup of about 10 oz (300 ml).
Mix the syrup with the carbonated water to make the finished soda.

recipes.title: Italian Dressing II
recipes.description: Włoski sos vinaigrette do sałatek z pietruszką, parmezanem i czosnkiem.

ingredients.text: 1 tbsp plus 1 tsp grated Parmesan cheese
ingredients.name: parmezan

ingredients.text: ¼ tsp dried whole Italian seasoning
ingredients.name: mieszanka włoskich ziół

steps.text: Combine all ingredients except garlic in a jar.
Cover tightly and shake vigorously.
Press a wooden pick through garlic clove; add to dressing mixture.
Cover and refrigerate until thoroughly chilled.
To serve, remove and discard garlic. Cover and shake dressing well.

recipes.title: Sopaipillas (Latin American Fried Dough)
recipes.description: Smażone ciasto z mąki pszennej, podawane na ciepło, posypane cukrem z cynamonem lub polane miodem albo syropem truskawkowym.

steps.text: Combine ingredients and knead into a round ball.
Cover with a towel and let set for 10–20 minutes.
Break dough into 2–3 inch balls. Roll out each ball so that it is 8–12 inches in diameter. Cut into quarters.
Deep fry in hot oil until golden brown. Turn once.
Drain on paper towels and sprinkle with mixture of sugar and cinnamon.
Serve warm plain or drizzled with honey or strawberry syrup.

recipes.title: Tuscan Roast Potatoes
recipes.description: Roasted potatoes seasoned with salt, pepper, olive oil and dried herbs, served warm as a side dish with grilled steak, roast chicken or vegetable sauté.

ingredients.text: 1 pound (450 g) each Russet potatoes and redskin potatoes, cut into 2-inch (5 cm) cubes
ingredients.name: ziemniaki
ingredients.note: each of Russet and redskin potatoes, cut into 2-inch (5 cm) cubes

ingredients.text: 1 ½ tsp each dried parsley, rosemary, thyme, basil and oregano
ingredients.name: mieszanka suszonych ziół
ingredients.note: each of dried parsley, rosemary, thyme, basil and oregano

steps.text: Heat a large pot of water to a boil.
Add potatoes and cook for 10 minutes.
Shock in a bowl of ice water.
Drain and refrigerate for 1 hour.
Combine remaining ingredients. Add potatoes and toss to coat.
Spread out in one even layer on your largest baking pan.
Roast at 450°F (230°C) for 20 minutes, stirring halfway.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Rocky Road Confectionery II
recipes.description: Rocky road is a type of confectionery commonly made in Australia. It is made from chunks of marshmallow in a matrix of chocolate.

steps.text: Put the chocolate in the bowl and microwave until melted.
Once the chocolate is melted, stir in the coconut oil, which will get melted by the chocolate.
Let cool slightly, then fold in the marshmallows.
Spread mixture in a greased and parchment-lined pan. Let set.
Unmold and cut into pieces.

recipes.title: Gingerbread Pancakes II
recipes.description: Placki piernikowe z melasą, kawą i przyprawami, podawane z masłem i syropem.

ingredients.text: 1 cup brewed coffee, cooled to room temperature
ingredients.name: kawa

steps.text: In a mixing bowl, combine pancake mix, coffee, water, molasses, cinnamon, ginger, and nutmeg.
Stir until combined.
The batter will be thin; for thicker pancakes, add more mix, 1 tablespoon at a time.
Coat a nonstick frying pan with cooking spray and place over medium heat. If using an electric skillet, heat to 375°F.
Pour ¼ cup of batter into hot pan; cook 2 minutes or until bubbles appear and edges look dry; flip pancakes and cook 1 or 2 minutes more.
Serve with butter and syrup, if desired.

recipes.title: Rwandan Goat Brochette
recipes.description: Rwandan goat brochette, also known as Brochettes de Chèvre, is a popular street food in Rwanda consisting of tender grilled goat meat skewers.

ingredients.text: 2 pounds goat meat, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.name: koźlina

steps.text: In a mixing bowl, combine the chopped onion, minced garlic, vegetable oil, paprika, cayenne pepper, black pepper, salt, and lemon juice. Stir well to create a marinade.
Add the goat meat cubes to the marinade and mix until the meat is thoroughly coated. Cover the bowl and let it marinate in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours, or overnight for best results.
Preheat your grill or barbecue to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated goat meat cubes onto the skewers, leaving a little space between each cube.
Place the skewers on the preheated grill and cook for about 15–20 minutes, turning occasionally, until the meat is cooked to your desired level of doneness and nicely charred.
Remove the skewers from the grill and let them rest for a few minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Semmelknoedel (Bavarian Bread Dumplings)
recipes.description: Bavarian bread dumplings made from white bread rolls, onions, eggs, milk and parsley.

ingredients.text: 10 white bread rolls, cut into small cubes
ingredients.name: bułka pszenna

ingredients.text: 1 bunch of parsley, washed and chopped
ingredients.name: natka pietruszki

steps.text: Heat the oil in a skillet. Add the diced onions, and sauté until translucent. Remove from the heat.
Combine the bread cubes and the cooked onions.
Mix the eggs with the milk, and pour it over the bread and the onions. Mix to make a dough.
Mix the parsley and flour into the dough. Season with salt and pepper.
Form balls of the dough about the size of tennis balls.
Boil the knoedel in salted water. After about 2 minutes, turn the temperature down to a lower setting and let them boil for another 10–15 minutes.

recipes.title: Tortellini in Sweet Potato Sauce
recipes.description: Tortellini with sweet potato sauce is a potluck staple.

steps.text: Bake or microwave sweet potato in its skin until tender.
Let cool.
Cook tortellini according to package directions, drain, and return to the pot.
Meanwhile, heat butter in a small skillet.
Add garlic and sauté over low heat until golden (about 1 minute), then remove from heat.
Peel sweet potato and mash well in a small mixing bowl.
Add garlic and butter, plus enough milk to make a thick sauce.
Season as desired with salt and pepper.
Combine sauce with pasta in the pot.
Heat just until sauce is heated through.

recipes.title: Kugel ziemniaczany (żydowski)
recipes.description: Tradycyjna żydowska zapiekanka z tartych ziemniaków, cebuli i mąki macowej.

steps.text: Ziemniaki obrać, opłukać i zetrzeć wraz z cebulą na tarce o drobnych otworach. Odcisnąć w .
Z białek ubić pianę, którą wraz z surowymi żółtkami, solą, pieprzem, margaryną i mąką macową dodajemy do masy ziemniaczanej. Dokładnie wymieszać i wylać na formę wysmarowaną olejem słonecznikowym.
Piec w piekarniku przez ok. 1 godzinę, do chwili aż powierzchnia będzie chrupiąca.

recipes.title: Kugel z mięsem (polski)
recipes.description: Zapiekanka z tartych ziemniaków, wołowiny i cebuli, pieczona w wysokiej temperaturze.

steps.text: Ziemniaki obrać, zetrzeć na tarce. Mięso pokroić na małe kawałki. Cebulę zetrzeć na tarce razem z ziemniakami lub pokroić w drobną kostkę.
Wszystkie składniki wymieszać w misce, dodać sól i pieprz do smaku. Blachę do pieczenia posmarować olejem.
Piekarnik rozgrzać do temperatury 250 °C. Włożyć do niego blachę z masą ziemniaczaną na najniższą półkę na około 1,5 godziny.
Po tym czasie podnieść blachę wyżej i piec przez jeszcze 1 godzinę nadal w tej samej temperaturze.

recipes.title: Mushroom Ketchup
recipes.description: Mushroom ketchup is a seasoning.

steps.text: Combine the mushrooms and salt. Stir, smash well, and let rest 10 minutes.
Transfer mushrooms to a non-metal container, such as a ceramic crock. Cover and let sit overnight.
Combine the mushrooms, onion, horseradish, lemon zest, cloves, allspice, vinegar, and cayenne. Bring to a simmer and cook for 15 minutes.
Drape a clean cloth over a bowl. Pour the mixture over the cloth, and squeeze to extract all the liquid. The liquid is the mushroom ketchup.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Mexican Rice II
recipes.description: Meksykański ryż z sosem chili ancho i bulionem drobiowym.

ingredients.text: 1 fresh red chile, seeded and finely diced (or 1 dehydrated chile that has been rehydrated)
ingredients.name: papryczka chili
ingredients.note: seeded and finely diced (or 1 dehydrated chile that has been rehydrated)

ingredients.text: 5 tbsp Ancho Enchilada Sauce, strained through a medium mesh
ingredients.name: sos chili ancho enchilada

ingredients.text: 4 cloves of garlic, peeled and crushed
ingredients.name: ząbek czosnku

ingredients.text: ½ small onion, peeled and finely diced
ingredients.name: cebula

steps.text: Sauté garlic, onions, and red chile in oil over medium heat for about 1 minute.
Add in the rice and stir frequently until rice begins to brown.
Mix chicken stock and chile sauce in another saucepan and bring to a boil. When mixed, make sure liquid mixture equals out to 2 cups of liquid.
Add chicken stock and chile sauce mixture to rice and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and bring rice to slow simmer. Cook for 25–30 minutes with the lid on.
Remove lid and fluff rice with a fork.

recipes.title: Silog
recipes.description: A heavy, easy-to-make Filipino breakfast served on every table.

ingredients.text: 1 fried chicken egg (sunny side-up or beaten)
ingredients.name: jajko

ingredients.group: Add-ons of your choice, such as
ingredients.name: parówka

ingredients.group: Add-ons of your choice, such as
ingredients.name: wołowina w puszce

ingredients.group: Add-ons of your choice, such as
ingredients.name: kiełbasa longganisa

ingredients.group: Add-ons of your choice, such as
ingredients.name: ogórek

steps.text: Place the fried rice and the egg on your plate.
Arrange your desired add-ons around the rice.
Serve with any desired condiments, such as spicy vinegar.

recipes.title: Super Foamy Milkshake
recipes.description: The Super Foamy is a highly viscous milkshake with a smooth, airy texture. It is low-fat and, for a shake, high-fiber.

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon (2 grams) locust bean gum powder
ingredients.name: guma guar

steps.text: Mix the locust bean gum powder, inulin powder, and sweet whey powder together.
Add the resulting powder to the skimmed milk.
Using an electric mixer, whip for 2 minutes until the product has turned to a fine foam. While whipping, move the whisks up and down so that air gets whipped into the shake.

recipes.title: Mushroom Tofu Soup
recipes.description: Soup of silken tofu blended with water and sautéed onion, mushrooms, thyme and red wine, finished with soy sauce.

steps.text: In a blender, blend tofu and ¼ cup water for about 2 minutes, or until smooth.
Add remaining ¾ cup water and process until blended.
In a large skillet, sauté onion for about 5 minutes.
Add mushrooms and thyme, and sauté 5 minutes more.
Add wine and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add tofu mixture and simmer until mushrooms are wilted.
Stir in soy sauce, and adjust salt to taste.

recipes.title: Chipotle BBQ Salmon Burgers
recipes.description: Burgery z łososia wild z chipotle, sosem adobo i sosem BBQ, grillowane na patelni grillowej.

ingredients.text: 1¼ pounds skinless wild salmon filet, cut into 2-inch cubes
ingredients.name: filet z łososia dzikiego bez skóry

ingredients.text: Seafood seasoning, such as Old Bay
ingredients.name: przyprawa do owoców morza

ingredients.text: 4 hamburger buns, split in half and toasted
ingredients.name: bułka do hamburgera

ingredients.text: 3 chipotles in adobo sauce, finely minced
ingredients.name: chipotle w sosie adobo

ingredients.text: 3 tbsp unsalted butter, cut into small cubes
ingredients.name: masło

steps.text: Run salmon cubes through a meat grinder on medium setting. Mix with chipotle, sauce, butter, and adobo.
Form into 4 equal patties, about ¾ inch thick. Brush with extra-virgin olive oil and season both sides liberally with seasoning. Set aside.
Preheat grill pan to medium high. Rub with olive oil, then add salmon patties. Grill 5–6 minutes per side for medium rare, or until desired doneness is achieved.
Brush buns with oil. Place a patty on and close. Serve immediately with desired condiments.

recipes.title: Nigerian Coconut Rice
recipes.description: Coconut rice is a dish common among all regions of Nigeria. It can be prepared in a variety of ways to suit one's personal taste.

ingredients.text: 4 tablespoons coconut oil or vegetable oil
ingredients.name: olej kokosowy

steps.text: Rinse the rice and leave it to drain well.
Heat a skillet over medium heat. Add 2 tablespoons coconut oil, then the diced onions. Cook, stirring, until softened slightly (about 2 minutes).
Stir in the thyme, ginger, and garlic. Cook for a few seconds.
Blend the pepper roughly then add spices and seasoning, salt stir for few minutes, then add fish and chicken
Stir in the rice and fry for about 3 minutes.
Add the coconut milk, broth, bay leaf then stir.
Cover and cook till firm to bite, about 15 minutes. Or more.
When ready you can serve like that or any desired way.

recipes.title: Thobwa la mtedza (Malawian Sesame Seed Drink)
recipes.description: Traditional Malawian drink made from sesame seeds, nutritious and refreshing, popular on hot days.

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons honey or sugar (or to taste)
ingredients.name: miód

steps.text: In a dry frying pan or skillet, toast the sesame seeds and peanut over medium heat. Stir them continuously to prevent burning until they turn golden brown and release their aroma.
Remove the pan from the heat and let the toasted seeds and peanuts cool for a few minutes.
In a blender, combine the toasted sesame seeds and peanuts with the water.
Blend the mixture until it becomes smooth and creamy.
Pour the mixture through a nut milk bag or fine mesh strainer into a large bowl to separate the liquid from the solids.
Squeeze or press the bag to extract as much liquid as possible.
Sweeten with the honey. Stir well to dissolve the sweetener.
Chill the drink in the refrigerator for at least an hour before serving.
Stir before serving, as it may naturally separate over time.

recipes.title: Fried Potato Wedges
recipes.description: Crispy deep-fried potato wedges seasoned with salt and herbs or spices.

ingredients.text: 4 tablespoons of olive oil or (canola oil)
ingredients.name: oliwa z oliwek

ingredients.text: 5 grams sea salt (paprika or onion salt works too)
ingredients.name: sól
ingredients.note: sea salt; paprika or onion salt works too

ingredients.text: 4 grams of parsley or oregano (many seasonings can work)
ingredients.name: natka pietruszki
ingredients.note: parsley or oregano; many seasonings can work

steps.text: Slice potatoes evenly (over-sized wedges can result in uneven cooking).
Sprinkle seasoning and salt over each potato.
Deep fry potato wedges until brown and crispy (cook longer for more crispiness.)
Put in a plastic container and put in fridge (or just put on a cooling area if eating immediately).

recipes.title: Marly Sponge
recipes.description: Marly sponge is a meringue stabilized with flour. It is typically used as a component in other pastries.

steps.text: Mix the almonds, flour, and the first quantity of sugar with a wire whisk.
Whip the egg whites to soft peaks.
Add the second quantity of sugar, little by little, and beat to firm peaks.
Fold the almond mixture into the egg whites.
Line a sheet pan with parchment paper and draw circles of the required diameter on the paper.
Using a pastry bag, pipe spirals of meringue into the circles.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 12–15 minutes.

recipes.title: Ofe Akwu (Palm Fruit Soup)
recipes.description: Ofe Akwu is the Igbo name for palm fruit soup, a deeply flavourful soup made from fresh palm fruit extract.

ingredients.text: 1 kilogram fresh palm fruits (or canned palm fruit concentrate)
ingredients.name: owoc palmy olejowej

ingredients.text: 700 grams assorted meat (e.g. beef, shaki, goat, oxtail)
ingredients.name: mięso mieszane

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon ogiri okpei (fermented locust bean paste)
ingredients.name: pasta ogiri okpei

ingredients.text: 150 grams uziza leaf or bitter leaf, shredded
ingredients.name: liść uziza lub bitterleaf

steps.text: Boil the palm fruits in water for 20–25 minutes until soft, then drain.
Pound the cooked fruits in a mortar to loosen the flesh from the seeds.
Add warm water and squeeze the mixture through a sieve.
Discard the fibre and seeds.
If using canned concentrate, dilute as directed.
Season the meat with onion, 1 seasoning cube, and salt.
Add stockfish midway through cooking.
Cook on medium heat until tender.
Reserve the meat stock.
Pour palm fruit extract into a pot.
Cook on medium heat, stirring occasionally, until it thickens and oil rises to the surface, about 15–20 minutes.
Add ogiri okpei, ehuru, and puréed chiles, and stir well.
Add reserved cooked meat and stock, smoked fish, ground crayfish, and the remaining seasoning cube; stir and simmer on medium heat.
Taste and adjust with salt. The soup should be thick, rich, and deeply orange-red.
If too thick, add a little warm water and stir.
Stir in uziza leaf and cook for 3–5 minutes only.
Serve hot with pounded yam (iyán), eba, or fufu.

recipes.title: Pan-Seared Pork Chops
recipes.description: Thick-cut bone-in pork chops seasoned with a chop rub, seared in a skillet and finished in the oven.

steps.text: Brush pork chops with cider vinegar. Season each pork chop with the chop rub, pressing lightly.
Heat oil in a very large oven-proof cast iron or stainless steel skillet over medium high heat. Add pork chops and sear for 3 minutes per side.
Insert an oven-safe probe thermometer into one pork chop and place pan in a 350°F oven. Bake until internal temperature reaches 145°F.
Remove and let rest for 5 minutes; serve.

recipes.title: Grilled Cornish Hens
recipes.description: Spatchcocked Cornish game hens rubbed with a smoky, peppery seasoning blend and grilled over charcoal.

steps.text: Combine all seasonings.
Brush hens with bacon fat.
Massage seasoning mixture into hens.
Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Preheat a charcoal grill using a chimney.
Place hens on the grill. Grill them, turning constantly, until internal temperature of both the thigh and breast reach 165°F.
Remove hens from grill and let rest 10 minutes.
Serve.

recipes.title: Spinach Mushroom Omelet
recipes.description: An American diner-style breakfast omelet with spinach, mushrooms and sharp cheddar.

ingredients.text: ⅔ cup baby bella mushrooms, thinly sliced
ingredients.name: pieczarka

ingredients.text: ½ ea. large red onion, diced
ingredients.name: cebula czerwona

ingredients.text: ½ cup shredded aged cheddar cheese
ingredients.name: ser cheddar

steps.text: In a large bowl, whisk the eggs, salt, pepper, nutmeg and milk, until even and glossy.
Heat the skillet over medium heat. Add half the butter, tilting the skillet in a circular motion to coat evenly.
Add paprika, mushrooms, and onions, and sauté until lightly browned.
Add spinach and toss for 30 seconds, or until slightly wilted, but still crunchy. Remove the vegetables from the heat and set aside.
Add the remaining half of the oil or butter to the pan over medium heat, and coat evenly. Lower the heat.
Pour the egg mixture into the skillet, swirling the pan to ensure an even, creamy layer of eggs. Heat until the eggs have begun to set, with some fluff on top.
Top the egg layer with the vegetables, distributing the vegetables evenly. Sprinkle the cheese evenly on top.
Gently push the edges of the omelet half a centimeter toward the center of the skillet with two spatulas, making sure not to break it. Turn the heat off.
Use the spatulas to carefully lift/pull half the omelet off the skillet and fold it over the other half. Carefully move the entire omelet onto a plate and serve.

recipes.title: Grilled Fruit Pouches
recipes.description: Peaches and plums with crystallized ginger, brandy and butter, grilled in foil pouches.

ingredients.text: 4 peaches, peeled and sliced into eighths
ingredients.name: brzoskwinia

ingredients.text: ½ cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, divided
ingredients.name: masło

steps.text: In a large bowl, toss together fruit, sugar, salt, lemon, and brandy. Set aside.
In four large sheets of aluminum foil, scatter a foundation of crystallized ginger.
Place the fruit mixture on top of the ginger. Top with 1 tablespoon of the butter. Fold into a pouch.
Place pouches in the hot coal area of a kettle grill. Cook 7 minutes. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Sour Mashed Sweet Potato
recipes.description: Sour mashed sweet potato is a way to use leftover roasted vegetables, such as sweet potatoes, taro or pumpkin. It works well as a party dip, a cold mash at picnics, or a side for cold meats and barbecued lamb chops.

ingredients.text: 500 g sweet potato or other vegetables
ingredients.name: batat

ingredients.text: ½ tsp kefir or 1 tsp yoghurt
ingredients.name: kefir

steps.text: Peel and roast the sweet potato or other vegetables until tender; a 500 g piece roasts in about 1½ hours at 150°C (300°F), or less at a higher temperature.
Allow the vegetables to cool to about room temperature.
Mash the vegetables in a bowl, breaking up all large pieces.
Peel the ginger, mash it in a mortar and pestle or mince it in a food processor, add it to the bowl and mix well.
Add the salt and kefir or yoghurt and mix in well until smooth.
Pack the mash into a crock or jar, smooth the top with a spatula.
Fill a strong plastic bag with water, seal it and place on top of the mash to exclude air and prevent mould.
Set aside in a warm (not hot) place for 48 hours to ferment.
After fermenting, remove the plastic bag, close the crock or jar with a lid and refrigerate to keep fresh.

recipes.title: Spice Rub for Chicken
recipes.description: A dry spice rub for chicken, mixing black pepper, cayenne, celery seed, garlic powder, paprika, salt and thyme.

steps.text: Mix together spices in a bowl.
Rub on chicken, inside and outside.
Let stand for a few minutes before cooking per your usual directions.

categories: Recipes using beef broth and stock

recipes.title: Wine Braised Shortribs
recipes.description: Short ribs braised slowly in red wine with potatoes, onion and tomato paste, finished with rosemary.

ingredients.text: 1½ pounds red potatoes, quartered but left unpeeled
ingredients.name: ziemniaki czerwone

steps.text: Heat a 6-quart Dutch oven over medium high heat. Add oil and heat for one more minute.
Season shortribs with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Add to Dutch oven and cook until deeply browned on all sides. Remove and keep warm.
Add remaining oil and onion and sauté until lightly browned at the edges. Add potatoes, shortribs, and remaining ingredients except rosemary.
Place in a cold oven then turn oven to 250°F and bake for 5½ hours.
Remove and skim fat. Serve sprinkled with rosemary.

recipes.title: Crullers (Twisted)
recipes.description: Twisted crullers leavened with baking powder, deep fried and dusted with confectioners' sugar.

steps.text: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs.
Sift flour with baking powder, nutmeg, and salt. Mix into batter alternately with milk to make a dough. Chill dough.
Roll dough out ¼ inch (0.75 cm) thick. Cut dough into strips measuring 1 x 8 inches (2.5 x 20 cm).
Fold each strip in half lengthwise; twist several times and pinch ends together.
Deep fry in hot (380°F / 200˚C) fat on until golden brown, flipping to cook both sides.
Place crullers on absorbent paper to drain, and cool. Sprinkle with confectioners' sugar.

recipes.title: Violet Lemonade
recipes.description: Violet lemonade is a lemonade variation that changes color from dark blue to bright pink when mixed with acid, because wild violets contain anthocyanins.

ingredients.text: 2 cups wild violets, stems and leaves removed
ingredients.name: fiołek polny

steps.text: Steep the violets in hot water for at least 10 minutes or until it turns a dark blue hue. Strain and reserve the liquid.
Stir the sugar into the violet tea until dissolved to create a simple syrup.
Combine the cold water with the lemon juice.
Serve the lemon mixture over ice, and garnish with extra flowers. When ready to drink, pour the syrup into the lemon water and watch it turn from a dark blue to a bright pink color.

recipes.title: Garlic Parsley Dressing
recipes.description: A simple vinegar and olive oil dressing flavored with garlic powder, black pepper and parsley.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients and pour the dressing on boiled broccoli or cauliflower salad.

recipes.title: Chilli Oil
recipes.description: This recipe is used to make chilli oil, an extremely useful and tasty condiment.

steps.text: Mix chile flakes and salt in a heat-proof bowl.
Mix 1 tablespoon of the oil into the chile flake/salt mixture. This will prevent the chile from scorching when hot oil is added later.
Heat peanut oil to about 200°C (392°F). Small bubbles should form when poking a wooden chopstick into the oil.
Pour heated oil over chilli flake mixture and stir vigorously.
Allow to cool and store in a container.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Mexican Rice Pilaf
recipes.description: A rice side dish with Mexican flavors from tequila, Mexican oregano, chile powder, habanero chiles and tomato paste.

steps.text: Rinse rice with cold water until water runs clear. Pat dry with paper towels.
Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat. Add rice and cook until rice turns golden brown.
Meanwhile, combine tequila, broth, tomato, salt, oregano, and pepper. Pour over rice and bring to a boil.
Add bay leaves and habanero chiles.
Cook, stirring occasionally, 30 minutes or until rice reaches the desired tenderness.
Remove bay leaves and chiles. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Nshima
recipes.description: A staple maize dish eaten in Zambia and neighboring regions, served with a protein such as meat, fish, poultry or beans and green vegetables.

ingredients.text: 3 cups of Mealie Meal/ White Cornmeal
ingredients.name: mąka kukurydziana biała

steps.text: Boil 1 Litre of water in advance, in a kettle or saucepan.
Once the water boils, combine 1 cup of cornmeal with 1 1/2 cups of cold water in a saucepan to make a smooth paste. A flat cooking stick is ideal for this.

Transfer the cornmeal paste to the stove (set at medium high heat), then slowly pour about 700 ml of boiling water into the saucepan, stirring continuously, making sure the mixture is smooth and well combined.
This should lead to a smooth porridge, almost creamy. Allow it to boil for at least 10 minutes, covered.
Remove the cover after 10 minutes and begin to add the remaining cornmeal to the porridge, a little at a time, making sure it is well combined before adding more.
The porridge should stiffen up quickly with each addition of cornmeal, so you will need to exert some muscle to mix it well, smoothing out any lumps that form.
Remove from the stove after the 10 minutes and, using a smooth serving spoon, scoop out the nshima one lump at a time and transfer it into your serving dish.

recipes.title: Four Cheese Pizza
recipes.description: Pizza z sosem pomidorowym i czterema rodzajami sera.

steps.text: Spread the pizza base over an ovenproof dish.
Spread the crushed tomatoes over the pizza base.
Spread the emmental, cheddar and mozzarella in a cross pattern (as shown in the gallery).
Top with the diced comté cheese.
Cook the pizza for 15 minutes at 210°C (410°F).

recipes.title: Zhug III
recipes.description: A condiment of fresh coriander, garlic and chile peppers blended with olive oil, cumin, paprika, citric acid and salt.

steps.text: Blend together the garlic, chili peppers, and fresh coriander.
After blending, add olive oil and continue to blend together.
Place ground mixture into bowl and stir in paprika, cumin, salt, and citric acid. Mix together.
Store in refrigerator within plastic or glass jar with a layer of olive oil poured over it.

recipes.title: Limoncello II
recipes.description: An alternative limoncello recipe made by infusing lemon peel in grain alcohol, then combining it with a sugar syrup.

steps.text: Peel lemons, avoiding or removing the bitter white pith.
Combine lemon peel and alcohol in the mason jar.
Cover the jar and let infuse for 20 days.
After infusion is complete, create a simple syrup by boiling the water and stirring in the sugar until dissolved.
Allow syrup to cool completely, then strain the infused alcohol into it. Stir well to combine.
Bottle the limoncello or return to the jar for storage.

recipes.title: Liberian Fried Sweet Potato Puffs
recipes.description: Liberian fried sweet potato puffs made from mashed sweet potatoes seasoned with spices, fried to a crispy exterior and soft interior.

ingredients.text: 2 large sweet potatoes, boiled and mashed
ingredients.name: batat gotowany

steps.text: In a large mixing bowl, combine the mashed sweet potatoes with the beaten egg.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the all-purpose flour, baking powder, salt, black pepper, ground cinnamon, ground nutmeg, and cloves.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the sweet potato mixture, stirring until well combined.
Heat vegetable oil in a large pot or deep-fryer to 350°F (175°C).
Using a spoon or cookie scoop, carefully drop spoonfuls of the sweet potato mixture into the hot oil.
Fry the sweet potato puffs in batches for about 3–4 minutes or until they are golden brown and crispy.
Remove the fried puffs from the oil using a slotted spoon, and place them on a plate lined with paper towels to drain any excess oil.
Serve warm as a snack or appetizer.

recipes.title: Crushed Tomato Sauce
recipes.description: An easy tomato sauce that goes well with pasta, chicken or eggplant parmesan, pizza, and as a dip for mozzarella sticks.

ingredients.text: ½ onion, or an equal amount of shallots
ingredients.name: cebula
ingredients.note: or an equal amount of shallots

ingredients.text: 1 can (28 ounces) crushed tomatoes (Cento brand is best)
ingredients.name: pomidory krojone w puszce

ingredients.text: Several cranks of ground black pepper
ingredients.name: pieprz czarny mielony

steps.text: Heat olive oil in skillet or pot over medium-high heat. Add garlic, onions, salt, pepper, and Italian seasoning, if desired.
Turn the heat down to low and add tomatoes.
Cook over low heat for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Taste a spoonful of the sauce, and season with salt to taste; taste again and salt as needed.
After it is salted to your taste, stir in the basil and remove from the heat.
Serve however you like and enjoy!

recipes.title: Corn Bread (Lombardy)
recipes.description: Traditional bread from the mountain areas of Lombardy, Italy, made with corn flour and sourdough. In its native area it is called "pan giald", meaning "yellow bread".

steps.text: Boil 200 g of water and pour it over the cornmeal in a bowl; mix well with a fork and let it cool to room temperature.
Add the sourdough, wheat flour, salt and the rest of the water; knead until smooth. Cover with a towel and let rise for about 8 hours.
Fold the dough on itself a few times, form into a round loaf and place on a pan covered with baking paper. Make a couple cuts on the surface and let rise for another hour.
Preheat the oven to 240°C, sprinkle the loaf with water and bake for 10 minutes; lower the oven temperature to 160°C and keep baking for 30 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let it rest on a rack to cool down.

recipes.title: Homemade Baharat
recipes.description: A homemade blend of ground spices for baharat.

steps.text: Finely grind all the ingredients using a mill or spice grinder. Mix well.
To intensify the taste, fry the powder in butter before use.

recipes.title: Holiday Soda
recipes.description: A holiday soda with edible pine needles, clementine peel and warming spices, made as a syrup mixed with carbonated water.

ingredients.text: ½ cup (120 ml) edible pine needles (preferably Douglas fir)
ingredients.name: igła sosny jadalnej

ingredients.text: Peel from 3 clementine oranges (or a similar easy-to-peel variety such as tangerines)
ingredients.name: skórka mandarynki
ingredients.note: peel from clementine oranges or similar easy-to-peel variety such as tangerines

steps.text: Wash the pine needle branch and clementines.
Remove the pine needles from the branches and peel the clementines.

Mix the pine needles and clementine peels with the sugar in a container, and let this sit in the fridge for 24 hours. The sugar will extract the liquid from the citrus peels and produce a syrupy liquid.
Boil the cinnamon sticks, cloves, and cardamom pods in the water.
Pour the warm water with boiled spices into the container with pine needles and peels.
Mix the ingredients together and strain the mixture.
To make the finished soda, mix 1 volume of syrup with 5 volumes of carbonated water.

recipes.title: Garlic and Lemon Dressing
recipes.description: A very simple dressing for salad or pasta.

ingredients.text: 1 strip of lemon peel (1 x ½ inch)
ingredients.name: skórka cytrynowa

steps.text: Place the garlic and rosemary on a cutting board and lightly crush with the flat side of a heavy knife.
Put the rosemary, garlic, and lemon peel in a clean bottle with a tight-fitting cap.
Pour in the oil and lemon juice.
Cap the bottle and shake well.

recipes.title: Middle Eastern Lamb Kabobs
recipes.description: Kawałki jagnięciny marynowane w occie winnym, oliwie i przyprawach, grillowane na szaszłykach.

ingredients.text: 1 pound (450 g) leg of lamb (shank end), cut into 1½ inch cubes
ingredients.name: udziec jagnięcy
ingredients.note: shank end, cut into 1½ inch cubes

steps.text: Combine all ingredients except lamb in a gallon size zip-top bag.
Add lamb cubes and toss to coat; refrigerate overnight to marinate.
The next day, drain lamb and discard marinade.
Thread 4 lamb cubes onto one skewer. Repeat until all lamb has been skewered.
Fire up a charcoal grill for 15 minutes.
Add lamb and cook 8 minutes per side for medium rare.
Serve warm with couscous.

recipes.title: Chadian Gilled Fish
recipes.description: Chadian grilled fish is a popular dish in Chad known for its simplicity and flavorful taste. Fresh fish is marinated with local spices, then grilled to perfection.

ingredients.text: Freshly ground black pepper, to taste
ingredients.name: pieprz czarny

ingredients.text: 2 whole fresh fish (such as tilapia or catfish), cleaned and scaled
ingredients.name: ryba świeża (np. tilapia lub sum)
ingredients.note: whole, cleaned and scaled; such as tilapia or catfish

steps.text: Preheat your grill or barbecue to medium-high heat.
In a mixing bowl, combine the vegetable oil, paprika, ginger, garlic, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper. Mix well to form a smooth marinade.

Pat dry the fish with paper towels and place them on a plate or tray. Using a basting brush, generously coat both sides of the fish with the marinade. Make sure to cover the fish thoroughly for maximum flavor.

If desired, you can let the fish marinate in the refrigerator for about 30 minutes to allow the flavors to penetrate. However, this step is optional, and you can proceed directly to grilling if you're short on time.
Once the grill is heated, lightly oil the grates to prevent sticking. You use a folded paper towel soaked in vegetable oil and held with tongs to do so.

Carefully place the marinated fish on the grill and close the lid. Cook for about 4–5 minutes per side, depending on the thickness of the fish, or until the flesh is opaque and easily flakes with a fork. While grilling, you can baste the fish with any remaining marinade using a basting brush for added flavor and moisture.
Once the fish is cooked through and nicely charred, remove from the grill using tongs or a spatula. Be careful not to break the delicate flesh.
Serve hot with lemon wedges on the side for squeezing over the fish. It pairs well with a side of rice or millet and can be accompanied by a fresh salad or steamed vegetables.

recipes.title: Baked Brie in Puff Pastry
recipes.description: Brie zapiekany w cieście francuskim, idealny na przyjęcie. Podawany na ciepło.

ingredients.text: 1 block (10 ounces) Brie cheese, rind removed and brought to room temperature
ingredients.name: ser brie
ingredients.note: 10 ounces, rind removed and brought to room temperature

steps.text: Place block of cheese in the middle of sheet of pastry.
Trim off about ½ inch of pastry, and fold pastry over cheese. When you reach the last fold, brush the fold with beaten egg to seal the pastry together.
Brush top with egg and bake at 375 °F for 15 minutes.
Cool 10 minutes and serve.

recipes.title: Kuih Makmur (Malaysian Peanut Cookies)
recipes.description: Malajskie kruche ciasteczka z orzeszkami ziemnymi, obtoczone w cukrze pudrze.

ingredients.text: 2 oz fried or toasted peanuts, coarsely ground
ingredients.name: orzeszek ziemny

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180°C. Grease or line a baking sheet.
Knead together the flour and ghee until you get a rough dough.
Divide the dough into balls about 2 inches in diameter.
Flatten one of the balls in the palm of your hand, making a little divot in the center.
Spoon about 1–2 tsp peanuts into the center of the dough. Pinch the edges of the dough together to enclose the peanuts, and gently reshape into a ball.
Place the filled cookies on the baking sheet. Bake 15–20 minutes until dried and a very light golden brown.
Carefully remove the hot cookies from the tray, and roll in powdered sugar.
Let cool and serve.

recipes.title: Palm Fruit with Syrup
recipes.description: Thai dessert of palmyra palm fruit in sugar syrup, served cold with ice to cool down in the heat.

steps.text: Peel the palm fruit, and slice it.
Put the water in a pan, add the white sugar, and let it simmer over medium heat.
Add the palm fruit to the syrup, and heat it again.
Add the pandan leaves to the syrup.
Chill the fruit in syrup.
Serve it cold with ice on top.

recipes.title: Bua Loi (Rice Balls in Sweet Coconut Milk)
recipes.description: Traditional Thai rice flour dessert served with coconut milk, often prepared for religious or ritual ceremonies.

ingredients.text: 1 cup steamed and mashed taro root
ingredients.name: taro

steps.text: Combine rice flour, mashed taro, and water to make a dough.
Shape the dough into small balls, using additional rice flour to prevent sticking.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the dough balls to the boiling water. They will initially sink but will gradually float to the surface as they cook.
Remove the cooked bua loi from the pot, and drain the water.
Transfer the bua loi to a dish, and serve with coconut milk. This dish is best served hot.

recipes.title: Sindhi Pulao
recipes.description: Pulao ryżowy w stylu sindhi z cebulą, zielonymi chili, liśćmi curry, orzechami nerkowca i przyprawami.

steps.text: Heat some oil in a pot, and add the onions. Fry until dark brown.
Add the chiles, curry leaves, cashews, garam masala, pepper, chili powder, bay leaf, and salt.
Add the rice and enough water to cook the rice.
Simmer uncovered until all the water is absorbed.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Tiramisu Mousse
recipes.description: This tiramisu mousse is so-called because its flavor profile matches tiramisu.

ingredients.text: 1 cup whipping cream, whipped to soft peaks
ingredients.name: śmietanka

steps.text: Combine mascarpone cheese, sugar, espresso, and eggs. Set aside.
Gently fold in the whipped cream.
Chill until set.
Before serving, dust with cocoa powder.

recipes.title: Efo Riro
recipes.description: Efo Riro is a popular Yoruba vegetable soup made with leafy vegetables, palm oil, peppers, and assorted meats or fish. It is commonly eaten with swallows such as amala, pounded yam, or eba.

ingredients.text: 2 bunches spinach or ugu (pumpkin leaves), chopped
ingredients.name: szpinak

ingredients.text: 500 g assorted meat (beef, goat meat, or chicken)
ingredients.name: mięso wołowe
ingredients.note: assorted meat (beef, goat meat, or chicken)

ingredients.text: 2–3 scotch bonnet peppers (ata rodo), to taste
ingredients.name: papryczka chili
ingredients.note: 2–3 scotch bonnet peppers (ata rodo), to taste

steps.text: Wash and cook the assorted meat with onion, seasoning cubes, and salt until tender.
Add stockfish and continue cooking until soft.
Blend the peppers and onion into a smooth or slightly coarse paste.
Heat palm oil in a pot (do not bleach).
Add the blended pepper mix and fry for about 10–15 minutes until it reduces and thickens.
Add the cooked meat, stockfish, dried fish, and meat stock.
Stir and allow to simmer for 10 minutes.
Add ground crayfish and ogiri if using.
Add chopped vegetables and stir gently.
Allow to cook for 3–5 minutes (do not overcook the vegetables).
Adjust seasoning with salt or seasoning cubes.
Remove from heat and serve hot.

recipes.title: Tea Extract
recipes.description: Tea extract is a highly concentrated version of tea used in various recipes. This recipe attempts to emulate various commercial products that condense tea at a 10:1 ratio.

ingredients.text: 1 tea bag or 1 tsp (5 mL) loose leaf tea
ingredients.name: herbata czarna (liście)
ingredients.note: 1 tea bag or 1 tsp (5 mL) loose leaf tea

steps.text: Boil the water.
Steep the tea bag or loose leaf tea in the water for five minutes.
Remove the tea bag or strain out the tea leaves.
Boil the tea until 90% has evaporated and only 10% of the original volume remains.

recipes.title: Tomato Basil Sausage Pasta
recipes.description: A quick pasta with sausage meat, marinara tomato sauce, milk and fresh basil.

ingredients.text: ½ cup (50 g / 2 oz) fresh basil leaves, chopped
ingredients.name: bazylia świeża

steps.text: Boil the spaghetti in water until al dente.
Meanwhile, cook the sausage meat in a pan over a medium heat for 6 minutes until well browned.
Add the onion, salt, and pepper and cook for a further 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the marinara sauce, milk, and basil, and cook for 2 minutes.
Drain the pasta in a colander and stir into the sauce.
Divide the pasta between 4 plates and serve.

recipes.title: Sindhi Raitha
recipes.description: Sindhijska surówka z jogurtem, cebulą, zielonym chili, pomidorami i amchoorem, podawana schłodzona.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients together.
Serve cool.

recipes.title: Guacamole III
recipes.description: Odmiana guacamole, dobra jako dodatek, przystawka lub do fajitas.

ingredients.text: About ¼ cup cherry, grape, or pear tomatoes halved or quartered, with about ⅛ cup seeded
ingredients.name: pomidor koktajlowy
ingredients.note: halved or quartered, with about ⅛ cup seeded

ingredients.text: 2 jalapeño peppers, 1 seeded and 1 unseeded, diced finely
ingredients.name: papryczka jalapeño

ingredients.text: Kosher salt and extra virgin olive oil to taste
ingredients.name: sól
ingredients.note: kosher salt; extra virgin olive oil to taste

ingredients.text: Kosher salt and extra virgin olive oil to taste
ingredients.name: oliwa z oliwek
ingredients.note: extra virgin olive oil to taste

steps.text: Halve the avocado. Carefully lodge the base end of a chef's knife in the pit, twisting to remove, and then pinching the pit off of the knife.
Remove flesh with large spoon, being careful to maintain the integrity of the flesh. Dice in large chunks and transfer to mixing bowl. Mash to desired consistency.
Add lime, and stir to combine.
Add remaining ingredients, and stir to combine.

recipes.title: Hartshorne Catsup for Sea-stores
recipes.description: Historyczny sos grzybowo-piwny (catsup) z anchois, szalotką i przyprawami, przygotowany przez redukcję i przecedzenie.

ingredients.text: 2 quarts large mushroom flaps, rubbed to pieces
ingredients.name: pieczarki

steps.text: Combine the beer, anchovies, shallots, mace, cloves, peppercorns, ginger, and mushrooms in a pot.
Let simmer until reduced by half.
Strain through cloth, and cool.

recipes.title: Tabbouleh VI
recipes.description: Sałatka tabbouleh z bulgurem, natką pietruszki, pomidorem, szczypiorem, oliwą i sokiem z cytryny.

ingredients.text: 2 cups (480 ml) fresh parsley, finely chopped
ingredients.name: natka pietruszki

ingredients.text: 1 large tomato, diced with seeds discarded
ingredients.name: pomidor

ingredients.text: ⅓ cup (80 ml) extra virgin olive oil
ingredients.name: oliwa z oliwek

ingredients.text: ½ cup (120 ml) fresh lemon juice
ingredients.name: sok z cytryny

steps.text: Boil 2–3 cups of water
Once water comes to a boil, add bulgur wheat and remove from heat. Let cool.
Drain the bulgur wheat, and mix wheat with all other ingredients.
Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Mchemsho
recipes.description: Traditional Tanzanian mixed stew of beef, green bananas, vegetables and spices simmered in a flavorful broth.

ingredients.text: 4 green cooking bananas, peeled and sliced
ingredients.name: banan plantan

steps.text: Place the beef in a large pot and cover with water.
Add half of the onion, half of the ginger, and a pinch of salt.
Simmer until the meat becomes tender, about 1–1½ hours.
Reserve the cooking stock.
Heat the oil in a separate large pot.
Sauté the remaining onion until soft.
Add the garlic and remaining ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomatoes and cook until softened.
Add the cumin, coriander, and turmeric.
Add the potatoes, carrots, green bananas, green beans, cabbage, and bell pepper.
Pour in the reserved stock.
Add the cooked beef.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 30–40 minutes.
Cook until all vegetables are tender.
Season with salt, black pepper, and lime juice.
Garnish with chopped coriander.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Sincronizada (Fried Ham and Cheese Tortilla Sandwich)
recipes.description: Smażona kanapka z tortilli z szynką i serem queso fresco.

steps.text: Heat up some oil in a pan over medium heat.
On a cutting board, with two tortillas, place a slice of deli ham and then queso fresco in the middle, and place another tortilla on top.
When the oil is hot, place the raw sincronizada on the pan and let the first side brown for a few minutes until the outside becomes crispy.
Once the first side is golden brown, flip the sincronizada over and brown the other side to crisp up in the same manner.
After a few more minutes, place the sincronizada on a plate with napkins, and enjoy.

recipes.title: Hazelnut and Black Raspberry Panna Cotta
recipes.description: Panna cotta flavored with hazelnut and black raspberry liqueurs, served with fresh berries or a berry sauce.

steps.text: Heat all ingredients in a saucepan over medium-low heat until gelatin is melted.
Pour into ramekins, and chill until set (usually 6 hours, but they are better left overnight).
Serve with fresh berries or a berry sauce.

recipes.title: Achicha Ede (Cocoyam Porridge)
recipes.description: A traditional Igbo dish of cocoyam cooked with palm oil, vegetables and local seasonings.

ingredients.text: 4 cups dried cocoyam flakes or cocoyam pieces
ingredients.name: suszone płatki taro
ingredients.note: dried cocoyam flakes or cocoyam pieces

ingredients.text: 2 cups leafy vegetables (ugu or scent leaves)
ingredients.name: warzywa liściaste

steps.text: Wash and soak the dried cocoyam flakes in warm water until they soften slightly.
Wash and boil dry fish or stockfish until soft.
In a pot, add water, palm oil, onions, pepper, crayfish, seasoning cubes, and the fish. Bring to a boil.
Add the soaked cocoyam flakes and stir gently.
Allow it to cook until the cocoyam becomes tender and absorbs the flavors.
Stir in the ugba and leafy vegetables.
Let it cook for a few more minutes so everything combines well.
Taste and add salt or seasoning if needed.
Serve as a complete traditional meal.

recipes.title: Vegan Gingerbread Cake
recipes.description: This gingerbread cake is soft and juicy. It can be topped freely as per personal preference but already tastes good on it's own.

ingredients.text: 1 cup (240 ml) all-purpose flour or a 1:1 gluten-free flour blend
ingredients.name: mąka pszenna
ingredients.note: all-purpose flour or a 1:1 gluten-free flour blend

ingredients.text: ⅓ cup (240 ml) granulated cane sugar
ingredients.name: cukier trzcinowy

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoon (15 ml) coconut oil, melted and cooled
ingredients.name: olej kokosowy

steps.text: Combine the flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, salt, and sugar in the large bowl.
Whisk together the almond milk, coconut oil, applesauce, molasses, and vanilla in the medium bowl.
Mix the wet with the dry ingredients successively.
Grease the baking pan and fill it with the batter.
Bake for 12 minutes at 190 °C (375 °F) or until it tests clean when a skewer is inserted into the center.
Cool and unmold the cake.

recipes.title: Bife de Tartaruga (Turtle Steak)
recipes.description: A traditional Cape Verdean dish of turtle meat marinated with garlic, lime juice and spices, then grilled or pan-fried. Beef steak or firm fish may be used instead.

ingredients.text: 500 g turtle meat steak (or substitute beef steak)
ingredients.name: stek z mięsa żółwia

steps.text: Wash and pat dry the meat.
In a bowl, combine garlic, lime juice, vinegar, olive oil, salt, pepper, and paprika.
Rub the marinade thoroughly over the meat.
Cover and refrigerate for 2–4 hours.
Heat a grill or frying pan over medium-high heat.
Cook the steak for 4–6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Add the sliced onion during the final minutes of cooking and sauté until softened.
Remove from heat and allow the steak to rest for a few minutes.
Garnish with chopped parsley before serving.

recipes.title: Homemade Red Wine
recipes.description: A homemade wine made from dark grapes, sugar, and yeast, traditionally prepared during the Christmas season.

ingredients.text: 2 ounces (60 ml) liquid yeast or 2 Tbsp (15 ml) dry yeast granules
ingredients.name: drożdże płynne
ingredients.note: or 2 Tbsp (15 ml) dry yeast granules

ingredients.text: ½–¾ cup (120–180 ml) white sugar for colouring
ingredients.name: cukier do koloryzowania

steps.text: Clean and wash grapes well, removing stalks and any debris.
Crush the grapes until you get a good purple colour.
Place the crushed grapes in a ceramic jar, and mix with 2 kg sugar. Mix in the water, egg whites, yeast, and wheat until well-combined.
Cover with an airtight lid, and let ferment in a cool place for 21 days, stirring well every other day.
Strain the mixture and discard the solids.
Stir the remaining sugar into the liquid, and place back in the fermenting container. Mix well, and keep airtight for another 21 days to ferment.
Filter the wine using a muslin cloth.
Place the sugar for colouring in a heavy bottomed pot over medium heat. Stir until the sugar melts and becomes a dark brown caramel—do not let it burn.
Remove the caramel from the heat, and gradually and carefully stir in 5–7 Tbsp hot water. Let cool slightly.
Stir the caramel syrup into the wine, then transfer the wine into a jar for storage.

recipes.title: Chipotle Lime Grilled Chicken
recipes.description: Grilled chicken breasts marinated in olive oil, chipotle hot sauce, lime juice and honey, then seasoned with a chipotle BBQ rub.

ingredients.text: ¼ cup freshly squeezed lime juice
ingredients.name: sok z limonki

steps.text: Combine all ingredients except for BBQ Rub in a gallon zip-top plastic freezer bag. Add chicken breasts and refrigerate for 45 minutes.
Remove chicken from bag. Season each breast with BBQ Rub.
Place on a preheated charcoal grill and cook, turning often, until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Remove and let rest for 5 minutes.
Serve.

recipes.title: Mutton Broth
recipes.description: Bulion z baraniny z marchewką...

ingredients.text: 3 pounds scrag of fresh mutton neck, cut into several pieces
ingredients.name: szyja baranina

ingredients.text: A few turnips, cut into slices
ingredients.name: rzodkiew

steps.text: Wash the mutton pieces, then place in a pot.
Cover the mutton with the cold water. Bring to a boil, then skim well.
Add the turnips, parsley, thyme, and a little salt.
Boil gently for 1½ hours. Let cool slightly, and skim the fat from the surface.
Strain through a fine sieve to remove the solids.
Cool thoroughly and as quickly as possible to prevent spoilage.
Store in the fridge or freezer until use.

recipes.title: Chleb z czosnkiem
recipes.description: Ciepłe pieczywo z kromkami nasmarowanymi masłem czosnkowym, zapiekane w folii.

ingredients.text: 1 długa bagietka pszenna lub mały bochenek chleba
ingredients.name: bagietka pszenna

ingredients.text: ok. 50 g miękkiego masła (mniej więcej 1/4 kostki)
ingredients.name: masło

ingredients.text: opcjonalnie: 1 łyżka posiekanej natki pietruszki lub suszone zioła (np. oregano, bazylia)
ingredients.name: natka pietruszki
ingredients.note: opcjonalnie; posiekana, lub suszone zioła (np. oregano, bazylia)

steps.text: Nagrzej piekarnik do około 190 °C (grzanie góra‑dół).
Masło pozostaw na kilka minut w temperaturze pokojowej, aby stało się miękkie.
Czosnek obierz i przeciśnij przez praskę lub bardzo drobno posiekaj.
W miseczce wymieszaj masło z czosnkiem, solą i ewentualnie ziołami, aż powstanie jednolita pasta.
Bagietkę lub chleb ponacinaj w kromki, nie przecinając ich do samego spodu, żeby bochenek pozostał w całości.
Każde nacięcie oraz wierzch pieczywa posmaruj przygotowanym masłem czosnkowym.
Bochenek zawiń szczelnie w folię aluminiową.
Wstaw do nagrzanego piekarnika i piecz około 15 minut, aż pieczywo się dobrze ogrzeje, a masło całkowicie się rozpuści.
Podawaj od razu, na gorąco, odrywając kromki rękami.

recipes.title: Maraq
recipes.description: Maraq is a rich and aromatic soup popular across the Horn of Africa, especially in Somalia, Djibouti, Kenya, Ethiopia, and parts of Yemen.

ingredients.text: 500 g (1 lb) lamb, goat, beef, or chicken, cut into pieces
ingredients.name: mięso jagnięce
ingredients.note: lamb, goat, beef, or chicken, cut into pieces

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon xawaash spice blend (optional but traditional)
ingredients.name: mieszanka przypraw xawaash

steps.text: Wash and trim the meat if necessary, then cut it into medium-sized pieces.
Heat oil or ghee in a large pot over medium heat and add the chopped onions, cooking until soft and golden.
Stir in the garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant.
Add the diced tomatoes and cook until softened, then mix in the cumin, coriander, turmeric, black pepper, salt, and xawaash spice blend.
Add the meat to the pot and stir well so it becomes fully coated with the spices.
Cook for about 5–7 minutes until lightly browned.
Pour in the water or stock and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat and allow it to simmer for 45–60 minutes, depending on the type of meat used.
Add the carrots, potatoes, zucchini, and chili pepper, then continue simmering for another 20–25 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Taste the soup and adjust the seasoning if needed.
Garnish with fresh coriander before serving hot.

recipes.title: Slow-Cooked Chicken in Cream Sauce
recipes.description: Whole chicken pieces slow-cooked in a sauce made from cream of chicken soup and cream of celery soup.

ingredients.text: 1 can (10 ounces) condensed cream of chicken soup
ingredients.name: zupa krem z kurczaka w puszce

ingredients.text: 1 can (10 ounces) condensed cream of celery soup
ingredients.name: zupa krem z selera w puszce

steps.text: Put chicken in crock pot.
Mix together cream of chicken soup and cream of celery soup.
Pour soup mixture over chicken in crock pot.
Cook on high for 4 hours or on low for 8 hours.

recipes.title: Gravy Cakes (Hartshorne)
recipes.description: Meat-based cakes, great as sides to a roast dinner or other meat-based meal.

steps.text: Chop 2 legs of beef in pieces, put them into a pot of water, and slow cook for 24 hours.
Add onions, herbs, and spices as for gravy.
Continue stewing until the meat is off the bones, and the gravy has started to develop.
Strain the mixture into a milk-pan, to which quantity it should be reduced.
When cold, skim off the fat, put it into a saucepan, and add any other flavourings as wanted.
Simmer it on a slow heat until reduced to about 12 saucers two-thirds full,
Put them in an airy place till as dry as leather, put them in paper bags, and keep in a dry place.

recipes.title: Almond Gambols
recipes.description: 18th century almond cookies with rosewater, musk and lemon zest, very aromatic.

steps.text: Start pounding the almonds in a marble mortar.
Gradually pound in the sugar a spoonful at a time until it is all incorporated.
Pound in the rosewater, musk, ambergris, and lemon zest until the mixture is a fine paste.
Pinch off balls and roll them in some additional sugar, then place on parchment-lined sheets.
Bake in a slow oven (275–300°F/135–150°C) until dried through.

recipes.title: Marinated Mackerel
recipes.description: Makrela marynowana w occie, zapiekana w piekarniku, podawana na zimno.

steps.text: Clean and scale fish. Place in a baking dish large enough for the fish and vinegar.
Mix other ingredients, except vinegar, with salt to taste, and pour over fish.
Pour over enough vinegar to cover well.
Place in moderate oven for 40–50 minutes.
Lift fish carefully onto serving dish, and strain liquor over top.
Let cool and serve.

ingredients.text: 24 chicken wings, tips removed, cut in half at the joint
ingredients.name: skrzydełko kurczaka
ingredients.note: tips removed, cut in half at the joint

ingredients.text: 2 ½ quarts peanut or canola oil
ingredients.name: olej arachidowy

steps.text: Combine sauce and liquid smoke. Set aside.
Season chicken evenly with seasoning. Set aside.
Heat oil to 350°F. Add chicken, and working in batches, deep fry for 10–12 minutes or golden brown, crisp, and cooked through to 165°F.
Remove chicken and drain on a cooling rack.
Toss with sauce mixture. Serve warm with blue cheese dressing.

recipes.title: Rosemary Garlic Oil
recipes.description: Infused oils like this rosemary garlic oil can be easily made in your own home.

ingredients.text: ½ gallon any flavorless high-smoke point oil, such as canola, grapeseed, peanut, or safflower
ingredients.name: olej roślinny
ingredients.note: any flavorless high-smoke point oil, such as canola, grapeseed, peanut, or safflower

steps.text: Heat the oil in your tallest largest pot over low heat.
Add remaining ingredients and warm for 1 hour.
Strain and keep in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Oat Rice
recipes.description: Prosty ugotowany ryż na mleku owsianym zamiast wody.

steps.text: Wash the rice and drain the water.
Pour the oat milk and rice into a pot.
Put the pot on the stove, and cook over medium heat for about 5 minutes or until foam appears.
Start stirring the mixture with a spoon, and continue stirring until the mixture boils.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, stirring, until almost all the liquid is gone.
Remove from the heat and serve.
Combine all ingredients.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Crumble III
recipes.description: A classic rhubarb crumble with a buttery, brown sugar topping baked until golden.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 190°C (375°F / gas mark 5).
Cut the rhubarb into pieces and stew for a short time with the caster sugar and water until tender.
While the rhubarb is stewing, combine the flour and butter in a bowl until it resembles fine breadcrumbs.
Stir in the brown sugar.
Place the cooked rhubarb in a deep pie dish (1 L / 2 pt).
Spoon over the crumble topping and spread out evenly.
Bake crumble for about 25 mins until the crumble is golden brown.

recipes.title: Rolex (Ugandan Flatbread-Rolled Omelet)
recipes.description: Rolex ("rolled eggs") is a vegetable-filled omelet wrapped in a chapati flatbread. It is best enjoyed when hot and can be eaten for almost any meal.

ingredients.text: 1 medium-sized cabbage, finely chopped or grated
ingredients.name: kapusta biała

ingredients.text: ½ tablespoon salt or to taste
ingredients.name: sól

steps.text: Heat a pan over medium heat.
Crack the eggs in a medium sized bowl. Whisk in the onions, tomato, cabbage, coriander, salt, and pepper.
Add 1 tablespoon of the oil to the hot pan, and pour in half the egg mixture. Allow it to cook for about 3 minutes.
When the top is only a little wet, place a chapati over it.
Flip the omelette and chapati over so the chapati is at the bottom. Allow the chapati to warm for 2 minutes.
Roll the omelet up with the chapati on the outside.
Wrap in foil and serve it immediately.
Repeat the steps above with the remaining egg mixture and chapati.

recipes.title: Plain Kefir
recipes.description: Prosty kefir przygotowany z ziaren kefirowych i świeżego mleka.

ingredients.text: 50 grams (1¾ oz) of kefir grains (see note)
ingredients.name: ziarna kefirowe

steps.text: Remove kefir grains from previous batch of starter, using a sieve or colander.
Shake kefir grains to remove excess kefir. Rinsing is not necessary (but optionally, rinse in fresh milk).
Place kefir grains in glass jar or jug with fresh milk. Generally, keep a ratio of kefir grains to milk of about 1:10 or 5% w/w.
Set aside to ferment at room temperature (18–22°C) for 12–24 hours (see notes) until a smooth yoghurt-like consistency develops.

recipes.title: Microwave Oat Porridge
recipes.description: A simple oat porridge cooked in the microwave.

steps.text: Mix water, oat flakes, and salt in a bowl.
Boil on high heat for 2–3 minutes.
Stir and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Thin Waffles
recipes.description: These waffles can be served straight away or used to make waffle cake.

steps.text: Crack the eggs into a mixing bowl, and add the sugar.
Gradually stir the flour into the egg mixture.
Then, gradually mix in the melted butter.
Heat the waffle iron according to the manufacturer's directions until it is ready.
Ladle a sufficient amount of batter onto the waffle iron—it should just barely cover the surface.
Close the iron, and cook until the waffle is medium-brown (about 2 minutes).
Remove the cooked waffle from the iron.
Repeat the waffle cooking process until you have used up all the waffle batter.
Serve waffles on their own, or use to make waffle cake.

recipes.title: Stuffing
recipes.description: Farsz z suszonym chlebem i ziołami, do drobiu lub w formie placuszków.

ingredients.text: 4 slices of white bread (just slightly stale is best)
ingredients.name: chleb tostowy biały

steps.text: Trim crusts off bread and place slices into a large mixing bowl.
Add water and all other ingredients, and with the hands, work the mixture until it is thoroughly combined.

The stuffing may be cooked by packing it into the washed cavity of chicken or turkey, prior to roasting, or by forming the stuffing into patties and placing on a greased tray in an oven (moderate temperature).

recipes.title: Pasta with Sausage
recipes.description: Spaghetti cooked together with sausages, tossed with butter and pasta sauce or ketchup.

steps.text: Bring 2 liters water to a boil, and add salt.
Add the spaghetti to the boiling water, and cook for 3 minutes.
Add sausages to pasta, and boil for 5 minutes.
Drain water.
Add butter to the pasta, then mix in sauce or ketchup.
Serve.

recipes.title: Fried Bacon and Egg Sandwich (Homemade Egg McMuffin)
recipes.description: This egg sandwich recipe mimics the Egg McMuffin.

steps.text: Get your English muffins ready to toast.
Over medium heat, fry bacon in one layer, turning often until browned and crispy to your taste.
Lower the heat if the bacon fat starts to spatter.
Remove the bacon to a plate lined with paper towels.
Pat the bacon with another sheet of paper towel to remove some of the excess fat.
Pour most of the remaining fat from the pan into a teacup, leaving most of the brown bits in the pan.
Wash and dry the pan, and put it back on the heat.
Pour about a tablespoon of the bacon fat back into the pan.
Start toasting the English muffins.
Crack eggs into the pan, add salt and pepper, and fry for about 2 minutes.
Break the yolks, spreading them over the whites, and flip the eggs. Fry for another minute.
Assemble your sandwiches with the English muffins, bacon, and fried eggs. Serve.

recipes.title: Grilled Pork Loin
recipes.description: Boneless pork loin rubbed with Dijon mustard, cider vinegar and barbecue rub, then grilled until cooked through.

steps.text: Combine mustard and vinegar, and rub all over pork.
Coat pork evenly with the Barbecue Rub.
Grill on a preheated grill, turning often until internal temperature reaches 145°F (63˚C).
Remove and let rest for 10 minutes.
Serve.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Pork Marinade
recipes.description: A marinade for pork made from chicken broth, red wine, lime juice, dark honey, salt, garlic powder and black pepper.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in a large mason jar. Keep refrigerated for up to 2 weeks.

recipes.title: Honey Bourbon Marinade
recipes.description: Marynata miodowo-bourbonowa do mięs.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in a mason jar or a gallon-size zip-top bag.
Refrigerate for up to 2 weeks.

recipes.title: Hazelnut Meringue
recipes.description: Hazelnut meringue that can be piped as small cookies or larger discs, for example as a base for a pavlova.

ingredients.text: 1 lb (500 g) skinned hazelnuts, finely chopped
ingredients.name: orzechy laskowe

steps.text: Whip the egg whites to soft peaks.
Gradually beat in the caster sugar, little by little, and continue whipping to form stiff peaks.
Fold in the confectioners' sugar and nuts, working carefully to avoid deflating the egg whites.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. With a pencil, draw circles of the desired diameter using a plate or cake tin.
Using a pastry bag with a ½-inch plain round tip, pipe a spiral, starting at the centre of the circles, working outward toward the edge forming a disc about ½ inch thick.
Bake at 250°F (120°C) until crisp and very lightly browned, 1½ to 2 hours.

recipes.title: Vanilla Fudge II
recipes.description: A fancy fudge with marshmallow crème, white chocolate and pecans.

steps.text: Line a baking tray with foil (extending it beyond the tray), and grease it up with some butter.
In the saucepan, combine the sugar, milk, and butter.
Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly.
Cook for 5 minutes after reaching the boiling point, stirring the mixture constantly so it doesn't burn.
Remove it from the heat.
Add the marshmallow crème, white chocolate, pecans, and the vanilla extract. Stir the mixture until smooth.
Pour into the tray, and leave to cool to room temperature.
Refrigerate until firm, then cut into pieces.
Enjoy!

recipes.title: Fit-fit (Ethiopian Bread Salad)
recipes.description: Fit-fit, also known as Ethiopian bread salad, is a delightful and flavorful dish made with torn pieces of injera (Ethiopian flatbread) tossed in a zesty dressing. This salad is a popular breakfast or brunch option in Ethiopian cuisine and is perfect for using up leftover injera.

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons niter kibbeh (Ethiopian spiced clarified butter) or regular butter
ingredients.name: masło
ingredients.note: niter kibbeh (Ethiopian spiced clarified butter) or regular butter

ingredients.text: 1 jalapeño pepper, seeded and finely chopped (optional for spice)
ingredients.name: papryczka jalapeño
ingredients.note: seeded and finely chopped (optional for spice)

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon berbere spice blend, or to taste
ingredients.name: mieszanka przypraw berbere

ingredients.text: 4-6 pieces of leftover injera, torn into bite-sized pieces
ingredients.name: injera

ingredients.text: Fresh cilantro or parsley, chopped, for garnish
ingredients.name: kolendra świeża

steps.text: Heat the niter kibbeh or regular butter in a large skillet or frying pan over medium heat.
Add the finely chopped onion to the pan and sauté until translucent and slightly browned.
Stir in the diced tomatoes and jalapeño pepper (if using) and cook for a few minutes until the tomatoes start to soften.
Sprinkle the berbere spice blend over the mixture and mix well to coat the onions and tomatoes. Adjust the amount of berbere according to your preferred level of spiciness.
Add the torn pieces of injera to the pan and gently toss them with the onion and tomato mixture.
Sauté the mixture for a few minutes, stirring occasionally, until the injera is heated through and slightly crispy.
Season with salt to taste. Keep in mind that injera can be slightly sour, so adjust the salt accordingly.
Remove from heat and transfer to a serving dish. Garnish with freshly chopped cilantro or parsley.
Serve warm as a delicious and satisfying breakfast or brunch option.

recipes.title: Tequila Lime Strip Steak
recipes.description: Grillowany stek z polędwicy wołowej marynowany w tequili, soku z limonki i oliwie.

steps.text: Combine liquid ingredients and salt in a gallon zip-top freezer bag. Add steaks and squeeze as much air out as possible. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
Remove steaks from marinade and discard extra. Place steak rub in a pie pan and add steaks, pressing lightly to help adhesion on both sides.
Spray cold grill grate with nonstick cooking spray. Set up for direct and indirect heat and add some soaked mesquite chips to the coals.
Place steaks on hottest part of grill and cook for 2–3 minutes per side.
Move to the cooler part of the grill and cook, turning once, until internal temperature reaches 10° cooler than your preferred doneness.
Remove and let rest for 7 minutes.
Slice thinly across the grain on a bias and serve.

recipes.title: Zambian Beans and Rice
recipes.description: A wholesome staple of Zambian cuisine: beans and rice make a complete and satisfying meal.

ingredients.text: 1 cup dried beans (black-eyed peas or kidney beans), soaked overnight
ingredients.name: fasola sucha
ingredients.note: black-eyed peas or kidney beans, soaked overnight

steps.text: In a large pot, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the pot. Sauté until the onions are soft and translucent.
Add the diced tomato and chopped hot pepper (if using) to the pot. Cook until the tomatoes are soft and slightly reduced.
Drain and rinse the soaked beans, then add them to the pot with the sautéed vegetables.
Pour in the water and season with salt to taste. Stir well to combine all the ingredients.

Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and let it simmer for about 1–1.5 hours, or until the beans are tender and fully cooked. Stir occasionally during cooking to prevent sticking and to ensure even cooking of the beans.
In a separate pot, cook the rice according to your preferred method.
Once the beans are tender and the rice is cooked, serve hot. You can mix the beans and rice together or serve them side by side on the plate.

recipes.title: Egg Noodles I
recipes.description: Homemade egg noodles that can be served with a variety of pasta sauces, such as pesto sauce.

steps.text: In a bowl beat together eggs, salt, olive oil, and wine.
Stir in 1 cup flour with fork.
Gently add second cup of flour after the first is mixed thoroughly.
Remove mixture from bowl and place on a lightly floured work surface.
Knead in the last cup of flour a bit at a time. If the dough becomes too dry, add a bit of cold water.
Continue kneading until the dough is uniform and shiny in appearance.
Roll into a large ball and cut into quarters. Overturn the mixing bowl over the cut pieces to protect from dust and drying out.
Let dough relax for approx. 30 minutes.
Shape noodles as desired (see notes).
To cook, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a rolling boil. Add rolled and cut noodles to the water and cook to al dente.

recipes.title: Kachumbari
recipes.description: Fresh East African salad made from tomatoes, onions, and chile peppers, often served as a side dish with grilled meats, rice dishes, bread, or stews.

steps.text: Gently toss together all the ingredients in a mixing bowl until well-distributed.
Allow the salad to rest for 5–10 minutes.
Taste the salad and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve fresh.

recipes.title: Oaties
recipes.description: Kruche ciasteczka owsiane z melasą, pieczone w dwóch okrągłych formach.

steps.text: Put the butter or margarine, sugar, and treacle into a saucepan.
Stir over low heat until the fat and sugar have melted.
Add the oats, flour, and baking powder and combine thoroughly.
Press into two well greased 7-inch round cake tins.
Bake in the centre of a moderate oven at 180°C (350°F / gas mark 4) for 20–25 minutes or until cooked through (test with a skewer).
Mark into slices whilst warm.
Allow to become almost cold in the tin before removing.

recipes.title: Onion Salt
recipes.description: Onion salt is a flavorful seasoning made by combining dried onion powder with salt.

steps.text: In a blender or food processor, add the dried onion flakes.
Pulse or blend the onion flakes until they turn into a fine powder-like consistency.
In a bowl, combine the powdered onion with the salt.
Mix the onion powder and salt thoroughly until well incorporated.
Store the onion salt in an airtight container in a cool, dry place.
Label the container with the date of preparation.

recipes.title: Quick Tomato Noodle Soup
recipes.description: A quick soup made with instant noodles, fresh tomatoes, sausages and onion.

ingredients.text: 2 packages instant ramen or udon noodles with flavoring mix
ingredients.name: makaron ramen instant
ingredients.note: instant ramen or udon noodles with flavoring mix

steps.text: Bring 1.5 liters of water to a boil.
Add noodles to boiling water with one of flavoring packets.
Add chopped tomatoes and sausages. Boil for 5 minutes.
Add chopped onion and serve.

recipes.title: Coconut Rice (Indonesian)
recipes.description: Indonesian coconut rice cooked in coconut milk with shallots, ginger, fenugreek seed and pandan leaves.

steps.text: Rinse and drain the rice.
Put all ingredients in a skillet or saucepan; make sure the rice is submerged in the coconut milk by 2 cm.
Cover the pan and allow to cook over medium-low heat until the liquid is absorbed.
Remove the pandan leaves.
Pour the rest of the coconut milk over the rice.
Allow to rest for 15 minutes at room temperature, then serve.

recipes.title: Creamy Cornstarch Scrambled Eggs
recipes.description: Creamy scrambled eggs made with a cornstarch and milk mixture and cooked in butter.

steps.text: In a cup, whisk together the milk and cornstarch until it is free of lumps.
Add the cornstarch mixture to your eggs, and beat until smooth. Season with salt.
Heat a non-stick skillet over high heat until hot, then add the butter—it should sizzle right away.
Wait until the butter's melted and bubbly, but before it browns. Add the beaten eggs. Wait without stirring anything, until the edges of the eggs start to bubble up (about 3 seconds).

Remove the skillet from the heat. Start stirring the eggs, making 1 full circle per second, for about 11–12 seconds. The eggs will have absorbed all the butter but remain partially undercooked. Do not wait until they look fully cooked!
Transfer them onto a plate.
Season with black pepper to taste and serve.

recipes.title: Garlic Croutons III
recipes.description: Grzanki czosnkowe pieczone w piekarniku, a następnie podsmażone na oliwie z przyprawami.

ingredients.text: 1 stale loaf Italian bread, cut into 2-inch (5 cm) cubes
ingredients.name: chleb włoski

steps.text: Place cubes on a greased baking sheet and bake at 400°F (200°C) until thoroughly dried.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Add seasonings and combine with oil.
Add bread cubes and toss to coat.
Cook until crisp.
Remove and set aside until needed.

recipes.title: Zambian Vegetable Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Zambian vegetable stir-fry is a flavorful and nutritious dish that showcases a medley of fresh vegetables cooked to perfection.

ingredients.text: 1 cup chibwabwa (pumpkin leaves), chopped (or other indigenous greens)
ingredients.name: liście dyni

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon sesame oil (optional, for added flavor)
ingredients.name: olej sezamowy

steps.text: Heat the vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the thinly sliced onion and minced garlic to the hot oil. Stir-fry until the onions are translucent and fragrant.
