Toss in the julienned carrot, thinly sliced red bell pepper, green bell pepper, and yellow bell pepper. Stir-fry for a few minutes until the vegetables are slightly tender but still retain their crispness.

Add the shredded cabbage, chibwabwa (or other indigenous greens), and masau (if using) to the wok. Continue stir-frying for another few minutes until the vegetables are cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Season the stir-fry with salt and ground black pepper to taste. Be mindful not to over-salt, as the soy sauce will also contribute to the dish's saltiness.
Drizzle the soy sauce over the stir-fry and toss the vegetables to coat them evenly. If using sesame oil, add it now for an extra layer of flavor.
Stir-fry for another minute or so to allow the flavors to meld.
Remove the wok from the heat and serve the Zambian vegetable stir-fry hot as a delightful and nutritious side dish.

recipes.title: Ivorian Grilled Chicken
recipes.description: This is a spicy, delicious chicken meal.

ingredients.text: 3 tablespoons chile powder or 20 fresh puréed red habanero chillies
ingredients.name: chili w proszku
ingredients.note: or 20 fresh puréed red habanero chillies

steps.text: Combine the garlic, pepper, chili powder, mustard, and bouillon cubes.
Pour the mixture over the chicken and massage it very well.
Let rest for about 20 minutes while you prepare the grill.
Place the chicken on the grill, turning it regularly until each piece become golden brown.
When it is done to your taste, serve with any complimentary side such as Ivorian tomato sauce or Ivorian salad and enjoy.

recipes.title: Roti Jala (Malaysian Lacy Pancakes)
recipes.description: Thin and lacy Malaysian pancakes, typically served with savory dishes like curries. This version uses water instead of coconut milk.

ingredients.text: A few drops of food coloring (desired color; optional)
ingredients.name: barwnik spożywczy

steps.text: Combine all the ingredients in a blender, and blend until you get a well-combined batter. Over-blending will produce excess foam.
Let the batter rest for 30 minutes.
Transfer the batter to a squeeze-bottle with a nozzle (see notes).
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
If necessary, use a paper towel to lightly grease the pan with some oil.
Use the squeeze bottle to drizzle batter over the surface of the pan in a swirling, lacy pattern.
Let the pancake cook just until dry—avoid excessive coloration.
Remove from the pan, transfer to a plate, and roll or fold up.
Repeat the cooking process until you have used up all the batter.
Serve warm.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Roast Pork Loin with Gravy
recipes.description: If you look up comfort food in the dictionary, you'll see a picture of this dish.

ingredients.text: 2 cups apple cider vinegar, brought to a boil
ingredients.name: ocet jabłkowy

steps.text: Combine salt, honey, vinegar, peppercorns, thyme, and ice. Pour into a gallon-size zip-top bag and add roast. Refrigerate 3–3½ hours.
Drain roast and pat dry with paper towels. Coat roast liberally with olive oil.
Place on a roasting rack set in a large roasting pan. Insert a probe thermometer and bake in the center of a 425°F oven until internal temperature reaches 140°F.
Pour drippings from pan and reserve. Keep roast warm at 200°F.
Skim fat from drippings and pour 2 tablespoons into a large saucepan. Heat over medium high heat. Add flour and cook, whisking continuously, until mixture turns blond in color.
Add skimmed drippings and chicken broth and bring to a boil. Cook until slightly thickened.
Reduce heat to low and cook until slightly thinner than desired consistency. If the gravy gets too thick, add some more chicken broth.
Slice pork as thick or as thin as you like, and drizzle with gravy.

recipes.title: Ofe Egusi
recipes.description: Ofe Egusi is a popular Igbo soup made from ground melon seeds (egusi), palm oil, and assorted meats or fish. It is rich, thick, and commonly served with fufu, pounded yam, or eba.

ingredients.text: 500 g assorted meat (beef, goat meat, or chicken)
ingredients.name: mięso mieszane
ingredients.note: assorted meat (beef, goat meat, or chicken)

ingredients.text: 1 bunch bitterleaf or spinach (optional, for variation)
ingredients.name: bitterleaf lub szpinak

steps.text: Wash and cook the assorted meat with onion, seasoning cubes, and salt until tender.
Add stockfish and continue cooking until soft.
In a bowl, mix ground egusi with a small amount of water to form a thick paste.
Heat palm oil in a pot (do not bleach), then add a little onion if desired.
Scoop small portions of the egusi paste into the hot oil and allow it to fry lightly without stirring too much.
Gradually add meat stock and stir gently to form a thick base.
Add dried fish, crayfish, pepper, and ogiri (if using).
Allow the soup to simmer for 10–15 minutes.
Add vegetables (bitterleaf or spinach) and stir gently.
Adjust seasoning with salt and seasoning cubes.
Simmer for another 3–5 minutes, then remove from heat.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Kwacoco (Cameroonian Steamed Taro Bundles)
recipes.description: Cameroonian steamed taro bundles filled with smoked fish, smoked turkey and spinach, wrapped in banana leaves.

ingredients.name: wędzony indyk
ingredients.catalogName: Indyk wędzony, bez kości i skóry, jasne lub ciemne mięso

steps.text: In a medium pot, combine the bouillon powder, smoked fish, crayfish, chile pepper, and turkey. Cover with water, and bring to a boil. Cook for 3–5 minutes. Set aside the stock for later use.
Cut the cocoyam into large chunks, rinse right away to avoid discoloration, and soak in cool water until needed.
Either grate the cocoyam or pulse it in a food processor until almost but not completely smooth.
Combine the cooked fish, turkey, spinach, red oil, salt, and country onion spice in a large bowl. Add a little stock as necessary.
Cut the banana leaves into rectangles, removing any undesirable edges. Clean them, drain them, and pat them dry.
Heat the banana leaves over an open flame to wilt them and make them flexible.

Place around 1–2 cups of the above mixture on one leaf. Swiftly fold banana leaves over the filling, pressing the sides into a rectangle form while pressing inward to prevent any filling from leaking out. Fold the sides in twice to seal. Repeat this step with the remaining filling and banana leaves.

Place a rack or steamer inside a large pot with a few inches of boiling water. Line with banana leaves, and place the wrapped bundles in the steamer. Steam for about an hour, adding more water as needed.
Unwrap the kwacoco to serve.

recipes.title: Sabaayad
recipes.description: Sabaayad (also called Kimis) is a traditional Somali flatbread. It is a layered bread commonly eaten for breakfast or served with tea, honey, soups, curries, and meat stews throughout Somalia and the Horn of Africa.

ingredients.text: Additional oil for layering and frying
ingredients.name: olej roślinny

steps.text: Combine the flour and salt in a large bowl.
Add the oil and mix thoroughly.
Gradually add the warm water and knead until a soft, smooth dough forms.
Continue kneading for 5–10 minutes.
Cover the dough and allow it to rest for 30 minutes.
Divide the dough into 8 equal portions and shape into balls.
Roll each ball into a thin circle.
Brush the surface lightly with oil.
Fold the dough into a square and roll it out again.
Heat a lightly oiled griddle or frying pan over medium heat.
Cook each sabaayad until golden brown on both sides, turning once.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Chicken Broth II
recipes.description: Clear chicken broth made by simmering a whole chicken or chicken parts with a carrot and parsley, then chilling it to remove the fat.

ingredients.text: 1 whole chicken (without gizzards) or 3 pounds (1.3 kg) chicken parts
ingredients.name: kurczak
ingredients.note: without gizzards, or 3 pounds (1.3 kg) chicken parts

steps.text: Place ingredients in a large stock pot and cover with water.
Bring to a boil, then simmer for 4 hours or until chicken is falling off the bone.
Strain broth into another pot and let cool.
Place pot in refrigerator for 24 hours. Fat will rise to the top and congeal.
Remove the fat.
If desired, remove meat from the chicken parts.
Add it back into the soup or make chicken tacos (be careful to remove all the bones).

recipes.title: Bliny pszenno-gryczane
recipes.description: Drożdżowe bliny z mąki pszennej i gryczanej, podawane z masłem, śmietaną lub kawiorem.

steps.text: Na 5-6 godzin przed smażeniem blinów wymieszać ciasto z mąki pszennej, wody, drożdży i łyżki roztopionego masła.
Dokładnie wymieszać i ubić.
Odstawić w ciepłe miejsce do wyrośnięcia.
Gdy ciasto wyrośnie (po 2-3 godzinach), ubić ponownie.
Dodać sól, cukier i szklankę mąki gryczanej.
Ponownie odstawić do wyrośnięcia.
Na godzinę przed smażeniem dodać 1,5-2 szklanki gorącego mleka.
Dokładnie wymieszać.
Gdy ciasto wyrośnie, nie mieszać już więcej.
Dużą łyżką nakładać ciasto na patelnię.
Bliny można piec w piekarniku (wtedy się ich nie przewraca) lub smażyć na kuchence.
Gdy zaczną podnosić się i rumienić, polewa się je stopionym masłem, a następnie przewraca na drugą stronę.

recipes.title: Honey Teriyaki Spareribs
recipes.description: Żeberka wieprzowe w wersji azjatyckiej, z sosem sojowym, miodem i marmoladą pomarańczową.

ingredients.text: Grill Seasoning for Chops, as needed
ingredients.name: przyprawa do grillowania

steps.text: Shake the grill seasoning on ribs and gently massage into meat. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Combine remaining ingredients. Refrigerate until needed.
Place ribs into a large foil pouch. Pour in soy mixture and tilt to evenly distribute. Tightly crimp the edges to seal.
Bake at 250°F for 5 hours.
Snip foil pouch over a large saucepan to release liquid. Degrease and bring liquid to a boil over high heat for 5 minutes.
Brush generously on one side of ribs and either grill glaze side down over high heat or place glaze side up under a preheated broiler until nicely browned.
Slice into 1-rib portions and toss with some of the remaining soy mixture. Serve.

recipes.title: Ikokore
recipes.description: Ikokore is a traditional Nigerian dish from the Ijebu and Ilaje communities of southwestern Nigeria, made from grated water yam cooked in a richly seasoned broth with fish, seafood, palm oil and spices.

steps.text: Peel and wash the water yam.
Grate the water yam into a bowl and set aside.
Clean and prepare the fish and any seafood being used.
Chop the onion and measure out the remaining ingredients.
Pour water or fish stock into a large pot and bring to a boil.
Add palm oil, onions, pepper, crayfish, seasoning cubes, and salt.
Add the fish and cook for several minutes.
Gradually add the grated water yam in small portions, stirring gently.
Allow the mixture to cook on medium heat until the yam thickens and absorbs the broth.
Add periwinkles or shrimp if using.
Continue cooking for 10–15 minutes, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking.
Adjust seasoning and remove from heat when the dish reaches a soft, thick consistency.

recipes.title: Hopping John with Pinto or Great Northern Beans
recipes.description: Tradycyjne południowoamerykańskie danie z fasolą, ryżem i boczkiem.

steps.text: Wash the beans well and soak overnight in water to cover.
In the morning add 2 cups more water. Simmer until tender.
Fry the salt pork until crisp, remove from the fat, and add to the beans.
Brown the onion in the salt pork fat.
Mix all the ingredients, and add salt and pepper to taste.
Continue cooking for 10 minutes.
And serve at once.

categories: Recipes using vegetable broth and stock

recipes.title: Chikwanda (Zambian Sweet Potato Stew)
recipes.description: Chikwanda is a Zambian stew that showcases the natural sweetness of sweet potatoes in a rich and savory sauce.

ingredients.text: 2 large sweet potatoes, peeled and diced
ingredients.name: batat

steps.text: In a large pot, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the pot. Sauté until the onions are soft and translucent.
Add the diced tomato and chopped hot pepper (if using) to the pot. Cook until the tomato is soft and tender.
Stir in the ground cumin, ground cayenne pepper, and ground turmeric, coating the vegetables with the spices.
Add the diced sweet potatoes and sliced carrot to the pot. Mix well with the spiced vegetables.
Pour in the vegetable broth or water, ensuring that the sweet potatoes and carrots are mostly submerged.
Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer and cover the pot with a lid.
Let the stew cook for about 20–25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sweet potatoes and carrots are tender and cooked through.
Season the stew with salt to taste, adjusting the seasoning according to your preference.
Remove the pot from the heat and let the stew rest for a few minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Turkey Wrap
recipes.description: Tortille z indykiem, czarnymi oliwkami i pastą pomidorową, zapiekane w piekarniku.

steps.text: Cut the olives in half.
Cut the turkey into ¾-inch chunks.
Mix the olives and tomato paste.
Mix in turkey, adding as much as will be covered by the paste.
Optionally, warm the mixture.
Place some of the mixture on a tortilla.
Wrap the tortilla around the mixture.
Place the finished wrap on an ungreased cookie sheet, with the exposed edge (flap) downward to prevent the wrap from coming undone before it is cooked.
Keep making wraps as needed.
Place the cookie sheet in an oven set to 350°F.
Remove the wraps when they start to brown, which should be about 15 minutes.
Let the wraps cool a bit on the outside while heat sinks into the inside.

recipes.title: Sev Puri (Crispy Indian Snack with Potato)
recipes.description: Crispy puris filled with boiled potato, tamarind and coriander chutneys, onion and sev.

ingredients.text: ½ tsp red chile pepper (lal mirchi)
ingredients.name: papryczka chili

steps.text: Arrange the puris on a plate, and make a hole in the center of each puri.
Fill with a few chopped boiled potato cubes.
Add about ¼ tsp of tamarind and green chutneys in each.
Sprinkle with cumin powder, salt, red chilli powder.
Sprinkle finely chopped onions over top, then generously sprinkle sev all over the puris.
Garnish with finely chopped coriander.
Serve fresh.

recipes.title: Brown Rice Breakfast Bowl
recipes.description: A simple breakfast bowl of brown rice, oat milk, dates, cinnamon and pumpkin seeds.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients, and serve.

recipes.title: Grenadine
recipes.description: Grenadine is a pomegranate syrup used in various drinks, both alcoholic and nonalcoholic.

steps.text: Mix the juice and sugar in a pot or saucepan.
Boil the juice and sugar, stirring constantly, until it becomes a thick and viscous syrup resembling dark honey.
Remove from the heat, and let it cool.

recipes.title: Coconut Crusted Baked Cod
recipes.description: Cod fillets marinated in coconut milk with soy, sesame oil, ginger and chili flakes, baked and garnished with toasted coconut and mint.

steps.text: In a bowl, combine coconut milk, soy sauce, sesame oil, pepper flakes, ginger, and pepper.
Marinate cod in this mixture for 15 minutes.
Place fillets on an oiled baking pan.
Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes or until flaky.
Garnish with coconut flakes and fresh mint.

recipes.title: Date soda
recipes.description: Date soda is a beverage made from date syrup and carbonated water.

steps.text: Combine syrup and carbonated water until evenly mixed.
Serve cold.

recipes.title: Dry Rub Barbecue Ribs
recipes.description: Ribs of various animals are consumed around the world. This recipe will teach you how to make dry rub barbecue ribs.

steps.text: Combine liquid ingredients and place in a spray bottle. Spray liberally onto one side of ribs.
Coat moistened side of ribs with Rub. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Place applewood in the firebox of a 250°F smoker or the coal area of a 250°F charcoal grill set for indirect heat.
Place ribs in smoker or grill and cook, spraying often with remaining mixture, for 5–6 hours.
Remove and place on a medium-high heat charcoal grill, seasoned side down, spraying constantly until well-browned.
Remove and let rest for 5 minutes and serve.

recipes.title: Garlic Asparagus
recipes.description: Szparagi sauté z czosnkiem i cebulą, podawane na ciepło jako dodatek.

ingredients.text: 1 pound fresh asparagus, trimmed of tough ends
ingredients.name: szparag

steps.text: Melt butter with olive oil in a large straight-sided sauté pan over medium high heat.
Add onion and cook, stirring, until translucent.
Add garlic and cook, stirring, until golden.
Add a pinch of salt and some freshly ground black pepper, and cook 1 more minute.
Add asparagus and season mixture liberally with kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper. Sauté until asparagus is lightly browned around edges.
Check for taste and adjust seasoning if desired. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Wine Glazed Pork Chops
recipes.description: Grillowane schabowe z karkówki (żeberka) w glazurze z czerwonego wina i masła.

ingredients.text: 4 thick cut bone-in pork rib chops
ingredients.name: kotlet wieprzowy z kością

steps.text: Brush pork chops generously with cider vinegar.
Season pork with chop rub, patting down slightly.
Bring wine to a boil over high heat in a large saucepan, and ignite it.
Cook wine until reduced by half.
Add butter, 1 tbsp at a time while whisking, until all butter has melted.
Grill pork chops over high heat 2 minutes, brushing with wine mixture, then rotate 90° and cook for 2 minutes, brushing.
Flip to the other side and repeat 1 more time.
Remove and let rest 5 minutes.
Serve with remaining wine mixture.

recipes.title: Sałatka gyros
recipes.description: Warstwowa sałatka z kurczakiem, kukurydzą, ogórkami, kapustą pekińską i majonezem.

ingredients.text: 2–3 pomidory pokrojone w plastry lub kostki opcjonalnie (warstwa)
ingredients.name: pomidor
ingredients.note: 2–3; pokrojone w plastry lub kostki; opcjonalnie; warstwa

ingredients.text: 1 łyżeczka przyprawy gyros na surowego kurczaka
ingredients.name: przyprawa gyros

steps.text: Piersi kurczaka pokroić w kostkę, oprószyć przyprawą gyros, smażyć 10–15 minut.
Kapustę pekińską poszatkować.
Ostudzone kawałki kurczaka włożyć do salaterki, polać kilkoma łyżkami ketchupu.
Wsypać posiekane ogórki konserwowe lub kwaszone.
Potem wsypać puszkę kukurydzy, można też wsypać warstwę ciecierzycy.
Posmarować warstwą majonezu, wsypać warstwę rozdrobnionych pomidorów.
Posypać poszatkowaną kapustą pekińską, dodać sól, pieprz, polać oliwą z oliwek.

recipes.title: Garlic Croutons II
recipes.description: Grzanki czosnkowe smażone na patelni, podawane jako dodatek do zup i sałatek.

ingredients.text: 1 cup ½-inches bread cubes from good-quality French or Italian loaf
ingredients.name: chleb francuski lub włoski
ingredients.note: ½-inches bread cubes from good-quality French or Italian loaf

steps.text: Warm an 8-inch skillet over low heat while preparing bread. A minute before you are ready to cook, turn heat up to medium.
Toss bread in a bowl with oil, salt, and garlic powder.
Cook, stirring often, until crisp and golden brown (about 7 minutes).
Use as a garnish for soups and salads.

recipes.title: Panna Cotta (Basic)
recipes.description: A basic Italian-style panna cotta made with heavy cream, sugar, vanilla and gelatin, set in ramekins.

ingredients.text: ½ cup (60 g) white granulated sugar
ingredients.name: cukier

ingredients.text: 1½ tsp vanilla essence or 1 small vanilla bean
ingredients.name: ekstrakt waniliowy

steps.text: Allow the gelatin to bloom in 1 Tbsp of the cream for about 5 minutes.
Combine the remaining ingredients in a medium saucepan over medium heat, and stir occasionally until the sugar dissolves and tiny bubbles appear around the edge of your pan.
Remove from heat and add the gelatin, stirring until it is thoroughly incorporated.
Pour the cream mixture into small ramekins and allow to set in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours, up to overnight.
Serve with fresh fruit, balsamic vinegar, port, or a sweet sauce.

recipes.title: Tri-Colored Autumn Rice Balls
recipes.description: A simple sweet tea-time treat, once served during the autumn equinox celebration. The name comes from a bush clover that blooms only in the fall.

ingredients.text: ¼ cup toasted black sesame seeds, lightly crushed
ingredients.name: nasiona sezamu czarnego
ingredients.note: toasted black sesame seeds, lightly crushed

ingredients.text: 1 cup smooth Japanese bean paste (koshi-an), chilled
ingredients.name: pasta z fasoli azuki

ingredients.text: ½ cup roasted soybean powder (kinako) or toasted ground pecans
ingredients.name: mąka sojowa prażona

steps.text: Mix sesame seeds and sugar in a small bowl.
Moisten your hands with water and divide warm rice into 12 equal portions.
Shape 4 portions into balls. Moisten a clean dish towel and squeeze it dry.
Place 2½ tablespoons bean paste on towel; pat into a 4-inch circle.
Place 1 rice ball in the centre of the bean paste circle and use towel to mould bean paste around the rice ball.
Repeat this 3 more times, using another ½ cup of bean paste and the other 3 rice balls.
Place these on a nice serving tray. Flatten the remaining eight rice portions.
Form the remaining bean paste into 8 balls (about 2 teaspoons per ball). Place a bean paste ball in the centre of each piece of flattened rice and shape the rice around it.
Mould these stuffed rice balls into oval shapes. Roll 4 ovals in the sesame-sugar mixture. Roll the other 4 balls in the roasted soybean powder. Add these to the serving tray.

recipes.title: Cranberry Walnut Fudge
recipes.description: Fudge z białą czekoladą, orzechami włoskimi i suszoną żurawiną.

steps.text: Place butter, sour cream, and sugar into a saucepan.
Put the saucepan on a stove and cook for 15 minutes over medium heat.
Remove from heat and add vanilla extract, marshmallow creme, and white chocolate chips.
Using a mixing spoon, stir until the mixture is smooth.
Fold in the walnuts and cranberries.
Pour the mixture into an 8x8-inch baking pan.
Put the pan into the refrigerator to cool for 1 hour.
Unmold and cut into 1-inch pieces.

recipes.title: Flapjacks (Lower-sugar)
recipes.description: Oat bars sweetened mainly with golden syrup, with only a small amount of sugar.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 375 °F (180 °C).
Beat the butter and sugar until the mixture is creamy, then stir in the warmed golden syrup.
Work in the rolled oats and salt.
Grease a 10 x 8-inch (about 25 x 20 cm) baking tray.
Press mixture into baking tin, and bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes or until brown.
When firm, cut into slices and leave in tin until cool.

recipes.title: Fried Bananas
recipes.description: Fried bananas is a delightful dessert or snack enjoyed in many cuisines around the world. These sweet, caramelized banana slices offer a perfect balance of crispy and tender textures.

steps.text: Heat a skillet or frying pan over medium heat and melt the butter.
Add the banana slices to the pan and sprinkle them with brown sugar.
Cook the bananas for 2–3 minutes on each side or until they turn golden brown and caramelized.
If desired, sprinkle cinnamon over the bananas during cooking.
Remove the fried bananas from the pan and serve them hot. Optionally, serve with a scoop of vanilla ice cream for an extra treat.

recipes.title: Homemade Hominy
recipes.description: Hominy made from shelled corn soaked in lye water, rinsed until the skins loosen, then cooked until the grains burst.

steps.text: Put the water into a large kettle or saucepan, and stir in the lye.
Bring the water to a boil, then add the corn and let it boil until the skins will slip off the grains when pressed between the thumb and finger.
Remove from the stove, stir sufficiently to loosen the skins, then remove them by washing the corn in a colander.

Cover the grains with cold water and return to the fire. When the water boils, pour it off. Repeat at least three times to make sure there is no trace of the lye. Allow the grains to cook in more water until they burst.
Season the corn with the salt, and while still hot put it into a jar or crock and cover it tight until used. The cooking water should remain on it.

recipes.title: Lumanda (Zambian Okra Stew)
recipes.description: Lumanda is a flavorful Zambian okra stew that celebrates the unique taste and texture of okra. This vegetarian stew is made with fresh okra pods, tomatoes, onions, and a blend of aromatic spices.

ingredients.text: 1 hot pepper, chopped (remove seeds for less heat)
ingredients.name: papryczka chili
ingredients.note: chopped, remove seeds for less heat

steps.text: In a large pot, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, minced garlic, and chopped hot pepper to the pot. Sauté until the onions are soft and translucent.
Stir in the ground paprika, ground cumin, ground turmeric, and ground coriander. Cook for a minute or two to release the flavors of the spices.
Add the sliced okra and diced tomato to the pot. Stir well to combine the vegetables with the spice mixture.
Season the stew with salt to taste. Adjust the seasoning according to your preference.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and let simmer for about 15–20 minutes, or until the okra is tender and cooked through.
Stir occasionally during cooking to prevent sticking and to ensure even cooking of the okra and tomatoes.
Once the stew is ready, remove the pot from the heat and let rest for a few minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Sweet and Sour Grilled Tuna
recipes.description: Ahi tuna marinated in a sweet and sour mixture of ketchup, vinegar, soy sauce and brown sugar, then quickly grilled.

ingredients.text: 2 pounds ahi tuna loin, cut into 2 pieces
ingredients.name: tuńczyk

steps.text: Combine ketchup, vinegar, soy sauce, and sugar. Reserve ¼ cup and add tuna to larger amount of mixture and toss to coat. Drain tuna and set aside.
Coat a sheet of newspaper with 1–2 tsp oil. Wad up and place under a good chimneyful of natural chunk charcoal. Light and wait 15 minutes or until coals are coated with light gray ash.
Rub grate with remaining oil and place on heated chimney. Add tuna and cook 15–30 seconds or until desired doneness is achieved.
Remove to a plate and cover tightly with plastic wrap. Let rest 3 minutes.
Slice thinly across the grain and serve with reserved marinade, or wrap tightly with a new sheet of plastic wrap and refrigerate up to 3 days.

recipes.title: Fusion Spice Cookie (Gluten-Free)
recipes.description: Gluten-free cookies flavored with Chinese five-spice powder, rolled in sugar before baking.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Cream sugar, egg, and shortening together.
Add all-purpose baking mix and five-spice. Mix well to make a dough.
Roll teaspoonfuls of dough into balls, and roll the balls in sugar.
Bake at 350°F for 5 to 6 minutes.

recipes.title: Classic Puff Pastry
recipes.description: Classic puff pastry dough made from bread flour, butter, cold water and salt, built up with repeated four-folds.

ingredients.text: 2½ lbs (40 oz / 1125 g) room temp butter
ingredients.name: masło

steps.text: Mix the salt in with the larger portion of flour.
Add the cold water to the flour and salt and work it into a dough.
Knead about 80 times to make a soft dough and build some gluten.
Flatten out the dough (allows quicker cooling) and refrigerate.
Combine the room temperature butter and the smaller portion of flour and mix well. It will form a soft paste that is easy to spread.
Take the chilled dough and roll it into a rectangle about ¼–½ inch thick.
Leaving a 1-inch margin around the edge, spread the butter out over ⅔ of the dough.
Fold the dough into thirds like you were folding a letter, starting with the portion of dough with no butter.
Refrigerate for 20–30 minutes to allow the dough to relax, and so the butter doesn't get displaced when rolling out again.
Roll out the dough again to a large rectangle the same size as the first.
Fold the dough so that the two short edges meet in the center and then fold the dough in half. This should give the dough four layers and is, as a result, called a four-fold.
Refrigerate the dough again and then roll out and do another four-fold. Repeat this step two more times. You now have classical puff pastry dough to use as you see fit.

recipes.title: Cherry Soda
recipes.description: A cherry soda is a soda flavored with cherries.

steps.text: Combine the water, cherries, and sugar in a pot.
Boil the mixture until it becomes a thick syrup.
Strain the mixture, and discard the solids. This should yield about 5 oz (150 ml) syrup.
To make the finished soda, mix 1 volume of syrup with 5 volumes of carbonated water.

categories: Recipes using fish broth and stock

recipes.title: Poached Salmon with wild Huckleberries
recipes.description: Łosoś gotowany w bulionie rybnym i wodzie z jagodami huckleberry i cytryną.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
In a baking dish, combine the fish stock and water. Add the salmon, making sure it is covered by liquid. If more liquid is needed, add equal parts water/fish stock until covered.
Add herbs, huckleberries, lemon slices, and peppercorns.
Place the in pan in the preheated oven, and bake for 15–18 minutes until salmon is flaky.
Serve and enjoy.

recipes.title: Seafood Marinade
recipes.description: A seafood marinade of lemon juice, dry white wine, olive oil and dried herbs.

ingredients.text: ¼ cup freshly squeezed lemon juice
ingredients.name: sok z cytryny

ingredients.text: 1 ½ tsp freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: pieprz czarny

steps.text: Combine all ingredients.
Keep refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks, and remember to shake well before using.

To use, place either 4 ea. 6-ounce wild salmon filets, 4 ea. 7-ounce mahi mahi filets, or 4 ea. 6-ounce halibut fillets in a gallon-size zip-top bag. Pour in the marinade and refrigerate for up to 24 hours.

recipes.title: Coconut Pudding II
recipes.description: A steamed coconut custard made with eggs, thick coconut milk and sugar, flavored with jasmine water.

steps.text: Combine eggs, coconut milk, sugar and Jasmine water in a dish. Beat until foamy.
Pour the mixture into a heatproof dish, and place on top of a bamboo steamer basket.
Cover the basket and place above a large wok of boiling water.
Steam the pudding for 30–40 minutes, or until no longer fluid. If the pudding is cooked too fast, it becomes rubbery.
Take the pudding out of the steamer and allow to cool.

recipes.title: Home Fries
recipes.description: Classic American breakfast side dish made with cubed or sliced potatoes, pan-fried until golden and crispy.

ingredients.text: 3 medium potatoes (e.g., russet or Yukon gold), peeled and diced
ingredients.name: ziemniak
ingredients.note: e.g., russet or Yukon gold, peeled and diced

steps.text: Boil diced potatoes in salted water for 5 minutes to soften slightly.
Drain and let them dry.
Heat oil or butter in a nonstick skillet over medium heat.
Add onions (and peppers if using), sauté until translucent.
Add the potatoes in a single layer.
Let them brown undisturbed for 5–6 minutes.
Flip and cook the other sides until golden and crispy.
Season with salt, pepper, and paprika.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Mexican Tequila Marinade
recipes.description: Marynata z tequili, miodu mesquite, limonki i habanero, do mięs.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in an 8-ounce mason jar.
Keep refrigerated for up to 2 weeks.
Shake well before using.

recipes.title: Guacamole (Chile- and Herb-Free)
recipes.description: A simple, traditional Mexican guacamole made from avocado, tomato, onion and lime, without chile or herbs.

steps.text: Gently slice avocado and remove pit.
Add avocado to a bowl and mash until smooth.
Add chopped tomatoes and onion.
Squeeze lime on the mixture.
Add salt and stir.
If desired, eat with chips, bread, or salad.

recipes.title: Oreo Milkshake
recipes.description: Gęsty koktajl mleczny z lodami waniliowymi i kruszonymi ciastkami Oreo.

ingredients.text: 2 cups (500 ml / 17 oz) vanilla ice cream
ingredients.name: lody waniliowe

steps.text: Put ice cream in a cup and add a little milk (for thicker) or more milk (for less thick).
Mix with a spoon until smooth. If your cup is not filled to your desire add more ice cream and milk.
Stir in oreos until thoroughly mixed in.
Add anything else to the top such as "magic shell" sauce or whipped cream and sprinkles

recipes.title: Never Fail Pie Crust
recipes.description: Szybkie ciasto kruche, łatwe do wykonania z podstawowych składników.

steps.text: Combine flour, shortening and salt. Cut in shortening with fork (or pastry blender) until it resembles corn meal.
Combine water and vinegar with beaten egg. Add to flour mixture a little at a time until a soft dough forms.
Divide dough into three discs, and use or freeze individually.
When using, roll out onto a floured surface to desired measurements.

recipes.title: French Meringue
recipes.description: Also called common meringue, a simple meringue made by whipping egg whites and beating in granulated sugar. It can be baked into cookies or a crispy base for pavlova, vacherin, or other desserts.

ingredients.text: ¼ tsp cream of tartar or a few drops lemon juice
ingredients.name: krem z winianu potasu
ingredients.note: or a few drops lemon juice

ingredients.text: 8 oz (250 g) superfine sugar or sifted confectioners' sugar
ingredients.name: cukier puder
ingredients.note: superfine sugar or sifted confectioners' sugar

steps.text: Whip the egg whites and cream of tartar until they reach soft peaks.
Add the first amount of sugar, little by little, while beating by hand or machine.
Whip until stiff.
Stop beating and fold in the remaining sugar, if used, with a spatula.
Use as desired or in your recipe.

recipes.title: Vegetarian Rassolnik
recipes.description: A vegetarian version of the Russian rassolnik soup made with potatoes, pickled cucumbers, carrot, onion and rice.

steps.text: Bring water to boil. Add the sliced potatoes, cucumbers, carrots, and onions.
When the vegetables are cooked, add the cooked rice, bay leaf, and oil.
Bring to a boil.
Season with salt to taste.
Serve garnished with chopped herbs.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Substitute
recipes.description: A substitute for pumpkin purée made from puréed carrot and swede mixed with plain yogurt.

ingredients.text: 1 kg (about 2 lbs) mixed carrot and swede
ingredients.name: mieszanka marchwi i brukwi

steps.text: Purée the vegetable mix until smooth.
Add the yogurt.
Use in place of pumpkin purée.

recipes.title: Smoky Chipotle Hot Sauce
recipes.description: A smoky hot sauce made from chipotle purée, tomato paste and malt vinegar.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients and store in a nonreactive container at room temperature for up to 2 months.

recipes.title: Pizza with Peppers
recipes.description: Pizza with peppers is a hot dish.

ingredients.text: 1 yellow bell pepper, with 4 rings sliced off and the rest diced
ingredients.name: papryka żółta
ingredients.note: with 4 rings sliced off and the rest diced

ingredients.text: 1 small ball pizza dough (enough for a single personal pizza)
ingredients.name: ciasto na pizzę
ingredients.note: small ball, enough for a single personal pizza

steps.text: Heat a dash of oil in a frying pan over low heat.
Add the onion and diced bell peppers, and cook, stirring, for half an hour.
Stretch and roll the pizza dough out to about 8–12 inches (20–30 cm) in diameter, and place in a pizza pan or on a sheet pan.
Top the dough with the tomatoes, then the cooked onion-pepper mixture.
Scatter the cheeses evenly over top, then arrange the 4 reserved pepper rings decoratively on top.
Bake for 10 minutes at 220°C (430°F), then top with the chorizo and bake for another 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Shakshuka (also spelled shakshouka)
recipes.description: One-pan Middle Eastern and North African dish of eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce, traditionally served for breakfast or brunch.

ingredients.text: ¼ teaspoon cayenne pepper (or to taste)
ingredients.name: pieprz cayenne

ingredients.text: Salt and black pepper, to taste
ingredients.name: sól

ingredients.text: 60 g (2 oz) feta cheese, crumbled, to serve
ingredients.name: ser feta

ingredients.text: Small handful fresh parsley or coriander (cilantro), chopped, to serve
ingredients.name: natka pietruszki

ingredients.text: Crusty bread or pita, to serve
ingredients.name: chleb

steps.text: Heat olive oil in a large, deep skillet or sauté pan over medium heat.
Add onion and both bell peppers; cook 8 minutes until softened.
Add garlic, cumin, sweet paprika, smoked paprika, and cayenne.
Stir 1 minute until fragrant.
Add crushed tomatoes. Season with salt and pepper.
Stir well and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to medium-low. Simmer the sauce 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened.
Use the back of a spoon to make 6 small wells in the sauce. Crack an egg into each well.
Cover the pan with a lid. Cook 6–8 minutes until egg whites are set but yolks are still runny, or longer if firmer yolks are preferred.
Remove from heat. Scatter feta and fresh herbs over the top. Serve immediately from the pan with bread.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Potato and Leek Soup II
recipes.description: Kremowa zupa z porów i ziemniaków, którą po przetarciu przez sitko można uzyskać bardzo gładką.

ingredients.text: 930 g leeks (not including the toughest portion of their green tops), halved lengthwise and sliced
ingredients.name: por
ingredients.note: not including the toughest portion of their green tops, halved lengthwise and sliced

ingredients.text: 600 g yellow potatoes, peeled and diced into 1–2 cm cubes
ingredients.name: ziemniak żółty
ingredients.note: peeled and diced into 1–2 cm cubes

steps.text: After preparing the leeks, wash them very well in water to remove all traces of dirt and grit, which hide between the layers. Drain well.
Melt the butter in a large pot over medium heat. Add the vegetables, and season with a pinch each of salt and pepper. Stir to coat everything well with butter.
Cover the pot, and let the vegetables sweat over low heat for 10 minutes—make sure not to let them brown.
Stir in the chicken stock, and bring the pot to a boil. Simmer until the vegetables are cooked through.
Working in batches if necessary, purée the mixture using a hand- or full-size blender.
If you would like a very smooth soup, work the puréed mixture through a sieve into a clean pot—this is laborious, but it yields a velvety product.
Taste the soup, and season to taste with additional salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Nsima (Cornmeal Swallow)
recipes.description: Nsima is a thick, porridge-like staple made from maize flour, typically served with meat, vegetable or fish relishes.

steps.text: Measure out the maize flour and set it aside.
In a large cooking pot, bring the water to a boil.
Once the water is boiling, reduce the heat to low and gradually add the maize flour to the pot while stirring continuously with a wooden spoon or a stiff whisk.
Make sure to pour the flour in a slow, steady stream to prevent clumping.
Keep stirring the mixture vigorously to combine the maize flour and water thoroughly. This step is crucial to avoid lumps from forming.
Continue stirring for about 5 minutes until the mixture starts to thicken.
Increase the heat to medium-low and cover the pot with a lid. Allow the mixture to cook for about 10–15 minutes. This cooking time allows the maize flour to cook fully and eliminates the raw taste.
Remove the lid and stir the mixture again, making sure to scrape the sides and bottom of the pot to prevent sticking or burning.

Continue cooking the nsima, stirring frequently, for another 10–15 minutes until it reaches the desired consistency. It should have a thick, smooth texture similar to mashed potatoes or stiff porridge. If it's too thick, you can add a little more water and continue stirring until you achieve the desired consistency.
Once the nsima is cooked to your liking, remove it from the heat and let it sit for a few minutes to cool slightly before serving.
Serve the nsima hot with your choice of relishes such as meat, vegetables, or fish. Popular relishes include chicken stew, beef and vegetable stew, fried fish, or a variety of sautéed greens.

recipes.title: Indian Mango, Chilli Powder, and Cumin Condiment (Chhundo)
recipes.description: A sweet and spicy condiment or pickle from Gujarat, eaten with roti and sabzi.

steps.text: Peel and finely grate the mangoes.
Combine the grated mango evenly with the rest of the ingredients.
Spread the mixture in a shallow, wide-mouthed jar and cover with a thin cloth.
Keep the mixture in the sun for 5 days until the syrup attains a single thread consistency, stirring thrice daily.

recipes.title: Swiss Meringue
recipes.description: Swiss meringue is a variety of meringue made by heating egg whites and sugar over a double boiler before whipping to stiff peaks.

steps.text: Put the egg whites and sugar into a stainless steel bowl.
Place the bowl over simmering water and whip with a wire whisk until the mixture is 120°F (50°C).
Remove the bowl from the heat and continue whipping until the meringue is completely cool.
Use as desired or as directed in your recipe.

recipes.title: Italian Meringue
recipes.description: Italian meringue is a meringue made by whipping together egg whites and hot sugar syrup. It can be used to top various desserts such as lemon meringue pie or baked alaska.

steps.text: In a saucepan, dissolve the sugar in the water and bring to a boil.
Boil the syrup until it reaches 243°F (117°C).
While the syrup is boiling, whip the egg whites to soft peaks.
While beating, gradually pour the syrup into the egg whites in a steady stream.
Continue whipping until the meringue is completely cool and forms firm peaks.
Use as desired.

recipes.title: Chili Mix
recipes.description: Homemade chili spice mix for seasoning chile con carne, made as an alternative to instant packets from the store.

ingredients.text: 1–2 teaspoons ground red cayenne pepper or crushed/powdered ancho chilli pepper
ingredients.name: pieprz cayenne
ingredients.note: 1–2 teaspoons; ground red cayenne pepper or crushed/powdered ancho chilli pepper

ingredients.text: ½ teaspoon dehydrated garlic (minced or powdered)
ingredients.name: czosnek suszony

steps.text: Mix all ingredients and store in an airtight jar.
Use 1–3 tablespoons of Chili Mix per 1 lb of meat (to taste).

recipes.title: Morel Mushroom Sauce
recipes.description: A rich sauce of morel mushrooms sautéed in butter, finished with white wine, whipping cream and Dijon mustard.

ingredients.text: 3 cups gray morel mushrooms, cut into slices less than 1 inch long
ingredients.name: smardz
ingredients.note: gray morel mushrooms, cut into slices less than 1 inch long

ingredients.text: ¼ cup thinly-sliced green onion tops
ingredients.name: szczypiorek

steps.text: In a 12-inch non-stick skillet, heat the butter over medium-high heat until foaming.
Add the morels and sauté, stirring occasionally, for 15–20 minutes until slightly crispy.
Add the onion tops, parsley, nutmeg, pepper, and salt and cook for a few minutes
Turn up the heat, add wine, and reduce to almost a glaze
Turn heat to medium and add the cream and mustard. Reduce slightly over slow boil until thickened—about 10–12 minutes.
Serve.

recipes.title: Krummelpap (South African Maize Porridge)
recipes.description: Krummelpap is a slowly cooked maize porridge from South Africa. It is traditionally eaten at breakfast with a little milk, butter and sugar, or at dinner with a gravy-like sauce.

ingredients.text: 250 ml hot/boiling water, or more as needed
ingredients.name: woda

steps.text: Combine maize and salt in a large pot (like the one used for rice).
Add a third of the hot water, mixing with a fork to make little balls or crumbs.
Very gradually stir in more water. Don't add too much water.
Put the pot over low heat, and cover with a lid. Cook, stirring with a fork every 10 minutes. Keep the lid on; it is the steam that cooks the maize.

Taste after 35 minutes to test if it is done. If it still tastes like maize, continue cooking; the wonder of this porridge is that you can't overcook it, though you can burn it. It takes approximately 50 minutes to cook.

recipes.title: Chicken Karahi (Pakistani Chicken with Tomato and Peppers)
recipes.description: Pakistański kurczak karahi z pomidorami i papryką, podawany z zielonymi chili i kolendrą.

steps.text: Combine garlic paste and salt. Rub this mixture over the chicken pieces, and let marinate for several hours.
Heat some oil in a specialized wok known as a karaahi, and add red peppers to brown.
Add the marinated chicken to the wok. Let the chicken cook over low heat until it becomes slightly tender.
Add the diced tomatoes, mixing them thoroughly with the chicken. Let this cook on over low heat for 15 minutes.
Serve it by garnishing it with green chilies and coriander.

recipes.title: Mulling Spice with Anise
recipes.description: Mieszanka przypraw do grzanego wina, cydru lub soku jabłkowego z dodatkiem anyżu.

steps.text: Mix ingredients together well.
Store in closed jar.
Mix ¼ cup (150 g) of spice mixture per 16 cups (4 L) of wine, cider, or apple juice.
Simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve hot in mugs with cinnamon stick stirrers or fill a punch bowl and garnish with orange slices.

recipes.title: Chicken Bog II
recipes.description: A Southern-style chicken and rice dish cooked with smoked sausage and herb seasonings.

steps.text: Put water, salt, onion, and chicken in pot. Boil until tender (about 1 hour).
Remove chicken, let cool, and remove bones.
Chop meat into bite-sized pieces.
Skim off fat from juices. Measure 3 ½ cups of this broth into a 6-quart saucepan. Add rice, chicken pieces and smoked sausage, herb seasoning and "chicken and herb" seasoning.
Cook these ingredients for 30 minutes. Bring to a boil and reduce heat and simmer, keeping covered the entire time. If rice mixture is too wet, cook uncovered until desired consistency.

recipes.title: Chicken Omelet
recipes.description: Chicken Omelet served with rice, chapatis or bread, for lunch or dinner.

steps.text: Clean the chicken thoroughly
Cut into 8 pieces
Season with salt, black pepper, ginger and lemon juice
Cover and cook in moderate heat till tender and dry
Pour oil in another cooking pan and fry the onions till brown in colour
Add tomatoes, cinnamon, salt, green chilies and turmeric while stirring
Squeeze out two cups of concentrated coconut milk
Gradually add the concreated coconuts milk and cook for 2 minutes
Then pour the mixture over the chicken
Cover and simmer until the mixture thickens
Place the chicken gravy in a pie dish (tasa) arranging it in a nice way
Pour the eggs one at a time on top of the chicken and bake for 15-25 minutes until set

recipes.title: Cayenne Hot Sauce
recipes.description: This hot sauce tastes very much like Tabasco and other vinegar-based cayenne hot sauces.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients.
Store indefinitely at room temperature in a squirt bottle.

recipes.title: Mini English Muffin Pizzas
recipes.description: Small pizzas made on halved English muffins with pizza sauce, pepperoni and mozzarella, baked until the cheese melts.

steps.text: Slice English muffins in half.
Spoon 1 tbsp pizza sauce on each English muffin half and spread evenly.
Place 4 pepperoni slices on each English muffin half.
Cover each mini pizza with ¼ cup mozzarella cheese.
Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 10 minutes.
Let cool then eat.

recipes.title: North Carolina Style BBQ Chicken
recipes.description: Thin, vinegar-based mop sauce from eastern North Carolina, applied to grilled chicken.

ingredients.text: 3 each skinless bone-in chicken thighs and drumsticks
ingredients.name: udko z kurczaka (bez skóry)
ingredients.note: skinless bone-in chicken thighs and drumsticks

steps.text: Season chicken liberally with the barbecue rub. Gently massage into meat and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Meanwhile, combine the vinegar, honey, and Worcestershire sauce.
Place enough charcoal briquets to fill the charcoal compartment of a large chimney starter. Wad up some oil-moistened newspaper, stick under the compartment, and light. Wait 15 minutes.
Once coals are heated, disperse evenly along the bottom of the grill. Toss in soaked hickory chunks and reapply the grate.
Grill chicken over medium low, turning often and brushing with vinegar mixture when turned, until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Remove and let rest for 7 minutes.
While chicken is resting, boil remaining vinegar mixture on high for 5 minutes. Drizzle over chicken and serve warm.

images: Beans and fried plantains with Beef02.jpg

recipes.title: Nigerian Ewa Agoyin
recipes.description: Ewa agoyin is a popular Nigerian street food made from very soft and mashed beans with a rich, spicy, and deeply caramelized pepper sauce.

ingredients.text: 4 cups brown beans or honey beans
ingredients.name: fasola brunatna

steps.text: Cook the beans in plenty of water until they become extremely soft and mushy.
Stir or lightly mash the cooked beans until you get a smooth, thick, porridge-like texture. Season with salt to taste, and set aside.
Blend or grind dried pepper and fry it with chopped onions in a pot or pan.
Cook in palm oil and allow it to fry slowly until it becomes dark, thick, and smoky.
Add salt and seasoning cubes if desired, and continue frying until the oil rises and the sauce is well cooked.
Spoon the hot pepper sauce over the mashed beans and serve.

recipes.title: Jamaican Sorrel Soda
recipes.description: Jamaican sorrel soda is a traditional Jamaican carbonated drink consisting of sweetened hibiscus tea with added ginger.

ingredients.text: 3 hibiscus (roselle) tea bags or 3 tsp (15 ml) dried hibiscus
ingredients.name: herbata hibiskus

ingredients.text: 6 ea. ¼ in (0.67 cm) cubes of ginger (optional)
ingredients.name: imbir świeży

steps.text: Combine the water, hibiscus, and ginger in a pot.
Boil for about 15 minutes.
Remove and discard the hibiscus and ginger.
Stir the sugar into the liquid, and simmer until you have about 5 oz (150 ml) syrup.
Remove from the heat and let cool.
To make the finished soda, mix 1 volume of syrup with 5 volumes of sparkling water.

recipes.title: Country Roast Chicken Seasoning
recipes.description: Mieszanka przypraw do pieczonego kurczaka w stylu wiejskim.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Maminy pudding z kartofli
recipes.description: Pudding z utartych ziemniaków, jajek, masła i mleka, zapiekany w piekarniku.

steps.text: Utrzeć trzy ziemniaki, lub zrobić z nich purée.
Ubić cukier z jajkami, masłem i mlekiem, według uznania można dodać cukier waniliowy i aromat.
Dodać do utartych ziemniaków.
Całość umieścić w natłuszczonej formie i położyć na wierzchu kawałki masła.
Piec godzinę w średnio nagrzanym piecu.

recipes.title: Soppa ta' l-Armla (Maltese Widow's Soup)
recipes.description: A Maltese vegetable soup with cauliflower, peas and tomatoes, finished with ricotta, eggs and cheeselets.

steps.text: Fry the onions in a pan with a small amount of oil until translucent.
Combine the cooked onions, potatoes, courgettes, tomatoes, cauliflower, and peas in a pot.
Season with salt and pepper, and bring to a boil.
Simmer until the vegetables are cooked.
In the last few minutes of cooking, add the eggs, ricotta, and cheeselets.

recipes.title: Nigerian Eggplant Fufu
recipes.description: Nigerian eggplant fufu is a swallow made from eggplants. Despite the dark purple colour of eggplant, it turns a dark greyish colour as in amala when cooked.

steps.text: Cut the eggplant into small pieces and soften in a pot of boiling water.
Drain well.
Absorb excess water from the eggplant with paper towels.
Blend the eggplant with the food processor.
Transfer the eggplant purée to a pot, and stir over medium heat for 2 minutes.
Add the psyllium husk, and stir for additional 3 minutes.
Shape into desired portions.

recipes.title: Bolinhos de Mandioca com Mel
recipes.description: Słodkie kulki z tartej manioki, smażone na złoto i podawane z miodem.

steps.text: Place the grated cassava in a large bowl.
Add the eggs, sugar, vanilla extract, cinnamon, and salt.
Mix thoroughly until a uniform batter forms.
Heat oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat.
Scoop small portions of the mixture and carefully place them into the hot oil.
Fry until golden brown on all sides, about 3–4 minutes.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Arrange the fritters on a serving plate.
Drizzle generously with honey before serving.

recipes.title: Pickled Oysters
recipes.description: Pickled oysters with vinegar and spices, adapted and modernized from the 1881 Household Cyclopedia.

steps.text: Drain off the liquor from the oysters, and wash them.
Combine the oysters with the salt and vinegar; simmer them for about 10 minutes, discarding any scum that rises to the surface.
Take out the oysters, leaving the liquid. Place oysters in a jar.
Add the peppercorns, mace, and cloves to the oyster liquid, and boil for 5 minutes.
Skim the liquid, and pour it over the oysters in the jar.

recipes.title: Sweetened Mulling Spice Mix
recipes.description: A sweetened spice mix for mulling drinks.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients together.
Store in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Scrambled Eggs with Sausage
recipes.description: Scrambled eggs cooked in a pan together with fried sausages and optional chopped vegetables.

steps.text: Add the sausages to a hot frying pan. Fry, turning, until sausage is cooked through.
Beat the eggs with the salt.
Transfer egg mixture to pan along with vegetables, if using. Fry for 30–60 seconds.
Serve.

recipes.title: Hamburger Buns
recipes.description: Fresh, homemade hamburger buns that make hamburgers taste better.

ingredients.text: ¼ stick 2 tablespoons 30 g Butter, room temperature
ingredients.name: masło

ingredients.text: 1 packet 1 scant tablespoon 7 g Yeast (weight given for active dry yeast)
ingredients.name: drożdże suszone
ingredients.note: weight given for active dry yeast

ingredients.text: ¾–1 cup (6–8 fl oz) 170–225 g Warm water (see notes)
ingredients.name: woda
ingredients.note: ¾–1 cup (6–8 fl oz), see notes

steps.text: Put all ingredients except the warm water into a mixing bowl. If using a stand mixer, fit the dough hook and turn it to its lowest setting to begin stirring. If mixing by hand, give it a few strokes with a mixing spoon or spatula. Don't stir more than necessary.

Pour in half to three-quarters of the warm water and stir thoroughly. With a stand mixer, let it run until the dough comes together, several minutes. By hand, turn the dough onto a clean, flat surface and knead for up to 10 minutes, adding flour or water by the spoonful as needed.

Assess the texture. If the dough is sticky and too slack to form a smooth, soft ball, add flour a generous spoonful at a time, stirring until incorporated (unlikely to need more than about ½ cup/60 g). If there is dry flour in the bottom, pour a little of the remaining warm water on that part and mix again. If you overcorrected, add a spoonful of flour until workable.
Turn on the empty, cold oven for one minute, then turn it off.
Cover the dough to keep the surface from drying out, by coating it with oil or covering with a lid or big plate.
Put the bowl of dough in the (now slightly warm) oven or another warm place. Double check the oven is off.
Let the dough rise for about 1 hour, until puffy and almost twice its original volume. With cold water it will take longer.
If using parchment paper, place it on the baking sheet; otherwise lightly grease the pan.
Sprinkle a big spoonful of flour on your work surface and spread it out a bit.
Remove the bowl from the oven and scrape the puffy dough onto the floured work surface.
Roll the dough in the flour to lightly coat all sides, adding more flour if needed. Roll into a rough log and cut into about 12 pieces of similar size with a sharp knife or bench scraper.

Pick up one piece, dust the wet edges in flour, choose the smoothest side as the top, stretch and pinch the edges back to the bottom, pinch the lumpy bits together on the bottom, flatten slightly, and place pinched-side-down on the baking sheet.
Repeat for the other eleven pieces, leaving about an inch or two between them on the sheet.
Place the baking sheet back in the barely warm oven to proof for about 45 minutes or an hour. If the oven has cooled, warm it for about 30 seconds and turn it off before adding the pan.
When the buns look nicely puffy, take the baking sheet out of the oven.
Preheat the empty oven to 375 °F (190 °C, gas mark 5).
When hot, put the proofed buns in the oven and bake for 12–15 minutes, until golden brown.
Serve hot, warm, or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Sauerkraut II
recipes.description: Kiszona kapusta przygotowywana w garnku z solą, fermentowana przez kilka tygodni i konserwowana w słoikach.

steps.text: Remove old leaves from the cabbage heads.
Quarter heads and cut out the cores.
Shred cabbage.
Put cabbage and salt in large pan and mix with hands.
Gently pack into crock using a potato masher.
When crock is nearly full, cover with cloth, plate, and weight.
Check daily and remove scum.
When the kraut is sour enough, you can leave it in crock and seal it with paraffin wax; it can also be sealed in sterilized glass jars, adding enough brine to fill the jar.
Process for 15 minutes below boiling point.

recipes.title: Hypotonic Sports Drink
recipes.description: Homemade hypotonic sports drink made from water, table salt and cordial, quick to prepare and absorbed faster than plain water during exercise.

steps.text: Transfer the water to a clean container, such as a measuring jug.
Stir in the salt until fully dissolved, then mix in the cordial. Stir thoroughly until evenly mixed.
Chill the mixture in the fridge until cool.
Pour into a clean sports bottle or thermos flask and sip gradually during exercise.

recipes.title: Spinach Mushroom Pesto Spaghetti
recipes.description: Spaghetti with spinach, mushrooms and pesto, finished with parmesan.

ingredients.text: ½ cup (60 g / 2 oz) grated parmesan cheese, plus extra for sprinkling
ingredients.name: parmezan

steps.text: Boil the spaghetti in water until al dente.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a pan over a medium heat.
Cook the spinach for 5 minutes until it is wilted.
Add the mushrooms, salt, and pepper and cook for a further 3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the pesto and cheese and cook for 2 minutes.
Drain the pasta in a colander and stir into the sauce.
Divide the pasta between 4 plates and serve.
To serve, sprinkle with some extra cheese.

recipes.title: Tostones (Fried Plantains)
recipes.description: Smażone plantany krojone w plasterki, podawane jako przekąska lub dodatek.

steps.text: Heat oil in a frying pan over low heat.
Peel plantain, and cut it horizontally or in circular slices.
Add plantains to frying pan and fry on both sides for about 1 minute or until golden brown.
Drain, cool, and enjoy!

recipes.title: Chipsi mayai
recipes.description: Chipsi mayai, also known as zege, is a Tanzanian street food: a simple potato and egg omelette, found all over Tanzania.

ingredients.text: 4 medium potatoes, peeled and cut into fries
ingredients.name: ziemniak
ingredients.note: medium, peeled and cut into fries

ingredients.text: 2 tbsp vegetable oil (plus extra for frying)
ingredients.name: olej roślinny

steps.text: Peel the potatoes and cut them into thin fries.
Heat oil in a deep frying pan or pot.
Fry the potatoes until golden brown and crispy.
Remove the fries and drain on paper towels.
In a bowl, beat the eggs until well combined.
Add salt and black pepper.
Stir in the onion, tomato, and chili if using.
Add the fried chips to the beaten eggs and mix gently.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a frying pan over medium heat.
Pour the egg and chips mixture into the pan.
Cook for 3–5 minutes until the bottom is golden brown.
Carefully flip the omelette using a plate or lid.
Cook the other side for another 3–4 minutes.
Remove from the heat when fully cooked.
Garnish with fresh coriander.
Cut into wedges and serve hot.

recipes.title: Mbahal Kebb (Gambian Chicken Skewers)
recipes.description: Mbahal kebb is a traditional Gambian dish known for its unique combination of flavors and aromatic spices. It is a popular grilled chicken dish marinated in a tangy and spicy sauce.

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper (adjust according to your spice preference)
ingredients.name: pieprz cayenne
ingredients.note: adjust according to your spice preference

ingredients.text: Fresh parsley or cilantro, chopped (for garnish)
ingredients.name: kolendra świeża

steps.text: In a mixing bowl, combine the groundnut paste, finely chopped onions, minced garlic, diced tomatoes, tomato paste, vegetable oil, ground cayenne pepper, ground black pepper, and salt. Mix well to create a marinade.

Add the chicken pieces to the marinade, ensuring they are well coated. Cover the bowl and let the chicken marinate for at least 2 hours, or preferably overnight in the refrigerator, to allow the flavors to develop.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
If using wooden skewers, soak them in water for about 30 minutes to prevent them from burning on the grill.
Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto the skewers, if using, or place them directly on the grill.

Grill the chicken over medium-high heat, turning occasionally, until it is cooked through and has a nice charred appearance. This usually takes about 20–25 minutes, depending on the thickness of the chicken pieces.
Once the chicken is cooked, remove it from the grill and transfer it to a serving dish.
Garnish with freshly chopped parsley or cilantro.
Serve the mbahal kebb hot with rice or couscous.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Pork Chops
recipes.description: Slow cooking makes already-tender pork chops melt-in-your-mouth tender.

ingredients.text: 2 tbsp firmly packed dark brown sugar
ingredients.name: ciemny cukier trzcinowy

steps.text: Brush chops with olive oil and season liberally with chop rub. Set aside.
Heat a large stainless steel or cast iron skillet over high heat. Add pork chops and cook until browned and slightly charred on both sides.
Remove and set aside.
Place pan back on heat and deglaze with white wine. Pour out wine and reserve.
Place apples in the bottom of a crockpot. Place pork chops on top and drizzle with remaining ingredients.
Cook on low 7–8 hours.
Drain apples and pork into a large saucepan. Bring liquid to a boil over high heat until reduced by half.
Pour liquid back over pork chops and serve warm.

recipes.title: Fireweed Vinegar
recipes.description: Ocet z kwiatów i pąków wierzbówki kiprzycy, przygotowany przez zalanie octem ryżowym lub winnym białym.

ingredients.text: 1 cup rice or white wine vinegar
ingredients.name: ocet ryżowy lub winny biały

steps.text: Rinse blossoms in a colander and let dry.
Place blossoms in a sterilized jar and pour vinegar over the top.
Place mixture in a dark place and allow it to steep for 3 to 4 weeks.
Strain vinegar through a strainer or a paper coffee filter.
Store in the refrigerator.
For longer storage, process in a boiling water bath for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Scrambled Eggs with Vegetables
recipes.description: Scrambled eggs cooked with fresh tomato, cucumber and onion.

steps.text: Heat a frying pan over medium heat, and add oil.
Add tomato and cucumber to the pan.
Cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add salt.
Beat the eggs with the onion and additional salt if desired.
Transfer mixture to the pan.
Cook eggs and vegetables, turning every 30 seconds until cooked to taste.
Serve.

recipes.title: Lotus cheesecake
recipes.description: Sernik Lotus bez pieczenia z ciasteczkami karmelowymi i kremem karmelowym.

ingredients.text: 300 g ciasteczek karmelowych korzennych, najlepiej Lotus Biscoff  (200 g na spód, 100 g do dekoracji)
ingredients.name: ciastko karmelowe korzenne
ingredients.note: 200 g na spód, 100 g do dekoracji; najlepiej Lotus Biscoff

ingredients.text: 300 g kremu karmelowego korzennego, najlepiej Lotus (200 g do masy, 100 g polewę)
ingredients.name: krem karmelowy korzenny
ingredients.note: 200 g do masy, 100 g na polewę; najlepiej Lotus

ingredients.text: 600-700 g serka homogenizowanego o zawartości tłuszczu co najmniej 18%, najlepiej Philadelphia ze względu na słonawy smak
ingredients.name: serek homogenizowany
ingredients.note: 600-700 g; tłuszcz co najmniej 18%, najlepiej Philadelphia ze względu na słonawy smak

steps.text: Tortownicę o średnicy 20 cm wyłożyć papierem do pieczenia.
Połowę ciasteczek (200 g) zblendować lub rozkruszyć na piasek i wsypać do miski.
Masło roztopić i wlać do rozkruszonych ciasteczek.
Wymieszać ugniatając.
Dno tortownicy wyłożyć ciasteczkami rozkruszonymi i wymieszanymi z masłem i przygnieść tworząc spód tortu.
Połowę kremu karmelowego (200 g) rozmieszać z serkiem homogenizowanym (600-700 g), ręcznie albo mikserem na wolnych obrotach.
Dodać cukier pudrowy i ponownie wymieszać.
Masę przełożyć do tortownicy i wygładzić wierzch.
Resztę kremu karmelowego (100 g) roztopić i polać nim masę kremową w tortownicy.
Resztę ciastek karmelowych (100 g) rozkruszyć i posypać nimi wierzch tortu.

recipes.title: Mascarpone Glazed Strawberries
recipes.description: Strawberries cooked in butter and sugar, then glazed in a sauce of mascarpone, coffee liqueur and dark rum.

ingredients.text: 1 pound fresh strawberries, hulled and sliced
ingredients.name: truskawka

steps.text: Melt butter in your largest stainless steel sauté pan over medium heat. Add strawberries and cook until deeply browned. Remove and keep warm.
Deglaze pan with rum and ignite. Stir to dissolve browned bits.
Add remaining ingredients, and boil until reduced by ⅓.
Add strawberries, reduce heat to low, and cook ½ hour.
Remove pan from heat and serve.

recipes.title: Creamy Tomato and Bean Soup
recipes.description: A blended, hearty vegetarian soup made mostly from canned tomatoes and white beans, finished with cream cheese and fresh basil.

ingredients.text: 1 tbsp olive oil or neutral cooking oil
ingredients.name: olej roślinny
ingredients.note: olive oil or neutral cooking oil

ingredients.text: 1 can (15 oz / 425 g) white beans, with liquid
ingredients.name: fasola biała

ingredients.text: 5–10 cloves garlic (according to preference), peeled and cut in half
ingredients.name: czosnek
ingredients.note: 5–10, according to preference, peeled and cut in half

ingredients.text: 2 leaves fresh sage, torn in half by hand
ingredients.name: szałwia świeża

ingredients.text: 2 cans (30 oz / 850 g) crushed or diced tomatoes
ingredients.name: pomidory

ingredients.text: 10–20 leaves of fresh basil, chiffonaded or torn to strips by hand
ingredients.name: bazylia świeża
ingredients.note: 10–20, chiffonaded or torn to strips by hand

steps.text: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat for about 30 seconds or until it begins to shimmer.
Add onions to the large pot of oil, and season with salt and pepper. Cook about 2 minutes until softened, stirring occasionally to prevent burning.
Add the beans with their liquid, garlic, oregano, and sage. Simmer for 3–5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, tomato paste, red pepper, and water. Simmer an additional 5–10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove from heat, stir in the cream cheese, and break up any large piece with the stirring utensil.
Let the soup cool for 1–2 minutes, then use either a blender or stick blender to purée the soup.
Return the puréed soup to the stove at the lowest heat setting for an additional 10–15 minutes, stirring often to prevent burning.
Just before serving, stir in fresh basil leaves, reserving a handful to garnish each bowl.

recipes.title: Omo tuo
recipes.description: A Ghanaian rice dish of cooked rice rolled or pounded into balls, traditionally served with soup.

steps.text: After properly cleaning the rice, add it to a saucepan of water.
When the rice is tender, add salt and bring to a boil.
Give it a good five to seven minutes.
To make the rice smooth, mash it with a wooden spoon or a small pestle.
Pour cold water into a cup and place it near the pan.
Transfer the rice to a serving dish after scooping it with wet hands and rolling it into balls.

recipes.title: Wali wa Nazi
recipes.description: Traditional East African rice dish prepared by cooking rice in coconut milk.

steps.text: Wash the rice thoroughly until the water runs clear.
Soak the rice in water for 20 minutes, then drain.
In a cooking pot, combine the coconut milk, water, and salt.
Bring the mixture to a gentle boil over medium heat.
Add the drained rice and stir once.
Reduce the heat to low and cover the pot tightly.
Cook for 20–25 minutes, or until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender.
Remove the pot from the heat and allow it to rest for 5–10 minutes.
Fluff the rice gently with a fork before serving.

recipes.title: Chikanda (Zambian Orchid Sausage)
recipes.description: Chikanda is a unique and flavorful Zambian snack made from the roots of the chikanda orchid plant. Also known as "African sausage" or "African polony".

ingredients.text: 2 cups water (for boiling the chikanda roots)
ingredients.name: woda

ingredients.text: 1 cup dried and ground wild orchid tubers (chikanda roots)
ingredients.name: korzeń storczyka chikanda
ingredients.note: dried and ground wild orchid tubers

ingredients.text: ½ cup water (for mixing with the groundnuts)
ingredients.name: woda

steps.text: In a pot, bring 2 cups of water to a boil. Add the dried and ground chikanda roots to the boiling water. Boil for about 30 minutes to soften them.
While the chikanda roots are boiling, toast the groundnuts in a dry pan over medium heat until they are slightly browned and aromatic.
Allow the boiled chikanda roots and the roasted groundnuts to cool down to room temperature.
In a blender or food processor, grind the roasted groundnuts into a fine powder. Add ½ cup of water to the groundnuts and blend to form a smooth paste.
In the same blender or food processor, blend the cooked rice until it becomes a smooth paste.
In a large bowl, mix together the ground chikanda, groundnut paste, and rice paste. Use your hands or a wooden spoon to combine the ingredients thoroughly.
Add the chopped onion, minced garlic, and chopped hot pepper (if using) to the mixture. Mix well.
Season the chikanda mixture with ground cayenne pepper, ground cumin, and salt to taste. Adjust the seasoning according to your preference.
Take a handful of the chikanda mixture and roll it into a sausage shape using your hands.
Repeat the process until all the mixture is used up, forming several chikanda sausages.
Place the chikanda sausages on a clean surface or plate and allow them to dry and firm up for about 3 to 4 hours.
Once the chikanda sausages have dried and firmed up, they are ready to be served.

recipes.title: Ployes
recipes.description: Thin, bubbly buckwheat pancakes cooked on one side only, originating from French-Acadian communities in New Brunswick, Quebec, and Northern Maine.

ingredients.text: ¾ cup (90 g) unbleached all-purpose flour (or gluten-free blend)
ingredients.name: mąka pszenna

ingredients.text: ½ cup (120 ml) hot water (not boiling)
ingredients.name: woda

steps.text: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together buckwheat flour, all-purpose flour, baking powder, and salt.
Stir in cold water gradually to form a thick paste. Mix until just combined.
Slowly add hot water, whisking vigorously to create a smooth, lump-free batter. The consistency should be thinner than pancake batter but thicker than cream.
Let the batter rest at room temperature for 15–30 minutes. Bubbles should begin to form.
Heat a dry cast iron skillet over medium-high heat until hot but not smoking.
Stir the batter briefly. Ladle about ¼ cup into the center of the pan and spread thinly with the back of the ladle.
Cook on one side only until the top is dry and full of holes. Do not flip.
Stack cooked ployes on a plate and cover with a clean towel to keep warm. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Red Beet Food Coloring
recipes.description: This homemade food coloring derives its color from beets.

ingredients.text: 2 medium beetroots, peeled and cut into chunks
ingredients.name: burak

steps.text: Blend beets and water in a food processor.
Using a cheesecloth, strain the purée into a bowl to extract the juice.
Pour the juice into a saucepan and add sugar.
Turn the heat to medium-high, and stir to dissolve the sugar.
Skim off and discard any foam that collects at the surface of the liquid.
Simmer until the liquid reduces to a single-thread consistency.
Turn off the heat and stir in the lemon juice.
Cool slightly, then pour into an airtight jar and cool completely.

recipes.title: Hartshorne Sweet Sauce
recipes.description: A sweet sauce of red wine, vinegar, meat broth, onion, cinnamon and bay leaf.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan.
Simmer for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Nigerian White Soup (Ofe Nsala)
recipes.description: A light, delicately spiced Igbo soup made without palm oil, thickened with raw yam and traditionally prepared with fresh catfish.

ingredients.text: 1 kilograms fresh catfish (or chicken/goat meat), cleaned and cut
ingredients.name: sum świeży

ingredients.text: 200 grams raw yam, peeled and sliced (for thickening)
ingredients.name: jam surowy, obrany

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoons ogiri okpei (fermented locust bean paste)
ingredients.name: ogiri okpei

steps.text: Wash and clean the catfish, cut it thoroughly, season lightly with diced onion, a pinch of salt and one seasoning cube, and set aside. If using goat meat or chicken, cook until nearly tender and reserve the stock.
Boil the sliced raw yam in a small pot of water until very soft, then pound or blend into a smooth, lump-free paste. This will serve as the soup thickener.

Place the catfish and stockfish in a pot, add enough water to cover, then add ogiri okpei, ground ehuru, blended scotch bonnet pepper and the remaining onion. Bring to a boil on medium heat and cook until the fish is just tender; do not overcook catfish or it will fall apart.
Add the yam paste in small spoonfuls into the boiling soup, stir gently and allow it to dissolve and thicken the broth.
Add the ground crayfish and the remaining seasoning cube. Taste and adjust with salt.
Stir in the shredded uziza leaves and cook for 3-5 minutes only. The soup should be light, aromatic, pale in colour, and gently thickened.
Serve hot with pounded yam (iyán), eba, fufu, or semovita.

recipes.title: Biscuit Cake
recipes.description: A traditional cake made from equal weights of butter, sugar and flour with eggs, flavored with nutmeg and caraway, adapted from an 18th-century handwritten recipe.

ingredients.text: 1 pound butter, softened and cut in pieces
ingredients.name: masło

steps.text: Beat together the eggs, butter, and sugar until very creamy.
Combine the flour, nutmeg, and caraway seeds.
Add the dry mixture to the egg mixture, and beat for 1 hour.
Transfer to a pan, and bake for 1 hour.
Let cool and unmold.

recipes.title: Deep Fried Pretzels
recipes.description: A quick snack that works well as an appetizer. Many variations are possible.

ingredients.text: 1 cup canola oil or vegetable oil
ingredients.name: olej roślinny

ingredients.text: ¼ tsp seasoned salt, garlic salt, or Italian seasoning
ingredients.name: sól przyprawowa
ingredients.note: seasoned salt, garlic salt, or Italian seasoning

steps.text: Fill a deep saucepan partially full of canola oil.
Heat up the oil.
Cover a paper towel with seasoning (the paper towel will help absorb moisture).
Then set paper towel on a plate.
Use a spatula to drop pretzels into oil.
Only leave them in for 2–3 seconds.
Remove pretzels, and lay them out on bed of seasoning to dry.
The oil may be used for multiple batches.

recipes.title: Omu Tuo (Ghanian Mashed Rice)
recipes.description: Omu tuo to ghański przysmak z ugotowanego i ubitego ryżu, formowany w kule podobne do ugali. Podawany z zupami orzechowymi lub palmowymi.

steps.text: If desired, rinse the rice well to eliminate excess starch. This step is optional as the starch contributes to the desired stickiness of the rice.
Combine the rice, butter, and salt in a pot with water. Cook over low heat, allowing the rice to slowly simmer until all the water is absorbed and the rice reaches a soft texture.
Using a wooden spoon, begin pounding the rice in the pot, alternating from one side to the other. Repeat this process until the rice transforms into a mushy consistency.
Transfer the mashed rice to a moistened bowl and gently swirl it until a bowl shape is formed.
Serve with peanut stew or any other soup of your preference.

recipes.title: Passover Hazelnut Loaf Cake
recipes.description: Passover hazelnut loaf cake that tastes like Nutella without the chocolate.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 °F (180 °C).
Grind the hazelnuts in a food processor until fine. You should have about 3½ cups.
Whip sugar and egg yolks until light yellow.
Whip the whites until soft peaks form.
Fold the ground nuts and the egg whites into the egg yolk mixture.
Pour into a shallow wide-brimmed oven-safe dish.
Bake for 30 minutes until the surface is golden brown.

recipes.title: Spicy Fried Okra
recipes.description: Smażony okra w pikantnej panierce z mąki i ostrego sosu.

steps.text: Combine salt, peppers, and ½ cup flour. Coat okra with flour mixture.
Dip okra into hot sauce and dredge in remaining flour, adding more as needed.
Let rest 2–3 minutes.
Heat oil in a large pot or a deep-fryer to 375°F.
Add okra, 6 at a time, and fry 3–4 minutes until golden brown and crispy.
Drain on a cooling rack and repeat until all okra has been fried.
Sprinkle fried okra with additional kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper and serve warm.

recipes.title: Chocolate Orange Hot Cross Bun Trifle
recipes.description: A layered trifle of marmalade custard, chocolate and salted caramel hot cross buns, orange segments, whipped cream and chocolate dessert sauce.

ingredients.text: 6 chocolate and salted caramel hot cross buns, 2 split into halves and 4 torn into pieces
ingredients.name: bułka z czekoladą i słonym karmelem
ingredients.note: 2 split into halves and 4 torn into pieces

ingredients.text: 1¼ cups (310 ml/10 fl oz) heavy cream
ingredients.name: śmietanka kremówka

ingredients.text: 4 large oranges, zested and split into segments
ingredients.name: pomarańcza

steps.text: Microwave the marmalade for 30–60 seconds to loosen.
Leave the marmalade to cool until it is just warm to the touch.
Combine the marmalade and custard in a bowl and mix together.
Whip the cream with most of the orange zest in another bowl to soft peaks.
Heat the sugar, cinnamon, and water in a pan over a low heat for 4–6 minutes, swirling occasionally.
Place the torn buns in a 3-trifle dish.
Pour the custard mixture into the trifle dish.
Add a layer of three-quarters of the orange segments and two-thirds of the whipped cream.
Spoon 3 tablespoons of the dessert sauce over the dish.
Top with remaining custard and cream.
Drizzle the remaining sauce over the trifle.
Place the remaining orange segments on top.
Brush the bun tops with the cinnamon glaze and place on top of the trifle.
To serve, sprinkle with the remaining orange zest.

recipes.title: Oat Bran Cereal
recipes.description: Easy breakfast cereal made from oat bran, water and salt.

steps.text: Boil water.
Stir in oat bran and salt
Reduce heat and cook for 4–6 minutes

recipes.title: Firecracker Grilled Shrimp
