recipes.description: Shrimp marinated in Firecracker marinade, threaded on bamboo skewers and grilled over charcoal until pink and slightly charred.

steps.text: Pour marinade into a gallon size zip-top bag. Add shrimp and toss to coat. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Drain shrimp and discard remaining marinade. Thread 4 shrimp onto each skewer.
Preheat your charcoal grill using a chimney starter, not lighter fluid to medium high. Reapply the grate and add shrimp. Cook, turning often, until shrimp is pink and slightly charred.
Remove shrimp from skewers and discard skewers. Serve warm.

recipes.title: American Marinara Sauce II
recipes.description: A more rustic, less Italian-American marinara sauce with onion, garlic, yellow bell pepper, herbs, fresh basil and white wine, simmered in tomatoes and tossed with pasta.

ingredients.text: Extra-virgin olive oil (preferably Italian, if not Italian then Tunisian, French, and Greek are advisable)
ingredients.name: oliwa z oliwek
ingredients.note: preferably Italian, if not Italian then Tunisian, French, and Greek are advisable

ingredients.text: ½ head of garlic (or less), minced
ingredients.name: czosnek

ingredients.text: 1 cup (240 g) fresh basil, finely torn or roughly chopped and reserved
ingredients.name: bazylia świeża
ingredients.note: finely torn or roughly chopped, reserved

ingredients.text: 2 medium to large onions (preferably red or yellow), diced
ingredients.name: cebula
ingredients.note: medium to large, preferably red or yellow, diced

ingredients.text: 1 yellow bell pepper, cut into strips
ingredients.name: papryka żółta

ingredients.text: 1 large can plus 1 small can whole tomatoes, crushed by hand with juices
ingredients.name: pomidory z puszki
ingredients.note: large can plus small can, crushed by hand with juices

ingredients.text: ½ cup (120 ml), plus more as needed, white table wine
ingredients.name: wino białe wytrawne

steps.text: Heat the olive oil and almond oil in an oversized pan. Add onion, garlic, and bell pepper, and sweat.
Deglaze pan with white wine, then add tomatoes.
Grind dried herbs and red pepper flakes with a mortar and pestle. Add this mixture and the unreserved fresh basil to the pan.
Simmer for an hour (or more if necessary), stirring occasionally.
Add wine until desired consistency is achieved. Add salt and pepper to taste.
Add al dente pasta to pan with sauce and combine using tongs.
Plate and garnish with fresh basil and Parmigiano-Reggiano.

recipes.title: Kuih Bakul (Malaysian Sweet Browned Rice Cake)
recipes.description: Steamed sticky rice cake cooked so long that it browns and develops a nutty flavor from the Maillard reaction. The Malaysian equivalent of the Cantonese nian gao.

steps.text: Line each tin with banana leaves, making sure they overlap each other and extend well above the rim of the tin.
Fold the banana leaves back down so that they are folded over the outside rim of the tin.
Tie a piece of twine around the circumference of the tin to secure the folded leaves in place.
Gradually mix the water into the rice flour until smooth and well combined.
Stir in the sugar until completely dissolved.
Let rest for 15 minutes.
Stir the mixture, and divide it evenly between the prepared tins.
Bring a few inches of water to boil in the bottom of a steamer.
Place the filled tins in the steamer. Wrap the lid in a cloth to prevent condensation dripping, and cover the steamer.
Steam for 7–8 hours, topping up the steamer with additional boiling water as needed. When the cake is cooked, it should be browned.
Remove the tins from the steamer, and let them cool and rest overnight.
Untie the twine, and unmold the cakes.
If desired, use scissors to trim the excess banana leaves flush with the top of the cake.

recipes.title: Homemade Fines Herbes
recipes.description: Fines herbes is a mixture of herbs used in French cuisine. It normally contains parsley, chives, tarragon and chervil.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients together.
Use as directed in your recipe.

recipes.title: Mutura
recipes.description: Mutura is a traditional Kenyan sausage made by stuffing cleaned animal intestines with minced meat, spices and sometimes fresh animal blood, then grilling it over charcoal.

ingredients.text: 500 g beef, goat meat, or mixed meat, finely chopped
ingredients.name: mięso wołowe, kozie lub mieszane

ingredients.text: 200 g tripe or organ meat, finely chopped
ingredients.name: flaki wołowe

steps.text: Thoroughly clean the intestines using water and salt. Rinse several times until clean.
Boil the chopped meat and tripe for several minutes until partly cooked.
Heat a pan and sauté the onions, garlic, ginger, and chilies until fragrant.
Combine the meat mixture with the sautéed ingredients in a bowl.
Add black pepper, coriander leaves, and salt.
Stir in the blood if using.
Carefully stuff the cleaned intestines with the meat mixture, avoiding overfilling.
Tie the ends securely with kitchen twine or thin strips of casing.
Grill the mutura over medium charcoal heat, turning regularly until browned and fully cooked.
Slice into bite-sized pieces and serve hot.

recipes.title: Pimento Cheese Spread II
recipes.description: Pasta serowa z papryką pimento i majonezem, podawana schłodzona.

ingredients.text: 1 jar (7 ounces) roasted red peppers or pimentos
ingredients.name: papryka czerwona pieczona

ingredients.text: 1 pound sharp or extra sharp cheddar cheese, coarsely grated
ingredients.name: ser cheddar
ingredients.note: sharp or extra sharp, coarsely grated

steps.text: Drain and chop red peppers (or pimentos).
Toss peppers with grated cheese.
In a separate bowl, whisk lemon juice and mayonnaise together.
Pour liquid mix over cheese mixture and mix until well-blended.
Keep refrigerated.

recipes.title: Italian Chicken Rolls
recipes.description: Zawijane piersi z kurczaka nadziewane serem ricotta, kremowym serkiem i mozzarellą, zapiekane w sosie pomidorowym.

ingredients.text: 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut in half
ingredients.name: pierś z kurczaka
ingredients.note: bez kości i skóry, przekrojone na pół

steps.text: Combine ricotta, cream cheese, and ½ cup mozzarella cheese. Set aside.
Place chicken on a sheet of plastic wrap and cover with another. Pound out to ¼ inch thickness.
Sprinkle one side of chicken liberally with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Spread unseasoned side with cheese mixture and roll up.
Place seam-side down in a greased 13x9-inch (or smaller) baking dish. Pour sauce over and bake in a 425°F oven 20 minutes or until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Heat broiler. Sprinkle chicken with cheese and place under broiler until cheese is melted. Remove and serve warm.

recipes.title: Mukimo
recipes.description: Traditional Kenyan dish of mashed boiled potatoes with green vegetables and legumes such as peas, maize or beans.

ingredients.text: 2 cups pumpkin leaves, spinach, or kale, chopped
ingredients.name: liście dyni
ingredients.note: chopped; pumpkin leaves, spinach, or kale

steps.text: Place the potatoes, maize, and peas in a large pot and cover with water.
Bring to a boil and cook until the potatoes are tender.
Add the chopped vegetables and continue cooking for 5–10 minutes.
Drain excess water if necessary.
Mash all the ingredients together until well combined.
Season with salt to taste.
Serve hot with beef stew, chicken stew, or grilled meat.

recipes.title: Fasolia (Ethiopian Green Bean Stew)
recipes.description: Fasolia is an Ethiopian stew of tender green beans cooked in a rich, aromatic sauce. It is a vegetarian dish often served with injera or rice.

ingredients.text: ½ teaspoon cayenne pepper, or to taste
ingredients.name: pieprz cayenne

ingredients.text: 500 grams (1 lb) fresh green beans, trimmed and cut into bite-sized pieces
ingredients.name: fasolka szparagowa
ingredients.note: trimmed and cut into bite-sized pieces

ingredients.text: Fresh cilantro or parsley, chopped, for garnish
ingredients.name: kolendra świeża (liście)

steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet or frying pan over medium heat.
Add the finely chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet. Sauté until the onion becomes translucent and the garlic is fragrant.
Add the diced tomatoes to the skillet and cook for a few minutes until they start to soften.
Stir in the berbere spice blend, paprika, cumin, coriander, turmeric, cayenne pepper, and salt. Mix well to coat the onions and tomatoes with the spices.
Add the trimmed and cut green beans to the skillet and stir to combine them with the spice mixture.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the skillet with a lid, and simmer for about 20–25 minutes, or until the green beans are tender but still slightly crisp. Stir occasionally to ensure even cooking.
Taste and adjust the seasoning with salt or additional spices if desired.
Remove from heat and let the stew rest for a few minutes to allow the flavors to meld together.
Garnish with freshly chopped cilantro or parsley.
Serve as a main course, accompanied by injera or rice.

recipes.title: Sailor's Sauce (Hartshorne)
recipes.description: Sailor's sauce is a deeply rich sauce that can be used for a number of meat-based dishes.

steps.text: Chop the liver, shallots, truffles or mushrooms.
Heat a saucepan with oil. Once hot, add the above mixture and fry for 1 minute.
Add the gravy, wine, salt, and pepper.
Simmer for half an hour.
Strain contents and serve.

recipes.title: Kele Ka Halwa (Fried Bananas in Milk)
recipes.description: A banana dessert of fried bananas mixed with thickened milk and topped with toasted nuts.

steps.text: Chop the cashews and almonds into small pieces.
Fry the chopped nuts in a small amount of ghee until golden-brown.
Simmer the milk until reduced and very thick.
Peel the bananas, and cut into ¼ inch-thick slices.
Heat the 250 g ghee in a skillet. Add the bananas, and fry until they turn brown. Remove the fried bananas from the hot oil.
Mix the cooked bananas with the thickened milk, and let cool.
Garnish the bananas and milk with the toasted nuts, and serve.

categories: Recipes using pork broth and stock

recipes.title: Bò bía
recipes.description: Southern Vietnamese variant of popiah, a fresh spring roll filled with sausage, jicama, egg omelette, shrimp and herbs.

ingredients.text: 400 g jicama, peeled and cut into matchsticks
ingredients.name: jicama

steps.text: Roast the small dried shrimps without any oil in a pan by stirring constantly on medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes until fragrant.
Clean the pan, fill about half full with water and bring to a boil. Cook 2 Chinese sausages for about 10 minutes to soften and remove some of the fat.
Rinse the sausages well, let them cool and slide them thinly on a diagonal.
Crack 2 eggs in a small bowl and beat them until fluffy. Season lightly with a pinch of salt and a pinch of sugar.
In a non-stick pan, add 1 tsp of vegetable oil. When it's hot enough, pour in half of the egg mixture and quickly tilt the pan in a circular motion to spread the egg thinly and evenly.
When one side is golden, flip it over and fry the other side for 5 more seconds. Repeat until the egg mixture has been used up.
Let the omelettes cool completely. Roll them up and cut into half-inch strips.
In a saucepan, heat up some cooking oil and sauté 1 tbsp of garlic until fragrant.
Add in the jicama strips and stir-fry with some salt for about 10 to 15 minutes until it turns quite translucent and tastes naturally sweet.
Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a small sauce pan on medium-high heat, then fry 1 tbsp minced garlic till golden brown.
Add hoisin sauce, pork broth, peanut butter and sugar. Stir well and simmer on low heat for 1-2 minutes until thickened.
Transfer to condiment bowls and top up with minced fresh chili, pickled carrots and daikon and crushed peanuts.

Set up a rolling station with the prepared Chinese sausages, stir-fried jicama, omelette strips, fresh greens (e.g. lettuce and Thai basil), roasted small dried shrimps, some crushed peanuts and fried shallots ready on the plates.
Prepare a small bowl with pickled carrots and daikon.
Prepare a large bowl of lukewarm water to soften rice paper, and a flat work surface (like a cutting board or a large plate) for the rolling job.
To soften the rice paper, quickly dip it into a bowl of warm water (the dipping motion should take no more than 2 seconds). Gently shake off excess water and lay it on the flat surface.

Place a piece of lettuce and a few basil leaves at one end of the paper, then continue to add some of the stir-fried jicama, few slices of the Chinese sausages, few omelette strips, some roasted small dried shrimps, some fried shallots and crushed peanuts.

Starting from the end with vegetables, roll 1-2 rounds first until you reach the center of the rice paper, then fold both sides inwards. Then continue rolling until reaching the other end of the paper.
Roll gently and tight enough, so that the ingredients do not fall out after one's first bite. A nice roll should show up all the colors of the ingredients inside.
To serve, dip the salad roll in the dipping sauce or spoon some of the sauce onto the roll and have a bite.

recipes.title: Scotch Bonnet Pepper Poppers
recipes.description: Scotch bonnet peppers stuffed with a ricotta, Parmesan and sausage filling, then baked.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Fry sausage on medium-high heat, chopping as it cooks until it is the size of small peas. Drain and cool slightly.
In a bowl, mix ricotta, Parmesan, and onion with sausage to form the filling.
Cut tops of peppers about ¼ inch below the stem. Set tops aside.

With a sharp knife, scoop out seeds and membrane from each pepper. Mix as much of the seeds and membrane into the filling as needed to regulate heat. For example, moderate poppers use seeds and membrane from 6–8 peppers. Moderate poppers nicely complement the cocktail hour. For very hot poppers, leave the seeds and membranes in each pepper.
Using your fingers, stuff each pepper with filling. Replace tops.
Place poppers on parchment-lined tray and bake 15–20 minutes or until desired.
Cool slightly before serving.

recipes.title: Marshmallow Rice Squares II
recipes.description: Puffed cereal squares bound with melted marshmallows, milk and powdered sugar.

ingredients.text: 1 cup marshmallows (either regular white, cream soda flavour, or bubblegum flavour)
ingredients.name: pianki marshmallow
ingredients.note: either regular white, cream soda flavour, or bubblegum flavour

steps.text: Melt marshmallows in the microwave in 30 second intervals until it melts into a creamy mixture.
Remove marshmallow fluff from microwave, pour in the milk, and mix for 1½ minutes.
Add the powdered sugar and mix for 2 more minutes.
Add the puffed cereal, and mix for 1 more minute.
Put back in microwave and heat for 13 seconds.
Remove from the microwave and mix a final time.
Press into a greased dish or pan. Let set, then cut into pieces.

recipes.title: Strawberry Frozen Yogurt
recipes.description: Frozen yogurt made from puréed fresh strawberries, lemon, Greek yogurt and sugar.

steps.text: Wash and dry the strawberries and lemon.
Slice strawberries into small pieces.
Combine strawberries and sugar.
Roll a lemon on a counter while applying pressure with the palm of one hand. Cut lemon in half and squeeze both halves through a strainer into the strawberry mixture.
Remove any remaining seeds from the lemon halves and add them, with the rind, to the strawberry mixture.
Allow strawberry mixture to macerate for 1–2 hours, stirring occasionally until all of the sugar crystals are dissolved.
Discard lemon halves, then orange liqueur to the strawberry mixture.
Use a blender or food processor to reduce the strawberry mixture to a purée, but don't over-blend.
Stir the Greek yogurt into to the strawberry mixture, mixing until well combined.
Refrigerate strawberry yogurt mixture for at 4 four hours.
Pour strawberry yogurt mixture into a prepared ice cream maker, and mix for approximately 20 minutes, or until the frozen yogurt has reached a firm consistency.
Eat immediately, or freeze for later.

recipes.title: Liver Kebabs
recipes.description: Szaszłyki z wątróbki, smaczne i dobre dla małych dzieci, podawane z chlebem i marokańską sałatką.

steps.text: Cut the liver into small cubes about 1 cm square, and put them in a container.
Add paprika, some salt and pepper, chopped coriander, minced garlic, and oil to the liver.
Mix this all together and leave to marinate for 30 minutes or more.
Slide the meat onto skewers, and grill to preferred level of char.

recipes.title: Rosemary and Citrus Cordial
recipes.description: Syrop cytrusowy z rozmarynem i imbirem, do rozcieńczania wodą gazowaną.

steps.text: Using a peeler, remove long strips of peel from grapefruit and 2 of lemons. Be careful not to remove any of white pith.
Put the peels into a saucepan. Juice the lemons and grapefruit, and add the juice to the pan.
Using a rolling pin, roll over the rosemary sprigs a few times on a chopping board to release the oils.
Add the rosemary to the pan with ginger, sugar, and water.
Heat for 5 minutes over a low-medium heat, stirring occasionally, to dissolve the sugar.
Reduce the heat to low and cook for 15 minutes until you get a slightly thick syrup. Leave it to cool, then use immediately or chill overnight to develop the flavors.
Strain the cordial syrup through a sieve into a bowl or jug. Transfer to a bottle.
To use, mix 1–2 tablespoons of cordial into ⅔ cup (160 ml) of fizzy water to make a soda, or add to boiling water with 2 tablespoons of whiskey to make a hot toddy.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Soup
recipes.description: This sweet potato soup is inspired by flavors of Southeast Africa and Asia, with the addition of ginger and lime.

ingredients.name: śmietanka
ingredients.note: reason: missing units; what is "milk cream"?

steps.text: Place the peeled potatoes, ginger, stock, and water in a large saucepan.
Bring to a boil, then simmer until the potatoes are softened and tender (approximately 30 minutes).
Transfer the contents of the pot to a blender along with the lime juice, and process until smooth. You may need to work in batches. Alternatively, you can use an immersion blender.
Return the soup to the pot, stir in the milk, and allow to cook for few minutes until heated through.

recipes.title: Coquitos (Coconut Macaroons)
recipes.description: Coconut macaroons made from eggs, desiccated coconut, sugar and vanilla, piped onto a baking sheet.

steps.text: Preheat your oven to 180°C.
Mix all ingredients together in a bowl.

If your paste is too thick to pipe with a large piping tip, then add the water, and keep adding one tablespoon of water at a time until you get a consistency you can pipe. If your eggs are extra large, you may not need the extra water.
Pipe dollops on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Bake in a medium to hot oven for 30 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Cola IV
recipes.description: Cola is a type of soda flavored with citrus and spices. This homemade version is a syrup mixed with carbonated water.

ingredients.text: 12 drops tea tree oil (optional, read important warning below)
ingredients.name: olejek z drzewa herbacianego

ingredients.text: 50 ml 150+ proof unflavored spirit or a mixture of 25 ml water with 25 ml gum arabic
ingredients.name: spirytus niearomatyzowany 150+ proof
ingredients.note: or a mixture of 25 ml water with 25 ml gum arabic

steps.text: Mix the oils in flavor solution A in a container.
Transfer 1 ml of flavor solution A into another container and dilute it with the spirit or gum arabic water.
Mix flavor solution B in a third container.
Combine ½ teaspoon (2.5 ml) of the finished flavor solution A, all of flavor solution B, the white sugar, and the water to make the syrup.
To make the finished soda, combine 1 volume of syrup with 3 volumes of carbonated water.

recipes.title: Tofu Scramble II
recipes.description: Wegańska jajecznica z tofu, z dodatkiem wegańskiego bekonu i zielonej cebuli.

ingredients.text: 2 strips Smart vegetarian bacon or other breakfast meat substitute
ingredients.name: wegetariański bekon
ingredients.note: Smart vegetarian bacon or other breakfast meat substitute

ingredients.text: ½ large block of firm tofu
ingredients.name: tofu

ingredients.text: A couple dashes of ground turmeric
ingredients.name: kurkuma

steps.text: Heat the oil in a pan on medium-high heat.
Add the bacon and cook, but don't cook it too long.
Once it's done, chop it into small pieces.
Press as much water from the tofu as possible.
Use a cheese grater to grate the tofu into semi-small chunks.
Add the onion, garlic, bacon, turmeric, and liquid aminos to the tofu, and stir gently until well mixed.
Put it in the hot pan (it should sizzle a bit), and sprinkle the nutritional yeast flakes over the top.
Keep stirring occasionally for about 10 minutes or until you've got the desired look of scrambled "eggs."

recipes.title: Mtori (Tanzanian stew)
recipes.description: Mtori is a traditional Tanzanian stew made from green bananas (plantains) and meat, usually beef. It is known for its creamy texture and is commonly served as a comforting, energy-rich meal.

ingredients.text: 6–8 green cooking bananas (plantains), peeled and sliced
ingredients.name: banan plantan

steps.text: Place the beef and water in a large pot.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer until the meat is tender, about 1–1½ hours.
Remove the meat from the stock and set aside.
Add the bananas, onion, carrot, bell pepper, and potato to the stock.
Cook until the bananas become very soft.
Return the cooked meat to the pot.
Add the ginger, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Simmer for 10 minutes.
Mash the bananas using a wooden spoon or potato masher until a thick, creamy consistency is achieved.
Stir in the butter or margarine.
Adjust seasoning to taste.
Simmer for another 5 minutes.
Garnish with fresh coriander and serve hot.

recipes.title: Papaya Lassi
recipes.description: Gęsty napój jogurtowy z papają, miodem i cynamonem.

steps.text: Combine everything in a blender.
Blend until smooth.

recipes.title: Chicken Bog III
recipes.description: A one-pot Southern-style chicken and rice dish cooked in its own broth with vegetables and herbs.

ingredients.text: 2 stalks celery, washed and snapped in halves or quarters (leaves and all)
ingredients.name: seler naciowy
ingredients.note: washed and snapped in halves or quarters (leaves and all)

steps.text: In a large soup pot, kettle, or deep-sided heavy casserole with top, combine onion, celery, carrots, poultry seasoning, parsley flakes, bay leaves, salt, and pepper.
Rinse the chicken and place on top of the other ingredients in the pot. Add enough water to cover the chicken and bring to a boil, uncovered, over medium-high heat.
Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for about 1 hour, or until juices run clear when the chicken is pricked with a fork.
Remove chicken to a platter to cool. Strain broth from pot (you should have about 8 cups; if you have more, set aside for another use).
Return 8 cups broth to the pot and bring to a boil over high heat. Pour in rice and return to a boil. Adjust heat to lowest possible setting, stir and cover.
Cook 20 minutes, stirring occasionally and keeping an eye on the pot to be sure it does not cook dry. Add more of the broth if necessary.
While the rice is cooking, skin and remove chicken meat from the bones; discard bones and skin. Cut meat into bite-sized pieces and set aside.
When the rice is cooked, add the boneless chicken and butter. Stir together carefully, taste to correct seasoning and serve. Or, keep pot covered over low heat until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Mesquite BBQ Burger
recipes.description: Grilled beef burgers seasoned with mesquite smoke powder, molasses and yellow mustard.

steps.text: Preheat grill to 500–575°F.
Combine garlic, smoke powder, and 4 heavy pinches each of salt and freshly ground black pepper. Set aside.
Combine remaining ingredients in a mixing bowl. Form into ¾ inch-thick patties and make an indentation in the center of each patty with your thumb.
Sprinkle patties on both sides with seasoning mixture. Place on grill and cook, turning often, until desired 'doneness' is achieved.
Serve on buns with cook's choice of cheese and desired toppings.

recipes.title: Mesquite BBQ Salmon
recipes.description: Grillowany łosoś z mesquite, z przyprawami w stylu teksańskim i sosem barbecue.

ingredients.text: 4 ea. (24 ounces) skin-on wild salmon filets, pin bones removed
ingredients.name: filet z łososia dzikiego

ingredients.text: ¾ cup mesquite wood chips, soaked in water for 30 minutes
ingredients.name: wiórki drzewa mesquite

steps.text: Combine lemon juice and olive oil in a gallon-size zip-top bag. Add salmon, toss to coat, and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour.
Wad up a sheet of newspaper and moisten with vegetable oil. Place under chimney full of coals, which you have put in the bottom of the grill, then light. Wait 15 minutes.
While charcoal heats, combine seasonings and sugar. Rub into salmon filets.

Dump coals evenly around grill and toss in wood chips. Re-apply grate, then quickly swab grill with the towel. Add salmon filets, skin side down, to the hottest part of the grill and cook 2–3 minutes per side for medium rare, rotating 90 degrees halfway through cooking to make grill marks.
Brush meat side with sauce and cook until charred and crispy on the meat side, about 30 seconds. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Lemon-Lime Soda II
recipes.description: Lemon-lime soda is a carbonated beverage flavored similarly to lemon- and limeade.

ingredients.text: 1 tsp (5 mL) 150+ proof unflavored spirit OR a mixture of ½ tsp (2.5 mL) gum arabic with ½ tsp (2.5 mL) water
ingredients.name: alkohol neutralny o mocy 150+ proof
ingredients.note: 150+ proof unflavored spirit, or gum arabic mixed with water

steps.text: Combine the spirit or gum arabic water and oils together in a small cup, mixing well. Set aside.
Transfer this mixture into a larger container.
Put the citric acid, water, and white sugar into the container. Stir well.
To make the finished soda, combine 1 volume of syrup with 5 volumes of carbonated water.

recipes.title: Simple Boiled Chickpeas
recipes.description: Dried chickpeas cooked from scratch with celery, which the page says taste far better than canned.

steps.text: Cover the chickpeas completely with water, and let them soak overnight.
Drain the chickpeas.
Combine the chickpeas and celery in a pot.
Add enough water to completely cover the contents by a few inches.
Bring the pot to a simmer over medium heat.
Cook for about 2 hours until the chickpeas are tender; the cooking time is not an exact science, so bite into a chickpea to see if it is fully cooked.
Once the chickpeas are done, drain the cooking liquid. If desired, reserve it to use as aquafaba.
Use the cooked chickpeas as you would canned chickpeas.
Alternatively, season them with salt, pepper, and a dash of olive oil and vinegar if you would like to eat them plain.

recipes.title: Sweet Maple Barbecue Chicken
recipes.description: Grilled chicken leg quarters coated with a hickory BBQ rub and maple barbecue sauce.

steps.text: Press rub into chicken.
Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Preheat grill to medium high.
Add chicken pieces and cook, turning often, 15 minutes.
Brush chicken liberally with 1 cup barbecue sauce and cook, turning often, until internal temperature reaches 165–170°F.
Remove to a platter and cover with aluminum foil and let rest 10 minutes.
Serve warm with remaining ½ cup barbecue sauce.

recipes.title: Kunun Aduwa (Nigerian Tiger Nut Milk)
recipes.description: Traditional Nigerian beverage made from tiger nuts (aduwa), naturally sweetened with dates and often served cold.

ingredients.text: 2 cups dried or fresh tiger nuts (aduwa)
ingredients.name: orzech tygrysi

steps.text: If using dried tiger nuts, soak them in water overnight to soften, then drain and rinse them.
In a blender, combine the tiger nuts, ginger, and dates.
Blend until smooth and creamy, adding water as needed to aid blending.
Strain the blended mixture using a fine sieve or cheesecloth to separate the milk from the chaff.
Chill in the refrigerator and serve cold.

recipes.title: Deep Fried Urad and Rice Flour Dough Balls (Murukku)
recipes.description: Chrupiące murukku z mąki ryżowej i urad dal, doprawione chili, kminkiem i sezamem.

steps.text: Dry roast the urad dal. Grind it into a fine powder, and keep it aside.
In a wide bowl combine the rice flour, urad dal powder, chili powder, salt, sesame seeds, and jeera. Mix it well, then mix in the oil.
Mix in enough water to make a dough of roti consistency.
In a deep frying pan heat enough oil for deep frying.
Once the oil is hot enough for frying, press dough into a murukku mould. Fry the murukku in batches until they are light golden brown in color.
Drain the finished fritters on a paper towel.

recipes.title: Indian Moong Dal
recipes.description: Moong dal cooked in the typical Indian way, pressure-cooked with green chiles and turmeric, then finished with cumin and curry leaves.

steps.text: Combine the dal, green chillies, turmeric powder, and water in a pressure cooker. Cook for 15 minutes, then leave the pressure cooker to release steam on its own.
Open the pressure cooker and mash the cooked dal. Add salt to taste. Add more water if it is too thick and heat over a medium heat.
Heat oil or ghee in a frying pan, then add jeera and curry leaves. After it splutters, pour it over the cooked dal.
Serve hot with rice or rotis.

recipes.title: Lemon-Lime Soda I
recipes.description: Lemon-lime soda is a carbonated beverage flavored similarly to lemon- and limeade.

steps.text: Remove the zest from the lemons and limes in strips, leaving behind the bitter white pith.
Combine the sugar and zest in a container, and let this sit in the fridge for 24 hours. The sugar will extract the liquid from the citrus peels and produce a syrupy liquid.
Strain the solids out of the peel and sugar mixture.
Mix the peel and sugar mixture with lime juice. This should produce slightly under ½ cup (120 ml) of syrup.
To make the finished soda, mix 1 volume of syrup with 5 volumes of carbonated water.

recipes.title: Mbulawu (Malawian Fermented Millet Porridge)
recipes.description: Mbulawu is a traditional Malawian fermented millet porridge. It is a nutritious and comforting breakfast option that is enjoyed by many in Malawi.

steps.text: In a saucepan, bring the water to a boil.
Gradually add the millet flour to the boiling water, stirring continuously to prevent lumps from forming.
Reduce the heat to low and let the mixture simmer for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add a pinch of salt to taste and continue stirring.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and allow the porridge to cool down to room temperature.

Once the porridge has cooled, cover it with a clean cloth and leave it to ferment overnight or for at least 8 hours. This fermentation process enhances the flavor and nutritional profile of the porridge.
The next morning, heat the vegetable oil in a separate pan.

Pour the fermented millet porridge into the pan and heat it over medium heat, stirring continuously until it reaches the desired consistency. You can add more water if you prefer a thinner consistency.
Serve warm in a bowl.

recipes.title: Spicy Plantain Chips
recipes.description: Crispy fried green plantain rounds flavored with serrano chile and garlic.

ingredients.text: 2 quarts peanut or canola oil for deep-frying
ingredients.name: olej roślinny
ingredients.note: peanut or canola oil for deep-frying

steps.text: Combine plantains, salt, black pepper, the chile, and garlic. Shape into rounds about the size of a thin slice of potato.
Heat oil to 375°F. Add rounds, 6–8 at a time, and fry until golden brown and crispy on the outside.
Drain on a cooling rack set above a sheet pan, and season immediately with salt and freshly ground black pepper.
Serve warm or room temperature.

recipes.title: Waakyne (Ghanaian Rice and Beans)
recipes.description: A popular West African meal of rice and black-eyed peas, commonly eaten for breakfast or lunch.

steps.text: Pick over the beans to remove any debris. Wash well, then drain and transfer to a pressure cooker.
Add the dried millet stalk leaves along with enough water to fully cover the beans by a couple inches.
Close the valve of the pressure cooker and leave it until it reaches its full pressure. This should not take more than 15 minutes.
Once it has reached its full pressure, reduce the heat and leave for an additional 15 minutes for the beans to cook.
Let cool down naturally and depressurize—this should take around 20 minutes. Once the pot is adequately cooled, open the lid.
Transfer the contents of the pressure cooker to another pot, and stir in the rice. If needed, add enough water to cook the rice. Season to taste with salt.
Simmer over low heat until the rice is fully cooked.
Remove the millet stalk leaves, and serve with your favourite side dish.

recipes.title: Sweet Onion Ranch Dressing
recipes.description: A slightly sweeter ranch.

steps.text: Mix all the ingredients in a large bowl.

recipes.title: Ifisashi n'ubwoko (Rwandan Peanut Spinach Stew with Mushroom)
recipes.description: A Rwandan stew combining spinach and mushrooms with a creamy peanut sauce. It is often served with steamed rice or ugali.

ingredients.text: 2 bunches of spinach, washed and chopped
ingredients.name: szpinak

steps.text: In a large pot, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and minced garlic, and sauté until the onion is translucent and fragrant.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the pot and cook for a few minutes until they begin to soften.
Add the chopped spinach to the pot and stir well to combine with the mushrooms and onion mixture.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the peanut butter and water until smooth. Pour the peanut sauce mixture into the pot.
Stir the ingredients together, ensuring that the peanut sauce coats the spinach and mushrooms evenly.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste. Stir well to incorporate the seasoning.
Reduce the heat to low and let the stew simmer for about 15–20 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld together and the spinach to wilt.
Taste and adjust the seasoning if needed.
Remove from heat and transfer to a serving dish.
Serve hot with steamed rice or ugali.

recipes.title: Chicken Bacon Broccoli Alfredo Spaghetti
recipes.description: Spaghetti with chicken, bacon and broccoli in a creamy milk and parmesan sauce.

ingredients.text: 1 cup (125 g / 4.5 oz) grated parmesan cheese
ingredients.name: parmezan

ingredients.text: ¼ cup (25 g / 1 oz) chopped parsley
ingredients.name: natka pietruszki

steps.text: Boil the spaghetti in water until al dente.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a pan over a medium heat.
Cook the chicken in oil for 4 minutes until cooked.
Add in salt, pepper, and garlic, and stir.
Stir in broccoli, then add milk and cook for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in cheese, parsley and bacon.
Drain the pasta in a colander and stir into the chicken sauce.
Divide the pasta between 4 plates and serve.

recipes.title: Balsamic Marinade
recipes.description: Balsamic vinegar adds a tangy sweetness to balance the buttery flavor of extra-virgin olive oil and the heat of cayenne pepper.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in a gallon size zip-top bag.
Add whatever you're marinating and marinate like you would normally.

recipes.title: Saffron Sweet Rice
recipes.description: Słodki ryż z szafranem, rodzynkami i migdałami, podawany jako dodatek.

ingredients.text: 1 large scoop (⅛ tsp) saffron (expensive but worth it!)
ingredients.name: szafran
ingredients.note: large scoop, expensive but worth it!

ingredients.text: ¼–½ cup slivered almonds, toasted if desired
ingredients.name: migdały

steps.text: Wash rice and add enough water cover rice with water equal to the depth of the rice.
Add salt, saffron, sugar, raisins.
Cook over high heat until water disappears and steam is rising from holes in the surface of the rice.
Reduce heat to warm.
Add almonds.
Cover tightly and let stand for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Glazed Pork Chops
recipes.description: Grilled thick-cut pork chops brushed with a reduced apple cider glaze.

ingredients.text: Grill Seasoning for Chops, as needed
ingredients.name: przyprawa do grillowania

steps.text: Rub seasoning on pork chops.
Refrigerate pork chops for 30 minutes.
Meanwhile, combine remaining ingredients in a large saucepan.
Bring to a boil over medium heat, and cook until reduced by ⅓.
Remove from heat and set aside.
Grill pork chops over high heat for 2 minutes, covered.
Brush with cider mixture, rotate 90°, and cook for 2 minutes.
Flip and repeat 1 more time.
Remove and let rest for 7 minutes.
Serve with remaining cider mixture.

recipes.title: Chicken Bog (Grand Strand)
recipes.description: A one-pot rice dish with chicken, smoked sausage and onion, cooked in its own broth.

steps.text: Boil chicken and onions in 4 cups of water until tender.
If desired, debone chicken.
Slice sausage into ½-inch pieces.
Add sausage, pepper and rice to chicken.
Simmer until all broth is absorbed and rice is cooked.

recipes.title: Herbed Corn
recipes.description: Kukurydza z masłem i zielonymi ziołami, pieczona na grillu w folii.

ingredients.text: 7 ears sweet corn, husks and silks carefully removed
ingredients.name: kukurydza

steps.text: Combine all ingredients except corn in small bowl. Mix well.
Measure about 1 tablespoon of the mixture and spread over each ear of corn.
Wrap each ear of corn in heavy foil.
Grill over medium heat 10–15 minutes, or until tender.

recipes.title: English Style Aged Cheese
recipes.description: Traditional English-style aged cheese made from unpasteurized cow's milk, rennet, and salt, aged for at least 60 days.

steps.text: Gently heat milk and bring it to blood temperature (80 °F/27 °C).
Combine rennet and water, then add to milk. Stir for 1 minute.
Cover and let it rest for 1½ hours, preferably near a fire where it can stay warm. Maintain a temperature of 80 °F (27 °C) while milk is left to coagulate under a gentle heat.
When it reaches the right consistency, stir and then separate the curds from the whey.

Cut the curds in a crisscross configuration with a long and flat wooden stick, so as to release the whey from the milk (separate the liquid part of the milk from the solid part of the milk). Do not remove curds from pot.

Cover the curds once again and let rest for 1–1½ hour. Gently stir again, and then slowly heat it all again to 100 F; if heated too fast, the heat will create a film or thin skin on the curds and the cheese will remain wet and not age properly.
Break up the curds very slowly with your hands. Strain through a fine mesh cloth, separating the curds from the whey.
Squeeze out excess water. Open up the cloth, break apart the curds, and add the salt.
Put curds into a wooden press (vice) lined with butter and a mesh-like cloth. Press to extract more of the whey from the curds.
Leave in the press for 2–3 days; in the interim, flip it over.
Remove the curd from the press.

Sprinkle a clean shelf in a cool place with a good amount salt. Set the cheese down upside-down. Leave it to age for a minimum of 60 days, flipping over every day to allow for complete drying. The longer it ages, the drier and sharper the cheese becomes.

recipes.title: Soy Ginger Barbecue Sauce
recipes.description: Sos sojowy z imbirem do grilla i marynowania mięsa.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in a mason jar.
Refrigerate for as long as either the soy sauce or the hoisin lasts, whichever comes first.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Beef Stew
recipes.description: Gulasz wołowy przygotowany w wolnowarze z marchwią, selerem, cebulą i pomidorami.

ingredients.text: 2 pounds (900 g) stew beef, cut into 1-inch (2.5 cm) cubes
ingredients.name: wołowina gulaszowa

ingredients.text: 1 whole clove or ½ tsp ground cloves
ingredients.name: goździk

steps.text: Trim all fat from meat.
Put all ingredients in crockpot; mix thoroughly.
Cover and cook on low 12 hours or on high 5 to 6 hours.
Remove bay leaves before serving.

recipes.title: Ndizi na Nyama (Tanzanian Green Bananas with Beef)
recipes.description: Ndizi na nyama (green bananas and meat) is a Tanzanian dish popular among the East African countries.

ingredients.text: 1 pound lean beef, cut into small pieces
ingredients.name: wołowina chuda

ingredients.text: 2 green (unripe) cooking bananas, peeled and quartered
ingredients.name: banan plantan

steps.text: Bring water to a boil in a saucepan.
Add beef, ginger, salt, and garlic. Cover and cook over medium-low heat for 15 minutes.
When the meat is almost done, add the oil, tomato paste, onion, and tomatoes to the pan. Cook for 5 minutes.
Add the banana to the saucepan, cover, and cook for 10–12 minutes until the banana has slightly softened.
Stir in the coconut milk, and reduce the heat to low. Cook for 15 minutes more until the banana can be readily pierced with a fork and the meat is very soft.
Season with salt to taste, and serve hot.

recipes.title: Rosemary Grilled Salmon Steaks
recipes.description: Steki z łososia grillowane z rozmarynem, marynowane w occie jabłkowym i oleju canola.

steps.text: Combine the oil, vinegar, rosemary, and pepper.
Add salmon steaks, and marinate for 15 minutes.
Place the steaks on a hot grill, cooking on each side for 3 minutes until flaky.

recipes.title: Welsh Fruit Bread (Bara Brith) III
recipes.description: A variation of bara brith that uses baking powder and bicarbonate of soda as raising agents instead of yeast; the dried fruit soaked in tea gives the loaf its taste and succulence.

steps.text: Soak the fruit in tea for several hours.
Strain, retain both fruit and tea.
Mix the flour, sugar, spice, baking powder and bicarb.
Add soaked fruit to the dry ingredients, then start to mix.
Add the egg, and continue to mix.
Add the black tea in small amounts, mixing as you go.

Continue to add the tea until the mixture is thick but runny—it should cling to a spoon, but any excess should drop off easily. If you have used up all your tea, a drop of milk can be added instead to achieve this consistency.
Add the chopped glace cherries, which will further increase the moisture of the batter.
Pour into a greased baking tin, and bake at 190°C for approximately 90 minutes. Loosely cover the top with foil for the first hour, to avoid burning. Once cooked, turn out and cool.
Serve sliced with butter and a cup of tea.

recipes.title: Scorched rice
recipes.description: Crispy golden layer of rice formed on the bottom of the pot, a dish found in many cuisines around the world.

ingredients.text: 2 tbsp vegetable oil, butter, or other cooking fat
ingredients.name: olej roślinny
ingredients.note: vegetable oil, butter, or other cooking fat

steps.text: Rinse the rice thoroughly until the water runs clear.
Soak the rice for 20–30 minutes if desired, then drain.
Bring the water and salt to a boil in a heavy-bottomed pot.
Add the rice and cook until most of the water has been absorbed.
Reduce the heat to very low.
Drizzle the oil or melted butter around the edges of the pot.
Cover the pot tightly with a lid.
Continue cooking for 20–30 minutes without stirring.
Allow a golden-brown crust to form on the bottom of the pot.
Remove the pot from the heat and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Carefully loosen the rice from the sides of the pot.
Invert onto a serving plate or gently remove the crispy layer with a spatula.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Yellow Saffron Food Coloring
recipes.description: This homemade food coloring derives its color from saffron.

ingredients.text: ½ cup (100 g) plus 1 tablespoon white granulated sugar
ingredients.name: cukier biały

steps.text: Use a pestle and mortar to crush the saffron and 1 tablespoon sugar together into a fine powder.
Combine the powder in a saucepan with the water and the rest of the sugar.
Turn the heat to medium-high, and stir to dissolve the sugar.
Simmer until the liquid reduces to a single-thread consistency.
Turn off the heat and stir in the lemon juice.
Cool slightly, then pour into an airtight jar and cool completely.

categories: Recipes using vegetable broth and stock

recipes.title: Zimbabwean Chicken and Vegetable Soup
recipes.description: Zimbabwean chicken and vegetable soup is a delicious soup that combines a variety of vegetables with peanut butter and a few red pepper flakes.

ingredients.text: 2 cups canned diced tomatoes, with juices
ingredients.name: pomidory

ingredients.text: ¼ teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes, or more to taste
ingredients.name: płatki chili

ingredients.text: 1 cup chopped cooked chicken, or to taste
ingredients.name: mięso z kurczaka

steps.text: Heat the olive oil in the pot over medium heat.
Add the onion, and sauté for about 5 minutes until translucent.
Stir ½ cup of the vegetable stock and the peanut butter into the onions until the mixture looks smooth.
Stir in the remaining vegetable stock, diced tomatoes with their liquid, and crushed red pepper flakes; simmer for 30 minutes, stirring frequently.
Stir in the cabbage, sweet potato, carrot, and turnip. Simmer, stirring, until the vegetables become soft (about 30 minutes).
Stir in the okra and chicken, and simmer for about 30 additional minutes.

recipes.title: Sparkling Lemonade with Fresh Herbs
recipes.description: A refreshing sparkling lemonade made with lemon juice, sugar, carbonated water and fresh mint or lemon balm.

ingredients.text: A few leaves of fresh mint and/or lemon balm (Melissa officinalis)
ingredients.name: mięta świeża
ingredients.note: a few leaves of fresh mint and/or lemon balm (Melissa officinalis)

steps.text: Juice the lemons, and dissolve the sugar in the juice.
Add carbonated water and the fresh herb leaves.
Serve cold.

recipes.title: Tangy Lemon Mousse
recipes.description: A tangy lemon mousse made with lemon juice and zest, egg yolks, butter and whipped cream, chilled briefly before serving.

ingredients.text: ¼ cup pasteurized egg product, or 2 pasteurized egg yolks, beaten
ingredients.name: żółtko jaja
ingredients.note: pasteurized egg product, or 2 pasteurized egg yolks, beaten

ingredients.text: 2 cups heavy cream, whipped to soft peaks
ingredients.name: śmietanka 36%

steps.text: Combine all ingredients except for whipped cream.
Gently fold in the whipped cream.
Refrigerate for 20 minutes and serve.

recipes.title: Cornbread Stuffed Zucchini
recipes.description: Small zucchini halves filled with a cornbread, cream cheese and egg soufflé mixture, topped with cornbread and Monterey Jack cheese and baked.

ingredients.text: 1 ½ cups grated Monterey Jack cheese
ingredients.name: ser Monterey Jack

steps.text: Scoop out the column of seeds in zucchini halves using a teaspoon or a grapefruit spoon. Set aside.
Combine 1 cup cornbread with salt, pepper, egg yolks, and cream cheese. Set aside.
Whip egg whites to stiff peaks with cream of tartar. Stir in ¼ of the egg whites.
Gently fold in remaining egg whites. Place enough mixture to fill the column in the zucchini.
Combine remaining cornbread and Monterey Jack cheese. Sprinkle over top of each zucchini half.
Bake in a 400°F oven for 30–35 minutes or until browned and bubbly on top. Serve warm.

ingredients.text: 6 ancho chiles, stemmed and finely chopped
ingredients.name: papryczka ancho suszona

ingredients.text: 3 dried arbol chiles, stemmed and finely chopped
ingredients.name: papryczka arbol suszona

steps.text: Blend everything in a blender, food processor, or spice grinder until it is a fine powder.

recipes.title: Spanish Potato Omelette
recipes.description: Tortilla de patatas, a typical Spanish omelette often served as a tapa; it can also be cooked without onions.

steps.text: Peel the potatoes, wash them, and dry them with a cloth.
Cut them into 1 cm cubes or 2 mm slices.
Wash and dry them again.
Add some salt to your taste and mix them.
Heat the oil; when hot, fry the potatoes, but do not let them get brown.
Once they're done, drain the oil and store the potatoes.
Dice or slice the onion; fry it until it is translucent.
Beat the 8 eggs in a bowl with a small amount of salt until the mix is homogenous.
Then, mix in the potatoes and the onion.
Heat 3 tablespoons of olive oil in an empty pan – you can use the previous pan after removing most of the oil.
Once the pan is hot, add the egg with the onion and the potatoes.
After 7–8 minutes, the bottom part should be done.
Put the dish over the pan and carefully turn it around so that the undone part rests on the dish. This is the most difficult step of the recipe.
Put the pan on the fire again and slowly slide the mix into the pan to cook the other side.
After a couple of additional minutes, it should be done and ready to serve.

categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

recipes.title: Shrimp Curry
recipes.description: Shrimp sautéed in a pan with onion, garlic, curry powder, chicken broth and red curry paste.

ingredients.text: 1 pound peeled, deveined jumbo shrimp, heads removed
ingredients.name: krewetki
ingredients.note: peeled, deveined jumbo shrimp, heads removed

steps.text: Heat oil in a large stainless steel sauté pan over medium high heat.
Add shrimp and sauté just until bright pink. Remove and keep warm.
Melt ghee in same pan. Add vegetables and sauté until browned around edges.
Add remaining ingredients and shrimp and toss to coat. Reduce heat to medium low and cook until shrimp are heated through.
Remove and serve.

recipes.title: Ove (Nigerian Yam Moi Moi)
recipes.description: Ove is a typical Nigerian pudding prepared from yam.

steps.text: Remove unwanted substances from the fish. Then, rinse and cook for few minutes.
Combine the groundnut oil, onion, pepper paste, and fish to make a sauce.
Stir the sauce into the grated yam along with the salt.
Wrap this mixture up in the leaf, then boil for a few minutes to cook it.

recipes.title: Oral Rehydration Solution
recipes.description: Oral rehydration solution (ORS) is a life-saving solution of sugar, salt, and water, formulated to treat dehydration caused by diarrhea, heat, or vomiting.

ingredients.text: ½ level teaspoon (~3.5 g) table salt
ingredients.name: sól

steps.text: Dissolve the salt and sugar completely in the water, stirring until fully mixed.
If needed, warming the solution can help dissolve the salt and sugar.

recipes.title: Sambar II (Kerala/Tamil style)
recipes.description: A vegan South Indian lentil and vegetable stew flavoured with tamarind, coconut and roasted spices.

ingredients.text: 2 cups mixed vegetables (small onions, tomato, drumstick)
ingredients.name: mieszanka warzyw

ingredients.text: Coriander leaves and curry leaves for garnishing, finely chopped
ingredients.name: liście kolendry

steps.text: Wash and cook the dal until soft. Mash it.
Heat the pan and add 1 tsp oil.
Add asafoetida, chili powder, coriander powder, and coriander seeds. Fry them well.
Add coconut and fry until the mixture is dark red in colour (do not burn it). Remove from heat and let cool.
Wash the vegetables, and boil them in a pot of water with the turmeric powder.
When the vegetables are almost done, add tamarind paste and allow it to boil for some time.
Grind the coconut mixture, then mix in the mashed dal. Stir this combination into the pot of vegetables, and let it boil for some time.
Season with salt to taste, and mix in the mustard seed and curry leaves.
Serve hot, garnished with the coriander leaves.

recipes.title: Hlib t'mer (Algerian Date Milk)
recipes.description: Algerian drink from the Sahara made with camel milk and dates.

steps.text: Remove the seeds from the dates and check if there are any worms inside them.
Boil the dates with water and sugar for a few minutes until you feel the dates are well-cooked.
Turn off the heat, blend the date mixture, and strain it as well as possible.
Pour the resulting date syrup into your cup of milk.

recipes.title: Nigerian Yanrin
recipes.description: Traditional Yoruba delicacy made from tiny freshwater crustaceans, used in soups and stews.

ingredients.text: A handful of scent leaves or basil leaves
ingredients.name: liście bazylii

steps.text: Rinse the yanrin thoroughly several times to remove sand.
Blend or pound the peppers roughly.
Put water, onions, peppers, seasoning, spice, and iru into a pot.
Bring to a boil for about 10 minutes.
Add the yanrin and cook for another 10–15 minutes.
Add scent leaves last.
Taste and adjust salt/spices.

ingredients.text: 2 slabs St. Louis style/cut pork spareribs
ingredients.name: żeberka wieprzowe

steps.text: Season ribs with the Barbecue Rub.
Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Place applewood in the firebox of a 250°F smoker or in the coal area of a 250°F charcoal grill set for indirect heat.
Combine remaining ingredients and bring to a boil over high heat until reduced by ⅓.
Cover tightly and set aside.
Place ribs in smoker/on top of grill grate and cook, brushing often with preserve mixture, for 5–6 hours.
Brush ribs generously with preserve mixture and place on a medium high grill and cook, repeatedly brushing side facing you, until well browned.
Repeat one more time.
Remove and let rest 10 minutes.
Slice into 1-rib portions and serve.

recipes.title: Seasoned Bread and Butter Balls
recipes.description: Small bread balls seasoned with garlic powder and oregano, warmed in the microwave with butter.

steps.text: Remove crusts from bread, and add other ingredients onto a microwave safe plate.
Make each slice of bread into ball, and lay on same plate.
Microwave plate for 25 seconds, wait 30 seconds, and serve.

recipes.title: Guacamole (Chile-Free)
recipes.description: A simple guacamole made from ripe avocados, garlic, lime juice, red onion, tomato and cilantro.

ingredients.text: 1 small red onion, diced very small
ingredients.name: cebula czerwona

steps.text: Put everything except the avocados into a medium-sized mixing bowl.
Halve the avocados and scoop the flesh into the bowl. Using a large fork (or a blender), mash the avocados and combine with all the other ingredients.
Taste the mixture and add anything you think necessary (be aware that the flavors, especially the lime, will soften a little by the time it is served).
Cover and refrigerate for at least an hour to allow the flavors to blend.
When it is removed from the refrigerator, there may be some brown on the top – you can scrape that off, but it isn't harmful.
Using a covering that is in full contact with the surface of the guacamole (for example, some plastic wrap that's pressed right down into the food) may help.

recipes.title: Mini Herb Baguettes
recipes.description: Małe bagietki z oregano, rozmarynem i tymiankiem, pieczone w 200°C.

steps.text: Combine flour, yeast, salt, powdered oregano, rosemary powder, and thyme.
Gradually mix the water into the flour, kneading until elastic.
Let stand 30 minutes.
Weigh out 100 grams of dough, and let rest for 10 minutes.
Shape the dough into a long loaf. Repeat with remaining dough.
Transfer loaves to a baking sheet sprinkled with flour.
Make slices in the top with a sharp knife or blade.
Let rise 50 minutes until fluffy.
Spray loaves with water.
Bake 25 minutes in a 200°C oven until cooked through.

recipes.title: Serbian Flatbread (Lepinja)
recipes.description: A simple yeasted Serbian flatbread baked in a greased pan.

steps.text: Mix sugar, salt, and yeast into a little warm milk. Let stand for a few minutes until foamy.
Mix the yeast mixture into the flour.
Add the warm water, and knead the dough until it doesn't stick to your fingers.
Cover dough with a cloth, and put it in warm place (for instance near a heater) until doubled in size.
Knead the dough again, and let rest until it doubles again.
Knead it some more, and sprinkle with some flour.
Put the dough in the greased pan in which you plan to bake it, spreading it out until it's about ½ inch thick. Let rest for about half an hour.
Bake in a 400–420°F oven until golden an inserted toothpick comes out clean.

recipes.title: Italian Garlic and Herb Marinade
recipes.description: Marynata czosnkowo-ziołowa w stylu włoskim na bazie czerwonego wina.

ingredients.text: ½ cup red wine, preferably from an Italian region
ingredients.name: wino czerwone wytrawne

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in the dish you're going to marinate your food in.
Refrigerate for up to 2 weeks.

recipes.title: Roasted Redskin Potatoes
recipes.description: Red-skinned potatoes are boiled until tender, then tossed with olive oil, bay leaves and herbs and roasted until browned.

steps.text: Put potatoes and bay leaves in a large Dutch oven. Add enough water to cover, bring to a rolling boil and cook for 15 minutes or until tender.
Drain and shock. Drain again, discard bay leaves and pat dry with paper towels.
Whisk together oil and remaining ingredients. Add potatoes and toss to coat.
Bake in a 425°F oven for 10 minutes or until lightly to deeply brown. Serve.

categories: Recipes using beef broth and stock

recipes.title: Quick and Easy Beef Stroganoff
recipes.description: Szybki stroganow wołowy z makaronem jajecznym, sosem grzybowym i śmietaną kwaśną.

ingredients.text: 1 can (8 oz / 250 g) cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.name: zupa krem z grzybów

ingredients.text: ½ can (4 oz / 125 ml) beef broth
ingredients.name: bulion wołowy

steps.text: Cook egg noodles in a large pot according to directions.
While egg noodles cook, season the beef with salt and pepper and brown the meat in a skillet unless it is already cooked.
Low and slow makes a tender product.
If meat is already cooked, heat the meat in the microwave or in a skillet.
Drain egg noodles.
Mix cream of mushroom soup, beef broth, and sour cream in the pot used for the egg noodles.
Season the sauce with salt and pepper keeping in mind that many of the ingredients contain plenty of salt.
Add noodle mixture with beef and serve.

recipes.title: Mbatata a matenda (Malawian Cassava Fritters)
recipes.description: Mbatata a matenda is a popular Malawian snack made from cassava. These cassava fritters are crispy on the outside, soft on the inside, and bursting with flavor.

ingredients.text: 2 green chiles (optional, for heat), finely chopped
ingredients.name: papryczka chili

steps.text: In a mixing bowl, combine the grated cassava, beaten egg, finely chopped onion, and finely chopped green chilies (if using).
Add the cornmeal to the mixture and mix well until everything is evenly combined.
Season the mixture with salt to taste. Adjust the seasoning according to your preference.
In a frying pan, heat vegetable oil over medium-high heat.
Take spoonfuls of the cassava mixture and carefully drop them into the hot oil. Flatten the fritters slightly with the back of the spoon.
Fry the fritters until they are golden brown and crispy on both sides. Use a slotted spoon to remove them from the oil and place them on paper towels to drain any excess oil.
Repeat the frying process with the remaining cassava mixture.
Allow the fritters to cool slightly before serving.

recipes.title: Sombi
recipes.description: Sombi is a traditional West African dish, especially popular in Senegal. Made with rice and coconut milk, it is served as a creamy, mildly sweet porridge or dessert.

ingredients.text: * 1 cup unsweetened shredded coconut (fresh or dried)
ingredients.name: wiórki kokosowe

ingredients.text: *½ cup packed light or dark brown sugar
ingredients.name: cukier trzcinowy brązowy

steps.text: In a medium saucepan over medium heat, combine the coconut milk, shredded coconut, brown sugar, salt, and vanilla bean seeds. Bring the mixture to a gentle boil, stirring frequently.
Cook for about 5 minutes, or until slightly reduced.
Add the cooked white rice and continue to stir.
Cook for another 5 minutes, or until the rice begins to break down and the mixture thickens into a porridge-like consistency.
Remove the saucepan from heat and stir in the fresh lime juice.
Serve hot as a warm, mildly sweet dessert or breakfast porridge.

recipes.title: Homemade Herbes de Provence
recipes.description: A fairly standard mixture of the herbs traditionally used in the cooking of Provence, France.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients, and mix until blended.

recipes.title: Smoky Tuna Melts
recipes.description: Tuna melts with smoked mozzarella on white bread, flavored with butter and lemon juice.

ingredients.text: 1 container (4.5 oz) hickory smoke-flavored albacore tuna
ingredients.name: tuńczyk w puszce

steps.text: Combine tuna, melted butter, and lemon juice.
Spread some of the tuna mixture on each slice of bread.
Top with cheese.
Broil until the cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Pasta with Vegetables
recipes.description: Spaghetti cooked with chopped tomato and cucumber, tossed with butter or oil, onion and pasta sauce or ketchup.

steps.text: Bring 2 liters water to a boil with the salt.
Add spaghetti to boiling water. Cook for 4 minutes.
Add chopped tomatoes and cucumber to the boiling pasta. Boil for another 5 minutes.
Drain the water, add the butter or oil, and mix in the chopped onion.
Mix in sauce or ketchup, and serve.
